_comment: 原創翻譯層：上游模組自帶 EN 文本但 As1 未收錄的鍵。人工真相檔（手編或工作流生成後人工審核）。
_usage: schema：entries.<檔名>.<鍵> = {en, ch, cn}。en=擷取當時上游原文（供過時比對）；ch=直寫繁中台灣用語（不經 OpenCC）；cn=直寫簡中大陸用語（**同樣不經 OpenCC，不得由 ch 機轉產生**）。與 As1 同鍵時 As1 優先，build 會提示退役該條目。

ContextMenu_CU_CarryWho.en: There is nobody there to carry.

ContextMenu_CU_Cures.en: Cutting away every bite should stop the infection.

ContextMenu_CU_Cures.cn: 切除所有咬伤应该能阻止感染.

ContextMenu_CU_Debug_Ep_fibrillation.cn: 心室颤动 (敏感内容替代版)

ContextMenu_CU_Debug_HealMind.en: Give back the eyes, the brain, the face

ContextMenu_CU_Debug_HealMind.cn: 还回眼睛, 大脑, 脸

ContextMenu_CU_Defib_Hands.en: You need both hands for the pads.

ContextMenu_CU_Defib_None.en: You have no defibrillator, or its battery is flat.
ContextMenu_CU_Defib_None.ch: 你沒有去顫器, 或是電池沒電了.
ContextMenu_CU_Defib_None.cn: 你没有除颤器, 或者电池没电了.

ContextMenu_CU_Defib_Pointless.en: %1. Shocking a heart that is working will stop it.
ContextMenu_CU_Defib_Pointless.ch: %1. 電擊正常跳動的心臟會讓它停止.
ContextMenu_CU_Defib_Pointless.cn: %1. 电击正常跳动的心脏会让它停跳.

ContextMenu_CU_Defib_Who.en: There is nobody there to shock.

ContextMenu_CU_Defib_Worth.en: %1. A shock could put this heart back.
ContextMenu_CU_Defib_Worth.ch: %1. 電擊或許能讓這顆心臟恢復跳動.
ContextMenu_CU_Defib_Worth.cn: %1. 电击或许能让这颗心脏恢复跳动.

ContextMenu_CU_DissectDone.en: This body has already been opened.
ContextMenu_CU_DissectDone.ch: 這具屍體已經被剖開過了.
ContextMenu_CU_DissectDone.cn: 这具尸体已经被剖开过了.

ContextMenu_CU_DissectNoBlade.en: You need a scalpel or a knife.

ContextMenu_CU_DissectWhy.en: Open the body and learn from what is inside: First Aid experience, and the names of what can go wrong in it. A slip cuts your own hand, and the dead can carry the infection: wear gloves.
ContextMenu_CU_DissectWhy.ch: 剖開屍體, 從體內學習: 獲得急救經驗, 並認識體內可能出錯的各種病症名稱. 一不小心會割傷自己的手, 而且死者可能帶有感染: 請戴上手套.
ContextMenu_CU_DissectWhy.cn: 剖开尸体, 从体内学习: 获得急救经验, 并认识体内可能出问题的各种病症名称. 一不小心会割伤自己的手, 而且死者可能携带感染: 请戴上手套.

ContextMenu_CU_Dose_Asleep.en: They cannot swallow while they are out. An injection would still go in.
ContextMenu_CU_Dose_Asleep.ch: 對方昏迷時無法吞嚥. 但仍然可以注射.
ContextMenu_CU_Dose_Asleep.cn: 对方昏迷时无法吞咽. 但仍然可以注射.

ContextMenu_CU_Dose_Hands.en: You need both hands to give somebody a dose.
ContextMenu_CU_Dose_Hands.ch: 你需要雙手才能給別人用藥.
ContextMenu_CU_Dose_Hands.cn: 你需要双手才能给别人用药.

ContextMenu_CU_Dose_What.en: That is not medicine. Pills, syringes and the mod's own bottles can be given to somebody else.
ContextMenu_CU_Dose_What.ch: 那不是藥物. 藥丸, 注射器以及本模組提供的藥瓶可以給予他人.
ContextMenu_CU_Dose_What.cn: 那不是药物. 药丸, 注射器以及本模组自带的药瓶可以给予他人.

ContextMenu_CU_Dose_Who.en: There is nobody there to give it to.

ContextMenu_CU_FatalBite.en: A bite on the chest, neck or head cannot be cut away. There is no limb to take.
ContextMenu_CU_FatalBite.ch: 胸部, 頸部或頭部的咬傷無法切除. 沒有可截去的肢體.
ContextMenu_CU_FatalBite.cn: 胸部, 颈部或头部的咬伤无法切除. 没有可截去的肢体.

ContextMenu_CU_NeedHotBlade.en: Heat a blade to %1 C first. Hottest: %2 C.
ContextMenu_CU_NeedHotBlade.ch: 先將刀刃加熱至%1 °C. 目前最高: %2 °C.
ContextMenu_CU_NeedHotBlade.cn: 先将刀刃加热至%1 °C. 当前最高: %2 °C.

ContextMenu_CU_NeedSaw.en: You have no saw. Hardware stores, garages and toolboxes have them.
ContextMenu_CU_NeedSaw.ch: 你沒有鋸子. 五金行, 車庫和工具箱裡都找得到.
ContextMenu_CU_NeedSaw.cn: 你没有锯子. 五金店, 车库和工具箱里都能找到.

ContextMenu_CU_NoHeatTool.en: You have nothing metal to sear with. A knife or a scalpel, heated in a fire until it glows.
ContextMenu_CU_NoHeatTool.ch: 你沒有可用來燒灼的金屬. 刀子或手術刀, 放進火裡加熱到發紅即可.
ContextMenu_CU_NoHeatTool.cn: 你没有可用来烧灼的金属. 刀或手术刀, 放进火里加热到发红即可.

ContextMenu_CU_NoProsthetic.en: You have no %1. They turn up in hospitals and medical clinics.
ContextMenu_CU_NoProsthetic.ch: 你沒有%1. 醫院和診所裡可以找到.
ContextMenu_CU_NoProsthetic.cn: 你没有%1. 医院和诊所里可以找到.

ContextMenu_CU_Proc_Hands.en: This takes both hands, and one of yours is gone or unusable.
ContextMenu_CU_Proc_Hands.ch: 這需要雙手, 而你有一隻手已經失去或無法使用.
ContextMenu_CU_Proc_Hands.cn: 这需要双手, 而你有一只手已经没了或无法使用.

ContextMenu_CU_Proc_Missing.en: You are missing the thing this takes - see the line below.
ContextMenu_CU_Proc_Missing.ch: 你缺少這項處置所需的東西 - 請看下一行.
ContextMenu_CU_Proc_Missing.cn: 你缺少这项处置所需的东西 - 请看下一行.

ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NeedBandage.en: You have no dressing. A bandage, a ripped sheet or a rag will do.
ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NeedBandage.ch: 你沒有敷料. 繃帶, 碎布或破布都行.
ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NeedBandage.cn: 你没有敷料. 绷带, 碎布条或破布都行.

ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NeedBlade.en: You have no blade. Any knife or scalpel will do.
ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NeedBlade.ch: 你沒有刀刃. 任何刀子或手術刀都行.
ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NeedBlade.cn: 你没有刀刃. 任何刀或手术刀都行.

ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NeedNeedle.en: You have no decompression needle, and nothing else will reach.
ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NeedNeedle.ch: 你沒有減壓針, 其他東西都刺不到那麼深.
ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NeedNeedle.cn: 你没有减压针, 别的东西都扎不到那么深.

ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NeedNothing.ch: 不需要. 你的雙手就夠了.
ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NeedNothing.cn: 不需要. 你的双手就够了.

ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NeedSaline.en: You have no bag of saline.

ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NotNeeded.en: Nothing on this person's problem list needs it yet.
ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NotNeeded.ch: 這個人的問題清單上目前還沒有需要這項處置的狀況.
ContextMenu_CU_Proc_NotNeeded.cn: 这个人的问题清单上目前还没有需要这项处置的状况.

ContextMenu_CU_StumpClosing.en: Keep it bandaged and it will close in about %1 hours.
ContextMenu_CU_StumpClosing.ch: 保持包紮, 約 %1 小時後就會癒合.
ContextMenu_CU_StumpClosing.cn: 保持包扎, 大约 %1 小时后就会愈合.

ContextMenu_CU_StumpNotSealed.en: The stump is still open. Heat a blade in a fire until it glows, then cauterize it.
ContextMenu_CU_StumpNotSealed.ch: 殘肢傷口仍未閉合. 把刀刃放在火上燒到發紅, 再用它燒灼止血.
ContextMenu_CU_StumpNotSealed.cn: 残肢伤口仍未闭合. 把刀刃放在火上烧到发红, 再用它烧灼止血.

ContextMenu_CU_TourniquetApply_Tip.en: Temporary bleeding control. Pain and stiffness after %1 game minutes; tissue damage after %2.
ContextMenu_CU_TourniquetApply_Tip.ch: 暫時控制出血. 經過 %1 遊戲分鐘後會開始疼痛和僵硬, 超過 %2 後會造成組織損傷.
ContextMenu_CU_TourniquetApply_Tip.cn: 暂时控制出血. 经过 %1 游戏分钟后会开始疼痛和僵硬, 超过 %2 后会造成组织损伤.

ContextMenu_CU_TourniquetNone.en: You have no tourniquet. Clinics and ambulances carry them, or make one from ripped sheets and a stick.
ContextMenu_CU_TourniquetNone.ch: 你沒有止血帶. 診所和救護車上都有, 也可以用碎布和木棍自製.
ContextMenu_CU_TourniquetNone.cn: 你没有止血带. 诊所和救护车上都有, 也可以用碎布条和木棍自制.

ContextMenu_CU_TourniquetRemove_Tip.en: Bleeding can resume. Dress the wound before removing it. Left on too long, it damages the limb.
ContextMenu_CU_TourniquetRemove_Tip.ch: 可能會再次出血. 解開前先包紮傷口. 綁太久會損傷肢體.
ContextMenu_CU_TourniquetRemove_Tip.cn: 可能会再次出血. 解开前先包扎伤口. 绑太久会损伤肢体.

ContextMenu_CU_WontCure.en: The infection has spread past this limb. This will not save you.
ContextMenu_CU_WontCure.ch: 感染已經擴散到這條肢體以外. 這救不了你.
ContextMenu_CU_WontCure.cn: 感染已经扩散到这条肢体以外. 这救不了你.

ContextMenu_TABAS_MissingWaterData.en: Bath water data is missing or has not loaded yet. If the two halves are incomplete or do not match, use Remove Leftover Bath Water.
ContextMenu_TABAS_MissingWaterData.ch: 洗澡水資料遺失或尚未載入. 若浴缸的兩半不完整或不一致, 請使用「移除殘留洗澡水」.
ContextMenu_TABAS_MissingWaterData.cn: 洗澡水数据丢失或尚未加载. 若浴缸的两半不完整或不一致, 请使用“移除残留洗澡水”.

ContextMenu_TABAS_RecoverWaterHint.en: Discards leftover water when one half is missing or the two halves do not match, and resets the water data. Keeps the bathtub. Put the stopper in again to refill.
ContextMenu_TABAS_RecoverWaterHint.ch: 當浴缸其中一半遺失或兩半不一致時, 捨棄殘留的水並重設水量資料. 浴缸本身會保留. 重新放置浴缸塞即可再次注水.
ContextMenu_TABAS_RecoverWaterHint.cn: 当浴缸其中一半缺失或两半不一致时, 舍弃残留的水并重置水量数据. 浴缸本身会保留. 重新放置浴缸塞即可再次注水.

ContextMenu_CU_CraftCrude_Need.en: You need %1 pieces of scrap wood and some duct tape. With no hands, gnaw wood off a wooden wall, door or crate.
ContextMenu_CU_CraftCrude_Need.ch: 你需要 %1 塊廢木材和一些布膠帶. 沒有手的話, 可以從木牆、木門或木箱上啃下木頭.
ContextMenu_CU_CraftCrude_Need.cn: 你需要 %1 块废木材和一些管道胶带. 没有手的话, 可以从木墙、木门或木箱上啃下木头.

ContextMenu_CU_CraftCrude_Tip.en: Lash five pieces of scrap wood together with duct tape. It is slow, cannot climb, and breaks easily, but it is something.
ContextMenu_CU_CraftCrude_Tip.ch: 用布膠帶把五塊廢木材綁在一起. 它很慢、無法攀爬, 又容易壞, 但總比沒有好.
ContextMenu_CU_CraftCrude_Tip.cn: 用管道胶带把五块废木材绑在一起. 它很慢、无法攀爬, 又容易坏, 但总比没有强.

ContextMenu_CU_GnawEmpty.en: There is nothing left of it to bite off.
ContextMenu_CU_GnawEmpty.ch: 上面已經沒有東西可以咬下來了.
ContextMenu_CU_GnawEmpty.cn: 上面已经没有东西可以咬下来了.

ContextMenu_CU_Gnaw_Tip.en: With no hands left, you can still bite splinters of wood off a wooden object. It hurts, and it wears the object down. Five pieces and some duct tape make a crude prosthetic.
ContextMenu_CU_Gnaw_Tip.ch: 就算沒有手, 你仍然可以從木製物件上咬下木片. 這很痛, 也會損耗那個物件. 五塊廢木材加上一些布膠帶, 就能做成簡易義肢.
ContextMenu_CU_Gnaw_Tip.cn: 就算没有手, 你仍然可以从木制物件上咬下木片. 这很痛, 也会损耗那个物件. 五块废木材加上一些管道胶带, 就能做成简易假肢.

IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_RV_ArcaneCacheCont.cn: 法术书、仪式手册或研究

IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_RV_Purify.en: Purifies water and restores spoiled food
IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_RV_Purify.ch: 淨化水源並復原腐敗食物
IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_RV_Purify.cn: 净化水源并复原腐败食物

IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_RV_PurifyCleanses.en: Blood, dirt, clothing, and carried items
IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_RV_PurifyCleanses.ch: 血跡、汙垢、衣物與攜帶物品
IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_RV_PurifyCleanses.cn: 血迹、污垢、衣物与携带物品

IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_RV_WorldMapTelepor.en: Enables teleportation from the world map

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_blast_wave.en: Blast hits multiple zombies in the impact area.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_blast_wave.ch: 衝擊波會打中衝擊範圍內的多名殭屍.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_blast_wave.cn: 冲击波会打中冲击范围内的多名僵尸.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_blink.en: Triggers a Repulsion pulse at destination.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_blink.ch: 在目的地觸發一道排斥術脈衝.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_blink.cn: 在目的地触发一道排斥术脉冲.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_heal.en: Heals one additional body part at 40%% normal heal.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_heal.ch: 再治療一個部位, 效果為一般治療的 40%%.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_heal.cn: 再治疗一个部位, 效果为一般治疗的 40%%.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_mage_bolt.en: +1 secondary target within 1.0 tile at 35%% damage.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_mage_bolt.ch: 1.0 格內額外 1 個次要目標, 傷害 35%%.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_mage_bolt.cn: 1.0 格内额外 1 个次要目标, 伤害 35%%.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_shield.en: Blocked hits auto-cast a weaker Repulsion pulse.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_shield.ch: 格擋到的攻擊會自動施放較弱的排斥術脈衝.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellAugment_shield.cn: 格挡到的攻击会自动施放较弱的排斥术脉冲.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_arc_lash.en: Short cone arc that shocks and stumbles nearby enemies.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_arc_lash.ch: 短錐電弧, 電擊並絆倒附近敵人.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_arc_lash.cn: 短锥电弧, 电击并绊倒附近敌人.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_blast_wave.en: Explosive frontal wave that damages enemies and structures.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_blast_wave.ch: 正面爆炸波, 傷害敵人與結構.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_blast_wave.cn: 正面爆炸波, 伤害敌人与结构.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_blink.en: Short-range teleport to a target location.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_bulwark_skin.en: Briefly hardens your body to reduce incoming damage.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_bulwark_skin.ch: 短暫硬化身體, 減少受到的傷害.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_bulwark_skin.cn: 短暂硬化身体, 减少受到的伤害.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_cauterize.en: Quick emergency treatment for wounds and bleeding.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_cauterize.ch: 快速處理傷口與出血的急救法術.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_cauterize.cn: 快速处理伤口与出血的急救法术.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_chain_arc.en: Electric bolt that jumps between nearby zombies with falloff.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_chain_arc.ch: 在附近殭屍間跳躍的電箭, 傷害遞減.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_chain_arc.cn: 在附近僵尸间跳跃的电箭, 伤害递减.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_comet_lance.en: Long-range penetrating beam with heavy damage and long cooldown.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_comet_lance.ch: 遠距貫穿光束, 高傷害、長冷卻.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_comet_lance.cn: 远距贯穿光束, 高伤害、长冷却.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_cure.en: Advanced curative spell for severe conditions.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_cure.ch: 處理嚴重狀態的進階治癒法術.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_cure.cn: 处理严重状态的进阶治愈法术.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_fire_bolt.en: Ranged fire bolt that damages and ignites targets.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_fire_bolt.ch: 遠程火焰箭, 傷害並點燃目標.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_fire_bolt.cn: 远程火焰箭, 伤害并点燃目标.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_flame_gout.en: Forward cone of flame that burns enemies and terrain.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_flame_gout.ch: 前方火錐, 燒傷敵人與地形.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_flame_gout.cn: 前方火锥, 烧伤敌人与地形.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_frost_field.en: Cold field that damages and slows enemies in an area.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_frost_field.ch: 寒冷領域, 傷害並減緩範圍內敵人.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_frost_field.cn: 寒冷领域, 伤害并减缓范围内敌人.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_heal.ch: 恢復損傷最重的身體部位.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_heal.cn: 恢复损伤最重的身体部位.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_home.en: Set or return to your home anchor point.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_last_aegis.en: Emergency ward that clears ordinary wound infections and mitigates damage. Does not cure Knox infection.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_last_aegis.ch: 緊急結界, 可清除一般傷口感染並減輕傷害. 無法治癒諾克斯感染.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_last_aegis.cn: 紧急结界, 可清除普通伤口感染并减轻伤害. 无法治愈诺克斯感染.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_light.en: Creates a temporary light source at target point.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_light.ch: 在目標點製造暫時光源.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_light.cn: 在目标点制造暂时光源.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_mage_bolt.en: Focused ranged bolt that damages one target.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_mage_bolt.ch: 集中遠程魔力箭, 傷害單一目標.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_mage_bolt.cn: 集中远程魔力箭, 伤害单一目标.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_mage_lance.en: Piercing lance that can strike multiple aligned targets.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_mage_lance.ch: 貫穿長矛, 可擊中直線上多名目標.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_mage_lance.cn: 贯穿长矛, 可击中直线上多名目标.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_mark.en: Stores a travel mark at a visible location.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_mark.ch: 在可見位置儲存一個旅行標記.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_mark.cn: 在可见位置保存一个旅行标记.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_mend_wound.en: Closes a random minor wound and eases pain.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_mend_wound.ch: 閉合一處隨機輕傷並減輕疼痛.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_mend_wound.cn: 闭合一处随机轻伤并减轻疼痛.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_phase_walk.en: Briefly phase through walls and obstacles.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_recall.en: Teleports you to a saved mark.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_repair.en: Repairs target item condition with magic.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_repair.ch: 以魔法修復目標物品的狀態.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_repair.cn: 以魔法修复目标物品的状态.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_repulsion.en: Area pulse that knocks zombies away from you.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_repulsion.ch: 範圍脈衝, 把殭屍從你身邊推開.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_repulsion.cn: 范围脉冲, 把僵尸从你身边推开.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_sanctuary_field.en: Sustained anti-zombie ward that repeatedly pushes threats away.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_sanctuary_field.ch: 持續驅趕結界, 反覆把威脅推開.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_sanctuary_field.cn: 持续驱赶结界, 反复把威胁推开.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_shield.en: Protective ward that blocks incoming attacks near you.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_shield.ch: 防護結界, 格擋你附近的來襲攻擊.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_shield.cn: 防护结界, 格挡你附近的来袭攻击.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_ward_candle.en: Carries a moving light and steadily calms panic.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_ward_candle.ch: 帶著移動光源, 並穩定安撫恐慌.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellDesc_ward_candle.cn: 带着移动光源, 并稳定安抚恐慌.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellTrait_bulwark_skin.en: Mitigates 45%% of incoming health loss while active.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellTrait_bulwark_skin.ch: 生效期間減輕 45%% 受到的生命損失.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellTrait_bulwark_skin.cn: 生效期间减轻 45%% 受到的生命损失.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellTrait_heal.ch: 治療損傷最重的部位 (基礎 25).
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellTrait_heal.cn: 治疗损伤最重的部位 (基础 25).

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellTrait_last_aegis.en: Mitigates 70%% of incoming health loss while active.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellTrait_last_aegis.ch: 生效期間減輕 70%% 受到的生命損失.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellTrait_last_aegis.cn: 生效期间减轻 70%% 受到的生命损失.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellTrait_phase_walk.en: Attempts no-clip/ghost movement; falls back to obstacle-step phasing.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellTrait_phase_walk.ch: 嘗試穿牆／幽靈移動; 失敗則改為跨過障礙的相位步.
IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellTrait_phase_walk.cn: 尝试穿墙／幽灵移动; 失败则改为跨过障碍的相位步.

IGUI_DeadMagic_SpellTrait_ward_candle.en: Applies minor panic reduction over time.

IGUI_NC_ModOptions_UseNeatCraftingUI.ch: 使用 Neat Crafting 介面
IGUI_NC_ModOptions_UseNeatCraftingUI.cn: 使用 Neat Crafting 界面
