IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_ArcherySkil.en:
Archery completely replaces vanilla Aiming for bows. None of a bow's four AimingPerk fields apply at all; hit chance, critical chance and range are folded onto the bow itself and scaled by your Archery level instead.

Archery XP comes from an arrow actually landing on a zombie - not from the hit-chance roll - plus a small amount every time you nock.

One vanilla effect does survive: a rifle-trained character still holds a bow very slightly steadier, because recoil, sway and sight range are read off the character rather than off the weapon, and are not reachable from Lua. That is accepted, not a bug.

Five Archery skill books raise how fast you learn. See the Skill books & Magazines page.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_ArcherySkil.ch:
對弓而言, 射箭完全取代了原版的瞄準. 弓的四個 AimingPerk 欄位全都不會生效; 命中機率, 暴擊機率和射程都直接併入弓本身, 改由你的射箭等級來調整.

射箭經驗來自箭矢實際射中殭屍 (而不是命中機率的判定), 另外每次搭箭也會獲得少量經驗.

只有一個原版效果仍然保留: 受過步槍訓練的角色拿弓時還是會稍微穩一點, 因為後座力, 晃動和視野範圍是從角色身上讀取, 而不是從武器讀取, 而且 Lua 無法存取這些數值. 這是已接受的取捨, 不是錯誤.

五本射箭技能書能提升你的學習速度. 詳見「技能書與雜誌」頁面.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_ArcherySkil.cn:
对弓而言, 射箭完全取代了原版的瞄准. 弓的四个 AimingPerk 字段全都不会生效; 命中概率, 暴击概率和射程都直接并入弓本身, 改由你的射箭等级来调整.

射箭经验来自箭矢实际射中僵尸 (而不是命中概率的判定), 另外每次搭箭也会获得少量经验.

只有一个原版效果仍然保留: 受过步枪训练的角色拿弓时还是会稍微稳一点, 因为后坐力, 晃动和视野范围是从角色身上读取, 而不是从武器读取, 而且 Lua 无法访问这些数值. 这是已接受的取舍, 不是错误.

五本射箭技能书能提升你的学习速度. 详见“技能书与杂志”页面.

IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_ArrowCrafti.en:
Every arrow in this mod follows the same shape: turn wood into a plain shaft, fletch the shaft, then haft a head onto it. The sealed packs shortcut part of that - a Carbon Arrow Shaft arrives already fletched, and the two manufactured heads cannot be made at all, only found.

Fletching XP scales with how far along the chain you are, so finishing an arrow is worth far more than carving the shaft it started as.

Broken arrows repair back into whole ones from their right-click Repair option - no recipe and no skill gate, though each attempt can still fail.

For the material roster - which head needs which skill, and what each sealed pack contains - see the Arrowheads & Shafts page. For how the faster recipe tiers unlock, see the Skill books & Magazines page.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_ArrowCrafti.ch:
本 MOD 中的每支箭都遵循同樣的流程: 把木頭削成素箭桿, 為箭桿裝上箭羽, 再把箭頭裝到箭桿上. 密封包裝能省掉其中一部分步驟: 碳製箭桿到手時就已經裝好箭羽, 而兩種工廠製箭頭完全無法製作, 只能找到.

製箭經驗會隨你在流程中的進度增加, 所以完成一支箭得到的經驗遠多於削出它最初的箭桿.

損壞的箭可以透過右鍵選單的「修理」選項修復成完整的箭: 不需要配方, 也沒有技能門檻, 不過每次嘗試仍可能失敗.

材料一覽 (哪種箭頭需要哪項技能, 以及每種密封包裝內含什麼) 請見「箭頭與箭桿」頁面. 較快的配方等級如何解鎖, 請見「技能書與雜誌」頁面.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_ArrowCrafti.cn:
本 MOD 中的每支箭都遵循同样的流程: 把木头削成素箭杆, 为箭杆装上箭羽, 再把箭头装到箭杆上. 密封包装能省掉其中一部分步骤: 碳制箭杆到手时就已经装好箭羽, 而两种工厂制箭头完全无法制作, 只能找到.

制箭经验会随你在流程中的进度增加, 所以完成一支箭得到的经验远多于削出它最初的箭杆.

损坏的箭可以通过右键菜单的“修理”选项修复成完整的箭: 不需要配方, 也没有技能门槛, 不过每次尝试仍可能失败.

材料一览 (哪种箭头需要哪项技能, 以及每种密封包装内含什么) 请见“箭头与箭杆”页面. 较快的配方等级如何解锁, 请见“技能书与杂志”页面.

IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_Arrows.en:
An arrow's multipliers apply on top of whichever bow is firing it, so the words below describe the arrow rather than the finished shot.

Recovery is a sandbox option, so the percentages here are your current world's settings rather than the mod's defaults.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_Arrows.ch:
箭矢的倍率會疊加在發射它的弓之上, 所以下面的描述是針對箭矢本身, 而不是最終射出的效果.

回收是沙盒選項, 所以這裡的百分比是你目前世界的設定, 而不是 MOD 的預設值.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_Arrows.cn:
箭矢的倍率会叠加在发射它的弓之上, 所以下面的描述是针对箭矢本身, 而不是最终射出的效果.

IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_Bows.en:
Every bow shot in this mod is permanently halved by the engine's two-handed grip test: the arrow displayed in your off hand means the game never sees the bow held in both hands. That is a deliberate, accepted trade for showing the nocked arrow at all.

The numbers below are the BOW's own contribution, before that halving and before the nocked arrow's own multiplier. See the Arrows page for the other half.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_Bows.ch:
本 MOD 中每一次射箭都會被引擎的雙手握持判定永久減半: 顯示在副手上的箭矢, 會讓遊戲始終不認為你是用雙手持弓. 這是為了能顯示搭上的箭而刻意接受的取捨.

下面的數值是弓本身的貢獻, 尚未經過減半, 也尚未套用所搭箭矢的倍率. 另一半請見「箭矢」頁面.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_Bows.cn:
本 MOD 中每一次射箭都会被引擎的双手握持判定永久减半: 显示在副手上的箭矢, 会让游戏始终不认为你是用双手持弓. 这是为了能显示搭上的箭而刻意接受的取舍.

下面的数值是弓本身的贡献, 尚未经过减半, 也尚未应用所搭箭矢的倍率. 另一半请见“箭矢”页面.

IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_BuildableTa.en:
The practice target is built from the Carpentry menu under Furniture, and needs Woodwork 2.

Every aimed shot inside range hits it. There is no hit roll on the target itself, which makes it a pure practice tool rather than a test of your accuracy.

Arrows lodge in the target's face, up to twenty of them, and after that in its base. They are ordinary world items: walk up and pick them back up.

Shooting the target trains Archery at {TARGETXP} XP per hit, less than a zombie hit is worth.

The target has its own recovery sandbox option, separate from each arrow's. It is currently {TARGETRECOVERY}.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_BuildableTa.ch:
練習標靶可從木工選單的「家具」分類中建造, 需要木工 2 級.

在射程內瞄準射擊必定命中標靶. 標靶本身沒有命中判定, 因此它純粹是練習工具, 而不是測試你準度的方式.

箭矢會插在標靶正面, 最多二十支, 之後則會插在底座上. 它們是一般的世界物品: 走過去撿回來就好.

射擊標靶每次命中可訓練 {TARGETXP} 點射箭經驗, 比命中殭屍得到的少.

標靶有自己的回收沙盒選項, 與每種箭矢的選項分開. 目前為 {TARGETRECOVERY}.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_BuildableTa.cn:
练习标靶可从“建造”菜单的“家具”分类中建造, 需要木工 2 级.

在射程内瞄准射击必定命中标靶. 标靶本身没有命中判定, 因此它纯粹是练习工具, 而不是测试你准度的方式.

箭矢会插在标靶正面, 最多二十支, 之后则会插在底座上. 它们是普通的世界物品: 走过去捡回来就好.

射击标靶每次命中可训练 {TARGETXP} 点射箭经验, 比命中僵尸得到的少.

标靶有自己的回收沙盒选项, 与每种箭矢的选项分开. 当前为 {TARGETRECOVERY}.

IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_MuscleStrai.en:
Drawing and holding a bow tires your arms. It is tracked as the same arm stiffness and Pain that every weapon uses, so it shows up in the usual moodles rather than anywhere special.

A compound bow's mechanical let-off makes it much cheaper to HOLD at full draw, even though drawing it in the first place costs what its number below implies. That is the whole point of a compound, and it is the let-off row rather than the strain row that tells the two apart.

Strain has no effect on your accuracy and none on your damage. What it costs you is comfort and time.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_MuscleStrai.ch:
拉弓和保持拉弓會讓你的手臂疲勞. 它的計算方式與所有武器共用的手臂僵硬和疼痛相同, 所以會顯示在一般的狀態圖示中, 而不是其他特別的地方.

複合弓的機械省力設計讓它在滿弓時保持起來輕鬆得多, 不過一開始拉弓的消耗仍如下方數值所示. 這正是複合弓的意義所在, 而能區分兩者的是「省力率」那一列, 不是「勞損」那一列.

勞損不會影響你的準度, 也不會影響傷害. 它讓你付出的代價是舒適度與時間.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_MuscleStrai.cn:
拉弓和保持拉弓会让你的手臂疲劳. 它的计算方式与所有武器共用的手臂僵硬和疼痛相同, 所以会显示在一般的状态图标中, 而不是其他特别的地方.

复合弓的机械省力设计让它在满弓时保持起来轻松得多, 不过一开始拉弓的消耗仍如下方数值所示. 这正是复合弓的意义所在, 而能区分两者的是“省力率”那一行, 不是“劳损”那一行.

劳损不会影响你的准度, 也不会影响伤害. 它让你付出的代价是舒适度与时间.

IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_Nocking.en:
A bow remembers the last arrow you chose and picks it again on an empty reload. If you have run out of that one, it falls back to the best arrow you are carrying.

There are three ways to nock. Hold the reload key for the radial menu and choose an arrow; tap the reload key to nock the remembered or best arrow straight away; or right-click an arrow in your inventory and choose "Nock in (bow)". That same right-click menu also carries this handbook's own entry, so the two sit side by side.

The rack key - 'x' unless you have rebound it - un-nocks, and the arrow goes back into your inventory rather than being lost.

How long a nock takes depends on your Archery level and on the bow's draw weight. Each bow's nock speed is listed on the Bows page.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_Nocking.ch:
弓會記住你上次選擇的箭, 在空弓裝填時再次選用它. 如果那種箭已經用完, 就會改用你身上最好的箭.

搭箭有三種方式. 按住裝填鍵開啟環形選單並選擇一支箭; 輕按裝填鍵, 立即搭上記住的箭或最好的箭; 或在物品欄中對箭矢按右鍵, 選擇「在 (弓) 上搭箭」. 同一個右鍵選單裡也有這本手冊的選項, 兩者並列在一起.

上膛鍵 (除非你重新設定過, 否則是「x」) 可以取下箭, 箭會回到你的物品欄, 不會遺失.

搭箭所需時間取決於你的射箭等級和弓的拉力. 每把弓的搭箭速度都列在「弓」頁面.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_Nocking.cn:
弓会记住你上次选择的箭, 在空弓装填时再次选用它. 如果那种箭已经用完, 就会改用你身上最好的箭.

搭箭有三种方式. 按住装填键打开环形菜单并选择一支箭; 轻按装填键, 立即搭上记住的箭或最好的箭; 或在物品栏中右键点击箭矢, 选择“在 (弓) 上搭箭”. 同一个右键菜单里也有这本手册的选项, 两者并列在一起.

上膛键 (除非你重新设置过, 否则是“x”) 可以取下箭, 箭会回到你的物品栏, 不会丢失.

搭箭所需时间取决于你的射箭等级和弓的拉力. 每把弓的搭箭速度都列在“弓”页面.

IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_Quiver.en:
The Leather Quiver holds arrows and nothing else. It matches on the arrow tag rather than on a list of item IDs, so a sealed arrow pack cannot go in until you have opened it.

There is no cap on how many arrows fit - only the container's weight budget.

The bundle of arrows shown on a worn quiver is display only. It swaps between meshes at 1, 2, 3, 4, 5-6, 7-9 and 10 or more arrows, and carries no stat of its own.

Wearing a quiver speeds up every nock by {QUIVERBONUS}.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_Quiver.ch:
皮革箭袋只能裝箭矢, 不能裝其他東西. 它是依箭矢標籤來判斷, 而不是依物品 ID 清單, 所以密封的箭矢包裝要先開啟才能放進去.

能放的箭矢數量沒有上限, 只受容器的重量容量限制.

穿戴中的箭袋上顯示的那束箭只是外觀. 它會在 1, 2, 3, 4, 5-6, 7-9 和 10 支以上的箭矢之間切換模型, 本身不帶任何屬性.

穿戴箭袋能讓每次搭箭加快 {QUIVERBONUS}.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_Quiver.cn:
皮革箭袋只能装箭矢, 不能装其他东西. 它是依箭矢标签来判断, 而不是依物品 ID 列表, 所以密封的箭矢包装要先打开才能放进去.

能放的箭矢数量没有上限, 只受容器的重量容量限制.

穿戴中的箭袋上显示的那束箭只是外观. 它会在 1, 2, 3, 4, 5-6, 7-9 和 10 支以上的箭矢之间切换模型, 本身不带任何属性.

穿戴箭袋能让每次搭箭加快 {QUIVERBONUS}.

IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_RecoveryBre.en:
Every arrow that hits a zombie lodges something in it. Win the recovery roll and the whole arrow lodges; lose it and the arrow's Broken counterpart lodges instead. A lost roll never destroys the arrow outright.

Either way the arrow is visible, stuck in the zombie, and can be looted off the corpse.

Recovery chance is set per arrow and is a sandbox option, so a server can tune it. The Arrows page shows your own world's live value rather than the mod's default.

A Broken arrow is not waste. Right-click it and choose Repair: a window shows your chance, lets you pick which material to spend, and repairs one arrow or the whole stack. You need a crafting surface within reach, and a higher Fletching level makes each attempt succeed more often. See the Arrow crafting page.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_RecoveryBre.ch:
每支射中殭屍的箭都會在牠身上留下東西. 回收判定成功, 整支箭會插在牠身上; 判定失敗, 則改為插上該箭的損壞版本. 判定失敗絕不會讓箭直接消失.

無論哪種情況, 箭都看得見, 插在殭屍身上, 可以從屍體上搜刮下來.

回收機率依每種箭矢分別設定, 而且是沙盒選項, 所以伺服器可以調整. 「箭矢」頁面顯示的是你自己世界的即時數值, 而不是 MOD 的預設值.

損壞的箭不是廢物. 對它按右鍵並選擇「修理」: 視窗會顯示你的成功率, 讓你選擇要消耗哪種材料, 並修理一支或整疊箭. 你需要伸手可及的製作檯面, 而製箭等級越高, 每次嘗試的成功率就越高. 詳見「製作箭矢」頁面.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_RecoveryBre.cn:
每支射中僵尸的箭都会在它身上留下东西. 回收判定成功, 整支箭会插在它身上; 判定失败, 则改为插上该箭的损坏版本. 判定失败绝不会让箭直接消失.

无论哪种情况, 箭都看得见, 插在僵尸身上, 可以从尸体上搜刮下来.

回收概率依每种箭矢分别设置, 而且是沙盒选项, 所以服务器可以调整. “箭矢”页面显示的是你自己世界的实时数值, 而不是 MOD 的默认值.

损坏的箭不是废物. 右键点击它并选择“修理”: 窗口会显示你的成功率, 让你选择要消耗哪种材料, 并修理一支或整组箭. 你需要伸手可及的制作台面, 而制箭等级越高, 每次尝试的成功率就越高. 详见“制作箭矢”页面.

IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_SkillBooksM.en:
Ten skill books ship: five for Archery and five for Fletching. Each one covers two levels, and reading it only speeds up how fast you gain XP - it never grants a level directly.

The two recipe magazines work differently. Reading The Nock & Fletch REPLACES every slow Fletching recipe with a faster version rather than adding a second entry beside it, and Skip the Shaft does the same for its four shortcut recipes. Your crafting list will not grow; the rows you already had simply get quicker.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_SkillBooksM.ch:
本 MOD 附帶十本技能書: 五本射箭, 五本製箭. 每本涵蓋兩個等級, 閱讀後只會提升你獲得經驗的速度, 絕不會直接給予等級.

兩本配方雜誌的運作方式不同. 閱讀《箭尾與箭羽》會把每個慢速製箭配方替換成較快的版本, 而不是在旁邊新增第二個項目; 《省去箭桿》對它的四個捷徑配方也是如此. 你的製作清單不會變長, 原本就有的項目只是變得更快.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_SkillBooksM.cn:
本 MOD 附带十本技能书: 五本射箭, 五本制箭. 每本涵盖两个等级, 阅读后只会提升你获得经验的速度, 绝不会直接给予等级.

两本配方杂志的运作方式不同. 阅读《箭尾与箭羽》会把每个慢速制箭配方替换成较快的版本, 而不是在旁边添加第二个条目; 《省去箭杆》对它的四个捷径配方也是如此. 你的制作列表不会变长, 原本就有的条目只是变得更快.

IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_StartHere.en:
The Archery Handbook is a reference, not a tutorial and not a quest log. Nothing here has to be read in order, and nothing on these pages tracks your progress.

Open it again at any time with {KEY}, or by right-clicking any RadArchery item in your inventory, which jumps straight to that item's page.

Every number shown throughout is read live from the mod's own data when the page is drawn, so a rebalance can never leave it stale.

The other eleven pages:
Archery skill - what the custom skill replaces, and how it is trained.
Nocking - the three ways to put an arrow on the string.
Recovery & Breakage - what becomes of an arrow after it hits.
Muscle strain - why holding a draw tires your arms.
Quiver - the Leather Quiver and its nock bonus.
Practice target - the buildable target and what it trains.
Bows - every bow, its stats and where it comes from.
Arrows - all ten arrows and their multipliers.
Arrowheads & Shafts - the crafting materials and the sealed packs.
Arrow crafting - the shape of the chain from wood to finished arrow.
Skill books & Magazines - the ten books and the two recipe magazines.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_StartHere.ch:
《射箭手冊》是參考資料, 不是教學, 也不是任務日誌. 這裡的內容不必按順序閱讀, 這些頁面也不會追蹤你的進度.

隨時可以用 {KEY} 再次開啟, 或在物品欄中對任何 RadArchery 物品按右鍵, 直接跳到該物品的頁面.

頁面上顯示的每個數字, 都是在繪製頁面時即時從 MOD 自身資料讀取的, 所以就算重新平衡也不會讓它過時.

其他十一個頁面:
射箭技能 - 這項自訂技能取代了什麼, 以及如何訓練.
搭箭 - 把箭搭上弦的三種方式.
回收與損壞 - 箭命中後會變成怎樣.
肌肉勞損 - 為什麼保持拉弓會讓手臂疲勞.
箭袋 - 皮革箭袋及其搭箭加成.
練習標靶 - 可建造的標靶及其訓練內容.
弓 - 每把弓的屬性與來源.
箭矢 - 全部十種箭矢及其倍率.
箭頭與箭桿 - 製作材料與密封包裝.
製作箭矢 - 從木頭到成品箭的整個流程.
技能書與雜誌 - 十本技能書與兩本配方雜誌.
IGUI_RadArcheryHandbook_Body_StartHere.cn:
《射箭手册》是参考资料, 不是教程, 也不是任务日志. 这里的内容不必按顺序阅读, 这些页面也不会追踪你的进度.

随时可以用 {KEY} 再次打开, 或在物品栏中右键点击任何 RadArchery 物品, 直接跳到该物品的页面.

页面上显示的每个数字, 都是在绘制页面时实时从 MOD 自身数据读取的, 所以就算重新平衡也不会让它过时.

其他十一个页面:
射箭技能 - 这项自定义技能取代了什么, 以及如何训练.
搭箭 - 把箭搭上弦的三种方式.
回收与损坏 - 箭命中后会变成怎样.
肌肉劳损 - 为什么保持拉弓会让手臂疲劳.
箭袋 - 皮革箭袋及其搭箭加成.
练习标靶 - 可建造的标靶及其训练内容.
弓 - 每把弓的属性与来源.
箭矢 - 全部十种箭矢及其倍率.
箭头与箭杆 - 制作材料与密封包装.
制作箭矢 - 从木头到成品箭的整个流程.
技能书与杂志 - 十本技能书与两本配方杂志.

IGUI_RadArcheryRepair_Refused.en: A repair was refused - nothing was spent.
IGUI_RadArcheryRepair_Refused.ch: 修理遭到拒絕 - 未消耗任何東西.
IGUI_RadArcheryRepair_Refused.cn: 修理被拒绝 - 未消耗任何东西.

IGUI_RadArchery_AnimClipsMissing.en: RadArchery's bow animations did not load correctly this session, probably because Steam had not finished installing/updating the mod when the game started. Your bow(s) will animate as a rifle for the rest of this session so your character stays playable -- restart the game when it is convenient to fix this permanently.
IGUI_RadArchery_AnimClipsMissing.ch: RadArchery 的弓動畫在本次遊戲中未能正確載入, 可能是遊戲啟動時 Steam 尚未完成此模組的安裝/更新. 為了讓你的角色仍可正常遊玩, 本次遊戲剩餘的時間裡你的弓將以步槍動作呈現 -- 方便時請重新啟動遊戲以永久修正此問題.
IGUI_RadArchery_AnimClipsMissing.cn: RadArchery 的弓动画在本次游戏中未能正确加载, 可能是游戏启动时 Steam 尚未完成该模组的安装/更新. 为了让你的角色仍可正常游玩, 本次游戏剩余时间内你的弓将以步枪动作呈现 -- 方便时请重启游戏以永久修复此问题.

IGUI_RadArchery_NoNockInVehicle.en: Can't nock an arrow while in a vehicle.

IGUI_CMC_MoveDesc.en: Move entries under another entry with Entry>New Parent, separating each pair with a semicolon. The new parent keeps whatever it already did and gains a submenu holding the moved entry. When no entry in the menu carries that name, one is created where the first moved entry sat. An old parent left with nothing below it is removed as well.
IGUI_CMC_MoveDesc.ch: 以「項目>新上層」的格式將項目移到另一個項目底下, 每組之間以分號分隔. 新的上層項目會保留原本的功能, 並多出一個存放被移動項目的子選單. 若選單中沒有任何項目使用該名稱, 會在第一個被移動項目原本的位置建立一個. 移走後底下已無任何項目的舊上層項目也會一併移除.
IGUI_CMC_MoveDesc.cn: 以“条目>新上级”的格式将条目移到另一个条目下面, 每组之间用分号分隔. 新的上级条目会保留原本的功能, 并多出一个存放被移动条目的子菜单. 如果菜单中没有任何条目使用该名称, 会在第一个被移动条目原本的位置创建一个. 移走后下面已没有任何条目的旧上级条目也会一并移除.

IGUI_CMC_MoveList_tooltip.en: Check Doors>Door turns "Check Status > Check Doors" into "Door > Check Doors". Grab one>Grab;Grab half>Grab;Grab all>Grab collects the three into a new "Grab" entry. Both sides are matched anywhere in the menu, including inside submenus.
IGUI_CMC_MoveList_tooltip.ch: 「檢查門>門」會把「檢查狀態 > 檢查門」變成「門 > 檢查門」. 「拿取一個>拿取;拿取一半>拿取;拿取全部>拿取」會把這三項集中到新的「拿取」項目中. 兩邊都會在整個選單中比對, 包括子選單內.
IGUI_CMC_MoveList_tooltip.cn: “检查门>门”会把“检查状态 > 检查门”变成“门 > 检查门”. “拿取[一个]>捡起;拿取[一半]>捡起;拿取[全部]>捡起”会把这三项集中到新的“捡起”条目中. 两边都会在整个菜单中匹配, 包括子菜单内.

IGUI_CMC_RenameDesc.en: Rename entries with Old Name>New Name, separating each pair with a semicolon. Start the old name with ~ to swap only that part of the entry and keep the rest, such as the furniture name after "Push". The lists above keep matching the name the game gave the entry.

IGUI_CMC_RenameDesc.cn: 以“旧名称>新名称”的格式重命名条目, 每组之间用分号分隔. 旧名称以 ~ 开头时, 只替换条目中的该部分并保留其余内容, 例如“推动”之后的家具名称. 上方的列表仍按游戏给条目的原名称进行匹配.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsGradientFast_Tooltip.en:
Draws the item footprint gradient with fewer color bands (6 instead of 12), halving the gradient draw calls per item per frame. The gradient looks chunkier but the render is faster.

Off (default): smooth 12-band gradient.

This is a per-machine visual setting; each player chooses their own.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsGradientFast_Tooltip.ch:
以較少的色帶 (6 條而非 12 條) 繪製物品占位漸層, 使每個物品每幀的漸層繪製呼叫減半. 漸層看起來較粗糙, 但算繪更快.

關閉 (預設): 平滑的 12 色帶漸層.

這是各電腦獨立的視覺設定; 每位玩家可自行選擇.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsGradientFast_Tooltip.cn:
以较少的色带 (6 条而非 12 条) 绘制物品占位渐变, 使每个物品每帧的渐变绘制调用减半. 渐变看起来较粗糙, 但渲染更快.

关闭 (默认): 平滑的 12 色带渐变.

这是各电脑独立的视觉设置; 每位玩家可自行选择.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_001.en: Hah, you're really cute for a post-apocalyptic scavenger

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_002.en: Well, I think you are quite good-looking too

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_002.cn: 嗯, 我也觉得你长得挺好看的

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_003.en: Thank you, that was a nice compliment, sweetie
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_003.ch: 謝謝, 這句讚美真動聽, 親愛的
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_003.cn: 谢谢, 这句夸奖真好听, 亲爱的

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_004.en: Aww, you know, I like you more than canned tuna for breakfast
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_004.ch: 哎呀, 你知道嗎, 我喜歡你勝過早餐吃鮪魚罐頭
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_004.cn: 哎呀, 你知道吗, 我喜欢你胜过早餐吃金枪鱼罐头

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_005.en: WHAT?! I BRING YOU GOOD FUCK? Oh... you said "luck"? Sorry, hah...
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_005.ch: 什麼?! 我帶給你「性」運? 喔…你是說「幸運」? 抱歉, 哈…
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_005.cn: 什么?! 我给你带来“性”运? 哦…你是说“幸运”? 抱歉, 哈…

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_006.en: And you are the "sledge" to my "sledgehammer", babe
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_006.ch: 而你就是我「大錘」上的「錘頭」, 寶貝
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_006.cn: 而你就是我“大锤”上的“锤头”, 宝贝

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_007.en: Don't you sweet-talk me like this, babe. I still won't do your laundry
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_007.ch: 別對我甜言蜜語啦, 寶貝. 我還是不會幫你洗衣服的
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_007.cn: 别对我甜言蜜语啦, 宝贝. 我还是不会帮你洗衣服的

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_008.en: Hah, that was clever. Where did you learn that sweet talk? From zombies?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_008.ch: 哈, 真聰明. 你這些甜言蜜語是跟誰學的? 跟殭屍嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_008.cn: 哈, 真聪明. 你这些甜言蜜语是跟谁学的? 跟僵尸吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_009.en: You are sweet as a strawberry and spicy like a chili, aren't you?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_009.ch: 你像草莓一樣甜, 又像辣椒一樣嗆, 對吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_009.cn: 你像草莓一样甜, 又像辣椒一样呛, 对吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_010.en: Thanks, my turn now - are you a stir-fry? Cause you are hot. Ugh, that was bad...
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_010.ch: 謝啦, 換我了 - 你是熱炒嗎? 因為你好辣. 呃, 這句好爛…
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_010.cn: 谢啦, 换我了 - 你是爆炒菜吗? 因为你好辣. 呃, 这句好烂…

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_011.en: Hah, well, I hope you don't say that to every other survivor
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_011.ch: 哈, 好吧, 希望你不是對每個倖存者都這麼說
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_011.cn: 哈, 好吧, 希望你不是对每个幸存者都这么说

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_012.en: Well, aren't you a sweet zombie-killer, huh?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_012.ch: 哎呀, 你還真是個貼心的殭屍殺手, 是吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Flirt_012.cn: 哎呀, 你还真是个贴心的僵尸杀手, 是吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_FunInterrupted_00.en: Wait - do you hear that? We're not alone.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_FunInterrupted_00.ch: 等等 - 你有聽到嗎? 這裡不只我們.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_FunInterrupted_00.cn: 等等 - 你听到了吗? 这里不只我们.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_FunInterrupted_00.ch: 殭屍! 快起來, 快起來!
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_FunInterrupted_00.cn: 僵尸! 快起来, 快起来!

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_001.en: Now that was a proper... exercise, haha
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_001.ch: 這才叫真正的…運動, 哈哈
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_001.cn: 这才叫真正的…运动, 哈哈

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_002.en: Wow, where did you get that stamina? From running from zombies?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_002.ch: 哇, 你這體力是哪來的? 躲殭屍練出來的嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_002.cn: 哇, 你这体力是哪来的? 躲僵尸练出来的吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_003.en: Damn, you weren't lying... that really was a good stress relief
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_003.ch: 該死, 你沒騙我…這真的很紓壓
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_003.cn: 该死, 你没骗我…这真的很解压

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_004.en: Fuck, that was amazing, I feel like I just got back from some three-day-long scavenging mission
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_004.ch: 靠, 太讚了, 我感覺像剛從一趟三天的搜刮任務回來
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_004.cn: 靠, 太爽了, 我感觉像刚从一趟三天的搜刮任务回来

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_005.en: We should do that again soon, don't you think?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_005.ch: 我們應該找時間再來一次, 你說是不是?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_005.cn: 我们应该找时间再来一次, 你说是不是?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_006.en: Now that was a good break from zombie killing!
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_006.ch: 殺殭屍之餘這樣休息一下真不錯!
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_Fun_006.cn: 杀僵尸之余这样休息一下真不错!

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_001.en: Thank you! I will take good care of it
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_001.ch: 謝謝! 我會好好珍惜的
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_001.cn: 谢谢! 我会好好珍惜的

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_002.en: Wow, you didn't have to, thanks
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_002.ch: 哇, 你不必這樣的, 謝謝
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_002.cn: 哇, 你不必这样的, 谢谢

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_003.en: Is it for me? Wow, you are really sweet for a zombie-killer
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_003.ch: 這是給我的? 哇, 以殭屍殺手來說你真貼心
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_003.cn: 这是给我的? 哇, 以僵尸杀手来说你真贴心

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_004.en: Woah, no way... how did you know I wanted that? Thanks!
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_004.ch: 哇, 不會吧…你怎麼知道我想要這個? 謝謝!
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_004.cn: 哇, 不会吧…你怎么知道我想要这个? 谢谢!

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_005.en: A gift for me? Thank you, I love it!
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_005.ch: 送我的禮物? 謝謝, 我好喜歡!
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_005.cn: 送我的礼物? 谢谢, 我好喜欢!

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_006.en: Well, aren't you cute, thank you
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_006.ch: 哎呀, 你真可愛, 謝謝
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_006.cn: 哎呀, 你真可爱, 谢谢

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_007.en: Wow, it's amazing! Where did you find it? Or maybe I shouldn't know...
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_007.ch: 哇, 太棒了! 你在哪找到的? 還是我最好別知道…
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_007.cn: 哇, 太棒了! 你在哪找到的? 还是我最好别知道…

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_008.en: Aww, that's really nice of you, thanks
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_008.ch: 哎呀, 你人真好, 謝謝
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftLiked_008.cn: 哎呀, 你人真好, 谢谢

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_001.en: A gift? Hmm, well, thanks I guess
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_001.ch: 禮物? 嗯, 好吧, 大概要說聲謝謝吧
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_001.cn: 礼物? 嗯, 好吧, 大概要说声谢谢吧

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_002.en: I, um... I am sorry, but I don't really know how I could use it
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_002.ch: 我, 呃…抱歉, 但我真的不知道這能拿來做什麼
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_002.cn: 我, 呃…抱歉, 但我真的不知道这能拿来干什么

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_003.en: Well, it's the thought that counts

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_004.en: Well, I appreciate the thought, but... this? Really?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_004.ch: 嗯, 謝謝你的心意, 但是…這個? 真的假的?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_004.cn: 嗯, 谢谢你的心意, 但是…这个? 真的假的?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_005.en: Thanks, but this gift kinda sucks, babe, not gonna lie
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_005.ch: 謝了, 但老實說這禮物有點爛, 寶貝
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_005.cn: 谢了, 但老实说这礼物有点烂, 宝贝

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_006.en: This thing? How am I supposed to use it?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_006.ch: 這東西? 我要怎麼用啊?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GiftNeutral_006.cn: 这东西? 我要怎么用啊?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GoToBase.en: Alright. Got it. I'll head over to the base.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GoToBase.ch: 好. 知道了. 我這就去基地.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GoToBase.cn: 好. 知道了. 我这就去基地.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_001.en: I used to love Romero movies... I can't enjoy them anymore.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_001.ch: 我以前很愛羅梅羅的電影…現在再也看不下去了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_001.cn: 我以前很爱罗梅罗的电影…现在再也看不下去了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_003.en: Did you hear the screaming last night? No? Then never mind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_003.ch: 你昨晚有聽到尖叫聲嗎? 沒有? 那就算了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_003.cn: 你昨晚听到尖叫声了吗? 没有? 那就算了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_004.en: Dead, but not dead. Strange, isn't it?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_004.ch: 死了, 卻又沒死. 很奇怪, 對吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_004.cn: 死了, 却又没死. 很奇怪, 对吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_005.en: Must be the wind. The stench is awful today.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_005.ch: 一定是風的關係. 今天的臭味真可怕.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_005.cn: 一定是风的缘故. 今天的臭味真可怕.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_006.en: Ever been to Texas? It was more dangerous than this place.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_006.ch: 你去過德州嗎? 那裡比這裡還危險.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_006.cn: 你去过得州吗? 那里比这里还危险.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_007.en: You hear that? They say Osaka, Japan managed to quarantine itself.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_007.ch: 你聽說了嗎? 聽說日本大阪成功把自己隔離起來了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_007.cn: 你听说了吗? 听说日本大阪成功把自己隔离起来了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_008.en: Chemicals, viruses, aliens... what do you think caused this?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_008.ch: 化學物質, 病毒, 外星人…你覺得這是什麼造成的?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_008.cn: 化学物质, 病毒, 外星人…你觉得这是什么造成的?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_009.en: So this is The Last Man on Earth, huh?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_009.ch: 所以這就是「地球上最後一人」, 是吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_009.cn: 所以这就是“地球上最后一人”, 是吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_010.en: After a fight, that's when I get scared. You'll believe me if I say I wasn't bitten, right?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_010.ch: 每次打完一場, 我才會開始害怕. 如果我說我沒被咬, 你會相信我吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_010.cn: 每次打完一场, 我才会开始害怕. 如果我说我没被咬, 你会相信我吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_011.en: If you get bitten, don't hide it. That's how communities fall apart.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_011.ch: 如果被咬了, 別藏著. 社群就是這樣分崩離析的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_011.cn: 如果被咬了, 别藏着. 社区就是这样分崩离析的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_012.en: I dream about killing people I loved. I wish it had only been a dream.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_012.ch: 我夢到自己殺了心愛的人. 真希望那只是一場夢.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_012.cn: 我梦到自己杀了心爱的人. 真希望那只是一场梦.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_013.en: Believe it or not, they used to call me "Mad."
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_013.ch: 信不信由你, 以前大家都叫我「瘋子」.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_013.cn: 信不信由你, 以前大家都叫我“疯子”.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_014.en: I'm done being a zombie movie fan. I'm switching to shark movies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_014.ch: 我不再當殭屍電影迷了. 我要改看鯊魚電影.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_014.cn: 我不再当僵尸电影迷了. 我要改看鲨鱼电影.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_015.en: Don't wear headphones. You'll get bitten from behind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_015.ch: 別戴耳機. 你會被從背後咬一口.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_015.cn: 别戴耳机. 你会被从背后咬一口.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_016.en: If this pandemic ever ends... no, I won't say the rest.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_016.ch: 要是這場大流行哪天結束了…不, 後面的我就不說了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_016.cn: 要是这场大流行哪天结束了…不, 后面的我就不说了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_017.en: Let's not start fighting each other, alright? That's the boring part of the story.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_017.ch: 我們別開始自相殘殺, 好嗎? 那是故事裡最無聊的部分.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_017.cn: 我们别开始自相残杀, 好吗? 那是故事里最无聊的部分.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_018.en: I saw it. The day before this started, something came down from the sky... never mind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_018.ch: 我看到了. 這一切開始的前一天, 有東西從天上掉下來…算了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_018.cn: 我看到了. 这一切开始的前一天, 有东西从天上掉下来…算了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_019.ch: 全完了…是啊, 徹底完了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_019.cn: 全完了…是啊, 彻底完了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_020.en: Oh, it's you. Thought you were a zombie.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_020.ch: 喔, 是你啊. 我還以為是殭屍.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_020.cn: 哦, 是你啊. 我还以为是僵尸.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_021.en: I once killed three zombies with one bullet. You don't believe me, do you?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_021.ch: 我曾經一顆子彈殺了三隻殭屍. 你不信, 對吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_021.cn: 我曾经一颗子弹杀了三只僵尸. 你不信, 对吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_022.en: I once killed three zombies with one swing. That one's a lie.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_022.ch: 我曾經揮一下就殺了三隻殭屍. 這句是騙你的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_022.cn: 我曾经挥一下就杀了三只僵尸. 这句是骗你的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_023.en: Don't get careless. If you do, I can't afford to.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_023.ch: 別大意. 你要是大意了, 我就更不能大意.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_023.cn: 别大意. 你要是大意了, 我就更不能大意.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_024.en: Zombies don't have anywhere to go either. That's why they wander around.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_024.ch: 殭屍也無處可去. 所以牠們才會到處遊蕩.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_024.cn: 僵尸也无处可去. 所以它们才会到处游荡.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_025.en: What do we call them? Zombies? Undead? Infected?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_025.ch: 我們該怎麼稱呼牠們? 殭屍? 不死者? 感染者?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_025.cn: 我们该怎么称呼它们? 僵尸? 不死者? 感染者?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_026.en: There's a game I never finished. I want to go get it someday.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_026.ch: 有款遊戲我一直沒破關. 總有一天我要去把它拿回來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_026.cn: 有款游戏我一直没通关. 总有一天我要去把它拿回来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_027.en: Shoot. Swing. The world's gotten real simple.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_027.ch: 開槍. 揮砍. 世界變得好簡單.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_027.cn: 开枪. 挥砍. 世界变得好简单.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_028.en: Should've prepared a mohawk and spiked shoulder pads.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_028.ch: 早知道就準備個莫霍克頭跟尖刺護肩.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_028.cn: 早知道就准备个莫霍克头和尖刺护肩.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_029.en: Rumor says the military's gathering in California. Rumor says.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_029.ch: 傳聞軍隊正在加州集結. 只是傳聞.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_029.cn: 传闻军队正在加州集结. 只是传闻.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_030.en: You think this is God's test?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_030.ch: 你覺得這是上帝的考驗嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_030.cn: 你觉得这是上帝的考验吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_031.en: When there's no more room in Hell, huh?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_031.ch: 等到地獄再也容不下的時候, 是吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_031.cn: 等到地狱再也容不下的时候, 是吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_032.en: You only realize how good it is to have people around when you're alone.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_032.ch: 只有孤身一人時, 才會明白身邊有人有多好.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_032.cn: 只有孤身一人时, 才会明白身边有人有多好.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_033.en: This is the first time I've ever been grateful for gun culture.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_033.ch: 這是我第一次感謝槍枝文化.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_033.cn: 这是我第一次感谢枪支文化.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_034.en: Thanks for letting me join you. Just... don't kick me out, alright?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_034.ch: 謝謝你讓我加入. 只是…別把我趕走, 好嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_034.cn: 谢谢你让我加入. 只是…别把我赶走, 好吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_035.en: Do you count your shots? You should.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_035.ch: 你會數自己開了幾槍嗎? 你應該要數.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_035.cn: 你会数自己开了几枪吗? 你应该要数.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_036.en: Check your gear before we head out. You always forget something.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_036.ch: 出發前檢查一下裝備. 你總是會忘東忘西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_036.cn: 出发前检查一下装备. 你总是会丢三落四.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_037.en: The world's gone to hell, but sometimes... sometimes it's still kind of fun.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_037.ch: 世界已經變成地獄了, 但有時候…有時候還是挺好玩的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_037.cn: 世界已经变成地狱了, 但有时候…有时候还是挺好玩的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_038.en: We smell almost as bad as they do.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_038.ch: 我們身上的味道幾乎跟牠們一樣臭.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_038.cn: 我们身上的味道几乎跟它们一样臭.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_039.en: I want something sweet. Something spicy, too...
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_039.ch: 我想吃點甜的. 還想吃點辣的…
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_039.cn: 我想吃点甜的. 还想吃点辣的…

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_040.ch: 噔噔噔噔噔…噔噔噔噔噔…
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_040.cn: 噔噔噔噔噔…噔噔噔噔噔…

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_042.en: We should burn the bodies. Sorry, Jesus, but we can't have them coming back.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_042.ch: 我們應該把屍體燒掉. 抱歉了耶穌, 但不能讓他們再爬起來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_042.cn: 我们应该把尸体烧掉. 抱歉了耶稣, 但不能让他们再爬起来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_043.en: I'm worried about my cousin. Knowing him, he might be eating the zombies instead.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_043.ch: 我很擔心我表哥. 以他的個性, 搞不好反過來在吃殭屍.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_043.cn: 我很担心我表哥. 以他的性格, 搞不好反过来在吃僵尸.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_044.en: I'm looking for a friend I got separated from. I hope I don't find them in the horde.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_044.ch: 我在找一個走散的朋友. 希望不會在屍潮裡找到他.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_044.cn: 我在找一个走散的朋友. 希望不会在尸潮里找到他.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_045.en: Cough! Cough! ...What? It's just a cough.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_045.ch: 咳! 咳! …幹嘛? 只是咳嗽而已.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_045.cn: 咳! 咳! …干嘛? 只是咳嗽而已.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_046.en: I saw a zombie holding a sign that said "Zombie Rights."
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_046.ch: 我看到一隻殭屍舉著牌子, 上面寫著「殭屍權益」.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_046.cn: 我看到一只僵尸举着牌子, 上面写着“僵尸权益”.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_047.en: I once saw a drunk walking with a pack of zombies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_047.ch: 我曾經看過一個醉漢跟著一群殭屍一起走.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_047.cn: 我曾经看过一个醉汉跟着一群僵尸一起走.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_048.en: You're the leader. Keep it together.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_048.ch: 你是領袖. 要撐住啊.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_048.cn: 你是领袖. 要撑住啊.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_049.en: I heard a zombie bit Chuck Norris, suffered for a while, then died.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_049.ch: 聽說有隻殭屍咬了查克·諾里斯, 痛苦了一陣子, 然後就死了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_049.cn: 听说有只僵尸咬了查克·诺里斯, 痛苦了一阵子, 然后就死了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_050.en: Their teeth can bite through clothes. Be careful.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_050.ch: 牠們的牙齒能咬穿衣服. 小心點.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_050.cn: 它们的牙齿能咬穿衣服. 小心点.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_051.en: Someone who used to mock me died. Strangely enough, I was sad.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_051.ch: 以前常嘲笑我的人死了. 說也奇怪, 我竟然很難過.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_051.cn: 以前常嘲笑我的人死了. 说也奇怪, 我竟然很难过.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_052.en: Someone stopped by earlier. They were already dead, so I killed them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_052.ch: 剛才有人來過. 他已經死了, 所以我把他殺了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_052.cn: 刚才有人来过. 他已经死了, 所以我把他杀了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_053.en: That thing you ate yesterday... no, I won't say it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_053.ch: 你昨天吃的那個東西…不, 我不說了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_053.cn: 你昨天吃的那个东西…不, 我不说了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_054.en: A zombie bit me once, but it had dentures. Lucky me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_054.ch: 有次殭屍咬了我, 不過牠戴的是假牙. 算我走運.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_054.cn: 有次僵尸咬了我, 不过它戴的是假牙. 算我走运.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_055.en: I hear some people are trying to control the zombies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_055.ch: 聽說有些人想控制殭屍.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_055.cn: 听说有些人想控制僵尸.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_056.en: I can't name every president, but I know the next one. A zombie.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_056.ch: 我說不出每一任總統的名字, 但我知道下一任是誰. 殭屍.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_056.cn: 我说不出每一任总统的名字, 但我知道下一任是谁. 僵尸.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_057.en: If we held an election now, the zombies would win.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_057.ch: 要是現在舉行選舉, 殭屍會贏.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_057.cn: 要是现在举行选举, 僵尸会赢.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_058.en: I think zombies still carry habits from when they were alive.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_058.ch: 我覺得殭屍還保留著生前的習慣.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_058.cn: 我觉得僵尸还保留着生前的习惯.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_059.ch: 你覺得有吃素的殭屍嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_059.cn: 你觉得有吃素的僵尸吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_060.en: Maybe their goal isn't to eat us. Maybe it's to make more of themselves.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_060.ch: 也許牠們的目的不是吃掉我們. 也許是要製造更多同類.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_060.cn: 也许它们的目的不是吃掉我们. 也许是要制造更多同类.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_061.en: There's no Superman. No Batman. So we have to fight.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_061.ch: 沒有超人. 沒有蝙蝠俠. 所以我們只能自己戰鬥.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_061.cn: 没有超人. 没有蝙蝠侠. 所以我们只能自己战斗.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_062.en: I've thought "this is it" a hundred times. Still here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_062.ch: 我已經想過一百次「這下完了」. 結果還活著.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_062.cn: 我已经想过一百次“这下完了”. 结果还活着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_063.en: I've become prejudiced against zombies. Funny thing is, we're the minority now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_063.ch: 我開始對殭屍有偏見了. 好笑的是, 現在我們才是少數.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_063.cn: 我开始对僵尸有偏见了. 好笑的是, 现在我们才是少数.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_064.en: What's your favorite gun? ...That's a pretty old-school choice.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_064.ch: 你最喜歡哪把槍? …這選擇還真老派.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_064.cn: 你最喜欢哪把枪? …这选择还真老派.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_065.ch: 你最喜歡吃什麼? …認真的嗎? 噁.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_065.cn: 你最喜欢吃什么? …认真的吗? 呕.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_066.en: What's your favorite movie? ...Didn't expect that. You watch that kind of thing?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_066.ch: 你最喜歡哪部電影? …真沒想到. 你也看那種東西?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_066.cn: 你最喜欢哪部电影? …真没想到. 你也看那种东西?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_067.en: What's your favorite comic? ...Yeah, that's a cool one.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_067.ch: 你最喜歡哪部漫畫? …對, 那部很酷.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_067.cn: 你最喜欢哪部漫画? …对, 那部很酷.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_068.en: Who taught you to shoot? Bruce Willis?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_068.ch: 誰教你開槍的? 布魯斯·威利?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_068.cn: 谁教你开枪的? 布鲁斯·威利斯?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_069.en: That swing of yours is something else. Babe Ruth reincarnated, maybe?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_069.ch: 你那一揮真不得了. 該不會是貝比·魯斯轉世吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_069.cn: 你那一挥真不得了. 该不会是贝比·鲁斯转世吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_070.en: You're a good person. So I'll try to be one too.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_070.ch: 你是個好人. 所以我也會試著當個好人.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_070.cn: 你是个好人. 所以我也会试着当个好人.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_071.en: I still haven't gotten used to the feeling of cutting a zombie with a knife.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_071.ch: 我到現在還是不習慣用刀砍殭屍的感覺.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_071.cn: 我到现在还是不习惯用刀砍僵尸的感觉.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_072.en: I like crushing zombie heads. Splat!
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_072.ch: 我喜歡砸爛殭屍的頭. 啪嘰!
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_072.cn: 我喜欢砸烂僵尸的头. 啪叽!

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_073.en: I'm fine with bringing in more people, but choose carefully.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_073.ch: 我不反對再多收些人, 但要謹慎挑選.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_073.cn: 我不反对再多收些人, 但要谨慎挑选.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_074.en: There were crows gathering in the woods. Means there's a body out there.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_074.ch: 樹林裡聚了一群烏鴉. 代表那裡有屍體.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_074.cn: 树林里聚了一群乌鸦. 说明那里有尸体.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_075.en: Did you see a helicopter in the distance? No? ...Right.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_075.ch: 你有看到遠處的直升機嗎? 沒有? …好吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_075.cn: 你看到远处的直升机了吗? 没有? …好吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_076.en: Someone said they saw a ten-foot zombie. Probably just saw wrong.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_076.ch: 有人說看到一隻十呎高的殭屍. 大概只是看錯了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_076.cn: 有人说看到一只十英尺高的僵尸. 大概只是看错了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_077.en: I heard about a guy who walked straight through a horde. Then one day he tripped and died.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_077.ch: 我聽說有個傢伙直接穿過了屍潮. 結果有一天他絆了一跤就死了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_077.cn: 我听说有个家伙直接穿过了尸潮. 结果有一天他绊了一跤就死了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_078.en: Got any funny stories? ...Yeah, I heard that one already.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_078.ch: 有什麼好笑的故事嗎? …嗯, 那個我聽過了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_078.cn: 有什么好笑的故事吗? …嗯, 那个我听过了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_079.en: Got any funny stories? ...Never heard that one. Don't care, though.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_079.ch: 有什麼好笑的故事嗎? …那個我沒聽過. 不過我也不在乎.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_079.cn: 有什么好笑的故事吗? …那个我没听过. 不过我也不在乎.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_080.en: Got any funny stories? ...Ha! No, wait. It wasn't that funny.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_080.ch: 有什麼好笑的故事嗎? …哈! 不, 等等. 也沒那麼好笑.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_080.cn: 有什么好笑的故事吗? …哈! 不, 等等. 也没那么好笑.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_081.en: There was a pebble in my shoe. It's always the little things that ruin your life.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_081.ch: 我鞋子裡有顆小石頭. 毀掉人生的總是這種小事.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_081.cn: 我鞋里进了颗小石子. 毁掉人生的总是这种小事.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_082.en: Sometimes there are smart ones mixed in with the zombies. Don't get careless.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_082.ch: 殭屍裡有時會混著聰明的傢伙. 別大意.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_082.cn: 僵尸里有时会混着聪明的家伙. 别大意.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_083.en: Sometimes there are fast ones mixed in with the zombies. Don't get careless.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_083.ch: 殭屍裡有時會混著跑得快的傢伙. 別大意.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_083.cn: 僵尸里有时会混着跑得快的家伙. 别大意.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_084.en: Aim for the head. Not mine. The zombie's.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_084.ch: 瞄準頭部. 不是我的頭. 是殭屍的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_084.cn: 瞄准头部. 不是我的头. 是僵尸的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_085.en: Head's worth 100 points, torso's 50, arms are 20. Sound fair?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_085.ch: 頭部 100 分, 軀幹 50 分, 手臂 20 分. 很公平吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_085.cn: 头部 100 分, 躯干 50 分, 手臂 20 分. 很公平吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_086.en: I heard survivors are gathering at the Gigamart. Zombies too, obviously.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_086.ch: 聽說倖存者都聚集到吉嘉超市了. 殭屍當然也是.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_086.cn: 听说幸存者都聚集到吉嘉超市了. 僵尸当然也是.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_087.en: If you die, I die too.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_087.ch: 如果你死了, 我也會跟著死.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_087.cn: 如果你死了, 我也会跟着死.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_088.en: Cats or dogs? ...Huh. So that's your answer.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_088.ch: 貓還是狗? …哦. 原來這就是你的答案.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_088.cn: 猫还是狗? …哦. 原来这就是你的答案.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_089.en: This place might be worse than medieval London.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_089.ch: 這地方可能比中世紀的倫敦還糟.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_089.cn: 这地方可能比中世纪的伦敦还糟.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_090.en: Sometimes I wonder if they're really dead.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_090.ch: 有時候我會懷疑, 他們是不是真的死了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_090.cn: 有时候我会怀疑, 它们是不是真的死了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_091.en: Don't try to be a hero. You'll die.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_091.ch: 別想逞英雄. 你會死的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_091.cn: 别想逞英雄. 你会死的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_092.en: Maybe we're all standing on the edge between life and death. Us and them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_092.ch: 也許我們都站在生與死的邊緣. 我們和他們都是.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_092.cn: 也许我们都站在生与死的边缘. 我们和它们都是.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_093.en: A .44's the way to go. Dirty Harry carried one.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_093.ch: 要用就用 .44. 「緊急追捕令」的哈利就帶著一把.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_093.cn: 要用就用 .44. “肮脏的哈里”就带着一把.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_094.en: Careful. This is the Wild West now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_094.ch: 小心點. 現在這裡可是蠻荒西部.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_094.cn: 小心点. 现在这里可是狂野西部.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_095.en: Bang! Bang! Bang! How's my quick draw?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_095.ch: 砰! 砰! 砰! 我的快拔槍如何?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_095.cn: 砰! 砰! 砰! 我的快速拔枪怎么样?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_096.en: Ever been to the West Coast? I haven't. Let's drive there someday.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_096.ch: 你去過西岸嗎? 我沒去過. 改天開車去吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_096.cn: 你去过西海岸吗? 我没去过. 哪天开车去吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_097.en: They say in Heaven, everybody talks about the ocean.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_097.ch: 聽說在天堂, 大家都在聊大海.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_097.cn: 听说在天堂, 大家都在聊大海.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_098.en: If it comes down to it, leave me behind. I won't leave you, though.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_098.ch: 真到了那一步, 就丟下我吧. 不過我是不會丟下你的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_098.cn: 真到了那一步, 就丢下我吧. 不过我是不会丢下你的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_099.en: Guess we're back to the frontier days. Want to plant an apple tree?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_099.ch: 看來我們回到拓荒時代了. 要不要種棵蘋果樹?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_099.cn: 看来我们回到拓荒时代了. 要不要种棵苹果树?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_100.en: I once shot at someone thinking they were a zombie. Good thing I missed.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_100.ch: 我曾經把人當成殭屍開了槍. 還好沒打中.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_100.cn: 我曾经把人当成僵尸开了枪. 还好没打中.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_101.en: I'm tired... I can't remember the last time I wasn't.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_101.ch: 好累… 我都想不起上次不累是什麼時候了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_101.cn: 好累… 我都想不起上次不累是什么时候了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_102.en: When I wake up, the first thing I do is check my hands.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_102.ch: 我醒來第一件事就是檢查自己的手.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_102.cn: 我醒来第一件事就是检查自己的手.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_103.en: I can eat meat in the middle of that rotten stink now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_103.ch: 我現在都能在那股腐臭味中吃肉了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_103.cn: 我现在都能在那股腐臭味里吃肉了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_104.en: Choose the base location carefully. Please don't build it in the middle of a desert.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_104.ch: 基地位置要慎選. 拜託別蓋在沙漠正中間.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_104.cn: 基地位置要慎重选择. 拜托别建在沙漠正中间.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_105.en: The night is too quiet. Put on some club music or something.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_105.ch: 夜晚太安靜了. 放點夜店音樂之類的吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_105.cn: 夜里太安静了. 放点夜店音乐什么的吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_106.en: I once knew a guy who put poisonous mushrooms in a stew. You be careful too.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_106.ch: 我認識一個傢伙把毒菇放進燉菜裡. 你也小心點.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_106.cn: 我认识一个家伙把毒蘑菇放进炖菜里. 你也小心点.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_107.en: Do you know what bleach tastes like? I don't want to.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_107.ch: 你知道漂白水是什麼味道嗎? 我可不想知道.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_107.cn: 你知道漂白剂是什么味道吗? 我可不想知道.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_108.en: Drive safely, all right? I'd hate to die in some stupid car crash.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_108.ch: 開車小心點, 好嗎? 我可不想死在什麼蠢車禍裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_108.cn: 开车小心点, 好吗? 我可不想死在什么蠢车祸里.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_109.en: Someone said they saw a zombie climbing up the wall of a building. You believe that?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_109.ch: 有人說看到殭屍爬上建築物的牆. 你信嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_109.cn: 有人说看到僵尸爬上建筑物的墙. 你信吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_110.en: If you want to survive, make rules.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_110.ch: 想活下去, 就要訂規矩.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_110.cn: 想活下去, 就要立规矩.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_111.en: Darkness, corners... those things are good at hiding their presence.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_111.ch: 黑暗, 角落… 那些東西很會隱藏自己的存在.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_111.cn: 黑暗, 角落… 那些东西很擅长隐藏自己的存在.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_112.en: Look around before throwing bombs. Don't blow up the house, okay?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_112.ch: 丟炸彈前先看看四周. 別把房子炸了, 好嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_112.cn: 扔炸弹前先看看四周. 别把房子炸了, 好吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_113.en: Burning zombies are dangerous. They keep walking while they're on fire.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_113.ch: 著火的殭屍很危險. 他們身上著火還會繼續走.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_113.cn: 着火的僵尸很危险. 它们身上着火还会继续走.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_114.en: Someone said they saw a zombie dodge bullets. You believe that?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_114.ch: 有人說看到殭屍閃子彈. 你信嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_114.cn: 有人说看到僵尸躲子弹. 你信吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_115.en: Someone said they saw a zombie with no head. You believe that?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_115.ch: 有人說看到沒有頭的殭屍. 你信嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_115.cn: 有人说看到没有头的僵尸. 你信吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_116.en: If you've got time, load some rounds into the magazines.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_116.ch: 有空的話, 把子彈裝進彈匣裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_116.cn: 有空的话, 把子弹装进弹匣里.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_117.en: Was that you banging on the wall last night?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_118.en: Shotguns are powerful, but they call in a lot of zombies. Don't use them at the wrong time.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_118.ch: 霰彈槍威力很大, 但會引來一大堆殭屍. 別在錯的時機用.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_118.cn: 霰弹枪威力很大, 但会引来一大堆僵尸. 别在错误的时机用.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_119.en: Magazines everywhere and no gun! Should we throw the magazines at them?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_119.ch: 到處都是彈匣, 就是沒槍! 要不要拿彈匣砸他們?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_119.cn: 到处都是弹匣, 就是没枪! 要不要拿弹匣砸它们?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_120.en: Don't forget to turn off your flashlight.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_121.en: The sole of your boot is the strongest weapon.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_122.en: Splitting a zombie's head open in one hit is harder than it looks. There's a trick to it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_122.ch: 一擊劈開殭屍的頭比看起來難. 這需要技巧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_122.cn: 一击劈开僵尸的头比看起来难. 这是有诀窍的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_123.en: When you use a knife, don't carve them up. Drive it in with one clean thrust.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_123.ch: 用刀的時候別亂割. 俐落地一刀刺進去.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_123.cn: 用刀的时候别乱割. 干脆利落地一刀捅进去.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_124.en: If I turn into a zombie, then when that time comes... let's become zombies together, yeah?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_124.ch: 如果我變成殭屍, 到時候… 我們就一起變成殭屍吧, 好嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_124.cn: 如果我变成僵尸, 到时候… 我们就一起变成僵尸吧, 好吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_125.en: You're marking things on the map, right? Don't get lost.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_125.ch: 你有在地圖上做記號吧? 別迷路了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_125.cn: 你有在地图上做标记吧? 别迷路了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_126.en: I hate the cold, and I hate the heat.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_126.ch: 我討厭冷, 也討厭熱.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_126.cn: 我讨厌冷, 也讨厌热.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_128.en: Keep your eyes on the road when you're driving, okay?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_128.ch: 開車時眼睛要看路, 好嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_128.cn: 开车时眼睛要看路, 好吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_129.en: I heard the Navy is taking survivors to some island.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_129.ch: 聽說海軍正把倖存者載到某個島上.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_129.cn: 听说海军正把幸存者送到某个岛上.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_130.en: How many zombies have you killed so far? Me... I stopped counting.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_130.ch: 你到現在殺了多少殭屍? 我嘛… 早就不數了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_130.cn: 你到现在杀了多少僵尸? 我嘛… 早就不数了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_131.en: There was a Japanese guy fighting zombies with a katana. In the end, he died by seppuku.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_131.ch: 有個日本人拿武士刀砍殭屍. 最後他切腹自盡了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_131.cn: 有个日本人拿武士刀砍僵尸. 最后他切腹自尽了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_132.en: Listen, don't ever sneak up behind me. I might kill you by accident.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_132.ch: 聽好, 千萬別從背後偷偷靠近我. 我可能會失手殺了你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_132.cn: 听好, 千万别从背后偷偷靠近我. 我可能会失手杀了你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_133.en: I saw a rich guy get attacked and shove a wad of cash into a zombie's mouth before beating it to death.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_133.ch: 我看過一個有錢人被攻擊時, 把一疊鈔票塞進殭屍嘴裡, 再把它打死.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_133.cn: 我见过一个有钱人被袭击时, 把一沓钞票塞进僵尸嘴里, 再把它打死.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_134.en: Even when civilization ends, some things never change.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_134.ch: 就算文明終結了, 有些事還是永遠不變.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_134.cn: 就算文明终结了, 有些事还是永远不会变.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_135.en: I saw a preacher trying to enlighten a zombie. The zombie listened for a while... then bit him.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_135.ch: 我看過一個傳教士想開導殭屍. 殭屍聽了一會兒… 然後咬了他.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_135.cn: 我见过一个传教士想点化僵尸. 僵尸听了一会儿… 然后咬了他.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_136.en: Only open canned food when you're ready to eat it. It'll spoil.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_136.ch: 罐頭準備要吃時再開. 不然會壞掉.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_136.cn: 罐头准备要吃时再开. 不然会坏掉.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_137.en: Don't say it's just your imagination. If something feels off, check it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_137.ch: 別說只是你的錯覺. 只要覺得不對勁, 就去確認.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_137.cn: 别说只是你的错觉. 只要觉得不对劲, 就去确认.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_138.en: One day, a bomb might fall and end everything... maybe that day will come.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_138.ch: 也許哪天會掉下一顆炸彈, 讓一切結束… 說不定那天真的會來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_138.cn: 也许哪天会掉下一颗炸弹, 让一切结束… 说不定那天真的会来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_139.en: Collect books for me. I get bored when we're at the base.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_139.ch: 幫我收集書. 待在基地的時候好無聊.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_139.cn: 帮我收集书. 待在基地的时候好无聊.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_140.en: Persistent bastards. They follow you anywhere.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_140.ch: 一群死纏爛打的混蛋. 走到哪跟到哪.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_140.cn: 一群死缠烂打的混蛋. 走到哪跟到哪.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_141.en: Apparently they can't swim. They won't come into the river. Well, neither can we...
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_141.ch: 聽說他們不會游泳. 他們不會進河裡. 不過嘛, 我們也不會…
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_141.cn: 听说它们不会游泳. 它们不会下河. 不过嘛, 我们也不会…

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_142.en: Don't look for romance in a gun. This is real combat.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_142.ch: 別在槍裡找浪漫. 這是真正的戰鬥.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_142.cn: 别在枪里找浪漫. 这是真正的战斗.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_143.en: At least we probably don't have to worry about World War III anymore.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_143.ch: 至少我們大概不用再擔心第三次世界大戰了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_143.cn: 至少我们大概不用再担心第三次世界大战了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_144.en: Which are you better with, knives or guns? ...I see. So that's why you're so bad.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_144.ch: 你比較擅長用刀還是用槍? …原來如此. 難怪你這麼爛.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_144.cn: 你更擅长用刀还是用枪? …原来如此. 难怪你这么菜.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_145.en: A chef is absolutely necessary. Food rules everything.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_145.ch: 絕對需要一個廚師. 食物主宰一切.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_145.cn: 绝对需要一个厨师. 食物主宰一切.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_146.en: There were so many things I wanted to do before all this... guess that's not happening now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_146.ch: 這一切發生前, 我有好多想做的事… 看來現在是沒機會了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_146.cn: 这一切发生前, 我有好多想做的事… 看来现在是没机会了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_147.en: Put some seasoning in the food, will you? I hate tasteless meals.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_147.ch: 食物裡加點調味料好嗎? 我討厭沒味道的飯.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_147.cn: 食物里加点调料好吗? 我讨厌没味道的饭.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_148.en: Sometimes I feel like pointing the barrel at myself instead of the zombies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_148.ch: 有時候我很想把槍口對準自己, 而不是殭屍.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_148.cn: 有时候我很想把枪口对准自己, 而不是僵尸.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_149.en: I'm glad there aren't zombies running at us with bombs strapped to their bodies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_149.ch: 還好沒有身上綁著炸彈朝我們衝過來的殭屍.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_149.cn: 还好没有身上绑着炸弹朝我们冲过来的僵尸.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_150.en: Building a home means being ready to fight for it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_150.ch: 建立家園, 就代表要準備好為它而戰.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_150.cn: 建立家园, 就意味着要准备好为它而战.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_151.en: There's something I always keep with me... wait, where did it go?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_151.ch: 我總是隨身帶著一樣東西… 咦, 跑哪去了?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_151.cn: 我总是随身带着一样东西… 咦, 跑哪去了?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_152.en: I'm on cooking duty today. You don't have any picky eating habits, right?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_152.ch: 今天輪我煮飯. 你沒什麼挑食的習慣吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_152.cn: 今天轮到我做饭. 你没什么挑食的习惯吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_153.en: There's a zombie corpse lying around. Put it out on garbage day, will you?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_153.ch: 這裡躺著一具殭屍屍體. 垃圾日記得拿出去丟, 好嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_153.cn: 这里躺着一具僵尸尸体. 垃圾日记得拿出去扔, 好吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_154.en: If you find batteries, bring them back. I want to play my Game Boy.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_154.ch: 找到電池就帶回來. 我想玩我的任天堂 Game Boy.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_154.cn: 找到电池就带回来. 我想玩我的任天堂 Game Boy.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_155.en: Damn it, I just remembered I returned a video without rewinding it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_155.ch: 可惡, 我剛想起來我還錄影帶時沒倒帶.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_155.cn: 该死, 我刚想起来我还录像带的时候没倒带.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_156.en: All right, watch up, down, front, back, left, and right. I'll have a smoke.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_156.ch: 好, 上下前後左右都盯好. 我去抽根菸.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_156.cn: 好, 上下前后左右都盯好. 我抽根烟.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_157.en: Hey, you're not hiding cigarettes from me, are you?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_157.ch: 喂, 你沒把菸藏起來不給我吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_157.cn: 喂, 你没把烟藏起来不给我吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_158.en: Whatever happens, don't panic. That 0.1 second can be what kills you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_158.ch: 不管發生什麼都別慌. 那 0.1 秒就可能要了你的命.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_158.cn: 不管发生什么都别慌. 那 0.1 秒就可能要了你的命.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_159.en: I just saw an insanely beautiful woman... she was a zombie.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_159.ch: 我剛看到一個超級美女… 是殭屍.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_159.cn: 我刚看到一个超级美女… 是僵尸.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_160.en: That zombie I saw the other day was that famous... no? Oh. Never mind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_160.ch: 我前幾天看到的那隻殭屍, 是那個有名的… 不是嗎? 喔. 算了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_160.cn: 我前几天看到的那只僵尸, 是那个有名的… 不是吗? 哦. 算了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_161.en: In this world of slowpokes, I'm Carl Lewis.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_161.ch: 在這個慢吞吞的世界裡, 我就是卡爾·路易斯.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_161.cn: 在这个慢吞吞的世界里, 我就是卡尔·刘易斯.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_162.en: Under the bed, inside the closet, in the back seat... they can be anywhere, so stay sharp.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_162.ch: 床底下, 衣櫃裡, 後座… 他們可能在任何地方, 所以保持警覺.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_162.cn: 床底下, 衣柜里, 后座… 它们可能在任何地方, 所以保持警惕.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_163.en: Let me drive next time. My license got revoked, but still.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_163.ch: 下次讓我開吧. 雖然我的駕照被吊銷了, 但還是可以.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_163.cn: 下次让我开吧. 虽然我的驾照被吊销了, 但还是可以.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_164.en: That whiskey you hid under the bed? Sorry, I drank it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_164.ch: 你藏在床底下的那瓶威士忌? 抱歉, 我喝掉了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_164.cn: 你藏在床底下的那瓶威士忌? 抱歉, 我喝掉了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_165.en: I keep one bullet in my pocket... you know why, right?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_165.ch: 我口袋裡一直留著一顆子彈… 你知道為什麼吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_165.cn: 我口袋里一直留着一颗子弹… 你知道为什么吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_166.en: Don't run too much. You'll trip.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_166.ch: 別跑太多. 會跌倒的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_166.cn: 别跑太多. 会摔倒的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_167.en: You brought the travel itinerary, right?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_168.en: Where are we headed today? Disneyland?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_168.ch: 今天要去哪? 迪士尼樂園?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_168.cn: 今天去哪? 迪士尼乐园?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_169.en: I keep dreaming that I wake up inside a coffin.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_169.ch: 我一直夢到自己在棺材裡醒來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_169.cn: 我总是梦到自己在棺材里醒来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_170.en: They can see in the dark. Even if we can't see them, they can see us.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_170.ch: 他們在黑暗中看得見. 就算我們看不到他們, 他們也看得到我們.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_170.cn: 它们在黑暗中看得见. 就算我们看不到它们, 它们也看得到我们.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_171.en: That blood on you... oh, it's just zombie blood.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_171.ch: 你身上那些血… 喔, 只是殭屍的血啊.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_171.cn: 你身上那些血… 哦, 只是僵尸的血啊.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_172.en: It's easy to blame someone. Easy, and that's all.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_172.ch: 怪罪別人很容易. 很容易, 也就只是這樣而已.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_172.cn: 怪罪别人很容易. 很容易, 仅此而已.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_173.en: Luckily, our group doesn't fight with each other. Lucky us.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_173.ch: 幸好我們這群人不會內鬨. 真幸運.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_173.cn: 幸好我们这群人不会内讧. 真幸运.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_174.en: Left or right... it's always a tough choice.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_174.ch: 左邊還是右邊… 永遠是個難題.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_174.cn: 左边还是右边… 永远是个难题.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_175.en: They say meat tastes better when it's almost rotten, right?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_175.ch: 聽說肉快壞掉的時候最好吃, 對吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_175.cn: 听说肉快坏掉的时候最好吃, 对吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_176.en: Once, I ate a huge hamburger and my jaw popped out. How do those things keep theirs attached?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_176.ch: 有一次我吃超大漢堡, 下巴脫臼了. 那些東西是怎麼讓下巴不掉下來的?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_176.cn: 有一次我吃超大汉堡, 下巴脱臼了. 那些东西是怎么让下巴不掉下来的?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_177.en: A doctor is absolutely necessary. A doctor who isn't a zombie, I mean.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_177.ch: 絕對需要一個醫生. 我是說, 不是殭屍的醫生.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_177.cn: 绝对需要一个医生. 我是说, 不是僵尸的医生.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_178.en: Don't stick your muzzle out around a corner. Basic room clearing.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_178.ch: 轉角處別把槍口伸出去. 這是清房的基本.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_178.cn: 拐角处别把枪口伸出去. 这是清房的基本功.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_179.ch: 我們是殭屍剋星, 對吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_179.cn: 我们是僵尸克星, 对吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_180.en: Let's play chess sometime. The rules? We'll make them up.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_180.ch: 改天來下西洋棋吧. 規則? 我們自己訂.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_180.cn: 改天来下国际象棋吧. 规则? 我们自己定.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_181.en: Let's play poker sometime with the cards I made.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_181.ch: 改天用我做的牌來玩撲克吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_181.cn: 改天用我做的牌来玩扑克吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_182.en: Give me a better house, will you? Something like the White House.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_182.ch: 給我一間更好的房子吧? 像白宮那樣的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_182.cn: 给我一间更好的房子吧? 像白宫那样的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_183.en: If you find a tank, tell me. I always wanted to ride one.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_183.ch: 如果找到坦克就告訴我. 我一直想坐坐看.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_183.cn: 如果找到坦克就告诉我. 我一直想坐一次.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_184.en: Don't get careless just because we have walls. Everything has a lifespan.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_184.ch: 別因為有圍牆就大意. 什麼東西都有壽命.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_184.cn: 别因为有围墙就大意. 什么东西都有寿命.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_185.en: Always stay cool. That's how you survive.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_185.ch: 永遠保持冷靜. 這樣才能活下去.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_185.cn: 永远保持冷静. 这样才能活下去.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_186.en: Walk quietly. Like a cat, like a ninja...
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_186.ch: 走路輕一點. 像貓一樣, 像忍者一樣…
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_186.cn: 走路轻一点. 像猫一样, 像忍者一样…

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_187.en: Watch out for smells too, not just sounds... What? Your nose is stuffed and you can't smell anything?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_187.ch: 除了聲音, 也要注意氣味… 什麼? 你鼻塞聞不到?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_187.cn: 除了声音, 也要注意气味… 什么? 你鼻塞闻不到?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_188.en: The people back at base bring in all kinds of items. Check on them once in a while.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_188.ch: 基地裡的人會帶回各種物品. 偶爾去看看他們吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_188.cn: 基地里的人会带回各种物品. 偶尔去看看他们吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_189.en: I won't fight if you're not nearby, so keep that in mind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_189.ch: 你不在附近的話我是不會戰鬥的, 記好了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_189.cn: 你不在附近的话我是不会战斗的, 记住了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_190.en: Are you organizing the containers properly? I found a gun in the fridge.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_190.ch: 你有好好整理容器嗎? 我在冰箱裡找到一把槍.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_190.cn: 你有好好整理容器吗? 我在冰箱里找到一把枪.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_191.en: Are you organizing the containers properly? I found food in the armory.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_191.ch: 你有好好整理容器嗎? 我在軍械庫裡找到食物.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_191.cn: 你有好好整理容器吗? 我在军械库里找到食物.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_192.en: Could you please stop cooking with the same frying pan you used to beat a zombie?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_192.ch: 拜託別再用打過殭屍的平底鍋煮飯了好嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_192.cn: 拜托别再用打过僵尸的平底锅做饭了好吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_193.en: There's a dessert on the shelf. A Desert Eagle, I mean.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_193.ch: 架子上有份甜點. 我是說, 沙漠之鷹.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_193.cn: 架子上有份甜点. 我是说, 沙漠之鹰.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_194.en: Put curtains on the windows, will you? I can't relax like this.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_194.ch: 窗戶裝上窗簾好嗎? 這樣我沒辦法放鬆.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_194.cn: 窗户装上窗帘好吗? 这样我没法放松.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_195.en: Please don't make this place a house made of nothing but containers.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_195.ch: 拜託別把這裡弄成一間全是容器的房子.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_195.cn: 拜托别把这里弄成一间全是容器的房子.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_196.en: Please don't make this place a square box of a house.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_196.ch: 拜託別把這裡弄成方方正正的箱子屋.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_196.cn: 拜托别把这里弄成方方正正的盒子房.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_197.en: Stop leaving every damn thing on the floor.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_197.ch: 別再把該死的東西全丟在地上了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_197.cn: 别再把该死的东西全丢在地上了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_198.en: Don't go out on rainy days. It covers up every sign of the zombies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_198.ch: 下雨天別出門. 雨會掩蓋殭屍的所有蹤跡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_198.cn: 下雨天别出门. 雨会掩盖僵尸的所有踪迹.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_199.en: Dry your wet clothes properly. You'll catch a cold.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_199.ch: 濕衣服要好好晾乾. 會感冒的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_199.cn: 湿衣服要好好晾干. 会感冒的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_200.en: Sorry, I'm bad at locking up.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_200.ch: 抱歉, 我不太會鎖門.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_200.cn: 抱歉, 我不太会锁门.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_RecruitResponse.en: Thanks for having me. I'll follow your lead.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_RecruitResponse.ch: 謝謝你收留我. 我會聽你的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_RecruitResponse.cn: 谢谢你收留我. 我会听你的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye.en: I don't want to be alone. Please don't leave me behind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye.ch: 我不想一個人. 拜託別丟下我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye.cn: 我不想一个人. 求你别丢下我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye.ch: 他們在追我! 救救我!
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye.cn: 它们在追我! 救救我!

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye.en: Please, take me with you. I swear I'll be useful.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye.ch: 拜託, 帶我一起走. 我發誓我會派上用場.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye.cn: 求你了, 带我一起走. 我发誓我会派上用场.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye.ch: 拜託, 讓我加入你們.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye.cn: 求你了, 让我加入你们.

IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye.en: I can fight and scavenge. I won't be a burden.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye.ch: 我會戰鬥也會搜刮. 不會拖累你的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye.cn: 我能战斗也能搜刮. 不会拖累你的.

IGUI_NotAlone_FieldSpawnNotice_1.en: You hear someone calling for help

IGUI_NotAlone_FieldSpawnNotice_3.en: You hear a voice calling this way
IGUI_NotAlone_FieldSpawnNotice_3.ch: 你聽到有人朝這邊呼喚
IGUI_NotAlone_FieldSpawnNotice_3.cn: 你听到有人朝这边呼喊

IGUI_NotAlone_LoversComfort_Desc.en: Increases your health regeneration for 8 hours
IGUI_NotAlone_LoversComfort_Desc.ch: 8 小時內提升生命恢復速度
IGUI_NotAlone_LoversComfort_Desc.cn: 8 小时内提高生命恢复速度

IGUI_LGES_Why_SwitchedOff.en: An admin has switched this off.

IGUI_OffGrid_BkFull.en: This controller already has four generators.
IGUI_OffGrid_BkFull.ch: 此控制器已連接四台發電機.
IGUI_OffGrid_BkFull.cn: 此控制器已连接四台发电机.

IGUI_OffGrid_BkIndoors.en: A backup generator can't run indoors.
IGUI_OffGrid_BkIndoors.ch: 備用發電機無法在室內運轉.
IGUI_OffGrid_BkIndoors.cn: 备用发电机无法在室内运转.

IGUI_OffGrid_BwFar.en: This part does not reach that building.
IGUI_OffGrid_BwFar.ch: 此元件的範圍達不到那棟建築.
IGUI_OffGrid_BwFar.cn: 此部件的范围够不到那栋建筑.

IGUI_OffGrid_BwFull.en: This part already wires all it can.
IGUI_OffGrid_BwFull.ch: 此元件已接滿可接的建築.
IGUI_OffGrid_BwFull.cn: 此部件已接满可接的建筑.

IGUI_OffGrid_BwNotEnclosed.en: Not a closed building with a roof.
IGUI_OffGrid_BwNotEnclosed.ch: 不是有屋頂的封閉建築.
IGUI_OffGrid_BwNotEnclosed.cn: 不是有屋顶的封闭建筑.

IGUI_OffGrid_BwTaken.en: Another system already powers that building.
IGUI_OffGrid_BwTaken.ch: 該建築已由其他系統供電.
IGUI_OffGrid_BwTaken.cn: 该建筑已由其他系统供电.

IGUI_OffGrid_BwUnwired.en: Connect this transformer to the controller first.
IGUI_OffGrid_BwUnwired.ch: 請先將此變壓器連接至控制器.
IGUI_OffGrid_BwUnwired.cn: 请先将此变压器连接至控制器.

IGUI_OffGrid_GenHowTo.en: Convert a generator (Electrical 3 or Magazine: How to Use Generators, and a screwdriver), then run a cable from it to this controller.
IGUI_OffGrid_GenHowTo.ch: 改裝一台發電機 (需要電工 3 或雜誌「如何使用發電機」, 以及螺絲起子), 再從它拉一條電纜到此控制器.
IGUI_OffGrid_GenHowTo.cn: 改装一台发电机 (需要电工 3 或“电子杂志4: 发电机使用指南”, 以及螺丝刀), 再从它拉一条电缆到此控制器.

IGUI_OffGrid_InfoLgeeReach.en: LG Extended Electricity still restricts controller reach. Turn off "Mod sets generator range" and "Mod sets generator vertical range" in sandbox settings, then restart the server or reload your singleplayer save. Changing the options alone does not restore the range.
IGUI_OffGrid_InfoLgeeReach.ch: LG Extended Electricity 仍在限制控制器的供電範圍. 請在沙盒設定中關閉「MOD 設定發電機範圍」與「MOD 設定發電機垂直範圍」, 然後重新啟動伺服器或重新載入單人存檔. 只更改選項並不會恢復供電範圍.
IGUI_OffGrid_InfoLgeeReach.cn: LG Extended Electricity 仍在限制控制器的供电范围. 请在沙盒设置中关闭“MOD 设置发电机范围”和“MOD 设置发电机垂直范围”, 然后重启服务器或重新加载单人存档. 仅更改选项并不会恢复供电范围.

IGUI_OffGrid_InfoLowBatt.ch: 已切斷負載, 電池電量低
IGUI_OffGrid_InfoLowBatt.cn: 已切断负载, 电池电量低

IGUI_OffGrid_InfoSystemAtLevel.ch: 已接入位於 {1}, {2}, {3} 的系統.
IGUI_OffGrid_InfoSystemAtLevel.cn: 已接入位于 {1}, {2}, {3} 的系统.

IGUI_OffGrid_LampEmpty.en: Battery empty. It charges in the sun.
IGUI_OffGrid_LampEmpty.ch: 電池沒電了. 會在陽光下充電.
IGUI_OffGrid_LampEmpty.cn: 电池没电了. 会在阳光下充电.

IGUI_OffGrid_LampShaded.en: Under a roof: its panel gets no sun.
IGUI_OffGrid_LampShaded.ch: 有屋頂遮蔽: 它的太陽能板照不到陽光.
IGUI_OffGrid_LampShaded.cn: 有屋顶遮挡: 它的光伏板照不到阳光.

IGUI_OffGrid_LgeeSeeInfo.ch: 請見 離網 > 資訊
IGUI_OffGrid_LgeeSeeInfo.cn: 请见 离网 > 信息

IGUI_OffGrid_LgeeSets.ch: 由 LG Extended Electricity 設定
IGUI_OffGrid_LgeeSets.cn: 由 LG Extended Electricity 设置

IGUI_OffGrid_LoadShed.ch: 已切斷負載  {1}%% 時恢復
IGUI_OffGrid_LoadShed.cn: 已切断负载  {1}%% 时恢复

IGUI_OffGrid_OptSidebarTip.en: The almanac stays on the right-click menu and the hold-Q wheel.
IGUI_OffGrid_OptSidebarTip.ch: 曆書仍可從右鍵選單和按住 Q 的輪盤開啟.
IGUI_OffGrid_OptSidebarTip.cn: 历书仍可从右键菜单和按住 Q 的轮盘打开.

IGUI_OffGrid_PickHelp.en: Click a building to add it or take it away.
IGUI_OffGrid_PickHelp.ch: 點選建築以新增或移除.
IGUI_OffGrid_PickHelp.cn: 点击建筑以添加或移除.

IGUI_OffGrid_PickLegend.en: Green: wired. Yellow: add. Blue: remove. Red: out of reach, or another system has it.
IGUI_OffGrid_PickLegend.ch: 綠色: 已接線. 黃色: 新增. 藍色: 移除. 紅色: 超出範圍, 或已由其他系統占用.
IGUI_OffGrid_PickLegend.cn: 绿色: 已接线. 黄色: 添加. 蓝色: 移除. 红色: 超出范围, 或已被其他系统占用.

IGUI_SS_ModOptionsDesc1.en: Optional client-side volume override. Changes apply immediately without restarting the game.
IGUI_SS_ModOptionsDesc1.ch: 可選的客戶端音量覆寫. 變更立即生效, 無需重新啟動遊戲.
IGUI_SS_ModOptionsDesc1.cn: 可选的客户端音量覆盖. 更改立即生效, 无需重启游戏.

IGUI_SS_ModOptionsDesc2.en: Leave this disabled to keep using the world's Sandbox volume settings.
IGUI_SS_ModOptionsDesc2.ch: 保持停用即可繼續使用世界的沙盒模式音量設定.
IGUI_SS_ModOptionsDesc2.cn: 保持禁用以继续使用世界的沙盒模式音量设置.

IGUI_SS_ModOptionsEnable.en: Use live Mod Options volume override
IGUI_SS_ModOptionsEnable.ch: 使用即時模組選項音量覆寫
IGUI_SS_ModOptionsEnable.cn: 使用实时模组选项音量覆盖

IGUI_SS_ModOptionsEnableTooltip.en: When enabled, the sliders below replace RSS Sandbox audio-volume values for your local client.
IGUI_SS_ModOptionsEnableTooltip.ch: 啟用後, 下方的滑桿將取代RSS沙盒模式的音訊音量值, 僅作用於你的本機客戶端.
IGUI_SS_ModOptionsEnableTooltip.cn: 启用后, 下方的滑块将替代RSS沙盒模式的音频音量值, 仅作用于你的本地客户端.

IGUI_SS_ModOptionsFooter.en: This menu affects only what YOU hear. Zombie hearing, loot, crafting and durability remain Sandbox/server settings.
IGUI_SS_ModOptionsFooter.ch: 此選單只影響「你」聽到的聲音. 殭屍聽力、戰利品、製作和耐久度仍由沙盒/伺服器設定決定.
IGUI_SS_ModOptionsFooter.cn: 此菜单只影响“你”听到的声音. 僵尸听力、战利品、制作和耐久度仍由沙盒/服务器设置决定.

IGUI_SS_ModOptionsLMG.ch: 輕機槍/重機槍消音器音量
IGUI_SS_ModOptionsLMG.cn: 轻机枪/重机枪消音器音量

IGUI_SS_ModOptionsSliderTooltip.en: Affects suppressed gunshot playback only. 100 percent = normal RSS level. Maximum: 300 percent.
IGUI_SS_ModOptionsSliderTooltip.ch: 僅影響加裝消音器後的槍聲播放. 百分之100=RSS預設音量. 最大值: 百分之300.

IGUI_SS_ModOptionsTitle.ch: 即時消音器與熱彈殼音效
