IGUI_CU_MG_Pill_HoldTheBottleOverTheMout.en: Hold the bottle over the mouth, then hold click to tip it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Pill_HoldTheBottleOverTheMout.ch: 把瓶子拿到嘴巴上方, 然後按住點選把它傾斜.
IGUI_CU_MG_Pill_HoldTheBottleOverTheMout.cn: 把瓶子拿到嘴巴上方, 然后按住点击把它倾斜.

IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_ClickTheBowlToTakeSo.en: Click the bowl to take some paste, then hold and spread it over the marked patch.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_ClickTheBowlToTakeSo.ch: 點選碗沾取一些藥膏, 然後按住並塗抹在標記區域上.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_ClickTheBowlToTakeSo.cn: 点击碗蘸取一些药膏, 然后按住并涂抹在标记区域上.

IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_ClickTheBowlToTakeSo.en: Click the bowl to take some paste.

IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_GentlyPressItOnDonTR.en: Gently. Press it on, don't rub.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_GentlyPressItOnDonTR.ch: 輕一點. 壓上去, 不要揉.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_GentlyPressItOnDonTR.cn: 轻一点. 压上去, 不要揉.

IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_HoldAndDrawYourFinge.en: Hold and draw your fingers over the marked patch.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_HoldAndDrawYourFinge.ch: 按住並用手指劃過標記區域.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_HoldAndDrawYourFinge.cn: 按住并用手指划过标记区域.

IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_PatchyButItSOn.ch: 塗得不均勻, 但總算敷上了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_PatchyButItSOn.cn: 涂得不均匀, 但总算敷上了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_WhenYourFingersAreEm.en: When your fingers are empty, go back to the bowl.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_WhenYourFingersAreEm.ch: 手指上的藥膏用完時, 再回到碗裡沾取.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_WhenYourFingersAreEm.cn: 手指上的药膏用完时, 再回到碗里蘸取.

IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_YourFingersAreEmptyT.en: Your fingers are empty. Take some from the bowl.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_YourFingersAreEmptyT.ch: 你手指上沒東西. 從碗裡沾一些.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_YourFingersAreEmptyT.cn: 你手指上没东西. 从碗里蘸一些.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_BringTheSocketSOpe.en: Bring the socket's open end to the end of the stump, level with it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_BringTheSocketSOpe.ch: 把接受腔的開口端移到殘肢末端, 與它對齊.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_BringTheSocketSOpe.cn: 把接受腔的开口端移到残肢末端, 与它对齐.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ClickBothBucklesTo.en: Click both buckles to undo the straps.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ClickBothBucklesTo.ch: 點選兩個扣環解開綁帶.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ClickBothBucklesTo.cn: 点击两个扣环解开绑带.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ClickBothBucklesTo.en: Click both buckles to undo them.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ClickBothBucklesTo.ch: 點選兩個扣環把它們解開.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ClickBothBucklesTo.cn: 点击两个扣环把它们解开.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_DragTheSocketSOpen.en: Drag the socket's open end to the end of the stump.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_DragTheSocketSOpen.ch: 把接受腔的開口端拖曳到殘肢末端.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_DragTheSocketSOpen.cn: 把接受腔的开口端拖到残肢末端.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_EasyItSDraggingAtT.en: Easy -- it's dragging at the scar.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_EasyItSDraggingAtT.ch: 輕一點 -- 它在拉扯疤痕.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_EasyItSDraggingAtT.cn: 轻一点 -- 它在拉扯疤痕.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_EasyItSPinchingThe.ch: 輕一點 -- 它夾到殘肢了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_EasyItSPinchingThe.cn: 轻一点 -- 它夹到残肢了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_HoldTheSocketAndDr.en: Hold the socket and draw it off to the right.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_HoldTheSocketAndDr.ch: 握住接受腔, 往右拉出來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_HoldTheSocketAndDr.cn: 握住接受腔, 往右拉出来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_HoldTheSocketAndSl.en: Hold the socket and slide it onto the stump.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_HoldTheSocketAndSl.ch: 握住接受腔, 把它套上殘肢.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_HoldTheSocketAndSl.cn: 握住接受腔, 把它套上残肢.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_SeatedNowTheBuckle.ch: 到位了. 接下來扣扣環.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_SeatedNowTheBuckle.cn: 到位了. 接下来扣扣环.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_SlideItOnUntilItSe.en: Slide it on until it seats, then click both buckles.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_SlideItOnUntilItSe.ch: 套到底卡住為止, 然後點選兩個扣環.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_SlideItOnUntilItSe.cn: 套到底卡住为止, 然后点击两个扣环.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ThenDrawTheSocketO.en: Then draw the socket off the stump, easily.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ThenDrawTheSocketO.ch: 然後輕輕把接受腔從殘肢上拉下來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ThenDrawTheSocketO.cn: 然后轻轻把接受腔从残肢上拉下来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_UndoneDrawItOffThe.en: Undone. Draw it off the stump.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_UndoneDrawItOffThe.ch: 解開了. 把它從殘肢上拉下來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_UndoneDrawItOffThe.cn: 解开了. 把它从残肢上拉下来.

IGUI_CU_MG_SelfHarm_YourHandShakesHarder.en: Your hand shakes harder every time.
IGUI_CU_MG_SelfHarm_YourHandShakesHarder.ch: 你的手每次都抖得更厲害.
IGUI_CU_MG_SelfHarm_YourHandShakesHarder.cn: 你的手每次都抖得更厉害.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_DrawEachStitchThroug.en: Draw each stitch through slowly. Going too fast will hurt.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_DrawEachStitchThroug.ch: 慢慢把每一針拉出來. 太快會很痛.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_DrawEachStitchThroug.cn: 慢慢把每一针拉出来. 太快会很痛.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_HoldStillThisPartSti.ch: 別動. 這步會有點刺痛.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_HoldStillThisPartSti.cn: 别动. 这步会有点刺痛.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_ItTwistedOutOfYourFi.en: It twisted out of your fingers.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_KeepItStraightYouReL.en: Keep it straight -- you're levering it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_KeepItStraightYouReL.ch: 保持筆直 -- 你在撬它.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_KeepItStraightYouReL.cn: 保持笔直 -- 你在撬它.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_LetSClearUpTheGlassS.en: Let's clear up the glass shards next time...
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_LetSClearUpTheGlassS.ch: 下次先把碎玻璃清乾淨吧…
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_LetSClearUpTheGlassS.cn: 下次先把碎玻璃清干净吧…

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_PullTheShrapnelOutSl.en: Pull the shrapnel out slowly. Going too fast will hurt.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_PullTheShrapnelOutSl.ch: 慢慢把碎片拉出來. 太快會很痛.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_PullTheShrapnelOutSl.cn: 慢慢把碎片拉出来. 太快会很痛.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_UsingANeedleHolderWi.en: Using a needle holder will bypass the speed limit.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_UsingANeedleHolderWi.ch: 使用持針器可以不受速度限制.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_UsingANeedleHolderWi.cn: 使用持针钳可以不受速度限制.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_UsingTweezersWillByp.en: Using tweezers will bypass the speed limit.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_UsingTweezersWillByp.ch: 使用鑷子可以不受速度限制.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_UsingTweezersWillByp.cn: 使用镊子可以不受速度限制.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_YouToreTheStitchStra.en: You tore the stitch straight out.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_YouToreTheStitchStra.ch: 你把縫線直接扯出來了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_YouToreTheStitchStra.cn: 你把缝线直接扯出来了.

IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_CarefulTheBreakIsSt.en: Careful -- the break is still healing.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_CarefulTheBreakIsSt.ch: 小心 -- 骨折還在癒合.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_CarefulTheBreakIsSt.cn: 小心 -- 骨折还在愈合.

IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_EasyLiftItSlowly.ch: 輕一點. 慢慢抬起來.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_EasyLiftItSlowly.cn: 轻一点. 慢慢抬起来.

IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_LooseNowLiftTheBoar.en: Loose. Now lift the boards away.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_LooseNowLiftTheBoar.ch: 鬆開了. 現在把木板移開.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_LooseNowLiftTheBoar.cn: 松开了. 现在把木板移开.

IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeABoardAndEaseIt.en: Take a board and ease it away from the limb.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeABoardAndEaseIt.ch: 拿一塊木板, 慢慢從肢體上移開.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeABoardAndEaseIt.cn: 拿一块木板, 慢慢从肢体上移开.

IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeAKnotAndTugItSi.en: Take a knot and tug it sideways.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeAKnotAndTugItSi.ch: 抓住一個結, 往側邊拉.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeAKnotAndTugItSi.cn: 抓住一个结, 往侧边拉.

IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeEachKnotAndTugI.en: Take each knot and tug it loose, sideways.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeEachKnotAndTugI.ch: 抓住每個結, 往側邊拉鬆.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeEachKnotAndTugI.cn: 抓住每个结, 往侧边拉松.

IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_ThenTakeEachBoardAn.en: Then take each board and ease it away from the limb, slowly.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_ThenTakeEachBoardAn.ch: 然後拿起每塊木板, 慢慢從肢體上移開.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_ThenTakeEachBoardAn.cn: 然后拿起每块木板, 慢慢从肢体上移开.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ClickASnipMarkBesid.en: Click a snip mark beside a knot.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ClickASnipMarkBesid.ch: 點選線結旁的剪線標記.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ClickASnipMarkBesid.cn: 点击线结旁的剪线标记.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ClickTheSnipMarkBes.en: Click the snip mark beside each knot to cut the stitch.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ClickTheSnipMarkBes.ch: 點選每個線結旁的剪線標記來剪斷縫線.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ClickTheSnipMarkBes.cn: 点击每个线结旁的剪线标记来剪断缝线.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_GentlyItSTuggingAtT.en: Gently. It's tugging at the wound.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_GentlyItSTuggingAtT.ch: 輕一點. 它在拉扯傷口.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_GentlyItSTuggingAtT.cn: 轻一点. 它在拉扯伤口.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_HalfOfThemAreStillI.en: Half of them are still in.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_SnipOnTheMarkBeside.en: Snip on the mark beside a knot.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_SnipOnTheMarkBeside.ch: 從線結旁的標記處剪下.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_SnipOnTheMarkBeside.cn: 从线结旁的标记处剪下.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_SnippedNowDrawTheTh.en: Snipped. Now draw the thread out.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_SnippedNowDrawTheTh.ch: 剪斷了. 現在把線抽出來.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_SnippedNowDrawTheTh.cn: 剪断了. 现在把线抽出来.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_TakeTheSnippedKnotA.en: Take the snipped knot and draw it out.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_TakeTheSnippedKnotA.ch: 夾住剪斷的線結, 把它抽出來.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_TakeTheSnippedKnotA.cn: 夹住剪断的线结, 把它抽出来.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ThenTakeTheKnotWith.en: Then take the knot with the tweezers and draw the thread out, gently.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ThenTakeTheKnotWith.ch: 然後用鑷子夾住線結, 輕輕把線抽出來.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ThenTakeTheKnotWith.cn: 然后用镊子夹住线结, 轻轻把线抽出来.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_UpAndAwayFromTheWou.en: Up and away from the wound.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_UpAndAwayFromTheWou.ch: 往上, 朝遠離傷口的方向.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_UpAndAwayFromTheWou.cn: 往上, 朝远离伤口的方向.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_YouNickedTheSkinSni.en: You nicked the skin. Snip right beside the knot.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_YouNickedTheSkinSni.ch: 你劃破了皮膚. 要緊貼著線結旁邊剪.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_YouNickedTheSkinSni.cn: 你划破了皮肤. 要紧贴着线结旁边剪.

IGUI_CU_MG_Stopped.ch: 已停止 - 什麼都沒做
IGUI_CU_MG_Stopped.cn: 已停止 - 什么都没做

IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_AllTheWayThroughToTheL.en: All the way through to the lower mark.

IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_HoldStillThisPartSting.ch: 別動. 這步會有點刺痛.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_HoldStillThisPartSting.cn: 别动. 这步会有点刺痛.

IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_ItRippedThroughTheSkin.en: It ripped through the skin. Put it in again.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_ItRippedThroughTheSkin.ch: 針撕裂了皮膚. 重新刺入.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_ItRippedThroughTheSkin.cn: 针撕裂了皮肤. 重新刺入.

IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_KeepUnderTheWoundYouRe.en: Keep under the wound -- you're tearing it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_KeepUnderTheWoundYouRe.ch: 保持在傷口下方, 你正在撕裂它.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_KeepUnderTheWoundYouRe.cn: 保持在伤口下方, 你正在撕裂它.

IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_PushTheNeedleInAtTheUp.en: Push the needle in at the upper mark, draw it under the wound to the lower one.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_PushTheNeedleInAtTheUp.ch: 從上方標記把針刺入, 從傷口底下穿到下方標記.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_PushTheNeedleInAtTheUp.cn: 从上方标记把针刺入, 从伤口底下穿到下方标记.

IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_SlowlyWithoutANeedleHo.en: Slowly, without a needle holder. Then pull the thread snug.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_SlowlyWithoutANeedleHo.ch: 沒有持針器, 要慢慢來. 然後把線拉緊.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_SlowlyWithoutANeedleHo.cn: 没有持针钳, 要慢慢来. 然后把线拉紧.

IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_ThenPullTheThreadSnugN.en: Then pull the thread snug -- not too hard.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_ThenPullTheThreadSnugN.ch: 然後把線拉緊, 別太用力.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_ThenPullTheThreadSnugN.cn: 然后把线拉紧, 别太用力.

IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_AlreadyInBlood.en: There is still %1 in you. Anything more lands on top of it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_AlreadyInBlood.ch: 你體內還有 %1. 再打任何劑量都會疊加上去.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_AlreadyInBlood.cn: 你体内还有 %1. 再打任何剂量都会叠加上去.

IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_HoldItSteadyTheNeedle.en: Hold it steady -- the needle's in.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_HoldItSteadyTheNeedle.ch: 穩住, 針已經扎進去了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_HoldItSteadyTheNeedle.cn: 稳住, 针已经扎进去了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_NotEnoughYetPushItInA.en: Not enough yet -- push it in again.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_NotEnoughYetPushItInA.ch: 劑量還不夠, 再推一次.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_NotEnoughYetPushItInA.cn: 剂量还不够, 再推一次.

IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_PastTheBandIsTheWhole.en: Past the band is the whole syringe. That is an overdose.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_PastTheBandIsTheWhole.ch: 超過刻度帶就是整支注射器的量. 那會過量.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_PastTheBandIsTheWhole.cn: 超过刻度带就是整支注射器的量. 那会过量.

IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_PushSyringeDownToInje.en: Push syringe down to inject. Make sure to check the dosage.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_PushSyringeDownToInje.ch: 往下推注射器進行注射. 務必確認劑量.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_PushSyringeDownToInje.cn: 往下推注射器进行注射. 务必确认剂量.

IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_TooMuchYouPushedStrai.en: Too much -- you pushed straight past the dose.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_TooMuchYouPushedStrai.ch: 太多了, 你直接推過了劑量.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_TooMuchYouPushedStrai.cn: 太多了, 你直接推过了剂量.

IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_TookTooLongTheNeedleI.en: Took too long. The needle is done for.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_TookTooLongTheNeedleI.ch: 拖太久了. 這根針廢了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_TookTooLongTheNeedleI.cn: 拖太久了. 这根针废了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ClickAndDragTheTou.en: Click and drag the tourniquet onto the marked band.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ClickAndDragTheTou.ch: 點選並拖曳止血帶到標記區域上.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ClickAndDragTheTou.cn: 点击并将止血带拖到标记区域上.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ClickTheClipToLock.en: Click the clip to lock it.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ClickTheClipToRele.en: Click the clip to release it.
Click the clip to release it, then turn the rod back, slowly.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ClickTheClipToRele.ch: 點選扣環將它鬆開, 然後慢慢把絞棒轉回去.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ClickTheClipToRele.cn: 点击卡扣将其松开, 然后慢慢把绞棒转回去.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_DragTheTourniquetO.en: Drag the tourniquet onto the marked band, above the wound.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_DragTheTourniquetO.ch: 將止血帶拖到傷口上方的標示區.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_DragTheTourniquetO.cn: 将止血带拖到伤口上方的标示区.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_NotOnTheWoundOrBel.en: Not on the wound or below it. Above it -- between it and the heart.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_NotOnTheWoundOrBel.ch: 不是綁在傷口上或傷口下方. 要在上方, 介於傷口與心臟之間.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_NotOnTheWoundOrBel.cn: 不是绑在伤口上或伤口下方. 要在上方, 介于伤口与心脏之间.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnIfNotLockedWell.ch: 綁上了, 只是沒鎖好.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnIfNotLockedWell.cn: 绑上了, 只是没锁好.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnNowTakeTheRodAnd.en: On. Now take the rod and turn it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnNowTakeTheRodAnd.ch: 綁好了. 現在握住絞棒轉動它.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnNowTakeTheRodAnd.cn: 绑好了. 现在握住绞棒转动它.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnTheMarkedBandAcr.en: On the marked band, across the limb.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnTheMarkedBandAcr.ch: 放在標記區域上, 橫跨肢體.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnTheMarkedBandAcr.cn: 放在标记区域上, 横跨肢体.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ReleasedNowTurnThe.en: Released. Now turn the rod back, slowly.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ReleasedNowTurnThe.ch: 已鬆開. 現在慢慢把絞棒轉回去.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ReleasedNowTurnThe.cn: 已松开. 现在慢慢把绞棒转回去.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_SlackSlideItOffThe.en: Slack. Slide it off the limb.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_SlackSlideItOffThe.ch: 鬆了. 把它從肢體上滑下來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_SlackSlideItOffThe.cn: 松了. 把它从肢体上滑下来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_SlowlyTheBloodIsRu.en: Slowly -- the blood is rushing back.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_SlowlyTheBloodIsRu.ch: 慢一點, 血液正在回流.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_SlowlyTheBloodIsRu.cn: 慢一点, 血液正在回流.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TakeTheRodAndTurnI.en: Take the rod and turn it round.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TakeTheStrapAndDra.en: Take the strap and drag it off the limb.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TakeTheStrapAndDra.ch: 抓住綁帶, 把它從肢體上拉下來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TakeTheStrapAndDra.cn: 抓住绑带, 把它从肢体上拉下来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ThatSItLetGoAndCli.en: That's it. Let go and click the clip.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ThatSItLetGoAndCli.ch: 就是這樣. 放手後點選扣環.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ThatSItLetGoAndCli.cn: 就是这样. 松手后点击卡扣.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TooTightItSCrushin.en: Too tight. It's crushing the limb.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TooTightItSCrushin.ch: 太緊了. 它正在壓壞肢體.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TooTightItSCrushin.cn: 太紧了. 它正在压坏肢体.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TurnTheRodBackTheO.en: Turn the rod back the other way, slowly.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TurnTheRodBackTheO.ch: 把絞棒往反方向慢慢轉回去.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TurnTheRodBackTheO.cn: 把绞棒往反方向慢慢转回去.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TurnTheRodUntilThe.en: Turn the rod until the gauge is in the green, then click the clip.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TurnTheRodUntilThe.ch: 轉動絞棒直到量表進入綠色區域, 然後點選扣環.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TurnTheRodUntilThe.cn: 转动绞棒直到量表进入绿色区域, 然后点击卡扣.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_WhenItIsSlackDragT.en: When it is slack, drag the strap off the limb.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_WhenItIsSlackDragT.ch: 等它鬆了, 再把綁帶從肢體上拉下來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_WhenItIsSlackDragT.cn: 等它松了, 再把绑带从肢体上拉下来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_AnyShapeWillDoKeepGoin.en: Any shape will do. Keep going until it is all off.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_AnyShapeWillDoKeepGoin.ch: 怎麼繞都行. 一直拆到全部拆下來為止.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_AnyShapeWillDoKeepGoin.cn: 怎么绕都行. 一直拆到全部拆下来为止.

IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_GrabTheLooseEndAndUnwi.en: Grab the loose end and unwind it round the limb, the other way.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_GrabTheLooseEndAndUnwi.ch: 抓住鬆脫的一端, 沿著肢體反方向繞開.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_GrabTheLooseEndAndUnwi.cn: 抓住松脱的一端, 沿着肢体反方向绕开.

IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_GrabTheLooseEndOfTheDr.en: Grab the loose end of the dressing.

IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_ItSStuckToTheWoundEase.en: It's stuck to the wound. Ease it off.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_ItSStuckToTheWoundEase.ch: 它黏在傷口上了. 慢慢撕下來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_ItSStuckToTheWoundEase.cn: 它粘在伤口上了. 慢慢撕下来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_TheLastTurnIsStuckToTh.en: The last turn is stuck to the wound (dark red). Go slowly over it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_TheLastTurnIsStuckToTh.ch: 最後一圈黏在傷口上 (暗紅色). 慢慢拆過去.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_TheLastTurnIsStuckToTh.cn: 最后一圈粘在伤口上 (暗红色). 慢慢拆过去.

IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_1_Desc.en: Nothing hurts. Everything is a long way off.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_1_Desc.ch: 什麼都不痛了. 一切都離得好遠.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_1_Desc.cn: 什么都不痛了. 一切都离得好远.

IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_2_Desc.en: Your feet are somewhere below you. It's fine.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_2_Desc.ch: 你的腳在下面某個地方. 沒關係.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_2_Desc.cn: 你的脚在下面某个地方. 没关系.

IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_3_Desc.en: You have never felt better. None of it matters any more.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_3_Desc.ch: 你從沒感覺這麼好過. 一切都不重要了.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_3_Desc.cn: 你从没感觉这么好过. 一切都不重要了.

IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_4_Desc.en: You are barely here, and there is nowhere better to be.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_4_Desc.ch: 你幾乎不在這裡了, 而這裡就是最好的地方.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_4_Desc.cn: 你几乎不在这里了, 而这里就是最好的地方.

IGUI_CU_Moodle_Miserable_Desc.en: How does it feel knowing everyone is dead and there's no hope for you...?
IGUI_CU_Moodle_Miserable_Desc.ch: 知道所有人都死了, 你也毫無希望, 是什麼感覺…?
IGUI_CU_Moodle_Miserable_Desc.cn: 知道所有人都死了, 你也毫无希望, 是什么感觉…?

IGUI_CU_Note_Hypoxic.en: Not enough oxygen reaching the brain.

IGUI_CU_Note_Rhythm.en: The heart is out of rhythm.

IGUI_CU_Note_Shock.en: Pressure too low. This is shock.
IGUI_CU_Note_Shock.ch: 血壓過低. 這是休克.
IGUI_CU_Note_Shock.cn: 血压过低. 这是休克.

IGUI_CU_Note_Thin.en: Thin blood. Wounds will not close.
IGUI_CU_Note_Thin.ch: 血液太稀. 傷口無法閉合.
IGUI_CU_Note_Thin.cn: 血液太稀. 伤口无法闭合.

IGUI_CU_Options_Censor.ch: 隱藏「痛苦不堪」發作的敏感內容
IGUI_CU_Options_Censor.cn: 屏蔽“痛苦不堪”发作的敏感内容

IGUI_CU_Options_Censor_Tooltip.en: Low-mood episodes without self-harm or suicide: the character vomits instead, and when Miserable has a fibrillation attack first.
IGUI_CU_Options_Censor_Tooltip.ch: 低落情緒發作時不出現自殘或自殺: 角色改為嘔吐, 處於「痛苦不堪」狀態時則會先發生一次纖顫發作.
IGUI_CU_Options_Censor_Tooltip.cn: 低落情绪发作时不出现自残或自杀: 角色改为呕吐, 处于“痛苦不堪”状态时则会先发生一次纤颤发作.

IGUI_CU_Options_Moodles.ch: 顯示 Casualties Undead 的狀態圖示
IGUI_CU_Options_Moodles.cn: 显示 Casualties Undead 的状态图标

IGUI_CU_Options_Moodles_Tooltip.en: Hide this mod's moodles without disabling its medical conditions.
IGUI_CU_Options_Moodles_Tooltip.ch: 隱藏本模組的狀態圖示, 但不停用其醫療狀況.
IGUI_CU_Options_Moodles_Tooltip.cn: 隐藏本模组的状态图标, 但不禁用其医疗状况.

IGUI_CU_Options_Ring_Tooltip.en: The sound that builds as a character comes apart. Off by default - it is a symptom, not a warning, and nobody should have to listen to one they did not ask for.
IGUI_CU_Options_Ring_Tooltip.ch: 角色逐漸崩潰時越來越響的聲音. 預設關閉 - 這是症狀而非警告, 沒有人該被迫聽自己沒要求的聲音.
IGUI_CU_Options_Ring_Tooltip.cn: 角色逐渐崩溃时越来越响的声音. 默认关闭 - 这是症状而非警告, 没有人该被迫听自己没要求的声音.

IGUI_CU_Options_Vision.ch: 脫水與失血造成的視線模糊
IGUI_CU_Options_Vision.cn: 脱水与失血造成的视线模糊

IGUI_CU_Options_Vision_Tooltip.en: Use the game's focus blur when severely dehydrated or low on blood.
IGUI_CU_Options_Vision_Tooltip.ch: 嚴重脫水或失血過多時, 使用遊戲的對焦模糊效果.
IGUI_CU_Options_Vision_Tooltip.cn: 严重脱水或失血过多时, 使用游戏的对焦模糊效果.

IGUI_CU_Rag_DoneRough.ch: 綁上了. 勉強撐得住.
IGUI_CU_Rag_DoneRough.cn: 绑上了. 勉强撑得住.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Fold1.en: Fold the right edge across onto the left.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Fold2.en: Now fold the top edge down onto the bottom.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Fold2.ch: 現在把上邊往下摺到底邊.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Fold2.cn: 现在把上边往下折到底边.

IGUI_CU_Rag_FoldSub.en: Drag the edge all the way over.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Loose.ch: 綁得太鬆. 幾乎撐不住.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Loose.cn: 绑得太松. 几乎撑不住.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Press.en: Press the pad onto the wound and hold it there.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Press.ch: 把墊布壓在傷口上並按住.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Press.cn: 把垫布压在伤口上并按住.

IGUI_CU_Rag_PressSub.en: Keep still until the ring fills.
IGUI_CU_Rag_PressSub.ch: 保持不動, 直到圓環填滿.
IGUI_CU_Rag_PressSub.cn: 保持不动, 直到圆环填满.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Stemmed.en: The bleeding's easing. Tie it on.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Stemmed.ch: 出血減緩了. 把它綁上.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Stemmed.cn: 出血减缓了. 把它绑上.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Tie1.en: Take the left end over the pad.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Tie2.en: Now the right end back over.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Tight.ch: 太用力了 - 勒進肉裡了.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Tight.cn: 太用力了 - 勒进肉里了.

IGUI_CU_SeeToDo.en: To-do list: how to fix these
IGUI_CU_SeeToDo.ch: 待辦清單: 如何處理這些問題
IGUI_CU_SeeToDo.cn: 待办清单: 如何处理这些问题

IGUI_CU_Terms_HowToLearn.en: Its name, what it does and how it is fixed come from knowing the term: read a First Aid book or a medical journal, practise First Aid, or dissect a body.
IGUI_CU_Terms_HowToLearn.ch: 要知道它的名稱, 作用與處理方式, 得先認識這個術語: 閱讀急救書籍或醫學期刊, 練習急救, 或解剖屍體.
IGUI_CU_Terms_HowToLearn.cn: 要知道它的名称, 作用与处理方式, 得先认识这个术语: 阅读急救书籍或医学期刊, 练习急救, 或解剖尸体.

IGUI_CU_Terms_Unknown.en: YOU DON'T KNOW WHAT THIS IS

IGUI_CU_Why_acute_kidney_injury.en: The kidneys have stopped clearing anything.
IGUI_CU_Why_acute_kidney_injury.ch: 腎臟已經無法排除任何東西.
IGUI_CU_Why_acute_kidney_injury.cn: 肾脏已经无法排出任何东西.

IGUI_CU_Why_aspiration.en: There is vomit in the lungs. Clear the airway.
IGUI_CU_Why_aspiration.ch: 肺裡有嘔吐物. 清理呼吸道.
IGUI_CU_Why_aspiration.cn: 肺里有呕吐物. 清理气道.

IGUI_CU_Why_compartment_syndrome.en: The limb is swelling inside its own sheath.
IGUI_CU_Why_compartment_syndrome.ch: 肢體在自身的筋膜內腫脹.
IGUI_CU_Why_compartment_syndrome.cn: 肢体在自身的筋膜内肿胀.

IGUI_CU_Why_concussion.en: The head is not right. Rest it.
IGUI_CU_Why_concussion.ch: 頭部不太對勁. 好好休息.
IGUI_CU_Why_concussion.cn: 头部不太对劲. 好好休息.

IGUI_CU_Why_deep_vein_thrombosis.en: A clot in a leg that has not moved.
IGUI_CU_Why_deep_vein_thrombosis.ch: 久未活動的腿裡形成了血栓.
IGUI_CU_Why_deep_vein_thrombosis.cn: 久未活动的腿里形成了血栓.

IGUI_CU_Why_dehydration.en: The blood is too thick to move and too thin to clot.
IGUI_CU_Why_dehydration.ch: 血液濃稠得流不動, 卻又稀得無法凝結.
IGUI_CU_Why_dehydration.cn: 血液浓稠得流不动, 却又稀得无法凝结.

IGUI_CU_Why_haemorrhagic_shock.en: Not enough blood left to pump. Volume, now.
IGUI_CU_Why_haemorrhagic_shock.ch: 剩下的血不夠心臟泵送. 立刻補充血容量.
IGUI_CU_Why_haemorrhagic_shock.cn: 剩下的血不够心脏泵送. 立刻补充血容量.

IGUI_CU_Why_hypoglycaemia.en: Nothing left to burn. The hands are going.
IGUI_CU_Why_hypoglycaemia.ch: 身體已沒有能燃燒的了. 雙手開始不聽使喚.
IGUI_CU_Why_hypoglycaemia.cn: 身体已没有能燃烧的了. 双手开始不听使唤.

IGUI_CU_Why_hypothermia.en: Cold enough that the heart is getting irritable.
IGUI_CU_Why_hypothermia.ch: 冷到心臟開始躁動不安.
IGUI_CU_Why_hypothermia.cn: 冷到心脏开始躁动不安.

IGUI_CU_Why_intracranial_bleed.en: Bleeding inside the skull, with nowhere to go.
IGUI_CU_Why_intracranial_bleed.ch: 顱內出血, 血液無處可去.
IGUI_CU_Why_intracranial_bleed.cn: 颅内出血, 血液无处可去.

IGUI_CU_Why_necrosis.en: The tissue is dead and rotting on them.
IGUI_CU_Why_necrosis.ch: 組織已經壞死, 正在腐爛.
IGUI_CU_Why_necrosis.cn: 组织已经坏死, 正在腐烂.

IGUI_CU_Why_pneumonia.ch: 肺部正在積液. 需要抗生素.
IGUI_CU_Why_pneumonia.cn: 肺部正在积液. 需要抗生素.

IGUI_CU_Why_pneumothorax.en: Air in the chest, crushing the lung. This one is now.
IGUI_CU_Why_pneumothorax.ch: 胸腔內有空氣, 正在壓迫肺部. 必須立刻處理.
IGUI_CU_Why_pneumothorax.cn: 胸腔内有空气, 正在压迫肺部. 必须立刻处理.

IGUI_CU_Why_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia.en: Blood loss is weakening your hands and oxygen delivery. Control bleeding, eat and rest.
IGUI_CU_Why_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia.ch: 失血使你的雙手無力, 輸氧能力下降. 止血, 進食並休息.
IGUI_CU_Why_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia.cn: 失血使你的双手无力, 输氧能力下降. 止血, 进食并休息.

IGUI_CU_Why_pressure_injury.en: Tourniquet pressure is injuring the limb. Dress the wound and remove the tourniquet.
IGUI_CU_Why_pressure_injury.ch: 止血帶的壓力正在傷害肢體. 包紮傷口並取下止血帶.
IGUI_CU_Why_pressure_injury.cn: 止血带的压力正在伤害肢体. 包扎伤口并取下止血带.

IGUI_CU_Why_ptsd.en: What they saw keeps coming back. It does not go away; medicine softens it.
IGUI_CU_Why_ptsd.ch: 看過的景象不斷重現. 它不會消失, 藥物能減輕它.
IGUI_CU_Why_ptsd.cn: 看过的景象不断重现. 它不会消失, 药物能减轻它.

IGUI_CU_Why_pulmonary_embolism.en: The clot has gone to the lungs.

IGUI_CU_Why_pulmonary_oedema.en: The heart is backing up into the lungs.
IGUI_CU_Why_pulmonary_oedema.ch: 心臟的血液回堵到肺部.
IGUI_CU_Why_pulmonary_oedema.cn: 心脏的血液淤积到肺部.

IGUI_CU_Why_rib_fracture.en: Every breath grinds. Strap the chest.
IGUI_CU_Why_rib_fracture.ch: 每次呼吸都在摩擦作痛. 固定胸部.
IGUI_CU_Why_rib_fracture.cn: 每次呼吸都在摩擦作痛. 固定胸部.

IGUI_CU_Why_sepsis.en: The infection is in the blood.

IGUI_CU_Why_septic_shock.en: Everything is shutting down at once.

IGUI_CU_Why_tetanus.en: The muscles are locking. It started in a dirty wound.
IGUI_CU_Why_tetanus.ch: 肌肉正在僵直. 起因是骯髒的傷口.
IGUI_CU_Why_tetanus.cn: 肌肉正在僵直. 起因是肮脏的伤口.

IGUI_PhunZones_ALife_tooltip.en: Requires the Project A-Life NPCs mod. Block Spawns stops A-Life NPCs spawning in this zone; any that walk in, such as friendly ones, are left alone. A-Life NPCs are never moved or removed by the Zeds setting
IGUI_PhunZones_ALife_tooltip.ch: 需要 Project A-Life NPCs 模組. 「阻止生成」會讓 A-Life NPC 不在此區域生成; 自行走進來的 NPC (例如友善的 NPC) 則不受影響. 「殭屍」設定永遠不會移出或移除 A-Life NPC
IGUI_PhunZones_ALife_tooltip.cn: 需要 Project A-Life NPCs 模组. “阻止生成”会阻止 A-Life NPC 在此区域生成; 自行走进来的 NPC (例如友好的 NPC) 则不受影响. “僵尸”设置永远不会移出或移除 A-Life NPC

IGUI_PhunZones_MapBorder_tooltip.en: Colour of this zone's outline on the player's map and minimap, e.g. #FF8000 or 255,128,0. Leave empty for no outline
IGUI_PhunZones_MapBorder_tooltip.ch: 此區域在玩家地圖與小地圖上的外框顏色, 例如 #FF8000 或 255,128,0. 留空則不顯示外框
IGUI_PhunZones_MapBorder_tooltip.cn: 此区域在玩家地图和小地图上的轮廓颜色, 例如 #FF8000 或 255,128,0. 留空则不显示轮廓

IGUI_PhunZones_MapFill_tooltip.en: Colour this zone is shaded with on the player's map and minimap, e.g. #FF8000 or 255,128,0. Leave empty for no shading
IGUI_PhunZones_MapFill_tooltip.ch: 此區域在玩家地圖與小地圖上的填充顏色, 例如 #FF8000 或 255,128,0. 留空則不填色
IGUI_PhunZones_MapFill_tooltip.cn: 此区域在玩家地图和小地图上的填充颜色, 例如 #FF8000 或 255,128,0. 留空则不填充

IGUI_PhunZones_MapOpacity_tooltip.en: How opaque the map fill is, from 0 (invisible) to 100 (solid). Defaults to 30 when a fill colour is set
IGUI_PhunZones_MapOpacity_tooltip.ch: 地圖填色的不透明程度, 從 0 (完全透明) 到 100 (完全不透明). 設定填充顏色時預設為 30
IGUI_PhunZones_MapOpacity_tooltip.cn: 地图填充的不透明程度, 从 0 (完全透明) 到 100 (完全不透明). 设置填充颜色时默认为 30

IGUI_PhunZones_ZedAction_MoveSpawn.ch: 生成時移出 (允許遊蕩進入)
IGUI_PhunZones_ZedAction_MoveSpawn.cn: 生成时移出 (允许游荡进入)

IGUI_PhunZones_ZedAction_RemoveSpawn.ch: 生成時移除 (允許遊蕩進入)
IGUI_PhunZones_ZedAction_RemoveSpawn.cn: 生成时移除 (允许游荡进入)

IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_LocationsHint.en: Manage saved marks. Equip this grimoire and set Recall active to travel.
IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_LocationsHint.ch: 管理已儲存的標記. 裝備這本魔法書並將「召回」設為啟用即可傳送.
IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_LocationsHint.cn: 管理已保存的标记. 装备这本魔法书并将“召回”设为激活即可传送.

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Destructible.en: Whether players can destroy this shop's machines with a sledgehammer. Server default follows the sandbox option. Admins can always destroy them
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Destructible.ch: 玩家能否用大鎚破壞此商店的機台. 伺服器預設值依照沙盒選項. 管理員一律可以破壞
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Destructible.cn: 玩家能否用大锤破坏此商店的机器. 服务器默认值遵循沙盒选项. 管理员始终可以破坏

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Moveable.en: Whether players can pick up this shop's machines and place them elsewhere. Server default follows the sandbox option. Admins can always move them
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Moveable.ch: 玩家能否拾起此商店的機台並放到其他地方. 伺服器預設值依照沙盒選項. 管理員一律可以移動
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Moveable.cn: 玩家能否拿起此商店的机器并放到其他地方. 服务器默认值遵循沙盒选项. 管理员始终可以移动

IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_NoItemForShop.en: %1 has no machine item, so it cannot be installed by hand
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_NoItemForShop.ch: %1 沒有機台物品, 因此無法手動安裝
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_NoItemForShop.cn: %1 没有机器物品, 因此无法手动安装

IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_ShopDisabled.en: %1 is disabled. Enable it before placing one
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_ShopDisabled.ch: %1 已停用. 請先啟用再放置
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_ShopDisabled.cn: %1 已禁用. 请先启用再放置

IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_SpawnedShopItem.en: %1 added to your inventory. Right-click it to install
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_SpawnedShopItem.ch: %1 已加入你的物品欄. 對它按右鍵即可安裝
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_SpawnedShopItem.cn: %1 已添加到你的物品栏. 右键点击它即可安装

IGUI_RNPC_06a04b96.en: You don't have any recruits yet.

IGUI_RNPC_0784bfc5.en: Armed locals. They patrol the back roads and set up checkpoints.
IGUI_RNPC_0784bfc5.ch: 武裝的當地人. 他們在鄉間小路巡邏, 還設了檢查哨.
IGUI_RNPC_0784bfc5.cn: 武装的当地人. 他们在乡间小路巡逻, 还设了检查站.

IGUI_RNPC_1471b212.en: Regular people trying to get by. They scavenge, board up and trade.
IGUI_RNPC_1471b212.ch: 努力活下去的普通人. 他們搜刮物資、封堵門窗, 也做交易.
IGUI_RNPC_1471b212.cn: 努力活下去的普通人. 他们搜刮物资、封堵门窗, 也做交易.

IGUI_RNPC_15fa3ccb.en: On their own. They camp out, scavenge and keep to themselves.
IGUI_RNPC_15fa3ccb.ch: 獨來獨往. 他們在野外紮營、搜刮物資, 不跟別人打交道.
IGUI_RNPC_15fa3ccb.cn: 独来独往. 他们在野外扎营、搜刮物资, 不跟别人打交道.

IGUI_RNPC_172f270d.en: No jobs yet. Ask a faction for work.
IGUI_RNPC_172f270d.ch: 還沒有任何委託. 去找陣營要工作吧.
IGUI_RNPC_172f270d.cn: 还没有任何委托. 去找派系要活儿干吧.

IGUI_RNPC_1cedd073.en: Hostile. They hold a base and rob whoever they can.
IGUI_RNPC_1cedd073.ch: 敵對. 他們佔據一處據點, 能搶誰就搶誰.
IGUI_RNPC_1cedd073.cn: 敌对. 他们占据一处据点, 能抢谁就抢谁.

IGUI_RNPC_33097578.en: Not yet. We need to know you better first.
IGUI_RNPC_33097578.ch: 還不行. 我們得先多了解你一點.
IGUI_RNPC_33097578.cn: 还不行. 我们得先多了解你一点.

IGUI_RNPC_37dbf6d9.en: Their base got raided a day or two ago.
IGUI_RNPC_37dbf6d9.ch: 他們的據點一兩天前被襲擊了.
IGUI_RNPC_37dbf6d9.cn: 他们的据点一两天前被袭击了.

IGUI_RNPC_3cceb325.en: Then swear to it, and you are one of us. We look after our own.
IGUI_RNPC_3cceb325.ch: 那就發誓吧, 你就是我們的一份子了. 我們會照顧自己人.
IGUI_RNPC_3cceb325.cn: 那就发誓吧, 你就是我们的一员了. 我们会照顾自己人.

IGUI_RNPC_4045b1ef.en: Go in peace. You cannot come back for a while.
IGUI_RNPC_4045b1ef.ch: 平安地走吧. 你暫時不能回來.
IGUI_RNPC_4045b1ef.cn: 平安地走吧. 你暂时不能回来.

IGUI_RNPC_4ff2d227.en: Just back from a raid on %1.

IGUI_RNPC_549fdec8.en: One of our own turned on us %1. We threw them out.
IGUI_RNPC_549fdec8.ch: %1 我們自己人背叛了我們. 我們把那人趕出去了.
IGUI_RNPC_549fdec8.cn: %1 我们自己人背叛了我们. 我们把那人赶出去了.

IGUI_RNPC_5656a0de.en: A cult out in the country. They think the world was judged.
IGUI_RNPC_5656a0de.ch: 鄉下的一個邪教. 他們認為世界已經受了審判.
IGUI_RNPC_5656a0de.cn: 乡下的一个邪教. 他们认为世界已经受到了审判.

IGUI_RNPC_5984de80.en: You left us. It is too soon to come back.
IGUI_RNPC_5984de80.ch: 你離開了我們. 現在回來還太早.
IGUI_RNPC_5984de80.cn: 你离开了我们. 现在回来还太早.

IGUI_RNPC_6282ff8f.en: Well armed soldiers. They clear buildings and set up checkpoints.
IGUI_RNPC_6282ff8f.ch: 武裝精良的士兵. 他們清理建築, 還設了檢查哨.
IGUI_RNPC_6282ff8f.cn: 武装精良的士兵. 他们清理建筑, 还设了检查站.

IGUI_RNPC_65ba6f5d.en: The %1 need %2. Take these to any of their people. Do not sell them.
IGUI_RNPC_65ba6f5d.ch: %1 需要 %2. 把這些交給他們任何一個人. 不准賣掉.
IGUI_RNPC_65ba6f5d.cn: %1 需要 %2. 把这些交给他们任何一个人. 不许卖掉.

IGUI_RNPC_66259fb7.en: That order is switched off on this server.
IGUI_RNPC_66259fb7.ch: 此伺服器已停用這項命令.
IGUI_RNPC_66259fb7.cn: 此服务器已禁用这项命令.

IGUI_RNPC_69a87f65.en: You kept your word. Here is your pay.
IGUI_RNPC_69a87f65.ch: 你信守了承諾. 這是你的報酬.
IGUI_RNPC_69a87f65.cn: 你信守了承诺. 这是你的报酬.

IGUI_RNPC_7e175935.en: Our people keep dying near %1. Go and look, then come back and tell us what you saw.
IGUI_RNPC_7e175935.ch: 我們的人一直在 %1 附近送命. 去看看, 然後回來告訴我們你看到了什麼.
IGUI_RNPC_7e175935.cn: 我们的人一直在 %1 附近送命. 去看看, 然后回来告诉我们你看到了什么.

IGUI_RNPC_7e7f3ef7.en: There's a big group of the dead near %1. Put down %2 of them and come back.
IGUI_RNPC_7e7f3ef7.ch: %1 附近有一大群死人. 解決掉其中 %2 隻再回來.
IGUI_RNPC_7e7f3ef7.cn: %1 附近有一大群死人. 干掉其中 %2 只再回来.

IGUI_RNPC_8cc76863.en: Welcome. We look after our own.
IGUI_RNPC_8cc76863.ch: 歡迎. 我們會照顧自己人.
IGUI_RNPC_8cc76863.cn: 欢迎. 我们会照顾自己人.

IGUI_RNPC_903c284b.en: Hungry. Their group is low on food.
IGUI_RNPC_903c284b.ch: 餓著肚子. 他們的團體糧食不足.
IGUI_RNPC_903c284b.cn: 饿着肚子. 他们的团体粮食不足.

IGUI_RNPC_9085f622.ch: 被咬了. 看起來病了.
IGUI_RNPC_9085f622.cn: 被咬了. 看起来病了.

IGUI_RNPC_a7bccf3c.en: The dead are gathering near %1. Put down %2 of them, then come back to us.
IGUI_RNPC_a7bccf3c.ch: 死者正在 %1 附近聚集. 解決其中 %2 個, 然後回來找我們.
IGUI_RNPC_a7bccf3c.cn: 死者正在 %1 附近聚集. 解决其中 %2 个, 然后回来找我们.

IGUI_RNPC_ae8a1357.en: They set ambushes where the traffic is and make you pay to pass.
IGUI_RNPC_ae8a1357.ch: 他們在人來人往的地方設埋伏, 要你付錢才放行.
IGUI_RNPC_ae8a1357.cn: 他们在人来人往的地方设埋伏, 要你付钱才能通过.

IGUI_RNPC_b07eac92.en: That's theirs. Thank you. Here's your pay.
IGUI_RNPC_b07eac92.ch: 這是那人的東西. 謝謝你. 這是你的報酬.
IGUI_RNPC_b07eac92.cn: 这是那人的东西. 谢谢你. 这是你的报酬.

IGUI_RNPC_b4636fd8.en: From the %1? Thank you. Tell them we are grateful.
IGUI_RNPC_b4636fd8.ch: %1 送來的? 謝謝你. 替我們轉達感謝.
IGUI_RNPC_b4636fd8.cn: %1 送来的? 谢谢你. 替我们转达感谢.

IGUI_RNPC_b92a2ad4.en: What's left of the county police. They patrol and run checkpoints.
IGUI_RNPC_b92a2ad4.ch: 縣警察的殘部. 他們負責巡邏, 也管檢查哨.
IGUI_RNPC_b92a2ad4.cn: 县警察的残部. 他们负责巡逻, 也管检查站.

IGUI_RNPC_c5189dac.en: You are one of us, and we trust you.
IGUI_RNPC_c5189dac.ch: 你是我們的一份子, 我們信任你.
IGUI_RNPC_c5189dac.cn: 你是我们的一员, 我们信任你.

IGUI_RNPC_cd3d2441.en: You brought it back to us. Bless you.
IGUI_RNPC_cd3d2441.ch: 你把它帶回來給我們了. 願主保佑你.
IGUI_RNPC_cd3d2441.cn: 你把它带回来给我们了. 愿主保佑你.

IGUI_RNPC_d83c7f70.en: They loot the towns and trade what they find, mostly tools and parts.
IGUI_RNPC_d83c7f70.ch: 他們搜刮城鎮, 拿找到的東西去交易, 大多是工具和零件.
IGUI_RNPC_d83c7f70.cn: 他们搜刮城镇, 拿找到的东西去交易, 大多是工具和零件.

IGUI_RNPC_d8d8ace1.en: The %1 are short on %2. Take these to any of their people, and don't sell them.
IGUI_RNPC_d8d8ace1.ch: %1 缺 %2. 把這些交給他們任何一個人, 別拿去賣.
IGUI_RNPC_d8d8ace1.cn: %1 缺 %2. 把这些交给他们任何一个人, 别拿去卖.

IGUI_RNPC_da3ed49a.en: %1 died out near %2. Their %3 should still be on the body. Bring it back to us.
IGUI_RNPC_da3ed49a.ch: %1 死在 %2 附近. 那人的 %3 應該還在屍體上. 把它帶回來給我們.
IGUI_RNPC_da3ed49a.cn: %1 死在 %2 附近. 那人的 %3 应该还在尸体上. 把它带回来给我们.

IGUI_RNPC_dcb1e8c7.en: %1 died near %2. Their %3 is still with the body. Please bring it back to us.
IGUI_RNPC_dcb1e8c7.ch: %1 死在 %2 附近. 那人的 %3 還在遺體身邊. 請把它帶回來給我們.
IGUI_RNPC_dcb1e8c7.cn: %1 死在 %2 附近. 那人的 %3 还在遗体身边. 请把它带回来给我们.

IGUI_RNPC_e3173147.en: Farmers out in the country. They grow food and patrol the back roads.
IGUI_RNPC_e3173147.ch: 鄉下的農夫. 他們種糧食, 也在鄉間小路巡邏.
IGUI_RNPC_e3173147.cn: 乡下的农民. 他们种粮食, 也在乡间小路巡逻.

IGUI_RNPC_e8cdf1ab.en: Doctors and nurses. They treat people and are always low on medicine.
IGUI_RNPC_e8cdf1ab.ch: 醫生和護士. 他們替人治療, 藥品總是不夠用.
IGUI_RNPC_e8cdf1ab.cn: 医生和护士. 他们给人治病, 药品总是不够用.

IGUI_RNPC_ef28e8f3.en: The %1 sold us out %2. We don't trust them anymore.
IGUI_RNPC_ef28e8f3.ch: %1 %2 出賣了我們. 我們不再信任他們了.
IGUI_RNPC_ef28e8f3.cn: %1 %2 出卖了我们. 我们不再信任他们了.

IGUI_RNPC_f1f307ae.en: Fine. Go on, then. Don't come back for a while.
IGUI_RNPC_f1f307ae.ch: 好. 那就走吧. 這陣子別回來.
IGUI_RNPC_f1f307ae.cn: 好. 那就走吧. 这阵子别回来.

IGUI_RNPC_f5693aa4.en: %1 of the %2 led the raid on us. Find them and kill them.
IGUI_RNPC_f5693aa4.ch: %2 的 %1 帶頭襲擊了我們. 找到那傢伙, 殺了他.
IGUI_RNPC_f5693aa4.cn: %2 的 %1 带头袭击了我们. 找到那家伙, 杀了他.

IGUI_RNPC_f7d3e48c.en: You're one of them, and they trust you.
IGUI_RNPC_f7d3e48c.ch: 你是他們的一份子, 他們信任你.
IGUI_RNPC_f7d3e48c.cn: 你是他们的一员, 他们信任你.

IGUI_RNPC_f7edca19.en: %1 of the %2 led the raid on us. We want them dead. Find them.
IGUI_RNPC_f7edca19.ch: %2 的 %1 帶頭襲擊了我們. 我們要那傢伙的命. 把人找出來.
IGUI_RNPC_f7edca19.cn: %2 的 %1 带头袭击了我们. 我们要那家伙的命. 把人找出来.

IGUI_RNPC_ff3998e6.en: Firefighters still working out of their station. They help people out.
IGUI_RNPC_ff3998e6.ch: 仍以消防隊為據點工作的消防員. 他們會幫人一把.
IGUI_RNPC_ff3998e6.cn: 仍以消防站为据点工作的消防员. 他们会帮人一把.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Goal.en: Set five pieces of scrap wood along the frame, then bind every joint with duct tape.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Goal.ch: 把五塊廢木材沿著框架擺好, 再用布膠帶纏緊每個接合處.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Goal.cn: 把五块废木材沿着框架摆好, 再用管道胶带缠紧每个接合处.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step1.en: Take hold of a piece and drag it onto its place on the frame. It snaps in when it is close.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step1.ch: 抓住一塊木材, 拖曳到框架上對應的位置. 靠得夠近時就會自動卡上.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step1.cn: 抓住一块木材, 拖到框架上对应的位置. 靠得够近时就会自动卡上.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step2.en: Once all five are in, hold on a joint and work the mouse up and down over it to wind the tape on.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step2.ch: 五塊都放好後, 在接合處按住滑鼠並上下來回移動, 把膠帶纏上去.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step2.cn: 五块都放好后, 在接合处按住鼠标并上下来回移动, 把胶带缠上去.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step3.en: Every joint takes about the same: wind until it is done, then the next.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step3.ch: 每個接合處所需的工夫都差不多: 纏到好為止, 再換下一個.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step3.cn: 每个接合处所需的功夫都差不多: 缠到好为止, 再换下一个.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Watch.en: Yanking tears the tape and loses what was wound; straying off the joint sticks it to nothing. A sloppy job starts the prosthetic part worn.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Watch.ch: 猛拉會扯破膠帶, 已纏好的部分也會白費; 偏離接合處, 膠帶就黏不到東西. 做得馬虎, 義肢一開始就會帶有磨損.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Watch.cn: 猛拉会扯破胶带, 已缠好的部分也会白费; 偏离接合处, 胶带就粘不到东西. 做得马虎, 假肢一开始就会带有磨损.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_FallsApart.en: It falls apart in your hands.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint.en: Drag each piece of scrap wood onto its place along the frame.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint.ch: 把每塊廢木材拖曳到框架上對應的位置.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint.cn: 把每块废木材拖到框架上对应的位置.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint2.en: Then wind tape round every joint: hold, and work up and down over it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint2.ch: 然後在每個接合處纏上膠帶: 按住, 並在上面上下來回移動.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint2.cn: 然后在每个接合处缠上胶带: 按住, 并在上面上下来回移动.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_HoldOnAJoint.en: Hold on a joint, and work up and down.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_HoldOnAJoint.ch: 按住一個接合處, 上下來回移動.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_HoldOnAJoint.cn: 按住一个接合处, 上下来回移动.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_NotThere.en: That is not where it goes.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_NowTheTape.en: All the pieces are in. Now the tape.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_NowTheTape.ch: 木材都放好了. 接下來纏膠帶.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_NowTheTape.cn: 木材都放好了. 接下来缠胶带.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_TakeAPiece.en: Take hold of a piece of wood.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Torn.ch: 輕一點 - 膠帶扯破了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Torn.cn: 轻一点 - 胶带扯破了.

IGUI_CU_Stump_Crude.ch: %1已截肢: 已裝上木製義肢 (剩餘 %2%%)
IGUI_CU_Stump_Crude.cn: %1已截肢: 已装上木制假肢 (剩余 %2%%)

IGUI_GGS_AimBlurSwitchTooltip.ch: 透過光學瞄具瞄準時, 使周邊視野變暗並柔化.
IGUI_GGS_AimBlurSwitchTooltip.cn: 通过光学瞄具瞄准时, 使周边视野变暗并柔化.

IGUI_GGS_ScopeMarksSwitchTooltip.en: Shows scope reticle marks and the moving aim marker.

IGUI_GGS_ScopeMarksSwitchTooltip.cn: 显示瞄准镜的准星标记与移动的瞄准标记.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_AdultAnimationP.cn: 启用成人内容时, 允许直接可见地播放私密动画.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_AdultContentEna.cn: 若已安装私密成人附加模组, 允许其场景入口与成人场景后续影响.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_Description.en: Client overrides for save Sandbox defaults. Use Sandbox default to return control to the save.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_Description.ch: 客戶端覆寫存檔的沙盒預設值. 選擇「使用沙盒預設值」即可將控制權交還給存檔.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_DesireAttractio.en: Allows desire scoring, attraction item bonuses, hygiene-attraction signals, and scanner/scorer bonuses.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_DesireAttractio.ch: 允許慾望評分、吸引力物品加成、衛生吸引力訊號與掃描/評分加成.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_DesireAttractio.cn: 允许欲望评分、吸引力物品加成、卫生吸引力信号与扫描/评分加成.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyMoodEffec.en: Allows family emotion hub, effect ledger, bond mood/stress/panic adjustments, and scene bonding effects.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyMoodEffec.ch: 允許家庭情緒中樞、效果紀錄、羈絆的情緒/壓力/恐慌調整與場景羈絆效果.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyRelatedIt.en: Allows related context actions such as protection, lactation aid, and attraction/hygiene bonus item actions.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyRelatedIt.ch: 允許相關的右鍵動作, 例如避孕措施、泌乳輔助, 以及吸引力/衛生加成物品動作.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InfantsEnabled_.en: Allows newborn creation and BabyCare infant systems. Existing baby items are not deleted.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InfantsEnabled_.cn: 允许生成新生儿与婴儿护理系统. 现有的婴儿物品不会被删除.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InseminationEna.en: Allows private-scene conception attempts. Requires adult content and pregnancy.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InseminationEna.cn: 允许在私密场景中尝试受孕. 需要启用成人内容与怀孕.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_IntimacyDialogu.en: Choose where brief private-scene reactions appear.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_IntimacyPresent.cn: 选择以画面动画呈现, 或以隐私卡片暗示带过. 两种模式下游戏效果都会照常生效.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_LactationEnable.en: Allows lactation state, milk updates, and baby-care milk handoff.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_LactationEnable.ch: 允許泌乳狀態、乳汁更新與嬰兒照護的乳汁交接.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_LactationEnable.cn: 允许泌乳状态、乳汁更新与婴儿护理的乳汁交接.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_MatureDialogueE.en: Allows private-scene dialogue when adult content is enabled.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_MatureDialogueE.ch: 啟用成人內容時, 允許私密場景對話.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_MatureDialogueE.cn: 启用成人内容时, 允许私密场景对话.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_PregnancyEnable.en: Allows pregnancy state, support, loop tools, and pregnancy-to-birth bridges.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_PregnancyEnable.ch: 允許懷孕狀態、懷孕支援、循環工具與懷孕到生產的銜接.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_PregnancyEnable.cn: 允许怀孕状态、怀孕支持、循环工具与怀孕到分娩的衔接.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_PrivateHygieneE.en: Allows private-scene hygiene, dirty-hands, and cleanup consequences.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_PrivateHygieneE.ch: 允許私密場景的衛生、髒手與清理後續影響.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_PrivateHygieneE.cn: 允许私密场景的卫生、脏手与清理后续影响.

IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15Pacesetter_desc.en: Your active Dalmatian companion grants 5% extra XP for all skills, including Strength and Fitness. Switching or dismissing the dog ends the bonus.

IGUI_KBW_WindowFitHelp.ch: 需要相符的窗戶開口. 在空的框架上按右鍵並選擇「尋找適合此開口的門/窗」.
IGUI_KBW_WindowFitHelp.cn: 需要匹配的窗户洞口. 右键点击空框架并选择“查找适合此洞口的门/窗”.

IGUI_PhunZones_MutantSpawn_tooltip.en: Requires The Mutants mod. Percentage (0-100, decimals allowed) of zombies that become this mutant when they spawn in this zone. Leave empty to use the sandbox setting; 0 stops this mutant spawning here. Mutants that wander in from elsewhere are not affected
IGUI_PhunZones_MutantSpawn_tooltip.ch: 需要 The Mutants 模組. 在此區域生成的殭屍中, 會變成此種變異體的百分比 (0-100, 可用小數). 留空則使用沙盒設定; 設為 0 則此變異體不會在此生成. 從其他地方遊蕩進來的變異體不受影響
IGUI_PhunZones_MutantSpawn_tooltip.cn: 需要 The Mutants 模组. 在此区域生成的僵尸中, 会变成此种变异体的百分比 (0-100, 可用小数). 留空则使用沙盒设置; 设为 0 则此变异体不会在此生成. 从其他地方游荡进来的变异体不受影响

IGUI_Wounds_ArrestHow.en: Only chest compressions and a defibrillator can bring you back.
IGUI_Wounds_ArrestHow.ch: 只有胸部按壓和電擊器能把你救回來.
IGUI_Wounds_ArrestHow.cn: 只有胸外按压和除颤器能把你救回来.

IGUI_Wounds_BulletSealed.en: The wound has closed over the bullet.
IGUI_Wounds_BulletSealed.ch: 傷口已把子彈封在裡面了.
IGUI_Wounds_BulletSealed.cn: 伤口已把子弹封在里面了.

IGUI_Wounds_CarDoorBlocked.ch: 對方那側的車門被擋住了.
IGUI_Wounds_CarDoorBlocked.cn: 他们那侧的车门被挡住了.

IGUI_Wounds_CarFar.en: Bring them right up to a door.

IGUI_Wounds_CarMoving.en: The car has to be standing still.

IGUI_Wounds_DefibFailed.ch: 沒有心律. 再次充電.
IGUI_Wounds_DefibFailed.cn: 没有心律. 再次充电.

IGUI_Wounds_DefibNotNeeded.en: Their heart is beating - a shock won't help.
IGUI_Wounds_DefibNotNeeded.ch: 對方心臟還在跳 - 電擊沒有用.
IGUI_Wounds_DefibNotNeeded.cn: 他们的心脏还在跳 - 电击没有用.

IGUI_Wounds_ExtractBlind.en: Grip the bullet and pull it straight out
IGUI_Wounds_ExtractBlind.ch: 夾住子彈, 直接拔出來
IGUI_Wounds_ExtractBlind.cn: 夹住子弹, 直接拔出来

IGUI_Wounds_ExtractIn.en: Grip the bullet and draw it out along the line
IGUI_Wounds_ExtractIn.ch: 夾住子彈, 沿著線拉出來
IGUI_Wounds_ExtractIn.cn: 夹住子弹, 沿着线拉出来

IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlive.en: Still breathing. Someone beside you can bring you round.
IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlive.ch: 還有呼吸. 身旁有人就能把你喚醒.
IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlive.cn: 还有呼吸. 身边有人就能把你唤醒.

IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlone.en: Left alone, you will come to for a few minutes - stop the bleeding then.
IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlone.ch: 若無人在旁, 你會短暫清醒幾分鐘 - 趁那時止血.
IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlone.cn: 如果身边没人, 你会短暂清醒几分钟 - 趁那时止血.

IGUI_Wounds_FaintLucid.en: You come to - stop the bleeding!
IGUI_Wounds_FaintLucid.ch: 你醒過來了 - 快止血!
IGUI_Wounds_FaintLucid.cn: 你醒过来了 - 快止血!

IGUI_Wounds_MenuDefibTip.en: Their heart has stopped. Each shock costs a charge, and each one after the first is less likely to work.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuDefibTip.ch: 對方心跳已停止. 每次電擊會消耗一格電量, 而第一次之後的每次電擊成功率都會降低.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuDefibTip.cn: 他们的心跳已停止. 每次电击会消耗一格电量, 而第一次之后的每次电击成功率都会降低.

IGUI_Wounds_MenuReviveTip.en: Their heart has stopped. Compressions buy time and rarely restart it; a defibrillator is the real way back.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuReviveTip.ch: 對方心跳已停止. 按壓能爭取時間, 但很少能讓心臟重新跳動; 電擊器才是真正的救命手段.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuReviveTip.cn: 他们的心跳已停止. 按压能争取时间, 但很少能让心脏重新跳动; 除颤器才是真正的救命手段.

IGUI_Wounds_MenuRouseTip.en: Only once nothing is bleeding. Gets them on their feet for about an hour; it does not put any blood back.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuRouseTip.ch: 須先止住所有出血. 能讓對方起身行動約一小時; 但不會補回任何血液.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuRouseTip.cn: 必须先止住所有出血. 能让他们站起来活动约一小时; 但不会补回任何血液.

IGUI_Wounds_MenuTowTip.en: They come along the ground behind you. No running, and it wears you out fast; raising a weapon, stairs and cars make you let go.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuTowTip.ch: 對方會被你拖在地上走. 無法奔跑, 而且體力消耗很快; 舉起武器, 上下樓梯或上車都會讓你放手.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuTowTip.cn: 他们会被你拖着在地上走. 无法奔跑, 而且体力消耗很快; 举起武器, 上下楼梯或上车都会让你松手.

IGUI_Wounds_NoExtractTissue.en: The bullet is too deep in the tissue - pack the wound and take antibiotics.
IGUI_Wounds_NoExtractTissue.ch: 子彈卡在組織深處 - 填塞傷口並服用抗生素.
IGUI_Wounds_NoExtractTissue.cn: 子弹卡在组织深处 - 填塞伤口并服用抗生素.

IGUI_Wounds_NoStitchBullet.en: You don't stitch a gunshot wound - flush it and pack it.
IGUI_Wounds_NoStitchBullet.ch: 槍傷不能縫合 - 要沖洗後再填塞.
IGUI_Wounds_NoStitchBullet.cn: 枪伤不能缝合 - 要冲洗后再填塞.

IGUI_Wounds_PackingDone.en: The wound has closed - the packing comes away.
IGUI_Wounds_PackingDone.ch: 傷口已癒合 - 填塞物脫落了.
IGUI_Wounds_PackingDone.cn: 伤口已愈合 - 填塞物脱落了.

IGUI_Wounds_ReviveBleeding.en: They are still bleeding - stop it first.
IGUI_Wounds_ReviveBleeding.ch: 對方仍在流血 - 先止血.
IGUI_Wounds_ReviveBleeding.cn: 他们还在流血 - 先止血.

IGUI_Wounds_ReviveKeep.en: The heart is still stopped. Keep going.
IGUI_Wounds_ReviveKeep.ch: 心臟仍未恢復跳動. 繼續.
IGUI_Wounds_ReviveKeep.cn: 心脏仍未恢复跳动. 继续.

IGUI_Wounds_TamponadeNeed.en: Requires a bandage or ripped sheets

IGUI_Wounds_TowTaken.en: Someone else already has hold of them.
IGUI_Wounds_TowTaken.ch: 已經有其他人抓著對方了.
IGUI_Wounds_TowTaken.cn: 已经有其他人抓着他们了.

IGUI_Wounds_TowWeapon.en: You let go to take up your weapon.
IGUI_Wounds_TowWeapon.ch: 你為了舉起武器而放手.
IGUI_Wounds_TowWeapon.cn: 你为了举起武器而松手.

IGUI_Wounds_TrimCut.en: Cut along the edge of the dead tissue
IGUI_Wounds_TrimCut.ch: 沿著壞死組織的邊緣切
IGUI_Wounds_TrimCut.cn: 沿着坏死组织的边缘切

IGUI_Wounds_TrimLift.en: Pick the cut strips out with the tip of the blade
IGUI_Wounds_TrimLift.ch: 用刀尖挑出切下的組織條
IGUI_Wounds_TrimLift.cn: 用刀尖挑出切下的组织条

IGUI_Wounds_TrimNoTweezers.en: No tweezers - the edge will not hold still.
IGUI_Wounds_TrimNoTweezers.ch: 沒有鑷子 - 邊緣固定不住.
IGUI_Wounds_TrimNoTweezers.cn: 没有镊子 - 边缘固定不住.

IGUI_Wounds_TrimSlip.en: The blade slips off the edge.

IGUI_Wounds_TrimSnip.en: Snip along the edge of the dead tissue
IGUI_Wounds_TrimSnip.ch: 沿著壞死組織的邊緣剪
IGUI_Wounds_TrimSnip.cn: 沿着坏死组织的边缘剪

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Error_HeatingHideout.ch: 暖氣控制只能在藏身點內空閒時使用.

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_FallbackSprites.en: Optional. 4 tiles (E, S, W, N) shown when 3D machines are off. Empty uses the generic machine
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_FallbackSprites.ch: 選填. 關閉 3D 機台時顯示的 4 個圖塊 (東, 南, 西, 北). 留空則使用通用機台
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_FallbackSprites.cn: 选填. 关闭 3D 机器时显示的 4 个图块 (东, 南, 西, 北). 留空则使用通用机器

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MachineTexture.en: The machine's picture: its 3D model and its shop window. Files live in media/textures/phunmart/
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MachineTexture.ch: 機台的外觀圖: 用於其 3D 模型與商店視窗. 檔案位於 media/textures/phunmart/
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MachineTexture.cn: 机器的外观图: 用于其 3D 模型与商店窗口. 文件位于 media/textures/phunmart/

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MachineTextureOther.en: A file in media/textures/phunmart/ by name (e.g. my-machine), or a path under media/textures/
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MachineTextureOther.ch: media/textures/phunmart/ 中的檔名 (例如 my-machine), 或 media/textures/ 下的路徑
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MachineTextureOther.cn: media/textures/phunmart/ 中的文件名 (例如 my-machine), 或 media/textures/ 下的路径

IGUI_PhunMart_Opt_Live_tooltip.en: Draw 3D machines at full resolution all the time, instead of the blurrier cached view the game uses for most objects. Turn off to save a little performance with many machines on screen.
IGUI_PhunMart_Opt_Live_tooltip.ch: 隨時以完整解析度繪製 3D 機台, 而不是使用遊戲對大多數物件採用的較模糊快取畫面. 畫面上有許多機台時, 關閉可稍微節省效能.
IGUI_PhunMart_Opt_Live_tooltip.cn: 始终以完整分辨率绘制 3D 机器, 而不是使用游戏对大多数物体采用的较模糊的缓存画面. 屏幕上有许多机器时, 关闭可略微节省性能.

IGUI_PhunMart_Opt_Models_tooltip.en: Draw vending machines as 3D models. Off shows the classic 2D sprites.
IGUI_PhunMart_Opt_Models_tooltip.ch: 以 3D 模型繪製販賣機. 關閉則顯示經典的 2D 圖塊.
IGUI_PhunMart_Opt_Models_tooltip.cn: 以 3D 模型绘制自动售货机. 关闭则显示经典的 2D 图块.

IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Texture.en: The machine's picture: its 3D model and its shop window. Pick one to look like that shop
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Texture.ch: 機台的外觀圖: 用於其 3D 模型與商店視窗. 選擇一個, 外觀就會和該商店一樣
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Texture.cn: 机器的外观图: 用于其 3D 模型与商店窗口. 选择一个, 外观就会和该商店一样

IGUI_WAS_DeleteNearestVehicleTip.en: Permanently remove the single vehicle nearest to you, within 12 tiles - never the one you are sitting in.
IGUI_WAS_DeleteNearestVehicleTip.ch: 永久移除 12 格內離你最近的單一載具 - 絕不會是你乘坐的那輛.
IGUI_WAS_DeleteNearestVehicleTip.cn: 永久移除 12 格内离你最近的单个载具 - 绝不会是你乘坐的那辆.

IGUI_WAT_DeleteNearestVehicleTip.en: Permanently remove the single vehicle nearest to you, within 12 tiles - never the one you are sitting in.
IGUI_WAT_DeleteNearestVehicleTip.ch: 永久移除 12 格內離你最近的單一車輛 - 絕不會是你乘坐的那輛.
IGUI_WAT_DeleteNearestVehicleTip.cn: 永久移除 12 格内离你最近的单辆车辆 - 绝不会是你乘坐的那辆.

IGUI_WAT_DeleteTheNearestVehicleConfirm.en: Permanently delete the vehicle nearest to you? The one you are sitting in is never touched. Anything inside it is lost.
IGUI_WAT_DeleteTheNearestVehicleConfirm.ch: 永久刪除離你最近的車輛? 你乘坐的那輛絕不會受影響. 車內的所有物品都會遺失.
IGUI_WAT_DeleteTheNearestVehicleConfirm.cn: 永久删除离你最近的车辆? 你乘坐的那辆绝不会受影响. 车内的所有物品都会丢失.

IGUI_WAT_NoVehicleToDeleteNearby.en: No vehicle within 12 tiles (the one you are sitting in doesn't count)
IGUI_WAT_NoVehicleToDeleteNearby.ch: 12 格內沒有車輛 (你乘坐的那輛不算)
IGUI_WAT_NoVehicleToDeleteNearby.cn: 12 格内没有车辆 (你乘坐的那辆不算)

IGUI_WAT_RepairRefitAllTip.en: Repair the nearest vehicle and fit a part into EVERY empty slot, including the add-ons a vehicle mod offers (armour, roof racks). Plain Repair leaves those as they are.
IGUI_WAT_RepairRefitAllTip.ch: 修理最近的車輛, 並在「每一個」空的零件欄位裝上零件, 包括車輛模組提供的附加零件 (裝甲, 車頂架). 一般的「修理」會讓這些欄位維持原狀.
IGUI_WAT_RepairRefitAllTip.cn: 修理最近的车辆, 并在“每一个”空的部件槽位装上部件, 包括车辆模组提供的附加部件 (装甲, 车顶架). 普通的“修理”会让这些槽位保持原样.

IGUI_WAT_ShowWessAdminToolsWhenYouRight.en: Show 'Wess Admin Tools' when you right-click the world. Off: open the menu with its keybind only (F7 unless you changed it in Options > Keybindings).
IGUI_WAT_ShowWessAdminToolsWhenYouRight.ch: 對世界按右鍵時顯示「Wess Admin Tools」. 關閉時: 只能用按鍵綁定開啟選單 (預設為 F7, 除非你在 選項 > 按鍵綁定 中更改過).
IGUI_WAT_ShowWessAdminToolsWhenYouRight.cn: 右键点击世界时显示“Wess Admin Tools”. 关闭时: 只能用按键绑定打开菜单 (默认为 F7, 除非你在 选项 > 按键绑定 中更改过).

IGUI_WAT_VehicleRepairedAddonsLeft.en: Vehicle repaired (%1 parts reinstalled; %2 empty add-on slots left as they are - Repair + refit all fills them)
IGUI_WAT_VehicleRepairedAddonsLeft.ch: 車輛已修理 (重新安裝了 %1 個零件; %2 個空的附加零件欄位維持原狀 - 「修理並補齊所有零件」可將其補齊)
IGUI_WAT_VehicleRepairedAddonsLeft.cn: 车辆已修理 (重新安装了 %1 个部件; %2 个空的附加部件槽位保持原样 - “修理并补齐所有部件”可将其补齐)

IGUI_WAT_VehicleSpawnBlocked.en: No vehicle appeared - there is no clear space nearby. Move away from other vehicles and try again.
IGUI_WAT_VehicleSpawnBlocked.ch: 沒有出現車輛 - 附近沒有空曠的位置. 請遠離其他車輛後再試一次.
IGUI_WAT_VehicleSpawnBlocked.cn: 没有出现车辆 - 附近没有空旷的位置. 请远离其他车辆后再试一次.

IGUI_WAT_VehicleSpawnIndoors.en: No vehicle appeared - vehicles can't be spawned indoors. Step outside and try again.
IGUI_WAT_VehicleSpawnIndoors.ch: 沒有出現車輛 - 無法在室內生成車輛. 請到戶外後再試一次.
IGUI_WAT_VehicleSpawnIndoors.cn: 没有出现车辆 - 无法在室内生成车辆. 请到户外后再试一次.

IGUI_WAT_VehicleSpawnMultiplayer.en: Vehicles can't be spawned from this menu in multiplayer. Wess Admin Tools: Server can.
IGUI_WAT_VehicleSpawnMultiplayer.ch: 多人遊戲中無法從此選單生成車輛. Wess Admin Tools: Server 可以.
IGUI_WAT_VehicleSpawnMultiplayer.cn: 多人游戏中无法从此菜单生成车辆. Wess Admin Tools: Server 可以.

IGUI_WAS_DeleteNearestVehicleWarn.en: Permanent: the vehicle and everything inside it are gone.
IGUI_WAS_DeleteNearestVehicleWarn.ch: 永久性: 載具及其內部的所有物品都會消失.
IGUI_WAS_DeleteNearestVehicleWarn.cn: 永久性: 载具及其内部的所有物品都会消失.

IGUI_WAS_DeleteTheNearestVehicleConfirm.en: Permanently delete the vehicle nearest to you? The one you are sitting in is never touched.
IGUI_WAS_DeleteTheNearestVehicleConfirm.ch: 永久刪除離你最近的載具? 你乘坐的那輛絕不會受影響.
IGUI_WAS_DeleteTheNearestVehicleConfirm.cn: 永久删除离你最近的载具? 你乘坐的那辆绝不会受影响.

IGUI_WAS_HostGrantedAdmin.en: You are hosting this game, so you now have admin on it - panel actions run on the server.
IGUI_WAS_HostGrantedAdmin.ch: 你正在主持這場遊戲, 因此你現在擁有此遊戲的管理員權限 - 面板操作會在伺服器上執行.
IGUI_WAS_HostGrantedAdmin.cn: 你正在主持这局游戏, 因此你现在拥有该游戏的管理员权限 - 面板操作会在服务器上执行.

IGUI_WAS_RepairLeavesAddonSlots.en: Empty add-on slots from vehicle mods (armour, roof racks) are left as they are - Repair + refit all fills them.
IGUI_WAS_RepairLeavesAddonSlots.ch: 載具模組的空附加零件欄位 (裝甲, 車頂架) 會維持原狀 - 「修理並補齊所有零件」可將其補齊.
IGUI_WAS_RepairLeavesAddonSlots.cn: 载具模组的空附加部件槽位 (装甲, 车顶架) 会保持原样 - “修理并补齐所有部件”可将其补齐.

IGUI_WAS_RepairRefitAllTip.en: Repair the vehicle you're standing next to and fit a part into EVERY empty slot, including the add-ons a vehicle mod offers (armour, roof racks). Plain Repair leaves those as they are.
IGUI_WAS_RepairRefitAllTip.ch: 修理你身旁的載具, 並在「每一個」空的零件欄位裝上零件, 包括載具模組提供的附加零件 (裝甲, 車頂架). 一般的「修理」會讓這些欄位維持原狀.
IGUI_WAS_RepairRefitAllTip.cn: 修理你身旁的载具, 并在“每一个”空的部件槽位装上部件, 包括载具模组提供的附加部件 (装甲, 车顶架). 普通的“修理”会让这些槽位保持原样.

IGUI_WAS_RosterLoading.en: Fetching the full player list from the server - press again in a moment.
IGUI_WAS_RosterLoading.ch: 正在從伺服器取得完整的玩家清單 - 請稍後再按一次.
IGUI_WAS_RosterLoading.cn: 正在从服务器获取完整的玩家列表 - 请稍后再按一次.

IGUI_WAS_ShowWessServerAdminWhenYouRight.en: Show 'Wess Server Admin' when you right-click the world. Off: open the panel with its keybind only (F6 unless you changed it in Options > Keybindings).
IGUI_WAS_ShowWessServerAdminWhenYouRight.ch: 對世界按右鍵時顯示「Wess Server Admin」. 關閉時: 只能用按鍵綁定開啟面板 (預設為 F6, 除非你在 選項 > 按鍵綁定 中更改過).
IGUI_WAS_ShowWessServerAdminWhenYouRight.cn: 右键点击世界时显示“Wess Server Admin”. 关闭时: 只能用按键绑定打开面板 (默认为 F6, 除非你在 选项 > 按键绑定 中更改过).

IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_DropDown_Tooltip.en: The numbers fall below the panel instead of rising above it. Use it when you keep the panel against the top edge.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_DropDown_Tooltip.ch: 數字會從面板往下落, 而不是往上飄. 適合把面板貼在螢幕頂端時使用.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_DropDown_Tooltip.cn: 数字会从面板往下落, 而不是往上飘. 适合把面板贴在屏幕顶端时使用.

IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_DropSize_Tooltip.en: How big the XP numbers are, over the panel or over your character. 100 is the usual size, 200 twice as big.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_DropSize_Tooltip.ch: 經驗值數字的大小, 不論顯示在面板上方或角色頭上. 100 為一般大小, 200 為兩倍大.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_DropSize_Tooltip.cn: 经验值数字的大小, 无论显示在面板上方还是角色头顶. 100 为常规大小, 200 为两倍大.

IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_StackAbove_Tooltip.en: The extra panels appear above the main one instead of below. Use it when you keep the panel low on the screen.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_StackAbove_Tooltip.ch: 額外的面板會出現在主面板上方, 而不是下方. 適合把面板放在螢幕較低處時使用.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_StackAbove_Tooltip.cn: 额外的面板会出现在主面板上方, 而不是下方. 适合把面板放在屏幕较低处时使用.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobDanger.en: Zombies. I'll get back to it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobDanger.ch: 有殭屍. 我晚點再回來做.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobDanger.cn: 有僵尸. 我晚点再回来做.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobDoorBarricaded.en: That's barricaded. I can't get through.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobDoorBarricaded.ch: 那裡被封住了. 我過不去.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobDoorBarricaded.cn: 那里被封住了. 我过不去.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobDoorBarricadedNoPat.en: That's barricaded. I can't reach it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobDoorBarricadedNoPat.ch: 那裡被封住了. 我到不了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobDoorBarricadedNoPat.cn: 那里被封住了. 我到不了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobDoorLockedNoPath.en: That door's locked. I can't reach it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobDoorLockedNoPath.ch: 那扇門鎖住了. 我到不了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobDoorLockedNoPath.cn: 那扇门锁住了. 我到不了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobLost.en: I lost you. Dropped the job, I'm here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobLost.ch: 跟丟你了. 工作先放下了, 我在這裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobLost.cn: 跟丢你了. 活先放下了, 我在这里.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedAshTool.en: I need a shovel or broom for the ashes.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedAshTool.ch: 我需要鏟子或掃把來清灰燼.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedAshTool.cn: 我需要铲子或扫帚来清灰烬.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedBroom.en: I need a mop, broom, or towel.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedBroom.ch: 我需要拖把、掃把或毛巾.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedBroom.cn: 我需要拖把、扫帚或毛巾.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedBroomAndFluid.en: I need a mop, broom, or towel, and bleach or cleaning liquid, for the grime.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedBroomAndFluid.ch: 我需要拖把、掃把或毛巾, 還有漂白水或清潔劑, 才能清掉汙垢.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedBroomAndFluid.cn: 我需要拖把、扫帚或毛巾, 还有漂白剂或清洁剂, 才能清掉污垢.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedCleaner.en: I need bleach or cleaning liquid for the blood.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedCleaner.ch: 我需要漂白水或清潔劑來清血跡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedCleaner.cn: 我需要漂白剂或清洁剂来清血迹.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedFragAsh.en: a shovel or broom for the ashes
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedFragAsh.ch: 清灰燼用的鏟子或掃把
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedFragAsh.cn: 清灰烬用的铲子或扫帚

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedFragCut.en: a cutting tool for the vines

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedFragFluidBlood.en: bleach or cleaning liquid for the blood
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedFragFluidBlood.ch: 清血跡用的漂白水或清潔劑
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedFragFluidBlood.cn: 清血迹用的漂白剂或清洁剂

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedFragFluidStains.en: bleach or cleaning liquid for the stains
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedFragFluidStains.ch: 清汙漬用的漂白水或清潔劑
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedFragFluidStains.cn: 清污渍用的漂白剂或清洁剂

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedImplement.en: I need a mop, broom, or towel.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedImplement.ch: 我需要拖把、掃把或毛巾.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedImplement.cn: 我需要拖把、扫帚或毛巾.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedImplementAndFlu.en: I need a mop, broom, or towel, and bleach or cleaning liquid, for the blood.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedImplementAndFlu.ch: 我需要拖把、掃把或毛巾, 還有漂白水或清潔劑, 才能清掉血跡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedImplementAndFlu.cn: 我需要拖把、扫帚或毛巾, 还有漂白剂或清洁剂, 才能清掉血迹.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedImplementAndPet.en: I need a mop or broom, and petrol, for the graffiti.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_CarryFull_Close_3.cn: 我背太多了. 别再给我了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_CarryFull_Far_1.en: That's it. I can't carry more.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_CarryFull_Far_1.ch: 就這樣. 我拿不下了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_CarryFull_Far_1.cn: 就这样. 我拿不下了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_CarryFull_Near_1.en: I'm at my limit. This is too much.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_CarryFull_Near_1.ch: 我到極限了. 這太多了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_CarryFull_Near_1.cn: 我到极限了. 这太多了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_CarryFull_Near_2.en: Any more and I can't move.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_CarryFull_Near_3.en: That's the last of my room.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressAgain_Close_1.en: You already gave me one like this. I kept it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressAgain_Close_1.ch: 你給過我一樣的了. 我一直留著.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressAgain_Close_1.cn: 你给过我一样的了. 我一直留着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressAgain_Close_2.en: Another one? I remember the first.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressAgain_Close_2.ch: 又一個? 第一個我還記得.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressAgain_Close_2.cn: 又一个? 第一个我还记得.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressAgain_Close_3.en: I know this one. I liked it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressAgain_Close_3.ch: 這個我認得. 我很喜歡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressAgain_Close_3.cn: 这个我认得. 我很喜欢.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressAgain_Near_1.en: You gave me one of these already.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressAgain_Near_3.en: I still have the last one.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressBag_Close_3.en: Room for your things too, you know.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressBag_Near_1.ch: 一個包包. 我會把它裝滿.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressBag_Near_1.cn: 一个包. 我会把它装满.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressBag_Near_3.en: Good. I was running out of room.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressBag_Near_3.ch: 太好了. 我快沒地方放了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressBag_Near_3.cn: 太好了. 我快没地方放了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressBroken_Close_1.ch: 這是壞的. 少拿這種東西打發我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressBroken_Close_1.cn: 这是坏的. 少拿这种东西打发我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressBroken_Close_2.en: This won't hold together. Try again.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressBroken_Close_2.ch: 這撐不了多久. 換一個吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressBroken_Close_2.cn: 这撑不了多久. 换一个吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressCloth_Close_3.en: I like it. I like that you thought of me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressCloth_Close_3.ch: 我很喜歡. 更喜歡你有想到我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressCloth_Close_3.cn: 我很喜欢. 更喜欢你想着我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressDirty_Close_1.en: You'd put this on me? Wash it first.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressDirty_Close_1.ch: 你要我穿這個? 先洗一洗吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressDirty_Close_1.cn: 你要我穿这个? 先洗一洗吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressDirty_Close_2.en: It's ruined, love. Not this one.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressDirty_Close_2.ch: 這已經毀了, 親愛的. 這件不行.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressDirty_Close_2.cn: 这已经毁了, 亲爱的. 这件不行.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressDirty_Close_3.en: I'm not wearing something with holes in it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressDirty_Close_3.ch: 我才不穿有破洞的東西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressDirty_Close_3.cn: 我才不穿有破洞的东西.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressHat_Close_1.en: A hat for me? Be honest — does it suit me?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressHat_Close_1.ch: 給我的帽子? 老實說, 適合我嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressHat_Close_1.cn: 给我的帽子? 老实说, 适合我吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressHat_Close_2.en: Now I'm really one of you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressHat_Close_2.ch: 現在我真的跟你是一夥的了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressHat_Close_2.cn: 现在我真的跟你是一伙的了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressHat_Close_3.ch: 我會留著. 一直留著.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressHat_Close_3.cn: 我会留着. 一直留着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressHat_Near_1.en: A hat? How do I look?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressHat_Near_1.ch: 帽子? 我看起來怎樣?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressHat_Near_1.cn: 帽子? 我看起来怎么样?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressJacket_Close_1.en: It smells like you. I'm keeping it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressJacket_Close_1.ch: 上面有你的味道. 我要留著.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressJacket_Close_1.cn: 上面有你的味道. 我要留着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressJacket_Close_2.en: Warm. I could get used to this.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressJacket_Close_2.ch: 好暖. 我捨不得脫了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressJacket_Close_2.cn: 好暖. 我舍不得脱了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressJacket_Close_3.ch: 謝謝你. 我是說真的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressJacket_Close_3.cn: 谢谢你. 我是说真的.

IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_DressJewel_Close_1.en: Not really my thing. I'll wear it anyway.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_DressJewel_Close_1.ch: 我不太戴這種東西. 不過我還是會戴.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_DressJewel_Close_1.cn: 我不太戴这种东西. 不过我还是会戴.

IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_DressJewel_Close_2.ch: 喔. 還不錯. 謝了.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_DressJewel_Close_2.cn: 哦. 还不错. 谢了.

IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_DressJewel_Near_2.ch: 給我戴? 嗯… 好吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_DressJewel_Near_2.cn: 给我戴? 嗯… 好吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressJewel_Close_3.en: Does it suit me? Be honest.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressJewel_Near_1.en: Jewelry. Like the world didn't end.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressJewel_Near_1.ch: 首飾. 好像世界還沒毀滅一樣.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressJewel_Near_1.cn: 首饰. 好像世界还没毁灭一样.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShades_Close_1.en: Now I look like I know what I'm doing.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShades_Close_1.ch: 現在我看起來像個行家了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShades_Close_1.cn: 现在我看起来像个行家了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShades_Far_2.en: Sun's less of a problem now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShades_Far_2.ch: 現在太陽沒那麼刺眼了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShades_Far_2.cn: 现在太阳没那么刺眼了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShades_Near_1.en: How do I look? Don't answer.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShades_Near_1.ch: 我看起來怎樣? 別回答.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShades_Near_1.cn: 我看起来怎么样? 别回答.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShades_Near_2.en: Better. The sun was killing me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShades_Near_2.ch: 好多了. 太陽曬得我快受不了了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShades_Near_2.cn: 好多了. 太阳晒得我快受不了了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShoes_Close_2.en: Try to keep up with me now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShoes_Close_2.ch: 現在換你努力跟上我了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShoes_Close_2.cn: 现在换你努力跟上我了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShoes_Near_1.ch: 鞋子. 我的腳感謝你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressShoes_Near_1.cn: 鞋子. 我的脚谢谢你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressSuit_Close_1.en: You dressed me head to toe. Thank you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressSuit_Close_1.ch: 你把我從頭到腳都打扮好了. 謝謝你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressSuit_Close_1.cn: 你把我从头到脚都打扮好了. 谢谢你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressSuit_Close_3.en: For a moment I forgot the world ended.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressSuit_Close_3.ch: 有那麼一瞬間, 我忘了世界已經完了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressSuit_Close_3.cn: 有那么一瞬间, 我忘了世界已经完了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressSuit_Near_3.en: I could get used to this.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressTags_Close_1.en: You trust me with these. I get it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressTags_Close_1.ch: 你把這些託付給我. 我明白.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressTags_Close_1.cn: 你把这些托付给我. 我明白.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressTags_Close_2.en: If something happens to me, you'll know me by these.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressTags_Close_2.ch: 要是我出了什麼事, 你可以靠這個認出我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressTags_Close_2.cn: 要是我出了什么事, 你可以靠这个认出我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressTags_Close_3.en: I'll wear them for both of us.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressTags_Near_1.en: Someone didn't make it home. I'll carry them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressTags_Near_1.ch: 有人沒能回家. 我會帶著它們.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressTags_Near_1.cn: 有人没能回家. 我会带着它们.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressWatch_Close_1.ch: 我會戴著. 每天都戴.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressWatch_Close_1.cn: 我会戴着. 每天都戴.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressWatch_Close_2.en: You picked this for me. I won't take it off.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressWatch_Close_2.ch: 這是你幫我挑的. 我不會拿下來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressWatch_Close_2.cn: 这是你帮我挑的. 我不会摘下来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressWatch_Close_3.en: My father had one like this.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressWatch_Close_3.ch: 我爸以前也有一支這樣的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressWatch_Close_3.cn: 我爸以前也有一块这样的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressWatch_Far_2.en: Haven't known the time in weeks.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressWatch_Far_2.ch: 我好幾個禮拜不知道時間了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressWatch_Far_2.cn: 我好几个星期不知道时间了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressWatch_Near_1.en: A watch? Now I'll know how long we've been walking.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressWatch_Near_1.ch: 手錶? 這下我就知道我們走了多久了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_DressWatch_Near_1.cn: 手表? 这下我就知道我们走了多久了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarAhead_Close_3.en: There's a car ahead — ease off.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarAhead_Close_3.ch: 前面有輛車, 放慢點.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarAhead_Close_3.cn: 前面有辆车, 放慢点.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarAnimal_Close_1.ch: 你看. 外面還有活著的東西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarAnimal_Close_1.cn: 你看. 外面还有活着的东西.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarAnimal_Close_2.en: An animal. Quiet, don't scare it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarAnimal_Close_2.ch: 是動物. 小聲點, 別嚇到牠.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarAnimal_Close_2.cn: 是动物. 小声点, 别吓到它.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarAnimal_Close_3.en: See it? There's still life out here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarAnimal_Close_3.ch: 看到了嗎? 這裡還有生命.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarAnimal_Close_3.cn: 看到了吗? 这里还有生命.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarBlizzard_Close_1.en: We are not driving through this. Stop the car.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarBlizzard_Close_1.ch: 這種天氣我們不能硬開過去. 停車.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarBlizzard_Close_1.cn: 这种天气我们不能硬闯过去. 停车.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarBlizzard_Close_2.en: I can't see anything. Pull over — I mean it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarBlizzard_Close_2.ch: 我什麼都看不見. 靠邊停, 我是認真的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarBlizzard_Close_2.cn: 我什么都看不见. 靠边停, 我是认真的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarBlizzard_Near_1.ch: 暴風雪. 連引擎蓋都看不見.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarBlizzard_Near_1.cn: 暴风雪. 连引擎盖都看不见.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdDrive_Close_1.en: You're turning blue. Find us a house. Now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdDrive_Close_1.ch: 你的臉都發青了. 找間房子. 現在就去.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdDrive_Close_1.cn: 你的脸都发青了. 找间房子. 现在就去.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdDrive_Close_2.en: I can't watch you freeze. Somewhere warm, please.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdDrive_Close_2.ch: 我不能眼睜睜看你凍著. 找個暖和的地方, 拜託.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdDrive_Close_2.cn: 我不能眼睁睁看你冻着. 找个暖和的地方, 求你了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdDrive_Near_1.en: You're shivering. The heater won't fix that. We need shelter.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdDrive_Near_1.ch: 你在發抖. 暖氣解決不了. 我們得找地方躲.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdDrive_Near_1.cn: 你在发抖. 暖气解决不了. 我们得找地方躲.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdDrive_Near_2.ch: 帶我們去暖和的地方. 快點.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdDrive_Near_2.cn: 带我们去暖和的地方. 快点.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdIn_Close_1.en: You're freezing. Get in, sit close. I'll find us somewhere warm.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdIn_Close_1.ch: 你快凍僵了. 上車, 坐近一點. 我會找個暖和的地方.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdIn_Close_1.cn: 你快冻僵了. 上车, 坐近一点. 我会找个暖和的地方.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdIn_Close_2.en: You're soaked through. Get in. I've got you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdIn_Close_2.ch: 你全身都濕透了. 上車. 有我在.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdIn_Close_2.cn: 你全身都湿透了. 上车. 有我在.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdIn_Near_1.en: You're soaked. Get in — we'll find dry clothes later.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdIn_Near_1.ch: 你濕透了. 上車, 晚點再找乾衣服.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdIn_Near_1.cn: 你湿透了. 上车, 晚点再找干衣服.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdOut_Close_1.en: Get inside. I'll get you dry and warm.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdOut_Close_1.ch: 進去吧. 我會讓你又乾又暖.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdOut_Close_1.cn: 进去吧. 我会让你又干又暖.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdOut_Close_2.en: Come on, in. Dry clothes, warm fire. Now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdOut_Close_2.ch: 來, 進去. 換乾衣服, 生個火. 馬上.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdOut_Close_2.cn: 来, 进去. 换干衣服, 生个火. 马上.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdOut_Near_1.en: Get dry. Now. Before you catch something.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdOut_Near_1.ch: 快去弄乾. 現在. 免得生病.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdOut_Near_1.cn: 快去弄干. 现在. 免得生病.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdOut_Near_2.ch: 進去. 取暖. 現在.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdOut_Near_2.cn: 进去. 取暖. 现在.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdWet_Close_1.en: You're soaked through and shivering. Next house, we stop. No arguing.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdWet_Close_1.ch: 你濕透了還在發抖. 下一間房子就停. 不准跟我爭.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdWet_Close_1.cn: 你湿透了还在发抖. 下一间房子就停. 不许跟我争.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdWet_Close_2.en: Wet and cold kills. I'm not losing you to it. Shelter. Now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdWet_Close_2.ch: 又濕又冷會死人的. 我不會讓你就這樣沒了. 找地方躲. 現在.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdWet_Close_2.cn: 又湿又冷会死人的. 我不会让你就这么没了. 找地方躲. 现在.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdWet_Near_1.en: You're soaked and freezing. Next house, we stop.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdWet_Near_1.ch: 你又濕又冷. 下一間房子就停.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdWet_Near_1.cn: 你又湿又冷. 下一间房子就停.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdWet_Near_2.en: Wet and cold is how people die out here. Shelter. Now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdWet_Near_2.ch: 在外面, 又濕又冷就是會死人. 找地方躲. 現在.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarColdWet_Near_2.cn: 在外面, 又湿又冷是会死人的. 找地方躲. 现在.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Close_.en: I can't — that smell. Drive, please.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Close_.ch: 我受不了…那個味道. 拜託, 快開.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Close_.cn: 我受不了…那个味道. 求你, 快开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Close_.en: I'm going to throw up. Get us away from the dead.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Close_.ch: 我要吐了. 快離開這些屍體.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Close_.cn: 我要吐了. 快离开这些尸体.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Close_.en: God, I can taste it in my throat. Go. Now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Close_.ch: 天啊, 我喉嚨裡都嚐得到. 走. 現在.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Close_.cn: 天哪, 我喉咙里都尝得到. 走. 现在.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Near_1.en: I'm going to be sick. That smell —
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Near_1.ch: 我快吐了. 那個味道…
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Near_1.cn: 我快吐了. 那个味道…

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Near_2.en: God. I can taste it. Drive.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Near_2.ch: 天啊. 我都嚐到味道了. 開車.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Near_2.cn: 天哪. 我都尝到味道了. 开车.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCorpseSick_Near_3.en: That's rotting flesh. Get us clear.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrash_Close_2.ch: 喂! 我還坐在這裡耶.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrash_Close_2.cn: 喂! 我还坐在这儿呢.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrash_Close_3.en: Careful, you'll get us both killed.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrash_Close_3.ch: 小心, 你會害我們兩個都沒命.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrash_Close_3.cn: 小心, 你会害我们俩都没命.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrashHard_Close_1.en: Are you okay? Talk to me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrashHard_Close_1.ch: 你還好嗎? 跟我說話.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrashHard_Close_1.cn: 你还好吗? 跟我说话.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrashHard_Close_2.en: Hey. Look at me. Are you hurt?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrashHard_Close_2.ch: 喂. 看著我. 你受傷了嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrashHard_Close_2.cn: 喂. 看着我. 你受伤了吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrashHard_Close_3.en: That was a bad one. Are you okay?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrashHard_Close_3.ch: 剛剛撞得好重. 你沒事吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrashHard_Close_3.cn: 刚刚撞得好重. 你没事吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrashHard_Near_1.en: Are you okay? That was bad.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrashHard_Near_1.ch: 你還好嗎? 撞得很慘.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarCrashHard_Near_1.cn: 你还好吗? 撞得很惨.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarDawn_Close_1.en: We made it through the night. Together.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarDawn_Close_1.ch: 我們撐過這一夜了. 一起.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarDawn_Close_1.cn: 我们熬过这一夜了. 一起.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarDawn_Close_2.ch: 天亮了. 我們又活過一晚.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarDawn_Close_2.cn: 天亮了. 我们又活过一晚.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarEating_Close_1.en: Put it down. Eat when we stop — I'm not scraping you off the dash.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarEating_Close_1.ch: 放下. 停車再吃, 我可不想把你從儀表板上刮下來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarEating_Close_1.cn: 放下. 停车再吃, 我可不想把你从仪表盘上刮下来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarEating_Close_2.ch: 晚點再嚼. 現在專心開車.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarEating_Close_2.cn: 晚点再嚼. 现在专心开车.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarEating_Near_1.en: Don't eat and drive. Both hands.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarEating_Near_1.ch: 別邊吃邊開車. 兩隻手都放上去.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarEating_Near_1.cn: 别边吃边开车. 两只手都放上去.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarEating_Near_2.en: You'll choke. Eyes on the road.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarExitClear_Close_1.en: Out. Finally. My legs are asleep.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarExitClear_Close_1.ch: 下車了. 終於. 我的腳都麻了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarExitClear_Close_1.cn: 下车了. 终于. 我的腿都麻了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarExitClear_Close_2.ch: 總算能透口氣. 接下來去哪?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarExitClear_Close_2.cn: 总算能透口气. 接下来去哪?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarExitClear_Close_3.en: Back on our feet. Stay close.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarExitClear_Close_3.ch: 又要用走的了. 跟緊我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarExitClear_Close_3.cn: 又要走路了. 跟紧我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarExitZombies_Close.ch: 直接開工. 待在我後面.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarExitZombies_Close.cn: 直接干活. 待在我后面.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarFast_Close_1.ch: 你開得像在飛. 慢點.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarFast_Close_1.cn: 你开得跟飞一样. 慢点.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarFog_Close_1.en: I can't see anything. Slow down for me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarFog_Close_1.ch: 我什麼都看不見. 拜託開慢點.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarFog_Close_1.cn: 我什么都看不见. 求你开慢点.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarFog_Close_2.en: Fog like this swallows people. Stay slow.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarFog_Close_2.ch: 這種霧會把人吞掉的. 保持慢速.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarFog_Close_2.cn: 这种雾会把人吞掉的. 保持慢速.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarFog_Near_2.en: Can't see the road. Ease off.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarGreetClear_Close_.en: You have a place in mind, or are we just driving?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarGreetClear_Close_.ch: 你有想去的地方嗎, 還是就隨便開?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarGreetClear_Close_.cn: 你有想去的地方吗, 还是就随便开?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarGreetZombies_Clos.en: Go. Now. I'll watch our backs.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarGreetZombies_Clos.ch: 走. 馬上. 後面我來盯.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarGreetZombies_Clos.cn: 走. 马上. 后面我来盯.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarGreetZombies_Clos.ch: 你敢停下來試試. 開車.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarGreetZombies_Clos.cn: 你敢停下来试试. 开车.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarGreetZombies_Clos.en: They're too close. Get us out.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarGreetZombies_Clos.ch: 它們太近了. 帶我們離開.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarGreetZombies_Clos.cn: 它们太近了. 带我们离开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHorde_Close_1.en: That's a lot of them. Don't stop.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHorde_Close_2.ch: 前面有屍群, 繼續開.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHorde_Close_2.cn: 前面有尸群, 继续开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHorde_Near_1.en: There's a lot of them ahead.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryDrive_Close.en: Eat. Please. I can't watch you do this to yourself.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryDrive_Close.ch: 吃點東西. 拜託. 我不能看你這樣折磨自己.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryDrive_Close.cn: 吃点东西. 求你了. 我不能看你这样折磨自己.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryDrive_Close.en: There's food in the bag. Eat it while I keep watch.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryDrive_Close.ch: 包裡有吃的. 我來把風, 你吃.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryDrive_Close.cn: 包里有吃的. 我来望风, 你吃.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryDrive_Near_.en: Eat something from the glovebox. You're shaking.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryDrive_Near_.ch: 吃點手套箱裡的東西. 你在發抖.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryDrive_Near_.cn: 吃点手套箱里的东西. 你在发抖.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryDrive_Near_.en: You need food before you make a mistake.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryDrive_Near_.ch: 你得吃點東西, 免得出錯.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryDrive_Near_.cn: 你得吃点东西, 免得出错.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryIn_Close_1.en: You're starving. Drive — but we eat first chance we get.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryIn_Close_1.ch: 你餓壞了. 開吧, 但一有機會就先吃東西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryIn_Close_1.cn: 你饿坏了. 开吧, 但一有机会就先吃东西.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryIn_Close_2.en: You need food. I won't let you waste away.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryIn_Close_2.ch: 你需要吃東西. 我不會讓你一天天瘦下去.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryIn_Close_2.cn: 你需要吃东西. 我不会让你一天天消瘦下去.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryIn_Far_2.ch: 你上次吃東西是什麼時候?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryIn_Far_2.cn: 你上次吃东西是什么时候?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryIn_Near_1.en: When did you last eat? We eat when we stop.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryIn_Near_1.ch: 你多久沒吃東西了? 停車就吃.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryIn_Near_1.cn: 你多久没吃东西了? 停车就吃.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryIn_Near_2.en: You're running on empty. Let's find something.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryIn_Near_2.ch: 你已經在硬撐了. 找點吃的吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryIn_Near_2.cn: 你已经在硬撑了. 找点吃的吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryOut_Close_1.en: Come on. We eat, then we rest. In that order.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryOut_Close_1.ch: 走吧. 先吃, 再休息. 照這個順序.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryOut_Close_1.cn: 走吧. 先吃, 再休息. 按这个顺序.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryOut_Close_2.en: I'll get you something. Sit down.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryOut_Close_2.ch: 我去幫你拿點吃的. 坐下.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryOut_Close_2.cn: 我去给你拿点吃的. 坐下.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryOut_Near_1.en: First thing we do is eat. I mean it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryOut_Near_1.ch: 第一件事就是吃東西. 我說真的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryOut_Near_1.cn: 第一件事就是吃东西. 我说真的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryOut_Near_2.ch: 吃東西. 現在, 什麼都先擺一邊.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHungryOut_Near_2.cn: 吃东西. 现在, 别的先放一边.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurt_Close_2.ch: 你在流血, 讓我看看.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurt_Close_2.cn: 你在流血, 让我看看.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtDrive_Close_1.en: Hold it tight. I'll tell you when to stop.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtDrive_Close_1.ch: 壓緊. 該停的時候我會說.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtDrive_Close_1.cn: 压紧. 该停的时候我会说.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtDrive_Close_2.en: Don't you dare pass out on me. Keep pressure.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtDrive_Close_2.ch: 你敢給我昏過去試試. 繼續壓著.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtDrive_Close_2.cn: 你敢给我晕过去试试. 继续压着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtDrive_Near_1.en: Keep pressure on it. Don't stop here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtDrive_Near_1.ch: 繼續壓著. 別在這裡停.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtDrive_Near_1.cn: 继续压着. 别在这里停.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtDrive_Near_2.en: You're still bleeding. Find somewhere safe.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtDrive_Near_2.ch: 你還在流血. 找個安全的地方.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtDrive_Near_2.cn: 你还在流血. 找个安全的地方.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtIn_Close_1.en: You're bleeding. Get in, sit, let me see it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtIn_Close_1.ch: 你在流血. 上車, 坐好, 讓我看看.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtIn_Close_1.cn: 你在流血. 上车, 坐好, 让我看看.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtIn_Close_2.en: Don't argue. In. I'm patching that now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtIn_Close_2.ch: 別爭. 上車. 我現在就幫你包紮.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtIn_Close_2.cn: 别争. 上车. 我现在就给你包扎.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtIn_Near_1.en: You're bleeding. Drive — I'll patch you when we stop.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtIn_Near_1.ch: 你在流血. 開吧, 停車後我幫你包紮.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtIn_Near_1.cn: 你在流血. 开吧, 停车后我给你包扎.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtIn_Near_2.en: Get in. We'll deal with that.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtOut_Close_1.en: Out. Sit. Let me look at you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtOut_Close_1.ch: 下車. 坐下. 讓我看看你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtOut_Close_1.cn: 下车. 坐下. 让我看看你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtOut_Close_2.en: You're done driving. I'm fixing that first.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtOut_Close_2.ch: 你別開了. 我先處理傷口.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtOut_Close_2.cn: 你别开了. 我先处理伤口.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtOut_Near_1.en: Out. Sit. Let me see that.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtOut_Near_1.ch: 下車. 坐下. 讓我看看傷口.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtOut_Near_1.cn: 下车. 坐下. 让我看看伤口.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtOut_Near_2.en: Stop the car. I need to look at it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtOut_Near_2.ch: 停車. 我得看看傷口.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarHurtOut_Near_2.cn: 停车. 我得看看伤口.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarLightning_Close_1.en: That was right on top of us. Keep going.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarLightning_Close_1.ch: 剛剛就劈在我們頭上. 繼續開.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarLightning_Close_1.cn: 刚刚就劈在我们头上. 继续开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarLightning_Close_2.ch: 連我都感覺到震動了. 快開.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarLightning_Close_2.cn: 连我都感觉到震动了. 快开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarLightning_Near_2.en: Lightning. Not the tallest thing out here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarLightning_Near_2.ch: 閃電. 還好我們不是這裡最高的東西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarLightning_Near_2.cn: 闪电. 还好我们不是这里最高的东西.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarNightFalls_Close_.en: It's getting dark. Let's not be driving when it's black.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarNightFalls_Close_.ch: 天快黑了. 別等到全黑了還在開車.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarNightFalls_Close_.cn: 天快黑了. 别等到全黑了还在开车.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarNightFalls_Close_.en: Night's coming. Find us somewhere, please.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarNightFalls_Close_.ch: 天要黑了. 拜託, 找個地方讓我們落腳.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarNightFalls_Close_.cn: 天要黑了. 求你了, 找个地方让我们落脚.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarNightFalls_Near_1.ch: 天色暗了. 把車燈打開.
