IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarNightFalls_Near_1.cn: 天色暗了. 把车灯打开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarNightFalls_Near_2.en: Dark soon. We should find somewhere.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarNightFalls_Near_2.ch: 快天黑了. 我們該找個地方了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarNightFalls_Near_2.cn: 快天黑了. 我们该找个地方了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicDrive_Close_.en: Look at me. Breathe. I've got you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicDrive_Close_.ch: 看著我. 呼吸. 有我在.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicDrive_Close_.cn: 看着我. 呼吸. 有我在.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicDrive_Close_.en: It's just us. Breathe. I'm not going anywhere.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicDrive_Close_.ch: 這裡只有我們. 呼吸. 我哪裡都不去.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicDrive_Close_.cn: 这里只有我们. 呼吸. 我哪儿都不去.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicDrive_Near_1.en: Hey. Look at the road. Breathe with me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicDrive_Near_1.ch: 嘿. 看路. 跟著我呼吸.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicDrive_Near_1.cn: 嘿. 看路. 跟着我呼吸.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicDrive_Near_2.ch: 慢下來. 呼吸. 我們沒事.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicDrive_Near_2.cn: 慢下来. 呼吸. 我们没事.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicIn_Close_1.en: Hey. Breathe with me. Then we go.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicIn_Close_1.ch: 嘿. 跟著我呼吸. 然後再走.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicIn_Close_1.cn: 嘿. 跟着我呼吸. 然后再走.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicIn_Close_2.en: You're panicking. It's okay. I'm here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicIn_Close_2.ch: 你慌了. 沒關係. 我在這裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicIn_Close_2.cn: 你慌了. 没关系. 我在这儿.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicIn_Near_1.en: Breathe. In and out. Then drive.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicIn_Near_1.ch: 呼吸. 吸氣, 吐氣. 然後再開.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicIn_Near_1.cn: 呼吸. 吸气, 呼气. 然后再开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicIn_Near_2.en: You're shaking. I'll watch the road with you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicIn_Near_2.ch: 你在發抖. 我陪你一起看路.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicIn_Near_2.cn: 你在发抖. 我陪你一起盯着路.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicOut_Close_1.en: We're safe. Look at me. Breathe with me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicOut_Close_1.ch: 我們安全了. 看著我. 跟著我呼吸.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicOut_Close_1.cn: 我们安全了. 看着我. 跟着我呼吸.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicOut_Close_2.en: You're okay. I'm right here. Breathe.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicOut_Close_2.ch: 你沒事. 我就在這裡. 呼吸.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicOut_Close_2.cn: 你没事. 我就在这儿. 呼吸.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicOut_Near_1.en: We're stopped. Look at me. Breathe.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicOut_Near_1.ch: 車停了. 看著我. 呼吸.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicOut_Near_1.cn: 车停了. 看着我. 呼吸.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicOut_Near_2.ch: 沒事了. 我們下車了. 呼吸.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarPanicOut_Near_2.cn: 没事了. 我们下车了. 呼吸.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRain_Close_1.en: Rain. Drive like the road's made of soap.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRain_Close_1.ch: 下雨了. 開車時就當路面是肥皂做的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRain_Close_1.cn: 下雨了. 开车时就当路面是肥皂做的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRain_Close_2.en: Here it comes. Stay on the road for me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRain_Close_2.ch: 來了. 為了我, 別開出路面.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRain_Close_2.cn: 来了. 为了我, 别开出路面.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRain_Near_1.ch: 開始下雨了. 把雨刷打開.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRain_Near_1.cn: 开始下雨了. 把雨刷打开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRain_Near_2.en: Wet road. Easy on the turns.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRain_Near_2.ch: 路面溼滑. 轉彎慢一點.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRain_Near_2.cn: 路面湿滑. 转弯慢一点.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainHeavy_Close_1.en: We can't drive in this. Find a place to wait it out.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainHeavy_Close_1.ch: 這種天沒辦法開車. 找個地方等雨停.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainHeavy_Close_1.cn: 这种天没法开车. 找个地方等雨停.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainHeavy_Close_2.en: I can't see the road. Pull over.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainHeavy_Close_2.ch: 我看不到路了. 靠邊停.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainHeavy_Close_2.cn: 我看不见路了. 靠边停.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainHeavy_Near_1.en: Can't see a thing. Slow it down.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainHeavy_Near_1.ch: 什麼都看不到. 開慢點.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainHeavy_Near_1.cn: 什么都看不见. 开慢点.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainHeavy_Near_2.ch: 雨太大了. 油門放輕.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainHeavy_Near_2.cn: 雨太大了. 油门松一松.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainStop_Close_1.en: Rain's done. Road's still slick — careful.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainStop_Close_1.ch: 雨停了. 路面還很滑, 小心.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainStop_Close_1.cn: 雨停了. 路面还很滑, 小心.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainStop_Close_2.en: It's stopping. Don't trust the road yet.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainStop_Close_2.ch: 雨要停了. 先別太相信路面.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainStop_Close_2.cn: 雨要停了. 先别太相信路面.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainStop_Near_1.en: Rain's easing. Road'll still be slick.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainStop_Near_1.ch: 雨變小了. 路面還是會很滑.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainStop_Near_1.cn: 雨变小了. 路面还是会很滑.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainStop_Near_2.ch: 終於. 不過路還是溼的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRainStop_Near_2.cn: 终于. 不过路还是湿的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarReckless_Close_1.ch: 開慢點! 我是說真的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarReckless_Close_1.cn: 开慢点! 我是认真的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarReckless_Close_2.ch: 你嚇到我了. 別這樣.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarReckless_Close_2.cn: 你吓到我了. 别这样.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRoadkill_Close_1.en: Don't look at it. Look at the road.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRoadkill_Close_2.ch: 它本來就死了. 大概吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRoadkill_Close_2.cn: 它本来就死了. 差不多吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRoadkill_Close_3.ch: 是它總比是我們好. 繼續開.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarRoadkill_Close_3.cn: 是它总比是我们好. 继续开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadDrive_Close_1.en: Talk when you're ready. I'll listen. Not before.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadDrive_Close_1.ch: 等你想說了再說, 我會聽. 不想說就別勉強.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadDrive_Close_1.cn: 等你想说了再说, 我会听. 不想说就别勉强.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadDrive_Close_2.en: I know that look. I'm here. That's all.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadDrive_Close_2.ch: 我懂那個表情. 我在這裡. 就這樣.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadDrive_Close_2.cn: 我懂那种表情. 我在这儿. 就这样.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadDrive_Near_1.en: You don't have to talk. I'm right here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadDrive_Near_1.ch: 你不用說話. 我就在這裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadDrive_Near_1.cn: 你不用说话. 我就在这儿.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadDrive_Near_2.en: Whatever's in your head — it can wait.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadDrive_Near_2.ch: 不管你在想什麼, 都可以晚點再說.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadDrive_Near_2.cn: 不管你在想什么, 都可以先放一放.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadIn_Close_1.en: You've gone quiet on me. I'm here. Always.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadIn_Close_1.ch: 你都不跟我說話了. 我在這裡. 一直都在.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadIn_Close_1.cn: 你都不跟我说话了. 我在这儿. 一直都在.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadIn_Close_2.en: Whatever it is — I'm not going anywhere.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadIn_Close_2.ch: 不管是什麼事, 我都不會走.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadIn_Close_2.cn: 不管是什么事, 我都不会走.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadIn_Far_2.ch: 想說就說, 不說也行.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadIn_Far_2.cn: 想说就说, 不说也行.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadIn_Near_1.en: You've gone quiet. I'm here. Just drive.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadIn_Near_1.ch: 你變得好安靜. 我在. 專心開車就好.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadIn_Near_1.cn: 你变得好安静. 我在. 专心开车就好.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadIn_Near_2.en: You don't have to talk. I'm here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadIn_Near_2.ch: 不想說話也沒關係. 我在.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadIn_Near_2.cn: 不想说话也没关系. 我在.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadOut_Close_1.en: When you're ready, I'll listen. All night if you need.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadOut_Close_1.ch: 等你準備好, 我會聽. 要聽一整晚也行.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadOut_Close_1.cn: 等你准备好, 我会听. 要听一整晚也行.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadOut_Close_2.en: Come here. You don't have to carry it alone.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadOut_Close_2.ch: 過來. 你不必一個人扛.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadOut_Close_2.cn: 过来. 你不必一个人扛着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadOut_Near_1.en: Talk when you're ready. Not before.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadOut_Near_1.ch: 準備好再說. 不用勉強.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadOut_Near_1.cn: 准备好再说. 不用勉强.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadOut_Near_2.en: I'm here when you want to talk.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadOut_Near_2.ch: 你想聊的時候, 我都在.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSadOut_Near_2.cn: 你想聊的时候, 我都在.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickDrive_Close_1.en: You're getting worse. Pull over. Now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickDrive_Close_1.ch: 你越來越糟了. 靠邊停. 馬上.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickDrive_Close_1.cn: 你越来越糟了. 靠边停. 马上.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickDrive_Close_2.en: I'm not letting you drive sick. Stop when you can.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickDrive_Close_2.ch: 我不會讓你帶病開車. 能停就停.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickDrive_Close_2.cn: 我不会让你带病开车. 能停就停.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickDrive_Near_1.en: You're sick. Pull over if you need — I won't judge.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickDrive_Near_1.ch: 你生病了. 需要就靠邊停, 我不會笑你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickDrive_Near_1.cn: 你生病了. 需要就靠边停, 我不会笑你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickDrive_Near_2.en: Don't push it. We can stop.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickDrive_Near_2.ch: 別硬撐. 我們可以停下來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickDrive_Near_2.cn: 别硬撑. 我们可以停下来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickIn_Close_1.en: You're sick. Let's get you home and warm.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickIn_Close_1.ch: 你生病了. 我們回家, 讓你暖和起來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickIn_Close_1.cn: 你生病了. 我们回家, 让你暖和起来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickIn_Close_2.en: You're burning up. I'll drive us somewhere safe.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickIn_Close_2.ch: 你燒得好燙. 我開車帶我們去安全的地方.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickIn_Close_2.cn: 你烧得好烫. 我开车带我们去安全的地方.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickIn_Near_1.en: You're burning up. Let's get you somewhere to rest.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickIn_Near_1.ch: 你在發燒. 我們找個地方讓你休息.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickIn_Near_1.cn: 你在发烧. 我们找个地方让你休息.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickIn_Near_2.en: You look ill. Drive — I'll find us a place.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickIn_Near_2.ch: 你看起來不舒服. 開車吧, 我來找地方.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickIn_Near_2.cn: 你看起来不舒服. 开车吧, 我来找地方.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickOut_Close_1.en: Out. Lie down. I'll take care of everything.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickOut_Close_1.ch: 下車. 躺下. 一切交給我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickOut_Close_1.cn: 下车. 躺下. 一切交给我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickOut_Close_2.en: Come on. Bed. I'll bring you water.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickOut_Close_2.ch: 來吧. 上床. 我拿水給你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickOut_Close_2.cn: 来吧. 上床. 我给你拿水.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickOut_Near_1.ch: 躺下吧. 剩下的我來處理.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickOut_Near_1.cn: 躺下吧. 剩下的我来处理.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickOut_Near_2.en: Out. Rest. I'll take it from here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickOut_Near_2.ch: 下車. 休息. 接下來交給我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSickOut_Near_2.cn: 下车. 休息. 接下来交给我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Close_1.en: That smell — something died nearby. Drive.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Close_1.ch: 這味道, 附近有東西死了. 開車.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Close_1.cn: 这味道, 附近有东西死了. 开车.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Close_2.en: Roll the window down, I can't breathe.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Close_2.ch: 把車窗搖下來, 我快不能呼吸了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Close_2.cn: 把车窗摇下来, 我快喘不过气了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Close_3.en: I'd know that smell anywhere. Go.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Close_3.ch: 這味道我到哪都認得. 快走.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Close_3.cn: 这味道我到哪儿都认得. 快走.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Near_1.en: That's a corpse. Roll the window down.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Near_1.ch: 是屍體. 把車窗搖下來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Near_1.cn: 是尸体. 把车窗摇下来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Near_3.en: God. Get us out of this.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Near_3.ch: 天啊. 快帶我們離開這裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSmell_Near_3.cn: 天哪. 快带我们离开这里.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSnow_Close_1.en: First snow. Drive slow — I don't want to end up in a ditch.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSnow_Close_1.ch: 初雪. 開慢點, 我可不想翻進水溝裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSnow_Close_1.cn: 初雪. 开慢点, 我可不想栽进沟里.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSnow_Close_2.ch: 下雪了. 拜託, 油門、煞車、方向盤都輕一點.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSnow_Close_2.cn: 下雪了. 拜托, 油门、刹车、方向盘都轻一点.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSnow_Near_1.ch: 開始下雪了. 注意路面結冰.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarSnow_Near_1.cn: 开始下雪了. 注意路面结冰.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarStorm_Close_1.en: I hate this. Keep going and stay with me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarStorm_Close_1.ch: 我討厭這種天氣. 繼續開, 陪著我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarStorm_Close_1.cn: 我讨厌这种天气. 继续开, 陪着我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarStorm_Close_2.en: That one shook the car. Drive.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarStorm_Close_2.ch: 剛那聲雷把車都震了. 快開.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarStorm_Close_2.cn: 刚那声雷把车都震了. 快开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarStorm_Near_1.ch: 剛才那下好近. 繼續開.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarStorm_Near_1.cn: 刚才那下好近. 继续开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarStorm_Near_2.en: Storm's right over us. Not the tallest thing, but still.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarStorm_Near_2.ch: 暴風雨就在我們頭上. 我們不是最高的東西, 但還是要小心.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarStorm_Near_2.cn: 暴风雨就在我们头顶. 我们不是最高的东西, 但还是得小心.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyDrive_Clos.en: Please drink. You're no use to me passed out.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyDrive_Clos.ch: 拜託喝點水. 你昏倒了對我可沒用.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyDrive_Clos.cn: 拜托喝点水. 你晕倒了对我可没用.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyDrive_Clos.ch: 喝點東西. 我來看著.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyDrive_Clos.cn: 喝点东西. 我来盯着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyDrive_Near.en: Drink. Dehydration kills slower, but it kills.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyDrive_Near.ch: 喝水. 脫水死得比較慢, 但還是會死.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyDrive_Near.cn: 喝水. 脱水死得慢, 但还是会死.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyDrive_Near.en: There's water in the bag. Drink it.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyIn_Close_1.en: You're dehydrated. Drink — I'm not losing you to thirst.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyIn_Close_1.ch: 你脫水了. 喝水, 我可不想因為口渴失去你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyIn_Close_1.cn: 你脱水了. 喝水, 我可不想因为口渴失去你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyIn_Close_2.ch: 喝水. 現在就喝, 然後再走.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyIn_Close_2.cn: 喝水. 现在就喝, 然后再走.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyIn_Near_1.en: Your lips are cracked. There's water in the bag.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyIn_Near_1.ch: 你嘴唇都乾裂了. 包包裡有水.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyIn_Near_1.cn: 你嘴唇都干裂了. 包里有水.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyOut_Close_.ch: 坐下. 喝水. 然後我們再談.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyOut_Close_.cn: 坐下. 喝水. 然后我们再谈.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyOut_Close_.en: Water first. You're not moving until you do.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyOut_Close_.ch: 先喝水. 沒喝之前你哪都別去.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyOut_Close_.cn: 先喝水. 不喝你哪儿都别去.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyOut_Near_1.ch: 喝水. 現在就喝, 其他事都先放著.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyOut_Near_1.cn: 喝水. 现在就喝, 别的事先放着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyOut_Near_2.en: Drink something before you do anything else.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyOut_Near_2.ch: 做其他事之前先喝點東西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarThirstyOut_Near_2.cn: 做别的事之前先喝点东西.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredDrive_Close_.en: You're falling asleep at the wheel. Pull over.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredDrive_Close_.ch: 你開車開到快睡著了. 靠邊停.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredDrive_Close_.cn: 你开车开得快睡着了. 靠边停.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredDrive_Close_.en: That's enough. Find somewhere to stop — please.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredDrive_Close_.ch: 夠了. 找個地方停下來, 拜託.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredDrive_Close_.cn: 够了. 找个地方停下来, 求你了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredDrive_Near_1.ch: 你快不行了. 找機會靠邊停吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredDrive_Near_1.cn: 你快不行了. 找机会靠边停吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredDrive_Near_2.en: Eyes open. You're not good for much longer.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredDrive_Near_2.ch: 眼睛睜開. 你撐不了多久了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredDrive_Near_2.cn: 眼睛睁开. 你撑不了多久了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Close_1.en: You're exhausted. Sit — I'll keep an eye out.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Close_1.ch: 你累壞了. 坐著, 我幫你盯著外面.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Close_1.cn: 你累坏了. 坐着, 我帮你盯着外面.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Close_2.en: You look ready to drop. We'll stop soon, I promise.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Close_2.ch: 你看起來快倒下了. 我們很快就停, 我保證.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Close_2.cn: 你看起来快倒下了. 我们很快就停, 我保证.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Far_2.en: Get in. We'll find somewhere to stop.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Far_2.ch: 上車. 我們找個地方歇腳.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Far_2.cn: 上车. 我们找个地方歇脚.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Near_1.en: You're dead on your feet. Just drive, I'll watch.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Near_1.ch: 你累到站都站不穩了. 專心開車, 我來看著.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Near_1.cn: 你累得站都站不稳了. 专心开车, 我来盯着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Near_2.en: You need sleep. Let's not go far.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Near_2.ch: 你需要睡覺. 別開太遠.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredIn_Near_2.cn: 你需要睡觉. 别开太远.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredNight_Close_.en: You can't drive tired in the dark. Stop. Please.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredNight_Close_.ch: 天黑又累, 不能開車. 停下來. 拜託.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredNight_Close_.cn: 天黑又累, 不能开车. 停下来. 求你了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredNight_Close_.en: I can see you fading. It's dark. We stop here, together.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredNight_Close_.ch: 我看得出你快撐不住了. 天黑了. 我們一起在這裡停下.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredNight_Close_.cn: 我看得出你快撑不住了. 天黑了. 我们一起在这儿停下.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredNight_Far_2.ch: 你快撐不住了, 天也黑了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredNight_Far_2.cn: 你快撑不住了, 天也黑了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredNight_Near_1.en: You're fading and it's going dark. Pull over.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredNight_Near_1.ch: 你快不行了, 天也要黑了. 靠邊停吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredNight_Near_1.cn: 你快不行了, 天也要黑了. 靠边停吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredNight_Near_2.en: Dark and you're exhausted — we stop here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredNight_Near_2.ch: 天黑了, 你又累壞了, 我們就停在這裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredNight_Near_2.cn: 天黑了, 你又累坏了, 我们就停在这儿.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredOut_Close_1.en: Go sleep. I'll watch over you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredOut_Close_1.ch: 去睡吧. 我會守著你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredOut_Close_1.cn: 去睡吧. 我会守着你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredOut_Close_2.en: Lie down. I'll be right here when you wake up.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredOut_Close_2.ch: 躺下吧. 你醒來時我就在這裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredOut_Close_2.cn: 躺下吧. 你醒来时我就在这儿.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredOut_Near_1.en: Go sleep. I'll take first watch.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredOut_Near_1.ch: 去睡吧. 我守第一班.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarTiredOut_Near_1.cn: 去睡吧. 我守第一班.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWeatherIn_Close_1.en: In out of the weather. Where to?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWeatherIn_Close_1.ch: 總算躲開這種天氣了. 我們去哪?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWeatherIn_Close_1.cn: 总算躲开这种天气了. 我们去哪儿?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWeatherIn_Close_2.en: Get in, dry off. Then we'll figure out where to.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWeatherIn_Close_2.ch: 上車, 把身體擦乾. 然後再決定去哪.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWeatherIn_Close_2.cn: 上车, 把身子擦干. 然后再决定去哪儿.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWeatherIn_Far_1.en: In out of it. Where to?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWeatherIn_Near_1.en: In out of this. Where to?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWeatherIn_Near_1.ch: 終於躲開了. 要去哪?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWeatherIn_Near_1.cn: 终于躲开了. 要去哪儿?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWeatherIn_Near_2.en: Get in — we'll wait it out somewhere.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWeatherIn_Near_2.ch: 上車, 我們找個地方等它過去.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWeatherIn_Near_2.cn: 上车, 我们找个地方等它过去.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWindy_Close_1.en: The wind's shoving us. Keep it steady.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWindy_Close_1.ch: 風一直在推我們. 穩住.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWindy_Close_1.cn: 风一直在推我们. 稳住.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWindy_Near_1.en: Wind's pushing us around. Two hands.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWindy_Near_1.ch: 風吹得車子一直晃. 雙手握好.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWindy_Near_1.cn: 风吹得车子一直晃. 双手握好.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWindy_Near_2.ch: 風好大. 握緊方向盤.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCarWindy_Near_2.cn: 风好大. 握紧方向盘.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzard_Close_1.en: We're not dying in the snow. With me, now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzard_Close_1.ch: 我們不會死在雪裡. 跟我走, 快.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzard_Close_1.cn: 我们不会死在雪里. 跟我走, 快.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzard_Close_2.en: Hold my hand. Shelter or we freeze.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzard_Close_2.ch: 握住我的手. 不找地方躲就會凍死.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzard_Close_2.cn: 握住我的手. 不找地方躲就会冻死.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzard_Far_1.ch: 暴風雪. 快找地方躲.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzard_Far_1.cn: 暴风雪. 快找地方躲.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzard_Near_1.en: Blizzard! We need a building, now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzard_Near_1.ch: 暴風雪! 我們得馬上進屋.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzard_Near_1.cn: 暴风雪! 我们得马上进屋.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzardInside_Close.en: We wait it out. Together. It'll pass.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzardInside_Close.ch: 我們等它過去. 一起等. 會過去的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzardInside_Close.cn: 我们等它过去. 一起等. 会过去的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzardInside_Close.en: No fire's worth that. We stay.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzardInside_Close.ch: 為了柴火出去不值得. 我們待在這.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzardInside_Close.cn: 为了柴火出去不值得. 我们待在这儿.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzardInside_Near_.en: We're not going out in that. No.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzardInside_Near_.ch: 這種天我們不出去. 不行.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvBlizzardInside_Near_.cn: 这种天我们不出去. 不行.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvChopping_Near_2.en: Slow work. Give me a minute.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvChopping_Near_2.ch: 這活很慢. 給我一點時間.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvChopping_Near_2.cn: 这活儿慢. 给我一点时间.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvChopping_Near_3.en: My arms are going to feel this tomorrow.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvChopping_Near_4.en: One more, then I'll take a breather.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvChopping_Near_4.ch: 再砍一棵, 我就歇一下.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvChopping_Near_4.cn: 再砍一棵, 我就歇口气.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCleaning_Near_1.en: Just a bit of elbow grease.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCleaning_Near_2.en: Getting the worst of it out.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCleaning_Near_3.en: This place could use a good scrub.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCleaning_Near_4.ch: 血真的會噴得到處都是, 對吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCleaning_Near_4.cn: 血真是弄得到处都是, 是吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearingAsh_Near_3.en: Burnt to the floor. Give me a moment.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearingAsh_Near_3.ch: 燒得只剩地板了. 給我一點時間.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearingAsh_Near_3.cn: 烧得只剩地板了. 给我一会儿.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCutVines_Near_1.ch: 這些藤蔓不該長在這裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCutVines_Near_1.cn: 这些藤蔓不该长在这里.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCutVines_Near_3.en: Vines up the walls. Not for long.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCutVines_Near_3.ch: 藤蔓爬滿了牆. 馬上就沒了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCutVines_Near_3.cn: 藤蔓爬满了墙. 马上就没了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCutVines_Near_4.en: A few cuts and this wall's clear.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCutVines_Near_4.ch: 再割幾刀, 這面牆就乾淨了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCutVines_Near_4.cn: 再割几刀, 这面墙就干净了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCutVines_Near_5.en: Nature's creeping back in. I'll cut it back.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCutVines_Near_5.ch: 大自然又慢慢爬回來了. 我把它割掉.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvCutVines_Near_5.cn: 大自然又悄悄爬回来了. 我把它割掉.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOut_Close_1.en: I can't see you. Hold onto me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOut_Close_1.ch: 我看不到你. 抓著我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOut_Close_1.cn: 我看不见你. 抓着我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOut_Close_2.en: Dark. Anything could be right there.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOut_Close_2.ch: 好暗. 什麼東西都可能就在那裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOut_Close_2.cn: 好黑. 那儿可能藏着任何东西.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOut_Near_1.en: It's black out here. Watch your step.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOut_Near_1.ch: 外面一片漆黑. 注意腳下.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOut_Near_1.cn: 外面一片漆黑. 注意脚下.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOut_Near_2.ch: 看不到. 待在我附近.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOut_Near_2.cn: 看不见. 待在我附近.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Close_1.en: It's dark. Stay close - I'll light the way.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Close_1.ch: 好暗. 待在我身邊, 我來照路.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Close_1.cn: 好黑. 待在我身边, 我来照路.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Close_2.en: Dark. Don't worry, I've got my flashlight.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Close_2.ch: 好暗. 別擔心, 我有手電筒.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Close_2.cn: 好黑. 别担心, 我有手电筒.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Far_1.en: Dark out. I've got my flashlight.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Far_1.ch: 外面很暗. 我有手電筒.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Far_1.cn: 外面很黑. 我有手电筒.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Far_2.en: Getting dark - I have a light.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Near_1.en: Black out here, but my flashlight's ready.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Near_1.ch: 外面一片漆黑, 不過我的手電筒準備好了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Near_1.cn: 外面一片漆黑, 不过我的手电筒准备好了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Near_2.en: Can't see. Good thing I've got a torch.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Near_2.ch: 看不到. 還好我有手電筒.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkOutTorch_Near_2.cn: 看不见. 还好我带了手电筒.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoom_Close_1.en: It's dark. Stay close. I've got you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoom_Close_1.ch: 好暗. 待在我身邊. 有我在.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoom_Close_1.cn: 好黑. 待在我身边. 有我在.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoom_Near_1.en: Can't see a thing in here. Light?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoom_Near_1.ch: 這裡什麼都看不到. 有燈嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoom_Near_1.cn: 这里什么都看不见. 有灯吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Close_.en: Dark room. Stay behind me - I'll light it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Close_.ch: 房間好暗. 待在我後面, 我來照亮.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Close_.cn: 屋里好黑. 待在我后面, 我来照亮.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Close_.en: Pitch black, but I've got my flashlight.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Close_.ch: 伸手不見五指, 不過我有手電筒.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Close_.cn: 伸手不见五指, 不过我有手电筒.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Far_1.en: Dark in here. I've got a flashlight.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Far_1.ch: 這裡很暗. 我有手電筒.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Far_1.cn: 这里很黑. 我有手电筒.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Far_2.en: No light in here - good thing I have one.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Far_2.ch: 這裡沒燈, 還好我自己有.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Far_2.cn: 这里没灯, 还好我自己带了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Near_1.en: Can't see a thing in here. My torch is ready.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Near_1.ch: 這裡什麼都看不到. 我的手電筒準備好了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Near_1.cn: 这里什么都看不见. 我的手电筒准备好了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Near_2.en: It's black in here, but I've got a light.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Near_2.ch: 這裡一片漆黑, 不過我有燈.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDarkRoomTorch_Near_2.cn: 这里一片漆黑, 不过我有灯.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDawn_Close_1.en: We made it. Together. Like always.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDawn_Close_1.ch: 我們撐過來了. 一起. 就像往常一樣.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDawn_Close_1.cn: 我们挺过来了. 一起. 和往常一样.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDawn_Close_2.ch: 天亮了. 再迎接新的一天吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDawn_Close_2.cn: 天亮了. 再去迎接新的一天吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDawn_Near_2.ch: 太陽出來了. 我們沒事.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvDawn_Near_2.cn: 太阳出来了. 我们没事.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvFog_Close_1.en: Don't wander in this. Hold onto me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvFog_Close_1.ch: 這種天別亂走. 抓著我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvFog_Close_1.cn: 这种天别乱走. 抓着我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvFog_Close_2.en: Fog's bad. I've got you. Keep close.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvFog_Close_2.ch: 霧很濃. 有我在. 靠近一點.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvFog_Close_2.cn: 雾很大. 有我在. 靠近点.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGlassGround_Near_1.ch: 小心, 有玻璃. 我來撿.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGlassGround_Near_1.cn: 小心, 有玻璃. 我来捡.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGlassGround_Near_2.en: Don't want to step on this barefoot.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGlassWindow_Near_1.en: Clearing the glass out of this window.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGlassWindow_Near_1.ch: 我在清這扇窗上的玻璃.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGlassWindow_Near_1.cn: 我在清这扇窗上的玻璃.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGlassWindow_Near_3.en: Pulling the shards out of the frame.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGlassWindow_Near_3.cn: 把碎片从窗框里拔出来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGraffiti_Near_1.en: Somebody had a lot to say. Not anymore.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGraffiti_Near_1.ch: 有人想說的可真多. 現在沒了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGraffiti_Near_1.cn: 有人想说的可真多. 现在没了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGraffiti_Near_2.en: Petrol and a good scrub. That'll do it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGraffiti_Near_2.ch: 汽油加上用力刷. 這樣就行了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGraffiti_Near_2.cn: 汽油加上使劲刷. 这样就行了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGraffiti_Near_3.en: Just a message. No one left to read it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGraffiti_Near_3.ch: 只是一段留言. 已經沒人會看了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvGraffiti_Near_3.cn: 只是一段留言. 已经没人会看了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightOn_Close_1.en: There you are. Stay in the light with me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightOn_Close_1.ch: 看到你了. 跟我待在亮處.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightOn_Close_1.cn: 看到你了. 跟我待在亮处.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightOn_Close_2.en: Light. I can see you again.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightOn_Close_2.ch: 有光了. 我又看得到你了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightOn_Close_2.cn: 有光了. 我又看得见你了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightOn_Near_1.ch: 好了. 有光了. 好多了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightOn_Near_1.cn: 好了. 有光了. 好多了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightOn_Near_2.ch: 很好. 現在看得到了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightOn_Near_2.cn: 很好. 现在看得见了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightning_Close_2.ch: 閃電. 到我後面. 快.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightning_Close_2.cn: 闪电. 到我后面. 快.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightning_Near_2.en: Did you see that? Inside, now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightning_Near_2.ch: 你看到了嗎? 馬上進去.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvLightning_Near_2.cn: 你看到了吗? 马上进去.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightIn_Close_1.en: Dark's got teeth in here. Stay close to me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightIn_Close_1.ch: 這裡的黑暗會咬人. 待在我身邊.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightIn_Close_1.cn: 这里的黑暗会咬人. 待在我身边.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightIn_Close_2.en: No light. We do nothing in the dark.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightIn_Close_2.ch: 沒有光. 黑漆漆的什麼都別做.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightIn_Close_2.cn: 没有光. 黑灯瞎火的什么都别干.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightIn_Near_1.en: We need a light in here. Can't do anything.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightIn_Near_1.ch: 這裡需要燈. 什麼都做不了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightIn_Near_1.cn: 这里得有灯. 什么都干不了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightIn_Near_2.ch: 好暗. 拿蠟燭或手電筒來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightIn_Near_2.cn: 好黑. 拿蜡烛或手电筒来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightOut_Close_1.en: Hand me a light. I don't like this dark.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightOut_Close_1.ch: 給我一盞燈. 我不喜歡這麼暗.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightOut_Close_1.cn: 给我个灯. 我不喜欢这么黑.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightOut_Close_2.en: No light. Stay behind me and don't move.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightOut_Close_2.ch: 沒有光. 待在我後面, 別動.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightOut_Close_2.cn: 没有光. 待在我后面, 别动.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightOut_Near_1.en: Got a flashlight? I can't see.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightOut_Near_1.ch: 有手電筒嗎? 我看不到.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNeedLightOut_Near_1.cn: 有手电筒吗? 我看不见.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNightFalls_Close_1.en: Dark soon. Stay close to me tonight.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNightFalls_Close_1.ch: 快天黑了. 今晚待在我身邊.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNightFalls_Close_1.cn: 天快黑了. 今晚待在我身边.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNightFalls_Close_2.en: Another night. I'm glad I'm not alone.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNightFalls_Close_2.ch: 又一個夜晚. 還好我不是一個人.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNightFalls_Close_2.cn: 又一个晚上. 还好我不是一个人.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNightFalls_Near_1.en: Sun's down. We need a door that locks.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNightFalls_Near_1.ch: 太陽下山了. 我們需要能鎖的門.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNightFalls_Near_1.cn: 太阳下山了. 我们得找扇能锁的门.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNightFalls_Near_2.ch: 夜晚要來了. 找個地方躲吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNightFalls_Near_2.cn: 天要黑了. 找个地方落脚吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNoPowerIn_Close_1.en: No power. Just us and the dark.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNoPowerIn_Close_1.ch: 沒電了. 只剩我們和黑暗.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNoPowerIn_Close_1.cn: 没电了. 只剩我们和黑暗.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNoPowerIn_Close_2.en: Power's gone. Hand me the light. We're okay.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNoPowerIn_Close_2.ch: 停電了. 把燈給我. 我們沒事.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNoPowerIn_Close_2.cn: 停电了. 把灯给我. 我们没事.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNoPowerIn_Near_2.ch: 沒電了. 只能靠蠟燭.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvNoPowerIn_Near_2.cn: 没电了. 只能靠蜡烛.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainHeavy_Close_1.en: We can't walk in this. Come on.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainHeavy_Close_1.ch: 這雨沒法走路. 跟我來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainHeavy_Close_1.cn: 这雨没法走路. 跟我来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainHeavy_Close_2.en: I can't see through it. Hold onto me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainHeavy_Close_2.ch: 雨大到我看不清. 抓著我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainHeavy_Close_2.cn: 雨大得我看不清. 抓着我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainHeavy_Near_1.en: It's pouring. We need a roof.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainHeavy_Near_1.ch: 下大雨了. 得找個屋頂躲.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainHeavy_Near_1.cn: 下大雨了. 得找个屋顶躲.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainInside_Close_1.en: Rain on the roof. I used to love that sound.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainInside_Close_1.ch: 雨打在屋頂上. 我以前很喜歡這個聲音.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainInside_Close_1.cn: 雨打在屋顶上. 我以前很喜欢这个声音.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainInside_Close_2.en: Stay in. Let it pass. We're dry.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainInside_Close_2.ch: 待在裡面. 等雨過去. 我們身上是乾的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainInside_Close_2.cn: 待在里面. 等雨过去. 我们身上是干的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainInside_Near_1.en: Listen to that. Glad we're in here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainInside_Near_1.ch: 聽聽那雨聲. 還好我們在裡面.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainInside_Near_1.cn: 听听这雨声. 还好我们在屋里.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainInside_Near_2.ch: 來得正好. 外面在下大雨.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainInside_Near_2.cn: 来得正是时候. 外面下大雨了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainStart_Close_1.ch: 下雨了. 待在我身邊.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainStart_Close_1.cn: 下雨了. 待在我身边.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainStart_Close_2.ch: 開始滴雨了. 有我在.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainStart_Close_2.cn: 开始掉雨点了. 有我在.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainStart_Near_1.ch: 開始下雨了. 把兜帽戴上.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainStart_Near_1.cn: 开始下雨了. 把兜帽戴上.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainStop_Close_1.ch: 雨停了. 你都溼透了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainStop_Close_1.cn: 雨停了. 你都湿透了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainStop_Close_2.en: It's over. Let's get you dry.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainStop_Close_2.ch: 停了. 我幫你弄乾吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvRainStop_Close_2.cn: 停了. 我帮你弄干吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSkillUp_Close_2.en: We're finding a rhythm. I like it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSkillUp_Close_2.ch: 我們找到節奏了. 我喜歡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSkillUp_Close_2.cn: 我们找到节奏了. 我喜欢.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSkillUp_Far_2.en: This is starting to feel natural.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSkillUp_Near_1.en: I'm getting the hang of it now.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSnowStart_Close_1.ch: 第一場雪. 幾乎算得上漂亮.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSnowStart_Close_1.cn: 第一场雪. 几乎称得上好看.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSnowStart_Close_2.en: Snow. Stay warm. Stay with me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSnowStart_Close_2.ch: 下雪了. 注意保暖. 待在我身邊.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSnowStart_Close_2.cn: 下雪了. 注意保暖. 待在我身边.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSnowStart_Near_1.ch: 開始下雪了. 是真正的雪.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSnowStart_Near_1.cn: 开始下雪了. 是真正的雪.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStorm_Close_1.en: That's thunder. I hate it. Stay with me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStorm_Close_1.ch: 是打雷. 我討厭打雷. 陪著我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStorm_Close_1.cn: 是打雷. 我讨厌打雷. 陪着我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStorm_Close_2.en: Storm's here. Don't let go of me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStorm_Close_2.ch: 暴風雨來了. 別放開我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStorm_Close_2.cn: 暴风雨来了. 别松开我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStorm_Far_1.en: Thunder. Let's not be out here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStorm_Far_1.ch: 打雷了. 別待在外面.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStorm_Far_1.cn: 打雷了. 别待在外面.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStorm_Near_1.en: Storm! Not the tallest thing out here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStorm_Near_1.ch: 暴風雨! 別當這裡最高的東西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStorm_Near_1.cn: 暴风雨! 别当这儿最高的东西.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStorm_Near_2.ch: 打雷了. 壓低身子, 快進屋.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStorm_Near_2.cn: 打雷了. 压低身子, 快进屋.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStormInside_Close_1.en: That one was close. You're shaking.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStormInside_Close_1.ch: 剛那下好近. 你在發抖.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStormInside_Close_1.cn: 刚那下好近. 你在发抖.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStormInside_Close_2.en: Come here. Storms pass. We're fine.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStormInside_Close_2.ch: 過來. 暴風雨會過去的. 我們沒事.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStormInside_Close_2.cn: 过来. 暴风雨会过去的. 我们没事.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStormInside_Near_1.en: Listen to that. We're lucky to be in.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStormInside_Near_1.ch: 聽聽那聲音. 幸好我們在屋裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvStormInside_Near_1.cn: 听听那动静. 幸亏我们在屋里.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Close_1.en: There goes my light. I'll swap the battery when I can.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Close_1.ch: 我的燈沒了. 等有機會我再換電池.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Close_1.cn: 我的灯灭了. 等有机会我再换电池.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Close_2.en: Dead. I'll change it once it's quiet.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Close_2.ch: 沒電了. 等安靜下來我再換.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Close_2.cn: 没电了. 等安静下来我再换.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Near_1.en: My light died. Got a spare battery?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Near_1.ch: 我的燈沒電了. 有備用電池嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Near_1.cn: 我的灯没电了. 有备用电池吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Near_2.en: Flashlight's dead. I'll need a battery.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Near_2.ch: 手電筒沒電了. 我需要電池.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Near_2.cn: 手电筒没电了. 我得要节电池.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Close_1.en: My flashlight's getting weak. Just so you know.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Close_1.ch: 我的手電筒越來越暗了. 跟你說一聲.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Close_1.cn: 我的手电筒越来越暗了. 跟你说一声.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Close_2.en: I've been burning through this battery. A fresh one soon would help.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Close_2.ch: 這顆電池快被我用光了. 最好快點換顆新的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Close_2.cn: 这节电池快被我用光了. 最好尽快换节新的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Near_1.en: This cell's nearly done. I'll need a fresh one soon.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Near_1.ch: 這顆電池快用完了. 我很快就需要新的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Near_1.cn: 这节电池快用完了. 我很快就得要节新的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Near_2.en: Light's fading - got a spare battery?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Near_2.ch: 燈越來越暗了, 有備用電池嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Near_2.cn: 灯越来越暗了, 有备用电池吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchReload_Close_2.ch: 裝好了. 跟新的一樣.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchReload_Close_2.cn: 装好了. 跟新的一样.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchReload_Far_1.en: Found a cell. Fitting it now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchReload_Far_1.ch: 找到一顆電池. 我現在裝上.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchReload_Far_1.cn: 找到一节电池. 我现在装上.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchReload_Near_2.ch: 好了, 新電池裝上了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchReload_Near_2.cn: 好了, 新电池装上了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvWindy_Close_1.en: Wind's tearing at everything. Stay close.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvWindy_Close_1.ch: 風大到什麼都快被扯走了. 待在我身邊.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvWindy_Close_1.cn: 风大得什么都要被扯走了. 待在我身边.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvWindy_Close_2.en: Hold on to me in this wind.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvWindy_Near_1.en: Wind's picking up. Hold your hat.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvWindy_Near_1.ch: 風越來越大了. 抓好你的帽子.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvWindy_Near_1.cn: 风越来越大了. 按住你的帽子.

IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_WashDoneSelf_Close_2.ch: 好了. 又能見人了嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_WashDoneSelf_Close_2.cn: 好了. 又能见人了吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAgain_Close_1.en: Another one? I have a few already.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAgain_Close_1.ch: 又一個? 我已經有好幾個了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAgain_Close_1.cn: 又一个? 我已经有好几个了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAgain_Close_2.en: You gave me one of these before. I kept it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAgain_Close_2.ch: 你以前送過我一個. 我一直留著.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAgain_Close_2.cn: 你以前送过我一个. 我一直留着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAgain_Close_3.en: I know this one. I remember.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAgain_Close_3.ch: 我認得這個. 我都記得.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAgain_Close_3.cn: 我认得这个. 我都记得.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAgain_Near_1.en: Another one? I've got some already.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAgain_Near_1.ch: 又一個? 我已經有一些了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAgain_Near_1.cn: 又一个? 我已经有一些了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Close_1.en: You keep the bullets. I'll keep you alive other ways.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Close_1.ch: 子彈你留著. 我會用別的辦法讓你活下去.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Close_1.cn: 子弹你留着. 我会用别的办法让你活下去.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Close_2.en: Ammo's yours. I'm better up close.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Close_2.ch: 彈藥歸你. 我比較擅長近身打.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Close_2.cn: 弹药归你. 我更擅长近身打.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Close_3.en: Save it for when it counts. I'll cover you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Close_3.ch: 留到關鍵時刻再用. 我掩護你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Close_3.cn: 留到关键时刻再用. 我掩护你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Far_2.ch: 你留著. 我不會開槍.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Far_2.cn: 你留着. 我不会开枪.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Near_1.en: Bullets. For you, then — I can't aim.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Near_1.ch: 子彈. 那就給你吧, 我瞄不準.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Near_1.cn: 子弹. 那就给你吧, 我瞄不准.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Near_2.ch: 你留著吧. 給我只會浪費.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Near_2.cn: 你留着吧. 给我只会浪费.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Near_3.en: You carry the guns. I'll carry the rest.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Near_3.ch: 槍你來拿. 其他的我來扛.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAmmo_Near_3.cn: 枪你来拿. 其他的我来扛.

IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBooze_Close_1.en: We'll drink to the ones who didn't make it.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBooze_Close_1.ch: 我們為那些沒能撐過來的人喝一杯.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBooze_Close_1.cn: 我们为那些没能撑过来的人喝一杯.

IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBooze_Close_3.en: One drink. You and me. Tonight.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBooze_Close_3.ch: 喝一杯. 就你跟我. 今晚.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBooze_Close_3.cn: 喝一杯. 就你和我. 今晚.

IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBooze_Near_2.en: Good stuff. Where'd you find it?
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBooze_Near_2.ch: 好東西. 你在哪找到的?
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBooze_Near_2.cn: 好东西. 你在哪儿找到的?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBooze_Close_1.ch: 我們為活下來乾一杯. 晚點再喝.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBooze_Close_1.cn: 我们为活下来干一杯. 晚点再喝.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBooze_Close_2.en: Not now — but I'm glad you thought of it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBooze_Close_2.ch: 現在不行, 但我很高興你想到了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBooze_Close_2.cn: 现在不行, 不过我很高兴你想到了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBooze_Close_3.en: Save it. We'll need a good night.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBooze_Close_3.ch: 先留著. 總會有個需要好好喝一場的晚上.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBooze_Close_3.cn: 先留着. 总会有个需要好好喝一场的晚上.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBooze_Near_1.ch: 酒? 正好需要. 晚點再說.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBooze_Near_1.cn: 酒? 正好需要. 晚点再说.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBooze_Near_2.en: Save it for a bad night.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCanned_Close_2.cn: 这个放得久. 谢谢你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCanned_Close_3.en: We'll open it on a bad day.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCanned_Near_1.ch: 罐頭啊. 聰明, 放不壞.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCanned_Near_1.cn: 罐头啊. 聪明, 放不坏.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Clo.en: A mop. Either you want the place clean, or you want me to hit something.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Clo.ch: 拖把. 你要嘛是想把這裡打掃乾淨, 要嘛是想要我拿它打東西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Clo.cn: 拖把. 你要么是想把这里打扫干净, 要么是想让我拿它打东西.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Clo.en: I'll sweep with it first. No promises after that.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Clo.ch: 我會先拿它掃地. 之後就不保證了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Clo.cn: 我会先拿它扫地. 之后就不敢保证了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Clo.en: Floors tidy, skulls dented. I can manage both.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Clo.ch: 地板掃乾淨, 腦袋敲凹. 兩樣我都行.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Clo.cn: 地板扫干净, 脑壳敲瘪. 两样我都行.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Far.en: A mop. Or a club. Depends on the day.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Far.ch: 拖把. 或是棍子. 看當天情況.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Far.cn: 拖把. 或者棍子. 看当天情况.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Far.en: Cleaning or fighting — it does both.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Far.ch: 打掃或打架, 它都行.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Far.cn: 打扫还是打架, 它都行.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Nea.en: A broom? For the floors, or for the dead?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Nea.ch: 掃把? 用來掃地, 還是對付死人?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Nea.cn: 扫帚? 用来扫地, 还是对付死人?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Nea.en: You gave me a mop. I'll decide what it's for.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Nea.ch: 你給了我拖把. 拿來幹嘛我自己決定.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleanWeapon_Nea.cn: 你给了我拖把. 拿来干嘛我自己决定.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Close_1.en: Bleach. You want the blood gone. Fair enough.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Close_1.ch: 漂白水. 你想把血跡清掉. 有道理.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Close_1.cn: 漂白剂. 你想把血迹清掉. 有道理.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Close_2.en: I'll clean it up. Don't ask about the smell.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Close_2.ch: 我會清乾淨. 味道就別問了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Close_2.cn: 我会清干净. 味道就别问了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Close_3.en: For us. I'll make this place fit to live in.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Close_3.ch: 為了我們. 我會把這裡弄得能住人.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Close_3.cn: 为了我们. 我会把这里弄得能住人.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Far_1.ch: 漂白水. 這東西很嗆.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Far_1.cn: 漂白剂. 这东西很冲.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Near_1.ch: 漂白水? 看來有東西要刷了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Near_1.cn: 漂白剂? 看来有东西要刷了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Near_2.en: Good. The floors were getting grim.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Near_2.ch: 很好. 地板都快不能看了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaner_Near_2.cn: 很好. 地板都快没法看了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaning_Close_.ch: 現在連抹布都送了. 真居家.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaning_Close_.cn: 现在连抹布都送了. 挺居家的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaning_Close_.en: I'll scrub the blood out. Yours or theirs.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaning_Close_.ch: 我會把血刷掉. 不管是你的還是它們的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaning_Close_.cn: 我会把血刷掉. 不管是你的还是它们的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaning_Close_.en: Someone has to keep this place livable. I'll do it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaning_Close_.ch: 總得有人讓這裡住得下去. 我來吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaning_Close_.cn: 总得有人让这里住得下去. 我来吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaning_Far_2.ch: 那就拿來收拾. 好啊.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaning_Far_2.cn: 那就拿来收拾. 行啊.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaning_Far_3.en: I'll find a use for it.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaning_Near_1.en: A sponge? So I'm scrubbing, am I?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaning_Near_1.ch: 海綿? 所以要我來刷是吧?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCleaning_Near_1.cn: 海绵? 所以要我来刷是吧?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCloth_Close_1.en: For me? You didn't have to.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCloth_Close_1.ch: 給我的? 你不用這樣的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCloth_Close_1.cn: 给我的? 你不用这样的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCloth_Close_3.en: You think of me. I noticed.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCloth_Close_3.ch: 你會想著我. 我都有注意到.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCloth_Close_3.cn: 你总想着我. 我都注意到了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCloth_Near_3.en: I'll find a use for it.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFood_Close_1.en: You're feeding me again. Thank you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFood_Close_1.ch: 你又在餵我了. 謝謝你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFood_Close_1.cn: 你又在喂我了. 谢谢你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Close_1.en: Petrol. For the car — or for a fire we'd rather not start.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Close_1.ch: 汽油. 給車用的, 或是用來點一把我們最好別點的火.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Close_1.cn: 汽油. 给车用的, 或者用来放一把我们最好别放的火.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Close_2.en: I'll keep it sealed. One spark and it's over.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Close_2.ch: 我會把它封好. 一點火星就完了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Close_2.cn: 我会把它封好. 一点火星就全完了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Close_3.en: Useful and terrifying. My favorite combination.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Close_3.ch: 有用又嚇人. 我最愛的組合.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Close_3.cn: 有用又吓人. 我最爱的组合.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Far_2.en: Fuel. For the car, or for fire.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Far_2.ch: 燃料. 給車用, 或是生火.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Far_2.cn: 燃料. 给车用, 或者点火.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Far_3.ch: 又重又易燃. 知道了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Far_3.cn: 又重又易燃. 知道了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Near_1.ch: 汽油? 你在打什麼主意.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Near_1.cn: 汽油? 你在打什么主意.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Near_2.en: Fuel. Keep it away from the stove.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Near_2.ch: 燃料. 離爐子遠一點.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Near_2.cn: 燃料. 离炉子远一点.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Near_3.en: Useful — if we don't burn first.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Near_3.ch: 有用, 前提是我們沒先被燒死.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFuel_Near_3.cn: 有用, 前提是我们没先被烧死.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Close_1.en: You'll lose. Just so you know.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Close_1.ch: 你會輸的. 先跟你說一聲.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Close_1.cn: 你会输的. 先跟你说一声.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Close_2.ch: 出事之後就沒玩過了. 來玩吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Close_2.cn: 出事以后就再没玩过了. 来玩吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Close_3.en: A quiet evening with you. I'd like that.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Close_3.ch: 跟你一起度過安靜的晚上. 我很樂意.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Close_3.cn: 和你一起过个安静的晚上. 我很乐意.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Far_3.en: Haven't seen one of these in a while.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Far_3.ch: 好久沒看到這種東西了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Far_3.cn: 好久没见过这玩意儿了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Near_2.en: I used to be good at this.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Near_3.ch: 總算有點正常的東西. 謝了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Near_3.cn: 总算有点正常的东西. 谢了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Close_1.en: I don't know how to use this yet. Teach me sometime?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Close_1.ch: 我還不會用這個. 改天教我?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Close_1.cn: 我还不会用这个. 改天教教我?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Close_2.en: A gun? I'd panic. Keep it on you for now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Close_2.ch: 槍? 我會慌掉的. 先放你身上吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Close_2.cn: 枪? 我会慌的. 先放你身上吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Close_3.en: Not yet. I'd rather you do the shooting.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Close_3.ch: 現在還不行. 開槍的事還是交給你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Close_3.cn: 现在还不行. 开枪的事还是交给你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Far_1.en: A gun? No. I don't know how.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Far_1.ch: 槍? 不要. 我不會用.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Far_1.cn: 枪? 不要. 我不会用.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Far_2.en: I can't use this. Not yet.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Far_2.ch: 這個我不會用. 還不會.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Far_2.cn: 这个我不会用. 暂时还不会.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Far_3.en: Keep it. I'd only hurt myself.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Far_3.ch: 你留著. 我只會傷到自己.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Far_3.cn: 你留着. 我只会伤到自己.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Near_1.en: I don't know how to use a gun. Not yet.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Near_1.ch: 我不會用槍. 至少現在還不會.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Near_1.cn: 我不会用枪. 至少现在还不会.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Near_2.en: A gun? I'd have no idea what to do.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Near_2.ch: 槍? 我拿了也不知道怎麼辦.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Near_2.cn: 枪? 我拿了也不知道怎么办.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Near_3.en: Take it back. I don't know how.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Near_3.ch: 拿回去吧. 我不會用.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGun_Near_3.cn: 拿回去吧. 我不会用.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHeavy_Close_1.en: Heavy. I'll manage — but don't make a habit of it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHeavy_Close_1.ch: 好重. 我撐得住, 但別養成習慣.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHeavy_Close_1.cn: 好重. 我扛得住, 但别养成习惯.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHeavy_Close_2.en: This thing weighs more than I do.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHeavy_Close_3.en: Give it here. I'll carry it, but you owe me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHeavy_Close_3.ch: 拿來吧. 我幫你扛, 但你欠我一次.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHeavy_Close_3.cn: 拿来吧. 我帮你扛, 但你欠我一次.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveJunk_Close_1.ch: 這是什麼? 你認真的?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveJunk_Close_1.cn: 这是什么? 你认真的?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveJunk_Close_2.en: Money. Look at it. Doesn't feed us.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveJunk_Close_2.ch: 錢. 你看看它. 又不能當飯吃.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveJunk_Close_2.cn: 钱. 你看看. 又不能当饭吃.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveJunk_Close_3.en: Pretty. I'd rather have a can of beans.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveJunk_Close_3.ch: 很漂亮. 但我寧可要一罐豆子.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveJunk_Close_3.cn: 挺漂亮. 但我宁可要一罐豆子.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveJunk_Far_1.en: What am I supposed to do with this?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveJunk_Near_3.ch: 很漂亮. 但現在一文不值.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveJunk_Near_3.cn: 挺漂亮. 可现在一文不值.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMeds_Close_1.en: Medicine. You're taking care of us.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMeds_Close_2.en: Bandages, pills — you think of everything.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMeds_Close_2.ch: 繃帶、藥丸, 你什麼都想到了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMeds_Close_2.cn: 绷带、药片, 你什么都想到了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMeds_Close_3.en: Thank you. This could save one of us.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMeds_Close_3.ch: 謝謝你. 這說不定能救我們其中一個人一命.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMeds_Close_3.cn: 谢谢你. 这说不定能救我们其中一个人的命.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMeds_Near_1.ch: 藥, 放在隨手拿得到的地方.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMeds_Near_1.cn: 药, 放在随手拿得到的地方.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRaw_Close_1.en: Raw. I'm not letting you eat it like that.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRaw_Close_1.ch: 生的. 我不會讓你就這樣吃下去.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRaw_Close_1.cn: 生的. 我不会让你就这么吃下去.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRaw_Close_2.en: Cook it. Please. I've seen what that does.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRaw_Close_2.ch: 煮熟. 拜託. 我看過吃生的會怎樣.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRaw_Close_2.cn: 煮熟. 求你了. 我见过吃生的会怎样.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRaw_Close_3.ch: 先生火. 然後我們一起吃.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRaw_Close_3.cn: 先生火. 然后我们一起吃.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRaw_Near_2.en: You'll get sick eating that as it is.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRead_Close_1.en: I'll read it to you, if you want.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRead_Close_1.ch: 你想的話, 我唸給你聽.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRead_Close_1.cn: 你想的话, 我念给你听.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRead_Close_3.en: Something to think about besides all this.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRead_Close_3.ch: 總算有這些以外的事可以想了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRead_Close_3.cn: 总算有这些以外的事可以想了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRead_Near_1.ch: 我好幾個星期沒讀東西了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRead_Near_1.cn: 我好几个星期没读过东西了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Close_1.en: This could kill you. Throw it. Now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Close_1.ch: 這會害死你的. 丟掉. 馬上.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Close_1.cn: 这会要了你的命. 扔掉. 马上.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Close_2.en: Rotten. Don't you dare eat it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Close_2.ch: 爛了. 你敢吃試試看.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Close_2.cn: 烂了. 你敢吃试试看.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Close_3.en: Are you trying to poison us both?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Close_3.ch: 你是想把我們兩個都毒死嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Close_3.cn: 你是想把我们俩都毒死吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Near_1.en: This is rotten. Why are you carrying it?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Near_1.ch: 這爛掉了. 你幹嘛還帶著?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Near_1.cn: 这烂掉了. 你干嘛还带着?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Near_3.en: Throw it before you get sick.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Near_3.ch: 趁你還沒生病, 丟掉.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRotten_Near_3.cn: 趁你还没生病, 扔掉.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSmokes_Close_3.en: Don't tell me they're bad for me. Not now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSmokes_Close_3.ch: 別跟我說抽菸傷身. 現在不要.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSmokes_Close_3.cn: 别跟我说抽烟伤身. 现在别说.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSmokes_Far_3.en: Didn't think anyone had these left.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSmokes_Far_3.ch: 沒想到還有人留著這個.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSmokes_Far_3.cn: 没想到还有人留着这个.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSmokes_Near_2.en: I quit once. Doesn't count anymore.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSmokes_Near_2.ch: 我戒過一次. 現在不算數了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSmokes_Near_2.cn: 我戒过一次. 现在不算数了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSmokes_Near_3.ch: 晚點抽一根. 等安靜下來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSmokes_Near_3.cn: 晚点抽一根. 等安静下来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Close_1.en: Tainted water. Don't you dare drink it. Boil it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Close_1.ch: 受汙染的水. 你敢喝試試看. 先煮沸.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Close_1.cn: 受污染的水. 你敢喝试试. 先烧开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Close_2.en: This could make you sick. Boil it first.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Close_2.ch: 這會讓你生病. 先煮沸.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Close_2.cn: 这会让你生病. 先烧开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Close_3.en: Bad water. I'll boil it — don't drink yet.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Close_3.ch: 髒水. 我來煮沸, 先別喝.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Close_3.cn: 脏水. 我来烧开, 先别喝.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Near_1.en: This water's tainted. Boil it first.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Near_1.ch: 這水受汙染了. 先煮沸.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Near_1.cn: 这水被污染了. 先烧开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Near_2.ch: 你會生病的. 煮沸再喝.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Near_2.cn: 你会生病的. 烧开再喝.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Near_3.ch: 有汙染. 不能直接喝.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTainted_Near_3.cn: 被污染了. 不能直接喝.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTool_Close_2.en: Give me a day and I'll fix this place up.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTool_Close_2.ch: 給我一天, 我就把這裡整頓好.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTool_Close_2.cn: 给我一天, 我就把这里收拾好.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTool_Close_3.ch: 像樣的工具. 謝謝你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTool_Close_3.cn: 像样的工具. 谢谢你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTool_Near_2.en: Decent. Still has some life in it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTool_Near_2.ch: 還不錯. 還能用一陣子.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTool_Near_2.cn: 还不错. 还能用一阵子.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorch_Close_1.en: You're looking after me. Thank you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorch_Close_1.ch: 你在照顧我. 謝謝你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorch_Close_1.cn: 你在照顾我. 谢谢你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorch_Close_2.en: A light of my own. I'll take good care of it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorch_Close_2.ch: 我自己的燈. 我會好好愛惜.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorch_Close_2.cn: 我自己的灯. 我会好好爱惜.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorch_Near_1.en: A flashlight - thanks, I'll keep it handy.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorch_Near_1.ch: 手電筒, 謝啦, 我會放在順手的地方.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorch_Near_1.cn: 手电筒, 谢啦, 我会放在顺手的地方.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorch_Near_2.en: Now I can see where we're going.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Clos.en: It's dead, but I appreciate it. A battery and it's good.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Clos.ch: 它沒電了, 但我很感謝. 裝顆電池就能用.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Clos.cn: 它没电了, 但我很感激. 装节电池就能用.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Clos.en: Empty flashlight - I'll fit a cell when you have one.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Clos.ch: 沒電池的手電筒. 你有電池時我再裝上.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Clos.cn: 没电池的手电筒. 等你有电池我再装上.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Far_.en: A flashlight - but there's no battery in it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Far_.ch: 手電筒, 但裡面沒電池.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Far_.cn: 手电筒, 但里面没电池.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Far_.en: Dead flashlight. I'll need a cell.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Far_.ch: 沒電的手電筒. 我需要電池.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Far_.cn: 没电的手电筒. 我得要节电池.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Near.en: Thanks, but it's empty. Got a battery?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Near.ch: 謝啦, 但裡面是空的. 有電池嗎?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Near.cn: 谢啦, 但里面是空的. 有电池吗?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Near.en: No battery in this one. I'll need a fresh cell.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Near.ch: 這支沒裝電池. 我需要一顆新電池.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Near.cn: 这个没装电池. 我需要一节新电池.

IGUI_KBW_GuideMagazinesBody.en: <IMAGE:media/ui/craftingMenus/BuildProperty_Book_16.png,20,20> <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> Unlocking buildables <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> Many buildables must be learned before they can be built. Read the matching magazine - such as Fine Wood Working, The Family Handyman, Old House Journal, Architectural Digest, Popular Mechanics, Home Mechanix, Projects In Metal, the Flooring Guide or the Decoration Guide - or reach the higher skill level the recipe allows instead. In Skills & Knowledge, select the knowledge row to see which magazine teaches it. <LINE> <LINE> Locked recipes are hidden until learned. All qualities shows them so you can see what a magazine unlocks, but they still cannot be built until you know them; the server checks the same rule. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> Where to find them <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> Magazines turn up in bookshops, libraries, magazine racks and mechanic shelves. Each one teaches one group of recipes, for example dressers, doors and windows, wooden floors, lighting or bathroom appliances. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> Building components <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> Appliances and plumbing use Refrigerant Bottles, Refrigerator Compressors, Plastic Sheets, Insulation Foam, Small Rubber Tubes, Thin Copper Pipe and Rubber Seals. They are found in tool and electronics stores and tool crates. Cut a Plastic Sheet into small sheets with scissors, make a Small Rubber Tube from a rubber hose, and assemble a Refrigerator Compressor from sheet metal, electronics scrap, electric wire, screws and thin copper pipe.
IGUI_KBW_GuideMagazinesBody.ch: <IMAGE:media/ui/craftingMenus/BuildProperty_Book_16.png,20,20> <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 解鎖可建造物 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 許多可建造物必須先學會才能建造. 請閱讀對應的雜誌, 例如《精細木工》, 《家庭雜工》, 《老房子期刊》, 《建築文摘》, 《大眾機械》, 《居家機工》, 《金屬工藝》, 《地板指南》或《裝飾指南》, 或者改為達到該配方所允許的較高技能等級. 在「技能與知識」中選取知識列, 即可檢視由哪本雜誌教授. <LINE> <LINE> 鎖定的配方在學會前會隱藏. 「所有品質」會將它們顯示出來, 讓你知道雜誌會解鎖哪些內容, 但在學會之前仍然無法建造; 伺服器也會檢查同樣的規則. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 在哪裡找到雜誌 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 雜誌會出現在書店, 圖書館, 雜誌架和修車廠貨架上. 每本雜誌教授一組配方, 例如五斗櫃, 門窗, 木地板, 照明或浴室設備. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 建造零件 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 電器和管線會用到冷媒瓶, 冰箱壓縮機, 塑膠布, 隔熱泡棉, 小橡膠管, 細銅管和橡膠密封圈. 這些可以在五金行, 電子產品店和工具箱中找到. 用剪刀將塑膠布剪成小塊塑膠布, 用橡膠軟管製作小橡膠管, 並用鋼板, 電子廢料, 電線, 螺絲和細銅管組裝冰箱壓縮機.
IGUI_KBW_GuideMagazinesBody.cn: <IMAGE:media/ui/craftingMenus/BuildProperty_Book_16.png,20,20> <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 解锁可建造物 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 许多可建造物必须先学会才能建造. 请阅读对应的杂志, 例如《精细木工》, 《家庭杂工》, 《老房子期刊》, 《建筑文摘》, 《大众机械》, 《居家机工》, 《金属工艺》, 《地板指南》或《装饰指南》, 或者改为达到该配方所允许的更高技能等级. 在“技能与知识”中选择知识行, 即可查看由哪本杂志教授. <LINE> <LINE> 锁定的配方在学会之前会被隐藏. “所有品质”会将它们显示出来, 让你了解杂志会解锁哪些内容, 但在学会之前仍然无法建造; 服务器也会检查同样的规则. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 在哪里找到杂志 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 杂志会出现在书店, 图书馆, 杂志架和修车铺货架上. 每本杂志教授一组配方, 例如五斗柜, 门窗, 木地板, 照明或浴室设备. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 建造零件 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 电器和管道会用到制冷剂瓶, 冰箱压缩机, 塑料布, 隔热泡沫, 小橡胶管, 细铜管和橡胶密封圈. 这些可以在五金店, 电子产品店和工具箱中找到. 用剪刀将塑料布剪成小块塑料布, 用橡胶软管制作小橡胶管, 并用金属板, 电子废料, 电线, 螺丝和细铜管组装冰箱压缩机.

IGUI_KBW_GuidePlanningToolsBody.en: <H2> Adding pieces <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> Choose a piece in the planning catalogue, select Add to plan and click in the world. Walls drag in a line and floors fill a dragged rectangle.  <LINE> Quickbar: the numbered bar at the bottom of the screen saves the current catalogue selection with its stage, variant, material and finish. Click an empty slot to save it, click a filled slot or press 1-9 to place it, and right-click a slot to replace or clear it.  <LINE> Pipette: in the Pieces tab, select Pipette and hover a planned ghost or a built piece in the world. The piece that would be picked is outlined and named; when several share a tile, the rotate key steps through them. Click to keep planning with exactly that piece - recipe, variant, material, direction and paint, plaster or wallpaper - without searching the catalogue. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> Editing the plan <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> Select ghosts: drag a box to select planned pieces; hold Shift to add to the selection. Ctrl-click and Shift-click in the Pieces list select several pieces too.  <LINE> Delete selected, or the Delete key, removes every selected ghost at once.  <LINE> Erase tool removes the planned piece outlined on the tile you click, the top one at first. When several share a tile, the rotate key steps down through them.  <LINE> Move blueprint shows the whole plan under the cursor and moves it where you click.  <LINE> Stop tool puts away whichever planning tool is in your hand. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE>  <PUSHRGB:0.88,0.78,0.40> A red ghost explains itself. <POPRGB> <SPACE> Hold the cursor over the spot to read why: another planned piece in the way, outside the plan's range, a missing frame or earlier stage, or no permission.
IGUI_KBW_GuidePlanningToolsBody.ch: <H2> 新增構件 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 在規劃目錄中選擇一個構件, 選擇「加入規劃」, 然後在世界中點選. 牆壁會沿直線拖曳放置, 地板則會填滿拖曳出的矩形.  <LINE> 快捷欄: 畫面底部的編號欄會儲存目前的目錄選取, 包括其階段, 變體, 材質和飾面. 點選空槽位即可儲存, 點選已儲存的槽位或按 1-9 即可放置, 按右鍵點選槽位則可取代或清除.  <LINE> 滴管工具: 在構件分頁中選擇「滴管工具」, 然後將游標停在世界中的已規劃幽靈或已建造構件上. 將被選取的構件會顯示外框和名稱; 當同一格上有多個構件時, 旋轉鍵可逐一切換. 點選即可沿用完全相同的構件繼續規劃, 包括配方, 變體, 材質, 方向以及油漆, 灰泥或壁紙, 不必在目錄中搜尋. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 編輯規劃 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 選取幽靈: 拖曳出方框即可選取已規劃的構件; 按住 Shift 可加入選取範圍. 在構件清單中按住 Ctrl 或 Shift 點選, 也可以選取多個構件.  <LINE> 「移除所選」或 Delete 鍵會一次移除所有選取的幽靈.  <LINE> 擦除工具會移除你點選的格子上以外框標示的已規劃構件, 起初是最上層的那個. 當同一格上有多個構件時, 旋轉鍵可往下逐一切換.  <LINE> 移動藍圖會在游標下顯示整個規劃, 並將它移到你點選的位置.  <LINE> 停止工具會收起你手上正在使用的任何規劃工具. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE>  <PUSHRGB:0.88,0.78,0.40> 紅色幽靈會說明原因. <POPRGB> <SPACE> 將游標停在該位置即可檢視原因: 有其他已規劃的構件擋住, 超出規劃範圍, 缺少框架或前一個階段, 或沒有權限.
IGUI_KBW_GuidePlanningToolsBody.cn: <H2> 添加构件 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 在规划目录中选择一个构件, 选择“添加到规划”, 然后在世界中点击. 墙壁会沿直线拖动放置, 地板则会填满拖出的矩形.  <LINE> 快捷栏: 屏幕底部的编号栏会保存当前的目录选择, 包括其阶段, 变体, 材质和饰面. 点击空槽位即可保存, 点击已保存的槽位或按 1-9 即可放置, 右键点击槽位则可替换或清除.  <LINE> 吸管工具: 在构件标签页中选择“吸管工具”, 然后将鼠标悬停在世界中的已规划幽灵或已建造构件上. 将被选取的构件会显示轮廓和名称; 当同一格上有多个构件时, 旋转键可逐个切换. 点击即可使用完全相同的构件继续规划, 包括配方, 变体, 材质, 方向以及油漆, 灰泥或壁纸, 无需在目录中搜索. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 编辑规划 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 选择幽灵: 拖出方框即可选择已规划的构件; 按住 Shift 可添加到当前选择. 在构件列表中按住 Ctrl 或 Shift 点击, 也可以选择多个构件.  <LINE> “移除所选”或 Delete 键会一次性移除所有选中的幽灵.  <LINE> 擦除工具会移除你点击的格子上以轮廓标示的已规划构件, 起初是最上层的那个. 当同一格上有多个构件时, 旋转键可向下逐个切换.  <LINE> 移动蓝图会在鼠标下显示整个规划, 并将其移动到你点击的位置.  <LINE> 停止工具会收起你手中正在使用的任何规划工具. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE>  <PUSHRGB:0.88,0.78,0.40> 红色幽灵会说明原因. <POPRGB> <SPACE> 将鼠标悬停在该位置即可查看原因: 有其他已规划的构件挡住, 超出规划范围, 缺少框架或前一阶段, 或没有权限.

IGUI_KBW_GuidePreviewBody.en: <H2> World preview settings <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> In the Plans tab, World preview settings choose how ghosts are drawn: Blueprint tint, Original textures or Solid preview (100%). Show the selected level only, the selected level with faded neighbours, the selected level and below, or all levels, and hide roofs, planned walls or room zones while you work inside a building. These settings change only what you see and are kept per player. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> Preview layout <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> Preview layout opens the whole plan in its own window. Switch between Isometric and Top-down, move between floors, toggle the grid, use Fit, zoom with the mouse wheel and drag to pan. The top-down view draws walls on the edge they stand on, floors as filled squares, objects as blocks and roofs hatched, with north up; rooms keep their colours and the gather area has a green outline.
IGUI_KBW_GuidePreviewBody.ch: <H2> 世界預覽設定 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 在規劃分頁中, 世界預覽設定可選擇幽靈的繪製方式: 藍圖色調, 原始紋理或實體預覽 (100%%). 你可以只顯示所選樓層, 顯示所選樓層並淡化相鄰樓層, 顯示所選樓層及以下樓層, 或顯示所有樓層; 在建築內工作時, 也可以隱藏屋頂, 已規劃的牆壁或房間區域. 這些設定只會改變你看到的畫面, 並會依玩家分別保存. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 預覽佈局 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 預覽佈局會在獨立視窗中開啟整個規劃. 你可以在等距視角與俯視之間切換, 在樓層間移動, 開關網格, 使用「符合視窗」, 用滑鼠滾輪縮放, 以及拖曳平移. 俯視檢視會將牆壁畫在其所在的邊上, 地板畫成填滿的方格, 物件畫成方塊, 屋頂以斜線標示, 並以北方朝上; 房間會保留各自的顏色, 收集區域則有綠色外框.
IGUI_KBW_GuidePreviewBody.cn: <H2> 世界预览设置 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 在规划标签页中, 世界预览设置可选择幽灵的绘制方式: 蓝图色调, 原始纹理或实体预览 (100%%). 你可以只显示所选楼层, 显示所选楼层并淡化相邻楼层, 显示所选楼层及以下楼层, 或显示所有楼层; 在建筑内工作时, 还可以隐藏屋顶, 已规划的墙壁或房间区域. 这些设置只会改变你看到的画面, 并按玩家分别保存. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 预览布局 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 预览布局会在单独的窗口中打开整个规划. 你可以在等距视角和俯视之间切换, 在楼层之间移动, 开关网格, 使用“适应窗口”, 用鼠标滚轮缩放, 以及拖动平移. 俯视视图会将墙壁绘制在其所在的边上, 地板绘制为填充的方格, 物体绘制为方块, 屋顶以斜线标示, 并以北方朝上; 房间会保留各自的颜色, 收集区域则有绿色轮廓.

IGUI_KBW_GuideRoofsBody.en: <H2> Roofs without guesswork <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> Select a room in the Rooms tab and open Roof helper. Neighbouring rooms on the same level are roofed together, and a room under an upper storey is roofed against that wall. The helper lists every roof that fits - flat, shed, lean-to, gable, hip and cross-gable - as small shaded 3D models, best first, with the recommended one marked. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> Choosing a roof <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> Roof family and pitch: the roof tiles and their slope, 30 or 45 degrees.  <LINE> Gable walls and Gable finish: the end walls, in any variant their family shares and in paint, plaster, plaster with paint or wallpaper where every piece accepts it.  <LINE> Overhang, Maximum rise, Start level offset, Ceiling deck and Eaves fine-tune the roof.  <LINE> Hover a layout to see it in the world in its real tiles, click to choose it, then select Add preview to blueprint. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE> The roof is added as ordinary planned pieces, so it is built, erased and checked like any other ghost. Shallow sheets, roof trim and tents are placed by hand from the catalogue. <LINE> <LINE>  <PUSHRGB:0.88,0.78,0.40> At 45 degrees the north and west slopes are hidden by the camera. <POPRGB> <SPACE> The ceiling deck keeps those tiles dry, as in vanilla buildings; at 30 degrees every side is built.
IGUI_KBW_GuideRoofsBody.ch: <H2> 屋頂不必靠猜 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 在房間分頁中選擇一個房間, 然後開啟屋頂助手. 同一樓層上相鄰的房間會一起加上屋頂, 而位於上層樓下方的房間會以靠著該面牆的方式加上屋頂. 助手會列出所有適合的屋頂, 包括平頂, 單坡式, 依附單坡式, 山牆式, 四坡式和交叉山牆式, 並以小型陰影 3D 模型呈現, 最佳的排在最前面, 並標示出建議的那一個. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 選擇屋頂 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 屋頂家族與坡度: 屋頂瓦片及其坡度, 30 或 45 度.  <LINE> 山牆與山牆飾面: 兩端的端牆, 可使用其家族共有的任何變體, 並可在每個構件都支援時使用油漆, 灰泥, 灰泥加油漆或壁紙.  <LINE> 出簷, 最大升高, 起始樓層偏移, 天花板層和屋簷可微調屋頂.  <LINE> 將游標停在某個佈局上, 即可在世界中以實際瓦片檢視, 點選即可選用, 然後選擇「將預覽加入藍圖」. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE> 屋頂會以一般的已規劃構件加入, 因此其建造, 擦除和檢查方式與其他幽靈相同. 緩坡屋面, 屋頂飾條和帳篷需從目錄中手動放置. <LINE> <LINE>  <PUSHRGB:0.88,0.78,0.40> 在 45 度時, 北側與西側坡面會被鏡頭擋住而隱藏. <POPRGB> <SPACE> 天花板層會讓這些格子保持乾燥, 與原版建築相同; 在 30 度時, 每一側都會建造.
IGUI_KBW_GuideRoofsBody.cn: <H2> 屋顶无需猜测 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 在房间标签页中选择一个房间, 然后打开屋顶助手. 同一楼层上相邻的房间会一起加盖屋顶, 而位于上层楼下方的房间会以倚靠该面墙的方式加盖屋顶. 助手会列出所有合适的屋顶, 包括平顶, 单坡式, 依附单坡式, 山墙式, 四坡式和交叉山墙式, 并以带阴影的小型 3D 模型呈现, 最佳的排在最前面, 并标出推荐的那一个. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 选择屋顶 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 屋顶家族与坡度: 屋顶瓦片及其坡度, 30 或 45 度.  <LINE> 山墙与山墙饰面: 两端的端墙, 可使用其家族共有的任何变体, 并可在每个构件都支持时使用油漆, 灰泥, 灰泥加油漆或壁纸.  <LINE> 出檐, 最大升高, 起始楼层偏移, 天花板层和檐口可微调屋顶.  <LINE> 将鼠标悬停在某个布局上, 即可在世界中以实际瓦片查看, 点击即可选用, 然后选择“将预览添加到蓝图”. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE> 屋顶会作为普通的已规划构件添加, 因此其建造, 擦除和检查方式与其他幽灵相同. 缓坡屋面, 屋顶饰条和帐篷需要从目录中手动放置. <LINE> <LINE>  <PUSHRGB:0.88,0.78,0.40> 在 45 度时, 北侧和西侧坡面会被镜头遮挡而隐藏. <POPRGB> <SPACE> 天花板层会让这些格子保持干燥, 与原版建筑相同; 在 30 度时, 每一侧都会建造.

IGUI_KBW_GuideRoomsBody.en: <H2> Drawing rooms <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> In the Rooms tab, type a name, pick a colour, select Draw room and drag a rectangle on the planning level. Rooms mark out spaces, show as coloured outlines and give the Roof helper its footprint. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> Any shape <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> Extend room: select a room and drag a rectangle that touches or overlaps it to add a wing; repeat for L, T, U or irregular shapes.  <LINE> Cut from room: select a room and drag an area to clear it out, for notches, holes or trimming a side. A room cut down to nothing is removed.  <LINE> Update room saves a new name or colour, Delete room removes the selected room, and Erase room removes the room on the tile you click. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE> Rooms are planning marks only: they do not build walls or floors by themselves.
IGUI_KBW_GuideRoomsBody.ch: <H2> 繪製房間 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 在房間分頁中輸入名稱, 選擇顏色, 選擇「繪製房間」, 然後在規劃樓層上拖曳出一個矩形. 房間用來劃分空間, 會以彩色外框顯示, 並為屋頂助手提供佔地範圍. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 任意形狀 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 延伸房間: 選擇一個房間, 然後拖曳出與其相接或重疊的矩形, 即可加上一個側翼; 重複此操作可做出 L 形, T 形, U 形或不規則形狀.  <LINE> 從房間切除: 選擇一個房間, 然後拖曳出要清除的區域, 可用於做出凹口, 開洞或修整某一側. 被切到完全不剩的房間會被移除.  <LINE> 「更新房間」會儲存新的名稱或顏色, 「刪除房間」會移除所選的房間, 「擦除房間」則會移除你點選的格子上的房間. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE> 房間只是規劃標記: 它們本身不會建造牆壁或地板.
IGUI_KBW_GuideRoomsBody.cn: <H2> 绘制房间 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 在房间标签页中输入名称, 选择颜色, 选择“绘制房间”, 然后在规划楼层上拖出一个矩形. 房间用于划分空间, 会以彩色轮廓显示, 并为屋顶助手提供占地范围. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 任意形状 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 扩展房间: 选择一个房间, 然后拖出与其相接或重叠的矩形, 即可添加一个侧翼; 重复此操作可做出 L 形, T 形, U 形或不规则形状.  <LINE> 从房间切除: 选择一个房间, 然后拖出要清除的区域, 可用于做出凹口, 开洞或修整某一侧. 被切得一点不剩的房间会被移除.  <LINE> “更新房间”会保存新的名称或颜色, “删除房间”会移除所选房间, “擦除房间”则会移除你点击的格子上的房间. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE> 房间只是规划标记: 它们本身不会建造墙壁或地板.

IGUI_KBW_RoofHelp.en: Every layout is drawn as a small model; the shading shows which way each slope faces. Hover a layout to see it in the world in its real tiles, click to choose it. Each card previews the real tile: use its arrows, the mouse wheel or a click on it to switch roof family, gable walls and gable finish (painted, wallpapered or plastered where the material allows it). At 45° the north and west slopes are hidden by the camera, so the ceiling deck keeps those tiles dry; at 30° both sides are built. End walls use the gable material and follow the exact slope of the roof. Only families the helper can lay out by itself are listed; shallow sheets, roof trim and tents are placed from the catalogue.
IGUI_KBW_RoofHelp.ch: 每種佈局都以小模型呈現; 陰影表示各坡面的朝向. 將滑鼠停在佈局上, 即可在遊戲世界中以實際格子檢視, 點選即可選用. 每張卡片都會預覽實際格子: 使用其箭頭, 滑鼠滾輪或點選卡片, 即可切換屋頂家族, 山牆與山牆飾面 (材料允許時可選塗漆, 壁紙或灰泥). 在 45° 時, 北側與西側坡面會被鏡頭遮住, 因此由天花板層讓這些格子保持乾燥; 在 30° 時兩側都會建造. 端牆使用山牆材料, 並完全貼合屋頂的坡度. 只會列出屋頂助手能自行鋪排的家族; 緩坡板片, 屋頂飾條與帳篷需從目錄放置.
IGUI_KBW_RoofHelp.cn: 每种布局都以小模型呈现; 阴影表示各坡面的朝向. 将鼠标悬停在布局上, 即可在游戏世界中以实际格子查看, 点击即可选择. 每张卡片都会预览实际格子: 使用其箭头, 鼠标滚轮或点击卡片, 即可切换屋顶家族, 山墙和山墙饰面 (材料允许时可选涂漆, 墙纸或抹灰). 在 45° 时, 北侧和西侧坡面会被镜头遮挡, 因此由天花板层保持这些格子干燥; 在 30° 时两侧都会建造. 端墙使用山墙材料, 并精确贴合屋顶的坡度. 只会列出屋顶助手能自行布置的家族; 缓坡板片, 屋顶饰条和帐篷需从目录中放置.

IGUI_KBW_TestSuite_BuildDesc.en: Builds every case in the scope, one at a time: supplies requirements (or uses what you carry), finds a valid square and stacks prerequisites there (frames, support walls, barricade targets), builds instantly or walks over and builds, applies wall finishes and coverings, then verifies objects, consumption and finishes. Kept pieces get their own spaced slot sized to their footprint.
IGUI_KBW_TestSuite_BuildDesc.ch: 逐一建造範圍內的每個測試案例: 提供需求物品 (或使用你身上攜帶的物品), 找到有效的格子並在那裡疊放前置構件 (框架, 支撐牆, 路障目標), 瞬間建造或走過去建造, 套用牆面飾面與覆蓋物, 然後驗證物件, 消耗與飾面. 保留的構件會各自獲得一個依佔地大小配置且彼此間隔的位置.
IGUI_KBW_TestSuite_BuildDesc.cn: 逐一建造范围内的每个测试用例: 提供需求物品 (或使用你随身携带的物品), 找到有效的格子并在那里叠放前置构件 (框架, 支撑墙, 路障目标), 瞬间建造或走过去建造, 应用墙面饰面和覆盖物, 然后验证物品, 消耗和饰面. 保留的构件会各自获得一个按占地大小划定且彼此间隔的位置.

IGUI_KBW_TestSuite_CatalogDesc.en: Opens the real catalogue and drives it: search, categories, favourites, list/grid and compact views, resizing, selecting cards and options, the ingredient drawer and the Plan hand-off.
IGUI_KBW_TestSuite_CatalogDesc.ch: 開啟真正的目錄並自動操作: 搜尋, 分類, 收藏, 清單/網格與精簡檢視, 調整大小, 選取卡片與選項, 材料面板, 以及轉交至規劃.
IGUI_KBW_TestSuite_CatalogDesc.cn: 打开真实的目录并自动操作: 搜索, 分类, 收藏, 列表/网格和紧凑视图, 调整大小, 选择卡片和选项, 材料面板, 以及转交至规划.

IGUI_KBW_TestSuite_DefinitionsDesc.en: Every buildable, variant, material and stage: sprites, entity scripts, native recipes, requirement items, skills, durability, icons and translations.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsContainerButtonSize.ch: 容器按鈕大小 (戰利品圖示)
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsContainerButtonSize.cn: 容器按钮大小 (战利品图标)

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsContainerButtonSize_.en: Sets the size of container and backpack buttons on the sidebar of the inventory and loot window. Supports enlarged sizes (XL and 2XL) tailored for 1440p and 4K displays.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsContainerButtonSize_.ch: 設定物品欄與戰利品視窗側邊欄上容器和背包按鈕的大小. 支援放大尺寸 (XL 與 2XL), 專為 1440p 與 4K 顯示器設計.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsContainerButtonSize_.cn: 设置物品栏与战利品窗口侧边栏上容器和背包按钮的大小. 支持放大尺寸 (XL 与 2XL), 专为 1440p 与 4K 显示器设计.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsHoldToPeek.ch: 按住快速檢視 (輕按切換)
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsHoldToPeek.cn: 按住快速查看 (轻按切换)

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsHoldToPeek_Tooltip.en: Hold inventory key to peek quickly and release to close. Tap once to keep open.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsHoldToPeek_Tooltip.ch: 按住物品欄按鍵可快速檢視, 放開即關閉. 輕按一次則保持開啟.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsHoldToPeek_Tooltip.cn: 按住物品栏按键可快速查看, 松开即关闭. 轻按一次则保持打开.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMaxMultiLoot.ch: 世界容器上限 (多容器戰利品)
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMaxMultiLoot.cn: 世界容器上限 (多容器战利品)

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMaxMultiLoot_Tooltip.en: Limits how many nearby containers/corpses are loaded simultaneously in the loot window to prevent lag when standing over hordes. The selected container is always guaranteed to be shown.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMaxMultiLoot_Tooltip.ch: 限制戰利品視窗中同時載入的附近容器/屍體數量, 以免站在屍群上方時造成卡頓. 目前選取的容器一律保證顯示.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMaxMultiLoot_Tooltip.cn: 限制战利品窗口中同时加载的附近容器/尸体数量, 以免站在尸群上方时造成卡顿. 当前选中的容器始终保证显示.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsScrollBehavior_Toolt.en: Choose what happens when scrolling the mouse wheel outside item grids. 'Standard Scroll' scrolls the inventory window up and down. 'Switch Container' cycles through open containers.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsScrollBehavior_Toolt.ch: 選擇在物品網格外捲動滑鼠滾輪時的行為. 「標準捲動」會上下捲動物品欄視窗. 「切換容器」會在已開啟的容器之間循環切換.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsScrollBehavior_Toolt.cn: 选择在物品网格外滚动鼠标滚轮时的行为. “标准滚动”会上下滚动物品栏窗口. “切换容器”会在已打开的容器之间循环切换.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsToggleInvKey_Tooltip.en: Shortcut to open, close, and peek into your inventory. We recommend setting this to TAB for quick peeking with WASD without searching through the game's keybindings.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsToggleInvKey_Tooltip.ch: 用來開啟、關閉與快速檢視物品欄的快捷鍵. 建議設為 TAB, 這樣就能一邊用 WASD 移動一邊快速檢視, 不必在遊戲的按鍵設定中翻找.

IGUI_ALifeUI_084ac3af41e772e9.en: APPEARANCE: choose skin tone, hair and beard, then build up to six outfit sets, A to F. Tick Enable this set for spawning on every set you want used; only ticked sets are picked. A set can be limited to a season (Any season, Spring only, Summer only, Autumn only or Winter only). In its season a seasonal set replaces the any-season sets. The season follows the outdoor temperature when the NPC is dressed and again while it lives (the date only picks spring or autumn between 4 and 22 C).
IGUI_ALifeUI_084ac3af41e772e9.ch: APPEARANCE: 選擇膚色、髮型與鬍子, 接著最多建立六套服裝組合 (A 到 F). 在每套想使用的組合上勾選允許此套生成 (Enable this set for spawning); 只有勾選的組合會被選取. 每套組合都可限定季節 (不限季節 Any season、僅春季 Spring only、僅夏季 Summer only、僅秋季 Autumn only 或僅冬季 Winter only). 在對應季節中, 季節限定組合會取代不限季節的組合. 季節依NPC換裝當下的室外溫度判定, 並在其存活期間持續重新判定 (只有在 4 到 22 C 之間時, 才由日期決定是春季還是秋季).
IGUI_ALifeUI_084ac3af41e772e9.cn: APPEARANCE: 选择肤色、发型和胡子, 然后最多创建六套服装套装 (A 到 F). 在每套想使用的套装上勾选允许此套生成 (Enable this set for spawning); 只有勾选的套装才会被选中. 每套套装都可限定季节 (不限季节 Any season、仅春季 Spring only、仅夏季 Summer only、仅秋季 Autumn only 或仅冬季 Winter only). 在对应季节中, 季节限定套装会取代不限季节的套装. 季节依据NPC换装时的室外温度判定, 并在其存活期间持续重新判定 (只有在 4 到 22 C 之间时, 才由日期决定是春季还是秋季).

IGUI_ALifeUI_1dc7eab00ff1b0a3.en: Spawn Weight In Group (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Very Rare, Unseen) sets how often this preset is picked inside its faction. Rare and Very Rare keep specialists from taking over a squad. Filter tags and Notes are for your own organisation.

IGUI_ALifeUI_1dc7eab00ff1b0a3.cn: 群组内生成权重 (Spawn Weight In Group) 可选普遍 (Common)、罕见 (Uncommon)、稀少 (Rare)、极稀少 (Very Rare) 或不出现 (Unseen), 决定此预设在所属阵营中被选中的频率. 稀少和极稀少可防止专业人员占满整个小队. 筛选标签 (Filter tags) 和备注 (Notes) 仅供你自己整理使用.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2bd66d18593d26c4.en: LOADOUT: pick a PRIMARY firearm, a SIDEARM and a MELEE / BELT weapon the same way, with up to four random choices each. AMMUNITION is counted in whole magazines, not loose rounds. Infinite ammunition removes the reload limit, and Drop magazines on death with its chance controls what can be looted. FIREARM ATTACHMENTS sets scopes, sights and other parts.
IGUI_ALifeUI_2bd66d18593d26c4.ch: LOADOUT: 用同樣的方式選擇 PRIMARY 槍械、SIDEARM 與 MELEE / BELT 武器, 每項最多可設四個隨機選項. AMMUNITION 以整個彈匣計算, 而非散裝子彈. 無限彈藥 (Infinite ammunition) 會取消裝填限制, 死亡時掉落彈匣 (Drop magazines on death) 及其機率則決定能搜刮到什麼. FIREARM ATTACHMENTS 用來設定瞄準鏡、準星與其他配件.
IGUI_ALifeUI_2bd66d18593d26c4.cn: LOADOUT: 用同样的方式选择 PRIMARY 枪械、SIDEARM 和 MELEE / BELT 武器, 每项最多可设四个随机选项. AMMUNITION 以整个弹匣计算, 而非散装子弹. 无限弹药 (Infinite ammunition) 会取消装填限制, 死亡时掉落弹匣 (Drop magazines on death) 及其概率则决定能搜刮到什么. FIREARM ATTACHMENTS 用于设置瞄准镜、准星和其他配件.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2e9da2a3439dd8de.en: On by default. The Creator leaves out clothing and loadout lines that only repeat the default value, so the NPC file is a third of the size and opens much faster. The file is rewritten this way on your next save, and the old copy is kept next to it as a backup. Older files still load. Turn it off to write every line again.
IGUI_ALifeUI_2e9da2a3439dd8de.ch: 預設開啟. 編輯器會省略只重複預設值的服裝與配備行, 讓NPC檔案縮小為原本的三分之一, 開啟速度也快得多. 下次儲存時檔案會以這種方式重寫, 舊檔則保留在旁邊作為備份. 舊檔案仍可載入. 關閉此項即可再次寫入每一行.
IGUI_ALifeUI_2e9da2a3439dd8de.cn: 默认开启. 编辑器会省略只重复默认值的服装和装备行, 让NPC文件缩小为原来的三分之一, 打开速度也快得多. 下次保存时文件会以这种方式重写, 旧文件则保留在旁边作为备份. 旧文件仍可加载. 关闭此项即可再次写入每一行.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2eadefaf4c99a38e.en: Pick a faction, then press + NEW MEMBER in the MEMBER PRESETS column. The new preset is selected and ready to edit. IGUI_ALifeUI_2f8a969721c18a23.ch: 預設開啟. 編輯器會在背景分成小段寫入你的NPC, 因此關閉編輯器或切換NPC時遊戲不會卡住. 只有在儲存出問題時才關閉: 關閉後會恢復舊的儲存方式, NPC清單很長時可能要花很久.
IGUI_ALifeUI_2f8a969721c18a23.cn: 默认开启. 编辑器会在后台分成小段写入你的NPC, 因此关闭编辑器或切换NPC时游戏不会卡住. 只有在保存出问题时才关闭: 关闭后会恢复旧的保存方式, NPC列表很长时可能要花很久.

IGUI_ALifeUI_3c353126289d06dc.en: BEHAVIOR tab: Behavior profile is the complete baseline package of priorities, engagement style and allowed abilities, and the summary under it spells out what it does. Primary doctrine adds one specialist role: None, Leader, Gunner, Medic, Sniper, Stealth or Ambusher. Combat ready decides whether the NPC starts out armed and prepared (Default, Yes, No or Mixed).
IGUI_ALifeUI_3c353126289d06dc.ch: BEHAVIOR 分頁: 行為設定 (Behavior profile) 是一整套基礎配置, 包含優先順序、交戰風格與允許的能力, 下方的摘要會說明它的作用. 主要準則 (Primary doctrine) 會增加一種專長角色: 無 (None)、領導者 (Leader)、槍手 (Gunner)、醫護兵 (Medic)、狙擊手 (Sniper)、潛行者 (Stealth) 或伏擊者 (Ambusher). 戰鬥就緒 (Combat ready) 決定NPC一出現是否就已武裝並做好準備 (預設 Default、是 Yes、否 No 或混合 Mixed).
IGUI_ALifeUI_3c353126289d06dc.cn: BEHAVIOR 标签页: 行为设定 (Behavior profile) 是一整套基础配置, 包含优先级、交战风格和允许的能力, 下方的摘要会说明它的作用. 主要准则 (Primary doctrine) 会增加一种专长角色: 无 (None)、领导者 (Leader)、枪手 (Gunner)、医疗兵 (Medic)、狙击手 (Sniper)、潜行者 (Stealth) 或伏击手 (Ambusher). 战斗就绪 (Combat ready) 决定NPC一出现是否就已武装并做好准备 (默认 Default、是 Yes、否 No 或混合 Mixed).
