IGUI_ALifeUI_3c8878222267fffa.en: Class (IDENTITY tab) decides who the Fear of the dead ability affects: Civilian members, and less easily Rescue and Worker members, leave distant zombies alone and run as a group when too many close in, while Police, Military and Criminal members stay steady. The world Fear switch also applies.
IGUI_ALifeUI_3c8878222267fffa.ch: 類別 (Class, 位於 IDENTITY 分頁) 決定「恐懼死者」(Fear of the dead) 能力會影響誰: 平民 (Civilian) 成員, 以及較不容易受影響的救援人員 (Rescue) 與工人 (Worker) 成員, 會避開遠處的殭屍, 並在太多殭屍逼近時集體逃跑; 警察 (Police)、軍人 (Military) 與罪犯 (Criminal) 成員則保持鎮定. 世界的「恐懼」開關也同樣適用.
IGUI_ALifeUI_3c8878222267fffa.cn: 类别 (Class, 位于 IDENTITY 标签页) 决定“恐惧死者”(Fear of the dead) 能力会影响谁: 平民 (Civilian) 成员, 以及较不容易受影响的救援人员 (Rescue) 和工人 (Worker) 成员, 会避开远处的僵尸, 并在太多僵尸逼近时集体逃跑; 警察 (Police)、军人 (Military) 和罪犯 (Criminal) 成员则保持镇定. 世界的“恐惧”开关也同样适用.

IGUI_ALifeUI_473c4c4608b4af70.en: IDENTITY is the person. Display name and Gender come first. NPC name chooses where the name comes from: a random name that matches the gender (the default), a random male name, a random female name, or Set name, which gives every NPC of this preset the name you type. IGUI_ALifeUI_5a2f708d0e1ea818.en: Closing the Creator or switching member never waits for a save: the NPC keeps being written in the background and the main menu says Saving NPC... until it is done. SAVING - RETRY WHEN SAVED means something that needs the finished file (SAVE NOW, new, copy, delete, export or sync) was held back to protect your edits. Nothing is lost. Wait for the label to change to SAVED and then do it again.
IGUI_ALifeUI_5a2f708d0e1ea818.ch: 關閉編輯器或切換成員時都不會等待儲存完成: NPC會在背景持續寫入, 主選單會顯示「Saving NPC...」直到完成. SAVING - RETRY WHEN SAVED 表示某個需要完整檔案的操作 (SAVE NOW、新增、複製、刪除、匯出或同步) 為了保護你的編輯而暫緩執行. 不會遺失任何東西. 等標籤變成 SAVED 後再操作一次即可.
IGUI_ALifeUI_5a2f708d0e1ea818.cn: 关闭编辑器或切换成员时都不会等待保存完成: NPC会在后台持续写入, 主菜单会显示“Saving NPC...”直到完成. SAVING - RETRY WHEN SAVED 表示某个需要完整文件的操作 (SAVE NOW、新建、复制、删除、导出或同步) 为了保护你的编辑而暂缓执行. 不会丢失任何东西. 等标签变成 SAVED 后再操作一次即可.

IGUI_ALifeUI_5ca26f6171dfa616.en: MODULES tab (NPC ABILITIES): every ability can be Inherit, On or Off. Inherit uses the faction setting; On and Off apply to this NPC only. The abilities are grouped as ORDERS, DANGER RESPONSE, COMBAT MOVEMENT, SURVIVAL & ROUTINE and OUTLAW CONDUCT. RESET ALL TO INHERIT clears this NPC's overrides, and APPLY ABILITIES TO FACTION applies this NPC's ability choices to the whole faction.
IGUI_ALifeUI_5ca26f6171dfa616.ch: MODULES 分頁 (NPC ABILITIES): 每項能力都可設為繼承 (Inherit)、開啟 (On) 或關閉 (Off). 繼承會沿用陣營設定; 開啟與關閉只套用於此NPC. 能力分為 ORDERS、DANGER RESPONSE、COMBAT MOVEMENT、SURVIVAL & ROUTINE 與 OUTLAW CONDUCT 幾組. RESET ALL TO INHERIT 會清除此NPC的覆寫設定, APPLY ABILITIES TO FACTION 則會把此NPC的能力選擇套用到整個陣營.
IGUI_ALifeUI_5ca26f6171dfa616.cn: MODULES 标签页 (NPC ABILITIES): 每项能力都可设为继承 (Inherit)、开启 (On) 或关闭 (Off). 继承会沿用阵营设置; 开启和关闭只应用于此NPC. 能力分为 ORDERS、DANGER RESPONSE、COMBAT MOVEMENT、SURVIVAL & ROUTINE 和 OUTLAW CONDUCT 几组. RESET ALL TO INHERIT 会清除此NPC的覆盖设置, APPLY ABILITIES TO FACTION 则会把此NPC的能力选择应用到整个阵营.

IGUI_ALifeUI_613538e43b8e972d.en: On the faction list, DUPLICATE FACTION copies a faction with all its NPCs and DELETE removes the selected one after asking. COPY CODE turns a faction into a share code you can paste to a friend or on Discord, and LOAD CODE adds a faction from a code in your clipboard. RESET FACTIONS TO DEFAULT puts the built-in factions back as shipped and keeps the ones you made.
IGUI_ALifeUI_613538e43b8e972d.ch: 在陣營清單中, DUPLICATE FACTION 會複製陣營及其所有NPC, DELETE 會在確認後刪除所選陣營. COPY CODE 會把陣營轉成分享碼, 可以貼給朋友或貼到 Discord 上. LOAD CODE 則會用剪貼簿中的代碼新增陣營. RESET FACTIONS TO DEFAULT 會把內建陣營恢復為原始狀態, 並保留你自己建立的陣營.
IGUI_ALifeUI_613538e43b8e972d.cn: 在阵营列表中, DUPLICATE FACTION 会复制阵营及其所有NPC, DELETE 会在确认后删除所选阵营. COPY CODE 会把阵营转换为分享码, 可以发给朋友或贴到 Discord 上. LOAD CODE 则会用剪贴板中的代码添加阵营. RESET FACTIONS TO DEFAULT 会将内置阵营恢复为原始状态, 并保留你自己创建的阵营.

IGUI_NotAlone_NewsTitle.ch: Stay With Me - 更新內容
IGUI_NotAlone_NewsTitle.cn: Stay With Me - 更新内容

IGUI_NotAlone_OptEquipScaleTip.en: Size of the Equipment window, multiplied on top of the game UI font scale. Larger values suit high-resolution screens.

IGUI_NotAlone_OptEquipScaleTip.cn: 装备窗口的大小, 会在游戏界面字体缩放的基础上再相乘. 数值越大越适合高分辨率屏幕.

IGUI_NotAlone_OptEquipScaleTipMale.en: Size of the Equipment window, multiplied on top of the game UI font scale. Larger values suit high-resolution screens.
IGUI_NotAlone_OptEquipScaleTipMale.ch: 裝備視窗的大小, 會再乘上遊戲介面的字型縮放. 數值越大越適合高解析度螢幕.
IGUI_NotAlone_OptEquipScaleTipMale.cn: 装备窗口的大小, 会在游戏界面字体缩放的基础上再相乘. 数值越大越适合高分辨率屏幕.

IGUI_NotAlone_OptRelPopupsTip.en: Off: no floating popups over her head when your friendship or romance changes.
IGUI_NotAlone_OptRelPopupsTip.ch: 關閉: 你們的友情或戀愛關係變化時, 她頭上不會浮現提示.
IGUI_NotAlone_OptRelPopupsTip.cn: 关闭: 你们的友情或恋爱关系变化时, 她头上不会浮现提示.

IGUI_NotAlone_OptRelPopupsTipMale.en: Off: no floating popups over his head when your friendship or romance changes.
IGUI_NotAlone_OptRelPopupsTipMale.ch: 關閉: 你們的友情或戀愛關係變化時, 他頭上不會浮現提示.
IGUI_NotAlone_OptRelPopupsTipMale.cn: 关闭: 你们的友情或恋爱关系变化时, 他头上不会浮现提示.

IGUI_NotAlone_OptSitWithRedTip.en: When you sit on the ground somewhere safe, she sits on the ground beside you and gets up when you do. A nearby zombie makes her stand.
IGUI_NotAlone_OptSitWithRedTip.ch: 你在安全的地方坐到地上時, 她會坐在你身旁的地上, 你起身時她也會起身. 附近有殭屍時她會站起來.
IGUI_NotAlone_OptSitWithRedTip.cn: 你在安全的地方坐到地上时, 她会坐在你身旁的地上, 你起身时她也会起身. 附近有僵尸时她会站起来.

IGUI_NotAlone_OptSitWithRedTipMale.en: When you sit on the ground somewhere safe, he sits on the ground beside you and gets up when you do. A nearby zombie makes him stand.
IGUI_NotAlone_OptSitWithRedTipMale.ch: 你在安全的地方坐到地上時, 他會坐在你身旁的地上, 你起身時他也會起身. 附近有殭屍時他會站起來.
IGUI_NotAlone_OptSitWithRedTipMale.cn: 你在安全的地方坐到地上时, 他会坐在你身旁的地上, 你起身时他也会起身. 附近有僵尸时他会站起来.

IGUI_NotAlone_ReportDone.ch: 已儲存至 %1 (已複製到剪貼簿)
IGUI_NotAlone_ReportDone.cn: 已保存到 %1 (已复制到剪贴板)

IGUI_NotAlone_ReportLogNote.en: Turn detailed logging on before you reproduce the bug, then press Generate report.
IGUI_NotAlone_ReportLogNote.ch: 重現錯誤前先開啟詳細記錄, 然後按下「產生報告」.
IGUI_NotAlone_ReportLogNote.cn: 复现 bug 前先开启详细日志, 然后点击“生成报告”.

IGUI_NotAlone_ReportOpenPage.cn: 打开创意工坊错误报告

IGUI_NotAlone_ReportStep1a.en: 1. Click Generate report, then upload the report file and console.txt
IGUI_NotAlone_ReportStep1a.ch: 1. 點選「產生報告」, 再把報告檔案和 console.txt
IGUI_NotAlone_ReportStep1a.cn: 1. 点击“生成报告”, 再把报告文件和 console.txt

IGUI_NotAlone_ReportStep2.en: 2. Post the pastebin links on the Stay With Me workshop page under Bug reports.
IGUI_NotAlone_ReportStep2.ch: 2. 把 pastebin 連結貼到 Stay With Me 工作坊頁面的 Bug reports 底下.
IGUI_NotAlone_ReportStep2.cn: 2. 把 pastebin 链接发到 Stay With Me 创意工坊页面的 Bug reports 下面.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedCutTool.en: I need something to cut these bushes with.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedCutTool.ch: 我需要能砍這些灌木的東西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobNeedCutTool.cn: 我需要能砍这些灌木的东西.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobPartialNeedCutTool.en: I cleared what I could, but the bushes need something to cut them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobPartialNeedCutTool.ch: 能清的我都清了, 但灌木得用東西砍才行.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobPartialNeedCutTool.cn: 能清的我都清了, 但灌木得用工具砍才行.

IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobStartNeedCutTool.en: I'll pull the grass, but I need something to cut the bushes with.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobStartNeedCutTool.ch: 草我會拔, 但我需要能砍灌木的東西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Say_JobStartNeedCutTool.cn: 草我来拔, 但我需要能砍灌木的东西.

IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBattery_Close_.en: You remembered I needed one. Thanks.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBattery_Close_.ch: 你還記得我需要這個. 謝了.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBattery_Close_.cn: 你还记得我需要这个. 谢了.

IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBattery_Close_.en: A cell. You look after me.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBattery_Close_.ch: 一顆電池. 你真照顧我.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBattery_Close_.cn: 一节电池. 你真照顾我.

IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBattery_Close_.en: I'll save it for when my light dies.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBattery_Close_.ch: 我先留著, 等燈沒電再用.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBattery_Close_.cn: 我先留着, 等灯没电了再用.

IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBattery_Near_1.en: A battery? Thanks - that keeps my light going.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBattery_Near_1.ch: 電池? 謝了, 這樣我的燈就能一直亮著.
IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBattery_Near_1.cn: 电池? 谢了, 这样我的灯就能一直亮着.

IGUI_NotAlone_SocM_ReceiveBattery_Near_2.ch: 很好, 一顆備用電池.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Close_1.en: I'll clear us a bit of space.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Close_1.ch: 我來清出一點空間給我們.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Close_1.cn: 我来给我们清出点地方.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Close_2.en: Clearing this back. It never stops growing.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Close_2.ch: 把這裡清一清. 這些東西長個沒完.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Close_2.cn: 把这儿清一清. 这些东西长个没完.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Close_3.en: A little less wild, right here.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Far_2.en: Clearing what I can from here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Far_2.ch: 我從這裡能清多少就清多少.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Far_2.cn: 我在这儿能清多少就清多少.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Far_3.en: Tidying up. Give me a minute.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Far_3.ch: 整理一下. 給我一分鐘.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Far_3.cn: 收拾一下. 给我一分钟.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Near_2.en: This is what the world does now. Grows over everything.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Near_2.ch: 現在的世界就是這樣. 什麼都被草蓋過去.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Near_2.cn: 现在的世界就是这样. 什么都被草盖过去.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvClearing_Near_3.en: Pulling it up, one square at a time.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitDanger_Close_1.en: I heard it too. Up. Stay with me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitDanger_Close_1.ch: 我也聽到了. 起來. 跟緊我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitDanger_Close_1.cn: 我也听到了. 起来. 跟紧我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitDanger_Near_1.ch: 有東西靠近了. 站起來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitDanger_Near_1.cn: 有东西靠近了. 站起来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitDown_Close_2.ch: 我喜歡這樣. 就這樣坐著.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitDown_Close_2.cn: 我喜欢这样. 就这么坐着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitDown_Near_2.en: I'll rest my feet a while.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitIdle_Close_1.en: I could stay like this a while. With you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitIdle_Close_1.ch: 我可以就這樣待一陣子. 跟你一起.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitIdle_Close_1.cn: 我可以就这样待一会儿. 和你一起.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitIdle_Near_1.ch: 很平靜. 至少現在是.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitIdle_Near_1.cn: 挺平静的. 至少现在是.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitIdle_Near_2.en: We should do this more often.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitUp_Close_1.ch: 好了, 陪你一起起來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSitUp_Close_1.cn: 好了, 陪你一起起来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSwingAtMe_Close_2.en: Are you trying to hurt me?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSwingAtMe_Close_3.en: Careful with that. I'm right here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSwingAtMe_Close_3.ch: 那東西小心點. 我就在這裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSwingAtMe_Close_3.cn: 那东西小心点. 我就在这儿.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSwingAtMe_Near_1.ch: 喂, 小心. 剛剛那是怎樣?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSwingAtMe_Near_1.cn: 喂, 小心. 刚才那是干嘛?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvSwingAtMe_Near_3.en: Put that down if you're not using it.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootAmmo_Near_1.ch: 彈藥. 每一發都很重要.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootAmmo_Near_1.cn: 弹药. 每一发都很重要.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootBooze_Near_1.ch: 一瓶酒. 留著晚點喝.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootBooze_Near_1.cn: 一瓶酒. 留着晚点喝.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootCigs_Near_1.en: Smokes. Don't mind if I do.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootCigs_Near_1.ch: 菸. 那我就不客氣了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootCigs_Near_1.cn: 烟. 那我就不客气了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootCleaner_Near_1.ch: 清潔用品. 留著有用.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootCleaner_Near_1.cn: 清洁用品. 留着有用.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootContainer_Near_1.en: A container. More room to carry.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootContainer_Near_1.ch: 一個容器. 能多裝點東西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootContainer_Near_1.cn: 一个容器. 能多装点东西.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootElectronics_Near_1.ch: 電子產品. 可能有用.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootElectronics_Near_1.cn: 电子产品. 可能有用.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootFood_Near_1.ch: 食物. 我們不會餓肚子了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootFood_Near_1.cn: 食物. 我们不会饿肚子了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootFull_Near_3.en: That's about all I can hold.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootFull_Near_3.ch: 我差不多只能拿這麼多了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootFull_Near_3.cn: 我差不多只能拿这么多了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootFurniture_Near_1.en: Could furnish the place with this.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootGround_Near_2.ch: 丟在地上? 算他們倒楣.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootGround_Near_2.cn: 丢在地上? 算他们倒霉.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootGun_Near_1.en: A gun. Let's hope we won't need it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootGun_Near_1.ch: 一把槍. 希望我們用不到.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootGun_Near_1.cn: 一把枪. 希望我们用不上.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootJunk_Near_1.en: Junk, but it might come in handy.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootJunk_Near_1.ch: 破爛, 但說不定用得上.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootJunk_Near_1.cn: 破烂, 但说不定用得上.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootMaterial_Near_1.ch: 材料. 蓋東西用得到.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_LootMaterial_Near_1.cn: 材料. 盖东西用得上.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Clos.en: Nothing wasted. You learned that out here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Clos.ch: 一點都不浪費. 這是在外面學到的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Clos.cn: 一点都不浪费. 这是在外面学会的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Clos.en: Hide and bone. We'll make something of it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Clos.ch: 獸皮和骨頭. 我們能拿來做點東西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Clos.cn: 兽皮和骨头. 我们能拿来做点东西.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Clos.en: Thank you. Everything has a use now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Clos.ch: 謝謝你. 現在什麼東西都有用處.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Clos.cn: 谢谢你. 现在什么东西都有用处.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Far_.cn: 动物部位. 挺实用的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Near.en: Parts. Good for something, I'm sure.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Near.ch: 部位. 我相信總有用處.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Near.en: Hides and bones. We'll use them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Near.ch: 獸皮和骨頭. 我們會用上的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Near.cn: 兽皮和骨头. 我们会用上的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Near.en: I'll sort it with the rest.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Near.ch: 我會跟其他東西放一起整理.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Near.cn: 我会跟其他东西一起归置好.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Close_1.en: You brought me something alive. Thank you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Close_1.ch: 你帶了個活的給我. 謝謝你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Close_1.cn: 你给我带了个活的. 谢谢你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Close_2.en: A tiny life. I'll protect it. Like you protect me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Close_2.ch: 小小的生命. 我會保護牠. 就像你保護我一樣.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Close_2.cn: 小小的生命. 我会保护它. 就像你保护我一样.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Close_3.en: I'll keep it. A little hope with fur.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Close_3.ch: 我會留著牠. 毛茸茸的小小希望.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Close_3.cn: 我会留着它. 毛茸茸的一点希望.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Near_1.ch: 活的東西. 在這種世道.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Near_1.cn: 活的东西. 在这种世道.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Near_2.en: Soft, small. I'll keep it close.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Near_2.ch: 軟軟的, 小小的. 我會把牠帶在身邊.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Near_2.cn: 软软的, 小小的. 我会把它带在身边.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Near_3.en: You thought to bring it to me.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Close_1.en: Bait. Tonight we might eat like kings.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Close_1.ch: 魚餌. 今晚我們說不定能吃得像國王一樣.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Close_1.cn: 鱼饵. 今晚我们说不定能吃得像国王一样.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Close_2.en: You bring the worms, I'll bring the patience.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Close_2.ch: 你負責蟲, 我負責耐心.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Close_2.cn: 你负责蚯蚓, 我负责耐心.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Close_3.en: I'll bait the line. You reel them in.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Close_3.ch: 我來掛餌. 你負責收線.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Close_3.cn: 我来挂饵. 你负责收线.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Far_1.ch: 魚餌. 那就是要釣魚了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Far_1.cn: 鱼饵. 那就是要钓鱼了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Far_3.en: I'll take it. Won't touch it more than I must.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Far_3.ch: 我收下了. 能不碰就不碰.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Far_3.cn: 我收下了. 能不碰就不碰.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Near_1.en: Bait? Good. Fish won't catch themselves.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Near_1.ch: 魚餌? 很好. 魚可不會自己上鉤.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Near_1.cn: 鱼饵? 好. 鱼可不会自己上钩.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Near_2.en: Worms and grubs. I'll bait the line.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Near_2.ch: 蚯蚓跟幼蟲. 我來掛餌.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Near_2.cn: 蚯蚓和幼虫. 我来挂饵.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Near_3.en: Useful. Just keep them off me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Near_3.ch: 有用. 只是別讓牠們碰到我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Near_3.cn: 有用. 只是别让它们碰到我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBattery_Close_1.en: You remembered I needed one. Thank you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBattery_Close_1.ch: 你記得我需要一顆. 謝謝你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBattery_Close_1.cn: 你记得我需要一节. 谢谢你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBattery_Close_2.en: A cell. You take care of me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBattery_Close_2.ch: 一顆電池. 你很照顧我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBattery_Close_2.cn: 一节电池. 你真照顾我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBattery_Close_3.en: I'll save it for when my light dies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBattery_Close_3.ch: 我先留著, 等燈沒電再用.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBattery_Close_3.cn: 我先留着, 等灯没电了再用.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBattery_Near_1.en: A battery? Thanks - this keeps my light alive.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBattery_Near_1.ch: 電池? 謝了, 這樣我的燈就不會熄了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBattery_Near_1.cn: 电池? 谢了, 这样我的灯就不会灭了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBattery_Near_2.ch: 很好, 一顆備用電池.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Close_1.en: Somewhere to sleep that isn't the ground.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Close_1.ch: 有個不用睡地上的地方了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Close_1.cn: 总算有个不用睡地上的地方了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Close_2.en: A tent. A little roof of our own.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Close_2.ch: 帳篷. 屬於我們的小屋頂.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Close_2.cn: 帐篷. 属于我们自己的小屋顶.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Close_3.ch: 謝謝你. 之後的夜晚會好過些.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Close_3.cn: 谢谢你. 以后的晚上会好过些.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Far_2.en: For the road, I take it.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Near_1.en: A tent? Good, my back's had enough.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Near_1.ch: 帳篷? 很好, 我的背已經受夠了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Near_1.cn: 帐篷? 好, 我的背已经受够了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Close_1.en: I'm not losing you to a cigarette. Not after everything.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Close_1.ch: 我不會讓一根菸奪走你. 經歷了這麼多, 絕對不行.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Close_1.cn: 我不会让一根烟把你夺走. 经历了这么多, 绝对不行.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Close_2.cn: 把那些放下. 求你了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Close_3.en: You survived the end of the world. Don't let this finish it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Close_3.ch: 你連世界末日都撐過來了. 別讓這東西要了你的命.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Close_3.cn: 你连世界末日都挺过来了. 别让这玩意儿要了你的命.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Far_1.en: Those will kill you. Faster than the dead will.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Far_1.ch: 那東西會害死你. 比死人還快.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Far_1.cn: 那东西会要了你的命. 比死人还快.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Far_2.en: Filthy habit. Keep them away from me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Far_2.ch: 噁心的習慣. 把那些拿遠一點, 別靠近我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Far_2.cn: 恶心的习惯. 把那些拿远点, 别靠近我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Far_3.ch: 不要. 我不幫你拿那種東西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Far_3.cn: 不要. 那种东西我不帮你拿.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Near_1.en: You're still smoking? After all this?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Near_1.ch: 你還在抽菸? 都這樣了還抽?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Near_1.cn: 你还在抽烟? 都这样了还抽?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Near_2.en: I'll hold them. I won't watch you use them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Near_2.ch: 我可以幫你拿著. 但我不會看著你抽.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Near_2.cn: 我可以帮你拿着. 但我不会看着你抽.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Near_3.en: That's a slow death. You know it is.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Near_3.ch: 那是慢性自殺. 你自己也知道.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Near_3.cn: 那是慢性自杀. 你自己心里清楚.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Close_1.en: A radio. Maybe the world's still out there.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Close_1.ch: 無線電. 也許外面的世界還在.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Close_1.cn: 无线电. 也许外面的世界还在.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Close_2.en: If anyone's left, we'll find them. Together.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Close_2.ch: 如果還有人活著, 我們會找到他們. 一起.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Close_2.cn: 要是还有人活着, 我们会找到他们. 一起.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Close_3.en: Thank you. A voice besides yours.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Close_3.ch: 謝謝你. 除了你之外, 總算能聽到別人的聲音.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Close_3.cn: 谢谢你. 除了你, 总算能听到别人的声音了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Near_1.en: A radio? We might reach someone.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Near_1.ch: 無線電? 說不定能聯絡上誰.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Near_1.cn: 无线电? 说不定能联系上谁.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Near_2.en: Good. Silence is worse than static.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Near_2.ch: 很好. 一片死寂比雜訊還難受.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Near_2.cn: 很好. 一片死寂比杂音还难受.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveContainer_Close.en: Room for your things too. You know that.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveContainer_Close.ch: 也有空間放你的東西. 你知道的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveContainer_Close.cn: 也有地方放你的东西. 你知道的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveContainer_Close.en: A box for our life. I'll keep it neat.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveContainer_Close.ch: 裝下我們生活的箱子. 我會整理得整整齊齊.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveContainer_Close.cn: 装下我们生活的箱子. 我会收拾得整整齐齐.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveContainer_Close.en: Thank you. More hands, more pockets.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveContainer_Close.ch: 謝謝你. 多一雙手, 就多幾個口袋.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveContainer_Close.cn: 谢谢你. 多一双手, 就多几个兜.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveContainer_Near_.ch: 這下我能多帶點東西了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveContainer_Near_.cn: 这下我能多带点东西了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Close_1.en: You want a real dinner. So do I.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Close_1.ch: 你想吃頓像樣的晚餐. 我也是.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Close_1.cn: 你想吃顿像样的晚饭. 我也是.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Close_2.en: I'll cook. You eat. That's the deal.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Close_2.ch: 我煮. 你吃. 就這麼說定了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Close_2.cn: 我做饭. 你吃. 就这么说定了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Close_3.en: Thank you. Let's make this place a home.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Close_3.ch: 謝謝你. 我們把這裡變成一個家吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Close_3.cn: 谢谢你. 咱们把这里变成一个家吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Near_1.en: A pot or a pan? Now we eat better.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Near_1.ch: 是鍋子還是平底鍋? 這下能吃好一點了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Near_1.cn: 是锅还是平底锅? 这下能吃得好点了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Near_2.ch: 很好. 又能吃正餐了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Near_2.cn: 很好. 又能吃上正经饭了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Close_1.en: A body. I don't like this, and I don't like it near you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Close_1.ch: 屍體. 我不喜歡這樣, 更不喜歡它靠近你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Close_1.cn: 尸体. 我不喜欢这样, 更不喜欢它靠近你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Close_2.en: Why would you hand me this? Get it away.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Close_2.ch: 你為什麼要把這個交給我? 拿開.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Close_2.cn: 你干嘛把这个塞给我? 拿开.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Close_3.en: No. Not this. Not after everything.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Close_3.ch: 不要. 不要這個. 都經歷這麼多了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Close_3.cn: 不要. 不要这个. 都经历这么多了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Near_3.en: Bury it or drop it. Not on me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Near_3.ch: 埋了或丟了都行. 別放我身上.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Near_3.cn: 埋了或者扔了都行. 别放我身上.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Clo.ch: 你在做什麼東西吧. 我來幫忙.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Clo.cn: 你在捣鼓什么东西吧. 我来帮忙.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Clo.en: Little pieces, bigger plans. I see you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Clo.ch: 小零件, 大計畫. 我都看在眼裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Clo.cn: 小零件, 大计划. 我都看在眼里.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Clo.en: Thank you. I'll keep it safe.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Clo.ch: 謝謝你. 我會好好收著.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Clo.cn: 谢谢你. 我会好好收着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Far.ch: 電子零件. 有人在搞什麼計畫吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Far.cn: 电子元件. 有人在搞什么名堂吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Nea.en: Parts for something. I'll hang onto it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Nea.ch: 某樣東西的零件. 我先收著.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Nea.cn: 某样东西的零件. 我先收着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Nea.ch: 說不定哪天能幫什麼東西供電.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Nea.cn: 说不定哪天能给什么东西供电.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Nea.ch: 很好. 我們會需要一些小裝置.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Nea.cn: 很好. 我们会用得上小玩意儿.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Clos.en: You keep us warm. I notice.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Clos.ch: 你讓我們保持溫暖. 我都有注意到.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Clos.cn: 你让我们不挨冻. 我都注意到了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Clos.en: Fire and food. You think ahead.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Clos.ch: 有火, 就有熱食. 你想得真遠.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Clos.cn: 有火, 就有热饭. 你想得真远.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Clos.en: Thank you. Safety, handed to me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Clos.ch: 謝謝你. 你把安全親手交給了我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Clos.cn: 谢谢你. 你亲手把安全交给了我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Near.en: A way to make fire. That matters.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Near.ch: 能生火的東西. 這很重要.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Near.cn: 能生火的东西. 这很重要.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Near.ch: 很好. 接下來的夜晚會很冷.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Near.cn: 很好. 往后的夜里会很冷.
我会把它放在干燥的地方.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Close_1.en: You and me, then. A quiet river.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Close_1.ch: 那就你跟我. 一條安靜的河.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Close_1.cn: 那就你和我. 一条安静的河.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Close_2.ch: 晚餐我來釣. 你看著就好.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Close_2.cn: 晚饭我来钓. 你看着就行.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Close_3.en: Thank you. A slow day sounds like heaven.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Close_3.ch: 謝謝你. 悠閒的一天聽起來就像天堂.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Close_3.cn: 谢谢你. 悠闲的一天听着就像天堂.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Near_1.en: A rod? Been a while since I fished.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Near_1.ch: 釣竿? 我好久沒釣魚了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Near_1.cn: 鱼竿? 我好久没钓鱼了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Near_2.en: Good. Quiet days by the water.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Near_2.ch: 很好. 在水邊過安靜的日子.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Near_2.cn: 很好. 在水边过安静的日子.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Near_3.en: I'll try not to fall in.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFun_Close_2.en: A game. I'll go easy on you. Maybe.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFun_Close_2.ch: 遊戲. 我會手下留情. 大概吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFun_Close_2.cn: 游戏. 我会手下留情. 大概吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFun_Close_3.en: Thank you. Normal, for an hour.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFun_Close_3.ch: 謝謝你. 能正常過上一個小時.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFun_Close_3.cn: 谢谢你. 能正常地过上一个小时.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFun_Near_1.ch: 好玩的? 好久沒有了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFun_Near_1.cn: 好玩的? 好久没有了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Close.en: You're making a home. I noticed.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Close.ch: 你在布置一個家. 我都注意到了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Close.cn: 你在布置一个家. 我都注意到了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Close.en: A place to sit. With you. Finally.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Close.ch: 能坐下來的地方. 跟你一起. 終於.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Close.cn: 能坐下来的地方. 和你一起. 终于.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Close.en: Thank you. This is what staying looks like.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Close.ch: 謝謝你. 這就是留下來的樣子.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Close.cn: 谢谢你. 这就是留下来的样子.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Near_.en: A chair? Good, we're not savages.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Near_.ch: 椅子? 很好, 我們又不是野人.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Near_.cn: 椅子? 很好, 咱们又不是野人.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Near_.en: Something to make a room feel lived in.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Near_.ch: 能讓房間有點人住的感覺.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Near_.en: I'll find a place for it.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGardening_Close.en: You want to grow things with me.
A garden. Somewhere to stay. With you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGardening_Close.ch: 花園. 一個能留下來的地方. 跟你一起.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGardening_Close.cn: 花园. 一个能留下来的地方. 和你一起.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGardening_Close.en: Thank you. I'll grow us something.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGardening_Close.ch: 謝謝你. 我會幫我們種點東西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGardening_Close.cn: 谢谢你. 我会给咱们种点东西.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGardening_Near_.ch: 很好. 總算有活的東西可以照顧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGardening_Near_.cn: 很好. 总算有活物可以照料.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Close.en: You're making this ours, piece by piece.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Close.ch: 你一點一點地把這裡變成我們的地方.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Close.cn: 你一点一点地把这里变成我们的地方.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Close.en: Little things for the house. I notice.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Close.ch: 家裡用的小東西. 我都有注意到.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Close.cn: 家里用的小东西. 我都注意到了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Close.en: Thank you. It feels like a home already.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Close.ch: 謝謝你. 已經有家的感覺了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Close.cn: 谢谢你. 已经有家的感觉了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Near_.en: Home things. Good, we're settling in.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Near_.ch: 居家用品. 很好, 我們漸漸安頓下來了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Near_.cn: 居家用品. 很好, 我们在慢慢安顿下来了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Near_.en: I'll find a place for it.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Clos.en: You thought of me when you saw this.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Clos.ch: 你看到這個就想到我了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Clos.cn: 你看到这个就想到我了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Clos.en: I'll play for you. Only you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Clos.ch: 我會為你演奏. 只為你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Clos.cn: 我会为你演奏. 只为你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Clos.en: Thank you. You gave me back a part of myself.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Clos.ch: 謝謝你. 你讓我找回了一部分的自己.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Clos.cn: 谢谢你. 你让我找回了一部分自己.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Near.ch: 音樂? 我差點都忘了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Near.cn: 音乐? 我差点都忘了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Near.ch: 不錯. 晚上有事做了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Near.cn: 不错. 晚上有点事做了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Near.ch: 我會練練看. 你別聽.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Close_1.en: You still see someone worth prettifying.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Close_2.en: A little color before the world ends. I'll take it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Close_2.ch: 世界末日前添點顏色. 我收下了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Close_2.cn: 世界末日前添点颜色. 我收下了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Close_3.en: Thank you. I'd forgotten about this part of me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Close_3.ch: 謝謝你. 我都忘了自己還有這一面.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Close_3.cn: 谢谢你. 我都忘了自己还有这一面.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Near_1.ch: 化妝品. 這時候送這個有點怪.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Near_1.cn: 化妆品. 这时候送这个有点怪.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Near_2.en: You and me, then. A little fun.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Near_2.ch: 那就你跟我. 找點樂子.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Near_2.cn: 那就你和我. 找点乐子.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Close_1.en: A map. Let's find someplace better.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Close_1.ch: 地圖. 我們去找個更好的地方吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Close_1.cn: 地图. 我们去找个更好的地方吧.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Close_2.en: We'll trace a road out of here together.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Close_2.ch: 我們一起在上面畫條路, 離開這裡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Close_2.cn: 我们一起在上面画条路, 离开这里.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Close_3.en: Thank you. I like knowing where we stand.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Close_3.ch: 謝謝你. 我喜歡知道我們身在何處.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Close_3.cn: 谢谢你. 我喜欢知道我们身在何处.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Far_2.en: Now we know where we're going.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Near_1.ch: 地圖? 很好. 不用亂猜了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Near_1.cn: 地图? 很好. 不用瞎猜了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Near_2.ch: 我會標出我們去過的地方.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Near_2.cn: 我会标出我们去过的地方.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Close_.en: You bring home the pieces and I'll make them fit.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Close_.ch: 你負責把材料帶回來, 我負責把它們拼起來.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Close_.cn: 你负责把材料带回来, 我负责把它们拼起来.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Close_.en: Good — we rebuild a little at a time.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Close_.ch: 很好, 我們一點一點重建.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Close_.cn: 很好, 我们一点一点重建.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Close_.ch: 每塊廢料都派得上用場. 謝謝你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Close_.cn: 每块废料都用得上. 谢谢你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Far_1.ch: 廢料. 總會找到用處.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Far_1.cn: 废料. 总能找到用处.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Near_1.en: Wood or metal — either way, useful.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Near_1.ch: 木頭還是金屬, 都有用.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Near_1.cn: 木头还是金属, 都有用.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Near_2.en: Now we can patch something up.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Near_2.ch: 這下可以修補點東西了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Near_3.en: I'll sort it with the rest.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Near_3.ch: 我會跟其他東西放一起整理.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Near_3.cn: 我会跟其他东西一起归置好.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Close_1.en: You found something worth keeping. For me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Close_1.ch: 你找到值得珍藏的東西. 而且是給我的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Close_1.cn: 你找到值得珍藏的东西. 而且是给我的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Close_2.en: I'll keep it close. Like I keep you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Close_2.ch: 我會把它帶在身邊. 就像我把你留在身邊.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Close_2.cn: 我会把它带在身边. 就像把你留在身边一样.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Close_3.en: Thank you. Proof the world was real.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Close_3.ch: 謝謝你. 證明那個世界真的存在過.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Close_3.cn: 谢谢你. 证明那个世界真的存在过.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Near_1.en: A memento. I'll keep it safe.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Near_1.ch: 紀念物. 我會好好收著.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Near_1.cn: 纪念物. 我会好好收着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Near_2.en: Good to remember there was a before.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Near_2.ch: 能想起從前的日子也好.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Near_2.cn: 能想起从前的日子也好.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Close_1.en: Paint. We cover the blood with something brighter.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Close_1.ch: 油漆. 用亮一點的顏色蓋掉血跡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Close_1.cn: 油漆. 用亮一点的颜色盖掉血迹.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Close_2.en: A fresh coat hides a lot. Around here, that's useful.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Close_2.ch: 刷層新漆能遮掉很多東西. 在這種地方很有用.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Close_2.cn: 刷层新漆能盖住很多东西. 在这种地方很有用.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Close_3.en: Thank you. Better to paint the walls than explain them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Close_3.ch: 謝謝你. 與其解釋牆上的東西, 不如把它漆掉.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Close_3.cn: 谢谢你. 与其解释墙上的东西, 不如把它刷掉.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Near_1.en: Paint? Good. The walls need it. So does the floor.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Near_1.ch: 油漆? 很好. 牆壁需要. 地板也是.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Near_1.cn: 油漆? 很好. 墙需要. 地板也是.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Near_2.en: A fresh coat. Nobody asks what's under it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Near_2.ch: 刷層新漆. 沒人會問底下是什麼.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Near_2.cn: 刷层新漆. 没人会问底下是什么.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Near_3.en: I'll take a brush to this place.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSecurity_Close_.en: You want us safe. I want that too.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSecurity_Close_.ch: 你想讓我們安全. 我也是.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSecurity_Close_.cn: 你想让我们安全. 我也是.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSecurity_Close_.en: Locks between us and them. Thank you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSecurity_Close_.ch: 我們跟它們之間多了道鎖. 謝謝你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSecurity_Close_.cn: 我们和它们之间多了道锁. 谢谢你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSecurity_Close_.en: I'll sleep better with this in place.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSecurity_Close_.ch: 裝上這個, 我會睡得比較安穩.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSecurity_Close_.cn: 装上这个, 我能睡得更踏实.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSecurity_Near_1.en: Good. The door's been too easy.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSecurity_Near_1.ch: 很好. 那扇門太容易打開了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSecurity_Near_1.cn: 很好. 那扇门太好开了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Close_1.en: You and me, then. First to ten.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Close_1.ch: 那就你跟我. 先拿十分的贏.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Close_1.cn: 那就你和我. 先到十分的赢.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Close_2.en: I haven't run for fun in years.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Close_2.ch: 我好幾年沒有單純為了好玩跑步了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Close_2.cn: 我好几年没为了好玩跑步了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Close_3.en: Thank you. It feels good to play.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Close_3.ch: 謝謝你. 玩一玩感覺真好.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Close_3.cn: 谢谢你. 玩一玩感觉真好.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Near_1.ch: 球? 我們可以玩一下.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Near_1.cn: 球? 我们可以玩一会儿.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Near_2.ch: 很好. 有理由動一動了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Near_2.cn: 很好. 有理由动一动了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTeddy_Close_1.en: You thought of me. Soft, fragile me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTeddy_Close_1.ch: 你想到我了. 心軟又脆弱的我.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTeddy_Close_1.cn: 你想到我了. 心软又脆弱的我.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTeddy_Close_2.en: I'll hold it when it's bad. Don't tell.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTeddy_Close_2.ch: 難熬的時候我會抱著它. 別說出去.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTeddy_Close_2.cn: 难熬的时候我会抱着它. 别说出去.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTeddy_Close_3.en: Thank you. It helps more than you know.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTeddy_Close_3.ch: 謝謝你. 它比你想的更有幫助.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTeddy_Close_3.cn: 谢谢你. 它比你想象的更管用.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTeddy_Near_1.ch: 軟綿綿的東西. 晚上用得上.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTeddy_Near_1.cn: 软绵绵的东西. 晚上用得上.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Close_.en: You want us fed without a fight. I like that.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Close_.ch: 你想讓我們不用拚命就有得吃. 我喜歡.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Close_.cn: 你想让我们不用拼命就有饭吃. 我喜欢.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Close_.en: I'll set them. You check them. Deal?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Close_.ch: 我來放. 你來巡. 成交?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Close_.cn: 我来放. 你来查. 成交?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Close_.en: Thank you. A clever kind of patience.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Close_.ch: 謝謝你. 一種聰明的耐心.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Close_.cn: 谢谢你. 一种聪明的耐心.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Near_1.en: A trap? Smart. Food that comes to us.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Near_1.ch: 陷阱? 聰明. 讓食物自己送上門.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Near_1.cn: 陷阱? 聪明. 让食物自己送上门.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Near_2.ch: 很好. 少走點路, 多吃點東西.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Near_2.cn: 很好. 少走点路, 多吃点东西.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Close_1.ch: 真大膽. 我喜歡大膽的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Close_1.cn: 真大胆. 我喜欢大胆的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Close_2.en: For me? Careful — I might take that as a hint.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Close_2.ch: 給我的? 小心點, 我可能會當成你在暗示什麼.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Close_2.cn: 给我的? 小心点, 我可能会当成你在暗示什么.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Close_3.en: Well then. You have my attention.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Close_3.ch: 這樣啊. 你成功引起我的注意了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Close_3.cn: 这样啊. 你成功引起我的注意了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Far_1.en: Why are you giving me this?

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Far_2.en: I don't know you well enough for that.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Far_2.ch: 我跟你還沒熟到那種程度.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Far_2.cn: 我跟你还没熟到那个份上.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Far_3.ch: 把那些收起來. 拜託.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Far_3.cn: 把那些收起来. 拜托.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Near_1.en: That's... unexpected. I'll take them anyway.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Near_1.ch: 這… 真意外. 我還是收下了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Near_1.cn: 这… 真意外. 我还是收下了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Near_2.en: You're brazen. I'll allow it. Once.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Near_2.ch: 你臉皮真厚. 我准了. 就這一次.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Near_2.cn: 你脸皮真厚. 我准了. 就这一次.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Near_3.en: I don't know what to say to that.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveVehiclePart_Clo.en: You want us moving again. I'm with you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveVehiclePart_Clo.ch: 你想讓我們再次上路. 我跟你一起.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveVehiclePart_Clo.cn: 你想让我们再次上路. 我跟你一起.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveVehiclePart_Clo.en: A part for the car. A way out. Thank you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveVehiclePart_Clo.ch: 車子的零件. 一條出路. 謝謝你.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveVehiclePart_Clo.cn: 车的零件. 一条出路. 谢谢你.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveVehiclePart_Nea.en: Auto parts. So we're fixing something.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveVehiclePart_Nea.ch: 車用零件. 看來我們要修東西了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveVehiclePart_Nea.cn: 车用零件. 看来我们要修东西了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveVehiclePart_Nea.en: Good. Maybe it runs after this.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveVehiclePart_Nea.ch: 很好. 裝上去說不定就能跑了.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveVehiclePart_Nea.cn: 很好. 装上说不定就能开了.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Clos.en: Another piece for the guns I won't touch.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Clos.ch: 又一個槍的零件, 那些槍我是不會碰的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Clos.cn: 又一个枪的零件, 那些枪我可不会碰.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Clos.en: It's for you, not me. I'll hold it anyway.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Clos.ch: 這是給你用的, 不是給我. 我先幫你拿著.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Clos.cn: 这是给你用的, 不是给我. 我先帮你拿着.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Clos.en: I don't like these. But I like that you carry them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Clos.ch: 我不喜歡這些東西. 但我喜歡你帶著它們.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Clos.cn: 我不喜欢这些东西. 但我喜欢你带着它们.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Far_.en: A gun part? I don't shoot.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Far_.ch: 槍枝零件? 我不開槍的.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Far_.cn: 枪械零件? 我不开枪的.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Near.en: Weapon parts. You and your guns.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Near.ch: 武器零件. 你跟你的槍啊.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Near.cn: 武器零件. 你和你那些枪啊.

IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Near.ch: 我就不用了. 但你留著吧.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Near.cn: 我就不用了. 但你留着吧.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsFloatingAutoClose_To.en:
Closes a floating bag window when you walk away from where the bag is: on the floor, inside a crate or on a corpse.

Bags you carry never close. Pinned windows close too.

Off: windows stay open until you close them.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsFloatingAutoClose_To.ch:
當你走離背包所在的位置時, 自動關閉該浮動背包視窗: 地上、箱子裡或屍體上的背包.

你身上攜帶的背包永遠不會關閉. 已固定的視窗也會關閉.

關閉: 視窗會保持開啟, 直到你自行關閉.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsFloatingAutoClose_To.cn:
当你走离背包所在的位置时, 自动关闭该浮动背包窗口: 地上、箱子里或尸体上的背包.

你身上携带的背包永远不会关闭. 已固定的窗口也会关闭.

关闭: 窗口会保持打开, 直到你自行关闭.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsIconRotation_Tooltip.en:
Draws item sprites with the rotation, scale and anchor tuned for the mod, so tools, clothes and bottles sit nicely in their cells.

On (default): tuned sprites.

Off: plain sprites, only the footprint size applies. Slightly faster to render.

This is a per-machine visual setting; each player chooses their own.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsIconRotation_Tooltip.ch:
以針對本模組調校過的旋轉、縮放與錨點繪製物品圖示, 讓工具、衣服和瓶子在格子中擺得整齊好看.

開啟 (預設): 調校過的圖示.

關閉: 一般圖示, 只套用占位尺寸. 算繪稍快.

這是各電腦獨立的視覺設定; 每位玩家可自行選擇.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsIconRotation_Tooltip.cn:
以针对本模组调整过的旋转、缩放与锚点绘制物品图标, 让工具、衣服和瓶子在格子中摆得整齐美观.

开启 (默认): 调整过的图标.

关闭: 普通图标, 只应用占位尺寸. 渲染稍快.

这是各电脑独立的视觉设置; 每位玩家可自行选择.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsItemInfo_Tooltip.en:
Shows extra info inside each item: the ammo count of magazines.

Off: items show only their icon, as before.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsItemInfo_Tooltip.ch:
在每個物品內顯示額外資訊: 彈匣的彈藥數量.

關閉: 物品只顯示圖示, 與之前相同.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsItemInfo_Tooltip.cn:
在每个物品内显示额外信息: 弹匣的弹药数量.

关闭: 物品只显示图标, 与之前相同.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsItemWeight_Tooltip.en:
Shows each item's weight in its top-right corner; for a pile, the total of the pile.

Needs Item info on. Turn off for slightly faster rendering.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsItemWeight_Tooltip.ch:
在每個物品的右上角顯示其重量; 若是一疊物品, 則顯示整疊的總重.

需開啟「物品資訊」. 關閉可讓算繪稍快.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsItemWeight_Tooltip.cn:
在每个物品的右上角显示其重量; 若是一叠物品, 则显示整叠的总重.

需开启“物品信息”. 关闭可让渲染稍快.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMultiLootCorpsesOnly.en:
Shows several containers at once only for corpses. Crates, shelves, fridges and the floor show just the one you selected.

The 'Max World Containers' limit still applies to the corpses. Better performance in bases full of containers.

Needs 'Show all loot containers' on.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMultiLootCorpsesOnly.ch:
只有屍體會同時顯示多個容器. 箱子、貨架、冰箱和地面只顯示你選取的那一個.

「世界容器上限」仍會套用到屍體. 在滿是容器的基地中效能更佳.

需開啟「顯示所有戰利品容器」.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMultiLootCorpsesOnly.cn:
只有尸体会同时显示多个容器. 箱子、货架、冰箱和地面只显示你选中的那一个.

“世界容器上限”仍会应用于尸体. 在满是容器的基地中性能更佳.

需开启“显示所有战利品容器”.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsTextShadow_Tooltip.en:
Draws a dark shadow under the small texts inside items (weight, ammo, stack count) so they read better over bright sprites.

Off (default): plain text. On: each text is drawn twice, which costs some FPS.

This is a per-machine visual setting.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsTextShadow_Tooltip.ch:
在物品內的小字 (重量, 彈藥, 堆疊數量) 下方繪製深色陰影, 讓它們在明亮的圖示上更容易閱讀.

關閉 (預設): 一般文字. 開啟: 每段文字都會繪製兩次, 會消耗一些 FPS.

這是各電腦獨立的視覺設定.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsTextShadow_Tooltip.cn:
在物品内的小字 (重量, 弹药, 堆叠数量) 下方绘制深色阴影, 让它们在明亮的图标上更容易阅读.

关闭 (默认): 普通文字. 开启: 每段文字都会绘制两次, 会消耗一些 FPS.

这是各电脑独立的视觉设置.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsTopBar_Tooltip.en:
Reserves a bar above the inventory and loot grids for search, category filter and auto-sort.

Off: the grids use the full height, as before.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsTopBar_Tooltip.ch:
在物品欄與戰利品網格上方保留一列, 用於搜尋、類別篩選與自動整理.

關閉: 網格使用完整高度, 與之前相同.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsTopBar_Tooltip.cn:
在物品栏与战利品网格上方预留一栏, 用于搜索、类别筛选与自动整理.

关闭: 网格使用完整高度, 与之前相同.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsInspectOnRightClick.cn: 物品菜单附带 3D 预览

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsInspectOnRightClick_.en:
Opening an item's context menu (right click) also shows a 3D preview of the item and its tooltip next to the menu. The menu itself is the game's own.

On by default. Off: only the normal menu. The Inspect (3D) mouse action works either way and shows just the 3D view and tooltip, without the menu.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsInspectOnRightClick_.ch:
開啟物品的右鍵選單 (右鍵點選) 時, 也會在選單旁顯示該物品的 3D 預覽及其提示框. 選單本身是遊戲原有的.

預設開啟. 關閉: 只顯示一般選單. 滑鼠動作「檢視 (3D)」不論開啟與否都能使用, 且只顯示 3D 視圖與提示框, 不含選單.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsInspectOnRightClick_.cn:
打开物品的右键菜单 (右键点击) 时, 也会在菜单旁显示该物品的 3D 预览及其提示框. 菜单本身是游戏原有的.

默认开启. 关闭: 只显示普通菜单. 鼠标动作“查看 (3D)”无论开启与否都能使用, 且只显示 3D 视图和提示框, 不含菜单.

IGUI_DD_LevelEffects_tooltip.en: Exact numbers for what the level you are hovering gives, such as the health added to everything you build or a weapon skill's damage bonus, read out of the game's own code.
IGUI_DD_LevelEffects_tooltip.ch: 游標所指等級提供之效果的確切數值, 例如所有建造物增加的耐久, 或武器技能的傷害加成, 皆直接讀取自遊戲本身的程式碼.
IGUI_DD_LevelEffects_tooltip.cn: 鼠标悬停的等级所提供效果的确切数值, 例如所有建造物增加的耐久, 或武器技能的伤害加成, 均直接读取自游戏本身的代码.

IGUI_DD_ListLimit_tooltip.en: How many entries a list shows before the rest are summed up on one line. A carpenter knows nineteen recipes, which makes for a very tall tooltip.
IGUI_DD_ListLimit_tooltip.ch: 清單顯示多少項目後, 其餘項目改以一行彙總. 木匠會十九種配方, 會讓工具提示變得非常長.
IGUI_DD_ListLimit_tooltip.cn: 列表显示多少条目后, 其余条目合并为一行汇总. 木匠知道十九种配方, 会让工具提示变得非常长.

IGUI_DD_Own_tooltip.en: On, every skill, trait and occupation this mod has written a line for uses that line, so the wording is the same throughout and no numbers are quoted that a rebalance mod may have changed. Off, the game's own description is used wherever there is one, and this mod only fills in the blanks.

IGUI_DD_Own_tooltip.cn: 开启时, 凡是本模组写有说明的技能、特质和职业都会改用该说明, 使措辞前后一致, 也不会引用可能已被平衡调整模组改动的数值. 关闭时, 只要游戏本身有说明就沿用, 本模组只补充缺失的部分.

IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_deliverydriver.en: Lives behind the wheel, and knows every shortcut.

IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_deliverydriver.cn: 整天握着方向盘, 熟悉每一条捷径.

IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_federalofficer.en: Trained, armed, and used to walking towards trouble.
IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_federalofficer.ch: 受過訓練、配有武器, 也習慣迎向麻煩.
IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_federalofficer.cn: 训练有素、配有武器, 也习惯迎着麻烦走去.

IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_mason.en: Lays stone and brick for a living.

IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_mortician.en: Prepares the dead for burial, and thinks nothing of it.
IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_mortician.ch: 為死者做下葬前的整理, 且毫不在意.
IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_mortician.cn: 为死者做下葬前的整理, 而且毫不在意.

IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_privateinvestigator.en: Paid to follow people who would rather not be followed.
IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_privateinvestigator.ch: 受僱跟蹤那些不想被跟蹤的人.
IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_privateinvestigator.cn: 受雇跟踪那些不想被跟踪的人.

IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_tailor.en: Cuts and stitches cloth for a living.

IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_waiter.en: On their feet all shift, carrying more than looks sensible.
IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_waiter.ch: 整個班都站著, 端著多到不太合理的東西.
IGUI_DD_P_mar_mar_waiter.cn: 整个班都站着, 端着多得不太合理的东西.

IGUI_DD_P_rr_railroader.en: Drove and looked after locomotives for a living.
IGUI_DD_P_rr_railroader.ch: 曾以駕駛與保養火車頭維生.
IGUI_DD_P_rr_railroader.cn: 曾靠驾驶和保养机车为生.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_animalcontrolofficer.en: Paid to catch animals that would rather not be caught.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_animalcontrolofficer.ch: 受僱捕捉那些不想被抓的動物.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_animalcontrolofficer.cn: 受雇捕捉那些不想被抓的动物.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_botanist.en: Grows plants, and knows how to tell one from another.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_botanist.ch: 栽培植物, 也懂得分辨各種植物.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_botanist.cn: 栽培植物, 也懂得分辨各种植物.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_butcher.en: Breaks down carcasses for a living.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_campcounselor.en: Kept a camp full of children fed, patched up and entertained.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_campcounselor.ch: 曾讓滿營的孩子吃飽、包紮好傷口, 還玩得開心.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_campcounselor.cn: 曾让满营地的孩子吃饱、处理好伤口, 还玩得开心.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_criminal.en: Made a living outside the law.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_dancer.en: Trained to move with balance and control.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_dancer.ch: 受過訓練, 動作平衡而有控制.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_dancer.cn: 受过训练, 动作平衡而有控制.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_deliveryman.en: Spends the day on foot between doorsteps.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_deliveryman.ch: 整天徒步往返於各家門口.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_deliveryman.cn: 整天步行往返于各家门口.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_detective.en: Trained to follow a trail, and to stay unnoticed on it.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_detective.ch: 受過追查線索的訓練, 且能在追蹤時不被察覺.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_detective.cn: 受过追查线索的训练, 追踪时也不会被察觉.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_dragracer.en: Lives for speed, and knows the car that delivers it.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_dragracer.ch: 為速度而活, 也懂得哪種車能帶來速度.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_dragracer.cn: 为速度而活, 也懂得什么车能带来速度.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_gasstationoperator.en: Pumps the fuel, and handles the small repairs.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_gasstationoperator.ch: 負責加油, 也處理小型維修.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_gasstationoperator.cn: 负责加油, 也处理小修小补.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_gravedigger.en: Digs the graves, and handles the dead.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_gravedigger.ch: 挖掘墳墓, 也處理死者.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_gravedigger.cn: 挖坟墓, 也处理死者.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_huntsman.en: Lives off what they can track, shoot and trap.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_huntsman.ch: 靠追蹤、射擊與設陷阱得來的獵物維生.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_huntsman.cn: 靠追踪、射击和设陷阱得来的猎物过活.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_janitor.en: Cleans and maintains other people's buildings.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_janitor.ch: 清潔並維護別人的建築.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_janitor.cn: 清洁并维护别人的建筑.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_junkyardworker.en: Strips wrecks, and welds the useful parts back together.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_junkyardworker.ch: 拆解報廢車輛, 再把有用的零件焊回一起.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_junkyardworker.cn: 拆解报废车辆, 再把有用的零件焊到一起.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_lifeguard.en: Watches the water, and pulls people out of it.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_lifeguard.ch: 看守水域, 把人從水裡救上來.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_lifeguard.cn: 看守水域, 把人从水里救上来.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_miner.en: Works underground with a pick and a shovel.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_miner.ch: 拿著鎬頭與鏟子在地下工作.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_miner.cn: 拿着镐头和铲子在地下干活.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_paparazzi.ch: 能悄悄接近而不被發現.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_paparazzi.cn: 能悄悄靠近而不被发现.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_priest.en: Spends the days quietly among a congregation.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_priest.ch: 每天靜靜地與會眾相處.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_priest.cn: 每天静静地与会众相处.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_schoolteacher.en: Spends the day keeping a classroom in order.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_soldier.en: Trained to fight, to shoot, and to keep going.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_soldier.ch: 受過戰鬥與射擊訓練, 也懂得堅持下去.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_soldier.cn: 受过战斗和射击训练, 也懂得坚持下去.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_storeemployee.en: Stocks the shelves, and keeps a shop running.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_storeemployee.ch: 負責上架補貨, 維持商店運作.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_storeemployee.cn: 负责上架补货, 维持商店运营.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_stuntman.en: Paid to fall over and get back up.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_truckdriver.en: Long hours behind the wheel, and the know-how to keep it rolling.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_truckdriver.ch: 長時間握著方向盤, 也懂得讓車子持續上路.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_truckdriver.cn: 长时间握着方向盘, 也懂得让车子一直跑下去.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_veterinarian.en: Treats animals, and knows how they are put together.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_veterinarian.ch: 治療動物, 也了解牠們的身體構造.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_veterinarian.cn: 治疗动物, 也了解它们的身体构造.

IGUI_DD_P_soto_weightliftinginstructor.en: Spends the working day lifting heavy things.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_weightliftinginstructor.ch: 整個工作日都在舉重物.
IGUI_DD_P_soto_weightliftinginstructor.cn: 整个工作日都在举重物.

IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_footballplayer.en: Played football, and runs like it.
IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_footballplayer.ch: 打過美式足球, 跑起來也有那個架勢.
IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_footballplayer.cn: 打过美式橄榄球, 跑起来也有那股劲.

IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_pizzacourier.en: Raced pizzas across town before they went cold.
IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_pizzacourier.ch: 曾在披薩變冷前飛奔穿越市區送達.
IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_pizzacourier.cn: 曾赶在披萨变凉前飞奔穿过城区送达.

IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_privateeye.en: Tailed people and dug up secrets for a fee.
IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_privateeye.ch: 收費跟蹤他人、挖掘秘密.
IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_privateeye.cn: 收费跟踪别人、挖掘秘密.

IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_scientist.en: Worked in a lab, and picks up new things fast.
IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_scientist.ch: 曾在實驗室工作, 學新東西很快.
IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_scientist.cn: 曾在实验室工作, 学新东西很快.

IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_wanderer.en: Lived off the land, always on the move.
IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_wanderer.ch: 靠山野為生, 始終四處漂泊.
IGUI_DD_P_squaregrail_wanderer.cn: 靠山野为生, 总是四处漂泊.

IGUI_DD_PlainText_tooltip.en: Leaves out colours and indentation, for screens that print descriptions as plain text or on a light background.
IGUI_DD_PlainText_tooltip.ch: 省略顏色與縮排, 適用於以純文字或淺色背景顯示說明的畫面.
IGUI_DD_PlainText_tooltip.cn: 省略颜色和缩进, 适用于以纯文本或浅色背景显示说明的界面.

IGUI_DD_ProfessionTooltips_tooltip.en: Off, occupations show the game's own description and the options below leave them alone.
IGUI_DD_ProfessionTooltips_tooltip.ch: 關閉時, 職業會顯示遊戲本身的說明, 下方選項也不會套用到職業.
IGUI_DD_ProfessionTooltips_tooltip.cn: 关闭时, 职业会显示游戏本身的说明, 下方选项也不会作用于职业.

IGUI_DD_Recipes_tooltip.en: Recipes you already know. These lists are long for the crafting occupations, so this is the first heading to turn off if the tooltips get too tall.
IGUI_DD_Recipes_tooltip.ch: 你已經學會的配方. 製作類職業的這份清單很長, 若工具提示變得太長, 最先該關閉的就是這個標題.
IGUI_DD_Recipes_tooltip.cn: 你已经学会的配方. 制作类职业的这份列表很长, 如果工具提示太长, 首先应关闭的就是这个标题.

IGUI_DD_SE_AMReloading_1.en: Handloading at the bench takes less time with every level.
IGUI_DD_SE_AMReloading_1.ch: 每升一級, 在彈藥復裝台自製彈藥的時間都會縮短.
IGUI_DD_SE_AMReloading_1.cn: 每升一级, 在装填台自制弹药的时间都会缩短.

IGUI_DD_SE_AMReloading_2.en: The bench needs at least one level before it will work at all.
IGUI_DD_SE_AMReloading_2.ch: 至少需要 1 級, 才能使用彈藥復裝台.
IGUI_DD_SE_AMReloading_2.cn: 至少需要 1 级才能使用装填台.

IGUI_DD_SE_Aiming_1.en: Shots land more often and stay accurate further out.
IGUI_DD_SE_Aiming_1.ch: 射擊更常命中, 遠距離也能保持準度.
IGUI_DD_SE_Aiming_1.cn: 射击更常命中, 远距离也能保持精度.

IGUI_DD_SE_Aiming_2.en: The sway settles faster after each shot and the spread tightens.
IGUI_DD_SE_Aiming_2.ch: 每次射擊後晃動更快穩定, 散布也更集中.
IGUI_DD_SE_Aiming_2.cn: 每次射击后晃动更快稳定, 散布也更集中.

IGUI_DD_SE_Art_1.en: Sculpting and painting actions finish faster.
IGUI_DD_SE_Art_1.ch: 雕塑與繪畫動作完成得更快.
IGUI_DD_SE_Art_1.cn: 雕塑和绘画动作完成得更快.

IGUI_DD_SE_Art_2.en: Bigger canvases and new kinds of sculpture open up as it rises.
IGUI_DD_SE_Art_2.ch: 隨著技能提升, 可使用更大的畫布, 並解鎖新的雕塑種類.
IGUI_DD_SE_Art_2.cn: 随着技能提升, 可以使用更大的画布, 并解锁新的雕塑种类.

IGUI_DD_SE_Axe_1.en: Swings land more often and crit more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_Axe_1.ch: 揮擊更常命中, 也更常暴擊.
IGUI_DD_SE_Axe_1.cn: 挥击更常命中, 也更常暴击.

IGUI_DD_SE_Axe_2.en: Hits do more damage, and from the middle levels the axe reaches further and knocks zombies back harder.
IGUI_DD_SE_Axe_2.ch: 攻擊傷害更高, 從中等等級起, 斧頭的攻擊距離更遠, 擊退殭屍的力道也更大.
IGUI_DD_SE_Axe_2.cn: 攻击伤害更高, 从中等等级起, 斧头的攻击距离更远, 击退僵尸的力度也更大.

IGUI_DD_SE_Axe_3.en: Swings get faster with every level, and cost less endurance near the top.
IGUI_DD_SE_Axe_3.ch: 每升一級揮擊都會更快, 接近頂級時耐力消耗也更少.
IGUI_DD_SE_Axe_3.cn: 每升一级挥击都会更快, 接近满级时耐力消耗也更少.

IGUI_DD_SE_Blacksmith_1.en: Nothing but the recipes. It decides what the forge and the anvil will let you make.
IGUI_DD_SE_Blacksmith_1.ch: 只影響配方. 它決定你能用鍛造爐與鐵砧做出什麼.
IGUI_DD_SE_Blacksmith_1.cn: 只影响配方. 它决定你能用锻造炉和铁砧做出什么.

IGUI_DD_SE_Blunt_1.en: Swings land more often and crit more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_Blunt_1.ch: 揮擊更常命中, 也更常暴擊.
IGUI_DD_SE_Blunt_1.cn: 挥击更常命中, 也更常暴击.

IGUI_DD_SE_Blunt_2.en: Hits do more damage, and from the middle levels the weapon reaches further.
IGUI_DD_SE_Blunt_2.ch: 攻擊傷害更高, 從中等等級起, 武器的攻擊距離更遠.
IGUI_DD_SE_Blunt_2.cn: 攻击伤害更高, 从中等等级起, 武器的攻击距离更远.

IGUI_DD_SE_Blunt_3.en: Swings get faster with every level, and cost less endurance near the top.
IGUI_DD_SE_Blunt_3.ch: 每升一級揮擊都會更快, 接近頂級時耐力消耗也更少.
IGUI_DD_SE_Blunt_3.cn: 每升一级挥击都会更快, 接近满级时耐力消耗也更少.

IGUI_DD_SE_Butchering_1.en: More of the carcass comes off usable.
IGUI_DD_SE_Butchering_1.ch: 屠體能取下更多可用的部分.
IGUI_DD_SE_Butchering_1.cn: 胴体能取下更多可用的部分.

IGUI_DD_SE_Butchering_2.en: Less of its blood ends up on you.

IGUI_DD_SE_Carving_1.en: Carved spears and handles come out in better condition.
IGUI_DD_SE_Carving_1.ch: 雕刻出的長矛與握柄耐久更高.
IGUI_DD_SE_Carving_1.cn: 雕刻出的长矛和握柄耐久更高.

IGUI_DD_SE_Cleaning_1.en: Cleaning actions finish faster and use less product.
IGUI_DD_SE_Cleaning_1.ch: 清潔動作完成得更快, 清潔用品也用得更少.
IGUI_DD_SE_Cleaning_1.cn: 清洁动作完成得更快, 清洁用品也用得更少.

IGUI_DD_SE_Cooking_1.en: Cooked food feeds you better the higher it is.
IGUI_DD_SE_Cooking_1.ch: 技能越高, 煮出的食物越有營養.
IGUI_DD_SE_Cooking_1.cn: 技能越高, 做出的食物越有营养.

IGUI_DD_SE_Cooking_2.en: From the middle levels rotten ingredients stop ruining a dish, and tainted food is recognised before you eat it.
IGUI_DD_SE_Cooking_2.ch: 從中等等級起, 腐壞食材不再毀掉菜餚, 受汙染的食物也能在吃下前被辨認出來.
IGUI_DD_SE_Cooking_2.cn: 从中等等级起, 腐烂食材不再毁掉菜肴, 被污染的食物也能在吃下前被认出来.

IGUI_DD_SE_Dancing_1.en: Fewer stumbles and fumbles, though tiredness still causes them.
IGUI_DD_SE_Dancing_1.ch: 絆腳與失誤減少, 但疲倦時仍會發生.
IGUI_DD_SE_Dancing_1.cn: 绊脚和失误减少, 但疲倦时仍会发生.

IGUI_DD_SE_Doctor_1.en: Examining, bandaging and stitching all take less time.
IGUI_DD_SE_Doctor_1.ch: 檢查、包紮與縫合所需時間都會縮短.
IGUI_DD_SE_Doctor_1.cn: 检查、包扎和缝合所需时间都会缩短.

IGUI_DD_SE_Doctor_2.en: The health panel reads a wound more clearly the higher it gets, and from level 3 an infection shows as soon as it sets in.
IGUI_DD_SE_Doctor_2.ch: 技能越高, 健康面板對傷口的顯示越清楚, 從 3 級起, 感染一發生就會顯示.
IGUI_DD_SE_Doctor_2.cn: 技能越高, 健康面板对伤口的显示越清楚, 从 3 级起, 感染一发生就会显示出来.

IGUI_DD_SE_Electricity_1.en: Every wiring and repair job succeeds more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_Electricity_1.ch: 各種接線與修理工作的成功率都會提高.
IGUI_DD_SE_Electricity_1.cn: 各种接线和修理工作的成功率都会提高.

IGUI_DD_SE_Electricity_2.en: Hooking a generator up takes a few levels, or the manual.
IGUI_DD_SE_Electricity_2.ch: 連接發電機需要數個等級, 或讀過說明書.
IGUI_DD_SE_Electricity_2.cn: 连接发电机需要几个等级, 或者读过说明书.

IGUI_DD_SE_Farming_1.en: A harvest yields more with every level.
IGUI_DD_SE_Farming_1.ch: 每升一級, 收穫的產量都會增加.
IGUI_DD_SE_Farming_1.cn: 每升一级, 收获的产量都会增加.

IGUI_DD_SE_Farming_2.en: A crop's state reads more clearly when you inspect it.
IGUI_DD_SE_Farming_2.ch: 檢查農作物時, 能更清楚得知其狀態.
IGUI_DD_SE_Farming_2.cn: 检查作物时, 能更清楚地了解其状态.

IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_1.en: Bigger fish take the hook and junk comes up less often.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_1.ch: 更大的魚會上鉤, 釣到垃圾的次數也減少.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_1.cn: 更大的鱼会上钩, 钓到垃圾的次数也会减少.

IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_2.en: The line takes more strain before it snaps, and the cast lands closer to where you aimed.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_2.ch: 釣線能承受更大拉力才會斷, 拋竿也更接近你瞄準的位置.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_2.cn: 钓线能承受更大拉力才会断, 抛竿落点也更接近你瞄准的位置.

IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_3.en: Bait survives a catch more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_3.ch: 釣到魚後, 誘餌更常保留下來.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_3.cn: 钓到鱼后, 鱼饵更常保留下来.

IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_1.en: Endurance drains slower and comes back faster.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_1.ch: 耐力消耗變慢, 恢復變快.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_1.cn: 耐力消耗更慢, 恢复更快.

IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_2.en: Swings and shoves come out faster.

IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_3.en: Climbing, falling and hard work take less out of you, and a zombie's grip is easier to shake off.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_3.ch: 攀爬、跌落與粗重工作對你的消耗更少, 殭屍的抓握也更容易掙脫.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_3.cn: 攀爬、摔落和重活对你的消耗更少, 僵尸的抓握也更容易挣脱.

IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_4.en: Left untrained for long, it slowly loses XP and can drop a level.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_4.ch: 長時間不訓練會逐漸流失經驗值, 甚至可能降一級.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_4.cn: 长时间不训练会逐渐流失经验值, 甚至可能掉一级.

IGUI_DD_SE_FlintKnapping_1.en: Knapping a flake more often leaves a usable sharpened stone behind as well.
IGUI_DD_SE_FlintKnapping_1.ch: 敲製石片時, 更常額外留下一塊可用的鋒利燧石片.
IGUI_DD_SE_FlintKnapping_1.cn: 敲制石片时, 更常额外留下一块可用的锋利碎石.

IGUI_DD_SE_Glassmaking_1.en: Nothing but the recipes. It decides what you can melt and shape, not how well it comes out.
IGUI_DD_SE_Glassmaking_1.ch: 只影響配方. 它決定你能熔化並塑形什麼, 而非成品好壞.
IGUI_DD_SE_Glassmaking_1.cn: 只影响配方. 它决定你能熔化和塑形什么, 而不是成品好坏.

IGUI_DD_SE_Husbandry_1.en: An animal's state reads more clearly when you inspect it.
IGUI_DD_SE_Husbandry_1.ch: 檢查動物時, 能更清楚得知其狀態.
IGUI_DD_SE_Husbandry_1.cn: 检查动物时, 能更清楚地了解其状态.

IGUI_DD_SE_Husbandry_2.en: Handling one hurts and stresses it less.
IGUI_DD_SE_Husbandry_2.ch: 處理動物時對牠造成的傷害與壓力更少.
IGUI_DD_SE_Husbandry_2.cn: 处理动物时对它造成的伤害和压力更少.

IGUI_DD_SE_Insanity_1.en: Butchering, skinning and hanging a human body each unlock a level at a time.
IGUI_DD_SE_Insanity_1.ch: 屠宰、剝皮與吊掛人類屍體的動作會逐級解鎖, 每級一項.
IGUI_DD_SE_Insanity_1.cn: 屠宰、剥皮和吊挂人类尸体的动作会逐级解锁, 每级一项.

IGUI_DD_SE_Insanity_2.en: Only a character with the Psychopath trait can gain it.
IGUI_DD_SE_Insanity_2.ch: 只有具備「精神病態者」特質的角色才能獲得.
IGUI_DD_SE_Insanity_2.cn: 只有拥有“精神病态者”特质的角色才能获得.

IGUI_DD_SE_LGUHunting_1.en: Watching a tree for game takes less time with every level.
IGUI_DD_SE_LGUHunting_1.ch: 每升一級, 在樹旁守候獵物所需的時間都會縮短.
IGUI_DD_SE_LGUHunting_1.cn: 每升一级, 在树旁守候猎物所需的时间都会缩短.

IGUI_DD_SE_Lightfoot_1.en: Your footsteps carry less far, at any pace.
IGUI_DD_SE_Lightfoot_1.ch: 無論以何種速度移動, 腳步聲都傳得更近.
IGUI_DD_SE_Lightfoot_1.cn: 无论以什么速度移动, 脚步声都传得更近.

IGUI_DD_SE_Lockpicking_2.en: Forcing a stubborn lock works more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_Lockpicking_2.ch: 強行撬開難搞的鎖更容易成功.
IGUI_DD_SE_Lockpicking_2.cn: 强行撬开难缠的锁更容易成功.

IGUI_DD_SE_Lockpicking_3.en: The odds on screen stay hidden until the middle levels.
IGUI_DD_SE_Lockpicking_3.ch: 到中等等級前, 畫面上不會顯示成功率.
IGUI_DD_SE_Lockpicking_3.cn: 到中等等级之前, 屏幕上不会显示成功率.

IGUI_DD_SE_LongBlade_1.en: Swings land more often and crit more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_LongBlade_1.ch: 揮擊更常命中, 也更常暴擊.
IGUI_DD_SE_LongBlade_1.cn: 挥击更常命中, 也更常暴击.

IGUI_DD_SE_LongBlade_3.en: Swings still speed up with every level, but the extra reach and the endurance saving only go to axes, spears and long blunt weapons.
IGUI_DD_SE_LongBlade_3.ch: 每升一級揮擊仍會加快, 但額外攻擊距離與耐力節省只適用於斧頭、長矛與長棍類武器.
IGUI_DD_SE_LongBlade_3.cn: 每升一级挥击仍会加快, 但额外攻击距离和耐力节省只适用于斧头、长矛和长棍类武器.

IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_1.en: Weapons lose condition less often, and half your level in the weapon's own skill counts towards this as well.
IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_1.ch: 武器較不容易耐久下降, 且你在該武器所屬技能等級的一半也會計入.
IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_1.cn: 武器更不容易掉耐久, 你在该武器对应技能等级的一半也会计入.

IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_2.en: Sharpening chips the blade less often, and a repair fails less often.
IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_2.ch: 磨刀時較少崩口, 修理也較少失敗.
IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_2.cn: 磨刀时更少崩口, 修理也更少失败.

IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_3.en: Trained by hitting things with a weapon, not by fixing one.
IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_3.ch: 靠用武器打東西來訓練, 而不是靠修理武器.
IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_3.cn: 靠用武器打东西来训练, 而不是靠修理武器.

IGUI_DD_SE_Masonry_1.en: The build menu offers a better-made version of a brick or stone wall as you climb.
IGUI_DD_SE_Masonry_1.ch: 隨著等級提升, 建造選單會提供更精良的磚牆或石牆.
IGUI_DD_SE_Masonry_1.cn: 随着等级提升, 建造菜单会提供做工更好的砖墙或石墙.

IGUI_DD_SE_Mechanics_1.en: Parts come off and go back on in better condition.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mechanics_1.ch: 拆裝零件時能保持更好的耐久.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mechanics_1.cn: 拆装零件时能保持更好的耐久.

IGUI_DD_SE_Mechanics_2.en: Engine repairs, headlight adjustment and the harder vehicles each need a level before you can touch them.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mechanics_2.ch: 引擎維修、頭燈調整及較難處理的車輛, 都需要達到一定等級才能動手.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mechanics_2.cn: 引擎维修、车头灯调整和较难处理的车辆, 都需要达到一定等级才能动手.

IGUI_DD_SE_Meditation_1.en: A session sheds more stress the higher it is.
IGUI_DD_SE_Meditation_1.ch: 技能越高, 每次冥想消除的壓力越多.
IGUI_DD_SE_Meditation_1.cn: 技能越高, 每次冥想消除的压力越多.

IGUI_DD_SE_Meditation_2.en: Deeper techniques open up as it rises, and a bag on your back stops getting in the way.
IGUI_DD_SE_Meditation_2.ch: 隨著技能提升會解鎖更深入的技巧, 背上的包包也不再礙事.
IGUI_DD_SE_Meditation_2.cn: 随着技能提升会解锁更深的技巧, 背上的包也不再碍事.

IGUI_DD_SE_MetalWelding_1.en: The build menu offers a better-made version of a metal wall, fence or frame as you climb.
IGUI_DD_SE_MetalWelding_1.ch: 隨著等級提升, 建造選單會提供更精良的金屬牆、圍欄或框架.
IGUI_DD_SE_MetalWelding_1.cn: 随着等级提升, 建造菜单会提供做工更好的金属墙、围栏或框架.

IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_1.en: Strength cuts the swings too, half as much per level.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_1.ch: 力量也能減少揮擊次數, 每級效果為一半.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_1.cn: 力量也能减少挥击次数, 每级效果减半.

IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_2.en: A tile costs the same endurance either way, spread over fewer swings.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_2.ch: 挖一格的總耐力消耗不變, 只是分攤在更少的揮擊上.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_2.cn: 挖一格的总耐力消耗不变, 只是分摊到更少的挥击上.

IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_3.en: Never fewer than a third of a tile's swings, or two.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_3.ch: 揮擊次數最少不低於該格原本次數的三分之一, 也不少於兩次.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_3.cn: 挥击次数最少不低于该格原本次数的三分之一, 也不少于两次.

IGUI_DD_SE_Music_1.en: Playing sheds more boredom and unhappiness.
IGUI_DD_SE_Music_1.ch: 演奏能消除更多無聊與憂鬱.
IGUI_DD_SE_Music_1.cn: 演奏能消除更多无聊和忧郁.

IGUI_DD_SE_Music_2.en: Songs can be learned early on, and high up a song can no longer be fumbled for lack of skill.
IGUI_DD_SE_Music_2.ch: 低等級就能學歌, 等級高時不會再因技術不足而演奏失誤.
IGUI_DD_SE_Music_2.cn: 低等级就能学歌, 等级高时不会再因技术不足而演奏失误.

IGUI_DD_SE_Nimble_1.en: Moving in a combat stance is faster with every level.
IGUI_DD_SE_Nimble_1.ch: 每升一級, 戰鬥姿態下的移動都會更快.
IGUI_DD_SE_Nimble_1.cn: 每升一级, 战斗姿态下的移动都会更快.

IGUI_DD_SE_Nimble_2.en: Climbing a fence scratches you less often, and you trip and fall less.
IGUI_DD_SE_Nimble_2.ch: 翻越圍欄時較少被刮傷, 絆倒與跌倒也更少.
IGUI_DD_SE_Nimble_2.cn: 翻越围栏时更少被刮伤, 绊倒和摔倒也更少.

IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_1.en: The search radius widens with every level.
IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_1.ch: 每升一級, 搜尋半徑都會擴大.
IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_1.cn: 每升一级, 搜寻半径都会扩大.

IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_2.en: Icons take less time to move, so a sweep covers more ground.
IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_2.ch: 圖示移動所需時間更短, 一次搜尋能涵蓋更大範圍.
IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_2.cn: 图标移动所需时间更短, 一次搜寻能覆盖更大范围.

IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_3.en: More categories and rarer finds come into reach as it rises.
IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_3.ch: 隨著技能提升, 可搜到更多類別與更稀有的物品.
IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_3.cn: 随着技能提升, 能搜到更多类别和更稀有的物品.

IGUI_DD_SE_Pottery_1.en: Nothing but the recipes. It decides what you can throw and fire.
IGUI_DD_SE_Pottery_1.ch: 只影響配方. 它決定你能拉坯與燒製什麼.
IGUI_DD_SE_Pottery_1.cn: 只影响配方. 它决定你能拉坯和烧制什么.

IGUI_DD_SE_ProstFamiliarity_1.en: While a prosthesis is worn this adds to the amputation skill for that limb, cutting the time penalty further.
IGUI_DD_SE_ProstFamiliarity_1.ch: 穿戴義肢時, 此技能會加到該肢體的截肢技能上, 進一步減少時間懲罰.
IGUI_DD_SE_ProstFamiliarity_1.cn: 佩戴假肢时, 该技能会加到该肢体的截肢技能上, 进一步减少时间惩罚.

IGUI_DD_SE_Reloading_1.en: Every reload, rack and magazine fill takes less time.
IGUI_DD_SE_Reloading_1.ch: 裝填、上膛與裝填彈匣所需時間都會縮短.
IGUI_DD_SE_Reloading_1.cn: 装填、上膛和压弹匣所需时间都会缩短.

IGUI_DD_SE_Reloading_2.en: Trained by loading guns and filling magazines by hand.
IGUI_DD_SE_Reloading_2.ch: 靠手動裝填槍械與彈匣來訓練.
IGUI_DD_SE_Reloading_2.cn: 靠手动装填枪械和弹匣来训练.

IGUI_DD_SE_Science_1.en: Researching a recipe or a specimen takes less time.
IGUI_DD_SE_Science_1.ch: 研究配方或標本所需時間更短.
IGUI_DD_SE_Science_1.cn: 研究配方或标本所需时间更短.

IGUI_DD_SE_Science_2.en: Every other skill earns a little extra experience while this one is high.
IGUI_DD_SE_Science_2.ch: 此技能等級高時, 其他所有技能都能多獲得一些經驗值.
IGUI_DD_SE_Science_2.cn: 该技能等级高时, 其他所有技能都能多获得一些经验值.

IGUI_DD_SE_Side_L_1.en: Every action is slower once that side is missing a limb, and this claws the time back.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_L_1.ch: 一旦該側缺少肢體, 所有動作都會變慢, 這項技能能把時間補回來.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_L_1.cn: 一旦该侧缺少肢体, 所有动作都会变慢, 这项技能能把时间追回来.

IGUI_DD_SE_Side_L_2.en: Trained simply by living with the amputation.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_L_2.ch: 只要帶著截肢生活就能訓練.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_L_2.cn: 只要带着截肢生活就能训练.

IGUI_DD_SE_Side_R_1.en: Every action is slower once that side is missing a limb, and this claws the time back.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_R_1.ch: 一旦該側缺少肢體, 所有動作都會變慢, 這項技能能把時間補回來.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_R_1.cn: 一旦该侧缺少肢体, 所有动作都会变慢, 这项技能能把时间追回来.

IGUI_DD_SE_Side_R_2.en: Trained simply by living with the amputation.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_R_2.ch: 只要帶著截肢生活就能訓練.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_R_2.cn: 只要带着截肢生活就能训练.

IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlade_1.en: Stabs land more often and crit more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlade_1.ch: 刺擊更常命中, 也更常暴擊.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlade_1.cn: 刺击更常命中, 也更常暴击.

IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlade_3.en: The knife is left behind in the jaw less often after an instant kill.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlade_3.ch: 一擊必殺後, 刀子較少卡在下顎裡.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlade_3.cn: 一击必杀后, 刀子更少卡在下颚里.

IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlunt_1.en: Swings land more often and crit more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlunt_1.ch: 揮擊更常命中, 也更常暴擊.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlunt_1.cn: 挥击更常命中, 也更常暴击.

IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlunt_3.en: Swings still speed up with every level, but the extra reach and the endurance saving only go to axes, spears and long blunt weapons.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlunt_3.ch: 每升一級揮擊仍會加快, 但額外攻擊距離與耐力節省只適用於斧頭、長矛與長棍類武器.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlunt_3.cn: 每升一级挥击仍会加快, 但额外攻击距离和耐力节省只适用于斧头、长矛和长棍类武器.

IGUI_DD_SE_Sneak_1.en: Zombies take longer to spot you while crouched.
IGUI_DD_SE_Sneak_1.ch: 蹲伏時殭屍需要更久才能發現你.
IGUI_DD_SE_Sneak_1.cn: 蹲伏时僵尸需要更久才能发现你.

IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_1.en: Thrusts land more often and crit more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_1.ch: 突刺更常命中, 也更常暴擊.
IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_1.cn: 突刺更常命中, 也更常暴击.

IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_2.en: Hits do more damage, and from the middle levels the spear reaches further.
IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_2.ch: 攻擊傷害更高, 從中等等級起, 長矛的攻擊距離更遠.
IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_2.cn: 攻击伤害更高, 从中等等级起, 长矛的攻击距离更远.

IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_3.en: Thrusts get faster with every level, and cost less endurance near the top.
IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_3.ch: 每升一級突刺都會更快, 接近頂級時耐力消耗也更少.
IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_3.cn: 每升一级突刺都会更快, 接近满级时耐力消耗也更少.

IGUI_DD_SE_Sprinting_1.en: Plain running speed, and nothing else.
IGUI_DD_SE_Sprinting_1.ch: 單純的跑步速度, 沒有其他效果.
IGUI_DD_SE_Sprinting_1.cn: 单纯的跑步速度, 没有其他效果.

IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_1.en: Every melee hit does more damage and every shove pushes harder.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_1.ch: 每次近戰攻擊傷害更高, 每次推開也更有力.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_1.cn: 每次近战攻击伤害更高, 每次推搡也更有力.

IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_2.en: You can carry more before the weight starts slowing you down.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_2.ch: 能背負更多東西才會被重量拖慢.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_2.cn: 能背更多东西才会被重量拖慢.

IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_3.en: Muscle strain builds slower and a zombie's grip is easier to break.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_3.ch: 肌肉拉傷累積更慢, 殭屍的抓握也更容易掙脫.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_3.cn: 肌肉拉伤累积更慢, 僵尸的抓握也更容易挣脱.

IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_4.en: Left untrained for long, it slowly loses XP and can drop a level.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_4.ch: 長時間不訓練會逐漸流失經驗值, 甚至可能降一級.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_4.cn: 长时间不训练会逐渐流失经验值, 甚至可能掉一级.

IGUI_DD_SE_Tailoring_1.en: A patch adds more scratch and bite protection with every level.
IGUI_DD_SE_Tailoring_1.ch: 每升一級, 補丁提供的抗刮傷與抗咬傷防護都會增加.
IGUI_DD_SE_Tailoring_1.cn: 每升一级, 补丁提供的防刮伤和防咬伤保护都会增加.

IGUI_DD_SE_Tailoring_2.en: Past the upper levels, matching fabric mends a hole outright instead of leaving a patch behind.
IGUI_DD_SE_Tailoring_2.ch: 達到高等級後, 使用相同布料可直接補好破洞, 而不是留下補丁.
IGUI_DD_SE_Tailoring_2.cn: 达到高等级后, 用相同布料能直接补好破洞, 而不是留下补丁.

IGUI_DD_SE_Tracking_1.en: Fainter tracks become readable, and the ones you can read turn up more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_Tracking_1.ch: 能辨識更模糊的蹤跡, 可辨識的蹤跡也更常出現.
IGUI_DD_SE_Tracking_1.cn: 能辨认更模糊的踪迹, 能辨认的踪迹也更常出现.

IGUI_DD_SE_Trapping_1.en: Traps catch more often, whatever the bait and wherever they sit.
IGUI_DD_SE_Trapping_1.ch: 不論使用何種誘餌、設在何處, 陷阱都更常捕到獵物.
IGUI_DD_SE_Trapping_1.cn: 不论用什么诱饵、放在哪里, 陷阱都更常捕到猎物.

IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_1.en: Everything you build gets more health with every level.
IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_1.ch: 每升一級, 你建造的一切都會更耐久.
IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_1.cn: 每升一级, 你建造的一切都会更耐久.

IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_2.en: Building takes less time, and the hammering carries less far.
IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_2.ch: 建造所需時間更短, 敲擊聲也傳得更近.
IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_2.cn: 建造所需时间更短, 敲击声也传得更近.

IGUI_DD_S_Blunt.en: Faster, harder swings with long blunt weapons, and less muscle strain from them.

IGUI_DD_S_Dancing.en: Fewer stumbles and fumbles while dancing.

IGUI_DD_S_Doctor.en: Reads injuries more clearly and treats them better.

IGUI_DD_S_Fitness.en: Faster swings, better climbing, and slower to tire.

IGUI_DD_S_FlintKnapping.en: Chips stone into tools and cutting edges.

IGUI_DD_S_Husbandry.en: Tells you more about an animal's state, and gets more out of it.

IGUI_DD_S_Husbandry.cn: 能了解更多动物状态, 也能从它身上获得更多.

IGUI_DD_S_Insanity.en: How comfortable you have grown with doing terrible things.

IGUI_DD_S_Insanity.cn: 你对做出可怕之事已经习惯到什么程度.

IGUI_DD_S_Lightfoot.ch: 無論以何種速度移動, 腳步聲都更輕.

IGUI_DD_S_LongBlade.en: Long blades land more often and cut deeper.

IGUI_DD_S_Masonry.en: Lays brick and stone, and builds sturdier walls as it rises.

IGUI_DD_S_Masonry.cn: 砌砖砌石, 技能提升后能建造更坚固的墙.

IGUI_DD_S_Mechanics.en: Vehicle parts come off and go back on in better condition.

IGUI_DD_S_Mechanics.cn: 拆装车辆零件时能保持更好的耐久.

IGUI_DD_S_Meditation.en: Meditating sheds more stress, and the techniques deepen as it rises.

IGUI_DD_T_base_blacksmith.en: Can work metal at an anvil.
