IGUI_DD_T_base_dextrous.ch: 操作物品欄與武器迅速, 攀繩時手也很穩.
IGUI_DD_T_base_dextrous.cn: 操作物品栏和武器迅速, 攀绳时手也很稳.

IGUI_DD_T_base_disorganized.en: Bags and world containers hold less.
IGUI_DD_T_base_disorganized.ch: 背包與場景容器可容納的量較少.
IGUI_DD_T_base_disorganized.cn: 背包和场景容器的容量更小.

IGUI_DD_T_base_eagleeyed.en: Spots things sooner, sees wider, and shoots better at range.
IGUI_DD_T_base_eagleeyed.ch: 更早發現事物, 視野更寬廣, 遠距離射擊也更準.
IGUI_DD_T_base_eagleeyed.cn: 更早发现目标, 视野更广, 远距离射击也更准.

IGUI_DD_T_base_emaciated.en: Weak, short of breath, and easily hurt.
IGUI_DD_T_base_emaciated.ch: 虛弱、容易喘, 也容易受傷.
IGUI_DD_T_base_emaciated.cn: 虚弱、容易气喘, 也容易受伤.

IGUI_DD_T_base_feeble.en: Less knockback from melee weapons, and carries less.
IGUI_DD_T_base_feeble.ch: 近戰武器的擊退較弱, 負重也較少.
IGUI_DD_T_base_feeble.cn: 近战武器的击退更弱, 负重也更少.

IGUI_DD_T_base_firstaid.en: Trained to treat wounds and injuries.
IGUI_DD_T_base_firstaid.ch: 受過處理傷口與傷勢的訓練.
IGUI_DD_T_base_firstaid.cn: 受过处理伤口和伤势的训练.

IGUI_DD_T_base_fishing.en: Knows how to work a rod and line.

IGUI_DD_T_base_formerscout.en: Lights fires quickly, and knows a little medicine, fishing and foraging.
IGUI_DD_T_base_formerscout.ch: 生火很快, 也懂一點醫療、釣魚與搜尋.
IGUI_DD_T_base_formerscout.cn: 生火很快, 也略懂医疗、钓鱼和搜寻.

IGUI_DD_T_base_gardener.en: Knows how to work a garden.

IGUI_DD_T_base_graceful.en: Moves quietly, and keeps their balance.
IGUI_DD_T_base_graceful.ch: 移動安靜, 且能保持平衡.
IGUI_DD_T_base_graceful.cn: 移动安静, 并能保持平衡.

IGUI_DD_T_base_gymnast.en: Light on the feet, and quick to change direction.
IGUI_DD_T_base_gymnast.ch: 腳步輕盈, 轉向迅速.
IGUI_DD_T_base_gymnast.cn: 脚步轻盈, 转向迅速.

IGUI_DD_T_base_handy.en: Builds faster and stronger, and barricades faster.
IGUI_DD_T_base_handy.ch: 建造更快更堅固, 加固也更快.
IGUI_DD_T_base_handy.cn: 建造更快更坚固, 加固也更快.

IGUI_DD_T_base_hardofhearing.en: Hears less, and notices less around them.
IGUI_DD_T_base_hardofhearing.ch: 聽力較差, 對周遭的察覺也較少.
IGUI_DD_T_base_hardofhearing.cn: 听力较差, 对周围的察觉也更少.

IGUI_DD_T_base_hemophobic.en: Panics at their own wounds, cannot treat anyone else, and hates being covered in blood.
IGUI_DD_T_base_hemophobic.ch: 看到自己的傷口會恐慌, 無法替他人治療, 也很討厭渾身是血.
IGUI_DD_T_base_hemophobic.cn: 看到自己的伤口会恐慌, 无法为他人治疗, 也很讨厌浑身是血.

IGUI_DD_T_base_herbalist.en: Finds medicinal herbs, and makes medicine from them.
IGUI_DD_T_base_herbalist.ch: 能找到藥草, 並用來製藥.
IGUI_DD_T_base_herbalist.cn: 能找到药草, 并用其制药.

IGUI_DD_T_base_herbalist_prof.en: Finds medicinal herbs, and makes medicine from them.
IGUI_DD_T_base_herbalist_prof.ch: 能找到藥草, 並用來製藥.
IGUI_DD_T_base_herbalist_prof.cn: 能找到药草, 并用其制药.

IGUI_DD_T_base_hiker.ch: 有長途健行的豐富經驗.
IGUI_DD_T_base_hiker.cn: 有丰富的长途徒步经验.

IGUI_DD_T_base_hunter.en: Used to stalking, shooting and dressing game.
IGUI_DD_T_base_hunter.ch: 習慣追蹤、射殺並處理獵物.
IGUI_DD_T_base_hunter.cn: 习惯追踪、射杀并处理猎物.

IGUI_DD_T_base_inconspicuous.en: Less likely to be spotted by zombies.

IGUI_DD_T_base_insomniac.en: Slow to fall asleep, wakes early, and rests less.
IGUI_DD_T_base_insomniac.ch: 不易入睡、早醒, 休息效果也較差.
IGUI_DD_T_base_insomniac.cn: 难以入睡、早醒, 休息效果也更差.

IGUI_DD_T_base_inventive.en: Works out recipes from items at lower skill levels.
IGUI_DD_T_base_inventive.ch: 能在較低技能等級時從物品中領悟配方.
IGUI_DD_T_base_inventive.cn: 能在较低技能等级时从物品中领悟配方.

IGUI_DD_T_base_inventive_prof.en: Works out recipes from items at lower skill levels.
IGUI_DD_T_base_inventive_prof.ch: 能在較低技能等級時從物品中領悟配方.
IGUI_DD_T_base_inventive_prof.cn: 能在较低技能等级时从物品中领悟配方.

IGUI_DD_T_base_irongut.en: Rarely ill from food, and tainted water does not harm them.
IGUI_DD_T_base_irongut.ch: 很少因食物生病, 受汙染的水也傷不了他們.
IGUI_DD_T_base_irongut.cn: 很少因食物生病, 污染的水也伤不了他们.

IGUI_DD_T_base_keenhearing.en: Notices more of what is around them.

IGUI_DD_T_base_marksman.en: Shoots straighter and harder, and reloads quicker.
IGUI_DD_T_base_marksman.ch: 射擊更準、更有威力, 裝填也更快.
IGUI_DD_T_base_marksman.cn: 射击更准、威力更大, 装填也更快.

IGUI_DD_T_base_mason.en: Better at building in stone and brick.
IGUI_DD_T_base_mason.ch: 更擅長以石材與磚塊建造.
IGUI_DD_T_base_mason.cn: 更擅长用石材和砖块建造.

IGUI_DD_T_base_mechanics.en: Can service and repair standard and heavy vehicles.
IGUI_DD_T_base_mechanics.ch: 能保養並修理標準型與商用型車輛.
IGUI_DD_T_base_mechanics.cn: 能保养并修理标准型和商用型车辆.

IGUI_DD_T_base_mechanics2.en: Can service and repair every kind of vehicle.
IGUI_DD_T_base_mechanics2.ch: 能保養並修理各種車輛.
IGUI_DD_T_base_mechanics2.cn: 能保养并修理所有类型的车辆.

IGUI_DD_T_base_nightowl.en: Falls asleep quickly, and rests more in less time.
IGUI_DD_T_base_nightowl.ch: 入睡快, 能在較短時間內得到更多休息.
IGUI_DD_T_base_nightowl.cn: 入睡快, 能在更短时间内得到更多休息.

IGUI_DD_T_base_nutritionist.en: Can read the nutrition of any food.
IGUI_DD_T_base_nutritionist.ch: 能看出任何食物的營養成分.
IGUI_DD_T_base_nutritionist.cn: 能看出任何食物的营养成分.

IGUI_DD_T_base_nutritionist2.en: Can read the nutrition of any food.
IGUI_DD_T_base_nutritionist2.ch: 能看出任何食物的營養成分.
IGUI_DD_T_base_nutritionist2.cn: 能看出任何食物的营养成分.

IGUI_DD_T_base_obese.en: Very slow, very short of breath, and easily hurt. Starts very heavy.
IGUI_DD_T_base_obese.ch: 非常緩慢、非常容易喘, 也容易受傷. 起始體重非常重.
IGUI_DD_T_base_obese.cn: 非常缓慢、极易气喘, 也容易受伤. 初始体重非常重.

IGUI_DD_T_base_organized.en: Bags and world containers hold more.
IGUI_DD_T_base_organized.ch: 背包與場景容器可容納的量較多.
IGUI_DD_T_base_organized.cn: 背包和场景容器的容量更大.

IGUI_DD_T_base_out_of_shape.en: Little endurance, and slow to get it back.

IGUI_DD_T_base_outdoorsman.en: Shrugs off foul weather, snags less in the woods, and lights a grill quickly.
IGUI_DD_T_base_outdoorsman.ch: 不受惡劣天氣影響, 在樹林中較少被勾住, 點燃烤架也很快.
IGUI_DD_T_base_outdoorsman.cn: 不受恶劣天气影响, 在树林中不易被勾住, 点燃烤架也很快.

IGUI_DD_T_base_overweight.en: Slower, short of breath, and easily hurt. Starts heavy.
IGUI_DD_T_base_overweight.ch: 較緩慢、容易喘, 也容易受傷. 起始體重偏重.
IGUI_DD_T_base_overweight.cn: 更缓慢、容易气喘, 也容易受伤. 初始体重偏重.

IGUI_DD_T_base_pronetoillness.en: More prone to disease, and turns faster once infected.
IGUI_DD_T_base_pronetoillness.ch: 較容易生病, 感染後更快殭屍化.
IGUI_DD_T_base_pronetoillness.cn: 更容易生病, 感染后更快僵尸化.

IGUI_DD_T_base_resilient.en: Rarely falls ill, and turns slowly once infected.
IGUI_DD_T_base_resilient.ch: 很少生病, 感染後殭屍化較慢.
IGUI_DD_T_base_resilient.cn: 很少生病, 感染后僵尸化更慢.

IGUI_DD_T_base_shortsighted.en: Sees less far, loses track of things slowly, and gains little from sights.
IGUI_DD_T_base_shortsighted.ch: 看得較近, 失去目標蹤影的速度較慢, 瞄具帶來的幫助也很少.
IGUI_DD_T_base_shortsighted.cn: 看得更近, 失去目标踪影的速度更慢, 瞄具带来的帮助也很少.

IGUI_DD_T_base_smoker.en: Addicted to tobacco. Unhappiness rises without a cigarette, and settles after one.
IGUI_DD_T_base_smoker.ch: 對菸草成癮. 沒菸抽時憂鬱會上升, 抽一根後便會平復.
IGUI_DD_T_base_smoker.cn: 烟草成瘾. 没烟抽时忧郁会上升, 抽一支后便会平复.

IGUI_DD_T_base_stout.en: Hits with more knockback, and carries more.
IGUI_DD_T_base_stout.ch: 攻擊擊退更強, 負重也更多.
IGUI_DD_T_base_stout.cn: 攻击击退更强, 负重也更多.

IGUI_DD_T_base_strong.en: Hits with far more knockback, and carries far more.
IGUI_DD_T_base_strong.ch: 攻擊擊退大幅增強, 負重也多出許多.
IGUI_DD_T_base_strong.cn: 攻击击退大幅增强, 负重也多出许多.

IGUI_DD_T_base_target_shooter.en: Has spent time on a shooting range.

IGUI_DD_T_base_thickskinned.ch: 較不容易被刮傷或咬傷.
IGUI_DD_T_base_thickskinned.cn: 更不容易被刮伤或咬伤.

IGUI_DD_T_base_tinkerer.en: Enjoys taking things apart and putting them back together.
IGUI_DD_T_base_tinkerer.ch: 喜歡把東西拆開再組裝回去.
IGUI_DD_T_base_tinkerer.cn: 喜欢把东西拆开再组装回去.

IGUI_DD_T_base_underweight.en: Weak in a fight, short of breath, and easily hurt. Starts light.
IGUI_DD_T_base_underweight.ch: 打鬥時力氣弱、容易喘, 也容易受傷. 起始體重偏輕.
IGUI_DD_T_base_underweight.cn: 打斗时力气弱、容易气喘, 也容易受伤. 初始体重偏轻.

IGUI_DD_T_base_unfit.en: Very little endurance, and slow to get it back.
IGUI_DD_T_base_unfit.ch: 耐力非常低, 恢復也慢.
IGUI_DD_T_base_unfit.cn: 耐力极低, 恢复也慢.

IGUI_DD_T_base_very_underweight.en: Very weak in a fight, very short of breath, and easily hurt. Starts very light.
IGUI_DD_T_base_very_underweight.ch: 打鬥時非常無力、非常容易喘, 也容易受傷. 起始體重非常輕.
IGUI_DD_T_base_very_underweight.cn: 打斗时非常无力、极易气喘, 也容易受伤. 初始体重非常轻.

IGUI_DD_T_base_weak.en: Almost no knockback, and can barely carry a thing.
IGUI_DD_T_base_weak.ch: 幾乎沒有擊退力, 也幾乎搬不動任何東西.
IGUI_DD_T_base_weak.cn: 几乎没有击退力, 也几乎搬不动任何东西.

IGUI_DD_T_base_weakstomach.en: Falls ill from food easily, and tainted water hits harder.
IGUI_DD_T_base_weakstomach.ch: 容易因食物生病, 受汙染的水影響也更大.
IGUI_DD_T_base_weakstomach.cn: 容易因食物生病, 污染的水影响也更大.

IGUI_DD_T_base_weightgain.en: Puts on weight steadily, and starts heavy.
IGUI_DD_T_base_weightgain.ch: 體重會穩定增加, 起始體重也偏重.
IGUI_DD_T_base_weightgain.cn: 体重会稳定增加, 初始体重也偏重.

IGUI_DD_T_base_weightloss.en: Loses weight steadily, and starts light.
IGUI_DD_T_base_weightloss.ch: 體重會穩定減少, 起始體重也偏輕.
IGUI_DD_T_base_weightloss.cn: 体重会稳定减少, 初始体重也偏轻.

IGUI_DD_T_base_wildernessknowledge.en: Gathers and brews herbal medicine, knaps stone and bone tools, and lights fires quickly.
IGUI_DD_T_base_wildernessknowledge.ch: 能採集並熬製草藥, 打製石器與骨器, 生火也很快.
IGUI_DD_T_base_wildernessknowledge.cn: 能采集并熬制草药, 打制石器和骨器, 生火也很快.

IGUI_DD_T_betlock_nimblefingers.en: Starts out able to pick a lock and spot an alarm.
IGUI_DD_T_betlock_nimblefingers.ch: 一開始就會開鎖, 也能察覺警報器.
IGUI_DD_T_betlock_nimblefingers.cn: 一开始就会开锁, 也能发现警报器.

IGUI_DD_T_bloodlusto_bloodlusto.en: The urge to kill only sharpens the bloodier things get.
IGUI_DD_T_bloodlusto_bloodlusto.ch: 局面越血腥, 殺戮的衝動就越強烈.
IGUI_DD_T_bloodlusto_bloodlusto.cn: 局面越血腥, 杀戮的冲动就越强烈.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_actionhero.en: Hits harder and crits more for every zombie close by, the closer the better, but hits weakly with none around.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_actionhero.ch: 附近每多一隻殭屍, 打擊就更重、暴擊也更多, 距離越近越好; 但周圍沒有殭屍時攻擊無力.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_actionhero.cn: 附近每多一只僵尸, 打击就更重、暴击也更多, 距离越近越好; 但周围没有僵尸时攻击乏力.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_anemic.en: Open bleeding wounds drain health faster, worst on the head and neck.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_anemic.ch: 開放性出血傷口會更快流失健康, 頭部與頸部最嚴重.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_anemic.cn: 开放性出血伤口会更快流失健康, 头部和颈部最严重.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_antigunactivist.en: Firearms reach less far, aiming one is upsetting, and Aiming and Reloading are learned slowly.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_antigunactivist.ch: 槍械射程較短, 持槍瞄準令人心煩, 瞄準與裝填技能也學得較慢.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_antigunactivist.cn: 枪械射程更短, 持枪瞄准令人不快, 瞄准和装填技能也学得更慢.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_ascetic.en: Content with little. Simple food fills more and boredom and unhappiness fade on their own, but rich food, good beds, TV and comics sit badly.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_ascetic.ch: 知足常樂. 簡單的食物更能填飽肚子, 無聊與憂鬱也會自行消退; 但豐盛的食物、好床、電視與漫畫都讓人不自在.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_ascetic.cn: 知足常乐. 简单的食物更顶饱, 无聊和忧郁也会自行消退; 但丰盛的食物、好床、电视和漫画都让人不舒服.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_badteeth.en: Eating can bring on pain in the head, more with bigger bites.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_badteeth.ch: 進食可能引發頭痛, 一口吃越多越痛.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_badteeth.cn: 进食可能引发头痛, 一口吃得越多越痛.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_blissful.ch: 憂鬱與無聊會穩定消退.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_blissful.cn: 忧郁和无聊会稳定消退.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_bloodlust.en: Killing a zombie up close lifts the mood and calms the nerves.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_bloodlust.ch: 近距離殺死殭屍能提振心情、平復情緒.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_bloodlust.cn: 近距离杀死僵尸能提振心情、平复情绪.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_bodyworkenthusiast.en: Restores old car bodies as a hobby.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_bodyworkenthusiast.ch: 把翻修老車車身當作嗜好.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_bodyworkenthusiast.cn: 把翻修老车车身当作爱好.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_bouncer.en: When zombies crowd in close, sometimes staggers the nearest one.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_bouncer.ch: 殭屍貼身圍上來時, 有時會讓最近的一隻踉蹌.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_bouncer.cn: 僵尸贴身围上来时, 有时会让最近的一只踉跄.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_brittlebones.en: Broken bones take longer to mend.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_brittlebones.ch: 骨折需要更久才能癒合.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_brittlebones.cn: 骨折需要更久才能愈合.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_brokenleg.en: Starts with a splinted broken leg, and breaking it again is worse.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_brokenleg.ch: 開局時一條腿骨折並上了夾板, 再次骨折會更嚴重.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_brokenleg.cn: 开局时一条腿骨折并上了夹板, 再次骨折会更严重.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_burnwardpatient.en: Starts burned and bandaged all over, and new burns on those spots last longer.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_burnwardpatient.ch: 開局時全身燒傷並包著繃帶, 這些部位的新燒傷也會持續更久.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_burnwardpatient.cn: 开局时全身烧伤并缠着绷带, 这些部位的新烧伤也会持续更久.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_butterfingers.en: Drops what is in hand while on the move, more often when heavily loaded or running, and sometimes drops items while moving them between containers.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_butterfingers.ch: 移動時會弄掉手上的東西, 負重過多或奔跑時更常發生, 在容器間搬移物品時也偶爾會掉落.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_butterfingers.cn: 移动时会弄掉手上的东西, 负重很大或奔跑时更常发生, 在容器间转移物品时也偶尔会掉落.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_coldaverse.en: Getting chilled is stressful and uncomfortable, more so the colder it gets.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_coldaverse.ch: 受寒會帶來壓力與不適, 越冷越嚴重.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_coldaverse.cn: 受寒会带来压力和不适, 越冷越严重.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_coldloving.en: Being chilled is calming and comfortable, more so the colder it gets.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_coldloving.ch: 身體發冷能讓人平靜舒適, 越冷越明顯.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_coldloving.cn: 身体发冷能让人平静舒适, 越冷越明显.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_depressive.en: Now and then sinks into a low mood that takes a long time to lift.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_depressive.ch: 不時陷入低落情緒, 而且很久才會好轉.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_depressive.cn: 不时陷入低落情绪, 而且很久才会好转.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_deprived.en: Starts with only underwear, a T-shirt, sneakers, a garbage bag and a key ring, and hauling a heavy load is upsetting.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_deprived.ch: 開局只有內衣、T恤、運動鞋、垃圾袋和鑰匙環, 背負重物會讓人心煩.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_deprived.cn: 开局只有内衣、T恤、运动鞋、垃圾袋和钥匙环, 背负重物会让人烦躁.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_gordonite.en: Deadly with a crowbar, and more so with Long Blunt and Strength.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_gordonite.ch: 使用撬棍時極具殺傷力, 長棍與力量等級越高越致命.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_gordonite.cn: 使用撬棍时极具杀伤力, 长棍和力量等级越高越致命.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_gourmand.en: Food they cook cooks faster, burns later and satisfies more.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_gourmand.ch: 親手烹煮的食物熟得更快、更不易燒焦, 也更令人滿足.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_gourmand.cn: 亲手烹饪的食物熟得更快、更不易烧焦, 也更令人满足.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_gunenthusiast.en: Shoots at the range for fun.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_gymrat.en: Workouts train Fitness and Strength faster and leave them less stiff.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_gymrat.ch: 健身時體格與力量提升更快, 鍛鍊痠痛也較輕.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_gymrat.cn: 锻炼时体格和力量提升更快, 锻炼疲劳也更轻.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_hardy.en: Holds a reserve of endurance, filled while fresh and spent when tiring.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_hardy.ch: 擁有一份儲備耐力, 精力充沛時填滿, 疲累時消耗.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_hardy.cn: 拥有一份储备耐力, 精力充沛时补满, 疲惫时消耗.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_heataverse.en: Overheating is stressful and uncomfortable, more so the hotter it gets.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_heataverse.ch: 過熱會帶來壓力與不適, 越熱越嚴重.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_heataverse.cn: 过热会带来压力和不适, 越热越严重.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_heatloving.en: Running hot is calming and comfortable, more so the hotter it gets.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_heatloving.ch: 身體發熱能讓人平靜舒適, 越熱越明顯.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_heatloving.cn: 身体发热能让人平静舒适, 越热越明显.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_hoarder.en: Carries more for every level of Strength.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_hoarder.ch: 每級力量帶來的負重加成較多.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_hoarder.cn: 每级力量带来的负重加成更多.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_homichlophile.en: Fog outdoors eases panic and stress.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_homichlophile.ch: 戶外起霧時能緩解恐慌與壓力.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_homichlophile.cn: 户外起雾时能缓解恐慌和压力.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_homichlophobia.en: Fog outdoors raises panic and stress.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_homichlophobia.ch: 戶外起霧時會加劇恐慌與壓力.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_homichlophobia.cn: 户外起雾时会加剧恐慌和压力.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_idealweight.en: Food fattens more while underweight and less while overweight, pulling weight toward healthy.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_idealweight.ch: 體重過輕時食物更容易增重, 過重時則較不易增重, 讓體重趨向健康.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_idealweight.cn: 体重过轻时食物更容易增重, 过重时则不易增重, 让体重趋向健康.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_immunocompromised.en: Infected wounds worsen faster, and any zombie wound can bring the Knox infection, even where the sandbox rules it out.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_immunocompromised.ch: 受感染的傷口惡化更快, 任何殭屍造成的傷口都可能帶來諾克斯感染, 即使沙盒設定排除了這種情況也一樣.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_immunocompromised.cn: 感染的伤口恶化更快, 任何僵尸造成的伤口都可能导致诺克斯感染, 即使沙盒设置排除了这种情况也一样.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_indefatigable.en: Near death or swarmed, springs back to full health and endurance and knocks nearby zombies down, then shrugs off pain for a short while.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_indefatigable.ch: 瀕死或遭圍攻時, 會恢復至滿健康與滿耐力並擊倒附近的殭屍, 之後短時間內不受疼痛影響.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_indefatigable.cn: 濒死或被围攻时, 会恢复至满健康和满耐力并击倒附近的僵尸, 之后短时间内不受疼痛影响.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_injured.en: Starts with bandaged wounds that heal slowly, and fresh injuries on those spots come out worse.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_injured.ch: 開局時帶著包紮過的傷口, 癒合緩慢, 這些部位的新傷也會更嚴重.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_injured.cn: 开局时带着包扎过的伤口, 愈合缓慢, 这些部位的新伤也会更严重.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_knifefighter.en: Has practised fighting with a knife.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_lowprofile.en: Good at keeping out of sight.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_madeofglass.en: Takes extra damage from every hit, and a hard knock can scratch or break something.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_madeofglass.ch: 每次受擊都會承受額外傷害, 重擊還可能造成刮傷或骨折.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_madeofglass.cn: 每次受击都会承受额外伤害, 重击还可能造成刮伤或骨折.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_naturaleater.en: Fresh, raw produce lifts the mood.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_naturaleater.ch: 新鮮的生鮮蔬果能提振心情.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_naturaleater.cn: 新鲜的生鲜果蔬能提振心情.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_noodlelegs.en: Can trip while running or sprinting, less often with Sprinting and Nimble.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_noodlelegs.ch: 跑步或衝刺時可能絆倒, 衝刺與靈活等級越高越少發生.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_noodlelegs.cn: 跑步或冲刺时可能绊倒, 冲刺和灵活等级越高越少发生.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_packmouse.en: Carries less for every level of Strength.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_packmouse.ch: 每級力量帶來的負重加成較少.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_packmouse.cn: 每级力量带来的负重加成更少.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_paintolerance.en: Pain never climbs past a limit.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_paintolerance.ch: 疼痛不會超過某個上限.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_paintolerance.cn: 疼痛不会超过某个上限.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_paranoia.en: On the move, sometimes panics at a zombie that isn't there and may scream, drawing real ones. Stress makes it likelier.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_paranoia.ch: 移動時偶爾會因不存在的殭屍而恐慌, 甚至尖叫, 引來真正的殭屍. 壓力越大越容易發生.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_paranoia.cn: 移动时偶尔会因不存在的僵尸而恐慌, 甚至尖叫, 引来真正的僵尸. 压力越大越容易发生.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_pettherapy.en: Petting an animal eases panic, stress, boredom and unhappiness.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_pettherapy.ch: 撫摸動物能緩解恐慌、壓力、無聊與憂鬱.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_pettherapy.cn: 抚摸动物能缓解恐慌、压力、无聊和忧郁.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_pluviophile.en: Rain outdoors eases unhappiness, stress and boredom, half as much under an umbrella.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_pluviophile.ch: 戶外下雨能緩解憂鬱、壓力與無聊, 撐傘時效果減半.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_pluviophile.cn: 户外下雨能缓解忧郁、压力和无聊, 打伞时效果减半.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_pluviophobia.en: Rain outdoors brings on unhappiness, stress and boredom, half as much under an umbrella.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_pluviophobia.ch: 戶外下雨會帶來憂鬱、壓力與無聊, 撐傘時效果減半.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_pluviophobia.cn: 户外下雨会带来忧郁、压力和无聊, 打伞时效果减半.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_prowessblade.en: Blades and axes hit harder, crit more with every blade and axe level, and often shrug off wear.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_prowessblade.ch: 刀刃與斧頭打擊更重, 刀刃與斧頭技能每升一級暴擊率都會提高, 且常能免於耗損.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_prowessblade.cn: 刀刃和斧头打击更重, 刀刃和斧头技能每升一级暴击率都会提高, 且常能免于磨损.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_prowessblunt.en: Blunt weapons hit harder, crit more with every blunt level, and often shrug off wear.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_prowessblunt.ch: 鈍器打擊更重, 鈍器技能每升一級暴擊率都會提高, 且常能免於耗損.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_prowessblunt.cn: 钝器打击更重, 钝器技能每升一级暴击率都会提高, 且常能免于磨损.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_prowessspear.en: Spears hit harder, crit more with every Spear level, and often shrug off wear.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_prowessspear.ch: 長矛打擊更重, 長矛技能每升一級暴擊率都會提高, 且常能免於耗損.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_prowessspear.cn: 长矛打击更重, 长矛技能每升一级暴击率都会提高, 且常能免于磨损.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_pyromania.en: Fire nearby eases panic and unhappiness, more the closer it is.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_pyromania.ch: 附近有火能緩解恐慌與憂鬱, 距離越近效果越強.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_pyromania.cn: 附近有火能缓解恐慌和忧郁, 距离越近效果越强.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_pyrophobia.en: Fire nearby raises panic and unhappiness, sharply when close.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_pyrophobia.ch: 附近有火會加劇恐慌與憂鬱, 距離很近時更會急遽上升.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_pyrophobia.cn: 附近有火会加剧恐慌和忧郁, 距离很近时更会急剧上升.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_quickrest.en: Gets endurance back faster while sitting down.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_restorationexpert.en: Repairs sometimes don't count against the item.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_restorationexpert.ch: 修理有時不會計入物品的修理次數.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_restorationexpert.cn: 修理有时不会计入物品的修理次数.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_scrapper.en: Used to working with scrap metal.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_selfdestructive.en: Deep unhappiness slowly wears health down, harder with Depressive, whose bouts it also makes likelier.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_selfdestructive.ch: 深度憂鬱會慢慢削減健康, 若有「憂鬱體質」則更嚴重, 也會讓其發作更頻繁.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_selfdestructive.cn: 深度忧郁会慢慢削减健康, 若有“抑郁倾向”则更严重, 也会让其发作更频繁.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_sunsensitivity.en: Daylight outdoors builds a headache, eased by holding an umbrella.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_sunsensitivity.ch: 白天待在戶外會逐漸頭痛, 撐傘可以緩解.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_sunsensitivity.cn: 白天待在户外会逐渐头痛, 打伞可以缓解.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_superimmune.en: Immune to the Knox infection, infected wounds and colds.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_superimmune.ch: 對諾克斯感染、傷口感染與感冒免疫.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_superimmune.cn: 对诺克斯感染、伤口感染和感冒免疫.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_tavernbrawler.en: Improvised weapons hit harder and wear down slower, most of all the flimsy ones.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_tavernbrawler.ch: 臨時武器打擊更重、耗損更慢, 越脆弱的武器效果越明顯.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_tavernbrawler.cn: 临时武器打击更重、磨损更慢, 越脆弱的武器效果越明显.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_terminator.en: Firearms hit harder, aim faster, reach further and jam less, and aiming one is calming.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_terminator.ch: 槍械傷害更高、瞄準更快、射程更遠、更少卡彈, 持槍瞄準也能讓人平靜.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_terminator.cn: 枪械伤害更高、瞄准更快、射程更远、更少卡壳, 持枪瞄准也能让人平静.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_thickblooded.ch: 出血傷口流失的健康較少.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_thickblooded.cn: 出血伤口流失的健康更少.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_tvjunkie.en: Needs television. A day without enough of it brings on boredom and unhappiness until the next watch.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_tvjunkie.ch: 離不開電視. 一天看得不夠就會無聊與憂鬱, 直到下次看電視為止.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_tvjunkie.cn: 离不开电视. 一天看得不够就会无聊和忧郁, 直到下次看电视为止.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_unwavering.en: Tiredness, exhaustion and pain barely weaken their swings, and wounds slow them less.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_unwavering.ch: 疲勞、精疲力竭與疼痛幾乎不影響揮擊, 傷口造成的減速也較少.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_unwavering.cn: 疲劳、精疲力竭和疼痛几乎不影响挥击, 伤口造成的减速也更少.

IGUI_DD_T_etw_wellfitted.en: Worn clothes weigh less and slow running and fighting much less.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_wellfitted.ch: 穿著的衣物重量較輕, 對奔跑與戰鬥的拖慢也大幅減少.
IGUI_DD_T_etw_wellfitted.cn: 穿着的衣物重量更轻, 对奔跑和战斗的拖累也大幅减少.

IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_eagleeyed.en: Spots things sooner, sees wider, and shoots better at range.
IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_eagleeyed.ch: 更早發現事物, 視野更寬廣, 遠距離射擊也更準.
IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_eagleeyed.cn: 更早发现目标, 视野更广, 远距离射击也更准.

IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_herbalist.en: Finds medicinal herbs, and makes medicine from them.
IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_herbalist.ch: 能找到藥草, 並用來製藥.
IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_herbalist.cn: 能找到药草, 并用其制药.

IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_improviser.en: Can improvise shivs, aerosol bombs and smoke bombs.
IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_improviser.ch: 能臨時製作自製匕首、氣溶膠炸彈與煙霧彈.
IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_improviser.cn: 能临时制作自制匕首、气溶胶炸弹和烟雾弹.

IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_navigator.en: Starts with a satchel of Knox Country maps.
IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_navigator.ch: 開局帶著一個裝滿諾克斯縣地圖的側背包.
IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_navigator.cn: 开局带着一个装满诺克斯县地图的单肩挎包.

IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_navigators.en: Starts with a satchel of Knox Country maps.
IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_navigators.ch: 開局帶著一個裝滿諾克斯縣地圖的側背包.
IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_navigators.cn: 开局带着一个装满诺克斯县地图的单肩挎包.

IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_tranquil.en: Unfazed by what would panic anyone else.
IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_tranquil.ch: 面對會讓別人恐慌的事物也處變不驚.
IGUI_DD_T_expandedprofessions_tranquil.cn: 面对会让别人恐慌的事物也处变不惊.

IGUI_DD_T_hydecobees_apiphobia.en: Terrified of bees. Angry ones bring on real panic, harvests come up short, and a queen sours in their care.
IGUI_DD_T_hydecobees_apiphobia.ch: 非常怕蜜蜂. 被激怒的蜂群會引發真正的恐慌, 收穫量會減少, 由其照料的蜂后也會變得暴躁.
IGUI_DD_T_hydecobees_apiphobia.cn: 非常怕蜜蜂. 被激怒的蜂群会引发真正的恐慌, 收获量会减少, 由其照料的蜂后也会变得暴躁.

IGUI_DD_T_hydecobees_beekeeper.en: Calm around a disturbed hive, takes more from every harvest, and can settle a queen to make her lay better.
IGUI_DD_T_hydecobees_beekeeper.ch: 面對受驚擾的蜂箱也能保持冷靜, 每次收穫更多, 還能安撫蜂后讓她產卵更好.
IGUI_DD_T_hydecobees_beekeeper.cn: 面对受惊扰的蜂箱也能保持冷静, 每次收获更多, 还能安抚蜂后让她产卵更好.

IGUI_DD_T_hydecobees_beekeeper2.en: Calm around a disturbed hive, takes more from every harvest, and can settle a queen to make her lay better.
IGUI_DD_T_hydecobees_beekeeper2.ch: 面對受驚擾的蜂箱也能保持冷靜, 每次收穫更多, 還能安撫蜂后讓她產卵更好.
IGUI_DD_T_hydecobees_beekeeper2.cn: 面对受惊扰的蜂箱也能保持冷静, 每次收获更多, 还能安抚蜂后让她产卵更好.

IGUI_DD_T_hydecounderground_badback.en: Digging with a pick or shovel wears them out faster, and they start out weaker.
IGUI_DD_T_hydecounderground_badback.ch: 用鎬或鏟子挖掘時更容易累, 開局時也較虛弱.
IGUI_DD_T_hydecounderground_badback.cn: 用镐或铲子挖掘时更容易累, 开局时也更虚弱.

IGUI_DD_T_hydecounderground_deeplungs.en: Breathes easier in the stale and foul air underground.
IGUI_DD_T_hydecounderground_deeplungs.ch: 在地底沉悶汙濁的空氣中呼吸較順暢.
IGUI_DD_T_hydecounderground_deeplungs.cn: 在地下沉闷污浊的空气中呼吸更顺畅.

IGUI_DD_T_hydecounderground_miner2.en: Used to tight spaces below ground.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_artistic.en: A natural at art, and a decent writer with it.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_artistic.ch: 天生擅長藝術, 文筆也不錯.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_artistic.cn: 天生擅长艺术, 文笔也不错.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_beach.en: Has a taste for beach music.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_beachno.en: Would rather hear anything but beach music.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_beachno.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放海灘音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_beachno.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放海滩音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_classical.en: Has a taste for classical music.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_classicalno.en: Would rather hear anything but classical music.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_classicalno.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放古典音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_classicalno.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放古典音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_cleanfreak.en: Cannot abide mess, and takes their time putting it right.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_cleanfreak.ch: 無法忍受髒亂, 整理乾淨卻要花較長時間.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_cleanfreak.cn: 无法忍受脏乱, 收拾干净却要花更长时间.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_couchpotato.en: Tires quickly, sleeps often, and would rather stay in than go out.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_couchpotato.ch: 容易疲倦、常常睡覺, 寧可待在家也不想出門.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_couchpotato.cn: 容易疲倦、经常睡觉, 宁愿待在家也不想出门.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_country.en: Has a taste for country music.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_countryno.en: Would rather hear anything but country music.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_countryno.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放鄉村音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_countryno.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放乡村音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_disciplined.en: Focused and self-improving. A natural at martial arts and meditation.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_disciplined.ch: 專注且力求精進. 天生擅長武術與冥想.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_disciplined.cn: 专注且追求自我提升. 天生擅长武术和冥想.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_discono.en: Would rather hear anything but oldies.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_discono.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放老歌.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_discono.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放老歌.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_holiday.en: Has a taste for holiday music.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_holidayno.en: Would rather hear anything but holiday music.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_holidayno.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放節日音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_holidayno.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放节日音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_jazzno.en: Would rather hear anything but jazz.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_jazzno.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放爵士音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_jazzno.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放爵士音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_killjoy.en: Crowds, loud music and excitement are not for them.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_killjoy.ch: 人群、吵鬧的音樂與刺激的場面都不適合他們.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_killjoy.cn: 人群、吵闹的音乐和刺激的场面都不适合他们.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_metalno.en: Would rather hear anything but metal.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_metalno.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放金屬音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_metalno.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放金属音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_muzakno.en: Would rather hear anything but muzak.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_muzakno.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放輕音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_muzakno.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放轻音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_partyanimal.en: Made for the dance floor, and keeps the party going.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_partyanimal.ch: 天生屬於舞池, 總能讓派對熱鬧不斷.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_partyanimal.cn: 天生属于舞池, 总能让派对热闹不断.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_popno.en: Would rather hear anything but pop.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_popno.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放流行音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_popno.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放流行音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_rapno.en: Would rather hear anything but rap.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_rapno.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放饒舌音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_rapno.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放说唱音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_rbsoul.en: Has a taste for R&B and soul.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_rbsoul.ch: 喜歡聽R&B 與靈魂音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_rbsoul.cn: 喜欢听R&B 和灵魂音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_rbsoulno.en: Would rather hear anything but R&B and soul.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_rbsoulno.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放R&B 與靈魂音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_rbsoulno.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放R&B 和灵魂音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_reggaeno.en: Would rather hear anything but reggae.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_reggaeno.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放雷鬼音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_reggaeno.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放雷鬼音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_rockno.en: Would rather hear anything but rock.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_rockno.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放搖滾音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_rockno.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放摇滚音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_salsano.en: Would rather hear anything but salsa.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_salsano.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放薩爾薩音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_salsano.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放萨尔萨音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_sloppy.en: Untroubled by mess, and makes plenty more of it.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_sloppy.ch: 不在意髒亂, 還會製造更多髒亂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_sloppy.cn: 不在意脏乱, 还会制造更多脏乱.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_tidy.en: Keeps the place clean without effort, and makes less mess to begin with.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_tidy.ch: 輕鬆就能保持環境整潔, 本來就不太會弄亂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_tidy.cn: 轻松就能保持环境整洁, 本来就不太会弄乱.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_tonedeaf.en: No ear for music, and no patience for it.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_tonedeaf.ch: 沒有音感, 對音樂也沒耐心.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_tonedeaf.cn: 没有乐感, 对音乐也没耐心.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_virtuoso.en: A natural musician, and a charismatic performer with it.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_virtuoso.ch: 天生的音樂家, 也是極具魅力的表演者.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_virtuoso.cn: 天生的音乐家, 也是极具魅力的表演者.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_world.en: Has a taste for world music.

IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_worldno.en: Would rather hear anything but world music.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_worldno.ch: 聽什麼都好, 就是別放世界音樂.
IGUI_DD_T_lifestyle_worldno.cn: 听什么都行, 就是别放世界音乐.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_desensitized_copy.ch: 幾乎不會恐慌, 也不在意不適.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_desensitized_copy.cn: 几乎不会恐慌, 也不在意不适.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_dextrous_copy.en: Quick with inventory and weapons, and sure-handed on a rope.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_dextrous_copy.ch: 操作物品欄與武器迅速, 攀繩時手也很穩.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_dextrous_copy.cn: 操作物品栏和武器迅速, 攀绳时手也很稳.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_inconspicuous_copy.en: Less likely to be spotted by zombies.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_acrophobic.en: Panics near a drop or on a rope, climbs badly, and may refuse a high window.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_acrophobic.ch: 靠近高處邊緣或攀繩時會恐慌, 不擅攀爬, 還可能拒絕翻越高處的窗戶.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_acrophobic.cn: 靠近高处边缘或攀绳时会恐慌, 不擅攀爬, 还可能拒绝翻越高处的窗户.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_alcoholic.en: Addicted to drink. Going without brings misery, and a glass settles the nerves.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_alcoholic.ch: 對酒精成癮. 沒酒喝會很痛苦, 喝一杯就能平復情緒.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_alcoholic.cn: 酒精成瘾. 没酒喝会很痛苦, 喝一杯就能平复情绪.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_basketballplayer.en: Quick on their feet, and used to changing direction at speed.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_basketballplayer.ch: 腳步敏捷, 習慣在高速中轉向.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_basketballplayer.cn: 脚步敏捷, 习惯在高速中变向.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_brokeleg.en: Starts out with a fractured leg.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_corpsefamiliar.en: Handles the dead without falling ill.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_defensetactics.en: Better at breaking a zombie's grab.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_demoman.en: Swings a sledgehammer hard, and often.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_depressive.en: Sadness creeps in unprompted and deepens the longer it is left. Medication holds it off.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_depressive.ch: 悲傷會無故湧上心頭, 放著不管就越陷越深. 藥物可以抑制.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_depressive.cn: 悲伤会无缘无故涌上心头, 放任不管就越陷越深. 药物可以抑制.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_electricalknowledge.en: Knows how electronics are put together, and can run a generator.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_electricalknowledge.ch: 了解電子產品的構造, 也會操作發電機.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_electricalknowledge.cn: 了解电子产品的构造, 也会使用发电机.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_electricalknowledge_co.en: Knows how electronics are put together, and can run a generator.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_electricalknowledge_co.ch: 了解電子產品的構造, 也會操作發電機.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_electricalknowledge_co.cn: 了解电子产品的构造, 也会使用发电机.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_fearful.en: Cries out when frightened, though crouching muffles it.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_fearful.ch: 受驚時會叫出聲, 但蹲下能壓低聲音.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_fearful.cn: 受惊时会叫出声, 但蹲下能压低声音.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_footballplayer.en: Built for short, heavy bursts of effort.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_footballplayer.ch: 天生適合短時間的高強度爆發.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_footballplayer.cn: 天生适合短时间的高强度爆发.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_gunknowledge.en: Has handled firearms, and knows how to keep one fed.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_gunknowledge.ch: 用過槍械, 也知道如何替槍裝填彈藥.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_gunknowledge.cn: 用过枪械, 也知道怎么给枪装弹.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_inattentive.en: Trips over things and comes to grief at dangerous work. Moving slowly helps.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_inattentive.ch: 常被東西絆倒, 從事危險工作時容易出事. 放慢動作會有幫助.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_inattentive.cn: 常被东西绊倒, 干危险的活时容易出事. 放慢动作会有帮助.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_keendriver.en: Drives faster, quieter and more surely.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_lithe.en: Turns quickly, and picks up nimbleness a little faster.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_lithe.ch: 轉身迅速, 靈活技能也學得稍快.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_lithe.cn: 转身迅速, 灵活技能也学得稍快.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_lumbering.en: Turns slowly, and picks up nimbleness a little slower.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_lumbering.ch: 轉身緩慢, 靈活技能也學得稍慢.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_lumbering.cn: 转身缓慢, 灵活技能也学得稍慢.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_majorlimp.en: Walks with a permanent heavy limp.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_minorlimp.en: Walks with a permanent slight limp.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_noemotion.en: Feels neither sadness, happiness nor panic.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_noemotion.ch: 感受不到悲傷、快樂與恐慌.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_noemotion.cn: 感受不到悲伤、快乐和恐慌.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_pickaxeman.en: Swings a pickaxe hard, and often.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_poordriver.en: Drives slower, louder and less surely.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_rushhour.en: Gets in and out of cars, and shifts their load, quickly.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_rushhour.ch: 上下車與搬移物品都很迅速.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_rushhour.cn: 上下车和搬运物品都很迅速.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_soccerplayer.en: Used to running and turning for ninety minutes at a stretch.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_soccerplayer.ch: 習慣連續九十分鐘的奔跑與轉向.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_soccerplayer.cn: 习惯连续九十分钟的奔跑和变向.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_strongback.en: Carries more, and strength counts for more towards it.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_strongback.ch: 負重更多, 力量對負重的加成也更大.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_strongback.cn: 负重更多, 力量对负重的加成也更大.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_weakback.en: Carries less, and strength counts for less towards it.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_weakback.ch: 負重更少, 力量對負重的加成也更小.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_weakback.cn: 负重更少, 力量对负重的加成也更小.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_weldingknowledge.en: Familiar with the methods and joints of welding.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_weldingknowledge.ch: 熟悉焊接的方法與接頭.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_weldingknowledge.cn: 熟悉焊接的方法和接头.

IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_weldingknowledge_copy.en: Familiar with the methods and joints of welding.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_weldingknowledge_copy.ch: 熟悉焊接的方法與接頭.
IGUI_DD_T_mar_mar_weldingknowledge_copy.cn: 熟悉焊接的方法和接头.

IGUI_DD_T_pivotmod_onyourtoes.en: Light on the feet, and turns on the spot.
IGUI_DD_T_pivotmod_onyourtoes.ch: 腳步輕盈, 能原地轉身.
IGUI_DD_T_pivotmod_onyourtoes.cn: 脚步轻盈, 能原地转身.

IGUI_DD_T_pivotmod_podshofe.en: Never quite sober, and slow to turn.
IGUI_DD_T_pivotmod_podshofe.ch: 從沒完全清醒過, 轉身也慢.
IGUI_DD_T_pivotmod_podshofe.cn: 从没完全清醒过, 转身也慢.

IGUI_DD_T_pk42_cannibalist.en: Has developed a taste for the wrong kind of meat.
IGUI_DD_T_pk42_cannibalist.ch: 對不該吃的肉產生了興趣.
IGUI_DD_T_pk42_cannibalist.cn: 对不该吃的肉产生了兴趣.

IGUI_DD_T_pk42_psychopath.en: Carries on exactly as before, without any of the consequences.
IGUI_DD_T_pk42_psychopath.ch: 一切照舊, 卻不會承受任何後果.
IGUI_DD_T_pk42_psychopath.cn: 一切照旧, 却不会承受任何后果.

IGUI_DD_T_reachmod_longarms.en: Reaches containers and the things inside them from further away. Doors, switches and fighting are unchanged.
IGUI_DD_T_reachmod_longarms.ch: 能從更遠處取用容器與其中的物品. 門、開關與戰鬥不受影響.
IGUI_DD_T_reachmod_longarms.cn: 能从更远处取用容器及其中的物品. 门、开关和战斗不受影响.

IGUI_DD_T_reachmod_shortarms.en: Has to stand almost on top of a container to use it. Doors, switches and fighting are unchanged.
IGUI_DD_T_reachmod_shortarms.ch: 必須幾乎貼著容器才能使用. 門、開關與戰鬥不受影響.
IGUI_DD_T_reachmod_shortarms.cn: 必须几乎贴着容器才能使用. 门、开关和战斗不受影响.

IGUI_DD_T_regretnothing_regretnothing.en: Immune to panic, thrives on violence, and smokes.
IGUI_DD_T_regretnothing_regretnothing.ch: 不會恐慌, 以暴力為樂, 而且抽菸.
IGUI_DD_T_regretnothing_regretnothing.cn: 不会恐慌, 以暴力为乐, 而且抽烟.

IGUI_DD_T_rr_railroader.en: Cleared to run any locomotive without reading its manual, and coaxes a cold diesel into life more often.
IGUI_DD_T_rr_railroader.ch: 無須閱讀手冊即可駕駛任何火車頭, 冷車發動柴油引擎的成功率也更高.
IGUI_DD_T_rr_railroader.cn: 无须阅读手册即可驾驶任何机车, 冷车发动柴油机的成功率也更高.

IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_buzzard.en: Far more resistant to food poisoning.
IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_buzzard.ch: 對食物中毒的抵抗力大幅提升.
IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_buzzard.cn: 对食物中毒的抵抗力大幅提升.

IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_indomitable.en: A will to persevere that fate does not always overrule.
IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_indomitable.ch: 堅韌的意志, 有時連命運也無法左右.
IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_indomitable.cn: 坚韧的意志, 有时连命运也无法左右.

IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_optimistic.en: Sadness comes slowly, and lifts easily.
IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_optimistic.ch: 悲傷來得慢, 也容易消散.
IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_optimistic.cn: 悲伤来得慢, 也容易消散.

IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_pessimistic.en: Sadness comes quickly, and is hard to shake.
IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_pessimistic.ch: 悲傷來得快, 也難以擺脫.
IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_pessimistic.cn: 悲伤来得快, 也难以摆脱.

IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_photographicmemory.en: Skill books hand over flat experience as well.
IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_photographicmemory.ch: 技能書也會直接給予固定經驗值.
IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_photographicmemory.cn: 技能书也会直接给予固定经验值.

IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_sandbagimmune.en: Immune to the Knox virus. Everything else in Kentucky still applies.
IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_sandbagimmune.ch: 對諾克斯病毒免疫. 肯塔基州的其他一切依然如故.
IGUI_DD_T_sandbag_sandbagimmune.cn: 对诺克斯病毒免疫. 肯塔基州的其他一切依然如故.

IGUI_DD_T_schizophreniatraitb42_schizoph.en: Hears sounds that were never made, and sometimes sees a zombie that is not there. Stress feeds it, the laughter carries, and the tablets that quiet it turn poisonous when stacked.
IGUI_DD_T_schizophreniatraitb42_schizoph.ch: 會聽見不存在的聲音, 偶爾還會看見不存在的殭屍. 壓力會加重症狀, 笑聲會傳得很遠, 而用來抑制症狀的藥片一旦疊加服用就會變成毒藥.
IGUI_DD_T_schizophreniatraitb42_schizoph.cn: 会听到不存在的声音, 偶尔还会看到不存在的僵尸. 压力会加重症状, 笑声会传得很远, 而用来压制症状的药片一旦叠加服用就会变成毒药.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_adrenalinejunkie2.en: Moves faster while badly panicked, and holds up better with zombies close.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_adrenalinejunkie2.ch: 極度恐慌時移動更快, 殭屍逼近時也更能撐住.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_adrenalinejunkie2.cn: 严重恐慌时移动更快, 僵尸逼近时也更能撑住.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_advancedforaging.en: Much better at finding the things their occupation would look for.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_advancedforaging.ch: 遠比一般人更容易找到與自身職業相關的物品.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_advancedforaging.cn: 远比常人更容易找到与自身职业相关的物品.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_agile.en: Quick to move and change direction.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_alcoholic.en: Addicted to drink. Going without brings boredom, misery and thirst, then worse.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_alcoholic.ch: 對酒精成癮. 沒酒喝會無聊、痛苦又口渴, 接著情況會更糟.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_alcoholic.cn: 酒精成瘾. 没酒喝会无聊、痛苦又口渴, 随后情况会更糟.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_allergic.en: Sneezes without warning, and the noise carries.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_allergic.ch: 會毫無預警地打噴嚏, 聲音還傳得很遠.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_allergic.cn: 会毫无预兆地打喷嚏, 声音还传得很远.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_automechanic.en: Has spent plenty of time under the hood.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_automechanic.ch: 常常埋首引擎蓋下修車.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_automechanic.cn: 经常埋头在引擎盖下修车.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_bludgeoner.en: Practised with hammers, clubs and other short blunt weapons.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_bludgeoner.ch: 熟練使用錘子、棍棒等短鈍器.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_bludgeoner.cn: 熟练使用锤子、棍棒等短钝器.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_breakintechnique.en: Axes bite harder into doors and barricades.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_breakintechnique.ch: 用斧頭劈砍門與加固物時更有力.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_breakintechnique.cn: 用斧头劈砍门和加固物时更有力.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_breathingtechnique.en: Recovers endurance while standing still, and faster still while sitting.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_breathingtechnique.ch: 站著不動時恢復耐力, 坐下時恢復得更快.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_breathingtechnique.cn: 静止站立时恢复耐力, 坐下时恢复得更快.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_breathingtechnique2.en: Recovers endurance while standing still, and faster still while sitting.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_breathingtechnique2.ch: 站著不動時恢復耐力, 坐下時恢復得更快.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_breathingtechnique2.cn: 静止站立时恢复耐力, 坐下时恢复得更快.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_calmminded.en: Keeps their head. Stress and panic fade quickly.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_calmminded.ch: 遇事冷靜. 壓力與恐慌消退得很快.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_calmminded.cn: 遇事冷静. 压力和恐慌消退得很快.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_commercialdriver.en: Tires less at the wheel, and can repair heavy vehicles.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_commercialdriver.ch: 開車時較不易疲勞, 也能修理商用型車輛.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_commercialdriver.cn: 开车时不易疲劳, 也能修理商用型车辆.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_culinary.en: Knows their way around a kitchen.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_cuttingtools.en: Learns faster while swinging an axe or a blade in the main hand.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_cuttingtools.ch: 主手揮舞斧頭或刀刃時學得更快.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_cuttingtools.cn: 主手挥舞斧头或刀刃时学得更快.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_depressive.en: Often low, sometimes for no reason, and a bad mood slows their learning.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_depressive.ch: 經常情緒低落, 有時毫無來由, 心情差時學習也會變慢.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_depressive.cn: 经常情绪低落, 有时毫无来由, 心情差时学习也会变慢.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_desensitized2.ch: 幾乎不會恐慌, 也不在意不適.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_desensitized2.cn: 几乎不会恐慌, 也不在意不适.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_dextrous2.en: Quick with inventory and weapons, and sure-handed on a rope.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_dextrous2.ch: 操作物品欄與武器迅速, 攀繩時手也很穩.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_dextrous2.cn: 操作物品栏和武器迅速, 攀绳时手也很稳.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_durability.en: Keeps equipment in working order for longer.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_durability.ch: 能讓裝備維持堪用狀態更久.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_durability.cn: 能让装备保持可用状态更久.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_eagleeyed2.en: Spots things sooner, sees wider, and shoots better at range.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_eagleeyed2.ch: 更早發現事物, 視野更寬廣, 遠距離射擊也更準.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_eagleeyed2.cn: 更早发现目标, 视野更广, 远距离射击也更准.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_entomologist.en: Better at turning up insects while searching.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_entomologist.ch: 搜尋時更容易找到昆蟲.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_entomologist.cn: 搜寻时更容易找到昆虫.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_fastmetabolism.en: Sheds weight easily. Builds fitness quickly, strength slowly.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_fastmetabolism.ch: 容易減重. 體格提升快, 力量提升慢.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_fastmetabolism.cn: 容易减重. 体格提升快, 力量提升慢.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_fearofthedark.en: Panics in the dark, and the dark wears on them.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_fearofthedark.ch: 在黑暗中會恐慌, 黑暗也會讓人身心俱疲.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_fearofthedark.cn: 在黑暗中会恐慌, 黑暗也会让人身心俱疲.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_firstaid2.en: Trained to treat wounds and injuries.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_firstaid2.ch: 受過處理傷口與傷勢的訓練.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_firstaid2.cn: 受过处理伤口和伤势的训练.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_forager.en: Has an eye for what grows in the wild.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_forager.ch: 對野外生長的植物很有眼光.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_forager.cn: 对野外生长的植物很有眼光.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_formeralcoholic.en: Off the drink, but a single glass may start it again.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_formeralcoholic.ch: 已經戒酒, 但只要一杯就可能再度上癮.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_formeralcoholic.cn: 已经戒酒, 但只要一杯就可能再次上瘾.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_formerscout2.en: Lights fires quickly, and knows a little medicine, fishing and foraging.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_formerscout2.ch: 生火很快, 也懂一點醫療、釣魚與搜尋.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_formerscout2.cn: 生火很快, 也略懂医疗、钓鱼和搜寻.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_formersmoker.en: Off tobacco, but a single cigarette may start it again.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_formersmoker.ch: 已經戒菸, 但只要一根就可能再度上癮.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_formersmoker.cn: 已经戒烟, 但只要一支就可能再次上瘾.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_gardener2.en: Knows how to work a garden.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_generatorexpert.en: Can run a generator, and repairs one better than most.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_generatorexpert.ch: 會操作發電機, 修理起來也比大多數人在行.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_generatorexpert.cn: 会使用发电机, 修理起来也比大多数人在行.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_generatorexpert2.en: Can run a generator, and repairs one better than most.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_generatorexpert2.ch: 會操作發電機, 修理起來也比大多數人在行.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_generatorexpert2.cn: 会使用发电机, 修理起来也比大多数人在行.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_gymnast2.en: Light on the feet, and quick to change direction.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_gymnast2.ch: 腳步輕盈, 轉向迅速.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_gymnast2.cn: 脚步轻盈, 转向迅速.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_handy2.en: Builds faster and stronger, and barricades in a fraction of the time.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_handy2.ch: 建造更快更堅固, 加固所需時間也大幅縮短.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_handy2.cn: 建造更快更坚固, 加固所需时间也大幅缩短.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_herbalist2.en: Finds medicinal herbs, and makes medicine from them.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_herbalist2.ch: 能找到藥草, 並用來製藥.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_herbalist2.cn: 能找到药草, 并用其制药.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_highsweaty.en: Sweats heavily, and gets soaked doing it.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_highsweaty.ch: 大量流汗, 還會因此渾身濕透.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_highsweaty.cn: 大量出汗, 还会因此浑身湿透.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_hunter2.en: Used to stalking, shooting and dressing game.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_hunter2.ch: 習慣追蹤、射殺並處理獵物.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_hunter2.cn: 习惯追踪、射杀并处理猎物.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_improvedforaging.en: Better at finding the things their occupation would look for.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_improvedforaging.ch: 更容易找到與自身職業相關的物品.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_improvedforaging.cn: 更容易找到与自身职业相关的物品.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_inconspicuous2.en: Less likely to be spotted by zombies.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_inventive2.en: Works out recipes from items at lower skill levels.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_inventive2.ch: 能在較低技能等級時從物品中領悟配方.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_inventive2.cn: 能在较低技能等级时从物品中领悟配方.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_keenhearing2.en: Notices more of what is around them.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_knifer.en: Practised with knives and other short blades.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_knifer.ch: 熟練使用刀子等短刀類武器.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_knifer.cn: 熟练使用刀具等短刀类武器.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_larkperson.en: A morning person. Fresher early, flagging by evening.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_larkperson.ch: 早起型的人. 早上精神較好, 到了傍晚就沒勁.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_larkperson.cn: 早起型的人. 早上精神更好, 到了傍晚就没劲.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_lesssweaty.en: Sweats little, and stays drier for it.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_lesssweaty.ch: 很少流汗, 也因此較能保持乾爽.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_lesssweaty.cn: 很少出汗, 也因此更能保持干爽.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_lifelonglearner.en: Never bored while reading something instructive.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_lifelonglearner.ch: 閱讀有教育意義的讀物時從不感到無聊.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_lifelonglearner.cn: 阅读有教育意义的读物时从不感到无聊.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_masonry.en: Has worked with stone, brick and mortar.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_masonry.ch: 做過石材、磚塊與砂漿的工作.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_masonry.cn: 干过石材、砖块和砂浆的活.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_mushroompicker.en: Better at turning up mushrooms while searching.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_mushroompicker.ch: 搜尋時更容易找到蘑菇.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_mushroompicker.cn: 搜寻时更容易找到蘑菇.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_optimistic.en: Rarely bored, and a black mood never lasts long.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_optimistic.ch: 很少感到無聊, 壞心情也從不持久.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_optimistic.cn: 很少感到无聊, 坏心情也从不持久.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_organized2.en: Bags and world containers hold more.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_organized2.ch: 背包與場景容器可容納的量較多.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_organized2.cn: 背包和场景容器的容量更大.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_outdoorsman2.en: Shrugs off foul weather, and minds the outdoors less.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_outdoorsman2.ch: 不受惡劣天氣影響, 也較不排斥待在戶外.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_outdoorsman2.cn: 不受恶劣天气影响, 也不太排斥待在户外.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_owlperson.en: An evening person. Fresher at night, flagging in the morning.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_owlperson.ch: 夜貓子. 晚上精神較好, 早上則沒勁.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_owlperson.cn: 夜猫子. 晚上精神更好, 早上则没劲.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_panicattacks.en: Struck by sudden panic, and slow to shake it off.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_panicattacks.ch: 會突然陷入恐慌, 而且很難擺脫.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_panicattacks.cn: 会突然陷入恐慌, 而且很难摆脱.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_potter.en: Has thrown and fired clay before.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_refueller.en: Moves items, refuels and siphons faster.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_refueller.ch: 搬移物品、加油與抽油都更快.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_refueller.cn: 转移物品、加油和抽油都更快.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_sensitivedigestion.en: Overeating brings discomfort, pain and nausea.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_sensitivedigestion.ch: 吃太多會導致不適、疼痛與噁心.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_sensitivedigestion.cn: 吃太多会导致不适、疼痛和恶心.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_slack.en: Out of the habit of physical work.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_slowmetabolism.en: Puts on weight easily. Builds strength quickly, fitness slowly.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_slowmetabolism.ch: 容易增重. 力量提升快, 體格提升慢.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_slowmetabolism.cn: 容易增重. 力量提升快, 体格提升慢.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_spearman.en: Practised with spears and other polearms.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_spearman.ch: 熟練使用長矛等長柄武器.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_spearman.cn: 熟练使用长矛等长柄武器.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_stronggrip.en: Heavy swings cost no more endurance than ordinary ones.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_stronggrip.ch: 沉重的揮擊消耗的耐力不比一般揮擊多.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_stronggrip.cn: 沉重的挥击消耗的耐力不比普通挥击多.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_stronggrip2.en: Heavy swings cost no more endurance than ordinary ones.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_stronggrip2.ch: 沉重的揮擊消耗的耐力不比一般揮擊多.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_stronggrip2.cn: 沉重的挥击消耗的耐力不比普通挥击多.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_swordsman.en: Practised with swords and other long blades.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_swordsman.ch: 熟練使用劍等長刀類武器.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_swordsman.cn: 熟练使用剑等长刀类武器.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_taut.en: Kept in shape by regular physical work.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_taut.ch: 靠規律的體力勞動維持身材.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_taut.cn: 靠规律的体力劳动保持身材.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_tireless.en: May catch a second wind mid-fight, and shakes off muscle strain quickly.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_tireless.ch: 戰鬥中可能突然恢復元氣, 肌肉拉傷也恢復得快.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_tireless.cn: 战斗中可能突然恢复元气, 肌肉拉伤也恢复得快.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_tireless2.en: May catch a second wind mid-fight, and shakes off muscle strain quickly.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_tireless2.ch: 戰鬥中可能突然恢復元氣, 肌肉拉傷也恢復得快.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_tireless2.cn: 战斗中可能突然恢复元气, 肌肉拉伤也恢复得快.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_tracker.en: Can read the tracks and signs animals leave behind.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_tracker.ch: 能解讀動物留下的足跡與痕跡.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_tracker.cn: 能解读动物留下的足迹和痕迹.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_trapper.en: Knows how to set a trap.

IGUI_DD_T_soto_usedtocorpses.en: Rotting corpses no longer turn the stomach.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_usedtocorpses.ch: 腐爛的屍體不再讓人反胃.
IGUI_DD_T_soto_usedtocorpses.cn: 腐烂的尸体不再让人反胃.

IGUI_DD_T_squaregrail_highstriker.en: Knows how to land a blow with a club or hammer.
IGUI_DD_T_squaregrail_highstriker.ch: 懂得用棍棒或錘子打出有效的一擊.
IGUI_DD_T_squaregrail_highstriker.cn: 懂得用棍棒或锤子打出有效的一击.

IGUI_DD_T_squaregrail_hostilewanderer.ch: 揮舞長矛時較不易疲勞.

IGUI_DD_T_squaregrail_organized2.en: Bags and world containers hold more.
IGUI_DD_T_squaregrail_organized2.ch: 背包與場景容器可容納的量較多.
IGUI_DD_T_squaregrail_organized2.cn: 背包和场景容器的容量更大.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swacrophobic.en: Heights are stressful, and worse out in the open.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swacrophobic.ch: 身處高處會感到壓力, 在空曠處更嚴重.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swacrophobic.cn: 身处高处会感到压力, 在开阔处更严重.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swadaptivemetabolism.en: Burns calories at whatever rate pulls them back to a healthy weight.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swadaptivemetabolism.ch: 熱量消耗速度會自動調整, 讓體重回到健康範圍.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swadaptivemetabolism.cn: 热量消耗速度会自动调整, 让体重回到健康范围.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swbouncer.en: Loses endurance more slowly in a fight.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swbrittle.en: A fall is likely to break a hand or a foot.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swbrittle.ch: 跌倒時很可能摔斷手或腳.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swbrittle.cn: 摔倒时很可能摔断手或脚.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swcompanion.en: A frog, slug or snail in the bag lifts the mood.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swcompanion.ch: 包包裡有青蛙、蛞蝓或蝸牛能提振心情.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swcompanion.cn: 包里有青蛙、蛞蝓或蜗牛能提振心情.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swcompetitiveeater.en: Eats and drinks in half the time.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swcouchdweller.ch: 待在室內時更快樂, 也較不無聊.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swcouchdweller.cn: 待在室内时更快乐, 也不那么无聊.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swdrunkard.en: Stays drunk longer without the fatigue, but sober hands lose their grip.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swdrunkard.ch: 醉得更久卻不會因此疲勞, 但清醒時手會握不穩.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swdrunkard.cn: 醉得更久却不会因此疲劳, 但清醒时手会握不稳.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swflailer.en: Panic sets them tripping and shrieking as they run.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swflailer.ch: 恐慌時會邊跑邊絆倒、尖叫.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swflailer.cn: 恐慌时会边跑边绊倒、尖叫.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swflatearther.en: Cannot use the map or the minimap. Map items still work.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swflatearther.ch: 無法使用地圖或小地圖. 地圖物品仍可使用.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swflatearther.cn: 无法使用地图或小地图. 地图物品仍可使用.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swflimsy.en: A heavy pack wrecks the arms and slows every swing.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swflimsy.ch: 背負重物會累壞雙臂, 讓每次揮擊都變慢.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swflimsy.cn: 背负重物会累坏双臂, 让每次挥击都变慢.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swimmuneresponse.en: Recovers endurance better while fighting the infection.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swimmuneresponse.ch: 對抗感染期間耐力恢復較好.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swimmuneresponse.cn: 对抗感染期间耐力恢复更好.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swinjured.en: Starts with a fracture somewhere in the legs.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swironliver.en: Sobers up quickly, and never tires from drink.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swironliver.ch: 酒醒得快, 喝酒也從不會疲勞.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swironliver.cn: 酒醒得快, 喝酒也从不会疲劳.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swlurcher.en: Liable to trip when running on empty.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swlurcher.ch: 耐力耗盡時奔跑容易絆倒.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swlurcher.cn: 耐力耗尽时奔跑容易绊倒.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swmaniac.en: Being covered in blood puts them in a fine mood.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swmaniac.ch: 渾身是血會讓人心情大好.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swmaniac.cn: 浑身是血会让人心情大好.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swonetrickpony.en: Will only carry their best type of melee weapon.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swonetrickpony.ch: 只願攜帶自己最擅長的那類近戰武器.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swonetrickpony.cn: 只愿携带自己最擅长的那类近战武器.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swpacer.en: Loses endurance more slowly while running.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swparamedic.en: Treats wounds in half the time.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swparamedic.ch: 治療傷口所需時間減半.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swparamedic.cn: 治疗伤口所需时间减半.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swpitcrew.en: Works on and refuels vehicles in half the time.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swpitcrew.ch: 進行車輛作業與加油所需時間減半.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swpitcrew.cn: 车辆作业和加油所需时间减半.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swproductive.en: Crafts, sews and consolidates in half the time.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swproductive.ch: 製作、縫紉與合併物品所需時間減半.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swproductive.cn: 制作、缝纫和合并物品所需时间减半.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swsloth.en: Tires slowly while walking or standing.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swsloth.ch: 走路或站立時較不易疲累.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swsloth.cn: 走路或站立时不易疲累.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swsundayrunner.ch: 衝刺會帶來壓力與憂鬱.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swsundayrunner.cn: 冲刺会带来压力和忧郁.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swtrekker.en: Recovers endurance while walking or standing still.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swtrekker.ch: 走路或靜止站立時也能恢復耐力.
IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swtrekker.cn: 走路或静止站立时也能恢复耐力.

IGUI_DD_T_swtraits_swvehophobic.en: Will not get into a vehicle.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_actionhero.en: Fights better the more zombies are close, hitting harder and landing more critical hits in a crowd.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_actionhero.ch: 附近殭屍越多越能打, 被包圍時打擊更重、暴擊更多.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_actionhero.cn: 附近僵尸越多越能打, 被包围时打击更重、暴击更多.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_albino.en: Daylight outdoors brings on a building headache. An umbrella slows it.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_albino.ch: 白天待在戶外會逐漸頭痛. 撐傘能減緩.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_albino.cn: 白天待在户外会逐渐头痛. 打伞能减缓.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_amputee.en: Missing an arm: nothing goes in the off hand and two-handed items cannot be held, but that arm can never be hurt.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_amputee.ch: 少了一隻手臂: 副手無法持物, 也無法拿雙手物品, 但那隻手臂永遠不會受傷.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_amputee.cn: 缺了一条手臂: 副手无法持物, 也无法拿双手物品, 但那条手臂永远不会受伤.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_anemic.en: Bleeding wounds drain health faster, worst on the head and neck.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_anemic.ch: 出血傷口會更快流失健康, 頭部與頸部最嚴重.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_anemic.cn: 出血伤口会更快流失健康, 头部和颈部最严重.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_antigun.en: Clumsy with guns: slower to aim, shorter reach and slower to learn Aiming, and aiming one brings their mood down.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_antigun.ch: 不擅用槍: 瞄準較慢、射程較短, 瞄準技能也學得較慢, 持槍瞄準還會讓心情變差.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_antigun.cn: 不擅用枪: 瞄准更慢、射程更短, 瞄准技能也学得更慢, 持枪瞄准还会让心情变差.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_antique.en: Now and then turns up rare antique versions of items in crates and metal shelves.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_antique.ch: 偶爾會在板條箱與金屬貨架上找到稀有的古董版物品.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_antique.cn: 偶尔会在板条箱和金属货架上找到稀有的古董版物品.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_ascetic.en: Cooked meals sour their mood, packaged snacks lift nothing, and cooking takes them longer.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_ascetic.ch: 熟食會讓心情變差, 包裝零食也無法提振心情, 烹飪還要花更久時間.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_ascetic.cn: 熟食会让心情变差, 包装零食也无法提振心情, 烹饪还要花更久时间.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_badteeth.en: Eating hurts. The bigger the meal, the worse the pain.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_badteeth.ch: 進食會痛. 吃得越多越痛.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_badteeth.cn: 进食会痛. 吃得越多越痛.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_batteringram.en: Sprinting into zombies knocks them down, at a cost in endurance each time. A broken leg stops it.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_batteringram.ch: 衝刺撞向殭屍能將其撞倒, 每次都會消耗耐力. 腿部骨折時無法使用.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_batteringram.cn: 冲刺撞向僵尸能将其撞倒, 每次都会消耗耐力. 腿部骨折时无法使用.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_bladetwirl.en: Picked up some sword and knife handling along the way.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_bladetwirl.ch: 一路上學會了一些用劍與用刀的技巧.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_bladetwirl.cn: 一路上学会了一些用剑和用刀的技巧.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_blissful.en: Unhappiness and boredom wear off faster.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_blissful.ch: 憂鬱與無聊消退得更快.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_blissful.cn: 忧郁和无聊消退得更快.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_blunttwirl.en: Knows their way around a club or a bat.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_blunttwirl.ch: 熟悉棍棒與球棒的用法.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_blunttwirl.cn: 熟悉棍棒和球棒的用法.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_bouncer.en: When three or more zombies crowd in, sometimes shoves one back without trying.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_bouncer.ch: 三隻以上殭屍圍上來時, 有時會不自覺地推開其中一隻.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_bouncer.cn: 三只以上僵尸围上来时, 有时会下意识地推开其中一只.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_broke.en: Starts with a broken leg, splinted and bandaged.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_broke.ch: 開局時一條腿骨折, 已上夾板並包紮.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_broke.cn: 开局时一条腿骨折, 已上夹板并包扎.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_burned.en: Starts covered in bandaged burns. Fire nearby brings panic and stress, and they refuse to hold firebombs.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_burned.ch: 開局時全身是包紮過的燒傷. 附近有火會帶來恐慌與壓力, 也拒絕拿起燃燒彈.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_burned.cn: 开局时全身是包扎过的烧伤. 附近有火会带来恐慌和压力, 也拒绝拿起燃烧弹.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_butterfingers.en: Sometimes drops whatever is in hand while moving, more often when running or carrying a lot.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_butterfingers.ch: 移動時偶爾會弄掉手上的東西, 奔跑或負重多時更常發生.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_butterfingers.cn: 移动时偶尔会弄掉手上的东西, 奔跑或负重很大时更常发生.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_depressive.en: Falls into bouts of sadness that take a long time to lift.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_depressive.ch: 會陷入陣發性的悲傷, 很久才會好轉.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_depressive.cn: 会陷入阵发性的悲伤, 很久才会好转.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_deprived.en: Starts with nothing, not even clothes.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_deprived.ch: 開局一無所有, 連衣服都沒有.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_deprived.cn: 开局一无所有, 连衣服都没有.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_drinker.en: Needs a drink regularly. Going without brings anger, stress and pain, then sickness.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_drinker.ch: 需要定期喝酒. 沒酒喝會憤怒、壓力上升並感到疼痛, 接著生病.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_drinker.cn: 需要定期喝酒. 没酒喝会愤怒、压力上升并感到疼痛, 随后生病.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_evasive.en: Has a chance to dodge a hit entirely and take no wound from it.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_evasive.ch: 有機會完全閃避攻擊, 不受任何傷.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_evasive.cn: 有几率完全闪避攻击, 不受任何伤.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_expertdriver.en: Vehicles drive faster, brake harder, handle rough ground better and run quieter.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_expertdriver.ch: 駕駛車輛時速度更快、煞車更有力、在崎嶇地面上更好操控, 運轉也更安靜.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_expertdriver.cn: 驾驶车辆时速度更快、刹车更有力、在崎岖地面上更好操控, 运行也更安静.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_fearful.en: Tends to cry out when panicked, and the noise draws zombies.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_fearful.ch: 恐慌時常會叫出聲, 聲音會引來殭屍.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_fearful.cn: 恐慌时常会叫出声, 声音会引来僵尸.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_fitted.en: Worn clothing weighs half as much and never slows them down.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_fitted.ch: 穿著的衣物重量減半, 也絕不會拖慢速度.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_fitted.cn: 穿着的衣物重量减半, 也绝不会拖慢速度.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_flexible.en: Light and supple, and quick to pick up Nimble.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_flexible.ch: 輕盈柔軟, 靈活技能學得快.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_flexible.cn: 轻盈柔韧, 灵活技能学得快.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_generator.en: Knows how to hook up and run a generator.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_generator.ch: 懂得連接並操作發電機.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_generator.cn: 懂得连接并使用发电机.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_glassbody.en: Every hurt has a chance to hurt worse, and even small knocks can break a bone.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_glassbody.ch: 每次受傷都可能更嚴重, 連輕微碰撞都可能造成骨折.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_glassbody.cn: 每次受伤都可能更严重, 连轻微碰撞都可能导致骨折.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_gordanite.en: Wields a crowbar like it was made for it: harder, faster hits and more critical hits, growing with Long Blunt and Strength.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_gordanite.ch: 揮舞撬棍彷彿天生為此而生: 打擊更重、更快, 暴擊更多, 並隨長棍與力量等級提升.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_gordanite.cn: 挥舞撬棍仿佛天生为此而生: 打击更重、更快, 暴击更多, 并随长棍和力量等级提升.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_gourmand.en: Food cooks faster and burns slower, cooked meals fill and please more, and stale food in containers is often found fresh.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_gourmand.ch: 食物熟得更快、更不易燒焦, 熟食更能填飽肚子也更令人滿足, 容器裡本該不新鮮的食物也常常是新鮮的.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_gourmand.cn: 食物熟得更快、更不易烧焦, 熟食更顶饱也更令人满足, 容器里本该不新鲜的食物也常常是新鲜的.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_graverobber.en: Finds extra loot on zombie corpses.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_graverobber.ch: 能在殭屍屍體上找到額外的戰利品.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_graverobber.cn: 能在僵尸尸体上找到额外的战利品.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_grunt.en: Has done odd jobs: building, bricklaying and metalwork.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_grunt.ch: 做過各種零工: 建築、砌磚與金屬加工.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_grunt.cn: 干过各种零活: 建筑、砌砖和金属加工.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_gunspecialist.en: Starts with real training in guns.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_gunspecialist.ch: 開局時就受過真正的槍械訓練.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_gunspecialist.cn: 开局时就受过正规的枪械训练.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_gymgoer.en: Gets more out of exercise, and workout stiffness clears sooner.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_gymgoer.ch: 健身效果更好, 鍛鍊痠痛也消退得更快.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_gymgoer.cn: 锻炼效果更好, 锻炼疲劳也消退得更快.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_hardy.en: Keeps a reserve of endurance that tops them up when they tire and refills when they rest.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_hardy.ch: 擁有一份儲備耐力, 疲累時補充耐力, 休息時再補滿.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_hardy.cn: 拥有一份储备耐力, 疲惫时补充耐力, 休息时再补满.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_idealweight.en: Their body steers back toward a healthy weight: food counts for more when underweight and less when overweight.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_idealweight.ch: 身體會自動回到健康體重: 體重過輕時食物的效果更大, 過重時則更小.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_idealweight.cn: 身体会自动回到健康体重: 体重过轻时食物的效果更大, 过重时则更小.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_immunocompromised.en: Infected wounds get worse faster, and any injury risks zombification.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_immunocompromised.ch: 受感染的傷口惡化更快, 任何傷勢都可能導致殭屍化.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_immunocompromised.cn: 感染的伤口恶化更快, 任何伤势都有僵尸化的风险.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_incomprehensive.en: Tends to find fewer items when searching containers.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_incomprehensive.ch: 搜尋容器時往往找到較少物品.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_incomprehensive.cn: 搜索容器时往往找到更少物品.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_indefatigable.en: Near death, springs back to full health, shoving close zombies away and curing infection. It takes a long time to come back.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_indefatigable.ch: 瀕死時會恢復至滿健康, 推開近身的殭屍並治癒感染. 之後需要很長時間才能再次觸發.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_indefatigable.cn: 濒死时会恢复至满健康, 推开近身的僵尸并治愈感染. 之后需要很长时间才能再次触发.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_ingenuitive.en: Knows every recipe that would normally need a magazine or an occupation, including ones from other mods.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_ingenuitive.ch: 懂得所有原本需要配方雜誌或特定職業才能學會的配方, 包括其他模組的配方.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_ingenuitive.cn: 掌握所有原本需要配方杂志或特定职业才能学会的配方, 包括其他模组的配方.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_injured.en: Starts with a few bandaged wounds.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_injured.ch: 開局時帶著幾處包紮過的傷口.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_injured.cn: 开局时带着几处包扎过的伤口.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_leadfoot.en: Stomps with far more force while wearing shoes.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_leadfoot.ch: 穿鞋時踩踏的力道大幅提升.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_leadfoot.cn: 穿鞋时踩踏的力道大幅提升.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_lucky.en: Chance tends to fall their way, from finds to critical hits.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_lucky.ch: 運氣往往站在他們那邊, 從搜刮到暴擊皆是.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_lucky.cn: 运气往往站在他们这边, 从搜刮到暴击皆是.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_martial.en: Bare-handed blows do real damage, growing with Short Blunt, at a small cost in endurance.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_martial.ch: 徒手攻擊能造成實質傷害, 並隨短棍等級提升, 但會消耗少量耐力.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_martial.cn: 徒手攻击能造成实质伤害, 并随短棍等级提升, 但会消耗少量耐力.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_mundane.en: Their weapons all but never land a critical hit.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_natural.en: Prefers natural food and knows where to find it.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_natural.ch: 偏好天然食物, 也知道去哪裡找.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_natural.cn: 偏好天然食物, 也知道去哪里找.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noodlelegs.en: Trips now and then while running or sprinting. Higher Sprinting and Nimble make it rarer.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noodlelegs.ch: 跑步或衝刺時不時會絆倒. 衝刺與靈活等級越高越少發生.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noodlelegs.cn: 跑步或冲刺时不时会绊倒. 冲刺和灵活等级越高越少发生.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxpaxe.en: Has chopped plenty of wood: starts with Axe and Carpentry levels, without learning them faster.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxpaxe.ch: 砍過大量木柴: 開局即有斧頭與木工等級, 但學習速度不會加快.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxpaxe.cn: 砍过大量木柴: 开局即有斧头和木工等级, 但学习速度不会加快.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxpfirstaid.en: Took first aid lessons: starts with First Aid levels, without learning it faster.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxpfirstaid.ch: 上過急救課程: 開局即有急救等級, 但學習速度不會加快.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxpfirstaid.cn: 上过急救课程: 开局即有急救等级, 但学习速度不会加快.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxpmaintenance.en: Looked after their tools: starts with Maintenance levels, without learning it faster.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxpmaintenance.ch: 一向愛惜工具: 開局即有維護等級, 但學習速度不會加快.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxpmaintenance.cn: 一向爱惜工具: 开局即有维护等级, 但学习速度不会加快.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxpshooter.en: Spent time at the range: starts with Aiming levels, without learning it faster.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxpshooter.cn: 在靶场练过: 开局即有瞄准等级, 但学习速度不会加快.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxpsneaky.en: Always won at hide and seek: starts with Sneaking and Lightfooted levels, without learning them faster.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxpsneaky.ch: 捉迷藏從沒輸過: 開局即有潛行與輕巧等級, 但學習速度不會加快.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxpsneaky.cn: 捉迷藏从没输过: 开局即有潜行和轻巧等级, 但学习速度不会加快.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxptechnician.en: Tinkered with electronics and engines: starts with Electrical and Mechanics levels, without learning them faster.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxptechnician.ch: 擺弄過電子產品與引擎: 開局即有電工與技工等級, 但學習速度不會加快.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_noxptechnician.cn: 摆弄过电子产品和引擎: 开局即有电工和技工等级, 但学习速度不会加快.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_packmule.en: Carries more, and Strength adds to it further.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_packmule.ch: 負重更多, 力量還能進一步提升負重.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_packmule.cn: 负重更多, 力量还能进一步提升负重.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_paranoia.en: Suffers false scares while on the move, more often when stressed.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_paranoia.ch: 移動時會受到虛驚, 壓力大時更常發生.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_paranoia.cn: 移动时会受到虚惊, 压力大时更常发生.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_poordriver.en: Vehicles drive slower, brake worse, struggle off-road and run louder.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_poordriver.ch: 駕駛車輛時速度較慢、煞車較差、越野吃力, 運轉也更吵.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_poordriver.cn: 驾驶车辆时速度更慢、刹车更差、越野吃力, 运行也更吵.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedammo.en: Starts with a case full of ammunition.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedcar.en: Starts with a toolbox of car maintenance supplies.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedcar.ch: 開局帶著一個裝滿汽車保養用品的工具箱.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedcar.cn: 开局带着一个装满汽车保养用品的工具箱.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedcoordinatio.en: Starts with maps of the major towns, a pencil and a digital watch.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedcoordinatio.ch: 開局帶著主要城鎮的地圖、一支鉛筆與一隻電子錶.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedcoordinatio.cn: 开局带着主要城镇的地图、一支铅笔和一块电子表.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedfood.en: Starts with a stock of food.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedmedical.en: Starts with a stock of medical supplies.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedmedical.ch: 開局帶著一批醫療用品.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedmedical.cn: 开局带着一批医疗用品.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedrepair.en: Starts with a stock of building supplies.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedweapon.en: Starts with a couple of basic weapons.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedweapon.ch: 開局帶著幾把基本武器.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_preparedweapon.cn: 开局带着几把基础武器.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_problade.en: Hits harder and lands more critical hits with blades and axes, which also wear out more slowly.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_problade.ch: 使用刀刃與斧頭時打擊更重、暴擊更多, 武器耗損也更慢.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_problade.cn: 使用刀刃和斧头时打击更重、暴击更多, 武器磨损也更慢.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_problunt.en: Hits harder and lands more critical hits with blunt weapons, which also wear out more slowly.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_problunt.ch: 使用鈍器時打擊更重、暴擊更多, 武器耗損也更慢.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_problunt.cn: 使用钝器时打击更重、暴击更多, 武器磨损也更慢.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_progun.en: Firearms wear out more slowly and, if the server allows it, sometimes save a round.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_progun.ch: 槍械耗損更慢, 若伺服器允許, 有時還能省下一發子彈.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_progun.cn: 枪械磨损更慢, 若服务器允许, 有时还能省下一发子弹.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_prospear.en: Hits harder and lands more critical hits with spears, which also wear out more slowly.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_prospear.ch: 使用長矛時打擊更重、暴擊更多, 武器耗損也更慢.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_prospear.cn: 使用长矛时打击更重、暴击更多, 武器磨损也更慢.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_quickrest.en: Gets endurance back much faster while sitting, and is told when it is full.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_quickrest.ch: 坐下時耐力恢復快很多, 耐力回滿時會收到提示.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_quickrest.cn: 坐下时耐力恢复快得多, 耐力回满时会收到提示.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_quickworker.en: Gets timed actions done much faster.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_quickworker.cn: 读条动作完成得快得多.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_restfulsleeper.en: Sleep restores them faster, a bad bed never leaves them stiff, and they wake once rested.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_restfulsleeper.ch: 睡眠恢復得更快, 睡在差的床上也不會身體僵硬, 休息夠了就會醒來.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_restfulsleeper.cn: 睡眠恢复得更快, 睡在差的床上也不会身体僵硬, 休息够了就会醒来.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_scrapper.en: Good at taking metal things apart.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_scrounger.en: Tends to find more items when searching containers.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_scrounger.ch: 搜尋容器時往往能找到更多物品.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_scrounger.cn: 搜索容器时往往能找到更多物品.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_secondwind.en: When worn out with zombies closing in, gets a burst of fresh endurance and wakefulness. It takes a long time to come back.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_secondwind.ch: 精疲力竭且殭屍逼近時, 會突然湧現耐力並恢復清醒. 之後需要很長時間才能再次觸發.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_secondwind.cn: 精疲力竭且僵尸逼近时, 会突然涌现耐力并恢复清醒. 之后需要很长时间才能再次触发.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_selfdestructive.en: While unhappy, their health slowly wears down, further the sadder they are.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_selfdestructive.ch: 憂鬱時健康會慢慢下降, 越憂鬱降得越多.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_selfdestructive.cn: 忧郁时健康会慢慢下降, 越忧郁降得越多.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_slowworker.en: Takes much longer to get timed actions done.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_specaid.en: Devoted to First Aid, with improvised medical recipes, but learns every other skill except Fitness and Strength far more slowly.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_specaid.ch: 專精急救, 並能使用臨時醫療配方, 但除了體格與力量以外, 其他技能都學得慢很多.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_speccrafting.en: Devoted to the crafting trades, but learns every other skill except Fitness and Strength far more slowly.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_speccrafting.ch: 專精製作類技藝, 但除了體格與力量以外, 其他技能都學得慢很多.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_specfood.en: Devoted to the kitchen, the farm and the outdoors, but learns every other skill except Fitness and Strength far more slowly.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_specfood.ch: 專精廚藝、農務與野外生存, 但除了體格與力量以外, 其他技能都學得慢很多.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_specfood.cn: 专精厨艺、农务和野外生存, 但除了体格和力量以外, 其他技能都学得慢得多.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_specguns.en: Devoted to firearms, but learns every other skill except Fitness and Strength far more slowly.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_specguns.ch: 專精槍械, 但除了體格與力量以外, 其他技能都學得慢很多.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_specguns.cn: 专精枪械, 但除了体格和力量以外, 其他技能都学得慢得多.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_specmove.en: Devoted to moving well, but learns every other skill except Fitness and Strength far more slowly.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_specmove.ch: 專精身手移動, 但除了體格與力量以外, 其他技能都學得慢很多.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_specmove.cn: 专精身法移动, 但除了体格和力量以外, 其他技能都学得慢得多.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_specweapons.en: Devoted to melee weapons and their upkeep, but learns every other skill except Fitness and Strength far more slowly.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_specweapons.ch: 專精近戰武器與其保養, 但除了體格與力量以外, 其他技能都學得慢很多.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_superimmune.en: Wounds never get infected, and the zombie virus is fought off after a long, feverish recovery.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_swift.en: Light on their feet, and quick to pick up Lightfooted.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_swift.ch: 腳步輕盈, 輕巧技能學得快.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_tavernbrawler.en: Improvised weapons hit harder and hold up much better in their hands.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_thickblood.en: Bleeding wounds drain health more slowly.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_thickblood.ch: 出血傷口流失健康的速度較慢.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_thickblood.cn: 出血伤口流失健康的速度更慢.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_tinkerer.en: Likes taking things apart and putting them back together.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_tinkerer.cn: 爱把东西拆开再装回去.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_unlucky.en: Chance tends to go against them, from finds to critical hits.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_vagabond.ch: 能在垃圾桶裡找到額外的食物.
IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_vagabond.cn: 能在垃圾桶里找到额外的食物.

IGUI_DD_T_toadtraits_wildsman.en: Knows how to live off the land.

IGUI_DD_ValueGroup_tooltip.en: Shows this kind of information in the Effects lists of traits and occupations and in Effects At Level on skills.

IGUI_CTB_DinlenmisKapak.en: One click takes at most %1; click again for the rest.

IGUI_CTB_Engel_Kap.en: No bucket in your inventory carries enough liquid.
IGUI_CTB_Engel_Kap.ch: 你的物品欄中沒有裝有足夠液體的水桶.
IGUI_CTB_Engel_Kap.cn: 你的物品栏中没有装有足够液体的水桶.

IGUI_CTB_Engel_Kullanici.en: Someone else is using the barrel.

IGUI_CTB_Engel_Kullanici.cn: 有其他人正在使用发酵桶.

IGUI_CTB_Engel_YuvaDolu.cn: 槽位已无空间 - 请先取出 %1.

IGUI_CTB_FiciYardim.en: A barrel is where fermentation happens. You pour the must into the bucket, put whatever the recipe asks for into the slots, and when the clock runs out the drink comes down into the tap. <LINE> <LINE> Pick a recipe from the dropdown first. The card then lists everything that recipe wants, line by line; hover a line to see which recipe that ingredient comes from and what else the barrel takes in its place. If you already carry the goods, Prepare is all you need - it fetches the missing pieces out of your inventory by itself. When the button stays dim, the line under it tells you what is short. <LINE> <LINE> You can load the slots by hand as well. Left click empties a full slot and opens the add menu on an empty one; right click always brings up the menu. <LINE> <LINE> A finished batch flows into the tap and waits there. Nothing new can finish until you draw it into a container, so empty the tap before you walk away. <LINE> <LINE> The second tab holds the upgrades. A fitted part either shortens the brewing time or raises the yield, and its tooltip says which jobs it touches. The three slots open at Brewing 3, 6 and 9. <LINE> <LINE> The strip at the top shows the temperature. IGUI_CTB_FiciYardim.cn: 发酵桶是进行发酵的地方. 把果浆倒进水桶, 将配方要求的材料放入各槽位, 计时结束时酒液就会流进出酒口. <LINE> <LINE> 先从下拉菜单选择配方. 卡片会逐行列出该配方需要的所有东西; 将鼠标悬停在某一行上, 可查看该材料来自哪个配方, 以及发酵桶还接受哪些替代品. 如果你身上已带齐材料, 只需点击“备料” - 它会自动从你的物品栏取出缺少的部分. 按钮保持灰暗时, 下方那行会告诉你缺了什么. <LINE> <LINE> 你也可以手动放入槽位. 左键点击已满的槽位会将其清空, 点击空槽位则打开添加菜单; 右键则总是打开菜单. <LINE> <LINE> 完成的批次会流进出酒口并在那里等待. 在你把它接到容器中之前, 不会有新的批次完成, 所以离开前请先清空出酒口. <LINE> <LINE> 第二个标签页是升级. 安装的部件会缩短酿造时间或提高产量, 其提示会说明影响哪些作业. 三个升级槽分别在酿酒 3、6、9 级开启. <LINE> <LINE> 顶部的状态栏显示温度. 发酵桶温度超出范围时会停止计时, 但不会变质 - 等室温降回来后, 会从中断处继续. <LINE> <LINE> 发酵桶清空时 (出酒口为空、没有批次、槽位为空) 可以拾取或拆除; 移动会保留已安装的部件, 拆除则会失去它们.

IGUI_CTB_ImbikYardim.en: A still distils. The fermented liquid in the bucket is heated over charcoal, condenses and runs down into the tap; ten litres of wine leave three litres of spirit behind. <LINE> <LINE> Pick a recipe, then press Prepare: it fetches the bucket, the fuel and the additive out of your inventory. Hover any line on the card to see where that ingredient comes from. If the button stays dim, the line under it names what is short. <LINE> <LINE> The fuel slot takes twelve charcoal and every run burns six. Fill it to the top and you can leave the fire alone for two batches. <LINE> <LINE> The finished spirit sits in the tap until you draw it into a container; the next batch waits on that. <LINE> <LINE> The upgrades on the second tab shorten the run or raise the yield, and their slots open at Brewing 3, 6 and 9. From Brewing 9 on, every run gives three and a half litres instead of three. <LINE> <LINE> A still heats itself, so the weather changes nothing here - the strip at the top says the temperature is not checked. Watch the charcoal instead.
IGUI_CTB_ImbikYardim.ch: 蒸餾器用來蒸餾. 水桶中已發酵的液體在木炭上加熱, 冷凝後流進出酒口; 十公升葡萄酒可蒸出三公升烈酒. <LINE> <LINE> 選擇配方後按「備料」: 它會從你的物品欄取出水桶、燃料和添加物. 將游標停在卡片任一行上, 可檢視該材料的來源. 如果按鈕維持灰暗, 下方那行會指出缺少什麼. <LINE> <LINE> 燃料槽位可放十二塊木炭, 每次蒸餾消耗六塊. 裝滿後, 兩個批次內都不必管火. <LINE> <LINE> 蒸好的烈酒會留在出酒口, 直到你把它接到容器中; 下一批次要等這一步完成. <LINE> <LINE> 第二個分頁的升級可縮短蒸餾時間或提高產量, 升級槽在釀酒 3、6、9 級開啟. 從釀酒 9 級起, 每次蒸餾可得三點五公升, 而非三公升. <LINE> <LINE> 蒸餾器會自行加熱, 所以天氣在這裡沒有影響 - 頂端的狀態列會顯示不檢查溫度. 你該留意的是木炭.
IGUI_CTB_ImbikYardim.cn: 蒸馏器用来蒸馏. 水桶中已发酵的液体在木炭上加热, 冷凝后流进出酒口; 十升葡萄酒可蒸出三升烈酒. <LINE> <LINE> 选择配方后点击“备料”: 它会从你的物品栏取出水桶、燃料和添加物. 将鼠标悬停在卡片任一行上, 可查看该材料的来源. 如果按钮保持灰暗, 下方那行会指出缺少什么. <LINE> <LINE> 燃料槽位可放十二块木炭, 每次蒸馏消耗六块. 装满后, 两个批次内都不用管火. <LINE> <LINE> 蒸好的烈酒会留在出酒口, 直到你把它接到容器中; 下一批次要等这一步完成. <LINE> <LINE> 第二个标签页的升级可缩短蒸馏时间或提高产量, 升级槽在酿酒 3、6、9 级开启. 从酿酒 9 级起, 每次蒸馏可得三点五升, 而不是三升. <LINE> <LINE> 蒸馏器会自行加热, 所以天气在这里没有影响 - 顶部的状态栏会显示不检查温度. 你要留意的是木炭.

IGUI_CTB_MahzenBilgi.en: The cellar is where bottles wait. Nothing is brewed here; a full bottle left in the rack simply ages on its own. <LINE> <LINE> Every row in the list is one group: the container and what is in it, how many bottles, how much time has passed and how much is left, and the state. Hover a row to read the two numbers apart. When the time is up the bottle turns into its aged form by itself - wine rests in a week, raw spirit becomes cognac in two. <LINE> <LINE> To take bottles out, select a row first and then use one of the buttons below: either the whole group or a single bottle from it. The third button needs no selection, it collects everything that has finished resting. The fourth button needs no selection either: it places every full bottle on you or nearby (on the floor or in containers close by) that can go in the cellar. The slot holds 50 bottles. <LINE> <LINE> The counter only runs while the cellar is cool. If the strip at the top reads 0-15 °C you are fine; a cellar that warms up or freezes stops the clock, harms nothing, and carries on once the temperature comes back. <LINE> <LINE> The second tab holds the upgrades. A part fitted here shortens the resting time, widens the temperature the cellar puts up with, or (the Bottle Rack) raises the slot to 100 bottles; the slots open at Brewing 3, 6 and 9. <LINE> <LINE> Put several bottles of the same drink in together - they collapse into one row in the list, and a single click takes them all back out.
IGUI_CTB_MahzenBilgi.ch: 酒窖是酒瓶靜置等待的地方. 這裡不釀造任何東西; 留在酒架上的滿酒瓶會自行陳釀. <LINE> <LINE> 清單中的每一列是一組: 容器與其內容物、酒瓶數量、已經過與剩餘的時間, 以及狀態. 將游標停在某列上, 可分別檢視這兩個時間. 時間一到, 酒瓶會自動轉為陳釀後的版本 - 葡萄酒陳釀一週, 蒸餾原酒兩週後變成干邑. <LINE> <LINE> 要取出酒瓶, 先選取一列, 再使用下方的按鈕之一: 取出整組或其中一瓶. 第三個按鈕不需選取, 會收取所有已完成陳釀的酒瓶. 第四個按鈕也不需選取: 會把你身上或附近 (地上或鄰近容器中) 所有可放入酒窖的滿酒瓶放進去. 槽位可容納 50 瓶. <LINE> <LINE> 只有酒窖保持涼爽時才會計時. 頂端狀態列顯示 0-15 °C 就沒問題; 酒窖變熱或結凍時會停止計時, 但不會造成損害, 溫度恢復後便會繼續. <LINE> <LINE> 第二個分頁是升級. 安裝在這裡的零件可縮短陳釀時間、放寬酒窖可承受的溫度範圍, 或 (酒瓶架) 將槽位提升至 100 瓶; 升級槽在釀酒 3、6、9 級開啟. <LINE> <LINE> 把同一種酒的多瓶一起放進去 - 它們會在清單中合併成一列, 點選一次就能全部取回.
IGUI_CTB_MahzenBilgi.cn: 酒窖是酒瓶静置等待的地方. 这里不酿造任何东西; 留在酒架上的满瓶酒会自行陈酿. <LINE> <LINE> 列表中的每一行是一组: 容器及其内容物、酒瓶数量、已过去和剩余的时间, 以及状态. 将鼠标悬停在某行上, 可分别查看这两个时间. 时间一到, 酒瓶会自动变为陈酿后的版本 - 葡萄酒陈酿一周, 蒸馏原酒两周后变成干邑. <LINE> <LINE> 要取出酒瓶, 先选择一行, 再使用下方的按钮之一: 取出整组或其中一瓶. 第三个按钮无需选择, 会收取所有已完成陈酿的酒瓶. 第四个按钮也无需选择: 会把你身上或附近 (地上或附近容器中) 所有可放入酒窖的满瓶酒放进去. 槽位可容纳 50 瓶. <LINE> <LINE> 只有酒窖保持凉爽时才会计时. 顶部状态栏显示 0-15 °C 就没问题; 酒窖变热或结冰时会停止计时, 但不会造成损害, 温度恢复后便会继续. <LINE> <LINE> 第二个标签页是升级. 安装在这里的部件可缩短陈酿时间、放宽酒窖可承受的温度范围, 或 (酒瓶架) 将槽位提升至 100 瓶; 升级槽在酿酒 3、6、9 级开启. <LINE> <LINE> 把同一种酒的多瓶一起放进去 - 它们会在列表中合并成一行, 点击一次就能全部取回.
