Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType.cn: 研究 - 疫苗改良. 类型:

Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType_tooltip.en:
Choice of result type for improving (researching) new vaccine levels.
-PROGRESSIVE CHANCE - on failure, the next success chance increases (accumulates);
-STATIC CHANCE - fixed percentage chance of success (30,20,14% from second to fourth);
-FULL RESEARCH - there is a hidden progress bar for study (100 units, conditionally, each research fills the bar).
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType_tooltip.ch:
改良 (研究) 新疫苗等級時的結果判定類型.
-累進機率 - 失敗時, 下一次的成功機率會提升 (可累積);
-固定機率 - 固定的成功百分比 (第二至第四級分別為 30, 20, 14%%);
-完整研究 - 存在一條隱藏的研究進度條 (概念上為 100 點, 每次研究會填充進度).
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType_tooltip.cn:
改良 (研究) 新疫苗等级时的结果判定类型.
-累进几率 - 失败时, 下一次的成功几率会提升 (可累积);
-固定几率 - 固定的成功百分比 (第二至第四级分别为 30, 20, 14%%);
-完整研究 - 存在一条隐藏的研究进度条 (概念上为 100 点, 每次研究会填充进度).

Sandbox_TakeABathAndShower_RemainingWate.cn: 随机化停水后的剩余水量. <LINE> 数值越高, 设定的剩余水量被减少的幅度越大.

Sandbox_LFO_StartWithLFGrey_tooltip.cn: 开局背包里有一个传奇腰包 (灰).

Sandbox_LSO_StartWithLSGrey_tooltip.cn: 开局背包里有一个传奇挎包 (灰).

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours_tooltip.en: A jar of sugar water or honey left on the ground away from any hive turns into a Wild Yeast Starter after this many hours. 48 = current (two days). 0 = never. Jars within reach of a hive are drunk by the bees instead and never sour.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours_tooltip.ch: 放在地上且遠離任何蜂箱的糖水罐或蜂蜜罐, 經過這麼多小時後會變成野生酵母引子. 48 = 目前值 (兩天). 0 = 永不. 位於蜂箱範圍內的罐子會被蜜蜂喝掉, 永遠不會發酸.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours_tooltip.cn: 放在地上且远离任何蜂箱的糖水罐或蜂蜜罐, 经过这么多小时后会变成野生酵母引子. 48 = 当前值 (两天). 0 = 永不. 位于蜂箱范围内的罐子会被蜜蜂喝掉, 永远不会发酸.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HoneycombYieldMultipl.en: Scales how many filled combs each production cycle adds. 1.0 = current (2-4), 2.0 = double. The hive still holds no more than its cells.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HoneycombYieldMultipl.ch: 調整每個生產週期新增多少滿載的蜂巢. 1.0 = 目前值 (2-4), 2.0 = 兩倍. 蜂箱能容納的數量仍以其巢房上限為準.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HoneycombYieldMultipl.cn: 调整每个生产周期新增多少满载的蜂巢. 1.0 = 当前值 (2-4), 2.0 = 两倍. 蜂箱能容纳的数量仍以其巢房上限为准.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadFermentationSpeed.en: Scales how fast mead barrels ferment through Young, Normal, Aged (and Spoiled). 1.0 = current pacing, 2.0 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed. Applies to batches already fermenting.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadFermentationSpeed.ch: 調整蜂蜜酒桶經過新釀, 正常, 熟成 (以及變質) 各階段的發酵速度. 1.0 = 目前節奏, 2.0 = 兩倍速, 0.5 = 半速. 對已在發酵的批次同樣生效.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadFermentationSpeed.cn: 调整蜂蜜酒桶经过新酿, 正常, 熟成 (以及变质) 各阶段的发酵速度. 1.0 = 当前节奏, 2.0 = 两倍速, 0.5 = 半速. 对已在发酵的批次同样生效.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.en: Bee and larvae growth per cycle
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.ch: 每週期蜜蜂與幼蟲成長量
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.cn: 每周期蜜蜂与幼虫成长量

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HibernationTemperatur.en: At or below this temperature the bees hibernate and the hive stops. 7 = current. Lower it for hardier bees, raise it for a shorter season.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HibernationTemperatur.ch: 溫度達到或低於此值時, 蜜蜂會進入冬眠, 蜂箱停止運作. 7 = 目前值. 調低代表蜜蜂更耐寒, 調高則產季更短.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HibernationTemperatur.cn: 温度达到或低于此值时, 蜜蜂会进入冬眠, 蜂箱停止运行. 7 = 当前值. 调低代表蜜蜂更耐寒, 调高则产季更短.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_BeeStingsEnabled_tool.en: When off, angry bees are still shown but never sting - no health damage, poison or swelling. For relaxed servers.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_BeeStingsEnabled_tool.ch: 關閉時, 憤怒的蜜蜂仍會出現, 但永遠不會螫人 - 不造成生命損傷, 中毒或腫脹. 適合輕鬆向的伺服器.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_BeeStingsEnabled_tool.cn: 关闭时, 愤怒的蜜蜂仍会出现, 但永远不会蜇人 - 不造成生命损伤, 中毒或肿胀. 适合轻松向的服务器.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_RoyalJellyHours_toolt.en: How long a full, queenless hive takes to make royal jelly. 72 = current (three days).
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_RoyalJellyHours_toolt.ch: 一個滿載且沒有蜂后的蜂箱需要多久才能產出蜂王乳. 72 = 目前值 (三天).
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_RoyalJellyHours_toolt.cn: 一个满载且没有蜂后的蜂箱需要多久才能产出蜂王浆. 72 = 当前值 (三天).

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.en: How many working hours one litre of stored sugar water buys. 24 = a full day of work per litre. The bees only drink while they are actually working, so a hive halted by rain or frost loses nothing from its supply. A hive holding any sugar water forages as if there were an ordinary spread of flowers around it - enough to keep working through winter or a poor biome, but no better than a decent summer.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.ch: 蜂箱儲存的一公升糖水能換得多少工作時數. 24 = 每公升可支撐整整一天的工作. 蜜蜂只在實際工作時才會飲用, 因此因下雨或結霜而停擺的蜂箱不會消耗存量. 只要蜂箱裡還有糖水, 採集效果就等同周圍有一般水準的花叢 - 足以撐過冬季或貧瘠的生態環境, 但也不會優於條件不錯的夏季.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.cn: 蜂箱储存的一升糖水能换得多少工作时长. 24 = 每升可支撑整整一天的工作. 蜜蜂只在实际工作时才会饮用, 因此因下雨或结霜而停摆的蜂箱不会消耗存量. 只要蜂箱里还有糖水, 采集效果就等同周围有一般水准的花丛 - 足以撑过冬季或贫瘠的生态环境, 但也不会优于条件不错的夏季.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.en: Scales how long a bee smoker keeps a hive calm. 1.0 = current, 2.0 = smoke lasts twice as long.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.ch: 調整蜂箱燻煙器讓蜂箱保持鎮定的時間. 1.0 = 目前值, 2.0 = 煙霧效果持續兩倍長.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.cn: 调整蜂箱熏烟器让蜂箱保持镇定的时间. 1.0 = 当前值, 2.0 = 烟雾效果持续两倍长.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.en: Scales how many bees and larvae each production cycle adds. 1.0 = current, 2.0 = double. Kept separate from honeycomb so honey and colony can be tuned apart.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.ch: 調整每個生產週期新增多少蜜蜂與幼蟲. 1.0 = 目前值, 2.0 = 兩倍. 與蜂巢產量分開設定, 讓蜂蜜與蜂群可以各自調整.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.cn: 调整每个生产周期新增多少蜜蜂与幼虫. 1.0 = 当前值, 2.0 = 两倍. 与蜂巢产量分开设置, 让蜂蜜与蜂群可以各自调整.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.ch: 蜜蜂憤怒持續時間倍率
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.cn: 蜜蜂愤怒持续时间倍率

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedBoostMultipli.en: Extra production while a hive is fed, on top of the forage the sugar water stands in for. 1.15 = 15%% faster, 1.0 = no bonus at all (the forage rescue still applies). Rain, snow and freezing still stop the hive no matter how well fed it is.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedBoostMultipli.ch: 蜂箱獲得餵食時的額外產量, 疊加在糖水所替代的蜜源之上. 1.15 = 快 15%%, 1.0 = 完全沒有加成 (糖水替代蜜源的保底仍然生效). 不論餵得多飽, 下雨, 下雪與結凍依然會讓蜂箱停止運作.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedBoostMultipli.cn: 蜂箱获得喂食时的额外产量, 叠加在糖水所替代的蜜源之上. 1.15 = 快 15%%, 1.0 = 完全没有加成 (糖水替代蜜源的保底仍然生效). 不论喂得多饱, 下雨, 下雪与结冻依然会让蜂箱停止运行.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.en: Sugar water: working hours per litre
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.ch: 糖水: 每公升可支撐的工作時數
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.cn: 糖水: 每升可支撑的工作时长

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadSpoilageEnabled_t.en: When disabled, a batch left too long holds at Aged quality forever instead of turning Spoiled.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadSpoilageEnabled_t.ch: 停用時, 放置過久的批次會永遠停留在熟成品質, 而不會變質.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadSpoilageEnabled_t.cn: 禁用时, 放置过久的批次会永远停留在熟成品质, 而不会变质.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.en: Scales how long bees stay angry after you disturb or crack open hives and nests. 1.0 = current, 0 = they calm down almost immediately, 2.0 = twice as long.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.ch: 調整你擾動或敲開蜂巢與蜂窩後, 蜜蜂持續憤怒的時間. 1.0 = 目前值, 0 = 幾乎立刻平息, 2.0 = 兩倍長.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.cn: 调整你扰动或敲开蜂巢与蜂窝后, 蜜蜂持续愤怒的时间. 1.0 = 当前值, 0 = 几乎立刻平息, 2.0 = 两倍长.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.ch: 燻煙鎮定持續時間倍率
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.cn: 熏烟镇定持续时间倍率

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours.en: Jars left out sour into yeast after (hours)
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours.ch: 罐子放置多久後發酸成酵母 (小時)
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours.cn: 罐子放置多久后发酸成酵母 (小时)

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLarvaeRaiseHours.en: How long placed queen larvae take to become a new queen. 48 = current (two days).
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLarvaeRaiseHours.ch: 放入的蜂后幼蟲需要多久才會長成新蜂后. 48 = 目前值 (兩天).
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLarvaeRaiseHours.cn: 放入的蜂后幼虫需要多久才会长成新蜂后. 48 = 当前值 (两天).

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_PropolisChance_toolti.en: Chance a harvest that collects honeycomb also yields propolis. 0.30 = current (30%%), 0 = never, 1.0 = always.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_PropolisChance_toolti.ch: 採收蜂巢時同時獲得蜂膠的機率. 0.30 = 目前值 (30%%), 0 = 永不, 1.0 = 必定獲得.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_PropolisChance_toolti.cn: 采收蜂巢时同时获得蜂胶的概率. 0.30 = 当前值 (30%%), 0 = 永不, 1.0 = 必定获得.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenForageWeightMult.en: Scales how often Queen Bees appear while foraging, in every zone. 1.0 = default scarcity (roughly one queen per 2-5 in-game hours of daytime foraging in forest zones, in season Apr-Oct, none Dec-Mar). 2.0 = about twice as common. 0 = queens never appear from foraging.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenForageWeightMult.ch: 調整所有區域中採集時遇到蜂后的頻率. 1.0 = 預設稀有度 (在森林區域白天採集, 產季 4 至 10 月時, 大約每 2-5 個遊戲小時出現一隻蜂后, 12 至 3 月完全不會出現). 2.0 = 約兩倍常見. 0 = 採集永遠不會找到蜂后.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenForageWeightMult.cn: 调整所有区域中采集时遇到蜂后的频率. 1.0 = 默认稀有度 (在森林区域白天采集, 产季 4 至 10 月时, 大约每 2-5 个游戏小时出现一只蜂后, 12 至 3 月完全不会出现). 2.0 = 约两倍常见. 0 = 采集永远不会找到蜂后.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveProductionSpeedMu.en: How fast a working hive fills its comb and grows. 1.0 = current pacing, 2.0 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed. Weather, temperature, flowers and feeding still apply on top.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveProductionSpeedMu.ch: 運作中的蜂箱填滿蜂巢與成長的速度. 1.0 = 目前節奏, 2.0 = 兩倍速, 0.5 = 半速. 天氣, 溫度, 花叢與餵食的影響仍會疊加其上.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveProductionSpeedMu.cn: 运行中的蜂箱填满蜂巢与成长的速度. 1.0 = 当前节奏, 2.0 = 两倍速, 0.5 = 半速. 天气, 温度, 花丛与喂食的影响仍会叠加其上.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_PropolisChance.ch: 採收時獲得蜂膠的機率
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_PropolisChance.cn: 采收时获得蜂胶的概率

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLarvaeRaiseHours.ch: 蜂后幼蟲培育時間 (小時)
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLarvaeRaiseHours.cn: 蜂后幼虫培育时间 (小时)

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLifespanDays_too.en: How many days a queen lays before she needs replacing. 7 = current. Longer games may want 14-30. Applies to queens inserted or raised after the change.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLifespanDays_too.ch: 蜂后能產卵幾天後才需要更換. 7 = 目前值. 長期遊玩的存檔可考慮 14-30. 僅對修改後放入或培育出的蜂后生效.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLifespanDays_too.cn: 蜂后能产卵几天后才需要更换. 7 = 当前值. 长期游玩的存档可考虑 14-30. 仅对修改后放入或培育出的蜂后生效.

Sandbox_CustomizableRecipes_CContainersR.cn: 回收已安装的升级套件

Sandbox_CustomizableRecipes_CContainersR.cn: 将容器升级至更高阶时, 可回收原本已安装的升级套件.

Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.cn: 为支持的容器类型指定明确的容量值.

Sandbox_CustomizableRecipes_CContainersA.cn: 启用后, 任何可用的更高阶套件都能直接应用, 无需先应用中间阶级. 升级套件配方不再需要前一阶的套件.

Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.en: Set an explicit weight reduction for supported container types.
Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.ch: 為支援的容器類型指定明確的減重效果數值.
Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.cn: 为支持的容器类型指定明确的减重效果数值.

Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.ch: 為支援的容器類型指定明確的重量值.
Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.cn: 为支持的容器类型指定明确的重量值.

Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.en: Configure blacklist and custom Capacity, Weight Reduction, and Weight overrides for supported containers.
Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.ch: 為支援的容器設定黑名單, 以及自訂的容量, 減重效果與重量覆寫值.
Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.cn: 为支持的容器设置黑名单, 以及自定义的容量, 减重效果与重量覆盖值.

Sandbox_LCO_StartWithLCGrey_tooltip.en: Start with a Legendary Cap (Grey) in your inventory.

Sandbox_LCO_StartWithLCGrey_tooltip.cn: 开局时物品栏中就带有一顶传奇棒球帽 (灰色).

Sandbox_LCO_StartWithLCFlashlight_toolti.cn: 开局时物品栏中就带有一支传奇手电筒.

Sandbox_ammomaker_CollectAdditionalSeeds.ch: 使用本體收集種子配方時, 額外把種子加入玩家物品欄
Sandbox_ammomaker_CollectAdditionalSeeds.cn: 使用本体收集种子配方时, 额外把种子加入玩家物品栏

Sandbox_ammomaker_DropCasingsReload_tool.en: Drops casings on ground when reloading revolvers or break-action firearms instead of adding them to player inventory
Sandbox_ammomaker_DropCasingsReload_tool.ch: 為左輪或中折式槍械裝彈時把彈殼掉在地上, 而不是放進玩家物品欄
Sandbox_ammomaker_DropCasingsReload_tool.cn: 为左轮或中折式枪械装弹时把弹壳掉在地上, 而不是放进玩家物品栏

Sandbox_ammomaker_ShowHiddenRecipes_tool.en: Shows inactive recipes as N/A in the crafting menu
Sandbox_ammomaker_ShowHiddenRecipes_tool.ch: 在製作選單把未啟用的配方顯示為N/A
Sandbox_ammomaker_ShowHiddenRecipes_tool.cn: 在制作菜单把未启用的配方显示为N/A

Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_PauseWhileDriv.en: Skips global event scans while all active players travel in vehicles and stops this mod's heat, rain-exposure and forced wind-sprite updates for the driver. Active weather is kept; it is never cleared.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_PauseWhileDriv.ch: 所有線上玩家都在載具裡時略過全域事件掃描, 並停止本模組對駕駛者的高溫、淋雨與強制風效更新. 進行中的天氣會保留, 絕不會被清除.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_PauseWhileDriv.cn: 所有在线玩家都在载具内时跳过全局事件扫描, 并停止本模组针对驾驶者的高温、淋雨与强制风效更新. 进行中的天气会保留, 绝不会被清除.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_PauseWhileDriv._note: 2026-08-21 CN 逐鍵在地化：跳过／全局／载具内；wind-sprite 譯為「風效」避免誤讀為奇幻精靈。

Sandbox_WorkingKnowledge_ConsumeOnRead_t.en: When enabled, a document is destroyed once it has been read, so it cannot be passed to another survivor. Intended for multiplayer servers that do not want a single copy training the whole group. Default: off.
Sandbox_WorkingKnowledge_ConsumeOnRead_t.ch: 啟用後, 文件一經閱讀就會銷毀, 無法再傳給其他倖存者. 給不想讓一份副本訓練整隊的多人伺服器使用. 預設: 關.
Sandbox_WorkingKnowledge_ConsumeOnRead_t.cn: 启用后, 文件一经阅读就会销毁, 无法再传给其他幸存者. 给不想让一份副本训练整队的多人服务器使用. 默认: 关.

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_AimingXPMultipli.en: Multiplies the Aiming XP earned from hitting or killing targets with bows and crossbows. 1.0 = vanilla rate. Increase for faster skill progression; set to 0 to disable XP gain from bows entirely. (Default: 1.0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_AimingXPMultipli.ch: 用弓或弩擊中或擊殺目標時獲得的瞄準經驗倍率. 1.0 = 原版速率. 調高可加快技能成長; 設為 0 則完全不會從弓弩獲得經驗. (預設: 1.0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_AimingXPMultipli.cn: 用弓或弩击中或击杀目标时获得的瞄准经验倍率. 1.0 = 原版速率. 调高可加快技能成长; 设为 0 则完全不会从弓弩获得经验. (默认: 1.0)

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_DamageScale_tool.en: A global damage multiplier applied to all bows and crossbows. 1.0 = standard damage. Values above 1.0 make bows more lethal; below 1.0 makes them weaker. Does not affect vanilla firearms. (Default: 1.0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_DamageScale_tool.ch: 套用到所有弓和弩的全域傷害倍率. 1.0 = 標準傷害. 高於 1.0 會讓弓更致命; 低於 1.0 則會變弱. 不影響原版槍械. (預設: 1.0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_DamageScale_tool.cn: 应用到所有弓和弩的全局伤害倍率. 1.0 = 标准伤害. 高于 1.0 会让弓更致命; 低于 1.0 则会变弱. 不影响原版枪械. (默认: 1.0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_DamageScale_tool._note: ｜2026-08-21 CN 詞級在地化修正。 ｜2026-08-21 對齊本包既有慣例：CN 应用/示例/粘性、CH 反坦克。

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_RecoverMissedArr.en: Percentage chance (0–100) that a fired arrow or bolt survives hitting the environment (walls, ground, objects) and can be picked back up. Set to 0 to disable environmental recovery entirely. Set to 100 for maximum recovery. (Default: 100)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_RecoverMissedArr.ch: 射出的箭或弩矢打到環境 (牆、地面、物體) 後仍完好、可以撿回的百分比機率 (0–100). 設為 0 則完全停用從環境回收. 設為 100 則回收率最高. (預設: 100)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_RecoverMissedArr.cn: 射出的箭或弩矢打到环境 (墙、地面、物体) 后仍完好、可以捡回的百分比几率 (0–100). 设为 0 则完全禁用从环境回收. 设为 100 则回收率最高. (默认: 100)

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_SpawnRateMultipl.en: Multiplies how often bows, crossbows, arrows, and bolts appear in the world as loot. 1.0 = default distribution. Values above 1.0 increase frequency; set to 0 to disable all Classic Bows loot spawning. (Default: 1.0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_SpawnRateMultipl.ch: 弓、弩、箭矢和弩矢在世界中作為戰利品出現頻率的倍率. 1.0 = 預設分布. 高於 1.0 會提高出現頻率; 設為 0 則停用所有經典弓弩戰利品生成. (預設: 1.0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_SpawnRateMultipl.cn: 弓、弩、箭矢和弩矢在世界中作为战利品出现频率的倍率. 1.0 = 默认分布. 高于 1.0 会提高出现频率; 设为 0 则禁用所有经典弓弩战利品生成. (默认: 1.0)

Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_EnableCraftingAdd.en: When disabled, hides and blocks the crafting recipes added by Break Big Rocks, prevents its vanilla forge-recipe patches, and stops automatic Blacksmithing recipe unlocks. Enabled by default.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowLifestyleManag.en: Compatibility toggle for Lifestyle: Hobbies. When disabled (default), traits that Lifestyle awards or removes from skill progression are excluded from recording, claiming, and loot journals. Restore the Lifestyle skill XP and let Lifestyle recalculate these traits. Enable only if you want journals to control the traits directly.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_SkillLearningTimeSc.cn: 控制每项技能学习时间的计算方式. 固定时间对每项技能使用同一基准时间. 等级进度按实际恢复的等级与部分等级计时. 总经验值按该技能自身的经验曲线计时, 类似 LG Skill Journal.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AutoOptOutUnready.cn: 自动排除未准备的玩家

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AutoOptOutUnready.en:
Once a teammate readies, players who make no choice for one real minute are left out of the deployment. Readying or unreadying restarts this timer.

Players in the deployment vehicle must choose for themselves.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AutoOptOutUnready.ch:
一旦有隊友就緒, 1 分鐘現實時間內未做任何選擇的玩家就不會加入這次部署. 就緒或取消就緒都會重新計時.

已在部署車輛內的玩家必須自行選擇.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AutoOptOutUnready.cn:
一旦有队友就绪, 1 分钟现实时间内未做任何选择的玩家就不会加入这次部署. 就绪或取消就绪都会重新计时.

已在部署车辆内的玩家必须自行选择.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EscalatingHordeWa.ch:
僅限一般突襲. 自由漫遊改用 24 小時間隔, 再加上情報中心的加成.

將週期性的完整屍潮改為五波逐次升級的威脅: 每一波分別為屍潮規模的 20%%, 50%%, 100%%, 150%%, 200%%. 預設間隔 20 分鐘, 從第一波到最後一波共需 80 遊戲內分鐘. 可用「屍潮波次間隔」調整間隔. 最後一波之後, 100%% 規模的殭屍波次會每 20 遊戲內分鐘持續出現, 直到所有突襲參與者撤離或死亡.

越後面的波次衝刺者越多. NPC 替換小隊使用所選的來源模組, 同樣依其設定規模的百分比縮放, 且出現機率提高.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EscalatingHordeWa.cn:
仅限普通突袭. 自由漫游改用 24 小时间隔, 再加上情报中心的加成.

将周期性的完整尸潮改为五波逐次升级的威胁: 每一波分别为尸潮规模的 20%%, 50%%, 100%%, 150%%, 200%%. 默认间隔 20 分钟, 从第一波到最后一波共需 80 游戏内分钟. 可用“尸潮波次间隔”调整间隔. 最后一波之后, 100%% 规模的僵尸波次会每 20 游戏内分钟持续出现, 直到所有突袭参与者撤离或死亡.

越靠后的波次冲刺者越多. NPC 替换小队使用所选的来源模组, 同样按其设定规模的百分比缩放, 且出现概率提高.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EscalatingHordeWa.en:
Normal Raids only. Free Roam uses a 24-hour interval plus the Intel Center bonus.

Replaces repeating full hordes with five increasingly dangerous waves: 20%%, 50%%, 100%%, 150%%, then 200%% of Horde Size per wave. The default 20-minute spacing takes 80 in-game minutes from the first wave to the last. Use Horde Wave Interval to change their spacing. After the final wave, 100%% zombie waves continue every 20 in-game minutes until all raid participants extract or die.

Later waves have more sprinters. NPC replacements use the selected provider, follow the same percentages of their configured size and become more likely.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EscalatingHordeWa._note:

需启用“递增尸潮波次”.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RepeatHordeMaximu.cn: 追加尸潮最长延迟 (小时)

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RepeatHordeMaximu.en:
Normal Raids only. Free Roam uses a 24-hour interval plus the Intel Center bonus.

Only applies when Escalating Horde Waves is off.

僅限一般突襲. 自由漫遊改用 24 小時間隔, 再加上情報中心的加成.

仅限普通突袭. 自由漫游改用 24 小时间隔, 再加上情报中心的加成.

仅在“递增尸潮波次”关闭时适用.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RepeatHordeMinimu.ch: 追加屍潮最短延遲 (小時)
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RepeatHordeMinimu.cn: 追加尸潮最短延迟 (小时)

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RepeatHordeMinimu.en:
Normal Raids only. Free Roam uses a 24-hour interval plus the Intel Center bonus.

Only applies when Escalating Horde Waves is off.

Shortest wait between full raid hordes, in game hours. The wait is randomly chosen between this value and Additional Horde Maximum Delay.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RepeatHordeMinimu.ch:
僅限一般突襲. 自由漫遊改用 24 小時間隔, 再加上情報中心的加成.

僅在「遞增屍潮波次」關閉時適用.

完整突襲屍潮之間的最短等待時間, 以遊戲內小時計. 實際等待時間會在此值與「追加屍潮最長延遲」之間隨機決定.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RepeatHordeMinimu.cn:
仅限普通突袭. 自由漫游改用 24 小时间隔, 再加上情报中心的加成.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RequireUpgradeSki.en: Hideout upgrades require the listed skills. Turn off to require only materials and earlier upgrades. Quest skill requirements still apply.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RequireUpgradeSki.ch: 藏身處升級需要具備所列技能. 關閉後只需要材料與前置升級. 任務的技能需求仍然有效.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RequireUpgradeSki.cn: 藏身处升级需要具备所列技能. 关闭后只需要材料和前置升级. 任务的技能需求仍然有效.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_ShareFactionQuest.ch:
陣營成員共同推進一條共享的任務進程, 初始內容複製自陣營擁有者的個人進度. 個人進度會另外儲存. 擁有者離開陣營時會保留陣營進度. 其他成員只有在某項任務完成時, 該任務已出現在自己的個人任務樹中, 才會將這筆陣營完成紀錄保留到個人進度. 加入陣營不會取得先前的陣營完成紀錄.

關閉後, 每位玩家的任務進度各自獨立.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_ShareFactionQuest.cn:
派系成员共同推进一条共享的任务进程, 初始内容复制自派系所有者的个人进度. 个人进度会另外保存. 所有者离开派系时会保留派系进度. 其他成员只有在某项任务完成时, 该任务已出现在自己的个人任务树中, 才会将这条派系完成记录保留到个人进度. 加入派系不会获得此前的派系完成记录.

关闭后, 每位玩家的任务进度各自独立.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_ShareFactionQuest.en:
Faction members work on a shared campaign, initially copied from the owner's personal progress. Personal progress is stored separately. Owners retain faction progress when leaving. Other members keep a faction completion personally only if that quest was already available in their personal quest tree when it was completed. Joining does not grant earlier faction completions.

Turn off for individual quest progress.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_VehicleRaidBaseFu.ch: 載具突襲基礎燃料消耗 (公升)
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_VehicleRaidBaseFu.cn: 车辆突袭基础燃料消耗 (升)

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_VehicleRaidBaseFu.en:
Base fuel cost for driving into a raid and returning home, charged separately for each trip. Actual use varies by vehicle and fuel consumption settings.

Entry and Free Roam vehicle extraction require the full listed fuel. Normal Raid boundary returns may use the remaining fuel even if it is below the cost. Set to 0 for free travel.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_VehicleRaidBaseFu.ch:
開車進入突襲與回家時的基礎燃料消耗, 每趟分別計算. 實際用量依車輛與油耗設定而異.

進入突襲以及自由漫遊的乘車撤離, 都需要備妥列出的全部燃料. 一般突襲越過邊界返回時, 即使剩餘燃料低於消耗量, 也能用掉剩下的燃料返回. 設為 0 則往返不耗油.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_VehicleRaidBaseFu.cn:
开车进入突袭和回家时的基础燃料消耗, 每趟分别计算. 实际用量因车辆和油耗设置而异.

进入突袭以及自由漫游的乘车撤离, 都需要备足列出的全部燃料. 普通突袭越过边界返回时, 即使剩余燃料低于消耗量, 也能用掉剩下的燃料返回. 设为 0 则往返不耗油.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_VehicleRoadClosur.en:
Chance that a destination has blocked roads when its road conditions are chosen. Blocked roads prevent vehicle deployment. In Normal Raids, escaping across the raid boundary leaves vehicles and their cargo behind. Free Roam vehicle extraction is available outside the insertion area regardless of road closures.

Set to 0 for always open or 100 for always blocked. Road conditions do not change during an active raid.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_VehicleRoadClosur.ch:
決定目的地道路狀況時, 該目的地道路被封鎖的機率. 道路封鎖時無法部署車輛. 在一般突襲中, 越過突襲邊界逃離時, 車輛與其中的貨物會被留下. 自由漫遊中, 無論道路是否封鎖, 只要在抵達區域以外都能乘車撤離.

設為 0 表示道路永遠暢通, 設為 100 則永遠封鎖. 進行中的突襲不會改變道路狀況.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_VehicleRoadClosur.cn:
决定目的地道路状况时, 该目的地道路被封锁的概率. 道路封锁时无法部署车辆. 在普通突袭中, 越过突袭边界逃离时, 车辆及其中的货物会被留下. 自由漫游中, 无论道路是否封锁, 只要在抵达区域以外都能乘车撤离.

设为 0 表示道路始终畅通, 设为 100 则始终封锁. 进行中的突袭不会改变道路状况.

Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_RoomWideIndoor.ch: 啟用後, 點燃的營火、壁爐、古董烤爐或烤肉架, 會讓同一個封閉房間內任何位置的玩家獲得與緊靠在旁邊相同的保暖效果. 熱量不會擴散到其他房間. 預設: 關閉.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_RoomWideIndoor.cn: 启用后, 点燃的营火、壁炉、古董烤炉或烧烤架, 会让同一个封闭房间内任何位置的玩家获得与紧靠在旁边相同的保暖效果. 热量不会扩散到其他房间. 默认: 关闭.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_RoomWideIndoor.en: If enabled, a lit campfire, fireplace, antique oven or barbecue warms players anywhere in the same enclosed room as strongly as standing beside it. Heat does not spread to other rooms. Default: off.

Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_SuppressorDura.en: Shots from full condition to worn out. Applies to both suppressor types. At 0 condition, suppression stops. Machined suppressors can be repaired; oil-filter suppressors must be replaced.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_SuppressorDura.ch: 從全新狀態到磨損報廢所需的射擊發數. 兩種消音器都適用. 耐久度為 0 時就不再消音. 機加工消音器可以修理; 機油濾清器消音器只能更換.
Sandbox_SimpleSuppressors_SuppressorDura.cn: 从全新状态到磨损报废所需的射击发数. 两种消音器都适用. 耐久度为 0 时就不再消音. 机加工消音器可以修理; 机油滤清器消音器只能更换.

Sandbox_Distillation_AgeTimeMultiplier_t.en:
How long casked spirits and wine take to mature.
100 is the mod's designed balance: five days for whiskey, ten for scotch, seven for country wine to become aged wine.
Higher is slower.
Sandbox_Distillation_AgeTimeMultiplier_t.ch:
入桶的烈酒與葡萄酒需要多久才會成熟.
100 是本模組設計的平衡值: 威士忌五天, 蘇格蘭威士忌十天, 鄉村葡萄酒七天變成陳年葡萄酒.
數值越高越慢.
Sandbox_Distillation_AgeTimeMultiplier_t.cn:
入桶的烈酒与葡萄酒需要多久才会成熟.
100 是本模组设计的平衡值: 威士忌五天, 苏格兰威士忌十天, 乡村葡萄酒七天变成陈酿葡萄酒.
数值越高越慢.

Sandbox_Distillation_CultureTimePercent_.en:
How long a batch made with yeast, or a crock pitched with a mother of vinegar, takes compared to the same batch made with plain sugar.
33 means a third of the time. Set to 100 to remove the advantage entirely.
Sandbox_Distillation_CultureTimePercent_.ch:
使用酵母的一批酒, 或投入醋母的陶罐, 相較於單純加糖的同一批需要多久.
33 表示只需三分之一的時間. 設為 100 可完全取消這項優勢.
Sandbox_Distillation_CultureTimePercent_.cn:
使用酵母的一批酒, 或投入醋母的陶罐, 相较于单纯加糖的同一批需要多久.
33 表示只需三分之一的时间. 设为 100 可完全取消这项优势.

Sandbox_Distillation_FermentRadius_toolt.en:
How far from a player, in tiles, containers are checked each hour for batches that are ready.
Anything you are carrying always counts. Raise this if you want a cellar to keep working while you stand at the far end of the building; large values cost performance.
Sandbox_Distillation_FermentRadius_toolt.ch:
每小時檢查容器內是否有已完成批次時, 容器與玩家的最大距離, 單位為格.
你隨身攜帶的物品一律計入. 若你希望人站在建築另一端時酒窖仍能繼續運作, 可以提高此值; 數值過大會影響效能.
Sandbox_Distillation_FermentRadius_toolt.cn:
每小时检查容器内是否有已完成批次时, 容器与玩家的最大距离, 单位为格.
你随身携带的物品一律计入. 若你希望人站在建筑另一端时酒窖仍能继续运作, 可以提高此值; 数值过大会影响性能.

Sandbox_Distillation_FermentTimeMultipli.en:
How long mash, wort, must and honey must take to ferment.
100 is the mod's designed balance: one day for mash, a day and a half for ale, two days for wine, three for mead.
Higher is slower.
Sandbox_Distillation_FermentTimeMultipli.ch:
醪, 麥汁, 葡萄原漿與蜂蜜原漿需要多久才會發酵完成.
100 是本模組設計的平衡值: 醪一天, 愛爾啤酒一天半, 葡萄酒兩天, 蜂蜜酒三天.
數值越高越慢.
Sandbox_Distillation_FermentTimeMultipli.cn:
醪, 麦汁, 葡萄原浆与蜂蜜原浆需要多久才会发酵完成.
100 是本模组设计的平衡值: 醪一天, 麦酒一天半, 葡萄酒两天, 蜂蜜酒三天.
数值越高越慢.

Sandbox_Distillation_IntoxicationMultipl.en:
How drunk these drinks get you. Affects only the intoxication they cause, not their mood, pain or healing effects.
Set to 0 for no intoxication at all.
Sandbox_Distillation_IntoxicationMultipl.ch:
這些飲品會讓你醉到什麼程度. 只影響它們造成的醉意, 不影響心情, 疼痛或治療效果.
設為 0 則完全不會醉.
Sandbox_Distillation_IntoxicationMultipl.cn:
这些饮品会让你醉到什么程度. 只影响它们造成的醉意, 不影响心情, 疼痛或治疗效果.
设为 0 则完全不会醉.

Sandbox_Distillation_LootEquipment.ch: 蒸餾器材出現在戰利品中
Sandbox_Distillation_LootEquipment.cn: 蒸馏器材出现在战利品中

Sandbox_Distillation_LootEquipment_toolt.en:
Whether the Still Kit and the Mother of Vinegar turn up in the world: drug shacks, barns, garages, camping lockers and survivor food stores.
Off by default, since the still is the gate on the whole spirits line.
Sandbox_Distillation_LootEquipment_toolt.ch:
蒸餾套件與醋母是否會出現在世界中: 製毒棚屋, 穀倉, 車庫, 露營置物櫃與倖存者的食物儲藏處.
預設關閉, 因為蒸餾器是整條烈酒產線的關鍵門檻.
Sandbox_Distillation_LootEquipment_toolt.cn:
蒸馏套件与醋母是否会出现在世界中: 制毒棚屋, 谷仓, 车库, 露营储物柜与幸存者的食物储藏处.
默认关闭, 因为蒸馏器是整条烈酒产线的关键门槛.

Sandbox_Distillation_LootFineSpirits.ch: 陳年烈酒出現在戰利品中
Sandbox_Distillation_LootFineSpirits.cn: 陈酿烈酒出现在战利品中

Sandbox_Distillation_LootFineSpirits_too.en:
Whether vodka, brandy, vermouth, absinthe, aged wine, whiskey and scotch turn up in the world.
Off by default: these cost days of waiting to make, and finding them hands you the back half of the mod. Malort never spawns at any setting.
Sandbox_Distillation_LootFineSpirits_too.ch:
伏特加, 白蘭地, 苦艾酒, 苦艾烈酒, 陳年葡萄酒, 威士忌與蘇格蘭威士忌是否會出現在世界中.
預設關閉: 這些酒要等上好幾天才做得出來, 直接撿到等於跳過本模組的後半段內容. 苦味利口酒在任何設定下都不會生成.
Sandbox_Distillation_LootFineSpirits_too.cn:
伏特加, 白兰地, 苦艾酒, 苦艾烈酒, 陈酿葡萄酒, 威士忌与苏格兰威士忌是否会出现在世界中.
默认关闭: 这些酒要等上好几天才做得出来, 直接捡到等于跳过本模组的后半段内容. 苦味利口酒在任何设置下都不会生成.

Sandbox_Distillation_LootHomebrew.ch: 自釀酒出現在戰利品中
Sandbox_Distillation_LootHomebrew.cn: 自酿酒出现在战利品中

Sandbox_Distillation_LootHomebrew_toolti.en:
Whether ale, country wine, mead and moonshine turn up in the world: survivor safehouses, squats, trailer parks, farm and garage fridges, drug shacks and hidden stashes.
Someone else was brewing before you got here. A found bottle of country wine still ages into aged wine on its own.
Sandbox_Distillation_LootHomebrew_toolti.ch:
愛爾啤酒, 鄉村葡萄酒, 蜂蜜酒與私釀烈酒是否會出現在世界中: 倖存者安全屋, 違占空屋, 拖車營地, 農場與車庫的冰箱, 製毒棚屋以及隱藏藏匿點.
在你抵達之前, 已經有人在釀酒了. 撿到的鄉村葡萄酒仍會自行陳釀成陳年葡萄酒.
Sandbox_Distillation_LootHomebrew_toolti.cn:
麦酒, 乡村葡萄酒, 蜂蜜酒与私酿烈酒是否会出现在世界中: 幸存者安全屋, 违占空屋, 拖车营地, 农场与车库的冰箱, 制毒棚屋以及隐藏藏匿点.
在你抵达之前, 已经有人在酿酒了. 捡到的乡村葡萄酒仍会自行陈酿成陈酿葡萄酒.

Sandbox_Distillation_RequireHeatSource_t.en:
The portable Still Kit only works next to live heat: a lit campfire, barbecue or fireplace, or a powered oven or antique stove.
Turn off to distil anywhere. The Moonshine Still workstation has its own firebox and is unaffected either way.
Sandbox_Distillation_RequireHeatSource_t.ch:
可攜式蒸餾套件只能在有火的熱源旁運作: 點燃的營火, 燒烤架或壁爐, 或是通電的烤箱與古典火爐.
關閉後即可在任何地方蒸餾. 私釀蒸餾器工作站自帶火箱, 不受此設定影響.
Sandbox_Distillation_RequireHeatSource_t.cn:
便携式蒸馏套件只能在有火的热源旁运作: 点燃的营火, 烧烤架或壁炉, 或是通电的烤箱与旧式壁炉.
关闭后即可在任何地方蒸馏. 私酿蒸馏器工作站自带火箱, 不受此设置影响.

Sandbox_Distillation_SourTimeMultiplier_.en:
How long a souring crock takes to become vinegar.
100 is the mod's designed balance: three days on a wild ferment, one day with a mother of vinegar pitched in.
Higher is slower.
Sandbox_Distillation_SourTimeMultiplier_.ch:
釀醋陶罐需要多久才會變成醋.
100 是本模組設計的平衡值: 自然發酵三天, 投入醋母則一天.
數值越高越慢.
Sandbox_Distillation_SourTimeMultiplier_.cn:
酿醋陶罐需要多久才会变成醋.
100 是本模组设计的平衡值: 自然发酵三天, 投入醋母则一天.
数值越高越慢.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GrantStarterFlash.en: Gives each new survivor a fully charged flashlight.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GrantStarterFlash.ch: 給每位新倖存者一支充滿電的手電筒.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GrantStarterFlash.cn: 给每位新幸存者一支充满电的手电筒.

Sandbox_CatsMod_SleepPoseRandom_tooltip.en: When OFF (default), cats nap belly-up during the day and on their side at night. When ON, each nap randomly picks belly-up or side sleep (50/50).
Sandbox_CatsMod_SleepPoseRandom_tooltip.ch: 設為關閉 (預設) 時, 貓咪白天仰躺小睡, 夜間側躺. 設為開啟時, 每次小睡會隨機選擇仰躺或側躺 (50/50).
Sandbox_CatsMod_SleepPoseRandom_tooltip.cn: 设为关闭 (默认) 时, 猫咪白天仰躺小睡, 夜间侧躺. 设为开启时, 每次小睡会随机选择仰躺或侧躺 (50/50).

Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.ch: 填充相容的模組丙烷物品
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.cn: 加注兼容的模组丙烷物品

Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.en: Allows registered modded drainable propane tools and containers, plus conservatively recognized propane-named drainables. Default: On.
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.ch: 允許已註冊的模組可清空丙烷工具與容器, 以及以保守方式辨識、名稱含丙烷的可清空物品. 預設值: 開啟.
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.cn: 允许已注册的模组可清空丙烷工具与容器, 以及以保守方式识别、名称含丙烷的可清空物品. 默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.ch: 啟用福索石油大型丙烷儲罐
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.cn: 启用福索石油大型丙烷储罐

Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.en: Allows supported Fossoil bulk-tank sprites to dispense propane. Existing stored data is preserved while disabled. Default: On.
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.ch: 允許受支援的福索石油大型儲罐貼圖輸出丙烷. 停用期間仍會保留既有儲存資料. 預設值: 開啟.
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.cn: 允许受支持的福索石油大型储罐贴图输出丙烷. 禁用期间仍会保留现有存储数据. 默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.ch: 啟用加即走大型丙烷儲罐
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.cn: 启用加即走大型丙烷储罐

Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.en: Allows supported Gas2Go bulk-tank sprites to dispense propane. Existing stored data is preserved while disabled. Default: On.
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.ch: 允許受支援的加即走大型儲罐貼圖輸出丙烷. 停用期間仍會保留既有儲存資料. 預設值: 開啟.
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.cn: 允许受支持的加即走大型储罐贴图输出丙烷. 禁用期间仍会保留现有存储数据. 默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.en: Allows empty or partially used Base.Propane_Refill bottles and propane lanterns to be refilled at a depot. Default: On.
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.ch: 允許在儲罐處填充空的或已部分使用的 Base.Propane_Refill 氣瓶與丙烷提燈. 預設值: 開啟.
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.cn: 允许在储罐处加注空的或已部分使用的 Base.Propane_Refill 气瓶与丙烷提灯. 默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.ch: 填充 The Workshop 丙烷容器
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.cn: 加注 The Workshop 丙烷容器

Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.en: Allows compatible Large and Huge propane tanks from The Workshop B42 to be refilled. The Workshop remains optional. Default: On.
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.ch: 允許填充 The Workshop B42 的相容大型與巨型丙烷儲罐. The Workshop 仍為可選模組. 預設值: 開啟.
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.cn: 允许加注 The Workshop B42 的兼容大型与巨型丙烷储罐. The Workshop 仍为可选模组. 默认: 开启.
