Sandbox_CU_MiserableThreshold_tooltip.ch: 角色進入「痛苦不堪」狀態、且發作可能升級為自殺企圖的不快樂值 (0-100). 不快樂值降到比此值低 10 時, 該狀態才會解除.
Sandbox_CU_MiserableThreshold_tooltip.cn: 角色进入“痛苦不堪”状态、且发作可能升级为自杀企图的不开心值 (0-100). 不开心值降到比此值低 10 时, 该状态才会解除.

Sandbox_CU_NoArmsSpeed_tooltip.en: Fraction of normal action speed with both arms gone and no prosthetics.
Sandbox_CU_NoArmsSpeed_tooltip.ch: 失去雙臂且沒有義肢時, 動作速度為正常的多少比例.
Sandbox_CU_NoArmsSpeed_tooltip.cn: 失去双臂且没有假肢时, 动作速度为正常的多少比例.

Sandbox_CU_OneArmSpeed_tooltip.en: Fraction of normal action speed with one arm gone and no prosthetic.
Sandbox_CU_OneArmSpeed_tooltip.ch: 失去一條手臂且沒有義肢時, 動作速度為正常的多少比例.
Sandbox_CU_OneArmSpeed_tooltip.cn: 失去一条手臂且没有假肢时, 动作速度为正常的多少比例.

Sandbox_CU_OneLegSpeed_tooltip.en: Fraction of normal walking speed with a leg gone and no crutch or prosthetic.
Sandbox_CU_OneLegSpeed_tooltip.ch: 失去一條腿且沒有拐杖或義肢時, 行走速度為正常的多少比例.
Sandbox_CU_OneLegSpeed_tooltip.cn: 失去一条腿且没有拐杖或假肢时, 行走速度为正常的多少比例.

Sandbox_CU_OrganRecoveryRate_tooltip.en: How fast a damaged heart, lungs, liver, kidneys and gut heal by themselves. The brain never heals. 0 means organ damage is permanent.
Sandbox_CU_OrganRecoveryRate_tooltip.ch: 受損的心臟、肺、肝、腎與腸道自行癒合的速度. 大腦永遠不會癒合. 0 代表器官損傷是永久性的.
Sandbox_CU_OrganRecoveryRate_tooltip.cn: 受损的心脏、肺、肝、肾与肠道自行愈合的速度. 大脑永远不会愈合. 0 代表器官损伤是永久性的.

Sandbox_CU_PTSDChance_tooltip.en: The chance each thing seen starts it (half as much again for a friend eaten alive). Less for the Desensitized and the Brave, more for the Cowardly, and certain once three have piled up. It sets in 12 to 48 hours later.
Sandbox_CU_PTSDChance_tooltip.ch: 每次目睹時觸發的機率 (目睹朋友被活活吃掉時再多一半). 「麻木」與「勇敢」者較低, 「懦弱」者較高, 累積三次後則必定觸發. 會在 12 到 48 小時後發作.
Sandbox_CU_PTSDChance_tooltip.cn: 每次目睹时触发的几率 (目睹朋友被活活吃掉时再多一半). “麻木不仁”与“无所畏惧”者较低, “畏首畏尾”者较高, 累积三次后则必定触发. 会在 12 到 48 小时后发作.

Sandbox_CU_PTSDFlashbacks_tooltip.en: How many flashbacks a day, on average, for a character with post-traumatic stress. Four times as likely with the dead close by; fewer with antidepressants or beta blockers.
Sandbox_CU_PTSDFlashbacks_tooltip.ch: 患有創傷後壓力的角色平均每天出現幾次閃回. 附近有死人時機率為四倍; 服用抗憂鬱藥或乙型阻斷劑時較少.
Sandbox_CU_PTSDFlashbacks_tooltip.cn: 患有创伤后应激的角色平均每天出现几次闪回. 附近有死人时几率为四倍; 服用抗抑郁药或β-阻断剂时较少.

Sandbox_CU_PTSDFriendHours.ch: 成為朋友前的相處時數
Sandbox_CU_PTSDFriendHours.cn: 成为朋友前的相处时数

Sandbox_CU_PTSDFriendHours_tooltip.en: Game hours two players must spend near each other before one counts as the other's friend. Faction members always count.
Sandbox_CU_PTSDFriendHours_tooltip.ch: 兩名玩家需在彼此附近待上多少遊戲小時, 其中一人才會被視為另一人的朋友. 同陣營成員一律算作朋友.
Sandbox_CU_PTSDFriendHours_tooltip.cn: 两名玩家需在彼此附近待上多少游戏小时, 其中一人才会被视为另一人的朋友. 同派系成员一律算作朋友.

Sandbox_CU_PTSD_tooltip.en: Seeing a friend's body, a friend eaten alive by the dead, or anybody's attempt on their own life can leave a character with post-traumatic stress: flashbacks, nightmares and a low mood that never quite lifts, for good. Antidepressants and beta blockers soften it; nothing cures it. It only comes from seeing it happen, so it needs other players.
Sandbox_CU_PTSD_tooltip.ch: 目睹朋友的屍體、朋友被死人活活吃掉, 或任何人企圖輕生, 都可能讓角色留下創傷後壓力: 閃回、惡夢, 以及永遠揮之不去的低落情緒, 且終生如此. 抗憂鬱藥與乙型阻斷劑可以減輕症狀, 但沒有任何方法能治癒. 只有親眼目睹才會觸發, 因此需要其他玩家.
Sandbox_CU_PTSD_tooltip.cn: 目睹朋友的尸体、朋友被死人活活吃掉, 或任何人企图轻生, 都可能让角色留下创伤后应激: 闪回、噩梦, 以及永远挥之不去的低落情绪, 且终生如此. 抗抑郁药与β-阻断剂可以减轻症状, 但没有任何方法能治愈. 只有亲眼目睹才会触发, 因此需要其他玩家.

Sandbox_CU_ProcedurePain.en: Treatment hurts as it is done

Sandbox_CU_ProcedurePainEffects_tooltip.en: When the patient is in a lot of pain, a minigame pulses red and they wince, and a patient being disinfected can flinch away.
Sandbox_CU_ProcedurePainEffects_tooltip.ch: 患者非常疼痛時, 小遊戲會閃爍紅光且患者會皺眉; 正在消毒的患者也可能痛得縮開.
Sandbox_CU_ProcedurePainEffects_tooltip.cn: 患者非常疼痛时, 小游戏会闪烁红光且患者会皱眉; 正在消毒的患者也可能痛得躲开.

Sandbox_CU_ProcedurePainScale_tooltip.en: Scales the pain a treatment causes as it is done. First Aid already takes up to half of it away.
Sandbox_CU_ProcedurePainScale_tooltip.ch: 調整治療過程中造成的疼痛. 急救技能本身已可減去最多一半.
Sandbox_CU_ProcedurePainScale_tooltip.cn: 调整治疗过程中造成的疼痛. 急救技能本身已可减去最多一半.

Sandbox_CU_ProcedurePain_tooltip.en: Every minigame adds pain to the treated body part as it goes, so the pain moodle climbs while the patient is being worked on, and every slip hurts more. The pain the base game adds at the end is not added twice. Off: only the base game's pain, at the end.
Sandbox_CU_ProcedurePain_tooltip.ch: 每個小遊戲在進行中都會為受治療的部位增加疼痛, 因此治療期間疼痛狀態會持續上升, 每次失手都會更痛. 原版遊戲在結束時加上的疼痛不會重複計算. 關閉: 只有原版遊戲在結束時加上的疼痛.
Sandbox_CU_ProcedurePain_tooltip.cn: 每个小游戏在进行中都会为受治疗的部位增加疼痛, 因此治疗期间疼痛状态会持续上升, 每次失手都会更痛. 原版游戏在结束时加上的疼痛不会重复计算. 关闭: 只有原版游戏在结束时加上的疼痛.

Sandbox_CU_ProstheticLootChance_tooltip.en: Scales how often prosthetics and crutches spawn in medical buildings. 0 removes them.
Sandbox_CU_ProstheticLootChance_tooltip.ch: 調整義肢與拐杖在醫療建築中生成的頻率. 0 代表不會生成.
Sandbox_CU_ProstheticLootChance_tooltip.cn: 调整假肢与拐杖在医疗建筑中生成的频率. 0 代表不会生成.

Sandbox_CU_ProstheticMaxSpeed_tooltip.en: Fraction of normal speed a prosthetic gives at Prosthetics skill 10.
Sandbox_CU_ProstheticMaxSpeed_tooltip.ch: 義肢技能 10 級時, 義肢提供的速度為正常的多少比例.
Sandbox_CU_ProstheticMaxSpeed_tooltip.cn: 假肢技能 10 级时, 假肢提供的速度为正常的多少比例.

Sandbox_CU_ProstheticStartSpeed_tooltip.en: Fraction of normal speed a prosthetic gives at Prosthetics skill 0.
Sandbox_CU_ProstheticStartSpeed_tooltip.ch: 義肢技能 0 級時, 義肢提供的速度為正常的多少比例.
Sandbox_CU_ProstheticStartSpeed_tooltip.cn: 假肢技能 0 级时, 假肢提供的速度为正常的多少比例.

Sandbox_CU_ProstheticXPMultiplier_toolti.en: Scales how fast the Prosthetics skill levels up.
Sandbox_CU_ProstheticXPMultiplier_toolti.ch: 調整義肢技能的升級速度.
Sandbox_CU_ProstheticXPMultiplier_toolti.cn: 调整假肢技能的升级速度.

Sandbox_CU_QualityFloor_tooltip.en: How far a badly played minigame can pull a treatment down, as a fraction of the character's real First Aid level. 0.25 means the worst result counts as a quarter of their skill; 1.0 means a bad result works as well as a perfect one.
Sandbox_CU_QualityFloor_tooltip.ch: 小遊戲玩得很差時最多能讓治療效果降低多少, 以角色實際急救等級的比例表示. 0.25 代表最差結果只算技能的四分之一; 1.0 代表差的結果與完美結果效果相同.
Sandbox_CU_QualityFloor_tooltip.cn: 小游戏玩得很差时最多能让治疗效果降低多少, 以角色实际急救等级的比例表示. 0.25 代表最差结果只算技能的四分之一; 1.0 代表差的结果与完美结果效果相同.

Sandbox_CU_SelfHarmAfterDays_tooltip.en: In-game days unhappiness must stay above the threshold before the first self-harm episode. Antidepressants stop the count and wind it back.
Sandbox_CU_SelfHarmAfterDays_tooltip.ch: 不快樂值需維持在門檻之上多少遊戲天數, 才會出現第一次自殘發作. 抗憂鬱藥會停止計數並使其倒退.
Sandbox_CU_SelfHarmAfterDays_tooltip.cn: 不开心值需维持在阈值之上多少游戏天数, 才会出现第一次自残发作. 抗抑郁药会停止计数并使其倒退.

Sandbox_CU_SelfHarmGraceSeconds_tooltip.en: Real seconds between an episode starting and it taking over the screen. You keep playing while the edges close in and the heartbeat gets louder. 0 means it lands at once.
Sandbox_CU_SelfHarmGraceSeconds_tooltip.ch: 從發作開始到佔據畫面之間的真實秒數. 畫面邊緣逐漸收攏、心跳聲越來越響時, 你仍可繼續遊玩. 0 代表立即發生.
Sandbox_CU_SelfHarmGraceSeconds_tooltip.cn: 从发作开始到占据画面之间的真实秒数. 画面边缘逐渐收拢、心跳声越来越响时, 你仍可继续游玩. 0 代表立即发生.

Sandbox_CU_SelfHarmThreshold_tooltip.en: Unhappiness (0-100) above which the depression clock runs and episodes can build up.
Sandbox_CU_SelfHarmThreshold_tooltip.ch: 不快樂值 (0-100) 超過此值時, 憂鬱計時開始累計, 發作也可能逐漸醞釀.
Sandbox_CU_SelfHarmThreshold_tooltip.cn: 不开心值 (0-100) 超过此值时, 抑郁计时开始累计, 发作也可能逐渐酝酿.

Sandbox_CU_SelfHarmWithoutBlade_tooltip.en: With no blade to hand, an episode can be a burn from a lighter or a blow from a blunt weapon. Off: with no blade, an episode is vomiting instead.
Sandbox_CU_SelfHarmWithoutBlade_tooltip.ch: 手邊沒有刀刃時, 發作可能改為用打火機燙傷或用鈍器擊打. 關閉: 沒有刀刃時, 發作改為嘔吐.
Sandbox_CU_SelfHarmWithoutBlade_tooltip.cn: 手边没有刀刃时, 发作可能改为用打火机烫伤或用钝器击打. 关闭: 没有刀刃时, 发作改为呕吐.

Sandbox_CU_SepsisHours.ch: 可能發生敗血症前的時數
Sandbox_CU_SepsisHours.cn: 可能发生败血症前的时数

Sandbox_CU_SepsisHours_tooltip.en: Game hours an infection must go untreated before it can reach the blood. A wound with a clean dressing on it can never become sepsis (unless the character is Immunocompromised).
Sandbox_CU_SepsisHours_tooltip.ch: 感染需未經治療多少遊戲小時才可能進入血液. 敷有乾淨敷料的傷口永遠不會演變成敗血症 (除非角色「免疫力低下」).
Sandbox_CU_SepsisHours_tooltip.cn: 感染需未经治疗多少游戏小时才可能进入血液. 敷有干净敷料的伤口永远不会演变成败血症 (除非角色“免疫功能低下”).

Sandbox_CU_SeveredLimbs_tooltip.en: A cut-off limb ends up in the hands of whoever cut it. It rots, and can be cooked and eaten, which costs more than it feeds.
Sandbox_CU_SeveredLimbs_tooltip.ch: 截下的肢體會落到截肢者手中. 它會腐爛, 也可以煮熟食用, 但付出的代價大於果腹的好處.
Sandbox_CU_SeveredLimbs_tooltip.cn: 截下的肢体会落到截肢者手中. 它会腐烂, 也可以煮熟食用, 但付出的代价大于果腹的好处.

Sandbox_CU_ShowMoodles_tooltip.en: The Miserable, high and condition moodles. Off hides them for everyone; players can also hide them for themselves in Options > Mods. The conditions still happen.
Sandbox_CU_ShowMoodles_tooltip.ch: 「痛苦不堪」、藥物興奮與病況狀態. 關閉後會對所有人隱藏; 玩家也可在 選項 > 模組 中為自己隱藏. 病況仍會照常發生.
Sandbox_CU_ShowMoodles_tooltip.cn: “痛苦不堪”、药物兴奋与病况状态. 关闭后会对所有人隐藏; 玩家也可在 选项 > 模组 中为自己隐藏. 病况仍会照常发生.

Sandbox_CU_SkillScaling.ch: 急救等級讓小遊戲更簡單
Sandbox_CU_SkillScaling.cn: 急救等级让小游戏更简单

Sandbox_CU_SkillScaling_tooltip.en: How much each First Aid level loosens a minigame's tolerances. 0 means First Aid does not change the minigames at all.
Sandbox_CU_SkillScaling_tooltip.ch: 每個急救等級能讓小遊戲的容錯放寬多少. 0 代表急救等級完全不影響小遊戲.
Sandbox_CU_SkillScaling_tooltip.cn: 每个急救等级能让小游戏的容错放宽多少. 0 代表急救等级完全不影响小游戏.

Sandbox_CU_StartingTermsKnown_tooltip.en: The share of medical terms a new character already knows, chosen at random. Each First Aid level they start with adds 7 percent.
Sandbox_CU_StartingTermsKnown_tooltip.ch: 新角色已知的醫學術語比例, 隨機選取. 開局時每 1 級急救再增加 7 個百分點.
Sandbox_CU_StartingTermsKnown_tooltip.cn: 新角色已知的医学术语比例, 随机选取. 开局时每 1 级急救再增加 7 个百分点.

Sandbox_CU_StumpSelfSealHours_tooltip.en: Hours a stump that was never cauterized must stay bandaged before it closes on its own. 0 means it never does.
Sandbox_CU_StumpSelfSealHours_tooltip.ch: 從未燒灼止血的殘肢需包紮多少小時才會自行癒合. 0 代表永遠不會.
Sandbox_CU_StumpSelfSealHours_tooltip.cn: 从未烧灼止血的残肢需包扎多少小时才会自行愈合. 0 代表永远不会.

Sandbox_CU_SuicideAfterDays.en: Days of depression before a suicide attempt
Sandbox_CU_SuicideAfterDays.ch: 企圖自殺前的憂鬱天數
Sandbox_CU_SuicideAfterDays.cn: 企图自杀前的抑郁天数

Sandbox_CU_SuicideAfterDays_tooltip.en: In-game days of depression before a Miserable character's episode can be an attempt on their life. Until then it is self-harm, the warning.
Sandbox_CU_SuicideAfterDays_tooltip.ch: 處於「痛苦不堪」的角色需憂鬱多少遊戲天數, 發作才可能變成企圖輕生. 在那之前只會是自殘, 作為警訊.
Sandbox_CU_SuicideAfterDays_tooltip.cn: 处于“痛苦不堪”的角色需抑郁多少游戏天数, 发作才可能变成企图轻生. 在那之前只会是自残, 作为警讯.

Sandbox_CU_TermsPerLevel.en: Terms learned per First Aid level

Sandbox_CU_TermsPerLevel_tooltip.en: How many new medical terms a character learns every time their First Aid goes up.
Sandbox_CU_TermsPerLevel_tooltip.ch: 角色每次急救等級提升時學會多少個新的醫學術語.
Sandbox_CU_TermsPerLevel_tooltip.cn: 角色每次急救等级提升时学会多少个新的医学术语.

Sandbox_CU_TourniquetDamageMinutes.ch: 止血帶造成損傷前 (分鐘)
Sandbox_CU_TourniquetDamageMinutes.cn: 止血带造成损伤前 (分钟)

Sandbox_CU_TourniquetDamageMinutes_toolt.en: Game minutes before a tourniquet starts damaging the limb and can cause a pressure injury.
Sandbox_CU_TourniquetDamageMinutes_toolt.ch: 止血帶綁上多少遊戲分鐘後開始損傷肢體, 並可能造成壓迫傷害.
Sandbox_CU_TourniquetDamageMinutes_toolt.cn: 止血带绑上多少游戏分钟后开始损伤肢体, 并可能造成压迫伤害.

Sandbox_CU_TourniquetPainMinutes.ch: 止血帶造成疼痛前 (分鐘)
Sandbox_CU_TourniquetPainMinutes.cn: 止血带造成疼痛前 (分钟)

Sandbox_CU_TourniquetPainMinutes_tooltip.en: Game minutes before a tourniquet starts adding pain and stiffness to the limb.
Sandbox_CU_TourniquetPainMinutes_tooltip.ch: 止血帶綁上多少遊戲分鐘後開始為肢體增加疼痛與僵硬.
Sandbox_CU_TourniquetPainMinutes_tooltip.cn: 止血带绑上多少游戏分钟后开始为肢体增加疼痛与僵硬.

Sandbox_CU_TourniquetReusable_tooltip.en: Taking a tourniquet off gives it back. Off: it is used up when it goes on.
Sandbox_CU_TourniquetReusable_tooltip.ch: 拆下止血帶時會歸還. 關閉: 綁上時即消耗.
Sandbox_CU_TourniquetReusable_tooltip.cn: 拆下止血带时会返还. 关闭: 绑上时即消耗.

Sandbox_CU_Tourniquets_tooltip.en: Tourniquets can be found or crafted, and put on a bleeding arm or leg from the Health menu. They stop the bleeding without healing the wound, and hurt the limb if left on.
Sandbox_CU_Tourniquets_tooltip.ch: 止血帶可以找到或製作, 並可從健康選單綁在流血的手臂或腿上. 它能止血但不會治癒傷口, 若一直綁著會傷害肢體.
Sandbox_CU_Tourniquets_tooltip.cn: 止血带可以找到或制作, 并可从健康菜单绑在流血的手臂或腿上. 它能止血但不会治愈伤口, 若一直绑着会伤害肢体.

Sandbox_CU_TraitsAffectMedicine_tooltip.en: Traits such as Thin-skinned, Slow Healer, Resilient and Prone to Illness, and Evolving Traits World's, change bleeding, clotting, healing and infection. Off: traits make no difference to this mod.
Sandbox_CU_TraitsAffectMedicine_tooltip.ch: 「薄皮」、「恢復慢」、「堅強韌性」、「體弱多病」等特質, 以及 Evolving Traits World 的特質, 會改變流血、凝血、癒合與感染. 關閉: 特質對本模組沒有影響.
Sandbox_CU_TraitsAffectMedicine_tooltip.cn: “细皮嫩肉”、“缓慢恢复”、“生命强韧”、“易患疾病”等特质, 以及 Evolving Traits World 的特质, 会改变流血、凝血、愈合与感染. 关闭: 特质对本模组没有影响.

Sandbox_CU_VisionEffects_tooltip.en: The screen blurs when a character is badly dehydrated or has lost a lot of blood. Players can also turn it off for themselves in Options > Mods.
Sandbox_CU_VisionEffects_tooltip.ch: 角色嚴重脫水或大量失血時畫面會變模糊. 玩家也可在 選項 > 模組 中為自己關閉.
Sandbox_CU_VisionEffects_tooltip.cn: 角色严重脱水或大量失血时画面会变模糊. 玩家也可在 选项 > 模组 中为自己关闭.

Sandbox_CU_VitalsReport_tooltip.en: A panel beside the health screen showing heart rate and rhythm, blood pressure, oxygen, blood left, clotting, every organ and the problem list.
Sandbox_CU_VitalsReport_tooltip.ch: 健康畫面旁的面板, 顯示心率與心律、血壓、血氧、剩餘血量、凝血狀況、各器官狀態與問題清單.
Sandbox_CU_VitalsReport_tooltip.cn: 健康界面旁的面板, 显示心率与心律、血压、血氧、剩余血量、凝血状况、各器官状态与问题列表.

Sandbox_CU_WheelchairLootChance_tooltip.en: Scales how often wheelchairs turn up in hospital rooms and medical storage. 0 removes them.
Sandbox_CU_WheelchairLootChance_tooltip.ch: 調整輪椅出現在病房與醫療倉庫的頻率. 0 代表不會出現.
Sandbox_CU_WheelchairLootChance_tooltip.cn: 调整轮椅出现在病房与医疗仓库的频率. 0 代表不会出现.

Sandbox_CU_WheelchairMeleeDamage_tooltip.en: Fraction of normal melee damage dealt sitting in a wheelchair: all arms, no legs behind it.
Sandbox_CU_WheelchairMeleeDamage_tooltip.ch: 坐在輪椅上時造成的近戰傷害為正常的多少比例: 只靠手臂, 沒有腿部出力.
Sandbox_CU_WheelchairMeleeDamage_tooltip.cn: 坐在轮椅上时造成的近战伤害为正常的多少比例: 只靠手臂, 没有腿部发力.

Sandbox_CU_WheelchairMeleeForce_tooltip.en: How hard a swing from a wheelchair pushes zombies back or knocks them down, as a fraction of normal.
Sandbox_CU_WheelchairMeleeForce_tooltip.ch: 在輪椅上揮擊時擊退或擊倒殭屍的力道, 為正常的多少比例.
Sandbox_CU_WheelchairMeleeForce_tooltip.cn: 在轮椅上挥击时击退或击倒僵尸的力度, 为正常的多少比例.

Sandbox_CU_WheelchairSpeed_tooltip.en: Scales how fast a wheelchair goes. At 1.0 it is a little over half walking speed with both hands on the rims; one hand pushes at 60 percent of that, and none at a quarter.
Sandbox_CU_WheelchairSpeed_tooltip.ch: 調整輪椅的移動速度. 在 1.0 時, 雙手推輪圈的速度略高於步行速度的一半; 單手推為其百分之 60, 沒有手可用時則為其四分之一.
Sandbox_CU_WheelchairSpeed_tooltip.cn: 调整轮椅的移动速度. 在 1.0 时, 双手推轮圈的速度略高于步行速度的一半; 单手推为其百分之 60, 没有手可用时则为其四分之一.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_BodyPanels_toolti.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_BodyPanels_toolti.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Engine_tooltip.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Engine_tooltip.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Exhaust_tooltip.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Exhaust_tooltip.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Feature_Toggles_t.en: Cosmetic section divider. Does nothing. Turning a feature off here skips it entirely during generation, rather than just setting its percentage to 0 -- use this for features you never want so the mod doesn't spend any time on them.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Feature_Toggles_t.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用. 在此關閉某項功能會在生成時完全略過它, 而不只是把其百分比設為 0 -- 對於你永遠不需要的功能請使用此處, 讓模組不必在它們上面花費任何時間.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Feature_Toggles_t.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用. 在此关闭某项功能会在生成时完全跳过它, 而不只是把其百分比设为 0 -- 对于你永远不需要的功能请使用此处, 让模组不必在它们上面花费任何时间.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_FuelElectrical_to.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_FuelElectrical_to.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_GlassLighting_too.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_GlassLighting_too.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Interior_tooltip.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Interior_tooltip.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Nature_Bushes_too.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Nature_Bushes_too.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Nature_Objects_to.en: Cosmetic section divider. These options place real vegetation objects with depth and occlusion; they are more expensive than overlays.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Nature_Objects_to.ch: 裝飾用分隔線. 這些選項會放置具有深度與遮擋效果的真實植被物件; 效能消耗比覆蓋層更高.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Nature_Objects_to.cn: 装饰用分隔线. 这些选项会放置具有深度与遮挡效果的真实植被物体; 性能开销比覆盖层更高.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Nature_Overlays_t.en: Cosmetic section divider. These options control flat decals on natural ground, roads, indoor floors, and roofs.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Nature_Overlays_t.ch: 裝飾用分隔線. 這些選項控制自然地面、道路、室內地板與屋頂上的平面貼花.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Nature_Overlays_t.cn: 装饰用分隔线. 这些选项控制自然地面、道路、室内地板与屋顶上的平面贴花.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Nature_Trees_tool.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Nature_Trees_tool.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_RunningGear_toolt.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_RunningGear_toolt.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_TS_Base_tooltip.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_TS_Base_tooltip.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_TS_Categories_too.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_TS_Categories_too.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_TS_Curve_tooltip.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_TS_Curve_tooltip.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_TS_Redecay_toolti.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_TS_Redecay_toolti.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_TS_Seasons_toolti.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_TS_Seasons_toolti.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_TS_Severity_toolt.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_TS_Severity_toolt.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Urban_Cracks_tool.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Urban_Cracks_tool.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Urban_Doors_toolt.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Urban_Doors_toolt.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Urban_Fences_tool.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Urban_Fences_tool.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Urban_Roofs_toolt.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Urban_Roofs_toolt.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Urban_Walls_toolt.ch: 裝飾用分隔線, 無任何作用.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Urban_Walls_toolt.cn: 装饰用分隔线, 无任何作用.

Sandbox_WDecay_TimeScaling.ch: 世界衰敗 - 依世界存續時間調整
Sandbox_WDecay_TimeScaling.cn: 世界衰败 - 按世界存续时间调整

Sandbox_WDecay_batteryChargeMax_tooltip.ch: 受損時電池的最高電量 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_batteryChargeMax_tooltip.cn: 受损时电池的最高电量 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_batteryChargeMin_tooltip.ch: 受損時電池的最低電量 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_batteryChargeMin_tooltip.cn: 受损时电池的最低电量 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_batteryConditionMax_toolt.ch: 受損時電池的最高耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_batteryConditionMax_toolt.cn: 受损时电池的最高耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_batteryConditionMin_toolt.ch: 受損時電池的最低耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_batteryConditionMin_toolt.cn: 受损时电池的最低耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_batteryDamageChance_toolt.en: Chance that the battery is damaged.

Sandbox_WDecay_brakeConditionMax_tooltip.ch: 受損時煞車的最高耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_brakeConditionMax_tooltip.cn: 受损时刹车的最高耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_brakeConditionMin_tooltip.ch: 受損時煞車的最低耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_brakeConditionMin_tooltip.cn: 受损时刹车的最低耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_bushesPercentageOnRoof_to.en: How many bushes spawn on roof tiles (Z > 1).
Sandbox_WDecay_bushesPercentageOnRoof_to.ch: 屋頂地塊 (Z > 1) 上生成灌木的數量佔比.
Sandbox_WDecay_bushesPercentageOnRoof_to.cn: 屋顶地块 (Z > 1) 上生成灌木的数量占比.

Sandbox_WDecay_doorConditionMax_tooltip.ch: 受損時車門的最高耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_doorConditionMax_tooltip.cn: 受损时车门的最高耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_doorConditionMin_tooltip.ch: 受損時車門的最低耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_doorConditionMin_tooltip.cn: 受损时车门的最低耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_doorDamageChance_tooltip.en: Chance that a door is damaged.

Sandbox_WDecay_enableBarricades_tooltip.en: If disabled, the barricade generator is skipped entirely, regardless of the barricade percentage below.

Sandbox_WDecay_enableWalls_tooltip.en: If disabled, the wall decay generator is skipped entirely, regardless of the wall percentage below.

Sandbox_WDecay_engineDamageChance_toolti.en: Chance that the engine is damaged.

Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelBudgetMs_toolti.en: Reduced version of Time Budget used while driving above the Fast Travel Speed.
Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelBudgetMs_toolti.ch: 以高於快速移動速度駕駛時使用的縮減版時間預算.
Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelBudgetMs_toolti.cn: 以高于快速移动速度驾驶时使用的缩减版时间预算.

Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelPriorityRadius.cn: 快速移动优先半径 (区块)

Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelPriorityRadius_.cn: 高速驾驶时的高优先范围. 超过快速移动扫描半径的数值会被限制.

Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelScanIntervalSec.en: How often periodic scans run for a fast-driving player. Lower values update nearby chunks sooner but use more CPU.
Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelScanIntervalSec.ch: 高速駕駛的玩家執行週期性掃描的頻率. 數值越低, 附近區塊更新越快, 但會占用更多 CPU.
Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelScanIntervalSec.cn: 高速驾驶的玩家执行周期性扫描的频率. 数值越低, 附近区块更新越快, 但会占用更多 CPU.

Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelScanRadius.ch: 快速移動掃描半徑 (區塊)
Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelScanRadius.cn: 快速移动扫描半径 (区块)

Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelScanRadius_tool.en: Periodic scan coverage while driving fast. Values above normal Scan Radius are clamped.
Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelScanRadius_tool.ch: 高速駕駛時的週期性掃描範圍. 超過一般掃描半徑的數值會被限制.
Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelScanRadius_tool.cn: 高速驾驶时的周期性扫描范围. 超过普通扫描半径的数值会被限制.

Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelSpeedKmh_toolti.en: Vehicle speed above which the mod switches to the Fast Travel Time Budget to reduce stutter while driving. 0 disables this.
Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelSpeedKmh_toolti.ch: 載具速度高於此值時, 模組會切換為快速移動時間預算, 以減少駕駛時的卡頓. 設為 0 則停用此功能.
Sandbox_WDecay_fastTravelSpeedKmh_toolti.cn: 载具速度高于此值时, 模组会切换为快速移动时间预算, 以减少驾驶时的卡顿. 设为 0 则禁用此功能.

Sandbox_WDecay_floorLeavesPercentageOnRo.cn: 道路地块上覆盖枯叶的数量占比.

Sandbox_WDecay_generalConditionChance_to.cn: 每个零件应用整体耐久度的概率.

Sandbox_WDecay_generalCondition_tooltip.cn: 应用于“所有”零件的基础耐久度 (100 = 完好). 各项单独设置会在此基础上再应用.

Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxConditionMax_tool.en: Maximum glove box condition when damaged (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxConditionMin_tool.en: Minimum glove box condition when damaged (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxConditionMin_tool.ch: 受損時手套箱的最低耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxConditionMin_tool.cn: 受损时手套箱的最低耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxDamageChance_tool.en: Chance that the glove box is damaged.

Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxMissingChance_too.en: Chance the glove box is missing.

Sandbox_WDecay_groundDebrisPercentageOnR.ch: 道路地塊上散落細枝、原木與石頭的數量佔比.
Sandbox_WDecay_groundDebrisPercentageOnR.cn: 道路地块上散落细枝、原木与石头的数量占比.

Sandbox_WDecay_groundDebrisPercentage_to.cn: 自然地面上散落细枝、原木与石头的数量占比.

Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayCrackPercent.cn: 建筑内部出现地板裂缝覆盖层的数量占比.

Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayCustomGrassP.cn: 自定义草地覆盖率 (室内)

Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayCustomGrassP.en: How much custom grass and ground debris appear as flat floor decals inside buildings.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayCustomGrassP.ch: 建築內部以平面地板貼花形式出現的自訂草地與地面雜物數量佔比.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayCustomGrassP.cn: 建筑内部以平面地板贴花形式出现的自定义草地与地面杂物数量占比.

Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayDebrisPercen.cn: 建筑内部以平面地板贴花形式出现的地面杂物数量占比.

Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayGrassPercent.en: How much grass and plants appear as flat floor decals inside buildings.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayGrassPercent.ch: 建築內部以平面地板貼花形式出現的草與植物數量佔比.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayGrassPercent.cn: 建筑内部以平面地板贴花形式出现的草与植物数量占比.

Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayLeavesPercen.en: How many leaf decals appear on indoor floors.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayLeavesPercen.ch: 室內地板上出現落葉貼花的數量佔比.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayLeavesPercen.cn: 室内地板上出现落叶贴花的数量占比.

Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayTrashPercent.en: How much decorative trash appears as flat floor decals inside buildings.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayTrashPercent.ch: 建築內部以平面地板貼花形式出現的裝飾性垃圾數量佔比.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayTrashPercent.cn: 建筑内部以平面地板贴花形式出现的装饰性垃圾数量占比.

Sandbox_WDecay_jumboXLXXLPercentage_tool.en: Chance for generated trees to use Jumbo XL or Jumbo XXL sprites.
Sandbox_WDecay_jumboXLXXLPercentage_tool.ch: 生成的樹木使用 Jumbo XL 或 Jumbo XXL 貼圖的機率.
Sandbox_WDecay_jumboXLXXLPercentage_tool.cn: 生成的树木使用 Jumbo XL 或 Jumbo XXL 贴图的概率.

Sandbox_WDecay_metalBarricadeMultiplier_.en: Relative material weight for generated window barricades. 100/100 gives an even wood/metal split; 0 disables metal barricades. The overall spawn rate is controlled by Barricade Percentage.
Sandbox_WDecay_metalBarricadeMultiplier_.ch: 生成窗戶路障時的相對材質權重. 100/100 代表木材與金屬各半; 0 則停用金屬路障. 整體生成率由路障覆蓋率控制.
Sandbox_WDecay_metalBarricadeMultiplier_.cn: 生成窗户路障时的相对材质权重. 100/100 代表木材与金属各半; 0 则禁用金属路障. 整体生成率由路障覆盖率控制.

Sandbox_WDecay_mufflerConditionMax_toolt.ch: 受損時消音器的最高耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_mufflerConditionMax_toolt.cn: 受损时消声器的最高耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_mufflerConditionMin_toolt.ch: 受損時消音器的最低耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_mufflerConditionMin_toolt.cn: 受损时消声器的最低耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_outdoorGrassPercentageOnR.en: How much grass spawns as a real object (has depth, characters can walk behind it) on road tiles. Separate from the Grass Overlay (Road) option above.
Sandbox_WDecay_outdoorGrassPercentageOnR.ch: 道路地塊上以真實物件 (具有深度, 角色可走到其後方) 生成草叢的數量佔比. 與上方的原版草地覆蓋率 (道路) 選項分開計算.
Sandbox_WDecay_outdoorGrassPercentageOnR.cn: 道路地块上以真实物体 (具有深度, 角色可走到其后方) 生成草丛的数量占比. 与上方的原版草地覆盖率 (道路) 选项分开计算.

Sandbox_WDecay_outdoorGrassPercentage_to.en: How much grass spawns as a real object (has depth, characters can walk behind it) on natural ground. Separate from the Grass Overlay option above - both can spawn on the same tile.
Sandbox_WDecay_outdoorGrassPercentage_to.ch: 自然地面上以真實物件 (具有深度, 角色可走到其後方) 生成草叢的數量佔比. 與上方的原版草地覆蓋率選項分開計算 - 兩者可在同一地塊上生成.
Sandbox_WDecay_outdoorGrassPercentage_to.cn: 自然地面上以真实物体 (具有深度, 角色可走到其后方) 生成草丛的数量占比. 与上方的原版草地覆盖率选项分开计算 - 两者可在同一地块上生成.

Sandbox_WDecay_progressiveDays_tooltip.en: Progressive mode only: in-game days until decay reaches 100%% of the configured sandbox percentages. 365 = one year.
Sandbox_WDecay_progressiveDays_tooltip.ch: 僅限漸進模式: 衰敗達到沙盒設定百分比 100%% 所需的遊戲內天數. 365 = 一年.
Sandbox_WDecay_progressiveDays_tooltip.cn: 仅限渐进模式: 衰败达到沙盒设置百分比 100%% 所需的游戏内天数. 365 = 一年.

Sandbox_WDecay_progressiveStartPercent_t.en: Progressive mode only: fraction of the configured percentages already present at world start. 0 = pristine world, 25 = the world starts with a quarter of the configured decay.
Sandbox_WDecay_progressiveStartPercent_t.ch: 僅限漸進模式: 世界開始時已存在的設定百分比比例. 0 = 全新完好的世界, 25 = 世界開始時已有四分之一的設定衰敗程度.
Sandbox_WDecay_progressiveStartPercent_t.cn: 仅限渐进模式: 世界开始时已存在的设置百分比比例. 0 = 全新完好的世界, 25 = 世界开始时已有四分之一的设置衰败程度.

Sandbox_WDecay_radioConditionMax_tooltip.ch: 受損時收音機的最高耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_radioConditionMax_tooltip.cn: 受损时收音机的最高耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_radioConditionMin_tooltip.ch: 受損時收音機的最低耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_radioConditionMin_tooltip.cn: 受损时收音机的最低耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_radioDamageChance_tooltip.en: Chance that the radio is damaged.

Sandbox_WDecay_redecayCheckIntervalDays_.en: How often each player's nearby completed chunks are checked for re-decay. Higher values delay re-decay checks and reduce scan work.
Sandbox_WDecay_redecayCheckIntervalDays_.ch: 每位玩家附近已處理完成的區塊多久檢查一次再衰敗. 數值越高, 再衰敗檢查越延後, 掃描負擔也越小.
Sandbox_WDecay_redecayCheckIntervalDays_.cn: 每位玩家附近已处理完成的区块多久检查一次再衰败. 数值越高, 再衰败检查越延后, 扫描负担也越小.

Sandbox_WDecay_redecayEnabled_tooltip.en: If enabled, chunks processed long ago receive additional decay passes as the world ages, applying only the percentage gained since the last pass. Without this, decay is applied once per chunk forever.
Sandbox_WDecay_redecayEnabled_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, 很久以前處理過的區塊會隨世界時間推移再進行額外的衰敗處理, 只套用自上次處理以來增加的百分比. 若停用, 每個區塊永遠只套用一次衰敗.
Sandbox_WDecay_redecayEnabled_tooltip.cn: 启用后, 很久以前处理过的区块会随世界时间推移再进行额外的衰败处理, 只应用自上次处理以来增加的百分比. 若禁用, 每个区块永远只应用一次衰败.

Sandbox_WDecay_redecayThresholdDays_tool.en: Minimum in-game days between decay passes on the same chunk.
Sandbox_WDecay_redecayThresholdDays_tool.ch: 同一區塊兩次衰敗處理之間的最少遊戲天數.
Sandbox_WDecay_redecayThresholdDays_tool.cn: 同一区块两次衰败处理之间的最少游戏天数.

Sandbox_WDecay_redecayUrbanEnabled_toolt.en: If enabled, re-decay also repeats walls, fences, doors, windows, barricades, and vines. If disabled, re-decay only adds vegetation.
Sandbox_WDecay_redecayUrbanEnabled_toolt.ch: 啟用後, 再衰敗也會重複處理牆壁, 圍欄, 門, 窗戶, 路障和藤蔓. 若停用, 再衰敗只會增加植被.
Sandbox_WDecay_redecayUrbanEnabled_toolt.cn: 启用后, 再衰败也会重复处理墙壁, 围栏, 门, 窗户, 路障和藤蔓. 若禁用, 再衰败只会增加植被.

Sandbox_WDecay_roadGrassNaturalRange.ch: 道路草地自然範圍 (地塊)
Sandbox_WDecay_roadGrassNaturalRange.cn: 道路草地自然范围 (地块)

Sandbox_WDecay_roadGrassNaturalRange_too.en: How far road-grass patches can spread from natural ground. Higher values reach farther from road edges and do a few more checks per processed chunk.
Sandbox_WDecay_roadGrassNaturalRange_too.ch: 道路草叢能從自然地面向外蔓延多遠. 數值越高, 能延伸到離路緣越遠的地方, 每個處理的區塊也會多做幾次檢查.
Sandbox_WDecay_roadGrassNaturalRange_too.cn: 道路草丛能从自然地面向外蔓延多远. 数值越高, 能延伸到离路缘越远的地方, 每个处理的区块也会多做几次检查.

Sandbox_WDecay_roadGrassVoronoiSpread.ch: 道路草地沃羅諾伊擴散
Sandbox_WDecay_roadGrassVoronoiSpread.cn: 道路草地沃罗诺伊扩散

Sandbox_WDecay_roadGrassVoronoiSpread_to.en: If enabled, road grass can form in any eligible road area and concentrates in lush Vegetation Region Scale patches. If disabled, road grass only begins near natural ground as before. Requires Vegetation Region Scale to be enabled.
Sandbox_WDecay_roadGrassVoronoiSpread_to.ch: 啟用後, 道路草地可在任何符合條件的道路區域生成, 並集中在植被區域尺度中的茂密區塊. 若停用, 道路草地會像以前一樣只從自然地面附近開始生長. 需要啟用植被區域尺度.
Sandbox_WDecay_roadGrassVoronoiSpread_to.cn: 启用后, 道路草地可在任何符合条件的道路区域生成, 并集中在植被区域尺度中的茂密区块. 若禁用, 道路草地会像以前一样只从自然地面附近开始生长. 需要启用植被区域尺度.

Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayCrackPercentag.en: How many cracked overlays appear on rooftops.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayCrackPercentag.ch: 屋頂上出現裂縫覆蓋層的數量佔比.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayCrackPercentag.cn: 屋顶上出现裂缝覆盖层的数量占比.

Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayCustomGrassPer.cn: 自定义草地覆盖率 (屋顶)

Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayCustomGrassPer.en: How much custom grass and ground debris appear as flat floor decals on rooftops.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayCustomGrassPer.ch: 屋頂上以平面地板貼花呈現的自訂草地和地面雜物數量.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayCustomGrassPer.cn: 屋顶上以平面地板贴花呈现的自定义草地和地面杂物数量.

Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayDebrisPercenta.en: How much ground debris appears as flat floor decals on rooftops.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayDebrisPercenta.ch: 屋頂上以平面地板貼花呈現的地面雜物數量.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayDebrisPercenta.cn: 屋顶上以平面地板贴花呈现的地面杂物数量.

Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayGrassPercentag.en: How much grass and plants appear as flat floor decals on rooftops.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayGrassPercentag.ch: 屋頂上以平面地板貼花呈現的草和植物數量.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayGrassPercentag.cn: 屋顶上以平面地板贴花呈现的草和植物数量.

Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayLeavesPercenta.en: How many leaf decals appear on rooftops.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayLeavesPercenta.ch: 屋頂上出現落葉貼花的數量.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayLeavesPercenta.cn: 屋顶上出现落叶贴花的数量.

Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayTrashPercentag.en: How much decorative trash appears as flat floor decals on rooftops.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayTrashPercentag.ch: 屋頂上以平面地板貼花呈現的裝飾性垃圾數量.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayTrashPercentag.cn: 屋顶上以平面地板贴花呈现的装饰性垃圾数量.

Sandbox_WDecay_scanIntervalSeconds_toolt.en: How often the mod scans for new chunks around each player. Lower = more responsive but higher CPU usage.
Sandbox_WDecay_scanIntervalSeconds_toolt.ch: 模組多久掃描一次每位玩家周圍的新區塊. 數值越低=反應越快, 但 CPU 使用率越高.
Sandbox_WDecay_scanIntervalSeconds_toolt.cn: 模组多久扫描一次每位玩家周围的新区块. 数值越低=响应越快, 但 CPU 占用越高.

Sandbox_WDecay_scanPriorityRadius_toolti.en: Normal-speed high-priority bubble for periodic scans. Values above Scan Radius are clamped to Scan Radius.
Sandbox_WDecay_scanPriorityRadius_toolti.ch: 定期掃描時以正常速度處理的高優先範圍. 超過掃描半徑的數值會被限制為掃描半徑.
Sandbox_WDecay_scanPriorityRadius_toolti.cn: 定期扫描时以正常速度处理的高优先范围. 超过扫描半径的数值会被限制为扫描半径.

Sandbox_WDecay_seasonalBiasEnabled_toolt.en: If enabled, generated vegetation follows the season: grass density is reduced in winter, lusher in summer, and leaves increase in autumn. Vegetation objects also update their seasonal appearance.
Sandbox_WDecay_seasonalBiasEnabled_toolt.ch: 啟用後, 生成的植被會隨季節變化: 冬季草地密度降低, 夏季更茂盛, 秋季落葉增加. 植被物件也會更新其季節外觀.
Sandbox_WDecay_seasonalBiasEnabled_toolt.cn: 启用后, 生成的植被会随季节变化: 冬季草地密度降低, 夏季更茂盛, 秋季落叶增加. 植被物体也会更新其季节外观.

Sandbox_WDecay_severityScalingEnabled.ch: 依世界時間調整嚴重程度
Sandbox_WDecay_severityScalingEnabled.cn: 按世界时间调整严重程度

Sandbox_WDecay_severityScalingEnabled_to.en: If enabled, world age also increases decay intensity, not just probability: vehicle parts spawn in worse condition and are missing more often, and damaged fences are destroyed more often.
Sandbox_WDecay_severityScalingEnabled_to.ch: 啟用後, 世界時間不只提高衰敗機率, 也會提高衰敗強度: 車輛零件生成時狀況更差, 缺失也更頻繁, 受損圍欄也更常被完全損毀.
Sandbox_WDecay_severityScalingEnabled_to.cn: 启用后, 世界时间不只提高衰败概率, 也会提高衰败强度: 车辆零件生成时状况更差, 缺失也更频繁, 受损围栏也更常被完全损毁.

Sandbox_WDecay_suspensionConditionMax_to.ch: 懸掛受損時的最高耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_suspensionConditionMax_to.cn: 悬挂受损时的最高耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_suspensionConditionMin_to.ch: 懸掛受損時的最低耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_suspensionConditionMin_to.cn: 悬挂受损时的最低耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_taillightConditionMax_too.ch: 尾燈受損時的最高耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_taillightConditionMax_too.cn: 尾灯受损时的最高耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_taillightConditionMin_too.ch: 尾燈受損時的最低耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_taillightConditionMin_too.cn: 尾灯受损时的最低耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_taillightDamageChance_too.en: Chance that a taillight is damaged.

Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingCurve_tooltip.en: Shape of the multiplier growth over time. Linear: steady. Logarithmic: fast early, saturates later. Quadratic: slow early, aggressive in old worlds.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingCurve_tooltip.ch: 倍率隨時間成長的曲線形狀. 線性: 穩定成長. 對數: 前期快速, 後期趨於飽和. 二次方: 前期緩慢, 在久遠的世界中急遽上升.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingCurve_tooltip.cn: 倍率随时间增长的曲线形状. 线性: 稳定增长. 对数: 前期快速, 后期趋于饱和. 二次方: 前期缓慢, 在久远的世界中急剧上升.

Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingEnabled_toolti.en: If enabled, decay percentages increase the older the world is. Newly explored chunks in long-running worlds look more decayed.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingEnabled_toolti.ch: 啟用後, 世界越久遠, 衰敗百分比越高. 在長期遊玩的世界中, 新探索的區塊看起來會更加破敗.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingEnabled_toolti.cn: 启用后, 世界越久远, 衰败百分比越高. 在长期游玩的世界中, 新探索的区块看起来会更加破败.

Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingFollowErosion_.en: If enabled, the multiplier follows the vanilla Erosion Speed (days until full erosion) instead of the per-year rate: it reaches the Maximum Multiplier when vanilla erosion reaches 100%%.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingFollowErosion_.ch: 啟用後, 倍率會跟隨原版侵蝕速度 (完全侵蝕所需天數), 而非每年增長率: 當原版侵蝕達到 100%% 時, 倍率達到最大倍率.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingFollowErosion_.cn: 启用后, 倍率会跟随原版侵蚀速度 (完全侵蚀所需天数), 而非每年增长率: 当原版侵蚀达到 100%% 时, 倍率达到最大倍率.

Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingMax_tooltip.en: Upper cap for the world-age decay multiplier. 4.0 means decay percentages can grow up to 4x their configured values.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingMax_tooltip.ch: 世界時間衰敗倍率的上限. 4.0 表示衰敗百分比最多可成長到設定值的 4 倍.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingMax_tooltip.cn: 世界时间衰败倍率的上限. 4.0 表示衰败百分比最多可增长到设置值的 4 倍.

Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingMode_option1.ch: 放大 (從第一天起完整套用)
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingMode_option1.cn: 放大 (从第一天起完整应用)

Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingMode_tooltip.en: Amplify: configured percentages apply fully from day one and grow up to the cap. Progressive: decay starts near zero and gradually ramps up to the configured percentages over the configured number of days, then keeps growing up to the cap. Combine Progressive with Incremental Re-Decay so already explored areas fill in over time.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingMode_tooltip.ch: 放大: 設定的百分比從第一天起完整套用, 並持續成長至上限. 漸進: 衰敗從接近零開始, 在設定的天數內逐步提升至設定的百分比, 之後持續成長至上限. 將漸進模式搭配漸進式再衰敗, 已探索的區域也會隨時間逐漸補上衰敗.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingMode_tooltip.cn: 放大: 设置的百分比从第一天起完整应用, 并持续增长至上限. 渐进: 衰败从接近零开始, 在设置的天数内逐步提升至设置的百分比, 之后持续增长至上限. 将渐进模式搭配渐进式再衰败, 已探索的区域也会随时间逐渐补上衰败.

Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingNatureFactor_t.en: How strongly world-age scaling affects vegetation (trees, bushes, grass, vines, ground overlays). 100 = base speed, 150 = nature reclaims 50%% faster, 0 = no scaling for nature.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingNatureFactor_t.ch: 世界時間調整對植被 (樹木, 灌木, 草, 藤蔓, 地面覆蓋層) 的影響程度. 100=基礎速度, 150=大自然收復速度加快 50%%, 0=不調整自然.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingNatureFactor_t.cn: 世界时间调整对植被 (树木, 灌木, 草, 藤蔓, 地面覆盖层) 的影响程度. 100=基础速度, 150=大自然收复速度加快 50%%, 0=不调整自然.

Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingPerYear_toolti.en: How much all decay percentages increase per in-game year of world age. 25 means +25%% relative increase per year, capped by the Maximum Multiplier.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingPerYear_toolti.ch: 世界每經過一個遊戲年, 所有衰敗百分比的增加幅度. 25 表示每年相對增加 25%%, 上限受最大倍率限制.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingPerYear_toolti.cn: 世界每经过一个游戏年, 所有衰败百分比的增加幅度. 25 表示每年相对增加 25%%, 上限受最大倍率限制.

Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingUrbanFactor_to.en: How strongly world-age scaling affects structural decay (walls, fences, doors, windows, barricades). 100 = base speed, lower values make buildings decay slower than nature grows.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingUrbanFactor_to.ch: 世界時間調整對結構衰敗 (牆壁, 圍欄, 門, 窗戶, 路障) 的影響程度. 100=基礎速度, 數值越低, 建築衰敗速度越慢於大自然生長.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingUrbanFactor_to.cn: 世界时间调整对结构衰败 (墙壁, 围栏, 门, 窗户, 路障) 的影响程度. 100=基础速度, 数值越低, 建筑衰败速度越慢于大自然生长.

Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingVehiclesFactor.en: How strongly world-age scaling affects vehicle deterioration when Severity Scaling is enabled. 100 = base speed.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingVehiclesFactor.ch: 啟用嚴重程度調整時, 世界時間調整對車輛劣化的影響程度. 100=基礎速度.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingVehiclesFactor.cn: 启用严重程度调整时, 世界时间调整对车辆劣化的影响程度. 100=基础速度.

Sandbox_WDecay_tireConditionMax_tooltip.ch: 輪胎受損時的最高耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_tireConditionMax_tooltip.cn: 轮胎受损时的最高耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_tireConditionMin_tooltip.ch: 輪胎受損時的最低耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_tireConditionMin_tooltip.cn: 轮胎受损时的最低耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_tireDamageChance_tooltip.en: Chance that a tire is damaged.

Sandbox_WDecay_treeAmericanhollyPercenta.en: Relative chance for American Holly (evergreen) trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeAmericanhollyPercenta.ch: 美國冬青 (常綠) 樹相對於其他樹種的生成機率. 0 表示停用.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeAmericanhollyPercenta.cn: 美国冬青 (常绿) 树相对于其他树种的生成概率. 0 表示禁用.

Sandbox_WDecay_treeAmericanlindenPercent.en: Relative chance for American Linden trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeAmericanlindenPercent.ch: 美國椴樹相對於其他樹種的生成機率. 0 表示停用.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeAmericanlindenPercent.cn: 美国椴树相对于其他树种的生成概率. 0 表示禁用.

Sandbox_WDecay_treeCanadianhemlockPercen.en: Relative chance for Canadian Hemlock (evergreen) trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeCanadianhemlockPercen.ch: 加拿大鐵杉 (常綠) 樹相對於其他樹種的生成機率. 0 表示停用.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeCanadianhemlockPercen.cn: 加拿大铁杉 (常绿) 树相对于其他树种的生成概率. 0 表示禁用.

Sandbox_WDecay_treeDogwoodPercentage_too.en: Relative chance for Dogwood trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeDogwoodPercentage_too.ch: 山茱萸樹相對於其他樹種的生成機率. 0 表示停用.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeDogwoodPercentage_too.cn: 山茱萸树相对于其他树种的生成概率. 0 表示禁用.

Sandbox_WDecay_treeRedmaplePercentage_to.en: Relative chance for Red Maple trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeRedmaplePercentage_to.ch: 紅楓樹相對於其他樹種的生成機率. 0 表示停用.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeRedmaplePercentage_to.cn: 红枫树相对于其他树种的生成概率. 0 表示禁用.

Sandbox_WDecay_treeRiverbirchPercentage_.en: Relative chance for River Birch trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeRiverbirchPercentage_.ch: 河樺樹相對於其他樹種的生成機率. 0 表示停用.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeRiverbirchPercentage_.cn: 河桦树相对于其他树种的生成概率. 0 表示禁用.

Sandbox_WDecay_treeVirginiapinePercentag.en: Relative chance for Virginia Pine (evergreen) trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeVirginiapinePercentag.ch: 維吉尼亞松 (常綠) 樹相對於其他樹種的生成機率. 0 表示停用.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeVirginiapinePercentag.cn: 弗吉尼亚松 (常绿) 树相对于其他树种的生成概率. 0 表示禁用.

Sandbox_WDecay_trunkConditionMax_tooltip.ch: 後備箱受損時的最高耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_trunkConditionMax_tooltip.cn: 后备箱受损时的最高耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_trunkConditionMin_tooltip.ch: 後備箱受損時的最低耐久度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_trunkConditionMin_tooltip.cn: 后备箱受损时的最低耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_trunkDamageChance_tooltip.en: Chance that the trunk is damaged.

Sandbox_WDecay_vegetationPatternDistribu.en: Smooth makes gentle density changes. Patchy creates deterministic barren, sparse, normal, and lush regions while preserving the approximate average density.
Sandbox_WDecay_vegetationPatternDistribu.ch: 平滑: 密度變化較和緩. 斑駁: 產生固定的荒蕪, 稀疏, 一般與茂密區域, 同時維持大致的平均密度.
Sandbox_WDecay_vegetationPatternDistribu.cn: 平滑: 密度变化较和缓. 斑驳: 生成固定的荒芜, 稀疏, 一般与茂密区域, 同时维持大致的平均密度.

Sandbox_WDecay_vegetationPatternScale_to.en: Size of deterministic Voronoi vegetation regions. Existing density percentages remain the world-wide average.
Sandbox_WDecay_vegetationPatternScale_to.ch: 固定沃羅諾伊植被區域的大小. 現有的密度百分比仍為全世界的平均值.
Sandbox_WDecay_vegetationPatternScale_to.cn: 固定沃罗诺伊植被区域的大小. 现有的密度百分比仍为全世界的平均值.

Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleBloodMax_tooltip.en: Maximum blood intensity (0-100) on vehicle exterior.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleBloodMax_tooltip.ch: 車輛外部的最高血跡濃度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleBloodMax_tooltip.cn: 车辆外部的最高血迹浓度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleBloodMin_tooltip.en: Minimum blood intensity (0-100) on vehicle exterior.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleBloodMin_tooltip.ch: 車輛外部的最低血跡濃度 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleBloodMin_tooltip.cn: 车辆外部的最低血迹浓度 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleDecayEnabled_toolt.en: Master switch. Disable to prevent any vehicle deterioration from this mod.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleDecayEnabled_toolt.ch: 總開關. 停用後, 本模組不會使任何車輛劣化.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleDecayEnabled_toolt.cn: 总开关. 禁用后, 本模组不会使任何车辆劣化.

Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRustMax_tooltip.en: Maximum rust percentage (0-100) applied to vehicles.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRustMax_tooltip.ch: 套用在車輛上的最高鏽蝕百分比 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRustMax_tooltip.cn: 应用在车辆上的最高锈蚀百分比 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRustMin_tooltip.en: Minimum rust percentage (0-100) applied to vehicles.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRustMin_tooltip.ch: 套用在車輛上的最低鏽蝕百分比 (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRustMin_tooltip.cn: 应用在车辆上的最低锈蚀百分比 (0-100).

Sandbox_WDecay_windowConditionMax_toolti.ch: 車窗受損時的最高耐久度 (0-100).

Sandbox_DeadMagic_PreventItemHasteStacki.en: Only the strongest haste boost from a single worn item applies, including enchantment and relic haste. Equal boosts do not stack. Disabled by default to keep existing item haste behavior. Other item effects and non-item haste are unchanged.
Sandbox_DeadMagic_PreventItemHasteStacki.ch: 只套用單件穿戴物品提供的最強疾行加成, 包含附魔與遺物的疾行. 相同的加成不會疊加. 預設停用, 以保留現有的物品疾行行為. 其他物品效果與非物品來源的疾行不受影響.
Sandbox_DeadMagic_PreventItemHasteStacki.cn: 只应用单件穿戴物品提供的最强疾行加成, 包括附魔与遗物的疾行. 相同的加成不会叠加. 默认禁用, 以保留现有的物品疾行行为. 其他物品效果与非物品来源的疾行不受影响.

Sandbox_PhunMart_ShopsDestructible_toolt.en: If enabled, players can destroy shop machines with a sledgehammer. A shop can override this in its Basics tab. Admins can always destroy machines.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ShopsDestructible_toolt.ch: 啟用後, 玩家可以用大鎚破壞商店機台. 個別商店可在其「基本」分頁中覆寫此設定. 管理員一律可以破壞機台.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ShopsDestructible_toolt.cn: 启用后, 玩家可以用大锤破坏商店机器. 单个商店可在其“基本”标签页中覆盖此设置. 管理员始终可以破坏机器.

Sandbox_PhunMart_ShopsMoveable_tooltip.en: If enabled, players can pick up and move shop machines like any other furniture. A shop can override this in its Basics tab. Admins can always move machines.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ShopsMoveable_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, 玩家可以像其他家具一樣拾起並移動商店機台. 個別商店可在其「基本」分頁中覆寫此設定. 管理員一律可以移動機台.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ShopsMoveable_tooltip.cn: 启用后, 玩家可以像其他家具一样拿起并移动商店机器. 单个商店可在其“基本”标签页中覆盖此设置. 管理员始终可以移动机器.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowAutonomousRet.en: Allows autonomous survivors, including travelling groups and base/faction residents, to use the normal bounded retreat decision when danger and a safe escape lane justify it. Player-owned companions remain governed by their orders. Turning this off does not disable combat, threat detection, group formation, traversal, or explicit player orders. Default on.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowAutonomousRet.ch: 允許自主倖存者 (包括旅行群體與基地/陣營居民) 在危險情勢與安全撤離路線皆足以支持時, 採用一般的有限撤退判斷. 屬於玩家的同伴仍依其命令行動. 關閉此選項不會停用戰鬥、威脅偵測、群體編隊、翻越或玩家明確下達的命令. 預設開啟.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowAutonomousRet.cn: 允许自主幸存者 (包括旅行群体与基地/派系居民) 在危险情势与安全撤离路线都足以支持时, 采用常规的有限撤退判断. 属于玩家的同伴仍按其命令行动. 关闭此选项不会禁用战斗、威胁检测、群体编队、翻越或玩家明确下达的命令. 默认开启.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowRadialOrders_t.en: Adds Knox companion, resident, and nearby-survivor actions to the vanilla emote radial. Turning this off leaves vanilla radial actions intact. Default on.

Sandbox_DeadMagic_FatigueMinCost_tooltip.en: Sets the minimum fatigue and endurance cost after scaling. A present zero cost is subject to this minimum; an absent cost remains absent. Default: 0.

Sandbox_LNO_HeadConditionLN.ch: 傳奇薙刀刀頭的耐久度
Sandbox_LNO_HeadConditionLN.cn: 传奇薙刀刀头的耐久度

Sandbox_LNO_HeadConditionLN_tooltip.en: <RGB:0,1,0>Durability of the naginata spear head. 10 = like a vanilla spear, 100 = legendary. Only new naginatas use a changed value. Range 10-100, default 100.
Sandbox_LNO_HeadConditionLN_tooltip.ch: <RGB:0,1,0>薙刀刀頭的耐久度. 10 = 與原版長矛相同, 100 = 傳奇. 修改後的數值只會套用到新產生的薙刀. 範圍 10-100, 預設 100.
Sandbox_LNO_HeadConditionLN_tooltip.cn: <RGB:0,1,0>薙刀刀头的耐久度. 10 = 与原版长矛相同, 100 = 传奇. 修改后的数值只对新生成的薙刀生效. 范围 10-100, 默认 100.

Sandbox_LNO_Magazine_tooltip.en:
<RGB:0,1,0>How often the magazine that teaches the recipes appears (bookshelves, magazine racks, survivor houses, zombies...).
0 = never, 1 = extremely rare, 5 = default, 10 = 3 times the default.
Sandbox_LNO_Magazine_tooltip.ch:
<RGB:0,1,0>教授配方的雜誌出現的頻率 (書架、雜誌架、倖存者住所、殭屍…).
0 = 永不出現, 1 = 極為罕見, 5 = 預設, 10 = 預設的 3 倍.
Sandbox_LNO_Magazine_tooltip.cn:
<RGB:0,1,0>教授配方的杂志出现的频率 (书架、杂志架、幸存者住所、僵尸…).
0 = 从不出现, 1 = 极其罕见, 5 = 默认, 10 = 默认的 3 倍.

Sandbox_LNO_NaginataCommon.ch: 薙刀生成 (普通: 車庫、工坊)
Sandbox_LNO_NaginataCommon.cn: 薙刀生成 (普通: 车库、工坊)

Sandbox_LNO_NaginataCommon_tooltip.en:
<RGB:0,1,0>How often legendary naginatas appear in garages and metalwork shops. Each color appears in places that fit it.
0 = never, 1 = extremely rare, 5 = default, 10 = 3 times the default.
Sandbox_LNO_NaginataCommon_tooltip.ch:
<RGB:0,1,0>傳奇薙刀在車庫與金屬加工店出現的頻率. 每種顏色會出現在與其相符的地點.
0 = 永不出現, 1 = 極為罕見, 5 = 預設, 10 = 預設的 3 倍.
Sandbox_LNO_NaginataCommon_tooltip.cn:
<RGB:0,1,0>传奇薙刀在车库和金属加工店出现的频率. 每种颜色会出现在与之相符的地点.
0 = 从不出现, 1 = 极其罕见, 5 = 默认, 10 = 默认的 3 倍.

Sandbox_LNO_NaginataRare.en: Naginata spawn (Rare: police, military, hunting, survivor houses, etc.)
Sandbox_LNO_NaginataRare.ch: 薙刀生成 (稀有: 警局、軍事、狩獵、倖存者住所等)
Sandbox_LNO_NaginataRare.cn: 薙刀生成 (稀有: 警局、军事、狩猎、幸存者住所等)

Sandbox_LNO_NaginataRare_tooltip.en:
<RGB:0,1,0>How often legendary naginatas appear in police stations, military sites, gun stores, hunting places, fire stations, hospitals, antique stores and survivor houses.
0 = never, 1 = extremely rare, 5 = default, 10 = 3 times the default.
Sandbox_LNO_NaginataRare_tooltip.ch:
<RGB:0,1,0>傳奇薙刀在警察局、軍事據點、槍械店、狩獵場所、消防局、醫院、古董店與倖存者住所出現的頻率.
0 = 永不出現, 1 = 極為罕見, 5 = 預設, 10 = 預設的 3 倍.
Sandbox_LNO_NaginataRare_tooltip.cn:
<RGB:0,1,0>传奇薙刀在警察局、军事据点、枪店、狩猎场所、消防站、医院、古董店和幸存者住所出现的频率.
0 = 从不出现, 1 = 极其罕见, 5 = 默认, 10 = 默认的 3 倍.

Sandbox_LNO_NaginataZombies_tooltip.en:
<RGB:0,1,0>How often zombies carry a legendary naginata.
0 = never, 1 = extremely rare, 5 = default, 10 = 3 times the default.
Sandbox_LNO_NaginataZombies_tooltip.ch:
<RGB:0,1,0>殭屍身上攜帶傳奇薙刀的頻率.
0 = 永不出現, 1 = 極為罕見, 5 = 預設, 10 = 預設的 3 倍.
Sandbox_LNO_NaginataZombies_tooltip.cn:
<RGB:0,1,0>僵尸身上携带传奇薙刀的频率.
0 = 从不出现, 1 = 极其罕见, 5 = 默认, 10 = 默认的 3 倍.

Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCaseCapacity.ch: 傳奇大小雙刀盒: 容量
Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCaseCapacity.cn: 传奇大小双刀盒: 容量

Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCaseCapacity_tooltip.en: <RGB:0,1,0>How much the opened case can hold. Range 15-50, default 50.
Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCaseCapacity_tooltip.ch: <RGB:0,1,0>開啟後的刀盒可容納的容量. 範圍 15-50, 預設 50.
Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCaseCapacity_tooltip.cn: <RGB:0,1,0>打开后的刀盒能容纳的容量. 范围 15-50, 默认 50.

Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCaseWeightReduction.ch: 傳奇大小雙刀盒: 減重
Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCaseWeightReduction.cn: 传奇大小双刀盒: 减重

Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCaseWeightReduction_to.en: <RGB:0,1,0>How much the opened case reduces the weight of what it holds. Range 50-99, default 99.
Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCaseWeightReduction_to.ch: <RGB:0,1,0>開啟後的刀盒對所裝物品的減重程度. 範圍 50-99, 預設 99.
Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCaseWeightReduction_to.cn: <RGB:0,1,0>打开后的刀盒对所装物品的减重程度. 范围 50-99, 默认 99.

Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_Dalmati.en: Allows Dalmatians to spawn outside schools and universities.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_Dalmati.ch: 允許大麥町犬在學校和大學外圍生成.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_Dalmati.cn: 允许大麦町犬在学校和大学外围生成.

Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_Dalmati.en: Multiplier for the normal Dalmatian spawn chance. 0 disables chance rolls; 1 is normal; 5 is five times as likely.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_Dalmati.ch: 大麥町犬基礎生成機率的倍率. 0 為停用生成; 1 為正常機率; 5 為正常機率的五倍.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsBreedPack15_Dalmati.cn: 大麦町犬基础生成概率的倍率. 0 为禁用生成; 1 为正常概率; 5 为正常概率的五倍.

Sandbox_KBW_RequireConstructionPaint_too.en: Require paint and a paintbrush for pre-colored Expanded recipes and selected wall finishes during construction. Disable to build those colors without paint. Does not change vanilla painting of existing walls or bucket capacity.
Sandbox_KBW_RequireConstructionPaint_too.ch: 建造預先上色的原版擴充配方及部分牆面飾面時, 需要油漆與油漆刷. 停用後即可不用油漆建造這些顏色. 不會改變原版為既有牆面上漆的方式或油漆桶容量.
Sandbox_KBW_RequireConstructionPaint_too.cn: 建造预先上色的原版扩展配方及部分墙面饰面时, 需要油漆和油漆刷. 禁用后无需油漆即可建造这些颜色. 不会改变原版对现有墙面涂漆的方式或油漆桶容量.

Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_ConeOutlineAlp.en: Outline opacity, 0 to 1 (default 0.3). Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_ConeOutlineAlp.ch: 輪廓不透明度, 範圍 0 到 1 (預設 0.3). 僅在開啟「對所有玩家強制套用這些設定」時生效. 與同名的模組選項相同.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_ConeOutlineAlp.cn: 轮廓不透明度, 范围 0 到 1 (默认 0.3). 仅在开启“对所有玩家强制应用这些设置”时生效. 与同名的模组选项相同.

Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_EnforceSetting.en: Enforce these settings for all players
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_EnforceSetting.ch: 對所有玩家強制套用這些設定
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_EnforceSetting.cn: 对所有玩家强制应用这些设置

Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_EnforceSetting.en: Multiplayer only. Off by default: every player uses their own Cone Vision Outline options (Settings -> Mods). When on, the settings below replace each player's own, and changing them in the mod options has no effect. The outline colour stays the player's choice. Has no effect in singleplayer.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_EnforceSetting.ch: 僅限多人遊戲. 預設關閉: 每位玩家使用各自的視野錐輪廓選項 (設定 -> 模組). 開啟後, 下方設定會取代每位玩家自己的設定, 在模組選項中變更這些設定也不會生效. 輪廓顏色仍由玩家自行選擇. 在單人遊戲中沒有作用.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_EnforceSetting.cn: 仅限多人游戏. 默认关闭: 每位玩家使用各自的视野锥轮廓选项 (设置 -> 模组). 开启后, 下方设置会替换每位玩家自己的设置, 在模组选项中更改这些设置也不会生效. 轮廓颜色仍由玩家自行选择. 在单人游戏中无效.

Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_LegacyOutlineM.en: Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: use the old square-visibility check instead of asking the game which zombies and animals it draws.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_LegacyOutlineM.ch: 僅在開啟「對所有玩家強制套用這些設定」時生效. 與同名的模組選項相同: 改用舊的方塊可見性判定, 而不是直接讀取遊戲正在繪製哪些殭屍與動物.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_LegacyOutlineM.cn: 仅在开启“对所有玩家强制应用这些设置”时生效. 与同名的模组选项相同: 改用旧的方块可见性判定, 而不是直接读取游戏正在绘制哪些僵尸和动物.

Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_OutlineAlwaysO.en: Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: outlines are shown all the time, not only while aiming (RMB).
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_OutlineAlwaysO.ch: 僅在開啟「對所有玩家強制套用這些設定」時生效. 與同名的模組選項相同: 輪廓會持續顯示, 而不只在瞄準 (右鍵) 時顯示.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_OutlineAlwaysO.cn: 仅在开启“对所有玩家强制应用这些设置”时生效. 与同名的模组选项相同: 轮廓会一直显示, 而不只在瞄准 (右键) 时显示.

Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_OutlineAnimals.en: Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: animals are outlined along with zombies.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_OutlineAnimals.ch: 僅在開啟「對所有玩家強制套用這些設定」時生效. 與同名的模組選項相同: 動物會和殭屍一樣顯示輪廓.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_OutlineAnimals.cn: 仅在开启“对所有玩家强制应用这些设置”时生效. 与同名的模组选项相同: 动物会和僵尸一样显示轮廓.

Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_ScaleOutlineBy.en: Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: outlines fade with distance in fog.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_ScaleOutlineBy.ch: 僅在開啟「對所有玩家強制套用這些設定」時生效. 與同名的模組選項相同: 在霧中, 輪廓會隨距離逐漸淡出.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_ScaleOutlineBy.cn: 仅在开启“对所有玩家强制应用这些设置”时生效. 与同名的模组选项相同: 在雾中, 轮廓会随距离逐渐淡出.

Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_ScaleOutlineBy.en: Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: the outline fades as the light on the target drops, and is gone in full darkness. Turn this on to stop outlines giving away zombies in the dark.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_ScaleOutlineBy.ch: 僅在開啟「對所有玩家強制套用這些設定」時生效. 與同名的模組選項相同: 目標所受的光照越暗, 輪廓越淡, 完全黑暗時輪廓會消失. 開啟此項可避免輪廓在黑暗中暴露殭屍的位置.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_ScaleOutlineBy.cn: 仅在开启“对所有玩家强制应用这些设置”时生效. 与同名的模组选项相同: 目标所受的光照越暗, 轮廓越淡, 完全黑暗时轮廓会消失. 开启此项可避免轮廓在黑暗中暴露僵尸的位置.

Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_VehicleOutline.ch: 乘車時: 一律顯示輪廓
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_VehicleOutline.cn: 乘车时: 始终显示轮廓

Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_VehicleOutline.en: Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: in a vehicle, outlines are shown without holding RMB.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_VehicleOutline.ch: 僅在開啟「對所有玩家強制套用這些設定」時生效. 與同名的模組選項相同: 乘車時無須按住右鍵即可顯示輪廓.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_VehicleOutline.cn: 仅在开启“对所有玩家强制应用这些设置”时生效. 与同名的模组选项相同: 乘车时无需按住右键即可显示轮廓.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_BloodVolumeByWeig.en: A heavier survivor has more blood to lose: about 4.2 litres at 70 kg and under, 5 at 80, 5.8 at 90 and over. The same wound empties a light body faster, and the same bag of blood does less for a heavy one. Off: everybody has 5 litres, as before.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_BloodVolumeByWeig.ch: 體重越重的倖存者可失的血越多: 70 公斤以下約 4.2 公升, 80 公斤為 5 公升, 90 公斤以上為 5.8 公升. 同樣的傷口會讓體重輕的人更快失血, 同一袋血對體重重的人效果也較小. 關閉: 所有人皆為 5 公升, 與以往相同.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_BloodVolumeByWeig.cn: 体重越重的幸存者可流失的血越多: 70 公斤及以下约 4.2 升, 80 公斤为 5 升, 90 公斤及以上为 5.8 升. 同样的伤口会让体重轻的人更快失血, 同一袋血对体重大的人效果也更小. 关闭: 所有人都是 5 升, 与以往相同.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_DebugLog_tooltip.en:
Writes what the mod is doing to Zomboid/Lua/Wounds_debug.log, and on a server to Wounds_debug_server.log: every condition's numbers once an in-game minute, and what each of them asked for.
For working out where health is going when nothing is visible on the panel. It does NOT enable any cheat.
Off by default: the file grows and is never cleaned up.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_DebugLog_tooltip.ch:
將模組的運作情況寫入 Zomboid/Lua/Wounds_debug.log, 伺服器上則寫入 Wounds_debug_server.log: 每個遊戲內分鐘記錄一次各狀況的數值, 以及它們各自要求了什麼.
用於在面板上看不出任何異狀時, 查明健康值流失到哪裡. 這「不會」啟用任何作弊功能.
預設關閉: 檔案會持續變大且永遠不會被清理.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_DebugLog_tooltip.cn:
将模组的运行情况写入 Zomboid/Lua/Wounds_debug.log, 服务器上则写入 Wounds_debug_server.log: 每个游戏内分钟记录一次各状况的数值, 以及它们各自请求了什么.
用于在面板上看不出任何异常时, 查明健康值流失到哪里. 这“不会”启用任何作弊功能.
默认关闭: 文件会持续变大且永远不会被清理.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_DrawFromOthers_to.en:
On: with a needle and an empty bag you can draw blood from another player standing next to you, not only from yourself - the donor pays the blood loss. On a server that includes a player who is unconscious and cannot refuse, so turn it on only if you trust your players.
Not yet tested in a multiplayer game.
Off: everybody draws only from their own arm.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_DrawFromOthers_to.ch:
開啟: 只要有針和空的採血袋, 你不只能從自己身上抽血, 也能從站在身旁的其他玩家身上抽血 - 失血由捐血者承擔. 在伺服器上, 這也包括失去意識, 無法拒絕的玩家, 因此請只在信任你的玩家時開啟.
尚未在多人遊戲中測試.
關閉: 每個人只能從自己的手臂抽血.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_DrawFromOthers_to.cn:
开启: 只要有针和空的采血袋, 你不仅能从自己身上抽血, 也能从站在身边的其他玩家身上抽血 - 失血由献血者承担. 在服务器上, 这也包括失去意识, 无法拒绝的玩家, 所以请只在信任你的玩家时开启.
尚未在多人游戏中测试.
关闭: 每个人只能从自己的手臂抽血.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_ExtractGameEnable.en:
On: taking out a lodged bullet opens a close-up where you guide the tweezers in yourself. A shaky hand hurts and can slip.
Off: the bullet comes out the vanilla way.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_ExtractGameEnable.ch:
開啟: 取出嵌入的子彈時會開啟特寫畫面, 由你親手引導鑷子. 手不穩會造成疼痛, 也可能滑脫.
關閉: 依原版方式取出子彈.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_ExtractGameEnable.cn:
开启: 取出嵌入的子弹时会打开特写画面, 由你亲手引导镊子. 手不稳会造成疼痛, 也可能滑脱.
关闭: 按原版方式取出子弹.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_GunshotWoundsEnab.en:
On: a bullet stops either in a joint - it has to come out before anything else - or deep in the tissue, where it stays: pack the wound and run antibiotics until the flesh closes over it. Gunshot wounds are packed, not stitched.
Not yet tested in a multiplayer game.
Off: bullets work exactly as in vanilla.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_GunshotWoundsEnab.ch:
開啟: 子彈會停在關節內 - 必須優先取出 - 或停在組織深處並留在體內: 填塞傷口並持續服用抗生素, 直到皮肉在子彈上方癒合. 槍傷用填塞處理, 不縫合.
尚未在多人遊戲中測試.
關閉: 子彈的運作方式與原版完全相同.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_GunshotWoundsEnab.cn:
开启: 子弹会停在关节内 - 必须优先取出 - 或停在组织深处并留在体内: 填塞伤口并持续服用抗生素, 直到皮肉在子弹上方愈合. 枪伤用填塞处理, 不缝合.
尚未在多人游戏中测试.
关闭: 子弹的机制与原版完全相同.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_TrimGameEnabled.ch: 小遊戲: 修剪傷口邊緣
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_TrimGameEnabled.cn: 小游戏: 修剪伤口边缘

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_TrimGameEnabled_t.en:
On: trimming a ragged wound opens a close-up where you cut the dead edge away yourself, with a scalpel or scissors. How clean the cut is decides how well the wound stitches afterwards and how much it hurts.
Off: trimming is a plain timed action, as it was before the minigame.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_TrimGameEnabled_t.ch:
開啟: 修剪參差不齊的傷口時會開啟特寫畫面, 由你親手用手術刀或剪刀切除壞死的邊緣. 切得越乾淨, 之後縫合的效果越好, 疼痛也越輕.
關閉: 修剪為一般的計時動作, 與加入小遊戲之前相同.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_TrimGameEnabled_t.cn:
开启: 修剪参差不齐的伤口时会打开特写画面, 由你亲手用手术刀或剪刀切除坏死的边缘. 切得越干净, 之后缝合的效果越好, 疼痛也越轻.
关闭: 修剪为普通的计时动作, 与加入小游戏之前相同.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_UnconsciousEnable.en:
BETA - turn on at your own risk. Not yet tested in a multiplayer game. Reloading does not get you up - a character who was out is out again. It cannot trap anybody: after six hours down they come round whatever happened, and turning this off stands them up.

On: after losing about a third of their blood the character goes down and the screen goes dark - they cannot move or act, and they are helpless where they fell. Once the bleeding is stopped another survivor can bring them round, which buys an hour on their feet but does not put blood back; only a transfusion or time does that.
Bleed on past that and the heart can stop: then only chest compressions (which buy time) and a defibrillator (which starts it) help, and without them they die within half an hour.
Alone, they come round on their own once the bleeding has been stopped long enough. Still bleeding, they come to for a few minutes - time to put a bandage on; left open, the wound puts them under again.
Off: blood loss behaves exactly as it did before.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_UnconsciousEnable.ch:
測試版 - 開啟風險自負. 尚未在多人遊戲中測試. 重新讀檔無法讓你起身 - 昏迷中的角色讀檔後依然昏迷. 它不會讓任何人永遠困住: 倒地六小時後無論發生什麼都會醒來, 關閉此選項也會讓他們站起來.

開啟: 失去約三分之一的血液後, 角色會倒地且畫面變暗 - 無法移動或行動, 只能無助地躺在倒下的地方. 止血後, 其他倖存者可以將其喚醒, 讓他能再站起來行動一小時, 但不會補回血液; 只有輸血或時間能做到.
若繼續失血, 心臟可能停止跳動: 此時只有胸部按壓 (爭取時間) 與電擊器 (讓心臟重新跳動) 有用, 沒有這些, 角色會在半小時內死亡.
獨自一人時, 只要止血夠久就會自行甦醒. 若仍在流血, 會短暫清醒幾分鐘 - 足以包紮傷口; 傷口若不處理, 會再次讓他昏迷.
關閉: 失血的運作方式與以往完全相同.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_UnconsciousEnable.cn:
测试版 - 开启风险自负. 尚未在多人游戏中测试. 重新读档无法让你起身 - 昏迷中的角色读档后依然昏迷. 它不会把任何人永远困住: 倒地六小时后无论发生什么都会醒来, 关闭此选项也会让他们站起来.

开启: 失去约三分之一的血液后, 角色会倒地且屏幕变暗 - 无法移动或行动, 只能无助地躺在倒下的地方. 止血后, 其他幸存者可以将其唤醒, 让其能再站起来活动一小时, 但不会补回血液; 只有输血或时间能做到.
若继续失血, 心脏可能停止跳动: 此时只有胸外按压 (争取时间) 与除颤器 (让心脏重新跳动) 有用, 没有这些, 角色会在半小时内死亡.
独自一人时, 只要止血够久就会自行苏醒. 若仍在流血, 会短暂清醒几分钟 - 足以包扎伤口; 伤口若不处理, 会再次让其昏迷.
关闭: 失血机制与以往完全相同.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetRecipesUnlocked.ch: 解鎖所有獸醫照護配方
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetRecipesUnlocked.cn: 解锁所有兽医护理配方

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetRecipesUnlocked.en: Everyone starts out knowing every vet care recipe, no need for the mod's magazine.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetRecipesUnlocked.ch: 所有人一開始就會所有獸醫照護配方, 不需要閱讀本模組的雜誌.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetRecipesUnlocked.cn: 所有人一开始就掌握所有兽医护理配方, 无需阅读本模组的杂志.

Sandbox_NeatLockpicking_CrowbarExhaustio.en: Multiplier on endurance lost per crowbar swing. Default 0.5 (half of the old drain). 1.0 is the previous rate.
Sandbox_NeatLockpicking_CrowbarExhaustio.ch: 每次揮動撬棍所消耗耐力的倍率. 預設 0.5 (舊版消耗量的一半). 1.0 為先前的消耗速率.
Sandbox_NeatLockpicking_CrowbarExhaustio.cn: 每次挥动撬棍所消耗耐力的倍率. 默认 0.5 (旧版消耗量的一半). 1.0 为先前的消耗速率.

Sandbox_NeatLockpicking_PinResistanceEna.en: When on, pins bind after about 50% lift. The first pin in the sequence is stiffest. Off by default.
Sandbox_NeatLockpicking_PinResistanceEna.ch: 開啟後, 彈子頂起約 50%% 後就會卡住. 順序中的第一根彈子最緊. 預設關閉.
Sandbox_NeatLockpicking_PinResistanceEna.cn: 开启后, 弹子顶起约 50%% 后就会卡住. 顺序中的第一颗弹子最紧. 默认关闭.

Sandbox_BackcountryATV_EngineVolume_tool.en: How loud the quad's engine is, for everyone. 100 is normal, 0 is silent, 200 is twice as loud.
Sandbox_BackcountryATV_EngineVolume_tool.ch: 全地形車引擎的音量, 對所有人生效. 100 為正常, 0 為靜音, 200 為兩倍音量.
Sandbox_BackcountryATV_EngineVolume_tool.cn: 全地形越野车引擎的音量, 对所有人生效. 100 为正常, 0 为静音, 200 为两倍音量.

Sandbox_BackcountryATV_SpawnRate_tooltip.en: How often quads turn up on farms, ranger stations, logging sites and rural homes. Only areas you have not explored yet are affected. If you change it, restart the game before loading the world.
Sandbox_BackcountryATV_SpawnRate_tooltip.ch: 全地形車出現在農場、護林站、伐木場與鄉間住宅的頻率. 只會影響你尚未探索的區域. 若更改此設定, 請先重新啟動遊戲再載入世界.
Sandbox_BackcountryATV_SpawnRate_tooltip.cn: 全地形越野车出现在农场、护林站、伐木场和乡村住宅的频率. 只会影响你尚未探索的区域. 若更改此设置, 请先重启游戏再加载世界.

Sandbox_TheDarknessIsComing2_gasMaskDrai.en: [Hazardous Fog] Gas Mask Filter Drain Rate
Sandbox_TheDarknessIsComing2_gasMaskDrai.ch: [危險霧氣] 防毒面具濾芯消耗速率
Sandbox_TheDarknessIsComing2_gasMaskDrai.cn: [危险雾气] 防毒面具滤芯消耗速率

Sandbox_TheDarknessIsComing2_gasMaskDrai.en: Rate at which gas mask filters deplete in hazardous fog. Higher values drain faster. Min 0.01, Max 1.0
Sandbox_TheDarknessIsComing2_gasMaskDrai.ch: 危險霧氣中防毒面具濾芯的消耗速率. 數值越高, 消耗越快. 最小值 0.01, 最大值 1.0
Sandbox_TheDarknessIsComing2_gasMaskDrai.cn: 危险雾气中防毒面具滤芯的消耗速率. 数值越高, 消耗越快. 最小值 0.01, 最大值 1.0

Sandbox_DeadMagic_Ritual_quickening_Enab.en: Allows Quickening to start. Applies only to this ritual. Enabled by default. Disabling it keeps existing items and unlocks intact.
Sandbox_DeadMagic_Ritual_quickening_Enab.ch: 允許發動「催生」儀式. 僅影響此儀式. 預設啟用. 停用後, 既有的物品與解鎖進度仍會保留.
Sandbox_DeadMagic_Ritual_quickening_Enab.cn: 允许发动“催生”仪式. 仅影响此仪式. 默认启用. 禁用后, 已有的物品与解锁进度仍会保留.

Sandbox_PalmPilots_SpawnRate_tooltip.en: Controls new PalmPilot spawns in containers and on office-worker zombies. Original Behavior keeps the previous spawn rates. Other Loot set to None still prevents natural spawns.
Sandbox_PalmPilots_SpawnRate_tooltip.ch: 控制 PalmPilot 在容器內與辦公室上班族殭屍身上的新生成. 「原始行為」會維持先前的生成率. 若「物資」中的「其他」設為「無」, 仍然不會自然生成.
Sandbox_PalmPilots_SpawnRate_tooltip.cn: 控制 PalmPilot 在容器内和办公室职员僵尸身上的新生成. “原始行为”会保持之前的生成率. 若“物品”中的“其他”设为“无”, 仍然不会自然生成.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackNPCs_to.en:
Whether to allow loss of control events to attack NPCs.

Note that this also means aiming at NPCs within your attack range may trigger Attacking outburst.

If "Go To NPCs" is disabled, attacking is only possible if an NPC happens to be in your attack range.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackNPCs_to.ch:
是否允許失去控制事件攻擊 NPC.

注意: 這也代表在攻擊範圍內瞄準 NPC 時, 可能觸發攻擊發作.

若停用「前往 NPC」, 只有在 NPC 剛好位於你的攻擊範圍內時才可能攻擊.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackNPCs_to.cn:
是否允许失去控制事件攻击 NPC.

注意: 这也意味着在攻击范围内瞄准 NPC 时, 可能触发攻击发作.

若禁用“前往 NPC”, 只有在 NPC 恰好位于你的攻击范围内时才可能攻击.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_GoToNPCs_tool.en:
Whether to allow loss of control events to go to NPCs.

Enabling this forces "Attack NPCs" to be on, since otherwise you'll be stuck hugging an NPC during loss of control.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_GoToNPCs_tool.ch:
是否允許失去控制事件前往 NPC.

啟用此項會強制開啟「攻擊 NPC」, 否則失去控制時你會一直貼著 NPC 動彈不得.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_GoToNPCs_tool.cn:
是否允许失去控制事件前往 NPC.

启用此项会强制开启“攻击 NPC”, 否则失去控制时你会一直贴着 NPC 动弹不得.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkDist.en: Going this many tiles away from closest zombie may trigger Kill Blink.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkDist.ch: 離最近的殭屍這麼多格遠時, 可能觸發瞬殺閃現.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkDist.cn: 离最近的僵尸这么多格远时, 可能触发瞬杀闪现.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkForc.en: Kill Blink Force Aim Max Time
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkForc.ch: 瞬殺閃現強制瞄準最長時間
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkForc.cn: 瞬杀闪现强制瞄准最长时间

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkForc.en: Maximum time you'll be forced to aim after kill blink.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkForc.ch: 瞬殺閃現後你被強制瞄準的最長時間.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkForc.cn: 瞬杀闪现后你被强制瞄准的最长时间.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkForc.en: Kill Blink Force Aim Min Time
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkForc.ch: 瞬殺閃現強制瞄準最短時間
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkForc.cn: 瞬杀闪现强制瞄准最短时间

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkForc.en: Minimum time you'll be forced to aim after kill blink.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkForc.ch: 瞬殺閃現後你被強制瞄準的最短時間.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkForc.cn: 瞬杀闪现后你被强制瞄准的最短时间.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkKnoc.en: All zombies will be knocked down within tiles around you when Kill Blink happens.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkKnoc.ch: 發生瞬殺閃現時, 你周圍這麼多格內的所有殭屍都會被擊倒.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkKnoc.cn: 发生瞬杀闪现时, 你周围这么多格内的所有僵尸都会被击倒.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkLone.ch: 瞬殺閃現落單殭屍距離
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkLone.cn: 瞬杀闪现落单僵尸距离

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkLone.en: Kill blink target must have no other zombies within this many tiles.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkLone.ch: 瞬殺閃現的目標周圍這麼多格內必須沒有其他殭屍.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkLone.cn: 瞬杀闪现的目标周围这么多格内必须没有其他僵尸.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkMaxB.en: Bloodlust level at which max Kill Blink chance is reached.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkMaxB.ch: 達到最高瞬殺閃現機率的嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkMaxB.cn: 达到最高瞬杀闪现几率的嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkMaxC.en:
The chance for Kill Blink outburst to occur.

Tested every game minute, but only if you've gone at least "Kill Blink Distance Trigger" tiles away from closest zombie.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkMaxC.ch:
瞬殺閃現發作的發生機率.

每遊戲內分鐘判定一次, 但只在你距離最近的殭屍至少「瞬殺閃現觸發距離」格時才判定.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkMaxC.cn:
瞬杀闪现发作的发生几率.

每游戏内分钟判定一次, 但只在你距离最近的僵尸至少“瞬杀闪现触发距离”格时才判定.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkMinB.en: Bloodlust level above which Kill Blink may occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkMinB.ch: 嗜血值高於此值時才可能發生瞬殺閃現.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkMinB.cn: 嗜血值高于此值时才可能发生瞬杀闪现.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkMinZ.ch: 瞬殺閃現與殭屍最小距離
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkMinZ.cn: 瞬杀闪现与僵尸最小距离

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkMinZ.en: You must be at least this many tiles away from zombies for Kill Blink to be possible.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkMinZ.ch: 你必須距離殭屍至少這麼多格, 才可能發生瞬殺閃現.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkMinZ.cn: 你必须距离僵尸至少这么多格, 才可能发生瞬杀闪现.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkOutb.en: Whether it's possible for you to blink... and realize you just killed a zombie in a different place.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkOutb.ch: 你是否可能眨一下眼…就發現自己剛在別處殺了一隻殭屍.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkOutb.cn: 你是否可能眨一下眼…就发现自己刚在别处杀了一只僵尸.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkStar.en: For how long you'll be forced to stop and stare and the now dead zombie you just kill-blinked to.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkStar.ch: 你會被迫停下腳步, 盯著剛才瞬殺閃現擊殺的那隻殭屍屍體多久.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkStar.cn: 你会被迫停下脚步, 盯着刚才瞬杀闪现击杀的那只僵尸尸体多久.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkUnto.en: Kill Blink Untouchable Period After Stop
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkUnto.ch: 瞬殺閃現結束後無敵時間
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkUnto.cn: 瞬杀闪现结束后无敌时间

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkUnto.en: Once Kill Blink happens, for this many real seconds zombies will be unable to hit you.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkUnto.ch: 發生瞬殺閃現後, 這麼多現實秒數內殭屍無法擊中你.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_KillBlinkUnto.cn: 发生瞬杀闪现后, 这么多现实秒数内僵尸无法击中你.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxKillBlinkD.en: Maximum distance in tiles to kill blink target.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxKillBlinkD.ch: 瞬殺閃現目標的最大距離 (格).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxKillBlinkD.cn: 瞬杀闪现目标的最大距离 (格).

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinKillBlinkD.en: Minimum distance in tiles to kill blink target.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinKillBlinkD.ch: 瞬殺閃現目標的最小距離 (格).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinKillBlinkD.cn: 瞬杀闪现目标的最小距离 (格).

Sandbox_ItemSpawnBlocker_BlockRecipes_to.en: Master switch for recipe blocking. When off, no crafting recipes are blocked.
Sandbox_ItemSpawnBlocker_BlockRecipes_to.ch: 配方封鎖總開關. 關閉時不會封鎖任何製作配方.
Sandbox_ItemSpawnBlocker_BlockRecipes_to.cn: 配方屏蔽总开关. 关闭时不会屏蔽任何制作配方.

Sandbox_ItemSpawnBlocker_RecipeBlockList.en: Crafting recipes to remove, separated by ';' or ','. Each entry matches, case-insensitively and partially, against the recipe name, its category, or the result item ID. Examples: Forge (all forging), Blacksmithing, DisassembleFirearms, SheetMetal, Base.Axe.
Sandbox_ItemSpawnBlocker_RecipeBlockList.ch: 要移除的製作配方, 以 ';' 或 ',' 分隔. 每一筆都會以不分大小寫的部分比對方式對照配方名稱、配方分類或產物的物品 ID. 範例: Forge (所有鍛造配方), Blacksmithing, DisassembleFirearms, SheetMetal, Base.Axe.
Sandbox_ItemSpawnBlocker_RecipeBlockList.cn: 要移除的制作配方, 以 ';' 或 ',' 分隔. 每个条目都会以不区分大小写的部分匹配方式对照配方名称、配方分类或产物的物品 ID. 示例: Forge (所有锻造配方), Blacksmithing, DisassembleFirearms, SheetMetal, Base.Axe.

Sandbox_ModernFirearmsSystemSandboxGun_M.ch: MSR 模組化狙擊步槍生成機率 [7.62mm]
Sandbox_ModernFirearmsSystemSandboxGun_M.cn: MSR 模块化狙击步枪刷新几率 [7.62mm]

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_EnableDebugMode_.en: When enabled, activates all [SVRP_CB_DEBUG] log output and runs internal diagnostic tests on game boot (e.g. quiver container checks). Leave OFF during normal play. Enable only when diagnosing issues. (Default: Off)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_EnableDebugMode_.ch: 啟用後, 會開啟所有 [SVRP_CB_DEBUG] 記錄輸出, 並在遊戲啟動時執行內部診斷測試 (例如箭袋容器檢查). 一般遊玩時請保持關閉. 僅在診斷問題時啟用. (預設: 關閉)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_EnableDebugMode_.cn: 启用后, 会开启所有 [SVRP_CB_DEBUG] 日志输出, 并在游戏启动时运行内部诊断测试 (例如箭袋容器检查). 正常游玩时请保持关闭. 仅在诊断问题时启用. (默认: 关闭)

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_FixedAimingLevel.en: Minimum Aiming Skill for Hit Calculations
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_FixedAimingLevel.ch: 命中計算用最低瞄準等級
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_FixedAimingLevel.cn: 命中计算用最低瞄准等级

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_FixedAimingLevel.en: Sets a minimum Aiming skill level (0–10) used when calculating bow and crossbow accuracy. If your character's Aiming level is lower than this value, this value is used instead. Useful for server admins who want consistent accuracy regardless of skill. Set to 0 to disable (uses the character's actual level). (Default: 0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_FixedAimingLevel.ch: 設定弓與弩計算命中率時使用的最低瞄準等級 (0–10). 若角色的瞄準等級低於此值, 就改用這個數值. 適合想讓命中率不受技能影響、保持一致的伺服器管理員. 設為 0 即停用 (使用角色的實際等級). (預設: 0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_FixedAimingLevel.cn: 设置弓与弩计算命中率时使用的最低瞄准等级 (0–10). 如果角色的瞄准等级低于此值, 则改用该数值. 适合希望命中率不受技能影响、保持一致的服务器管理员. 设为 0 即禁用 (使用角色的实际等级). (默认: 0)

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_OnlyRecoverFromC.en: When enabled, arrows and bolts can only be recovered from zombie and animal corpses — they will not be dropped on the ground after missing or hitting the environment. Overrides the recovery chance for environmental hits. (Default: Off)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_OnlyRecoverFromC.ch: 啟用後, 箭矢與弩矢只能從殭屍和動物屍體上回收, 射失或打中環境後不會掉落在地上. 會覆蓋擊中環境時的回收機率設定. (預設: 關閉)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_OnlyRecoverFromC.cn: 启用后, 箭矢与弩矢只能从僵尸和动物尸体上回收, 射空或打中环境后不会掉落在地上. 会覆盖击中环境时的回收几率设置. (默认: 关闭)

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_RetroactiveSpawn.ch: 回溯戰利品生成 (既有存檔)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_RetroactiveSpawn.cn: 回溯战利品生成 (已有存档)

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_RetroactiveSpawn.en: When enabled, the server will inject Classic Bows loot into hunting stores, sporting goods areas, and gun containers that have already been generated but not yet looted. Turn this ON if you added this mod to an existing save game — it gives the world a chance to populate bows in areas you have not visited yet. Has no effect on areas you have already looted. (Default: Off)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_RetroactiveSpawn.ch: 啟用後, 伺服器會在已生成但尚未被搜刮的狩獵用品店、運動用品區與槍械容器中加入經典弓弩的戰利品. 如果你是在既有存檔中加入這個模組, 請開啟此項, 讓世界有機會在你尚未造訪的區域生成弓. 對你已搜刮過的區域沒有效果. (預設: 關閉)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_RetroactiveSpawn.cn: 启用后, 服务器会在已生成但尚未被搜刮的狩猎用品店、体育用品区和枪械容器中加入经典弓弩的战利品. 如果你是给已有存档添加这个模组, 请开启此项, 让世界有机会在你尚未到访的区域生成弓. 对你已搜刮过的区域没有效果. (默认: 关闭)

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AccumulatedBloodlustF.ch: 立即狂暴所需累積嗜血值
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AccumulatedBloodlustF.cn: 立即狂暴所需累积嗜血值

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AccumulatedBloodlustF.en:
Once you land a hit with this much bloodlust accumulated, you'll instantly enter frenzy regardless of your bloodiness.

Note that your current bloodlust level is added to this value.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AccumulatedBloodlustF.ch:
累積的嗜血值達到此數量後, 只要擊中目標, 不論沾血程度如何, 你都會立即進入狂暴.

注意: 你目前的嗜血值會加到此數值上.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AccumulatedBloodlustF.cn:
累积的嗜血值达到此数量后, 只要击中目标, 不论沾血程度如何, 你都会立即进入狂暴.

注意: 你当前的嗜血值会加到此数值上.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationBloodlustLi.en:
If "Meditation Bloodlust Per Minute" is negative, this is the minimum bloodlust below which meditating won't reduce bloodlust.
Otherwise, this is the maximum bloodlust above which meditating won't add bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationBloodlustLi.ch:
若「每分鐘冥想嗜血值」為負值, 此為最低嗜血值, 低於此值時冥想不再降低嗜血值.
否則此為最大嗜血值, 高於此值時冥想不再增加嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationBloodlustLi.cn:
若“每分钟冥想嗜血值”为负值, 此为最低嗜血值, 低于此值时冥想不再降低嗜血值.
否则此为最大嗜血值, 高于此值时冥想不再增加嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationBloodlustPe.en:
How much bloodlust to remove (negative) or add (positive) every game world minute while you're meditating.
Note that removing bloodlust counts as bloodlust accumulation* and will have consequences.

* Accumulated bloodlust is slightly different from suppressed bloodlust - it may cause you to instantly enter frenzy on hit.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationBloodlustPe.ch:
冥想時每遊戲內分鐘減少 (負值) 或增加 (正值) 的嗜血值.
注意, 減少嗜血值算是累積嗜血值*, 會有後果.

* 累積的嗜血值與被壓抑的嗜血值略有不同, 它可能讓你在擊中時立即進入狂暴.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationBloodlustPe.cn:
冥想时每游戏内分钟减少 (负值) 或增加 (正值) 的嗜血值.
注意, 减少嗜血值算是累积嗜血值*, 会有后果.

* 累积的嗜血值与被压抑的嗜血值略有不同, 它可能让你在击中时立即进入狂暴.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationKillCraving.ch: 冥想殺戮渴望嗜血值修正
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationKillCraving.cn: 冥想杀戮渴望嗜血值修正

Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationKillCraving.en:
Modifier for bloodlust increase due to kill craving while meditating.

0.0 means no bloodlust will increase during meditation.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationKillCraving.ch:
冥想時, 因殺戮渴望而增加嗜血值的修正值.

0.0 表示冥想期間嗜血值不會增加.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationKillCraving.cn:
冥想时, 因杀戮渴望而增加嗜血值的修正值.

0.0 表示冥想期间嗜血值不会增加.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_NPCBloodlustModifier_.en:
Bloodlust change from hitting and killing NPCs is multiplied by this.

3 means 3x the bloodlust you get from zombies.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_NPCBloodlustModifier_.ch:
擊中與擊殺 NPC 造成的嗜血值變化會乘以此數值.

3 表示是從殭屍獲得嗜血值的 3 倍.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_NPCBloodlustModifier_.cn:
击中和击杀 NPC 造成的嗜血值变化会乘以此数值.

3 表示是从僵尸获得嗜血值的 3 倍.

Sandbox_FcknStmpr_LootBetaCommon.en: Container Loot Multiplier: Store & Storage Items - Common
Sandbox_FcknStmpr_LootBetaCommon.ch: 容器掉落倍率: 商店與收納物品 - 常見
Sandbox_FcknStmpr_LootBetaCommon.cn: 容器掉落倍率: 商店与收纳物品 - 常见

Sandbox_FcknStmpr_LootBetaVRare.en: Container Loot Multiplier: Loose Items - Very Rare
Sandbox_FcknStmpr_LootBetaVRare.ch: 容器掉落倍率: 散落物品 - 非常稀有
Sandbox_FcknStmpr_LootBetaVRare.cn: 容器掉落倍率: 散落物品 - 非常稀有

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_EnableSpecificC.en: Adds a world right-click menu that lets you choose the exact Fishing Expansion fish or seafood item caught by your next successful fishing attempt. The selection clears after one catch.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_EnableSpecificC.ch: 加入一個世界右鍵選單, 讓你指定下一次成功釣魚時釣到的 Fishing Expansion 魚類或海鮮物品. 釣到一次後選擇即會清除.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_EnableSpecificC.cn: 添加一个世界右键菜单, 让你指定下一次成功钓鱼时钓到的 Fishing Expansion 鱼类或海鲜物品. 钓到一次后选择即会清除.

Sandbox_FcknStmpr_LootBetaCommon_tooltip.en: This is the loot multiplier for common spawns (default chance more than 1.000) for Frockin Stompers!, such as items that are spawning in commercial areas. Set the number to 0 to stop this category from spawning, set the number to 10 to have them appear in almost all containers.
Sandbox_FcknStmpr_LootBetaCommon_tooltip.ch: 這是 Frockin Stompers! 常見生成物品 (預設機率大於 1.000) 的掉落倍率, 例如在商業區生成的物品. 設為 0 可停止此類別生成, 設為 10 則幾乎所有容器都會出現.
Sandbox_FcknStmpr_LootBetaCommon_tooltip.cn: 这是 Frockin Stompers! 常见刷新物品 (默认概率大于 1.000) 的掉落倍率, 例如在商业区刷新的物品. 设为 0 可停止此类别刷新, 设为 10 则几乎所有容器都会出现.

Sandbox_FcknStmpr_LootBetaVRare_tooltip.en: This is the loot multiplier for very rare spawns (default chance 0.001-0.010) for Frockin Stompers!, such as loose items in residential and functional areas. Set the number to 0 to stop this category from spawning, set the number to 1000 to have them appear in almost all containers.
Sandbox_FcknStmpr_LootBetaVRare_tooltip.ch: 這是 Frockin Stompers! 非常稀有生成物品 (預設機率 0.001-0.010) 的掉落倍率, 例如住宅區與功能區中的散落物品. 設為 0 可停止此類別生成, 設為 1000 則幾乎所有容器都會出現.
Sandbox_FcknStmpr_LootBetaVRare_tooltip.cn: 这是 Frockin Stompers! 非常稀有刷新物品 (默认概率 0.001-0.010) 的掉落倍率, 例如住宅区和功能区中的散落物品. 设为 0 可停止此类别刷新, 设为 1000 则几乎所有容器都会出现.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixJamming_JamStartW.en: Wear is 1 minus remaining condition ratio. Default 0.30 means no custom jams at 70% condition or above. Must be lower than X2; invalid settings use defaults 0.30 / 0.90 / 2.5%.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixJamming_JamStartW.ch: 磨損 = 1 減去剩餘耐久度比例. 預設 0.30 表示耐久度在 70%% 以上時不會發生自訂卡彈. 必須低於 X2; 無效的設定會改用預設值 (0.30 / 0.90 / 2.5%%).
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixJamming_JamStartW.cn: 磨损 = 1 减去剩余耐久度比例. 默认 0.30 表示耐久度在 70%% 以上时不会发生自定义卡弹. 必须低于 X2; 无效的设置会改用默认值 (0.30 / 0.90 / 2.5%%).

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixJamming_MaximumJa.en: Maximum custom jam chance per shot. Default 2.5 means 2.5%, averaging one jam per 40 shots at maximum wear. 0 disables new custom jams. Applies to firearms except revolvers, pump-action shotguns and bolt-action weapons. Launchers are excluded.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixJamming_MaximumJa.ch: 每次射擊的自訂卡彈機率上限. 預設 2.5 表示 2.5%%, 在磨損最大時平均每 40 發卡彈一次. 0 會停用新的自訂卡彈. 適用於左輪手槍、泵動式霰彈槍與栓動式武器以外的槍械. 發射器不在此列.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixJamming_MaximumJa.cn: 每次射击的自定义卡弹概率上限. 默认 2.5 表示 2.5%%, 在磨损最大时平均每 40 发卡弹一次. 0 会禁用新的自定义卡弹. 适用于左轮手枪、泵动式霰弹枪和栓动式武器以外的枪械. 发射器不在此列.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixJamming_MaximumJa.en: Wear Ratio Where Maximum Jamming Is Reached (X2)
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixJamming_MaximumJa.ch: 達到最大卡彈的磨損比例 (X2)
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixJamming_MaximumJa.cn: 达到最大卡弹的磨损比例 (X2)

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixJamming_MaximumJa.en: Jam chance rises linearly between X1 and X2, then stays at the maximum. Default 0.90 means the maximum applies at 10% condition or below. Must be higher than X1.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixJamming_MaximumJa.ch: 卡彈機率在 X1 與 X2 之間線性上升, 之後維持在最大值. 預設 0.90 表示耐久度在 10%% 以下時套用最大值. 必須高於 X1.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixJamming_MaximumJa.cn: 卡弹概率在 X1 与 X2 之间线性上升, 之后保持在最大值. 默认 0.90 表示耐久度在 10%% 以下时应用最大值. 必须高于 X1.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_MindfulnessOneLossOfC.en:
Modifier for loss of control chances and progression
while "Mindfulness" moodle from Lifestyles: Hobbies is at level 1.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MindfulnessOneLossOfC.ch:
Lifestyles: Hobbies 的「正念」狀態處於第 1 級時,
失控機率與進程的修正.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MindfulnessOneLossOfC.cn:
Lifestyles: Hobbies 的“正念”状态处于第 1 级时,

Sandbox_BloodlustO_MindfulnessOnePhrases.ch: 正念 1: 喊叫機率修正
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MindfulnessOnePhrases.cn: 正念 1: 喊叫几率修正

Sandbox_BloodlustO_MindfulnessOnePhrases.cn:

你的角色在嗜血行动 (例如秒杀) 时喊叫几率的修正.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_MindfulnessTwoPhrases.cn: 正念 2: 喊叫几率修正

Sandbox_RNPC_FactionsRelocate_tooltip.en: A faction leaves a seat that keeps costing it people and settles somewhere else.
Sandbox_RNPC_FactionsRelocate_tooltip.ch: 陣營會離開不斷折損人手的據點, 改到別處落腳.
Sandbox_RNPC_FactionsRelocate_tooltip.cn: 派系会离开不断折损人手的据点, 改到别处落脚.

Sandbox_RNPC_SeatAsk.en: Players can ask factions to move

Sandbox_RNPC_SeatAsk_tooltip.en: A player whose base is next to a faction seat can ask them to leave. It costs.
Sandbox_RNPC_SeatAsk_tooltip.ch: 基地緊鄰陣營據點的玩家可以要求他們離開. 這需要付出代價.
Sandbox_RNPC_SeatAsk_tooltip.cn: 基地紧邻派系据点的玩家可以要求他们离开. 这需要付出代价.

Sandbox_RNPC_SeatGap.ch: 據點與玩家基地的距離
Sandbox_RNPC_SeatGap.cn: 据点与玩家基地的距离

Sandbox_RNPC_SeatGap_tooltip.en: Factions settle at least this far from a player base when they can. 0 is off.
Sandbox_RNPC_SeatGap_tooltip.ch: 可行時, 陣營會在距離玩家基地至少這麼遠的地方落腳. 0 為關閉.
Sandbox_RNPC_SeatGap_tooltip.cn: 可行时, 派系会在距离玩家基地至少这么远的地方落脚. 0 为关闭.

Sandbox_PhunMart_MarkShopsOnMap.en: Mark visited machines on the map
Sandbox_PhunMart_MarkShopsOnMap.ch: 在地圖上標記造訪過的機台
Sandbox_PhunMart_MarkShopsOnMap.cn: 在地图上标记访问过的机器

Sandbox_PhunMart_MarkShopsOnMap_option2.en: Only with a pen or pencil
Sandbox_PhunMart_MarkShopsOnMap_option2.ch: 僅限持有原子筆或鉛筆

Sandbox_PhunMart_MarkShopsOnMap_option3.ch: 一律標記, 不需書寫工具
Sandbox_PhunMart_MarkShopsOnMap_option3.cn: 始终标记, 无需书写工具

Sandbox_PhunMart_MarkShopsOnMap_tooltip.en: The first time a player opens a machine, it is marked with a dollar sign on their own world map. Each machine is marked once per character, so a mark the player deletes stays deleted. Players can also turn marks off for themselves under Options > Mods.
Sandbox_PhunMart_MarkShopsOnMap_tooltip.ch: 玩家第一次開啟某台機台時, 會在其自己的世界地圖上以美元符號標記. 每台機台對每個角色只標記一次, 因此玩家刪除的標記不會再出現. 玩家也可以在 選項 > 模組 中為自己關閉標記.
