Sandbox_PhunMart_MarkShopsOnMap_tooltip.cn: 玩家第一次打开某台机器时, 会在其自己的世界地图上以美元符号标记. 每台机器对每个角色只标记一次, 因此玩家删除的标记不会再出现. 玩家也可以在 选项 > 模组 中为自己关闭标记.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_BuildingPlumbCostPerF.ch: 每個用水裝置的鐵管數
Sandbox_WaterPipes_BuildingPlumbCostPerF.cn: 每个用水设备的金属管数

Sandbox_WaterPipes_BuildingPlumbCostPerF.en: Metal pipes each fixture costs when plumbing a whole building. 1 = one pipe per sink, toilet or washer connected, however far the pipe has to run to reach it. 0 = free. Pipe laid this way gives nothing back when dismantled.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_BuildingPlumbCostPerF.ch: 為整棟建築接通水管時, 每個用水裝置消耗的鐵管數. 1 = 每接通一個水槽, 馬桶或洗衣機消耗一根鐵管, 不論水管要鋪多遠才能到達. 0 = 免費. 以此方式鋪設的水管拆除時不會返還任何材料.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_BuildingPlumbCostPerF.cn: 为整栋建筑接通水管时, 每个用水设备消耗的金属管数. 1 = 每接通一个水槽, 马桶或洗衣机消耗一根金属管, 不论水管要铺多远才能到达. 0 = 免费. 以此方式铺设的水管拆除时不会返还任何材料.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PurifierHeadTransfer_.en: How much of the pressure arriving at a purifier's dirty side reaches its clean side, as a percentage. A purifier is two tanks with a filter between them, so it cannot carry pressure the way a pipe does. 60 = default: town mains at 25 leave 15 behind the purifier, enough for taps and drips at full rate but not for a sprinkler without a pump. 100 makes the purifier transparent to pressure. 0 gives the clean side only a container's own base pressure.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PurifierHeadTransfer_.ch: 抵達淨水器髒水側的壓力有多少能傳到淨水側, 以百分比表示. 淨水器是兩個水槽中間夾著濾芯, 因此無法像水管那樣傳遞壓力. 60 = 預設: 城鎮供水壓力 25 經過淨水器後剩下 15, 足以讓水龍頭和滴灌頭全速運作, 但沒有水泵時不足以帶動灑水器. 100 則讓淨水器完全不影響壓力. 0 則讓淨水側只有容器本身的基礎壓力.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PurifierHeadTransfer_.cn: 抵达净水器脏水侧的压力有多少能传到净水侧, 以百分比表示. 净水器是两个水槽中间夹着滤芯, 因此无法像水管那样传递压力. 60 = 默认: 城镇供水压力 25 经过净水器后剩下 15, 足以让水龙头和滴灌头全速运作, 但没有水泵时不足以带动洒水器. 100 则让净水器完全不影响压力. 0 则让净水侧只有容器本身的基础压力.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationUnsuppressB.ch: 冥想解除壓抑嗜血值修正值
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationUnsuppressB.cn: 冥想解除压抑嗜血值修正值

Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationUnsuppressB.en:
Bloodlust reduced from meditation is used up this much to remove suppressed bloodlust instead of reducing your current bloodlust.

0.3 means 30%% of bloodlust change is used up.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationUnsuppressB.ch:
冥想所減少的嗜血值中, 有此比例會用來消除壓抑的嗜血值, 而不是減少你目前的嗜血值.

0.3 表示 30%% 的嗜血值變化會被用掉.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_MeditationUnsuppressB.cn:
冥想所减少的嗜血值中, 有此比例会用来消除压抑的嗜血值, 而不是减少你当前的嗜血值.

0.3 表示 30%% 的嗜血值变化会被用掉.

Sandbox_PhunMart_ChanceForTillChange.en: Chance for a till to hold change
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChanceForTillChange.ch: 收銀機存有零錢的機率
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChanceForTillChange.cn: 收银机存有零钱的概率

Sandbox_PhunMart_ChanceForTillChange_too.en: The probability that a cash register holds change when its loot first spawns. It arrives in the same form as zombie drops: loose coins, or a single Change item for the other two settings, since a till has nobody to credit.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChanceForTillChange_too.ch: 收銀機首次生成戰利品時存有零錢的機率. 零錢的形式與殭屍掉落相同: 散落硬幣, 或在另外兩種設定下為單一零錢物品, 因為收銀機沒有可入帳的對象.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChanceForTillChange_too.cn: 收银机首次生成战利品时存有零钱的概率. 零钱的形式与僵尸掉落相同: 散落硬币, 或在另外两种设置下为单个零钱物品, 因为收银机没有可入账的对象.

Sandbox_PhunMart_MaxTillChange_tooltip.en: The maximum number of cents a cash register can hold.
Sandbox_PhunMart_MaxTillChange_tooltip.ch: 收銀機最多可存放的美分數量.
Sandbox_PhunMart_MaxTillChange_tooltip.cn: 收银机最多可存放的美分数量.

Sandbox_PhunMart_MinTillChange_tooltip.en: The minimum number of cents a cash register can hold.
Sandbox_PhunMart_MinTillChange_tooltip.ch: 收銀機最少可存放的美分數量.
Sandbox_PhunMart_MinTillChange_tooltip.cn: 收银机最少可存放的美分数量.

Sandbox_GridInventory_ContainerBonusRows.en:
Adds extra rows vertically to all world containers and subgrids (drawers, shelves, compartments). Width (columns) remains intact to preserve proper layout proportions.

0 (default) keeps the mod's calibrated layouts.
Sandbox_GridInventory_ContainerBonusRows.ch:
為所有世界容器與子網格 (抽屜, 貨架, 隔間) 垂直增加額外列數. 寬度 (欄數) 維持不變, 以保持正確的版面比例.

0 (預設) 會保留模組校準過的版面配置.
Sandbox_GridInventory_ContainerBonusRows.cn:
为所有世界容器与子网格 (抽屉, 货架, 隔间) 纵向增加额外行数. 宽度 (列数) 保持不变, 以保持正确的布局比例.

0 (默认) 会保留模组校准过的布局.

Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnUmbrella.ch: 生成安布雷拉公司口糧

Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnUmbrella_tooltip.en: Allow Umbrella Corporation themed MRE kits and the collection box to appear in loot.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnUmbrella_tooltip.ch: 允許安布雷拉公司主題的 MRE 口糧包與合集盒出現在物資中.
Sandbox_MGsMRE_SpawnUmbrella_tooltip.cn: 允许保护伞公司主题的 MRE 口粮包与合集盒出现在物资中.

Sandbox_KnoxGPS_AllowVehicleMarks_toolti.en: Let players see on their map and minimap where they left each vehicle, and route back to it. ON by default. Turning it OFF hides the marks for everyone on the server, whatever each player has set in their own mod options.
Sandbox_KnoxGPS_AllowVehicleMarks_toolti.ch: 讓玩家在地圖與小地圖上看到自己把每輛車停在哪裡, 並可規劃路線返回. 預設開啟. 關閉後, 伺服器上所有人都看不到這些標記, 無論每位玩家在自己的模組選項中如何設定.
Sandbox_KnoxGPS_AllowVehicleMarks_toolti.cn: 让玩家在地图和小地图上看到自己把每辆车停在哪里, 并可规划路线返回. 默认开启. 关闭后, 服务器上所有人都看不到这些标记, 无论每位玩家在自己的模组选项中如何设置.

Sandbox_KnoxGPS_AllowVisitedMarks_toolti.en: Let players mark on their map every building they have entered. ON by default. Turning it OFF hides the marks for everyone on the server, whatever each player has set in their own mod options.
Sandbox_KnoxGPS_AllowVisitedMarks_toolti.ch: 讓玩家在地圖上標記自己進入過的每棟建築. 預設開啟. 關閉後, 伺服器上所有人都看不到這些標記, 無論每位玩家在自己的模組選項中如何設定.
Sandbox_KnoxGPS_AllowVisitedMarks_toolti.cn: 让玩家在地图上标记自己进入过的每栋建筑. 默认开启. 关闭后, 服务器上所有人都看不到这些标记, 无论每位玩家在自己的模组选项中如何设置.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesAdoptCap.ch: 持續遭遇團體上限 (團體數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesAdoptCap.cn: 持续遭遇群体上限 (群体数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesAdoptCap_.en:
Caps encounter crews kept travelling while you are away; they share the distant-group limit. Extra crews may continue while you are near, then leave the world as before.
Default 6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesAdoptCap_.ch:
限制你不在附近時仍持續移動的遭遇隊伍數量; 它們計入遠方漫遊團體上限. 你在附近時, 超出上限的隊伍可以繼續活動, 之後照舊離開世界.
預設: 6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesAdoptCap_.cn:
限制你不在附近时仍持续移动的遭遇队伍数量; 它们计入远方漫游团体上限. 你在附近时, 超出上限的队伍可以继续活动, 之后照旧离开世界.
默认: 6.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseChanc.en:
Chance that each eligible crew founds a base, checked once per game day.
Default 25.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseChanc.ch:
每支符合條件的隊伍建立基地的機率, 遊戲內每天檢查一次.
預設: 25.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseChanc.cn:
每支符合条件的队伍建立基地的概率, 游戏内每天检查一次.
默认: 25.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseClear.en: New NPC base distance from players (tiles)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseClear.ch: 新NPC基地與玩家的距離 (格)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseClear.cn: 新NPC基地与玩家的距离 (格)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseClear.en:
Minimum distance from any player when an NPC crew founds a base.
Default 45.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseClear.ch:
NPC隊伍建立基地時, 與任何玩家之間的最短距離.
預設: 45.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseClear.cn:
NPC队伍建立基地时, 与任何玩家之间的最短距离.
默认: 45.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseRetur.en: NPC trip length before returning home (game hours)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseRetur.ch: NPC返家前的外出時間 (遊戲內小時)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseRetur.cn: NPC返家前的外出时间 (游戏内小时)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseRetur.en:
Time a crew with a base spends away before planning a return home.
Default 8.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseRetur.ch:
有基地的隊伍在外多久之後, 才會計畫返家.
預設: 8.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBaseRetur.cn:
有基地的队伍在外多久之后, 才会计划返家.
默认: 8.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBases_too.en:
Crews of two or more may settle in an empty building away from players, store their loot and return after trips.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBases_too.ch:
兩人以上的隊伍可能在遠離玩家的空建築中定居, 存放戰利品, 並在外出後返回.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesBases_too.cn:
两人以上的队伍可能在远离玩家的空建筑中定居, 存放战利品, 并在外出后返回.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesEnabled_t.en:
Crews can move on after an encounter, such as fixing a car then scavenging from it. Distant groups plan around supplies. Off: crews keep their earlier behavior.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesEnabled_t.ch:
遭遇結束後, 隊伍可以接著做下一件事, 例如修好車子再從車上搜刮. 遠方團體會依物資狀況擬定計畫. 關閉: 隊伍維持先前的行為.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesEnabled_t.cn:
遭遇结束后, 队伍可以接着做下一件事, 例如修好汽车再从车上搜刮. 远方群体会根据物资状况制定计划. 关闭: 队伍保持之前的行为.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFishYield.en:
Scales fish caught by NPC crews. 100 keeps the usual catch; 0 gives no fish and 200 gives twice the usual catch.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFishYield.ch:
調整NPC隊伍釣到的魚量. 100維持一般漁獲; 0釣不到魚, 200則為一般漁獲的兩倍.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFishYield.cn:
调整NPC队伍钓到的鱼量. 100保持一般渔获; 0钓不到鱼, 200则为一般渔获的两倍.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFishingMi.ch: NPC平均每次釣魚時間 (遊戲內分鐘)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFishingMi.cn: NPC平均每次钓鱼时间 (游戏内分钟)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFishingMi.en:
Sessions last 60-140 percent of this time. Fishers stop if noticed by a player, hostile or zombie, or after gunfire or a hit.
Default 65.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFishingMi.ch:
每次釣魚持續此時間的百分之60到140. 若被玩家, 敵對者或殭屍發現, 或是聽到槍聲, 遭到攻擊, 釣魚者就會停止.
預設: 65.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFishingMi.cn:
每次钓鱼持续该时间的百分之60到140. 若被玩家, 敌对者或僵尸发现, 或是听到枪声, 遭到攻击, 钓鱼者就会停止.
默认: 65.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFishing_t.en:
Allows NPC crews to fish near water without reducing the fish available to players.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFishing_t.ch:
允許NPC隊伍在水邊釣魚, 不會減少玩家可釣到的魚.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFishing_t.cn:
允许NPC队伍在水边钓鱼, 不会减少玩家可钓到的鱼.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFixedCarD.ch: 遭遇中修好的車可駕駛
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFixedCarD.cn: 遭遇中修好的车可驾驶

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFixedCarD.en:
On: repaired cars have working engines, batteries, bonnets and some fuel, and remain with their trunk loot. Off: the car stays a wreck but remains the crew's stash.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFixedCarD.ch:
開啟: 修好的車有可用的引擎, 電池, 引擎蓋與少量燃料, 行李箱裡的戰利品也會保留. 關閉: 車子仍是殘骸, 但依然是隊伍的藏匿處.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFixedCarD.cn:
开启: 修好的车有可用的引擎, 电池, 引擎盖和少量燃料, 行李箱里的战利品也会保留. 关闭: 车辆仍是残骸, 但依然是队伍的藏匿处.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFixedCarF.en: Repaired encounter car fuel (percent of tank)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFixedCarF.ch: 遭遇修好車輛的油量 (油箱百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFixedCarF.cn: 遭遇修好车辆的油量 (油箱百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFixedCarF.en:
Sets how full a repaired car's fuel tank is. For example, 25 gives it a quarter tank.
Default 15.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFixedCarF.ch:
設定修好的車油箱有多滿. 例如25表示四分之一箱油.
預設: 15.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesFixedCarF.cn:
设置修好的车油箱有多满. 例如25表示四分之一箱油.
默认: 15.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesForageYie.ch: NPC搜尋產量 (正常值百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesForageYie.cn: NPC搜寻产量 (正常值百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesForageYie.en:
Scales food foraged per crew per game day. 100 gives six items, 200 gives twelve and 0 gives none.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesForageYie.ch:
調整每支隊伍在遊戲內每天搜尋到的食物量. 100為六件, 200為十二件, 0則沒有.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesForageYie.cn:
调整每支队伍在游戏内每天搜寻到的食物量. 100为六件, 200为十二件, 0则没有.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesForaging_.en:
Foraging crews bring seasonal berries, herbs, nuts and mushrooms to their camp stash. This does not reduce what players can forage.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesForaging_.ch:
搜尋隊伍會把當季的漿果, 香草, 堅果與蘑菇帶回營地的藏匿處. 這不會減少玩家可搜尋到的東西.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesForaging_.cn:
搜寻队伍会把当季的浆果, 香草, 坚果与蘑菇带回营地的藏匿处. 这不会减少玩家可搜寻到的东西.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesHuntYield.en: NPC hunting food yield (percent of normal)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesHuntYield.ch: NPC狩獵食物產量 (正常值百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesHuntYield.cn: NPC狩猎食物产量 (正常值百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesHuntYield.en:
Scales food gained from NPC hunts. 100 keeps the usual amount; 0 gives no food and 200 gives twice the usual amount.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesHuntYield.ch:
調整NPC狩獵獲得的食物量. 100維持一般數量; 0不會獲得食物, 200則為一般數量的兩倍.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesHuntYield.cn:
调整NPC狩猎获得的食物量. 100保持一般数量; 0不会获得食物, 200则为一般数量的两倍.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesHunting_t.en:
Allows armed NPC crews to hunt. Offline only allows hunting away from players and leaves nearby wildlife to you.
Default Offline and nearby wildlife (3).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesHunting_t.ch:
允許武裝NPC隊伍狩獵. 「僅限離線」只允許在遠離玩家處狩獵, 附近的野生動物留給你.
預設: 離線與附近野生動物 (3).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesHunting_t.cn:
允许武装NPC队伍狩猎. “仅限离线”只允许在远离玩家处狩猎, 附近的野生动物留给你.
默认: 离线与附近野生动物 (3).

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesMaxBases_.en:
Caps settled NPC bases across the world. If the limit is exceeded, the oldest base is abandoned. At 0, crews cannot found new bases.
Default 6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesMaxBases_.ch:
限制全世界NPC定居基地的數量. 超出上限時, 最舊的基地會被放棄. 設為0時, 隊伍無法建立新基地.
預設: 6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesMaxBases_.cn:
限制全世界NPC定居基地的数量. 超出上限时, 最旧的基地会被放弃. 设为0时, 队伍无法建立新基地.
默认: 6.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesNeedsDrai.ch: NPC物資消耗 (正常值百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesNeedsDrai.cn: NPC物资消耗 (正常值百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesNeedsDrai.en:
Scales how quickly groups become hungry and thirsty. Higher values cause more supply runs and more chances to encounter you.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesNeedsDrai.ch:
調整團體變得飢餓與口渴的速度. 數值越高, 外出補給的次數越多, 與你遭遇的機會也越多.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesNeedsDrai.cn:
调整群体变得饥饿与口渴的速度. 数值越高, 外出补给的次数越多, 与你遭遇的机会也越多.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesPartyWeig.ch: 活動遭遇頻率 (正常值百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesPartyWeig.cn: 活动遭遇频率 (正常值百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesPartyWeig.en:
Scales encounters with fishers, hunters, foragers, woodcutters, camp builders, scavengers and water carriers. 100 keeps the usual rate; 0 disables these encounters.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesPartyWeig.ch:
調整遇到釣魚者, 獵人, 搜尋者, 伐木工, 營地搭建者, 拾荒者與運水者的頻率. 100維持一般頻率; 0會停用這些遭遇.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesPartyWeig.cn:
调整遇到钓鱼者, 猎人, 搜寻者, 伐木工, 营地搭建者, 拾荒者与运水者的频率. 100保持一般频率; 0会禁用这些遭遇.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchCha.ch: 遭遇結束後轉往他處的比例 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchCha.cn: 遭遇结束后转往别处的比例 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchCha.en:
Sets the share of finished encounters whose crews take up another activity. The rest keep their post and later leave as before; higher values put more crews on roads.
Default 70.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchCha.ch:
設定遭遇結束後, 隊伍轉而從事其他活動的比例. 其餘隊伍會留守原位, 之後照舊離開; 數值越高, 路上的隊伍越多.
預設: 70.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchCha.cn:
设置遭遇结束后, 队伍转而从事其他活动的比例. 其余队伍会留守原位, 之后照旧离开; 数值越高, 路上的队伍越多.
默认: 70.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchCle.ch: 允許棄車的玩家距離 (格)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchCle.cn: 允许弃车的玩家距离 (格)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchCle.en:
A crew cannot abandon its car while any player is closer than this distance. For example, 80 keeps it at the car while you are within 80 tiles.
Default 60.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchCle.ch:
只要有任何玩家比此距離更近, 隊伍就不能棄車. 例如設為80時, 只要你在80格內, 隊伍就會留在車旁.
預設: 60.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchCle.cn:
只要有任何玩家比该距离更近, 队伍就不能弃车. 例如设为80时, 只要你在80格内, 队伍就会留在车旁.
默认: 60.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchHou.en: Wait before abandoning a car (game hours)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchHou.ch: 棄車前等待時間 (遊戲內小時)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchHou.cn: 弃车前等待时间 (游戏内小时)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchHou.en:
A crew stuck at a broken or crashed car this long may leave it and go scavenging, but only when no player is nearby.
Default 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchHou.ch:
隊伍困在故障或撞毀的車旁達此時間後, 可能棄車去搜刮, 但僅限附近沒有玩家時.
預設: 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ActivitiesSwitchHou.cn:
队伍困在故障或撞毁的车旁达到该时间后, 可能弃车去搜刮, 但仅限附近没有玩家时.
默认: 10.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.AimPlayerPercent_to.en: Global multiplier on how often NPC gunfire hits players, applied on top of the NPC aim setting and each character's own accuracy. 100 is unchanged. NPCs also aim worse in the first seconds of a fight, at long range and against a moving target.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AimPlayerPercent_to.ch: NPC射擊命中玩家頻率的全域倍率, 疊加在「NPC對玩家的射擊準確度」設定與每個角色自身的準確度之上. 100為不變. NPC在交戰最初幾秒, 遠距離及面對移動目標時, 瞄準也會變差.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AimPlayerPercent_to.cn: NPC射击命中玩家频率的全局倍率, 叠加在“NPC对玩家的射击准确度”设置和每个角色自身的准确度之上. 100为不变. NPC在交战最初几秒, 远距离以及面对移动目标时, 瞄准也会变差.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.AppearanceKeepAutho.ch: 保留原設定長相 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AppearanceKeepAutho.cn: 保留原设计长相 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.AppearanceKeepAutho.en:
Share of new people who keep their authored face, so named characters stay recognisable. 0 varies everyone, 100 varies nobody. Needs Varied NPC looks on.
Default 35.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AppearanceKeepAutho.ch:
新生成的人中保留原設定長相的比例, 讓有名有姓的角色仍認得出來. 0表示所有人都會變化, 100表示沒有人會變化. 需開啟「NPC外觀多樣化」.
預設: 35.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AppearanceKeepAutho.cn:
新生成的人中保留原设计长相的比例, 让有名有姓的角色仍能被认出. 0表示所有人都会变化, 100表示没有人会变化. 需开启“NPC外观多样化”.
默认: 35.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.AppearanceLoadoutVa.ch: [專家] 每人各選替代武器
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AppearanceLoadoutVa.cn: [专家] 每人各选替代武器

Sandbox_ProjectALife.AppearanceLoadoutVa.en: People whose profile lists several weapons for one slot pick one of them per person. Off always uses the first listed weapon. Profiles with a single weapon are unaffected. Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AppearanceLoadoutVa.ch: 若設定檔在同一欄位列出多把武器, 每個人會從中各選一把. 關閉則一律使用列出的第一把武器. 只有單一武器的設定檔不受影響. 預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AppearanceLoadoutVa.cn: 若档案在同一槽位列出多把武器, 每个人会从中各选一把. 关闭则始终使用列出的第一把武器. 只有单一武器的档案不受影响. 默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.AppearanceVariation.en:
Each new person gets their own hair, hair colour, beard and clothing colours, so crews stop looking cloned. Off keeps the authored look. People already in a save keep theirs.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AppearanceVariation.ch:
每個新生成的人都會有自己的髮型, 髮色, 鬍子和服裝顏色, 讓隊伍成員不再像複製人. 關閉則保留原設定的外觀. 存檔中已存在的人維持原樣.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AppearanceVariation.cn:
每个新生成的人都会有自己的发型, 发色, 胡子和服装颜色, 让队伍成员不再像复制人. 关闭则保留原设计的外观. 存档中已有的人保持原样.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ArmingPace.ch: 平民槍械普及速度 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ArmingPace.cn: 平民枪械普及速度 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ArmingPace_tooltip.en:
Sets how quickly built-in civilian groups gain guns over time. At 200, guns spread twice as fast; at 50, half as fast. Police, army and elite units are unaffected.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ArmingPace_tooltip.ch:
設定內建平民團體隨時間取得槍械的速度. 設為200時, 槍械普及速度為兩倍; 設為50時為一半. 警察, 軍隊與精銳部隊不受影響.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ArmingPace_tooltip.cn:
设置内置平民团体随时间获得枪械的速度. 设为200时, 枪械普及速度翻倍; 设为50时减半. 警察, 军队与精锐部队不受影响.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ArmingShare_tooltip.en:
Scales gun ownership among built-in non-military NPCs. At 0, affected NPCs use melee tools only. Police, army, elite units and Creator profiles are unchanged.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ArmingShare_tooltip.ch:
調整內建非軍事NPC的持槍比例. 設為0時, 受影響的NPC只使用近戰工具. 警察, 軍隊, 精銳部隊與編輯器設定檔不受影響.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ArmingShare_tooltip.cn:
调整内置非军事NPC的持枪比例. 设为0时, 受影响的NPC只使用近战工具. 警察, 军队, 精锐部队与编辑器档案不受影响.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BiteLoudness.ch: NPC啃咬與痛苦音量 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BiteLoudness.cn: NPC啃咬与痛苦音量 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BiteLoudness_toolti.en:
Sets the volume of zombie bites, being-eaten voices and NPC pain cries. Sounds fade with distance and are heard only within 25 tiles. At 0, they are muted.
Default 40.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BiteLoudness_toolti.ch:
設定殭屍啃咬, 被啃食叫聲與NPC痛苦叫聲的音量. 聲音會隨距離減弱, 只在25格內聽得到. 設為0時靜音.
預設: 40.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BiteLoudness_toolti.cn:
设置僵尸啃咬, 被啃食叫声与NPC痛苦叫声的音量. 声音会随距离减弱, 只在25格内听得到. 设为0时静音.
默认: 40.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BlameFair_tooltip.en:
With multiple players, outpost theft blames those inside the outpost rather than everyone. A manhunt keeps its named target instead of switching to the nearest player.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BlameFair_tooltip.ch:
有多名玩家時, 前哨站失竊只會怪罪在前哨站內的人, 而不是所有人. 追殺會鎖定指名的目標, 不會改追最近的玩家.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BlameFair_tooltip.cn:
有多名玩家时, 哨所失窃只会归咎于在哨所内的人, 而不是所有人. 追杀会锁定指名的目标, 不会改追最近的玩家.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodEnabled_toolti.en:
Adds floor splatter, bleeding drips and death pools, respecting the game's blood settings. Off: only the game's ordinary splatter and body stains remain.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodEnabled_toolti.ch:
新增地面噴濺血跡, 流血滴落與死亡血泊, 並遵循遊戲的血液設定. 關閉: 只保留遊戲原本的一般噴濺與身體血漬.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodEnabled_toolti.cn:
添加地面喷溅血迹, 流血滴落和死亡血泊, 并遵循游戏的血液设置. 关闭: 只保留游戏原本的普通喷溅和身体血渍.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodMeleeKillPerce.en: [Expert] NPC blood when killed in melee (%%)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodMeleeKillPerce.ch: [專家] NPC遭近戰擊殺時的血跡 (%%)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodMeleeKillPerce.cn: [专家] NPC被近战击杀时的血迹 (%%)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodMeleeKillPerce.en: Size of the blood pool when an NPC is killed with a blade, bat or other melee weapon, and the blood on the attacker. Only used while the NPC blood amount is above 100%%. Default 300%%.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodMeleeKillPerce.ch: NPC遭刀刃, 球棒或其他近戰武器擊殺時的血泊大小, 以及攻擊者身上沾到的血. 僅在NPC血跡量高於100%%時使用. 預設: 300%%
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodMeleeKillPerce.cn: NPC被刀刃, 球棒或其他近战武器击杀时的血泊大小, 以及攻击者身上沾到的血. 仅在NPC血迹量高于100%%时使用. 默认: 300%%

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodPercent_toolti.en:
Scales floor splatter, body stains, drips and pools from non-melee deaths. At 100, only the earlier body-stain behavior remains.
Default 200.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodPercent_toolti.ch:
調整非近戰死亡造成的地面噴濺, 身體血漬, 滴落血跡與血泊的量. 設為100時, 只保留先前的身體血漬行為.
預設: 200.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodPercent_toolti.cn:
调整非近战死亡造成的地面喷溅, 身体血渍, 滴落血迹和血泊的量. 设为100时, 只保留之前的身体血渍行为.
默认: 200.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BluntFracture.ch: [專家] 重型鈍器骨折機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BluntFracture.cn: [专家] 重型钝器骨折概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BluntFracture_toolt.en: Chance that an NPC's hit with a heavy blunt weapon (bat, sledgehammer) breaks the player's arm or leg it lands on. Blunt weapons never cut: a laceration becomes a scratch.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BluntFracture_toolt.ch: NPC以重型鈍器 (球棒, 大錘) 擊中玩家時, 打斷被擊中手臂或腿部的機率. 鈍器不會造成撕裂傷: 撕裂傷會改為刮傷.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BluntFracture_toolt.cn: NPC用重型钝器 (球棒, 大锤) 击中玩家时, 打断被击中手臂或腿部的概率. 钝器不会造成撕裂伤: 撕裂伤会改为刮伤.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BoardingStaged_tool.en:
Outposts start with one or two ground-floor planks, adding more every four game days while players stay over 40 tiles away. Upstairs gets sheets; metal bars stay unchanged.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BoardingStaged_tool.ch:
前哨站一開始只在一樓釘一兩塊木板, 在玩家保持40格以上距離時, 每4個遊戲內天數再多釘一些. 樓上改掛床單; 金屬欄杆維持不變.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BoardingStaged_tool.cn:
哨所一开始只在一楼钉一两块木板, 在玩家保持40格以上距离时, 每4个游戏内天数再多钉一些. 楼上改挂窗帘布; 金属栏杆保持不变.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BodyLootEnabled_too.en:
After fights, NPCs near players loot bodies when no danger is within 15 tiles, taking supplies and useful gear. Player bodies and former player companions' bodies are left alone.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BodyLootEnabled_too.ch:
戰鬥結束後, 若15格內沒有危險, 玩家附近的NPC會搜刮屍體, 拿走補給與有用的裝備. 玩家的屍體以及曾是玩家同伴者的屍體不會被動到.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BodyLootEnabled_too.cn:
战斗结束后, 若15格内没有危险, 玩家附近的NPC会搜刮尸体, 拿走补给和有用的装备. 玩家的尸体以及曾是玩家同伴者的尸体则不会被碰.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BodyLootPerMinute.en: Corpse searches per group (per real minute)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BodyLootPerMinute.ch: 每個團體的屍體搜刮次數 (每現實分鐘)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BodyLootPerMinute.cn: 每个团体的尸体搜刮次数 (每现实分钟)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BodyLootPerMinute_t.en:
Caps how many bodies one group searches each real minute. For example, 2 prevents it searching more than two corpses in a minute.
Default 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BodyLootPerMinute_t.ch:
限制單一團體每現實分鐘可搜刮的屍體數量. 例如設為2時, 一分鐘內最多只會搜刮兩具屍體.
預設: 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BodyLootPerMinute_t.cn:
限制单个团体每现实分钟可搜刮的尸体数量. 例如设为2时, 一分钟内最多只会搜刮两具尸体.
默认: 3.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BreachPolicy.ch: [專家] 強行闖入需要理由
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BreachPolicy.cn: [专家] 强行闯入需要理由

Sandbox_ProjectALife.BreachPolicy_toolti.en: NPCs break into a building only when raiding or looting, use an unlocked door first, try a window before smashing a door, and tell before entering a player's base. On by default.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BreachPolicy_toolti.ch: NPC只在突襲或搜刮時才會闖入建築, 會先走沒上鎖的門, 砸門前先試窗戶, 進入玩家基地前會先告知. 預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BreachPolicy_toolti.cn: NPC只在突袭或搜刮时才会闯入建筑, 会先走没上锁的门, 砸门前先试窗户, 进入玩家基地前会先告知. 默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CalmDownEnabled.ch: 被激怒的謹慎陣營消氣
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CalmDownEnabled.cn: 被激怒的谨慎阵营消气

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CalmDownEnabled_too.en:
Careful factions can calm down after provocation once their waiting time passes. Naturally hostile factions and grudges from real attacks do not fade this way.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CalmDownEnabled_too.ch:
被激怒的謹慎陣營在等待時間過後可以平息. 天生敵對的陣營, 以及因真正遭受攻擊而結下的仇恨, 不會以這種方式消退.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CalmDownEnabled_too.cn:
被激怒的谨慎阵营在等待时间过后可以平息. 天生敌对的阵营, 以及因真正遭受攻击而结下的仇恨, 不会以这种方式消退.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CalmDownHours.ch: [專家] 消氣: 遊戲內小時
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CalmDownHours.cn: [专家] 消气: 游戏内小时

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CalmDownHours_toolt.en: Game hours until a provoked careful faction forgives. Default 2.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CalmDownHours_toolt.ch: 被激怒的謹慎陣營原諒你所需的遊戲內小時. 預設: 2.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CalmDownHours_toolt.cn: 被激怒的谨慎阵营原谅你所需的游戏内小时. 默认: 2.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionAvoidTiles.ch: [專家] 避開殭屍: 前方偵測距離 (格)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionAvoidTiles.cn: [专家] 避开僵尸: 前方侦测距离 (格)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionAvoidTiles_t.en: How far ahead on their route NPCs watch for zombies. Default 12.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionAvoidTiles_t.ch: NPC在路線前方多遠處留意殭屍. 預設: 12.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionAvoidTiles_t.cn: NPC在路线前方多远处留意僵尸. 默认: 12.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionDangerRays.en: Danger avoidance sight checks (per real second)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionDangerRays.ch: 避險視線檢查 (每現實秒)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionDangerRays.cn: 避险视线检查 (每现实秒)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionDangerRays_t.en:
Limits extra sight checks for danger detours across all NPCs. Groups wait when the limit is reached. At 0, these extra checks stop; normal perception is unaffected.
Default 32.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionDangerRays_t.ch:
限制所有NPC為繞開危險而進行的額外視線檢查次數. 達到上限時團體會等待. 設為0時停止這些額外檢查; 一般感知不受影響.
預設: 32.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionDangerRays_t.cn:
限制所有NPC为绕开危险而进行的额外视线检查次数. 达到上限时团体会等待. 设为0时停止这些额外检查; 常规感知不受影响.
默认: 32.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionDangerRoutin.en: Walking NPCs take short detours around nearby zombie crowds and fresh combat or loud noises. They wait or abandon an unsafe destination when no safe detour is found. Running and combat movement keep their existing rules.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionDangerRoutin.ch: 步行中的NPC會短暫繞道, 避開附近的殭屍群, 剛發生的戰鬥或巨大聲響. 找不到安全繞道時, 他們會等待或放棄不安全的目的地. 跑步與戰鬥移動維持現有規則.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionDangerRoutin.cn: 步行中的NPC会短暂绕道, 避开附近的僵尸群, 刚发生的战斗或巨大声响. 找不到安全绕道时, 他们会等待或放弃不安全的目的地. 跑步和战斗移动保持现有规则.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionEnabled_tool.en:
Travelling NPCs avoid zombie groups by skipping buildings, detouring, waiting or backing off. They still fight zombies that are close or coming at them.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionEnabled_tool.ch:
移動中的NPC會略過建築, 繞路, 等待或後退來避開殭屍群. 對於靠近或衝向他們的殭屍仍會應戰.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionEnabled_tool.cn:
移动中的NPC会跳过建筑, 绕路, 等待或后退来避开僵尸群. 对于靠近或冲向他们的僵尸仍会应战.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionHazardCheck_.en: Checks proposed movement legs for burning tiles, lit campfires and water. NPCs reject legs with known hazards. Applies to all movement paces.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionHazardCheck_.ch: 檢查預定的移動路段是否有燃燒中的格子, 點燃的營火與水域. NPC會拒絕含有已知危險的路段. 適用於所有移動速度.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionHazardCheck_.cn: 检查预定的移动路段是否有燃烧中的格子, 点燃的营火和水域. NPC会拒绝含有已知危险的路段. 适用于所有移动速度.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsEarly.ch: 初期新來者 (每遊戲週倖存者數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsEarly.cn: 初期新来者 (每游戏周幸存者数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsEarly.en:
Sets how many newcomers can replace dead survivors each game week early in the outbreak. If nobody has died, nobody arrives.
Default 7.0.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsEarly.ch:
設定疫情爆發初期每個遊戲週最多有多少新來者能遞補死亡的倖存者. 若無人死亡, 就不會有人抵達.
預設: 7.0.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsEarly.cn:
设置疫情爆发初期每个游戏周最多有多少新来者能补充死亡的幸存者. 若无人死亡, 就不会有人抵达.
默认: 7.0.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsFadeD.ch: 抵達速率遞減期 (遊戲內天數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsFadeD.cn: 抵达速率递减期 (游戏内天数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsFadeD.en:
Sets how long the weekly arrival rate takes to fall from the early value to the later value.
Default 28.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsFadeD.ch:
設定每週抵達速率從初期數值降到後期數值所需的時間.
預設: 28.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsFadeD.cn:
设置每周抵达速率从初期数值降至后期数值所需的时间.
默认: 28.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsLate.ch: 後期新來者 (每遊戲週倖存者數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsLate.cn: 后期新来者 (每游戏周幸存者数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsLate_.en:
Sets the replacement arrival rate after the early period. Arrivals gradually fall from the early rate to this one; they only replace losses.
Default 1.0.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsLate_.ch:
設定初期過後的遞補抵達速率. 抵達速率會從初期數值逐漸降到此值; 新來者只會遞補損失.
預設: 1.0.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusArrivalsLate_.cn:
设置初期过后的补充抵达速率. 抵达速率会从初期数值逐渐降至此值; 新来者只会补充损失.
默认: 1.0.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusClearedDays.ch: 清空據點的空置期 (遊戲內天數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusClearedDays.cn: 清空据点的空置期 (游戏内天数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusClearedDays_t.en:
Keeps a camp, outpost or inhabited building empty after all its residents die. Once this period ends, rare newcomers may settle there if resettlement is enabled.
Default 30.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusClearedDays_t.ch:
營地, 前哨站或有人居住的建築在所有居民死亡後會保持空置. 此期間結束後, 若已啟用重新定居, 少數新來者可能會在此定居.
預設: 30.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusClearedDays_t.cn:
营地, 哨所或有人居住的建筑在所有居民死亡后会保持空置. 此期间结束后, 若已启用重新定居, 少数新来者可能会在此定居.
默认: 30.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusResettle_tool.en:
Allows newcomers to settle cleared sites after their vacancy period, at most one site per four arrivals. Off keeps cleared sites empty for the rest of the game.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusResettle_tool.ch:
允許新來者在空置期結束後入住已清空的據點, 每四名抵達者最多入住一處. 關閉時, 已清空的據點在剩餘的遊戲中都會保持空置.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusResettle_tool.cn:
允许新来者在空置期结束后入住已清空的据点, 每四名抵达者最多入住一处. 关闭时, 已清空的据点在剩余的游戏中都会保持空置.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusSize_tooltip.en:
Sets the finite survivor pool when the world starts. Natural groups and reinforcements draw from it; deaths reduce it. Slow arrivals replace losses. Admin spawns do not count.
Default 360.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusSize_tooltip.ch:
設定世界開始時的有限倖存者人口池. 自然出現的團體與增援都從中抽取; 死亡會使其減少. 緩慢抵達的新來者會遞補損失. 管理員生成的NPC不計入.
預設: 360.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CensusSize_tooltip.cn:
设置世界开始时的有限幸存者人口池. 自然出现的团体和增援都从中抽取; 死亡会使其减少. 缓慢抵达的新来者会补充损失. 管理员生成的NPC不计入.
默认: 360.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ChatterEnabled_tool.en:
Calm groups pause to talk, and passing NPCs greet each other or you. Danger interrupts them. Off disables both group chatter and these greetings.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ChatterEnabled_tool.ch:
平靜的團體會停下來交談, 路過的NPC會互相問候或向你打招呼. 遇到危險時會中斷. 關閉則同時停用團體閒聊與這些問候.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ChatterEnabled_tool.cn:
平静的团体会停下来交谈, 路过的NPC会互相问候或向你打招呼. 遇到危险时会中断. 关闭则同时禁用团体闲聊和这些问候.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ChatterFrequency.ch: 團體閒聊頻率 (正常值的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ChatterFrequency.cn: 团体闲聊频率 (正常值的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ChatterFrequency_to.en:
How often calm groups start talking. At 200, conversations happen twice as often; at 50, half as often.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ChatterFrequency_to.ch:
平靜的團體開始交談的頻率. 設為200時, 交談頻率加倍; 設為50時, 頻率減半.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ChatterFrequency_to.cn:
平静的团体开始交谈的频率. 设为200时, 交谈频率加倍; 设为50时, 频率减半.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ChatterMaxConcurren.en:
Maximum group conversations happening at once. Lower values keep speech easier to follow in crowded places.
Default 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ChatterMaxConcurren.ch:
同時進行的團體交談上限. 數值越低, 在人多的地方越容易跟上對話內容.
預設: 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ChatterMaxConcurren.cn:
同时进行的团体交谈上限. 数值越低, 在人多的地方越容易跟上对话内容.
默认: 3.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ChatterPassingGreet.en:
Chance that an NPC greets you or another NPC while passing. Friendly people greet more, wary people less, enemies never. At 0, passing greetings stop.
Default 70.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ChatterPassingGreet.ch:
NPC路過時向你或其他NPC打招呼的機率. 友善的人較常問候, 戒備的人較少, 敵人則從不問候. 設為0時, 不再有路過問候.
預設: 70.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ChatterPassingGreet.cn:
NPC路过时向你或其他NPC打招呼的概率. 友善的人更常问候, 戒备的人较少, 敌人则从不问候. 设为0时, 不再有路过问候.
默认: 70.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CleanupRespawnAfter.en: Let A-Life spawn again after a completed cleanup
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CleanupRespawnAfter.ch: 完成清除後允許A-Life再次生成
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CleanupRespawnAfter.cn: 完成清除后允许A-Life再次生成

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CleanupRespawnAfter.en:
After an admin has run CLEANUP A-LIFE to the end, the mod stays inert in that world so it can be removed safely. Turn this on only if you want the mod to spawn people and outposts again in a cleaned world.
Default off.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CleanupRespawnAfter.ch:
管理員完整執行 CLEANUP A-LIFE 後, 此模組在該世界會保持停用, 以便安全移除. 只有在你希望模組於已清除的世界中再次生成人員與前哨站時才開啟此項.
預設: 關閉.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CleanupRespawnAfter.cn:
管理员完整执行 CLEANUP A-LIFE 后, 此模组在该世界会保持停用, 以便安全移除. 只有在你希望模组在已清除的世界中再次生成人员和哨所时才开启此项.
默认: 关闭.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CloseDoors_tooltip.en:
Outside combat, the last group member closes doors the group opened. Player-opened doors and occupied doorways stay untouched; no locks are changed.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CloseDoors_tooltip.ch:
非戰鬥時, 團體的最後一名成員會關上團體打開的門. 玩家打開的門與有人站著的門口不受影響; 不會變更任何門鎖.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CloseDoors_tooltip.cn:
非战斗时, 团体的最后一名成员会关上团体打开的门. 玩家打开的门和有人站着的门口不受影响; 不会更改任何门锁.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdChance.en: [Expert] Cold: chance of catching a cold (%% per chilled hour)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdChance.ch: [專家] 寒冷: 感冒機率 (每受寒一小時的%%)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdChance.cn: [专家] 寒冷: 感冒概率 (每受寒一小时的%%)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdChance_tooltip.en: Per game hour spent badly chilled, the base chance that an NPC comes down with a cold (it grows with how chilled and wet the NPC is). 0 = chills never turn into a cold. Default 6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdChance_tooltip.ch: NPC每嚴重受寒一個遊戲內小時, 染上感冒的基本機率 (NPC越冷, 越濕, 機率越高). 0 = 受寒永遠不會演變成感冒. 預設: 6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdChance_tooltip.cn: NPC每严重受寒一个游戏内小时, 患上感冒的基础概率 (NPC越冷, 越湿, 概率越高). 0 = 受寒永远不会发展成感冒. 默认: 6.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdEnabled_tooltip.en:
Weather and clothing affect NPC warmth. Prolonged chill can cause coughing, worse aim, slower walking and faster fatigue. Indoors or near a fire, NPCs warm up.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdEnabled_tooltip.ch:
天氣和衣著會影響NPC的保暖程度. 長時間受寒可能導致咳嗽, 瞄準變差, 走路變慢和更快疲勞. NPC在室內或靠近火源時會回暖.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdEnabled_tooltip.cn:
天气和衣着会影响NPC的保暖程度. 长时间受寒可能导致咳嗽, 瞄准变差, 走路变慢和更快疲劳. NPC在室内或靠近火源时会回暖.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdSeekWarmth_tool.en:
Chilled NPCs without orders or danger seek a fire or heated building and wear warmer clothes from their packs. Groups follow their leader to a fire.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdSeekWarmth_tool.ch:
沒有命令也沒有危險的受寒NPC會尋找火源或有暖氣的建築, 並從背包拿出較保暖的衣物穿上. 團體會跟著領導者前往火堆.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdSeekWarmth_tool.cn:
没有命令也没有危险的受寒NPC会寻找火源或有暖气的建筑, 并从背包拿出更保暖的衣物穿上. 团体会跟着领导者前往火堆.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdSeverity.ch: [專家] 寒冷: 嚴重程度 (%%)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdSeverity.cn: [专家] 寒冷: 严重程度 (%%)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdSeverity_toolti.en: How hard the cold hits NPCs and how big the penalties of a cold are. 0 = NPCs never get chilled. 100 = default and gentle. 300 = harsh winters. Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdSeverity_toolti.ch: 寒冷對NPC的影響有多強, 以及感冒的懲罰有多大. 0 = NPC永遠不會受寒. 100 = 預設值, 較溫和. 300 = 嚴冬. 預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdSeverity_toolti.cn: 寒冷对NPC的影响有多强, 以及感冒的惩罚有多大. 0 = NPC永远不会受寒. 100 = 默认值, 较温和. 300 = 严冬. 默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdSneezeNoise.en: [Expert] Cold: sneezes and coughs make a little noise
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdSneezeNoise.ch: [專家] 寒冷: 打噴嚏和咳嗽會發出些許聲響
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdSneezeNoise.cn: [专家] 寒冷: 打喷嚏和咳嗽会发出少许声响

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdSneezeNoise_too.en: A sneeze or cough from a sick NPC is a small sound (a few tiles) that nearby zombies can hear. Turn off to keep them silent.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdSneezeNoise_too.ch: 生病NPC的噴嚏或咳嗽是附近殭屍聽得到的小聲響 (範圍數格). 關閉可讓它們保持無聲.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ColdSneezeNoise_too.cn: 生病NPC的喷嚏或咳嗽是附近僵尸能听到的小声响 (范围几格). 关闭可让它们保持无声.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CombatReactionDelay.en: Time to raise, aim and start firing, and to look for a new combat target. Default 75%% shortens these delays by one quarter. 100%% restores the previous timing. Lower is faster. Weapon fire rate, reload time and warnings keep their own timings.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CombatReactionDelay.ch: 舉槍, 瞄準並開始射擊, 以及尋找新戰鬥目標所需的時間. 預設75%%會將這些延遲縮短四分之一. 100%%恢復為先前的時間. 越低越快. 武器射速, 裝填時間與警告仍各自計時.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CombatReactionDelay.cn: 举枪, 瞄准并开始射击, 以及寻找新战斗目标所需的时间. 默认75%%会将这些延迟缩短四分之一. 100%%恢复为之前的时间. 越低越快. 武器射速, 装填时间和警告仍各自计时.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatAdvancedTraje.en: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Advanced Trajectory is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatAdvancedTraje.ch: 偵測到 Advanced Trajectory 已啟用時, 開啟A-Life相容性轉接器. 於世界啟動時套用一次; 變更後請重新啟動. 關閉此項只會停用此轉接器, 不會停用該模組本身.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatAdvancedTraje.cn: 检测到 Advanced Trajectory 已启用时, 开启A-Life兼容性适配器. 在世界启动时应用一次; 更改后请重新启动. 关闭此项只会禁用此适配器, 不会禁用该模组本身.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatAutoAll_toolt.en: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Auto All is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatAutoAll_toolt.ch: 偵測到 Auto All 已啟用時, 開啟A-Life相容性轉接器. 於世界啟動時套用一次; 變更後請重新啟動. 關閉此項只會停用此轉接器, 不會停用該模組本身.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatAutoAll_toolt.cn: 检测到 Auto All 已启用时, 开启A-Life兼容性适配器. 在世界启动时应用一次; 更改后请重新启动. 关闭此项只会禁用此适配器, 不会禁用该模组本身.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatCryOfFear.ch: [專家] Cry of Fear 怪物轉接器
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatCryOfFear.cn: [专家] Cry of Fear 怪物适配器

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatCryOfFear_too.en: Let Cry of Fear monsters bite A-Life people when their own attack animation never starts, at the same pace as ordinary zombies. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Does nothing without the monsters mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatCryOfFear_too.ch: 當 Cry of Fear 怪物自身的攻擊動畫始終沒有啟動時, 讓牠們以與一般殭屍相同的頻率咬A-Life人物. 於世界啟動時套用一次; 變更後請重新啟動. 未安裝該怪物模組時無作用.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatCryOfFear_too.cn: 当 Cry of Fear 怪物自身的攻击动画始终未启动时, 让它们以与普通僵尸相同的频率咬A-Life人物. 在世界启动时应用一次; 更改后请重新启动. 未安装该怪物模组时无效果.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatCyesPushDoors.ch: [專家] Cye's Push Doors 轉接器
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatCyesPushDoors.cn: [专家] Cye's Push Doors 适配器

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatCyesPushDoors.en: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Cye's Push Doors is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatCyesPushDoors.ch: 偵測到 Cye's Push Doors 已啟用時, 開啟A-Life相容性轉接器. 於世界啟動時套用一次; 變更後請重新啟動. 關閉此項只會停用此轉接器, 不會停用該模組本身.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatCyesPushDoors.cn: 检测到 Cye's Push Doors 已启用时, 开启A-Life兼容性适配器. 在世界启动时应用一次; 更改后请重新启动. 关闭此项只会禁用此适配器, 不会禁用该模组本身.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatGaelGunStore_.en: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when GaelGunStore-Firearms is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatGaelGunStore_.ch: 偵測到 GaelGunStore-Firearms 已啟用時, 開啟A-Life相容性轉接器. 於世界啟動時套用一次; 變更後請重新啟動. 關閉此項只會停用此轉接器, 不會停用該模組本身.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatGaelGunStore_.cn: 检测到 GaelGunStore-Firearms 已启用时, 开启A-Life兼容性适配器. 在世界启动时应用一次; 更改后请重新启动. 关闭此项只会禁用此适配器, 不会禁用该模组本身.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatJeemResidents.ch: [專家] Jeem 居民分類轉接器
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatJeemResidents.cn: [专家] Jeem 居民分类适配器

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatJeemResidents.en: Expose living Jeem residents as residents through the A-Life compatibility API when the Jeem extension is active. Needs an available actor registry. Does not replace the Companion Dogs patch. Applied at world startup; restart after changing this.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatJeemResidents.ch: Jeem 擴充啟用時, 經由A-Life相容性API將存活的 Jeem 居民標示為居民. 需要可用的角色註冊表. 不會取代 Companion Dogs 修補程式. 於世界啟動時套用; 變更後請重新啟動.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatJeemResidents.cn: Jeem 扩展启用时, 通过A-Life兼容性API将存活的 Jeem 居民标记为居民. 需要可用的角色注册表. 不会取代 Companion Dogs 补丁. 在世界启动时应用; 更改后请重新启动.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatMoreTraits.ch: [專家] More Traits Definitive 轉接器
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatMoreTraits.cn: [专家] More Traits Definitive 适配器

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatMoreTraits_to.en: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when More Traits Definitive is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatMoreTraits_to.ch: 偵測到 More Traits Definitive 已啟用時, 開啟A-Life相容性轉接器. 於世界啟動時套用一次; 變更後請重新啟動. 關閉此項只會停用此轉接器, 不會停用該模組本身.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatMoreTraits_to.cn: 检测到 More Traits Definitive 已启用时, 开启A-Life兼容性适配器. 在世界启动时应用一次; 更改后请重新启动. 关闭此项只会禁用此适配器, 不会禁用该模组本身.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatNoPocketLoot.en: [Expert] No pocket loot on A-Life people
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatNoPocketLoot.ch: [專家] A-Life人物身上不產生口袋戰利品
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatNoPocketLoot.cn: [专家] A-Life人物身上不生成口袋战利品

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatNoPocketLoot_.en:
Mark A-Life people as already searched when they appear, so the vanilla zombie pocket loot is not rolled on their bodies. Off keeps the vanilla loot. Use it with mods that add loot to zombies.
Default off.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatNoPocketLoot_.ch:
A-Life人物出現時即標記為已搜查, 因此不會在其屍體上判定原版殭屍的口袋戰利品. 關閉則保留原版戰利品. 適合搭配會為殭屍增加戰利品的模組使用.
預設: 關閉.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatNoPocketLoot_.cn:
A-Life人物出现时即标记为已搜查, 因此不会在其尸体上判定原版僵尸的口袋战利品. 关闭则保留原版战利品. 适合搭配会为僵尸增加战利品的模组使用.
默认: 关闭.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatPixelStrike.ch: [專家] Pixel Strike Indicator 轉接器
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatPixelStrike.cn: [专家] Pixel Strike Indicator 适配器

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatPixelStrike_t.en: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Pixel Strike Indicator is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatPixelStrike_t.ch: 偵測到 Pixel Strike Indicator 已啟用時, 開啟A-Life相容性轉接器. 於世界啟動時套用一次; 變更後請重新啟動. 關閉此項只會停用此轉接器, 不會停用該模組本身.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatPixelStrike_t.cn: 检测到 Pixel Strike Indicator 已启用时, 开启A-Life兼容性适配器. 在世界启动时应用一次; 更改后请重新启动. 关闭此项只会禁用此适配器, 不会禁用该模组本身.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatPointBlank_to.en: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Point Blank is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatPointBlank_to.ch: 偵測到 Point Blank 已啟用時, 開啟A-Life相容性轉接器. 於世界啟動時套用一次; 變更後請重新啟動. 關閉此項只會停用此轉接器, 不會停用該模組本身.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatPointBlank_to.cn: 检测到 Point Blank 已启用时, 开启A-Life兼容性适配器. 在世界启动时应用一次; 更改后请重新启动. 关闭此项只会禁用此适配器, 不会禁用该模组本身.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatProjectExile_.en: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Project Exile is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatProjectExile_.ch: 偵測到 Project Exile 已啟用時, 開啟A-Life相容性轉接器. 於世界啟動時套用一次; 變更後請重新啟動. 關閉此項只會停用此轉接器, 不會停用該模組本身.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatProjectExile_.cn: 检测到 Project Exile 已启用时, 开启A-Life兼容性适配器. 在世界启动时应用一次; 更改后请重新启动. 关闭此项只会禁用此适配器, 不会禁用该模组本身.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatRVInterior.ch: [專家] Project RV Interior 轉接器
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatRVInterior.cn: [专家] Project RV Interior 适配器

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatRVInterior_to.en: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Project RV Interior is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatRVInterior_to.ch: 偵測到 Project RV Interior 已啟用時, 開啟A-Life相容性轉接器. 於世界啟動時套用一次; 變更後請重新啟動. 關閉此項只會停用此轉接器, 不會停用該模組本身.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatRVInterior_to.cn: 检测到 Project RV Interior 已启用时, 开启A-Life兼容性适配器. 在世界启动时应用一次; 更改后请重新启动. 关闭此项只会禁用此适配器, 不会禁用该模组本身.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatWanderingZomb.en: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Wandering Zombies is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatWanderingZomb.ch: 偵測到 Wandering Zombies 已啟用時, 開啟A-Life相容性轉接器. 於世界啟動時套用一次; 變更後請重新啟動. 關閉此項只會停用此轉接器, 不會停用該模組本身.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatWanderingZomb.cn: 检测到 Wandering Zombies 已启用时, 开启A-Life兼容性适配器. 在世界启动时应用一次; 更改后请重新启动. 关闭此项只会禁用此适配器, 不会禁用该模组本身.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionEnabled_t.en:
Crews weigh guns, ammo, distance and nearby zombies before attacking a player, and avoid poor odds. Crews sent to attack and NPCs you have hurt still fight.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionEnabled_t.ch:
團夥在攻擊玩家前會評估槍枝, 彈藥, 距離與附近殭屍, 避開勝算低的戰鬥. 奉命進攻的團夥與被你傷害過的NPC仍會開戰.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionEnabled_t.cn:
团伙在攻击玩家前会评估枪支, 弹药, 距离与附近僵尸, 避开胜算低的战斗. 奉命进攻的团伙与被你伤害过的NPC仍会开战.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionFightPerc.ch: [專家] 審慎評估: 開戰門檻 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionFightPerc.cn: [专家] 审慎评估: 开战门槛 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionFightPerc.en: A crew fights when its score reaches this value. Lower means bolder crews, higher means more cautious ones. Default 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionFightPerc.ch: 團夥的評分達到此值時就會開戰. 越低團夥越大膽, 越高則越謹慎. 預設: 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionFightPerc.cn: 团伙的评分达到此值时就会开战. 越低团伙越大胆, 越高则越谨慎. 默认: 50.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionLowAmmoRo.en: [Expert] Discretion: rounds counted as low ammunition
Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionLowAmmoRo.ch: [專家] 審慎評估: 視為彈藥不足的發數
Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionLowAmmoRo.cn: [专家] 审慎评估: 视为弹药不足的发数

Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionLowAmmoRo.en: A gun with fewer rounds than this (loaded plus reserve) counts as a melee weapon when a crew weighs a fight. Default 6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionLowAmmoRo.ch: 團夥評估戰鬥時, 子彈 (已裝填加備用) 少於此數的槍枝會被視為近戰武器. 預設: 6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionLowAmmoRo.cn: 团伙评估战斗时, 子弹 (已装填加备用) 少于此数的枪支会被视为近战武器. 默认: 6.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionPatienceS.en: [Expert] Discretion: seconds before a held-back crew commits
Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionPatienceS.ch: [專家] 審慎評估: 按兵不動的團夥投入戰鬥前的秒數
Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionPatienceS.cn: [专家] 审慎评估: 按兵不动的团伙投入战斗前的秒数

Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionPatienceS.en: A crew that keeps holding back because of the odds alone commits to the fight after this many seconds if you stay near. Crews short on ammunition or surrounded by zombies never commit this way. Default 45.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionPatienceS.ch: 僅因勝算而持續按兵不動的團夥, 若你一直待在附近, 經過這麼多秒後會投入戰鬥. 彈藥不足或被殭屍包圍的團夥絕不會因此開戰. 預設: 45.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.DiscretionPatienceS.cn: 仅因胜算而持续按兵不动的团伙, 若你一直待在附近, 经过这么多秒后会投入战斗. 弹药不足或被僵尸包围的团伙绝不会因此开战. 默认: 45.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterAnswer.ch: [專家] 回答問題的時限 (秒)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterAnswer.cn: [专家] 回答问题的时限 (秒)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterAnswer_too.en: How long a confronting crew waits for an answer before it asks again ('Will you answer me?'). After the third silence the crew acts: leave, warn or attack, by faction.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterAnswer_too.ch: 對峙中的隊伍等待回答多久後會再問一次 (「你到底要不要回答?」). 第三次沒有回應後, 隊伍會依陣營採取行動: 離開, 警告或攻擊.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterAnswer_too.cn: 对峙中的队伍等待回答多久后会再问一次 (“你到底回不回答?”). 第三次没有回应后, 队伍会根据阵营采取行动: 离开, 警告或攻击.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterBetrayal.en: Outlaw flanking during talks (percent of faction habit)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterBetrayal.ch: 交涉時歹徒包抄 (陣營習性的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterBetrayal.cn: 交涉时歹徒包抄 (阵营习性的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterBetrayal_t.en:
Scales outlaw flanking during talks. A flanker circles while the leader stalls; calling it out or raising a gun makes them back off. 0 disables this betrayal.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterBetrayal_t.ch:
調整歹徒在交涉時包抄的頻率. 領導者拖延時間時, 包抄者會繞到側面; 當面點破或舉槍會讓他們退開. 設為0會停用這種背叛行為.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterBetrayal_t.cn:
调整歹徒在交涉时包抄的频率. 领导者拖延时间时, 包抄者会绕到侧面; 当面点破或举枪会让他们退开. 设为0会禁用这种背叛行为.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterCallout.en: Calls to leave a building (percent of faction habit)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterCallout.ch: 喊人離開建築 (陣營習性的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterCallout.cn: 喊人离开建筑 (阵营习性的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterCalloutTim.en: How long a crew outside a building waits for the player to answer or come out, with repeated calls and a warning shot, before it searches the building or leaves. The time left is shown to the player.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterCalloutTim.ch: 建築外的隊伍在搜尋建築或離開之前, 會反覆喊話並鳴槍示警, 等待玩家回應或出來的時間. 剩餘時間會顯示給玩家.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterCalloutTim.cn: 建筑外的队伍在搜索建筑或离开之前, 会反复喊话并鸣枪示警, 等待玩家回应或出来的时间. 剩余时间会显示给玩家.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterCallout_to.en:
Scales how often crews call hidden players outside instead of searching; police do this more than raiders. Player bases are always called out first. 0 disables ordinary callouts.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterCallout_to.ch:
調整隊伍喊躲藏的玩家出來, 而不進去搜尋的頻率; 警察比掠奪者更常這麼做. 對玩家基地一律會先喊話. 設為0會停用一般喊話.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterCallout_to.cn:
调整队伍喊躲藏的玩家出来, 而不进去搜索的频率; 警察比掠夺者更常这么做. 对玩家基地总是会先喊话. 设为0会禁用一般喊话.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterCues.ch: [專家] 腳本化的警告與對峙
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterCues.cn: [专家] 脚本化的警告与对峙

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterCues_toolt.en:
Stand-offs and hold-ups lean on gestures and distance instead of text over heads: one spoken line per phase (notice, demand, turn, parting), the rest goes to the talk panel, hand signals and nods carry the in-between. Every line is picked so it does not repeat. Off: every line is shouted over the head as before.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterCues_toolt.ch:
對峙與搶劫改以手勢和距離表現, 而非頭上的文字: 每個階段 (察覺, 要求, 轉折, 道別) 只說一句台詞, 其餘內容進入對話面板, 中間的過程則靠手勢和點頭表達. 每句台詞都經過挑選, 避免重複. 關閉: 和以前一樣, 每句台詞都在頭上喊出.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterCues_toolt.cn:
对峙与抢劫改以手势和距离来表现, 而不是头顶上的文字: 每个阶段 (察觉, 要求, 转折, 道别) 只说一句台词, 其余内容进入对话面板, 中间的过程则靠手势和点头表达. 每句台词都经过挑选, 避免重复. 关闭: 和以前一样, 每句台词都在头顶喊出.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterFixBlur.ch: [專家] 追獵者情報準確度 (格)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterFixBlur.cn: [专家] 追猎者情报准确度 (格)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterFixBlur_to.en: A hunting, raiding or revenge crew gets ONE tip about where its target is when it sets out, off by up to this many tiles. It never follows the player's live position; it searches and gives up.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterFixBlur_to.ch: 狩獵, 突襲或復仇隊伍出發時只會得到「一次」關於目標位置的情報, 誤差最多為此格數. 它絕不會追蹤玩家的即時位置; 它會搜尋, 然後放棄.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterFixBlur_to.cn: 狩猎, 突袭或复仇队伍出发时只会得到“一次”关于目标位置的情报, 误差最多为该格数. 它绝不会追踪玩家的实时位置; 它会搜索, 然后放弃.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterLostSight.ch: [專家] 跟丟躲藏玩家的時間 (秒)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterLostSight.cn: [专家] 跟丢躲藏玩家的时间 (秒)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterLostSight_.en: How long an NPC keeps chasing a player it can no longer see or hear. After that it only knows where he was last seen and searches from there.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterLostSight_.ch: NPC在看不見也聽不到玩家後, 還會繼續追多久. 之後它只知道玩家最後出現的位置, 並從那裡開始搜尋.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterLostSight_.cn: NPC在看不见也听不到玩家后, 还会继续追多久. 之后它只知道玩家最后出现的位置, 并从那里开始搜索.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterSearch_too.en: How long a crew searches a building where it believes a player is hiding: one man at the door, the rest room by room. Then it gives up and moves on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterSearch_too.ch: 隊伍搜尋它認為有玩家躲藏之建築的時間: 一人守在門口, 其他人逐房搜尋. 時間到後便放棄並離開.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterSearch_too.cn: 队伍搜索它认为有玩家躲藏的建筑的时间: 一人守在门口, 其他人逐个房间搜索. 时间到后便放弃并离开.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterStandoffs_.en:
Crews that warn may question you, demand a toll or call you outside before fighting. Silence, leaving, a raised gun or betrayal can start a fight. Off: only their attack warning remains.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterStandoffs_.ch:
會發出警告的隊伍可能在開戰前盤問你, 索取過路費或喊你出來. 沉默, 離開, 舉槍或背叛都可能引發戰鬥. 關閉: 只保留它們的攻擊警告.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterStandoffs_.cn:
会发出警告的队伍可能在开战前盘问你, 索要过路费或喊你出来. 沉默, 离开, 举枪或背叛都可能引发战斗. 关闭: 只保留它们的攻击警告.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterSurprise.ch: [專家] 突然遭遇時的停頓 (秒)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterSurprise.cn: [专家] 突然遭遇时的停顿 (秒)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterSurprise_t.en: How long a hostile crew holds its fire after it discovers a player: time to answer, drop the weapon, raise the hands or act first. Aiming at the crew or attacking it ends the beat at once.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterSurprise_t.ch: 敵對隊伍發現玩家後暫不開火的時間: 讓玩家有時間回應, 放下武器, 舉起雙手或先發制人. 瞄準或攻擊該隊伍會立刻結束這段停頓.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EncounterSurprise_t.cn: 敌对队伍发现玩家后暂不开火的时间: 让玩家有时间回应, 放下武器, 举起双手或先发制人. 瞄准或攻击该队伍会立即结束这段停顿.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Events_RadioActivat.en:
Tunes and switches on a nearby radio for base-event messages, then turns it off. No radio: text only. Requires physical and audible base-event effects.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Events_RadioActivat.ch:
調好並開啟附近的收音機播送基地事件訊息, 播完後關閉. 沒有收音機: 僅顯示文字. 需啟用「實體與聲音的基地事件效果」.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Events_RadioActivat.cn:
调好并打开附近的收音机播报基地事件消息, 播完后关闭. 没有收音机: 仅显示文字. 需要启用“实体与声音的基地事件效果”.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Events_ScriptedEffe.ch: 實體與聲音的基地事件效果
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Events_ScriptedEffe.cn: 实体与声音的基地事件效果

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Events_ScriptedEffe.en:
Radio messages, door marks, knocks, distant gunfire and dog barks can happen in the world. Off leaves text notices only.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Events_ScriptedEffe.ch:
無線電訊息, 門上記號, 敲門聲, 遠方槍聲與狗吠可能會在世界中實際發生. 關閉則只留下文字通知.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Events_ScriptedEffe.cn:
无线电消息, 门上记号, 敲门声, 远方枪声与狗吠可能会在世界中实际发生. 关闭则只留下文字通知.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Events_WallMarks.en: Visible marks beside the front door

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Events_WallMarks_to.en:
Places washable wall marks by the door: up to four, fading after ten game days. Off gives text only. Requires physical and audible base-event effects.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Events_WallMarks_to.ch:
在門邊留下可清洗的牆面標記: 最多四個, 遊戲內十天後褪去. 關閉時僅顯示文字. 需啟用「實體與聲音的基地事件效果」.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Events_WallMarks_to.cn:
在门边留下可清洗的墙面标记: 最多四个, 游戏内十天后褪去. 关闭时仅显示文字. 需要启用“实体与声音的基地事件效果”.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ExtraWoundPercent_t.en: Optional extra overall-health loss added on top of a hit, on top of the damage option above. 0 means no extra damage, so the 60%% option is exactly 60%% of the original hit. Default 0.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ExtraWoundPercent_t.ch: 可選的額外整體生命值損失, 疊加在命中傷害及上方的傷害選項之上. 0表示沒有額外傷害, 因此60%%選項正好造成原始命中60%%的傷害. 預設: 0.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ExtraWoundPercent_t.cn: 可选的额外整体生命值损失, 叠加在命中伤害及上方的伤害选项之上. 0表示没有额外伤害, 因此60%%选项正好造成原始命中60%%的伤害. 默认: 0.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FactionsLegacyRoste.en:
Restores the earlier factions, attitudes and spawn weights instead of the merged roster. Takes effect when the game or server starts.
Default off.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FactionsLegacyRoste.ch:
還原舊版的陣營, 態度與生成權重, 而非使用合併後的名單. 於遊戲或伺服器啟動時生效.
預設: 關閉.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FactionsLegacyRoste.cn:
恢复旧版的阵营, 态度和生成权重, 而不是使用合并后的名单. 在游戏或服务器启动时生效.
默认: 关闭.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairEntryLead.en: [Expert] Warning after a door or window is heard (seconds)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairEntryLead.ch: [專家] 聽見開門窗後的警告時間 (秒)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairEntryLead.cn: [专家] 听到开门窗后的警告时间 (秒)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairEntryLead_toolt.en: Time between the sound of a hostile NPC opening a door or climbing through a window and its first attack on a player nearby.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairEntryLead_toolt.ch: 從敵對NPC打開門或爬過窗戶發出聲響, 到它對附近玩家發動首次攻擊之間的時間.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairEntryLead_toolt.cn: 从敌对NPC打开门或爬过窗户发出声响, 到它对附近玩家发动首次攻击之间的时间.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairFightMemory.ch: [專家] 記住挑起衝突者的時間 (遊戲內分鐘)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairFightMemory.cn: [专家] 记住挑起冲突者的时间 (游戏内分钟)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairFightMemory_too.en: How long NPCs remember who started a fight with a player. Fighting back inside this time is self-defence, and the NPC that started it does not speak like a victim.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairFightMemory_too.ch: NPC會記得是誰先與玩家起衝突的時間長度. 在這段時間內反擊算是自衛, 而挑起衝突的NPC也不會說出像受害者的台詞.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairFightMemory_too.cn: NPC会记得是谁先与玩家发生冲突的时间长度. 在这段时间内反击算作自卫, 而挑起冲突的NPC也不会说出像受害者一样的台词.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairGrace.ch: [專家] 首次接觸緩衝時間 (秒)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairGrace.cn: [专家] 首次接触缓冲时间 (秒)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairGrace_tooltip.en: How long a hostile NPC must have been in your view before it may attack without shouting first.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairGrace_tooltip.ch: 敵對NPC必須在你的視野中停留多久, 才能不先喊話就發動攻擊.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairGrace_tooltip.cn: 敌对NPC必须在你的视野中停留多久, 才能不先喊话就发动攻击.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairTell.en: [Expert] Hostiles warn before the first attack
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairTell.ch: [專家] 敵對者首次攻擊前先警告
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairTell.cn: [专家] 敌对者首次攻击前先警告

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairTell_tooltip.en: A hostile NPC never lands its first blow or shot on a player who has not attacked it unless the player had a fair chance to notice: a shouted warning, a door or window heard opening, or the NPC in plain view for the first-contact grace. Fighting back is never delayed.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairTell_tooltip.ch: 敵對NPC絕不會對未攻擊它的玩家打出第一擊或開第一槍, 除非玩家有公平的機會察覺: 喊出的警告, 聽見門或窗戶被打開, 或NPC在首次接觸緩衝時間內一直清楚出現在視野中. 反擊則永遠不會延遲.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairTell_tooltip.cn: 敌对NPC绝不会对未攻击它的玩家打出第一击或开第一枪, 除非玩家有公平的机会察觉: 喊出的警告, 听到门或窗户被打开, 或NPC在首次接触缓冲时间内一直清楚出现在视野中. 反击则永远不会延迟.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairWarningLead.ch: [專家] 首次攻擊前的警告時間 (秒)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairWarningLead.cn: [专家] 首次攻击前的警告时间 (秒)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairWarningLead_too.en: Time between a hostile NPC's warning shout and its first blow or shot.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairWarningLead_too.ch: 敵對NPC喊出警告到打出第一擊或開第一槍之間的時間.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairWarningLead_too.cn: 敌对NPC喊出警告到打出第一击或开第一枪之间的时间.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairWindowOpen_tool.en: How long an NPC needs to open a closed window before it climbs through. The window can be heard opening.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairWindowOpen_tool.ch: NPC爬過關著的窗戶前, 需要多久才能把窗戶打開. 開窗的聲響聽得見.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FairWindowOpen_tool.cn: NPC爬过关着的窗户前, 需要多久才能把窗户打开. 开窗的声响能被听见.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FearDays.ch: [專家] 平民鎮定下來所需天數
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FearDays.cn: [专家] 平民镇定下来所需天数

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FearDays_tooltip.en: Civilians start out at full fear and steady over this many days, down to the lingering fear below. 0 starts them at the lingering fear.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FearDays_tooltip.ch: 平民一開始處於完全恐懼, 並在這麼多天內逐漸鎮定, 降到下方的殘留恐懼程度. 設為0則一開始就處於殘留恐懼程度.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FearDays_tooltip.cn: 平民一开始处于完全恐惧状态, 并在这么多天内逐渐镇定, 降到下方的残留恐惧程度. 设为0则一开始就处于残留恐惧程度.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FearLevel_tooltip.en: How many zombies it takes before civilians break and run.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FearLevel_tooltip.ch: 需要多少殭屍才會讓平民崩潰逃跑.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FearLevel_tooltip.cn: 需要多少僵尸才会让平民崩溃逃跑.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FearLingering_toolt.en: How much of their fear civilians keep once they have steadied. At 50 it takes a crowd about 1.6 times the size to make them run. 0 means they stop running from zombies altogether after the days above.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FearLingering_toolt.ch: 平民鎮定下來後仍保留多少恐懼. 設為50時, 需要約1.6倍規模的殭屍群才會讓他們逃跑. 0表示經過上方的天數後, 他們完全不再逃離殭屍.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FearLingering_toolt.cn: 平民镇定下来后仍保留多少恐惧. 设为50时, 需要约1.6倍规模的僵尸群才会让他们逃跑. 0表示经过上方的天数后, 他们完全不再逃离僵尸.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FireManeuver_toolti.en: Shooters can advance to nearby cover and briefly step out to fire. Eligible squad gunners provide bounded covering fire. Turning this off cancels active maneuvers.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FireManeuver_toolti.ch: 射手可推進到附近的掩體, 並短暫探身射擊. 符合條件的小隊槍手會提供有限度的掩護射擊. 關閉此項會取消進行中的機動.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FireManeuver_toolti.cn: 射手可推进到附近的掩体, 并短暂探身射击. 符合条件的小队枪手会提供有限度的掩护射击. 关闭此项会取消进行中的机动.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ForwardCoverTiles_t.en: Maximum length of a forward cover leg. Default 4; range 2-6. Weapon distance and movement safety still apply.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ForwardCoverTiles_t.ch: 前往前方掩體的單段路程最大長度. 預設: 4; 範圍: 2-6. 武器距離與移動安全限制仍然適用.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ForwardCoverTiles_t.cn: 前往前方掩体的单段路程最大长度. 默认: 4; 范围: 2-6. 武器距离和移动安全限制仍然适用.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FriskScripted.ch: [專家] 搶劫時的腳本化搜身
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FriskScripted.cn: [专家] 抢劫时的脚本化搜身

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FriskScripted_toolt.en:
In a hold-up one crew member, never the speaker if someone else is free, walks up to arm's length and pats you down with an animation and one of three pat-down sounds. The search lasts exactly as long as the sound. If you step away or fight, it stops and the crew reacts. Off: the old instant search.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FriskScripted_toolt.ch:
搶劫時, 一名隊伍成員 (若有其他人空著, 就絕不會是喊話者) 會走到一臂之距, 以動畫搭配三種搜身音效之一對你搜身. 搜身持續的時間與音效長度完全相同. 若你走開或反抗, 搜身會中止, 隊伍也會做出反應. 關閉: 使用舊的瞬間搜身.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FriskScripted_toolt.cn:
抢劫时, 一名队伍成员 (若有其他人空闲, 就绝不会是喊话者) 会走到一臂之距, 以动画配合三种搜身音效之一对你搜身. 搜身持续的时间与音效长度完全相同. 如果你走开或反抗, 搜身会中止, 队伍也会做出反应. 关闭: 使用旧的瞬间搜身.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelDayOffset.ch: 陣營時間軸偏移 (遊戲內天數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelDayOffset.cn: 阵营时间轴偏移 (游戏内天数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelDayOffset_too.en:
Moves faction progression ahead or back. At +30, a new world uses day-30 factions and gear; -10 delays progression by 10 days.
Default 0.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelDayOffset_too.ch:
將陣營演變進度提前或延後. 設為+30時, 新世界會使用第30天的陣營與裝備; 設為-10則將進度延後10天.
預設: 0.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelDayOffset_too.cn:
将阵营演变进度提前或推后. 设为+30时, 新世界会使用第30天的阵营和装备; 设为-10则将进度推后10天.
默认: 0.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelEnabled_toolt.en:
Changes factions, gear and aim as the world ages. Emergency services disappear by day 120; survivor and raider groups take over. Off uses fixed faction schedules.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelEnabled_toolt.ch:
隨著世界時間推移, 改變陣營, 裝備與瞄準能力. 緊急救援單位會在第120天前消失, 由倖存者與掠奪者團體接手. 關閉則使用固定的陣營時程.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelEnabled_toolt.cn:
随着世界时间推移, 改变阵营, 装备和瞄准能力. 紧急救援单位会在第120天前消失, 由幸存者和掠夺者团体接管. 关闭则使用固定的阵营时间表.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelLoneSurvivorM.ch: 獨行倖存者隊伍人數上限 (NPC)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelLoneSurvivorM.cn: 独行幸存者队伍人数上限 (NPC)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelLoneSurvivorM.en:
Limits lone survivors and survivor pairs to this many NPCs, even if group-size settings would make their party larger.
Default 2.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelLoneSurvivorM.ch:
將獨行倖存者與倖存者雙人組的人數限制為此數量, 即使團體規模設定會讓其隊伍更大.
預設: 2.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelLoneSurvivorM.cn:
将独行幸存者和幸存者双人组的人数限制为此数量, 即使团体规模设置会让其队伍更大.
默认: 2.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelSkillRampPerc.ch: [專家] 陣營演變瞄準成長 (%%)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelSkillRampPerc.cn: [专家] 阵营演变瞄准成长 (%%)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelSkillRampPerc.en: How much NPC aim improves as the stages pass, in %% of the built-in ramp (up to +3 aim rating in the last stage). 0%% turns the ramp off, 100%% is the default.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelSkillRampPerc.ch: 隨著階段推進, NPC瞄準能力提升的幅度, 以內建成長曲線的%%表示 (最後階段最多+3瞄準等級). 0%%為關閉成長, 100%%為預設值.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FunnelSkillRampPerc.cn: 随着阶段推进, NPC瞄准能力提升的幅度, 以内置成长曲线的%%表示 (最后阶段最多+3瞄准等级). 0%%为关闭成长, 100%%为默认值.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeEnabled.en: [Expert] Group life: spread out, shelter and idle roles
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeEnabled.ch: [專家] 團體生活: 散開, 避難與閒置角色
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeEnabled.cn: [专家] 团体生活: 散开, 避难与闲置角色

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeEnabled_to.en: Groups walk in a loose formation instead of one clump, never share a square when calm, and when they stop for a rest they move into a nearby house or shelter and idle there with different jobs: one sits in a corner, one keeps watch, two talk face to face, one comments, one stays quiet, others eat or smoke. Danger breaks it up at once. Off restores the old behaviour. On by default.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeEnabled_to.ch: 團體以鬆散隊形行走而不是擠成一團, 平靜時絕不共用同一格, 停下休息時會進入附近的房屋或避難處, 並在那裡各做各的事: 一人坐在角落, 一人負責站哨, 兩人面對面交談, 一人發表意見, 一人保持安靜, 其他人吃東西或抽菸. 一有危險就立刻解散. 關閉則恢復舊有行為. 預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeEnabled_to.cn: 团体以松散队形行走而不是挤成一团, 平静时绝不共用同一格, 停下休息时会进入附近的房屋或避难处, 并在那里各做各的事: 一人坐在角落, 一人负责放哨, 两人面对面交谈, 一人发表意见, 一人保持安静, 其他人吃东西或抽烟. 一有危险就立刻解散. 关闭则恢复旧有行为. 默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeRoles.ch: [專家] 團體生活: 閒置角色
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeRoles.cn: [专家] 团体生活: 闲置角色

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeRoles_tool.en: While a group rests, every member gets a role (lookout, sitter, talker, commenter, quiet, eater, smoker) with its own spot and pose. Off: they only spread out and stand. On by default.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeRoles_tool.ch: 團體休息時, 每名成員都會分配到一個角色 (哨兵, 坐著的人, 交談者, 發言者, 安靜者, 進食者, 抽菸者), 各有自己的位置與姿勢. 關閉: 他們只會散開站著. 預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeRoles_tool.cn: 团体休息时, 每名成员都会分配到一个角色 (哨兵, 坐着的人, 交谈者, 发言者, 安静者, 进食者, 抽烟者), 各有自己的位置与姿势. 关闭: 他们只会散开站着. 默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeShelterIdl.ch: [專家] 團體生活: 休息時長 (遊戲內分鐘)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeShelterIdl.cn: [专家] 团体生活: 休息时长 (游戏内分钟)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeShelterIdl.en: Typical length of a group rest, in game minutes. Each rest lasts between half and double of this value. Default 20, so 10 to 40.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeShelterIdl.ch: 團體休息的一般時長, 以遊戲內分鐘計. 每次休息介於此值的一半到兩倍之間. 預設: 20, 即10到40.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeShelterIdl.cn: 团体休息的一般时长, 以游戏内分钟计. 每次休息介于此值的一半到两倍之间. 默认: 20, 即10到40.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeSpread.ch: [專家] 團體生活: 散開強度 (%%)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeSpread.cn: [专家] 团体生活: 散开强度 (%%)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeSpread_too.en: How wide a travelling group spreads out. 100 is the normal formation, 50 keeps them closer, 150 spreads them wider, 0 turns the formation off. Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeSpread_too.ch: 移動中的團體散開的寬度. 100為正常隊形, 50讓他們靠得更近, 150讓他們散得更開, 0關閉隊形. 預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GroupLifeSpread_too.cn: 移动中的团体散开的宽度. 100为正常队形, 50让他们靠得更近, 150让他们散得更开, 0关闭队形. 默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearEnabled_tool.en:
Poorly armed NPCs back away from a player or hostile aiming or raising a firearm. The Creator determines which factions and members have this fear.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearEnabled_tool.ch:
武裝薄弱的NPC會從瞄準或舉起槍械的玩家或敵人面前退開. 由編輯器決定哪些陣營與成員有這種恐懼.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearEnabled_tool.cn:
武装薄弱的NPC会从瞄准或举起枪械的玩家或敌人面前退开. 由编辑器决定哪些阵营与成员有这种恐惧.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearPercent_tool.en: Chance that an NPC panics when a gun is aimed at it. Rolled once per NPC and player, so the same NPC always reacts the same way to the same player. A gun that is raised but not pointed at it counts half. Default 60.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearPercent_tool.ch: 被槍指著時NPC陷入恐慌的機率. 每組NPC與玩家只擲骰一次, 因此同一個NPC面對同一名玩家時反應永遠相同. 舉起但未指向它的槍只算一半. 預設: 60.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearPercent_tool.cn: 被枪指着时NPC陷入恐慌的概率. 每组NPC与玩家只掷骰一次, 因此同一个NPC面对同一名玩家时反应总是相同. 举起但未指向它的枪只算一半. 默认: 60.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearReactDelay.ch: [專家] 懼槍反應時間 (毫秒)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearReactDelay.cn: [专家] 惧枪反应时间 (毫秒)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearReactDelay_t.en: How long an NPC freezes and stares at the gun before it starts to run. 0 runs at once. Default 400.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearReactDelay_t.ch: NPC在開始逃跑前會僵住並盯著槍多久. 0表示立刻逃跑. 預設: 400.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearReactDelay_t.cn: NPC在开始逃跑前会僵住并盯着枪多久. 0表示立即逃跑. 默认: 400.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearRunDistance_.en: How far, in tiles, a frightened NPC runs from the gun on each leg. It heads for cover that breaks line of sight and keeps going until the gun has been out of sight for a few seconds. Default 35.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearRunDistance_.ch: 受驚的NPC每一段逃離槍口的距離 (以格計). 它會前往能阻斷視線的掩護處, 並持續逃跑, 直到槍離開視線數秒為止. 預設: 35.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearRunDistance_.cn: 受惊的NPC每一段逃离枪口的距离 (以格计). 它会前往能阻断视线的掩护处, 并持续逃跑, 直到枪离开视线数秒为止. 默认: 35.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearRunSpeed_too.en: How fast a frightened NPC runs away. A flight may use all of its stamina and slows down only when it is empty.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearRunSpeed_too.ch: 受驚的NPC逃跑的速度. 逃跑時可能耗盡全部耐力, 只有在耐力用完時才會放慢.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunFearRunSpeed_too.cn: 受惊的NPC逃跑的速度. 逃跑时可能耗尽全部耐力, 只有在耐力用完时才会放慢.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunHordeSize.en: [Expert] Horde size that may be shot
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunHordeSize.ch: [專家] 可射擊的殭屍群規模
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunHordeSize.cn: [专家] 可射击的僵尸群规模

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunHordeSize_toolti.en: A group of at least this many zombies within 12 tiles that blocks an NPC's route may be shot at, if it is not too loud (see the noise limit). Default 5.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunHordeSize_toolti.ch: 12格內擋住NPC路線且數量至少達此值的殭屍群可以射擊, 前提是不會太吵 (見噪音上限). 預設: 5.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunHordeSize_toolti.cn: 12格内挡住NPC路线且数量至少达到该值的僵尸群可以射击, 前提是不会太吵 (见噪音上限). 默认: 5.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunNoiseZombies.en: [Expert] No gunfire with this many zombies near
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunNoiseZombies.ch: [專家] 附近殭屍達此數量時不開槍
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunNoiseZombies.cn: [专家] 附近僵尸达到该数量时不开枪

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunNoiseZombies_too.en: An NPC holds fire when more than this many zombies are within 25 tiles, unless it is cornered, hurt or defending a hurt player. 0 turns the check off. Default 8.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunNoiseZombies_too.ch: 25格內的殭屍超過此數量時, NPC會停止開火, 除非被逼入絕境, 受傷或正在保護受傷的玩家. 0會關閉此檢查. 預設: 8.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunNoiseZombies_too.cn: 25格内的僵尸超过该数量时, NPC会停止开火, 除非被逼入绝境, 受伤或正在保护受伤的玩家. 0会关闭该检查. 默认: 8.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunsVsZombiesPercen.en: How often an NPC that could shoot a zombie does so. Gunfire draws more zombies, so lowering this makes NPCs walk around zombies, use melee on a lone one, and keep their guns for NPCs and players. They still shoot when cornered, hurt, defending a hurt player, on a horde that blocks the way, or on duty as military or police. 0 means never unless cornered. 100 is the old behaviour. While the world is under 14 days old the default 50 acts as 70, so early NPCs shoot more. Default 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunsVsZombiesPercen.ch: 能夠射擊殭屍的NPC實際開槍的頻率. 槍聲會引來更多殭屍, 因此調低此值會讓NPC繞過殭屍, 以近戰對付落單的殭屍, 把槍留給NPC與玩家. 但在被逼入絕境, 受傷, 保護受傷的玩家, 面對擋路的殭屍群, 或以軍警身分執勤時, 他們仍會開槍. 0表示除非被逼入絕境, 否則絕不開槍. 100為舊版行為. 世界存在未滿14天時, 預設值50會視為70, 因此前期NPC會更常開槍. 預設: 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunsVsZombiesPercen.cn: 能够射击僵尸的NPC实际开枪的频率. 枪声会引来更多僵尸, 因此调低该值会让NPC绕开僵尸, 用近战对付落单的僵尸, 把枪留给NPC与玩家. 但在被逼入绝境, 受伤, 保护受伤的玩家, 面对挡路的僵尸群, 或以军警身份执勤时, 他们仍会开枪. 0表示除非被逼入绝境, 否则绝不开枪. 100为旧版行为. 世界存在未满14天时, 默认值50会按70计算, 因此前期NPC会更常开枪. 默认: 50.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingAlertPercent.en:
Sets the minimum awareness after an NPC hears a sound. Confirmed contacts and final warnings still give full awareness.
Default 70.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingAlertPercent.ch:
設定NPC聽到聲音後的最低警覺程度. 已確認的接觸與最後警告仍會帶來完全警覺.
預設: 70.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingAlertPercent.cn:
设置NPC听到声音后的最低警觉程度. 已确认的接触和最后警告仍会带来完全警觉.
默认: 70.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingAlertSeconds.ch: 聲音警覺持續時間 (現實秒數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingAlertSeconds.cn: 声音警觉持续时间 (现实秒数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingAlertSeconds.en:
Sets how long extra awareness from sounds and warnings lasts before the NPC returns to its normal awareness.
Default 20.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingAlertSeconds.ch:
設定由聲音與警告帶來的額外警覺會持續多久, 之後NPC才恢復正常警覺.
預設: 20.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingAlertSeconds.cn:
设置由声音和警告带来的额外警觉会持续多久, 之后NPC才恢复正常警觉.
默认: 20.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingEnabled_tool.en:
Allows NPCs to react to world sounds and notice nearby players who run or shoot.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingEnabled_tool.ch:
讓NPC能對世界中的聲音作出反應, 並注意到附近正在奔跑或開槍的玩家.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingEnabled_tool.cn:
让NPC能对世界中的声音作出反应, 并注意到附近正在奔跑或开枪的玩家.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingFloorPercent.ch: 跨樓層聽覺距離 (剩餘百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingFloorPercent.cn: 跨楼层听觉距离 (剩余百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingFloorPercent.en:
Reduces hearing distance for each floor between the NPC and sound. At 50, one floor leaves half the range; two floors leave one quarter.
Default 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingFloorPercent.ch:
NPC與聲源之間每隔一層樓, 聽覺距離就會降低. 設為50時, 隔一層剩一半範圍; 隔兩層剩四分之一.
預設: 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingFloorPercent.cn:
NPC与声源之间每隔一层楼, 听觉距离就会降低. 设为50时, 隔一层剩一半范围; 隔两层剩四分之一.
默认: 50.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingPeripheralTi.en:
Lets NPCs notice a running or recently shooting player behind them on the same floor. At 0, this rear detection is disabled.
Default 8.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingPeripheralTi.ch:
讓NPC能察覺同一樓層中, 位於背後正在奔跑或剛開過槍的玩家. 設為0時停用背後察覺.
預設: 8.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingPeripheralTi.cn:
让NPC能察觉同一楼层中, 位于背后正在奔跑或刚开过枪的玩家. 设为0时禁用背后察觉.
默认: 8.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingRadiusPercen.en:
Scales how far NPCs hear sounds. At 50, hearing distance is halved. Indoor player sounds and NPC gunshots use half the resulting range.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingRadiusPercen.ch:
調整NPC能聽到聲音的距離. 設為50時, 聽覺距離減半. 室內的玩家聲音與NPC槍聲使用調整後範圍的一半.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingRadiusPercen.cn:
调整NPC能听到声音的距离. 设为50时, 听觉距离减半. 室内的玩家声音和NPC枪声使用调整后范围的一半.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingWallPercent.ch: 隔牆聽覺距離 (剩餘百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingWallPercent.cn: 隔墙听觉距离 (剩余百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingWallPercent_.en:
Sets how much hearing distance remains when a wall blocks the sound's path. At 50, a blocked sound can be heard from half as far away.
Default 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingWallPercent_.ch:
設定牆壁阻擋聲音路徑時保留多少聽覺距離. 設為50時, 受阻擋的聲音只能在一半的距離內被聽見.
預設: 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingWallPercent_.cn:
设置墙壁阻挡声音路径时保留多少听觉距离. 设为50时, 受阻挡的声音只能在一半的距离内被听到.
默认: 50.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Helicopter_Spotligh.en:
Sets how strongly the helicopter searchlight illuminates the ground.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Helicopter_Spotligh.ch:
設定直升機探照燈照亮地面的強度.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Helicopter_Spotligh.cn:
设置直升机探照灯照亮地面的强度.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Helicopter_Spotligh.ch: 探照燈飛行間隔 (現實分鐘)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Helicopter_Spotligh.cn: 探照灯飞行间隔 (实际分钟)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Helicopter_Spotligh.en:
Sets the minimum time between searchlight flights anywhere in the world. Shorter intervals allow more flights; the call chance still applies.
Default 20.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Helicopter_Spotligh.ch:
設定全世界任意兩次探照燈飛行之間的最短時間. 間隔越短, 可出動的架次越多; 呼叫機率仍然適用.
預設: 20.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Helicopter_Spotligh.cn:
设置全世界任意两次探照灯飞行之间的最短时间. 间隔越短, 可出动的架次越多; 呼叫概率仍然适用.
默认: 20.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Helicopter_Spotligh.en:
Sets the radius of the lit area. A larger beam covers more ground and makes it easier to be caught in the light.
Default 11.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Helicopter_Spotligh.ch:
設定照亮區域的半徑. 光束越大, 涵蓋範圍越廣, 也越容易被照到.
預設: 11.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Helicopter_Spotligh.cn:
设置照亮区域的半径. 光束越大, 覆盖范围越广, 也越容易被照到.
默认: 11.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Helicopter_Spotligh.en:
Allows moving searchlights at night or in low light. They can reveal people outdoors; cover and buildings hide them. Off disables only the searchlight.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Helicopter_Spotligh.ch:
允許在夜間或光線昏暗時出現移動的探照燈. 它們能照出戶外的人; 掩體與建築能讓人躲過照射. 關閉只會停用探照燈.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Helicopter_Spotligh.cn:
允许在夜间或光线昏暗时出现移动的探照灯. 它们能照出户外的人; 掩体和建筑能让人躲过照射. 关闭只会禁用探照灯.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.HibernateTiles_tool.en:
Beyond this distance (60-400 tiles), groups stop travelling, planning and using supplies. Members and loot stay; groups wake on approach without catching up missed time.
Default 150.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HibernateTiles_tool.ch:
超出此距離 (60-400格) 時, 團體會停止移動, 規劃與消耗物資. 成員與戰利品會保留; 有人接近時團體才會甦醒, 但不會補算錯過的時間.
預設: 150.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HibernateTiles_tool.cn:
超出该距离 (60-400格) 时, 群体会停止移动, 规划与消耗物资. 成员与战利品会保留; 有人接近时群体才会苏醒, 但不会补算错过的时间.
默认: 150.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.IdleBenchSeat_toolt.en:
Camp sitters beside a free outdoor bench sit on it instead of the ground. Off: they always sit on the ground.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.IdleBenchSeat_toolt.ch:
在營地坐下的人若旁邊有空著的戶外長椅, 會坐在長椅上而不是地上. 關閉: 他們一律坐在地上.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.IdleBenchSeat_toolt.cn:
在营地坐下的人若旁边有空着的户外长椅, 会坐在长椅上而不是地上. 关闭: 他们总是坐在地上.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.IdleCampWarmHands_t.en:
In cold weather, NPCs sitting beside a lit campfire periodically hold their hands toward it. In warm weather or without a fire, they just sit.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.IdleCampWarmHands_t.ch:
天冷時, 坐在點燃的營火旁的NPC會不時把手伸向火堆取暖. 天氣溫暖或沒有火時, 他們只是坐著.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.IdleCampWarmHands_t.cn:
天冷时, 坐在点燃的营火旁的NPC会不时把手伸向火堆取暖. 天气温暖或没有火时, 他们只是坐着.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.IdleFishingAnim_too.en:
Shore fishers cast, wait and pull their rods every 20-60 seconds. Off: they continue fishing without the rod animation.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.IdleFishingAnim_too.ch:
岸邊釣魚的人每20-60秒會拋竿, 等待並收竿. 關閉: 他們會繼續釣魚, 但不播放魚竿動畫.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.IdleFishingAnim_too.cn:
岸边钓鱼的人每20-60秒会抛竿, 等待并收竿. 关闭: 他们会继续钓鱼, 但不播放鱼竿动画.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryAuto.ch: [專家] 失血轉為負傷倒地的機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryAuto.cn: [专家] 失血转为负伤倒地的概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryAuto_tooltip.en: When an NPC would start bleeding out, this is the chance it goes injured instead. 0 means only the debug menu makes injured NPCs.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryAuto_tooltip.ch: NPC即將開始失血而死時, 改為負傷倒地的機率. 0表示只有除錯選單能讓NPC負傷倒地.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryAuto_tooltip.cn: NPC即将开始失血而死时, 改为负伤倒地的概率. 0表示只有调试菜单能让NPC负伤倒地.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryBleed.ch: [專家] NPC傷口流血速度 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryBleed.cn: [专家] NPC伤口流血速度 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryBleed_tooltip.en: How fast an NPC's open wounds bleed: scratches and cuts clot on their own, deep wounds and bullet wounds bleed until bandaged. 0 turns the bleeding off.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryBleed_tooltip.ch: NPC開放性傷口的流血速度: 刮傷與撕裂傷會自行止血, 深傷口與槍傷會持續流血直到包紮. 0會關閉流血.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryBleed_tooltip.cn: NPC开放性伤口的流血速度: 刮伤和撕裂伤会自行止血, 深伤口和枪伤会持续流血直到包扎. 0会关闭流血.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryCrawl_tooltip.en:
Downed NPCs crawl away from zombies and hostiles toward their group, and occasionally shuffle instead of lying still.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryCrawl_tooltip.ch:
倒地NPC會遠離殭屍與敵人, 朝自己的團體爬去, 偶爾也會挪動身體, 而不是一動也不動.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryCrawl_tooltip.cn:
倒地NPC会远离僵尸与敌人, 朝自己的团体爬去, 偶尔也会挪动身体, 而不是一动不动.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryDeath.ch: [專家] 每次審問提問的死亡機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryDeath.cn: [专家] 每次审问提问的死亡概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryDeath_tooltip.en: Each question put to an injured NPC can kill it. The player sees that it bled out.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryDeath_tooltip.ch: 向負傷NPC提出的每個問題都可能讓其死亡. 玩家會看到其失血而死.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryDeath_tooltip.cn: 向负伤NPC提出的每个问题都可能让其死亡. 玩家会看到其失血而死.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryDownHours.en: Unattended time before getting up (game hours)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryDownHours.ch: 無人照料自行起身的時間 (遊戲內小時)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryDownHours.cn: 无人照料自行起身的时间 (游戏内小时)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryDownHours_too.en:
Sets how long a downed NPC waits without help before getting up on its own, still limping. For example, 6 means a quarter of a game day.
Default 4.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryDownHours_too.ch:
設定倒地NPC在無人協助下, 要等多久才會自行起身 (仍會跛行). 例如, 6表示四分之一個遊戲日.
預設: 4.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryDownHours_too.cn:
设置倒地NPC在无人协助下, 要等多久才会自行起身 (仍会跛行). 例如, 6表示四分之一个游戏日.
默认: 4.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryDownHp.ch: [專家] 負傷NPC的健康 (佔滿值百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryDownHp.cn: [专家] 负伤NPC的健康 (占满值百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryDownHp_toolti.en: Health an NPC has when it goes down injured.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryEnabled_toolt.en:
NPCs that would bleed out can lie injured, be rescued, bandaged or questioned. Off keeps ordinary injury behavior; in multiplayer, only the client controlling the NPC runs its movement.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryEnabled_toolt.ch:
原本會失血而死的NPC可以負傷倒地, 被救援, 包紮或審問. 關閉時維持一般的受傷行為; 多人遊戲中, 只有控制該NPC的用戶端會執行其移動.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryEnabled_toolt.cn:
原本会失血而死的NPC可以负伤倒地, 被救援, 包扎或审问. 关闭时保持一般的受伤行为; 多人游戏中, 只有控制该NPC的客户端会执行其移动.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryLeave.en: [Expert] Distance a bandaged NPC walks away (tiles)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryLeave.ch: [專家] 包紮後NPC走開的距離 (格)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryLeave.cn: [专家] 包扎后NPC走开的距离 (格)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryLeave_tooltip.en: After you bandage an injured NPC it turns neutral and walks this far from you.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryLeave_tooltip.ch: 你替負傷NPC包紮後, 其會轉為中立, 並從你身邊走開這麼遠.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryLeave_tooltip.cn: 你为负伤NPC包扎后, 其会转为中立, 并从你身边走开这么远.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryMultiplayer.en: [Expert] Downed NPC survival on multiplayer servers
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryMultiplayer.ch: [專家] 多人伺服器上的倒地NPC存活
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryMultiplayer.cn: [专家] 多人服务器上的倒地NPC存活

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryMultiplayer_t.en:
Lets downed NPCs run on a server with connected players. The client that controls the NPC keeps its own bleed-out timers and wound list; the server only hands it a downed state. Off keeps the ordinary bleed-out in multiplayer. Single player is not affected.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryMultiplayer_t.ch:
讓倒地NPC機制在有玩家連線的伺服器上運作. 控制該NPC的用戶端會自行維護其失血計時與傷口清單; 伺服器只告知其倒地狀態. 關閉時, 多人遊戲維持一般的失血而死. 不影響單人遊戲.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryMultiplayer_t.cn:
让倒地NPC机制在有玩家连接的服务器上运行. 控制该NPC的客户端会自行维护其失血计时与伤口列表; 服务器只告知其倒地状态. 关闭时, 多人游戏保持一般的失血而死. 不影响单人游戏.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRange.en: [Expert] Rescue is blocked within this many tiles of a player
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRange.ch: [專家] 玩家幾格內禁止救援
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRange.cn: [专家] 玩家几格内禁止救援

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRange_tooltip.en: Only used when Rescues happen in front of players is off: then a teammate rescues an injured NPC only when no player is within this range or in sight.
