Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRange_tooltip.ch: 僅在「在玩家注視下救援」關閉時使用: 此時只有在此範圍內沒有玩家, 且沒有玩家看得到時, 隊友才會救援負傷NPC.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRange_tooltip.cn: 仅在“在玩家注视下救援”关闭时使用: 此时只有在此范围内没有玩家, 且没有玩家看得到时, 队友才会救援负伤NPC.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRecover.ch: 救援後的康復時間 (遊戲內小時)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRecover.cn: 救援后的康复时间 (游戏内小时)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRecover_toolt.en:
Sets the time from getting up with low health to full health and a normal walk. For example, 12 means half a game day of recovery.
Default 8.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRecover_toolt.ch:
設定從低健康值起身, 到恢復滿健康並正常行走所需的時間. 例如, 12表示康復需要半個遊戲日.
預設: 8.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRecover_toolt.cn:
设置从低健康值起身, 到恢复满健康并正常行走所需的时间. 例如, 12表示康复需要半个游戏日.
默认: 8.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRepGain.en: [Expert] Reputation gained for bandaging an injured NPC
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRepGain.ch: [專家] 包紮負傷NPC獲得的聲望
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRepGain.cn: [专家] 包扎负伤NPC获得的声望

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRepGain_toolt.en: Small reward for giving a bandage or medical item.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRepGain_toolt.ch: 給予繃帶或醫療物品的小額獎勵.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRepGain_toolt.cn: 给予绷带或医疗物品的小额奖励.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRepPenalty.en: [Expert] Reputation lost for interrogating a non-hostile NPC
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRepPenalty.ch: [專家] 審問非敵對NPC損失的聲望
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRepPenalty.cn: [专家] 审问非敌对NPC损失的声望

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRepPenalty_to.en: Taken once per injured NPC when you question a friendly, neutral or careful one. Hostile NPCs cost nothing.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRepPenalty_to.ch: 審問友善, 中立或謹慎的負傷NPC時, 每名NPC扣除一次. 審問敵對NPC不會扣除.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRepPenalty_to.cn: 审问友善, 中立或谨慎的负伤NPC时, 每名NPC扣除一次. 审问敌对NPC不会扣除.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRescueDrag_to.en:
Rescuers drag downed NPCs away before bandaging when zombies or hostiles are within 12 tiles. Off: rescue cannot start with danger that close.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRescueDrag_to.ch:
12格內有殭屍或敵人時, 救援者會先把倒地NPC拖離再包紮. 關閉: 危險如此接近時無法開始救援.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRescueDrag_to.cn:
12格内有僵尸或敌人时, 救援者会先把倒地NPC拖离再包扎. 关闭: 危险如此接近时无法开始救援.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRescueInView_.en:
Allows rescues while players are near or watching. Off: rescuers wait until all players are beyond the nearby-player distance set under expert combat.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRescueInView_.ch:
允許在玩家附近或注視時進行救援. 關閉: 救援者會等到所有玩家都超出專家戰鬥調校頁所設的附近玩家距離.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRescueInView_.cn:
允许在玩家附近或注视时进行救援. 关闭: 救援者会等到所有玩家都超出专家战斗调校页所设的附近玩家距离.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRescueRange_t.en: Teammates and friendly members of the same faction this close to the injured NPC may come to help. Helpers outside his squad also need a clear line of sight. Hostile NPCs never rescue him.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRescueRange_t.ch: 距離受傷NPC這麼近的隊友與同陣營友善成員可能會前來幫忙. 非其小隊的協助者還需要有清楚的視線. 敵對NPC絕不會救他.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRescueRange_t.cn: 距离受伤NPC这么近的队友与同阵营友善成员可能会前来帮忙. 非其小队的协助者还需要有清晰的视线. 敌对NPC绝不会救他.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRescue_toolti.en:
A teammate or friendly ally from the same bloc who can see a downed NPC walks over and bandages it. The rescued NPC stands up limping.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRescue_toolti.ch:
看得到倒地NPC的隊友或同陣營友善盟友會走過去替其包紮. 被救起的NPC會跛著腳站起來.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.InjuryRescue_toolti.cn:
看得到倒地NPC的队友或同阵营友善盟友会走过去为其包扎. 被救起的NPC会一瘸一拐地站起来.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LifecycleReloadGuar.en:
Restores NPCs after map reloads, removes leftover zombie copies out of sight and clears zombies around returning groups. Blocked groups return farther away. Off removes this protection.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LifecycleReloadGuar.ch:
地圖重新載入後恢復NPC, 在視線外移除殘留的殭屍分身, 並清除返回團體周圍的殭屍. 受阻的團體會在更遠處返回. 關閉則取消此保護.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LifecycleReloadGuar.cn:
地图重新加载后恢复NPC, 在视线外移除残留的僵尸副本, 并清除返回团体周围的僵尸. 受阻的团体会在更远处返回. 关闭则取消此保护.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootAllowRareFromPr.ch: 編輯器設定檔中的稀有物品
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootAllowRareFromPr.cn: 编辑器档案中的稀有物品

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootAllowRareFromPr.en:
On: Creator profiles keep their chosen rare gear. Off: custom sledgehammers, crafting heads and heavy armor are replaced with common gear at spawn.
Default off.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootAllowRareFromPr.ch:
開啟: 編輯器設定檔保留其選定的稀有裝備. 關閉: 生成時, 自訂的大錘, 製作用工具頭與重型護甲會換成普通裝備.
預設: 關閉.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootAllowRareFromPr.cn:
开启: 编辑器档案保留其选定的稀有装备. 关闭: 生成时, 自定义的大锤, 制作用工具头和重型护甲会替换为普通装备.
默认: 关闭.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcAmmoPercent.en: [Expert] NPC loot: magazines and ammo (percent of the loot setting)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcAmmoPercent.ch: [專家] NPC戰利品: 彈匣與彈藥 (戰利品設定的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcAmmoPercent.cn: [专家] NPC战利品: 弹匣与弹药 (战利品设置的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcAmmoPercent_.en:
Multiplies the NPC loot percent for dropped magazines and loose ammo. For example, 50 halves ammo drops.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcAmmoPercent_.ch:
以此倍率調整掉落彈匣與散裝彈藥的NPC戰利品百分比. 例如, 50會使彈藥掉落減半.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcAmmoPercent_.cn:
以此倍率调整掉落弹匣和散装弹药的NPC战利品百分比. 例如, 50会使弹药掉落减半.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcArmorPercent.en: [Expert] NPC loot: armor and clothing (percent of the loot setting)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcArmorPercent.ch: [專家] NPC戰利品: 護甲與衣物 (戰利品設定的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcArmorPercent.cn: [专家] NPC战利品: 护甲与衣物 (战利品设置的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcArmorPercent.en:
Multiplies the NPC loot percent for worn armor and clothing, including rare armor. For example, 50 halves armor drops.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcArmorPercent.ch:
以此倍率調整身上穿戴的護甲與衣物 (包括稀有護甲) 的NPC戰利品百分比. 例如, 50會使護甲掉落減半.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcArmorPercent.cn:
以此倍率调整身上穿戴的护甲和衣物 (包括稀有护甲) 的NPC战利品百分比. 例如, 50会使护甲掉落减半.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcDropPercent.en: NPC loot: how much of their gear stays on bodies (percent)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcDropPercent.ch: NPC戰利品: 屍體上保留多少裝備 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcDropPercent.cn: NPC战利品: 尸体上保留多少装备 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcDropPercent_.en:
Chance for each carried item to stay on an NPC's body. 100 drops all items; lower values drop fewer. Fixed NPC weapon drop chances take priority. Use wear below for poorer gear.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcDropPercent_.ch:
NPC攜帶的每件物品留在其屍體上的機率. 100表示所有物品都會掉落; 數值越低, 掉落越少. 固定的NPC武器掉落機率優先. 若想讓裝備變差, 請改用下方的磨損設定.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcDropPercent_.cn:
NPC携带的每件物品留在其尸体上的概率. 100表示所有物品都会掉落; 数值越低, 掉落越少. 固定的NPC武器掉落概率优先. 若想让装备变差, 请改用下方的磨损设置.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcSuppliesPerc.en: [Expert] NPC loot: supplies and other items (percent of the loot setting)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcSuppliesPerc.ch: [專家] NPC戰利品: 補給與其他物品 (戰利品設定的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcSuppliesPerc.cn: [专家] NPC战利品: 补给与其他物品 (战利品设置的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcSuppliesPerc.en:
Multiplies the NPC loot percent for food, medicine, tools and pocket items; identity cards always stay. For example, 50 halves supply drops.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcSuppliesPerc.ch:
以此倍率調整食物, 藥品, 工具與口袋物品的NPC戰利品百分比; 身分證一律保留. 例如, 50會使補給掉落減半.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcSuppliesPerc.cn:
以此倍率调整食物, 药品, 工具和口袋物品的NPC战利品百分比; 身份证一律保留. 例如, 50会使补给掉落减半.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWeaponPercen.en: [Expert] NPC loot: weapons (percent of the loot setting)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWeaponPercen.ch: [專家] NPC戰利品: 武器 (戰利品設定的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWeaponPercen.cn: [专家] NPC战利品: 武器 (战利品设置的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWeaponPercen.en:
Multiplies the NPC loot percent for guns and melee weapons. Ignored while NPC weapon drop chance is a fixed choice. For example, 50 halves weapon drops.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWeaponPercen.ch:
以此倍率調整槍械與近戰武器的NPC戰利品百分比. NPC武器掉落機率設為固定選項時忽略此項. 例如, 50會使武器掉落減半.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWeaponPercen.cn:
以此倍率调整枪械和近战武器的NPC战利品百分比. NPC武器掉落概率设为固定选项时忽略此项. 例如, 50会使武器掉落减半.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWearPercent.en: NPC loot: how worn out dropped gear is (percent)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWearPercent.ch: NPC戰利品: 掉落裝備的磨損程度 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWearPercent.cn: NPC战利品: 掉落装备的磨损程度 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWearPercent_.en:
Wear added to gear and ammo on death. 0 adds no wear; 100 is full. Fixed NPC weapon conditions take priority. Guns can still drop broken: set Dropped weapon condition for working guns.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWearPercent_.ch:
NPC死亡時加在裝備與彈藥上的磨損. 0表示不增加磨損; 100為完全磨損. 固定的NPC武器狀態優先. 槍械仍可能以損壞狀態掉落: 若要掉落可用的槍械, 請設定「掉落武器狀態」.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWearPercent_.cn:
NPC死亡时施加在装备和弹药上的磨损. 0表示不增加磨损; 100为完全磨损. 固定的NPC武器状态优先. 枪械仍可能以损坏状态掉落: 若要掉落可用的枪械, 请设置“掉落武器状态”.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootRareDropPercent.ch: 稀有護甲掉落機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootRareDropPercent.cn: 稀有护甲掉落概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootRareDropPercent.en:
Only military and special-response crews can drop rare armor, dirty and at 10-40 percent condition. 0 stops these drops. Sledgehammers and crafting components never drop.
Default 5.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootRareDropPercent.ch:
只有軍方與特別應變小組會掉落稀有護甲, 且皆為髒汙狀態, 狀態僅剩一成至四成. 設為0則停止此類掉落. 大錘與製作零件永遠不會掉落.
預設: 5.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootRareDropPercent.cn:
只有军方和特别应变小组会掉落稀有护甲, 且都是脏污的, 状态仅剩一成至四成. 设为0则停止此类掉落. 大锤和制作零件永远不会掉落.
默认: 5.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewBreach.ch: [專家] 近戰團夥: 持斧破門模組
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewBreach.cn: [专家] 近战团伙: 持斧破门模块

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewBreach_too.en: A fighter holding an axe cuts through doors and windows faster and does it when checking a noise. The normal courtesy rules still apply.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewBreach_too.ch: 持斧的戰士劈開門窗的速度更快, 調查聲響時也會這麼做. 一般的禮節規則仍然適用.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewBreach_too.cn: 持斧的战士劈开门窗的速度更快, 调查声响时也会这么做. 一般的礼节规则仍然适用.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewCaution.ch: [專家] 近戰團夥: 謹慎撤退模組
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewCaution.cn: [专家] 近战团伙: 谨慎撤退模块

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewCautionCro.en: [Expert] Melee crew: zombies that trigger a retreat
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewCautionCro.ch: [專家] 近戰團夥: 觸發撤退的殭屍數
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewCautionCro.cn: [专家] 近战团伙: 触发撤退的僵尸数

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewCautionCro.en: How many zombies near a crew member make it retreat. Normal fighters need five.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewCautionCro.ch: 團夥成員附近有多少殭屍時會撤退. 一般戰士需要五隻.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewCautionCro.cn: 团伙成员附近有多少僵尸时会撤退. 一般战士需要五只.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewCaution_to.en: Breaks contact early when a few zombies close in, using the existing withdraw behaviour with a lower crowd threshold.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewCaution_to.ch: 幾隻殭屍逼近時就提早脫離交戰, 沿用既有的撤退行為, 但觸發的殭屍數量門檻較低.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewCaution_to.cn: 几只僵尸逼近时就提前脱离交战, 沿用现有的撤退行为, 但触发的僵尸数量门槛较低.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewEnabled.ch: [專家] 近戰團夥 (測試陣營與模組)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewEnabled.cn: [专家] 近战团伙 (测试阵营与模块)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewEnabled_to.en: Master switch. On: the Sawmill Hands crew can spawn and the five melee modules work. Off: the faction is hidden from spawning, the Creator and the debug spawner, and every melee module is inert.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewEnabled_to.ch: 總開關. 開啟: 鋸木廠工人團夥可以生成, 五個近戰模組也會運作. 關閉: 這個陣營不會生成, 也不會出現在編輯器與除錯生成器中, 所有近戰模組都不起作用.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewEnabled_to.cn: 总开关. 开启: 锯木厂工人团伙可以生成, 五个近战模块也会生效. 关闭: 该阵营不会生成, 也不会出现在编辑器和调试生成器中, 所有近战模块都不起作用.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewFlank.ch: [專家] 近戰團夥: 雙人包夾模組
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewFlank.cn: [专家] 近战团伙: 双人包夹模块

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewFlank_tool.en: In a melee group one member engages and the others circle round to the far side of the target.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewFlank_tool.ch: 近戰團體中由一名成員正面交戰, 其他人繞到目標的另一側.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewFlank_tool.cn: 近战团体中由一名成员正面交战, 其他人绕到目标的另一侧.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewFootwork.ch: [專家] 近戰團夥: 步法模組
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewFootwork.cn: [专家] 近战团伙: 步法模块

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewFootwork_t.en: Sidestep between swings, back off when zombies press in, step back in afterwards. Tuned for pairs and groups.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewFootwork_t.ch: 揮擊之間側步閃避, 殭屍逼近時後退, 之後再踏步回來. 針對兩人組與團體調校.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewFootwork_t.cn: 挥击之间侧步闪避, 僵尸逼近时后退, 之后再踏步回来. 针对两人组和团体调校.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewIntimidate.ch: [專家] 近戰團夥: 威嚇逼近模組
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewIntimidate.cn: [专家] 近战团伙: 威吓逼近模块

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewIntimidate.en: Walks up on a player, shouts the warning from range, then closes in. The normal warn-before-strike rules still decide when the first blow may land.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewIntimidate.ch: 走向玩家, 在一段距離外喊出警告, 然後逼近. 何時可以落下第一擊, 仍由一般的「先警告再攻擊」規則決定.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeCrewIntimidate.cn: 走向玩家, 在一段距离外喊出警告, 然后逼近. 何时可以落下第一击, 仍由一般的“先警告再攻击”规则决定.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeFootwork_toolt.en: In melee, NPCs step back while swinging when zombies press or outnumber them, and step in when a lone zombie is within reach or backing off. Decided each swing from the zombies' positions and facing.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeFootwork_toolt.ch: 近戰時, 當殭屍逼近或數量多於NPC, NPC會邊揮擊邊後退; 當單獨一隻殭屍在攻擊範圍內或正在後退時, NPC會向前踏步. 每次揮擊都會依殭屍的位置與朝向決定.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeFootwork_toolt.cn: 近战时, 当僵尸逼近或数量多于NPC, NPC会边挥击边后退; 当单独一只僵尸在攻击范围内或正在后退时, NPC会向前踏步. 每次挥击都会根据僵尸的位置与朝向决定.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeKiteCrowd.en: [Expert] Zombies that make an NPC step back

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeKiteCrowd_tool.en: How many zombies facing an NPC within the step-back radius it takes before the NPC steps back between swings. 0 turns stepping back off.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeKiteCrowd_tool.ch: 後退半徑內面向NPC的殭屍需達到多少隻, NPC才會在揮擊之間後退. 設為0會關閉後退.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeKiteCrowd_tool.cn: 后退半径内面向NPC的僵尸需达到多少只, NPC才会在挥击之间后退. 设为0会关闭后退.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeKiteTiles_tool.en: How far around an NPC zombies are counted for melee footwork.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeKiteTiles_tool.ch: NPC周圍多遠範圍內的殭屍會計入近戰步法判定.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeKiteTiles_tool.cn: NPC周围多远范围内的僵尸会计入近战步法判定.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeStepBack.ch: [專家] 後退距離 (十分之一格)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeStepBack.cn: [专家] 后退距离 (十分之一格)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeStepBack_toolt.en: How far an NPC steps back between swings. It never steps out of weapon reach. 16 is 1.6 tiles.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeStepBack_toolt.ch: NPC在揮擊之間後退的距離. 它絕不會退出武器的攻擊範圍. 16即1.6格.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeStepBack_toolt.cn: NPC在挥击之间后退的距离. 它绝不会退出武器的攻击范围. 16即1.6格.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeStepIn.ch: [專家] 前踏距離 (十分之一格)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeStepIn.cn: [专家] 前踏距离 (十分之一格)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeStepIn_tooltip.en: How far an NPC steps toward a lone zombie that is in reach or backing off. 11 is 1.1 tiles.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeStepIn_tooltip.ch: NPC朝攻擊範圍內或正在後退的單獨殭屍前踏的距離. 11即1.1格.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MeleeStepIn_tooltip.cn: NPC朝攻击范围内或正在后退的单独僵尸前踏的距离. 11即1.1格.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ModuleFear_tooltip.en:
Civilians, families and workers avoid distant zombies and flee crowds for at least 30 seconds, fighting if cornered. Soldiers, police, criminals and hardened members stay steadier.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ModuleFear_tooltip.ch:
平民, 家庭與工人會避開遠處的殭屍, 遇到殭屍群會逃跑至少30秒, 被逼入絕境時才會反擊. 士兵, 警察, 罪犯與身經百戰的成員較為鎮定.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ModuleFear_tooltip.cn:
平民, 家庭与工人会避开远处的僵尸, 遇到僵尸群会逃跑至少30秒, 被逼入绝境时才会反击. 士兵, 警察, 罪犯与久经沙场的成员较为镇定.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.MuzzleFlash_tooltip.en:
Shows weapon-sized flashes and nearby ground light when NPCs fire. Suppressed weapons do not flash. Gunfire sounds and casings are unchanged.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MuzzleFlash_tooltip.ch:
NPC開火時顯示與武器大小相符的火光, 並照亮附近地面. 裝有滅音器的武器不會產生火光. 槍聲與彈殼不受影響.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.MuzzleFlash_tooltip.cn:
NPC开火时显示与武器大小相符的闪光, 并照亮附近地面. 装有消音器的武器不会产生闪光. 枪声和弹壳不受影响.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.NPCsReanimate_toolt.en:
NPCs infected by zombie bites or attacks can rise in their own clothes. The game's Transmission, Mortality and Reanimate settings still apply.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NPCsReanimate_toolt.ch:
被殭屍咬傷或攻擊而感染的NPC會穿著自己的衣服屍變起身. 遊戲的「傳染」, 「致死時間」與「屍變時間」設定仍然適用.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NPCsReanimate_toolt.cn:
被僵尸咬伤或攻击而感染的NPC会穿着自己的衣服尸变起身. 游戏的“传染”, “致死时间”和“尸体复活”设置仍然适用.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.NeighbourGroups_too.en:
Blocks new travelling groups when this many already live within 240 tiles. From day 4, the limit drops by one but never below one.
Default 4.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NeighbourGroups_too.ch:
240格內已有此數量的漫遊團體時, 不再出現新的漫遊團體. 從第4天起, 上限減少1, 但不會低於1.
預設: 4.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NeighbourGroups_too.cn:
240格内已有该数量的漫游群体时, 不再出现新的漫游群体. 从第4天起, 上限减少1, 但不会低于1.
默认: 4.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.NonPvpZoneShield_to.en:
On: NPCs do not start fights in non-PvP zones, but still retaliate against an attacker. Off: NPCs may attack there. Safehouses protect you either way.
Default off.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NonPvpZoneShield_to.ch:
開啟: NPC不會在非PvP區域主動挑起戰鬥, 但仍會反擊攻擊者. 關閉: NPC可能在這些區域發動攻擊. 無論開關, 安全屋都會保護你.
預設: 關閉.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NonPvpZoneShield_to.cn:
开启: NPC不会在非PvP区域主动挑起战斗, 但仍会反击攻击者. 关闭: NPC可能在这些区域发动攻击. 无论开关, 安全屋都会保护你.
默认: 关闭.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcArmorVsZombies.en: [Expert] NPC armour and clothing protection (all hits)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcArmorVsZombies.ch: [專家] NPC護甲與衣物防護 (所有命中)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcArmorVsZombies.cn: [专家] NPC护甲与衣物防护 (所有命中)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcArmorVsZombies_t.en: The base armour system for NPCs, with the same rules a player gets. It is not a Creator module. Every hit on an NPC (zombie bites and scratches, melee, bullets; from NPCs and from players) rolls against the matching protection of what is worn on the struck body part: bite, scratch or bullet defense. 100 always blocks, 0 never does, layers add up to 100. A blocked hit does no damage and cannot wound or infect, and the clothing tears. Body parts with no protection take the normal damage. Off ignores worn clothing. Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcArmorVsZombies_t.ch: NPC的基礎護甲系統, 規則與玩家相同. 這不是編輯器模組. NPC受到的每次命中 (殭屍啃咬與抓傷, 近戰, 子彈; 來自NPC或玩家) 都會依受擊部位所穿戴衣物的對應防護進行判定: 咬傷, 抓傷或子彈防禦. 100必定擋下, 0永遠擋不下, 多層衣物會疊加至100. 被擋下的命中不造成傷害, 也不會造成傷口或感染, 但衣物會破損. 沒有防護的身體部位照常受傷. 關閉時忽略身上穿戴的衣物. 預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcArmorVsZombies_t.cn: NPC的基础护甲系统, 规则与玩家相同. 这不是编辑器模块. NPC受到的每次命中 (僵尸啃咬与抓伤, 近战, 子弹; 来自NPC或玩家) 都会按受击部位所穿戴衣物的对应防护进行判定: 咬伤, 抓伤或子弹防御. 100必定挡下, 0永远挡不下, 多层衣物会叠加至100. 被挡下的命中不造成伤害, 也不会造成伤口或感染, 但衣物会破损. 没有防护的身体部位照常受伤. 关闭时忽略身上穿戴的衣物. 默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcDamagePercent_to.en:
Scales NPC melee and gun damage to players. At 50, each hit deals half the original damage; 100 is the original amount.
Default 72.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcDamagePercent_to.ch:
調整NPC對玩家的近戰與槍械傷害. 設為50時, 每次命中造成原本一半的傷害; 100為原始數值.
預設: 72.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcDamagePercent_to.cn:
调整NPC对玩家的近战和枪械伤害. 设为50时, 每次命中造成原本一半的伤害; 100为原始数值.
默认: 72.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcDamageTakenPerce.en: How hard bullets, melee hits, shoves and zombie bites land on NPCs, on top of the NPC maximum health setting. At 100 guns, shoves and bites cost what they used to, 130 is 30%% more. Melee hits are priced so that the defaults keep the old number of swings. This is the damage NPCs receive, not what they deal to players (see NPC damage output). Default 130.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcDamageTakenPerce.ch: 子彈, 近戰攻擊, 推擠與殭屍咬傷對NPC造成的傷害強度, 疊加在NPC最大生命值設定之上. 設為100時, 槍擊, 推擠與咬傷的傷害與以往相同, 130則增加30%%傷害. 近戰攻擊的傷害經過調整, 使預設值下擊倒所需的揮擊次數與以往相同. 這是NPC受到的傷害, 而非NPC對玩家造成的傷害 (見「NPC對玩家的傷害」). 預設: 130.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcDamageTakenPerce.cn: 子弹, 近战攻击, 推挤和僵尸咬伤对NPC造成的伤害强度, 叠加在NPC最大生命值设置之上. 设为100时, 枪击, 推挤和咬伤的伤害与以往相同, 130则增加30%%伤害. 近战攻击的伤害经过调整, 使默认值下击倒所需的挥击次数与以往相同. 这是NPC受到的伤害, 而非NPC对玩家造成的伤害 (见“NPC对玩家的伤害”). 默认: 130.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcHealthLegacy.ch: [專家] NPC生命值: 原始數值
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcHealthLegacy.cn: [专家] NPC生命值: 原始数值

Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcHealthLegacy_too.en: Switches the NPC health rebalance off: original maximum health, original hits needed to put an NPC down, original bleeding and regeneration. Default off.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcHealthLegacy_too.ch: 關閉NPC生命值平衡調整: 恢復原始的最大生命值, 擊倒NPC所需的原始命中次數, 原始的流血與生命值恢復. 預設: 關閉.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcHealthLegacy_too.cn: 关闭NPC生命值平衡调整: 恢复原始的最大生命值, 击倒NPC所需的原始命中次数, 原始的流血和生命值恢复. 默认: 关闭.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcHealthPercent_to.en:
Scales each survivor's original health. At 80, they have four-fifths of their usual health; profession differences still apply.
Default 98.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcHealthPercent_to.ch:
調整每位倖存者的原始生命值. 設為80時, 他們擁有平常五分之四的生命值; 職業差異仍然適用.
預設: 98.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcHealthPercent_to.cn:
调整每位幸存者的原始生命值. 设为80时, 他们拥有平常五分之四的生命值; 职业差异仍然适用.
默认: 98.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcRegenPercent_too.en: How fast a resting NPC recovers health. 100 is the original 1.5%% of maximum health per game hour, 50 is half of that. Only an NPC that has been out of the fight for two minutes and has no open wound recovers. 0 turns recovery off. Default 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcRegenPercent_too.ch: 休息中的NPC恢復生命值的速度. 100為原本的每遊戲內小時恢復最大生命值的1.5%%, 50為其一半. 只有脫離戰鬥滿兩分鐘且沒有開放性傷口的NPC才會恢復. 0會關閉恢復. 預設: 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcRegenPercent_too.cn: 休息中的NPC恢复生命值的速度. 100为原本的每游戏内小时恢复最大生命值的1.5%%, 50为其一半. 只有脱离战斗满两分钟且没有开放性伤口的NPC才会恢复. 0会关闭恢复. 默认: 50.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OfflineLootPercent.ch: 遠方搜刮保留的戰利品 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OfflineLootPercent.cn: 远方搜刮保留的战利品 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OfflineLootPercent_.en:
Groups scavenging away from players keep this share of each house's loot value. They stash it at a base or carry it if homeless. 0 disables this loot gain.
Default 25.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OfflineLootPercent_.ch:
在遠離玩家處搜刮的團體, 會保留每棟房屋戰利品價值的這個比例. 他們會把戰利品存放在基地, 沒有基地則隨身攜帶. 0則停用此戰利品收益.
預設: 25.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OfflineLootPercent_.cn:
在远离玩家处搜刮的团体, 会保留每栋房屋战利品价值的这个比例. 他们会把战利品存放在基地, 没有基地则随身携带. 0则禁用此战利品收益.
默认: 25.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersAdvantage.ch: 脅迫優勢 (正常值的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersAdvantage.cn: 胁迫优势 (正常值的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersAdvantage_too.en:
How much weapons, loaded ammo, armour, numbers, distance and clear sight affect obedience. At 0, these advantages do not matter; at 300, they dominate the decision.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersAdvantage_too.ch:
武器, 已裝填彈藥, 護甲, 人數, 距離與清晰視野對服從度的影響程度. 設為0時, 這些優勢毫無作用; 設為300時, 它們將主導決定.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersAdvantage_too.cn:
武器, 已装填弹药, 护甲, 人数, 距离和清晰视野对服从度的影响程度. 设为0时, 这些优势毫无作用; 设为300时, 它们将主导决定.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersCarefulMinute.ch: 搶劫受害者的戒心 (現實分鐘)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersCarefulMinute.cn: 抢劫受害者的戒心 (现实分钟)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersCarefulMinute.en:
Robbed NPCs flee, then remember you as dangerous and keep their distance for this long. At 0, this caution is not remembered.
Default 15.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersCarefulMinute.ch:
遭搶劫的NPC會逃跑, 之後在這段時間內記得你很危險並與你保持距離. 設為0時, 不會記住這份戒心.
預設: 15.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersCarefulMinute.cn:
遭抢劫的NPC会逃跑, 之后在这段时间内记得你很危险并与你保持距离. 设为0时, 不会记住这份戒心.
默认: 15.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersChance.ch: 命令服從度 (正常值的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersChance.cn: 命令服从度 (正常值的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersChance_toolti.en:
Scales the chance an NPC obeys a spoken order. At 0, nobody obeys; at 200, obedience is twice as likely. Civilians are easier to command than armed factions.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersChance_toolti.ch:
調整NPC服從口頭命令的機率. 設為0時, 沒有人會服從; 設為200時, 服從機率加倍. 平民比武裝陣營更容易指揮.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersChance_toolti.cn:
调整NPC服从口头命令的概率. 设为0时, 没有人会服从; 设为200时, 服从概率加倍. 平民比武装阵营更容易指挥.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersEnabled_toolt.en:
Lets you order NPCs to raise their hands, drop weapons, leave or follow. Obedience depends on fear, faction, weapons and group size.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersEnabled_toolt.ch:
允許你命令NPC舉起雙手, 放下武器, 離開或跟隨. 是否服從取決於恐懼程度, 陣營, 武器與團體人數.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersEnabled_toolt.cn:
允许你命令NPC举起双手, 放下武器, 离开或跟随. 是否服从取决于恐惧程度, 阵营, 武器和团体人数.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersFailFight.en: Fight chance after a failed hold-up (percent)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersFailFight.ch: 脅迫失敗後的反擊機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersFailFight.cn: 胁迫失败后的反击概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersFailFight_too.en:
Chance the target and their group attack after refusing hands-up, drop-weapon or hold-up orders. At 100, they always attack; at 0, they only refuse.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersFailFight_too.ch:
目標及其團體拒絕舉手, 放下武器或脅迫命令後發動攻擊的機率. 設為100時, 他們一律會攻擊; 設為0時, 他們只會拒絕.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersFailFight_too.cn:
目标及其团体拒绝举手, 放下武器或胁迫命令后发动攻击的概率. 设为100时, 他们总会攻击; 设为0时, 他们只会拒绝.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersGroupSurrende.ch: 團體遭脅迫時的個別反應
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersGroupSurrende.cn: 团体遭胁迫时的个别反应

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersGroupSurrende.en:
When one member surrenders, each groupmate chooses whether to obey, fight or flee after a warning. Off: the whole group always follows the surrendering member.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersGroupSurrende.ch:
當一名成員投降時, 每位同伴會在警告後各自選擇服從, 戰鬥或逃跑. 關閉: 整個團體一律跟隨投降的成員.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersGroupSurrende.cn:
当一名成员投降时, 每位同伴会在警告后各自选择服从, 战斗或逃跑. 关闭: 整个团体总是跟随投降的成员.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersSurrenderSeco.en:
Longest time an NPC keeps their hands up before lowering them and carrying on.
Default 90.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersSurrenderSeco.ch:
NPC舉著雙手的最長時間, 之後會放下雙手並繼續原本的行動.
預設: 90.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersSurrenderSeco.cn:
NPC举着双手的最长时间, 之后会放下双手并继续原来的行动.
默认: 90.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersZombieTiles.ch: 中斷投降的殭屍距離 (格)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersZombieTiles.cn: 中断投降的僵尸距离 (格)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersZombieTiles_t.en:
A surrendering NPC lowers their hands and reacts when a zombie comes within this distance.
Default 4.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersZombieTiles_t.ch:
殭屍進入此距離內時, 投降中的NPC會放下雙手並做出反應.
預設: 4.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OrdersZombieTiles_t.cn:
僵尸进入此距离内时, 投降中的NPC会放下双手并做出反应.
默认: 4.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutplayStagger_tool.en:
Your shoves briefly stagger NPCs, and melee hits interrupt their next swing. A staggered NPC cannot finish its attack.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutplayStagger_tool.ch:
你的推擊會讓NPC短暫踉蹌, 近戰命中則會打斷他們的下一次揮擊. 踉蹌中的NPC無法完成攻擊.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutplayStagger_tool.cn:
你的推搡会让NPC短暂踉跄, 近战命中则会打断他们的下一次挥击. 踉跄中的NPC无法完成攻击.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsBuildBudget.ch: [專家] 每輪前哨站建造工作量
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsBuildBudget.cn: [专家] 每轮哨所建造工作量

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsBuildBudget.en:
Maximum work units per round. Higher values finish sooner but may increase server stalls. Multiplayer streaming pauses still apply.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsBuildBudget.ch:
每輪最多的工作單位. 數值越高完成越快, 但可能增加伺服器卡頓. 多人模式的串流暫停仍然適用.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsBuildBudget.cn:
每轮最多的工作单位. 数值越高完成越快, 但可能增加服务器卡顿. 多人模式的流式加载暂停仍然适用.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsCompoundSpa.en:
Minimum distance between new walled compounds. Recently expired sites count until cleared. Small camps and fixed checkpoints are unchanged.
Default 500.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsCompoundSpa.ch:
新圍牆大院之間的最小距離. 最近到期的據點在清除前仍會計入. 小型營地與固定檢查站不受影響.
預設: 500.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsCompoundSpa.cn:
新围墙大院之间的最小距离. 最近到期的据点在清除前仍会计入. 小型营地和固定检查站不受影响.
默认: 500.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsLightsOn.ch: 前哨站火堆與燈具保持點亮
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsLightsOn.cn: 哨所火堆与灯具保持点亮

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsLightsOn_to.en:
Keeps campfires, lamps and generators in outposts, compounds, checkpoints and camps burning and switched on, refuelled while a player is near. Off leaves them as built.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsLightsOn_to.ch:
讓前哨站, 大院, 檢查站與營地中的營火, 燈具和發電機保持燃燒與開啟, 玩家在附近時會補充燃料. 關閉則維持建造時的狀態.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsLightsOn_to.cn:
让哨所, 大院, 检查站和营地中的营火, 灯具和发电机保持燃烧和开启, 玩家在附近时会补充燃料. 关闭则保持建造时的状态.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsMaxCompound.en:
Limits new walled compounds. At 0, none are proposed. Existing sites, small camps, checkpoints and admin-built sites stay.
Default 1.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsMaxCompound.ch:
限制新圍牆大院的數量. 設為0時不會規劃任何新大院. 現有據點, 小型營地, 檢查站與管理員建造的據點都會保留.
預設: 1.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsMaxCompound.cn:
限制新围墙大院的数量. 设为0时不会规划任何新大院. 现有据点, 小型营地, 检查站和管理员建造的据点都会保留.
默认: 1.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsStreamHold.en: Outpost building pause after travel (real seconds)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsStreamHold.ch: 移動後暫停前哨站建造 (現實秒數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsStreamHold.cn: 移动后暂停哨所建造 (实际秒数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsStreamHold_.en:
Pauses multiplayer wall and structure work until players stop crossing map sections. At least 5 seconds protects loading clients; new joins keep a separate 30-second pause.
Default 5.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsStreamHold_.ch:
暫停多人遊戲的牆壁與建築施工, 直到玩家不再跨越地圖區塊. 至少5秒可保護正在載入的客戶端; 新加入的玩家另有30秒的暫停.
預設: 5.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsStreamHold_.cn:
暂停多人游戏的墙壁和建筑施工, 直到玩家不再跨越地图区块. 至少5秒可保护正在加载的客户端; 新加入的玩家另有30秒的暂停.
默认: 5.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsStructureLo.ch: 前哨站移除損毀門檻 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsStructureLo.cn: 哨所移除损毁阈值 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsStructureLo.en:
Share of destroyed or burned walls, doors, windows and fences that causes an outpost to be removed. At 0, this damage-based removal is disabled.
Default 40.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsStructureLo.ch:
被摧毀或燒毀的牆壁, 門, 窗戶與圍欄達到此比例時, 前哨站會被移除. 設為0時停用這種依損毀移除的機制.
預設: 40.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsStructureLo.cn:
被摧毁或烧毁的墙壁, 门, 窗户和围栏达到此比例时, 哨所会被移除. 设为0时禁用这种基于损毁的移除机制.
默认: 40.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsSurvivorHol.en:
Allows cautious survivor communities to hold outposts alongside hostile crews. They warn strangers away but never send hunting parties. Off leaves only hostile holders.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsSurvivorHol.ch:
允許謹慎的倖存者社群與敵對隊伍一同據守前哨站. 他們會警告陌生人離開, 但絕不會派出狩獵隊. 關閉則只剩敵對的據守者.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsSurvivorHol.cn:
允许谨慎的幸存者社群与敌对队伍一同据守哨所. 他们会警告陌生人离开, 但绝不会派出狩猎队. 关闭则只剩敌对的据守者.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicContagion.ch: [專家] 恐慌在倖存者間蔓延
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicContagion.cn: [专家] 恐慌在幸存者间蔓延

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicContagion_tool.en: A frightened survivor makes the people around them more frightened for 30 to 60 seconds: their own group first, strangers within about 12 tiles less. Soldiers and police nearby calm them down. Off keeps every survivor's fright separate.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicContagion_tool.ch: 受驚的倖存者會讓周圍的人更加恐懼, 持續30到60秒: 自己的團體首當其衝, 約12格內的陌生人受影響較小. 附近的士兵與警察能讓他們冷靜下來. 關閉則每個倖存者的恐懼各自獨立.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicContagion_tool.cn: 受惊的幸存者会让周围的人更加恐惧, 持续30到60秒: 自己的团体首当其冲, 约12格内的陌生人受影响较小. 附近的士兵与警察能让他们冷静下来. 关闭则每个幸存者的恐惧各自独立.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicFirstDays_tool.en:
Civilians, families and workers flee zombies, flinch at loud events and spread fear early in the outbreak. Soldiers, police and criminals stay steadier. Requires Civilian fear of zombies.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicFirstDays_tool.ch:
疫情初期, 平民, 家庭與工人會逃離殭屍, 遇到巨大聲響會受驚, 並散播恐懼. 士兵, 警察與罪犯較為鎮定. 需開啟「平民懼怕殭屍」.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicFirstDays_tool.cn:
疫情初期, 平民, 家庭与工人会逃离僵尸, 遇到巨大声响会受惊, 并散播恐惧. 士兵, 警察与罪犯较为镇定. 需开启“平民惧怕僵尸”.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicLengthDays.ch: 初期恐慌消退時間 (遊戲內天數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicLengthDays.cn: 初期恐慌消退时间 (游戏内天数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicLengthDays_too.en:
Stretches or shortens the early-outbreak panic curve. Fright is strongest at the start and nearly gone by this many days after the outbreak.
Default 12.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicLengthDays_too.ch:
拉長或縮短疫情初期的恐慌曲線. 恐懼在一開始最強烈, 到疫情爆發後這麼多天時幾乎消失.
預設: 12.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicLengthDays_too.cn:
拉长或缩短疫情初期的恐慌曲线. 恐惧在一开始最强烈, 到疫情爆发后这么多天时几乎消失.
默认: 12.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicStrength_toolt.en: 100%% is the standard curve: full fright on days 0 and 1, then easing off. Lower values make survivors calmer, higher values keep them frightened longer. 0 turns the panic off.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicStrength_toolt.ch: 100%%為標準曲線: 第0天與第1天完全驚恐, 之後逐漸緩和. 數值越低, 倖存者越冷靜; 數值越高, 他們驚恐得越久. 設為0會關閉恐慌.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PanicStrength_toolt.cn: 100%%为标准曲线: 第0天与第1天完全惊恐, 之后逐渐缓和. 数值越低, 幸存者越冷静; 数值越高, 他们惊恐得越久. 设为0会关闭恐慌.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyAwayMinutes.ch: 離開團體時限 (現實分鐘)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyAwayMinutes.cn: 离开群体时限 (现实分钟)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyAwayMinutes_to.en:
Sets how long you can stay far from your NPC group before it leaves you behind and your membership ends.
Default 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyAwayMinutes_to.ch:
設定你可以遠離NPC團體多久, 超過後團體會丟下你, 你的成員身分也隨之結束.
預設: 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyAwayMinutes_to.cn:
设置你可以远离NPC群体多久, 超过后群体会丢下你, 你的成员身份也随之结束.
默认: 10.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyEnabled_toolti.en:
Lets you ask a friendly NPC group to take you in. The group keeps its own plans, offers jobs and warnings, and can leave you behind if you stay away.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyEnabled_toolti.ch:
讓你可以請友善的NPC團體收留你. 團體會保有自己的計畫, 提供任務與警告, 若你離開太久也可能丟下你.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyEnabled_toolti.cn:
让你可以请友善的NPC群体收留你. 群体会保留自己的计划, 提供任务与警告, 如果你离开太久也可能丢下你.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyMaxSize.ch: 可加入團體人數上限 (人)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyMaxSize.cn: 可加入群体人数上限 (人)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyMaxSize_toolti.en:
A group at this size refuses new members. NPCs and players both count toward the limit.
Default 6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyMaxSize_toolti.ch:
團體達到此人數時會拒絕新成員. NPC與玩家都計入上限.
預設: 6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyMaxSize_toolti.cn:
群体达到该人数时会拒绝新成员. NPC与玩家都计入上限.
默认: 6.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyMinOpinion.ch: 加入團體所需好感度 (點數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyMinOpinion.cn: 加入群体所需好感度 (点数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyMinOpinion_too.en:
Sets the leader's minimum opinion of you before you can join. Soldiers and raiders require more; gentler groups, such as families, require less.
Default 20.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyMinOpinion_too.ch:
設定首領對你的好感度至少要多少, 你才能加入. 士兵與掠奪者要求更高; 較溫和的團體 (例如家庭) 要求較低.
預設: 20.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyMinOpinion_too.cn:
设置首领对你的好感度至少要多少, 你才能加入. 士兵与掠夺者要求更高; 较温和的群体 (例如家庭) 要求较低.
默认: 20.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyStories_toolti.en:
Allows settled groups near you to tell stories about their old lives. You can also ask for a story.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyStories_toolti.ch:
允許你附近的定居團體講述他們過去生活的故事. 你也可以主動請他們講故事.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyStories_toolti.cn:
允许你附近的定居群体讲述他们过去生活的故事. 你也可以主动请他们讲故事.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyTaskFrequency.ch: 團體任務間隔 (遊戲內分鐘)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyTaskFrequency.cn: 群体任务间隔 (游戏内分钟)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyTaskFrequency_.en:
Sets the minimum time between jobs offered by your group leader at calm stops. At 0, automatic offers stop; you can still ask for a job.
Default 45.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyTaskFrequency_.ch:
設定團體首領在平靜的停留點提供任務的最短間隔. 設為0時不再自動提供; 你仍可主動要求任務.
預設: 45.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PartyTaskFrequency_.cn:
设置群体首领在平静的停留点提供任务的最短间隔. 设为0时不再自动提供; 你仍可主动要求任务.
默认: 45.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PeekWindow.ch: [專家] 掩體外暴露時間 (毫秒)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PeekWindow.cn: [专家] 掩体外暴露时间 (毫秒)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PeekWindow_tooltip.en: Time at the firing point before returning to cover. Default 1200; range 600-2000. At most two shots; weapon cycles finish normally.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PeekWindow_tooltip.ch: 在射擊點停留多久才返回掩體. 預設: 1200; 範圍: 600-2000. 最多開兩槍; 武器的擊發循環會照常完成.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PeekWindow_tooltip.cn: 在射击点停留多久才返回掩体. 默认: 1200; 范围: 600-2000. 最多开两枪; 武器的击发循环会照常完成.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Peek_Enabled_toolti.en:
Adds a right-click peephole view on closed doors. Each player can also turn it off in their own mod options.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Peek_Enabled_toolti.ch:
在關閉的門上加入右鍵窺視孔視角. 每位玩家也可在自己的模組選項中關閉.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Peek_Enabled_toolti.cn:
在关闭的门上添加右键猫眼视角. 每位玩家也可在自己的模组选项中关闭.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Peek_NoticeChancePe.en: Chance of being heard while peeking (percent)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Peek_NoticeChancePe.ch: 窺視時被聽見的機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Peek_NoticeChancePe.cn: 窥视时被听见的概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Peek_NoticeChancePe.en:
Every few seconds, an NPC within two tiles of the door may hear you peeking and speak. They cannot see you through the peephole. At 0, peeking is never heard.
Default 5.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Peek_NoticeChancePe.ch:
每隔幾秒, 門邊兩格內的NPC可能會聽見你在窺視並開口說話. 他們無法透過窺視孔看到你. 設為0時, 窺視永遠不會被聽見.
預設: 5.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Peek_NoticeChancePe.cn:
每隔几秒, 门边两格内的NPC可能会听见你在窥视并开口说话. 他们无法透过猫眼看到你. 设为0时, 窥视永远不会被听见.
默认: 5.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverBaseline.ch: 未造訪建築的搜刮基準值 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverBaseline.cn: 未造访建筑的搜刮基准值 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverBaseline_.en:
Sets the base chance before building type and rate scaling. Nearby scavenging adds up to 60 percentage points before those adjustments.
Default 5.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverBaseline_.ch:
設定套用建築類型與比率縮放之前的基本機率. 附近的搜刮活動會在這些調整之前額外增加最多60個百分點.
預設: 5.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverBaseline_.cn:
设置应用建筑类型与比率缩放之前的基础概率. 附近的搜刮活动会在这些调整之前额外增加最多60个百分点.
默认: 5.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverEnabled_t.en:
Unvisited scavenged buildings may have fewer valuables and signs of looting. Never changes buildings players entered, player bases, safehouses or outposts.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverEnabled_t.ch:
未造訪過的建築可能已被搜刮, 貴重物品較少並留有搜刮痕跡. 絕不會改動玩家進入過的建築, 玩家基地, 安全屋或前哨站.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverEnabled_t.cn:
未造访过的建筑可能已被搜刮, 贵重物品较少并留有搜刮痕迹. 绝不会改动玩家进入过的建筑, 玩家基地, 安全屋或哨所.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverFactionCo.ch: 被搜刮建築內的搜刮者屍體
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverFactionCo.cn: 被搜刮建筑内的搜刮者尸体

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverFactionCo.en:
A building may rarely contain a dead member of the group that scavenged the area, wearing that group's clothes and carrying its gear.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverFactionCo.ch:
建築內偶爾會有搜刮該區域之團體的成員屍體, 身穿該團體的服裝並攜帶其裝備.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverFactionCo.cn:
建筑内偶尔会有搜刮该区域的团体的成员尸体, 身穿该团体的服装并携带其装备.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverStrength.en: Previously scavenged building rate (percent of normal)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverStrength.ch: 先前被搜刮建築的比率 (正常值的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverStrength.cn: 先前被搜刮建筑的比率 (正常值的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverStrength_.en:
Scales the chance that a building is already scavenged. 100 keeps the usual chance, 300 triples it and 0 disables it.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverStrength_.ch:
調整建築已被搜刮過的機率. 100維持一般機率, 300變為三倍, 0則停用.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverStrength_.cn:
调整建筑已被搜刮过的概率. 100保持一般概率, 300变为三倍, 0则禁用.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverVisuals_t.en:
Already scavenged buildings may show open doors, broken windows and blood. These signs are placed only while every player is at least 40 tiles away.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverVisuals_t.ch:
已被搜刮過的建築可能出現敞開的門, 破碎的窗戶和血跡. 這些痕跡只會在所有玩家都距離至少40格時放置.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverVisuals_t.cn:
已被搜刮过的建筑可能出现敞开的门, 破碎的窗户和血迹. 这些痕迹只会在所有玩家都距离至少40格时放置.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverZombieCor.ch: 被搜刮建築內的殭屍屍體
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverZombieCor.cn: 被搜刮建筑内的僵尸尸体

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverZombieCor.en:
Already scavenged buildings may contain one or two dead zombies.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverZombieCor.ch:
已被搜刮過的建築內可能有一兩具殭屍屍體.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PickedOverZombieCor.cn:
已被搜刮过的建筑内可能有一两具僵尸尸体.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PinWindow.ch: [專家] 小隊掩護射擊時間 (毫秒)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PinWindow.cn: [专家] 小队掩护射击时间 (毫秒)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PinWindow_tooltip.en: Maximum covering fire time for one squad maneuver. Default 4000; range 2000-6000. Requires an eligible gunner and a clear friendly-safe line.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PinWindow_tooltip.ch: 單次小隊機動的最長掩護射擊時間. 預設: 4000; 範圍: 2000-6000. 需要有符合條件的槍手, 以及不會誤傷友軍的淨空射線.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PinWindow_tooltip.cn: 单次小队机动的最长掩护射击时间. 默认: 4000; 范围: 2000-6000. 需要有符合条件的枪手, 以及不会误伤友军的通畅射击线.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansEnabled_toolti.en:
Free groups choose goals such as supplies or shelter, discuss them and follow through until done, blocked, hurt or threatened. Off: groups return to travelling and idling.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansEnabled_toolti.ch:
自由團體會選擇物資或避難所等目標, 討論後貫徹執行, 直到完成, 受阻, 受傷或受到威脅為止. 關閉: 團體恢復為四處移動與閒置.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansEnabled_toolti.cn:
自由群体会选择物资或避难所等目标, 讨论后贯彻执行, 直到完成, 受阻, 受伤或受到威胁为止. 关闭: 群体恢复为四处移动与闲置.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansLifespanHours.ch: 團體計畫時限 (遊戲內小時)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansLifespanHours.cn: 群体计划时限 (游戏内小时)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansLifespanHours_.en:
Sets how long a group keeps a plan before giving up and choosing again. Shelter plans last until morning.
Default 6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansLifespanHours_.ch:
設定團體維持一項計畫多久, 之後便放棄並重新選擇. 避難計畫會持續到早上.
預設: 6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansLifespanHours_.cn:
设置群体维持一项计划多久, 之后便放弃并重新选择. 避难计划会持续到早上.
默认: 6.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansRadius_tooltip.en:
Sets how far a group looks for a building to visit for its plan. Nearby buildings are preferred; 80 limits the search to 80 tiles.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansRadius_tooltip.ch:
設定團體為執行計畫尋找建築物的範圍. 優先選擇附近的建築物; 設為80則只搜尋80格內.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansRadius_tooltip.cn:
设置群体为执行计划寻找建筑物的范围. 优先选择附近的建筑物; 设为80则只搜索80格内.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansTalk_tooltip.en:
Groups discuss plans before leaving and speak when they arrive or give up. Off: they still follow plans, but silently.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansTalk_tooltip.ch:
團體出發前會討論計畫, 抵達或放棄時也會開口說話. 關閉: 仍會執行計畫, 但不出聲.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansTalk_tooltip.cn:
群体出发前会讨论计划, 抵达或放弃时也会开口说话. 关闭: 仍会执行计划, 但不出声.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.PresetDifficulty_to.en:
How dangerous NPCs are. Easy: half damage, 80 health, raids from day 60. Only default-valued options change; density is separate. Reload for full effect.
Default Easy (1).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PresetDifficulty_to.ch:
NPC有多危險. 容易: 傷害減半, 生命值80, 第60天起突襲. 只會變更仍為預設值的選項; 人口密度另行設定. 重新載入後完全生效.
預設: 容易 (1).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PresetDifficulty_to.cn:
NPC有多危险. 容易: 伤害减半, 生命值80, 第60天起突袭. 只会更改仍为默认值的选项; 人口密度另行设置. 重新加载后完全生效.
默认: 容易 (1).

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Raid_MaxAttackers_t.en:
Caps attackers across all automatic raid waves, spread evenly among the waves. Earlier scouts do not count. Admin-forced raids ignore this limit.
Default 12.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Raid_MaxAttackers_t.ch:
限制所有自動突襲波次的攻擊者總數, 平均分配到各波次. 先前的偵察兵不計入. 管理員強制發動的突襲不受此上限限制.
預設: 12.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Raid_MaxAttackers_t.cn:
限制所有自动突袭波次的攻击者总数, 平均分配到各波次. 先前的侦察兵不计入. 管理员强制发起的突袭不受此上限限制.
默认: 12.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Raid_SirenAircraftS.en:
Controls opening sirens, jets and raid aircraft sounds. Helicopter raid arrivals also need the helicopter option switched on.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Raid_SirenAircraftS.ch:
控制開場警報聲, 噴射機與突襲飛機的音效. 直升機突襲抵達還需要開啟直升機選項.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Raid_SirenAircraftS.cn:
控制开场警报声, 喷气机和突袭飞机的音效. 直升机突袭抵达还需要开启直升机选项.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Raid_WarningHours.ch: 突襲偵察兵出動前的警告 (遊戲內小時)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Raid_WarningHours.cn: 突袭侦察兵出动前的预警 (游戏内小时)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Raid_WarningHours_t.en:
Sets the warning-to-scout delay; the raid follows its buildup. 0 sends scouts immediately. Scouts and raiders walk in from 40-50 tiles away, unseen and away from player bases.
Default 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Raid_WarningHours_t.ch:
設定從警告到偵察兵出動的延遲; 突襲會在集結後接著發動. 0表示立即派出偵察兵. 偵察兵與掠奪者會從40-50格外步行進入, 不被看見, 並避開玩家基地.
預設: 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Raid_WarningHours_t.cn:
设置从预警到侦察兵出动的延迟; 突袭会在集结后接着发起. 0表示立即派出侦察兵. 侦察兵和掠夺者会从40-50格外步行进入, 不被看见, 并避开玩家基地.
默认: 3.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.RegrowthDays.en: Local recovery interval (game days per group)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RegrowthDays.ch: 當地恢復間隔 (每個團體的遊戲內天數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RegrowthDays.cn: 当地恢复间隔 (每个群体的游戏内天数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.RegrowthDays_toolti.en:
After the death cooldown, limits a recovering area to one new group per interval. At 0, this additional recovery limit is disabled.
Default 2.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RegrowthDays_toolti.ch:
死亡冷卻結束後, 恢復中的區域每個間隔只能出現一個新團體. 設為0時停用此額外的恢復限制.
預設: 2.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RegrowthDays_toolti.cn:
死亡冷却结束后, 恢复中的区域每个间隔只能出现一个新群体. 设为0时禁用该额外的恢复限制.
默认: 2.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationDecayPerc.ch: 陣營信譽消退 (正常值的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationDecayPerc.cn: 阵营信誉消退 (正常值的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationDecayPerc.en:
How quickly earned faction standing returns toward zero. At 200, it fades twice as fast; at 0, earned standing stays unchanged.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationDecayPerc.ch:
已累積的陣營信譽回歸零的速度. 設為200時, 消退速度加倍; 設為0時, 已累積的信譽維持不變.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationDecayPerc.cn:
已获得的阵营信誉回归零的速度. 设为200时, 消退速度加倍; 设为0时, 已获得的信誉保持不变.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationDriftPerD.en: Personal reputation fade (points per game day)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationDriftPerD.ch: 個人聲望消退 (每遊戲日點數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationDriftPerD.cn: 个人声望消退 (每游戏日点数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationDriftPerD.en:
Points of personal reputation that drift toward neutral each day. At 0, your earned reputation stays unchanged.
Default 5.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationDriftPerD.ch:
個人聲望每天向中立回歸的點數. 設為0時, 你累積的聲望維持不變.
預設: 5.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationDriftPerD.cn:
个人声望每天向中立回归的点数. 设为0时, 你获得的声望保持不变.
默认: 5.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationGainCapPe.ch: 每日全額聲望獲取上限 (點)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationGainCapPe.cn: 每日全额声望获取上限 (点)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationGainCapPe.en:
Limits reputation gained from kills each day at full rate; extra hostile kills count at the reduced share below. Deeds get their own limit of 150 percent of this.
Default 60.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationGainCapPe.ch:
限制每天以全額計算的擊殺聲望獲取量; 超出後的敵對擊殺依下方的降低比例計算. 行為另有獨立上限, 為此值的1.5倍.
預設: 60.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationGainCapPe.cn:
限制每天按全额计算的击杀声望获取量; 超出后的敌对击杀按下方的降低比例计算. 行为另有独立上限, 为此值的1.5倍.
默认: 60.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationHysteresi.en:
Extra points beyond a level boundary needed before your reputation label changes. Higher values reduce frequent label changes.
Default 15.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationHysteresi.ch:
聲望稱號改變前, 需超出等級門檻的額外點數. 數值越高, 越能減少稱號頻繁變動.
預設: 15.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationHysteresi.cn:
声望称号改变前, 需超出等级门槛的额外点数. 数值越高, 越能减少称号频繁变动.
默认: 15.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillCrime.en: Reputation gain for a criminal kill (points)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillCrime.ch: 擊殺罪犯的聲望獲取 (點)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillCrime.cn: 击杀罪犯的声望获取 (点)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillCrime.en:
Personal reputation gained for killing an NPC from a criminal faction.
Default 15.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillCrime.ch:
擊殺犯罪陣營NPC所獲得的個人聲望.
預設: 15.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillCrime.cn:
击杀犯罪阵营NPC所获得的个人声望.
默认: 15.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillFrien.en: Reputation loss for a friendly kill (points)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillFrien.ch: 擊殺友善者的聲望損失 (點)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillFrien.cn: 击杀友善者的声望损失 (点)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillFrien.en:
Personal reputation lost for killing an NPC who regarded you as a friend.
Default 80.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillFrien.ch:
擊殺視你為朋友的NPC所失去的個人聲望.
預設: 80.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillFrien.cn:
击杀视你为朋友的NPC所失去的个人声望.
默认: 80.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillHosti.en: Reputation gain for a hostile kill (points)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillHosti.ch: 敵對擊殺的聲望獲取 (點)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillHosti.cn: 敌对击杀的声望获取 (点)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillHosti.en:
Personal reputation gained for killing an NPC who was hostile toward you.
Default 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillHosti.ch:
擊殺對你懷有敵意的NPC所獲得的個人聲望.
預設: 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillHosti.cn:
击杀对你怀有敌意的NPC所获得的个人声望.
默认: 10.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillNeutr.en: Reputation loss for a neutral kill (points)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillNeutr.ch: 擊殺中立者的聲望損失 (點)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillNeutr.cn: 击杀中立者的声望损失 (点)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillNeutr.en:
Personal reputation lost for killing a neutral or cautious NPC who meant you no harm.
Default 40.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillNeutr.ch:
擊殺對你無惡意的中立或謹慎NPC所失去的個人聲望.
預設: 40.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillNeutr.cn:
击杀对你没有恶意的中立或谨慎NPC所失去的个人声望.
默认: 40.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillScale.en: Reputation changes from kills and deeds (percent of normal)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillScale.ch: 擊殺與行為造成的聲望變化 (正常值的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillScale.cn: 击杀与行为造成的声望变化 (正常值的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillScale.en:
Scales personal reputation changes from kills and from deeds (visitors, hosting, gifts, treating, trading). At 0 none count; at 200 they count twice as much.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillScale.ch:
調整擊殺與行為 (訪客, 招待, 送禮, 治療, 交易) 造成的個人聲望變化. 設為0時全部不計; 設為200時以兩倍計算.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillScale.cn:
调整击杀和行为 (访客, 招待, 送礼, 治疗, 交易) 造成的个人声望变化. 设为0时全部不计; 设为200时按两倍计算.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillSurre.en: Reputation loss for a surrendered kill (points)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillSurre.ch: 擊殺投降者的聲望損失 (點)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillSurre.cn: 击杀投降者的声望损失 (点)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillSurre.en:
Personal reputation lost for killing an NPC who had surrendered.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillSurre.ch:
擊殺已投降NPC所失去的個人聲望.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationKillSurre.cn:
击杀已投降NPC所失去的个人声望.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationMode.en: Faction standing from gifts and trades
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationMode.ch: 送禮與交易影響陣營信譽
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationMode.cn: 送礼与交易影响阵营信誉

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationMode_tool.en:
Food gifts and fair trades improve standing with the visitor's faction. Off: these choices do not change faction standing; existing grudges remain.
Default Off (1).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationMode_tool.ch:
贈送食物與公平交易會提升你在訪客所屬陣營中的信譽. 關閉: 這些選擇不會改變陣營信譽; 既有的仇怨仍會保留.
預設: 關閉 (1).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationMode_tool.cn:
赠送食物和公平交易会提升你在访客所属阵营中的信誉. 关闭: 这些选择不会改变阵营信誉; 已有的仇怨仍会保留.
默认: 关闭 (1).

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcFightI.en: Hostile credit for killing fighting NPCs
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcFightI.ch: 擊殺交戰中NPC視為敵對擊殺
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcFightI.cn: 击杀交战中NPC视为敌对击杀

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcFightI.en:
Killing an NPC already in a fight counts as a hostile kill and is not held against you. Off judges each kill by the NPC's attitude toward you.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcFightI.ch:
擊殺已在戰鬥中的NPC會算作敵對擊殺, 不會對你不利. 關閉則依NPC對你的態度判定每次擊殺.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcFightI.cn:
击杀已在战斗中的NPC会算作敌对击杀, 不会对你不利. 关闭则按NPC对你的态度判定每次击杀.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.en: NPC opinion fade (points per game day)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.ch: NPC好感度消退 (每遊戲日點數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.cn: NPC好感度消退 (每游戏日点数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.en:
How far each NPC's opinion moves back toward its starting value each day. At 0, the NPC never forgets.
Default 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.ch:
每個NPC的好感度每天向初始值回歸的幅度. 設為0時, NPC永遠不會忘記.
預設: 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.cn:
每个NPC的好感度每天向初始值回归的幅度. 设为0时, NPC永远不会忘记.
默认: 3.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.en: Influence of NPC opinion (percent of normal)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.ch: NPC好感度的影響力 (正常值的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.cn: NPC好感度的影响力 (正常值的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.en:
Scales opinion's effect on prices, replies, invitations, company, deals, greetings, betrayal and orders. At 0, opinion is displayed but has no gameplay effect.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.ch:
調整好感度對價格, 回應, 邀請, 同行, 交易, 問候, 背叛與命令的影響. 設為0時, 仍會顯示好感度, 但不影響遊戲玩法.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.cn:
调整好感度对价格, 回应, 邀请, 同行, 交易, 问候, 背叛和命令的影响. 设为0时, 仍会显示好感度, 但不影响游戏玩法.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.en: Opinion changes from deeds (percent of normal)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.ch: 行為造成的好感度變化 (正常值的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.cn: 行为造成的好感度变化 (正常值的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.en:
Scales how deeds change an NPC's opinion. At normal strength, a gift gives about 8 points, a hit loses 20 and killing a groupmate loses 45; others may hear about it.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.ch:
調整行為對NPC好感度的影響程度. 在正常強度下, 送禮約增加8點, 攻擊一次減少20點, 殺死其團體成員減少45點; 其他人也可能聽聞此事.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.cn:
调整行为对NPC好感度的影响程度. 在正常强度下, 送礼约增加8点, 攻击一次减少20点, 杀死其团体成员减少45点; 其他人也可能听说此事.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.en:
Each NPC remembers a separate opinion of each player, shaped by temperament, reputation and deeds toward their group. Shown in conversations. Off disables individual opinions.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.ch:
每個NPC會分別記住對每位玩家的好感度, 受其性情, 玩家聲望以及玩家對其團體的所作所為影響. 會在對話中顯示. 關閉則停用個別好感度.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationNpcOpinio.cn:
每个NPC会分别记住对每位玩家的好感度, 受其性格, 玩家声望以及玩家对其团体的所作所为影响. 会在对话中显示. 关闭则禁用个别好感度.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationOverCapPe.en: Reputation gain beyond the daily limit (percent)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationOverCapPe.ch: 超出每日上限後的聲望獲取 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationOverCapPe.cn: 超出每日上限后的声望获取 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationOverCapPe.en:
Share of normal gain earned for hostile or criminal kills after the daily limit, with at least 1 point per kill. At 0, no further gain is possible that day.
Default 25.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationOverCapPe.ch:
達到每日上限後, 敵對擊殺或擊殺罪犯所獲聲望佔正常值的比例, 每次擊殺至少1點. 設為0時, 當天無法再獲得聲望.
預設: 25.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationOverCapPe.cn:
达到每日上限后, 敌对击杀或击杀罪犯所获声望占正常值的比例, 每次击杀至少1点. 设为0时, 当天无法再获得声望.
默认: 25.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationRadioBadN.ch: 關於玩家的負面廣播故事
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationRadioBadN.cn: 关于玩家的负面广播故事

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationRadioBadN.en:
Allows radio stories about a player's bad reputation. Off: only neutral or positive mentions are broadcast.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationRadioBadN.ch:
允許播出關於玩家惡名的廣播故事. 關閉: 只會播出中立或正面的內容.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationRadioBadN.cn:
允许播出关于玩家恶名的广播故事. 关闭: 只会播出中立或正面的内容.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationRadioName.en:
Radio stories may name players after lasting reputation changes, fighting sprees or surviving raids. Requires personal reputation; never reveals the player's location.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationRadioName.ch:
玩家的聲望長期變動, 連番激戰或在突襲中倖存後, 廣播故事可能會點名提及該玩家. 需要啟用個人聲望; 絕不會透露玩家的位置.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationRadioName.cn:
玩家的声望出现持久变化, 连番激战或在突袭中幸存后, 广播故事可能会点名提及该玩家. 需要启用个人声望; 绝不会透露玩家的位置.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationResetOnNe.en: Fresh reputation for a new character

New characters reset personal reputation, faction standing and NPC memories, not faction or Creator relations. Off keeps the old values. Reconnecting never resets the same character.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationResetOnNe.ch:
新角色會重置個人聲望, 陣營信譽與NPC記憶, 但不會重置陣營關係或編輯器設定的關係. 關閉則保留舊數值. 重新連線絕不會重置同一個角色.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationResetOnNe.cn:
新角色会重置个人声望, 阵营信誉和NPC记忆, 但不会重置阵营关系或编辑器设置的关系. 关闭则保留旧数值. 重新连接绝不会重置同一个角色.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationShowOther.en:
The T-menu reputation answer also lists other players' reputation levels on the server. Off shows only your own.
Default off.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationShowOther.ch:
T選單的聲望回覆也會列出伺服器上其他玩家的聲望等級. 關閉則只顯示你自己的.
預設: 關閉.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationShowOther.cn:
T菜单的声望回复也会列出服务器上其他玩家的声望等级. 关闭则只显示你自己的.
默认: 关闭.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationShowScore.en:
Shows the number beside your reputation level in the character window, notes and radio panel, such as Cutthroat (-62). Off shows only the level name.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationShowScore.ch:
在角色視窗, 筆記與無線電面板中, 於聲望等級旁顯示數值, 例如「兇徒 (-62)」. 關閉則只顯示等級名稱.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationShowScore.cn:
在角色窗口, 笔记和无线电面板中, 于声望等级旁显示数值, 例如“凶徒 (-62)”. 关闭则只显示等级名称.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationTracking_.en:
Tracks kills, help and mistreatment, with change notices and character-window scores. Off stops both tracking and display.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationTracking_.ch:
追蹤擊殺, 幫助與虐待行為, 並提供變動通知與角色視窗中的分數. 關閉後會同時停止追蹤與顯示.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ReputationTracking_.cn:
追踪击杀, 帮助和虐待行为, 并提供变动通知和角色窗口中的分数. 关闭后会同时停止追踪和显示.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Reputation_Professi.en:
Uses each faction's view of your profession when choosing nearby encounters. Off: every profession uses that faction's general attitude.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Reputation_Professi.ch:
選擇附近的遭遇時, 參考各陣營對你職業的看法. 關閉: 所有職業都套用該陣營的整體態度.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Reputation_Professi.cn:
选择附近的遭遇时, 参考各阵营对你职业的看法. 关闭: 所有职业都使用该阵营的总体态度.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Reputation_Professi.en:
During the first week, NPCs from a similar background may recognise your former profession, such as police recognising police. Requires personal reputation.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Reputation_Professi.ch:
第一週內, 背景相近的NPC可能認出你從前的職業, 例如警察認出警察. 需啟用個人聲望.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Reputation_Professi.cn:
第一周内, 背景相近的NPC可能认出你以前的职业, 例如警察认出警察. 需要启用个人声望.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Residents_ClearCorp.en:
Residents slowly carry zombie corpses out of loaded buildings to reduce corpse sickness. Never removes player or NPC corpses, or corpses in claimed player safehouses.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Residents_ClearCorp.ch:
住戶會慢慢把殭屍屍體搬出已載入的建築, 以減少屍體病. 絕不會移除玩家或NPC的屍體, 也不會移除已認領之玩家安全屋內的屍體.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Residents_ClearCorp.cn:
住户会慢慢把僵尸尸体搬出已加载的建筑, 以减少尸体病. 绝不会移除玩家或NPC的尸体, 也不会移除已认领的玩家安全屋内的尸体.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.RespawnCooldownDays.en: Local replacement delay after deaths (game days)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RespawnCooldownDays.ch: 死亡後當地補充延遲 (遊戲內天數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RespawnCooldownDays.cn: 死亡后当地补充延迟 (游戏内天数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.RespawnCooldownDays.en:
Blocks new travelling groups in an area of about 120 tiles after NPC deaths. Heavy losses extend the delay. At 0, this delay is disabled.
Default 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RespawnCooldownDays.ch:
NPC死亡後, 約120格範圍內不會出現新的漫遊團體. 傷亡慘重會延長此延遲. 設為0時停用此延遲.
預設: 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RespawnCooldownDays.cn:
NPC死亡后, 约120格范围内不会出现新的漫游群体. 伤亡惨重会延长该延迟. 设为0时禁用该延迟.
默认: 3.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.RetreatLOS.ch: [專家] 優先選擇隱蔽的撤退地點
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RetreatLOS.cn: [专家] 优先选择隐蔽的撤退地点

Sandbox_ProjectALife.RetreatLOS_tooltip.en: Prefer nearby retreat destinations that hide the NPC from the threat. Existing retreat triggers, stamina and fallback destinations remain in use.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RetreatLOS_tooltip.ch: 優先選擇附近能讓NPC避開威脅視線的撤退地點. 現有的撤退觸發條件, 體力與備用目的地仍照常使用.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RetreatLOS_tooltip.cn: 优先选择附近能让NPC避开威胁视线的撤退地点. 现有的撤退触发条件, 体力和备用目的地仍照常使用.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.RevengeMaxWaves.ch: 每筆仇怨的復仇團體數 (支)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RevengeMaxWaves.cn: 每笔仇怨的复仇团体数 (支)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.RevengeMaxWaves_too.en:
Limits revenge groups sent after a player for one grudge. Each is drawn from the original crew's survivors plus at most two reinforcements.
Default 2.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RevengeMaxWaves_too.ch:
限制因同一筆仇怨而派去追殺玩家的復仇團體數量. 每個團體都由原隊伍的倖存者組成, 外加最多兩名增援.
預設: 2.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RevengeMaxWaves_too.cn:
限制因同一笔仇怨而派去追杀玩家的复仇团体数量. 每个团体都由原队伍的幸存者组成, 外加最多两名增援.
默认: 2.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.RoomSweep_tooltip.en: NPCs carrying a weapon walk into buildings slowly with the weapon raised, pause at doorways and corners and look over the room before moving on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RoomSweep_tooltip.ch: 攜帶武器的NPC會舉起武器緩慢走進建築, 在門口與轉角停下, 先察看房間再繼續前進.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RoomSweep_tooltip.cn: 携带武器的NPC会举起武器缓慢走进建筑, 在门口和转角停下, 先观察房间再继续前进.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AttackGap.en: Minimum time between base attacks (game days)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AttackGap.ch: 基地攻擊最短間隔 (遊戲內天數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AttackGap.cn: 基地攻击最短间隔 (游戏内天数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AttackGap.en:
Minimum gap between attacks on the same house.
Default 1.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AttackGap.ch:
同一棟房屋兩次遭受攻擊之間的最短間隔.
預設: 1.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AttackGap.cn:
同一栋房屋两次遭受攻击之间的最短间隔.
默认: 1.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AttackMin.ch: 最早基地攻擊日 (世界天數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AttackMin.cn: 最早基地攻击日 (世界天数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AttackMin.en:
World age before the first attack on a house is allowed.
Default 14.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AttackMin.ch:
世界天數需達到此值, 房屋才可能遭受第一次攻擊.
預設: 14.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AttackMin.cn:
世界天数需达到该值, 房屋才可能遭受第一次攻击.
默认: 14.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Attacks_t.en:
Allows groups who hate you to attack your base after warnings. Off prevents these base-event attacks.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Attacks_t.ch:
允許痛恨你的團體在警告後攻擊你的基地. 關閉則不會發生這類基地事件攻擊.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Attacks_t.cn:
允许痛恨你的团体在警告后攻击你的基地. 关闭则不会发生这类基地事件攻击.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AwayTiles.ch: 未被看見投遞的住戶距離 (格)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AwayTiles.cn: 未被看见投递的住户距离 (格)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AwayTiles.en:
Notes and gifts can be left when every resident is at least this far from the delivery point and is not looking toward it.
Default 40.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AwayTiles.ch:
當所有住戶都距離投遞點至少此距離, 且沒有朝投遞點看時, 就能留下紙條與禮物.
預設: 40.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_AwayTiles.cn:
当所有住户都距离投递点至少该距离, 且没有朝投递点看时, 就能留下纸条与礼物.
默认: 40.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_BaseFlag_.en:
In SP/co-op, recognised bases block NPC spawning, shelter, loot and uninvited non-hostiles. Off: any slept-in or built-at place blocks spawns, as on dedicated servers.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_BaseFlag_.ch:
在單人/合作模式中, 被認定的基地會阻止NPC生成, 避難, 搜刮, 以及未受邀的非敵對者進入. 關閉: 任何睡過或建造過的地方都會阻止生成, 與專用伺服器相同.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_BaseFlag_.cn:
在单人/合作模式中, 被认定的基地会阻止NPC生成, 避难, 搜刮, 以及未受邀的非敌对者进入. 关闭: 任何睡过或建造过的地方都会阻止生成, 与专用服务器相同.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_BaseScore.en:
Points needed to recognise a base, with at least two kinds of evidence. A night adds 20, a day there 10, a running generator 20 and a claim 30.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_BaseScore.ch:
認定為基地所需的點數, 且至少需要兩種證據. 在此過夜一晚加20, 待上一天加10, 運轉中的發電機加20, 設為安全屋加30.
預設: 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_BaseScore.cn:
认定为基地所需的点数, 且至少需要两种证据. 在此过夜一晚加20, 待上一天加10, 运转中的发电机加20, 设为安全屋加30.
默认: 100.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Betrayal_.en:
Some visitors may lie about why they came. They give a warning sign before you open the door.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Betrayal_.ch:
有些訪客可能會謊報來意. 在你開門前, 他們會露出警訊.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Betrayal_.cn:
有些访客可能会谎报来意. 在你开门前, 他们会露出警示迹象.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_BittenPer.ch: 受傷訪客隱瞞咬傷機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_BittenPer.cn: 受伤访客隐瞒咬伤概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_BittenPer.en:
Chance that a wounded visitor is secretly bitten. Bitten visitors refuse to be searched.
Default 15.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_BittenPer.ch:
受傷訪客暗中已被咬傷的機率. 被咬傷的訪客會拒絕搜身.
預設: 15.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_BittenPer.cn:
受伤访客暗中已被咬伤的概率. 被咬伤的访客会拒绝搜身.
默认: 15.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_ChancePer.ch: 每次檢查的基地事件機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_ChancePer.cn: 每次检查的基地事件概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_ChancePer.en:
Chance of an event at an eligible house. Rare halves this chance; Often increases it by half.
Default 12.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_ChancePer.ch:
符合條件的房屋發生事件的機率. 「稀少」會讓此機率減半; 「頻繁」會讓它提高一半.
預設: 12.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_ChancePer.cn:
符合条件的房屋发生事件的概率. “稀少”会使该概率减半; “频繁”会使其提高一半.
默认: 12.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_CheckHour.ch: 基地事件檢查間隔 (遊戲內小時)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_CheckHour.cn: 基地事件检查间隔 (游戏内小时)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_CheckHour.en:
Time between event checks at the same house.
Default 2.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_CheckHour.ch:
同一棟房屋兩次事件檢查之間的時間.
預設: 2.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_CheckHour.cn:
同一栋房屋两次事件检查之间的时间.
默认: 2.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Dedicated.ch: 專用伺服器上的基地事件
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Dedicated.cn: 专用服务器上的基地事件

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Dedicated.en:
Allows base events on dedicated servers while at least one resident is online. Off disables them there. Single player and co-op do not need this switch.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Dedicated.ch:
在專用伺服器上, 只要至少有一名居民連線中就允許基地事件. 關閉則在專用伺服器上停用. 單人遊戲與合作模式不需要此開關.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Dedicated.cn:
在专用服务器上, 只要至少有一名居民在线就允许基地事件. 关闭则在专用服务器上禁用. 单人游戏与合作模式不需要此开关.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityEx.ch: 停止投遞的殭屍門檻 (隻)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityEx.cn: 停止投递的僵尸门槛 (只)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityEx.en:
Above this many zombies within 40 tiles of the front door, nothing is left at the house.
Default 60.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityEx.ch:
前門40格內的殭屍超過此數量時, 不會有任何東西留在屋前.
預設: 60.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityEx.cn:
前门40格内的僵尸超过该数量时, 不会有任何东西留在屋前.
默认: 60.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityHi.ch: 停止來訪的殭屍門檻 (隻)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityHi.cn: 停止来访的僵尸门槛 (只)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityHi.en:
Above this many zombies within 40 tiles of the front door, nobody visits and notes arrive half as often.
Default 30.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityHi.ch:
前門40格內的殭屍超過此數量時, 不會有人來訪, 紙條送達的頻率也減半.
預設: 30.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityHi.cn:
前门40格内的僵尸超过该数量时, 不会有人来访, 纸条送达的频率也减半.
默认: 30.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityMi.en: Zombie count for armed visitors only (zombies)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityMi.ch: 僅武裝訪客來訪的殭屍門檻 (隻)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityMi.cn: 仅武装访客来访的僵尸门槛 (只)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityMi.en:
Above this many zombies within 40 tiles of the front door, only armed groups visit.
Default 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityMi.ch:
前門40格內的殭屍超過此數量時, 只有武裝團體會來訪.
預設: 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DensityMi.cn:
前门40格内的僵尸超过该数量时, 只有武装群体会来访.
默认: 10.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DropDeadl.ch: 未送達紙條期限 (遊戲內天數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DropDeadl.cn: 未送达纸条期限 (游戏内天数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DropDeadl.en:
How long a note waits for a safe delivery opportunity before it expires without being delivered.
Default 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DropDeadl.ch:
紙條等待安全投遞時機的時間, 逾時便作廢, 不再送達.
預設: 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_DropDeadl.cn:
纸条等待安全投递时机的时间, 超时便作废, 不再送达.
默认: 3.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Entry_too.en:
Only when invited: visitors enter after you let them in at the door. Never: all visitors remain outside.
Default Only when invited (1).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Entry_too.ch:
僅限受邀時: 你在門口讓訪客進來後, 他們才會進入. 永不: 所有訪客都留在屋外.
預設: 僅限受邀時 (1).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Entry_too.cn:
仅限受邀时: 你在门口让访客进来后, 他们才会进入. 从不: 所有访客都留在屋外.
默认: 仅限受邀时 (1).

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Events_to.en:
Controls notes, gifts, visitors and attacks at claimed safehouses or buildings you live in. Off disables these base events.
Default Normal (3).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Events_to.ch:
控制已認領的安全屋或你居住的建築會出現的紙條, 禮物, 訪客與攻擊. 關閉則停用這些基地事件.
預設: 正常 (3).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_Events_to.cn:
控制已认领的安全屋或你居住的建筑会出现的纸条, 礼物, 访客与攻击. 关闭则禁用这些基地事件.
默认: 正常 (3).

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_GapDays.en: Minimum time between base events (game days)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_GapDays.ch: 基地事件最短間隔 (遊戲內天數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_GapDays.cn: 基地事件最短间隔 (游戏内天数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_GapDays_t.en:
Minimum gap between events at one house. Rare doubles the gap; Often halves it, but never below one game day.
Default 2.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_GapDays_t.ch:
同一棟房屋兩次事件之間的最短間隔. 「稀少」會讓間隔加倍; 「頻繁」會讓間隔減半, 但不會低於遊戲內一天.
預設: 2.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_GapDays_t.cn:
同一栋房屋两次事件之间的最短间隔. “稀少”会使间隔加倍; “频繁”会使间隔减半, 但不会低于游戏内一天.
默认: 2.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_HiddenTil.ch: 隱蔽投遞的住戶距離 (格)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_HiddenTil.cn: 隐蔽投递的住户距离 (格)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_HiddenTil.en:
Notes and gifts can also be left when every resident is at least this far away, is not looking toward the delivery point and cannot see it.
Default 20.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_HiddenTil.ch:
當所有住戶都距離至少此距離, 沒有朝投遞點看, 且看不見投遞點時, 也能留下紙條與禮物.
預設: 20.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_HiddenTil.cn:
当所有住户都距离至少该距离, 没有朝投递点看, 且看不见投递点时, 也能留下纸条与礼物.
默认: 20.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_InviteMin.ch: 受邀訪客等候時間 (遊戲內分鐘)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_InviteMin.cn: 受邀访客等候时间 (游戏内分钟)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_InviteMin.en:
Time an invited visitor waits for the door to open before giving up.
Default 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_InviteMin.ch:
受邀訪客在放棄前等你開門的時間.
預設: 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_InviteMin.cn:
受邀访客在放弃前等你开门的时间.
默认: 10.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_KnockSoun.en: Knocks for visitors, door sound for break-ins
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_KnockSoun.ch: 訪客敲門與闖入開門聲
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_KnockSoun.cn: 访客敲门与闯入开门声

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_KnockSoun.en:
Hear visitors knock at doors or windows from about 50 tiles away. Break-ins sound when the first inside door opens. Off: text notices only.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_KnockSoun.ch:
在約50格外就能聽到訪客敲門或敲窗. 有人闖入時, 打開屋內第一扇門會發出聲音. 關閉: 僅有文字通知.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_KnockSoun.cn:
在约50格外就能听到访客敲门或敲窗. 有人闯入时, 打开屋内第一扇门会发出声音. 关闭: 仅有文字通知.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_LadderGap.en: Time between hostile warning stages (game hours)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_LadderGap.ch: 敵對警告階段間隔 (遊戲內小時)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_LadderGap.cn: 敌对警告阶段间隔 (游戏内小时)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_LadderGap.en:
Minimum time between a hostile group's threat letter, door mark, sabotage and eventual attack.
Default 48.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_LadderGap.ch:
敵對團體從恐嚇信, 門上標記, 破壞到最終攻擊, 各階段之間的最短間隔.
預設: 48.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_LadderGap.cn:
敌对群体从恐吓信, 门上标记, 破坏到最终攻击, 各阶段之间的最短间隔.
默认: 48.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_MailboxTi.en:
Notes go into a mailbox within this distance of the front door. Without one, they are left on the porch.
Default 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_MailboxTi.ch:
紙條會放進距離前門此範圍內的信箱. 沒有信箱時, 則留在門廊上.
預設: 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_MailboxTi.cn:
纸条会放进距离前门该范围内的信箱. 没有信箱时, 则留在门廊上.
默认: 10.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_QuietDays.en: Peace after establishing a base (game days)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_QuietDays.ch: 建立基地後的平靜期 (遊戲內天數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_QuietDays.cn: 建立基地后的平静期 (游戏内天数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_QuietDays.en:
Time after a place becomes your base before its first base event can happen.
Default 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_QuietDays.ch:
某地成為你的基地後, 到第一次基地事件可能發生前的時間.
預設: 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_QuietDays.cn:
某地成为你的基地后, 到第一次基地事件可能发生前的时间.
默认: 3.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_SquatPerc.ch: 訪客賴著不走機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_SquatPerc.cn: 访客赖着不走概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_SquatPerc.en:
Chance that an overnight guest refuses to leave in the morning until you talk them out.
Default 15.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_SquatPerc.ch:
過夜訪客早上拒絕離開, 直到你勸說對方離開為止的機率.
預設: 15.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_SquatPerc.cn:
过夜访客早上拒绝离开, 直到你劝说对方离开为止的概率.
默认: 15.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_TraderVis.en:
Travellers may visit your door with goods to trade. Their trading conversation is still being reworked.
Default off.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_TraderVis.ch:
旅人可能帶著貨物到你門口交易. 他們的交易對話仍在重做中.
預設: 關閉.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_TraderVis.cn:
旅人可能带着货物到你门口交易. 他们的交易对话仍在重做中.
默认: 关闭.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_VisitGapD.ch: 訪客最短間隔 (遊戲內天數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_VisitGapD.cn: 访客最短间隔 (游戏内天数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_VisitGapD.en:
Minimum gap between two visits to the same house.
Default 1.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_VisitGapD.ch:
同一棟房屋兩次來訪之間的最短間隔.
預設: 1.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_VisitGapD.cn:
同一栋房屋两次来访之间的最短间隔.
默认: 1.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_VisitorHo.en: Visitor's initial wait at the door (real seconds)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_VisitorHo.ch: 訪客在門口的初始等候 (現實秒數)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_VisitorHo.cn: 访客在门口的初始等候 (现实秒数)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_VisitorHo.en:
Visitors face the door and wait for roughly two thirds to four thirds of this duration. Opening the door, talking or attacking ends it immediately. At 0, no initial wait.
Default 30.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_VisitorHo.ch:
訪客會面向門口, 等候約此時長的三分之二到三分之四. 開門, 交談或攻擊會立即結束等候. 設為0時沒有初始等候.
預設: 30.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Safehouse_VisitorHo.cn:
访客会面朝门口, 等候约此时长的三分之二到三分之四. 开门, 交谈或攻击会立即结束等候. 设为0时没有初始等候.
默认: 30.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeedClearTiles.ch: 初始城鎮團體淨空距離 (格)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeedClearTiles.cn: 初始城镇群体净空距离 (格)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeedClearTiles_tool.en:
Prevents starting travelling groups from being placed this close to a player. Groups may still arrive later. At 0, this starting clearance is disabled.
Default 150.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeedClearTiles_tool.ch:
防止初始漫遊團體被放置在離玩家這麼近的位置. 之後仍可能有團體到來. 設為0時停用此初始淨空距離.
預設: 150.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeedClearTiles_tool.cn:
防止初始漫游群体被放置在离玩家这么近的位置. 之后仍可能有群体到来. 设为0时禁用该初始净空距离.
默认: 150.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeedPerTown.ch: 每座城鎮的初始漫遊團體
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeedPerTown.cn: 每座城镇的初始漫游群体

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeedPerTown_tooltip.en:
Sets how many travelling groups each town receives when the world starts. The distant travelling group limit may allow extra groups in larger worlds.
Default 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeedPerTown_tooltip.ch:
設定世界開始時每座城鎮分配到的漫遊團體數量. 在較大的世界中, 遠方漫遊團體上限可能允許額外的團體.
預設: 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeedPerTown_tooltip.cn:
设置世界开始时每座城镇分配到的漫游群体数量. 在较大的世界中, 远方漫游团体上限可能允许额外的群体.
默认: 3.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ShotFxRange.ch: 多人遊戲槍擊效果距離 (格)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ShotFxRange.cn: 多人游戏枪击效果距离 (格)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ShotFxRange_tooltip.en:
Sets how far other players can see an NPC shot's flash and streak and hear its gunshot and casing in multiplayer.
Default 90.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ShotFxRange_tooltip.ch:
設定多人遊戲中其他玩家在多遠距離內能看到NPC射擊的火光與彈道軌跡, 並聽到槍聲與彈殼聲.
預設: 90.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ShotFxRange_tooltip.cn:
设置多人游戏中其他玩家在多远距离内能看到NPC射击的闪光和弹道轨迹, 并听到枪声和弹壳声.
默认: 90.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnCheckpointMinT.ch: [專家] 檢查站最小距離 (格)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnCheckpointMinT.cn: [专家] 检查站最小距离 (格)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnCheckpointMinT.en: Blockades and checkpoints are never built within this distance of a player, a player base or a place a player drove through in the last five minutes, and never on dead-end roads. Default 150.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnCheckpointMinT.ch: 路障封鎖與檢查站絕不會建在距離玩家, 玩家基地或玩家過去五分鐘內駕車經過之處的此距離內, 也絕不會建在死路上. 預設: 150.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnCheckpointMinT.cn: 路障封锁和检查站绝不会建在距离玩家, 玩家基地或玩家过去五分钟内驾车经过之处的此距离内, 也绝不会建在死路上. 默认: 150.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnDespawnMinTile.en:
NPCs can become inactive or be removed only when they are at least this far from every player and out of sight.
Default 60.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnDespawnMinTile.ch:
NPC只有在距離每位玩家至少這麼遠且不在視線內時, 才會轉為非活動狀態或被移除.
預設: 60.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnDespawnMinTile.cn:
NPC只有在距离每位玩家至少这么远且不在视线内时, 才会转为非活动状态或被移除.
默认: 60.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnFairnessEnable.en:
Keeps spawning, waking and removal away from nearby or watching players. Also reduces rural encounters and prevents checkpoints near players or on dead-end roads.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnFairnessEnable.ch:
讓生成, 甦醒與移除都避開附近或正在注視的玩家. 也會減少鄉間遭遇, 並避免在玩家附近或死路上設置檢查站.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnFairnessEnable.cn:
让生成, 苏醒与移除都避开附近或正在注视的玩家. 也会减少乡间遭遇, 并避免在玩家附近或死路上设置检查站.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnFarmDensity.en: Farmland encounter rate (percent of town rate)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnFarmDensity.ch: 農地遭遇率 (城鎮遭遇率的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnFarmDensity.cn: 农田遭遇率 (城镇遭遇率的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnFarmDensity_to.en:
Sets farm and ranch encounters relative to towns. At 60, the rate is 60 percent of the town rate.
Default 60.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnFarmDensity_to.ch:
設定農場與牧場相對於城鎮的遭遇率. 設為60時, 遭遇率為城鎮的百分之60.
預設: 60.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnFarmDensity_to.cn:
设置农场和牧场相对于城镇的遭遇率. 设为60时, 遭遇率为城镇的百分之60.
默认: 60.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnKeepOutTiles_t.en:
Minimum distance from players for random groups to appear, then walk in. Sight and loaded-map limits also apply; too large a distance can prevent spawns.
Default 45.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnKeepOutTiles_t.ch:
隨機團體出現時與玩家的最短距離, 出現後再走進來. 視線與已載入地圖範圍的限制同樣適用; 距離過大可能導致無法生成.
預設: 45.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnKeepOutTiles_t.cn:
随机群体出现时与玩家的最短距离, 出现后再走进来. 视线与已加载地图范围的限制同样适用; 距离过大可能导致无法生成.
默认: 45.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnRuralDensity.en: Countryside encounter rate (percent of town rate)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnRuralDensity.ch: 鄉間遭遇率 (城鎮遭遇率的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnRuralDensity.cn: 乡间遭遇率 (城镇遭遇率的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnRuralDensity_t.en:
Sets open-countryside encounters relative to towns. At 50, the rate is half the town rate. Only suitable visitors, such as travellers and hunters, appear.
Default 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnRuralDensity_t.ch:
設定開闊鄉間相對於城鎮的遭遇率. 設為50時, 遭遇率為城鎮的一半. 只會出現合適的訪客, 例如旅人與獵人.
預設: 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnRuralDensity_t.cn:
设置开阔乡间相对于城镇的遭遇率. 设为50时, 遭遇率为城镇的一半. 只会出现合适的访客, 例如旅人和猎人.
默认: 50.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnStartGraceMinu.ch: 初始團體淨空寬限期 (遊戲內分鐘)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnStartGraceMinu.cn: 初始群体净空宽限期 (游戏内分钟)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnStartGraceMinu.en:
Lets welcome and starting-town groups appear nearby during a new character's first minutes. Other groups still obey the normal player clearance.
Default 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnStartGraceMinu.ch:
新角色進入遊戲的最初幾分鐘內, 允許迎接團體與起始城鎮的團體在附近出現. 其他團體仍遵守一般的玩家淨空距離.
預設: 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnStartGraceMinu.cn:
新角色进入游戏的最初几分钟内, 允许迎接团体和起始城镇的团体在附近出现. 其他团体仍遵守常规的玩家净空距离.
默认: 10.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnWildernessDens.en: Wilderness encounter rate (percent of town rate)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnWildernessDens.ch: 荒野遭遇率 (城鎮遭遇率的百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnWildernessDens.cn: 荒野遭遇率 (城镇遭遇率的百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnWildernessDens.en:
Sets forest and wilderness encounters relative to towns. At 30, the rate is 30 percent of the town rate.
Default 30.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnWildernessDens.ch:
設定森林與荒野相對於城鎮的遭遇率. 設為30時, 遭遇率為城鎮的百分之30.
預設: 30.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnWildernessDens.cn:
设置森林和荒野相对于城镇的遭遇率. 设为30时, 遭遇率为城镇的百分之30.
默认: 30.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.StealthEnabled_tool.en: NPCs sometimes sneak (slow, crouched) while moving around town or scavenging. They stop sneaking when they see a player or a hostile NPC. Sneaking NPCs are harder for zombies to notice; the effect follows the zombie sight and hearing settings of the world. On by default.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.StealthEnabled_tool.ch: NPC在城鎮中移動或搜刮時, 有時會潛行 (緩慢, 蹲低). 看到玩家或敵對NPC時就會停止潛行. 潛行中的NPC較不容易被殭屍注意到; 效果依世界的殭屍視覺與聽覺設定而定. 預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.StealthEnabled_tool.cn: NPC在城镇中移动或搜刮时, 有时会潜行 (缓慢, 蹲低). 看到玩家或敌对NPC时就会停止潜行. 潜行中的NPC较不容易被僵尸注意到; 效果取决于世界的僵尸视觉与听觉设置. 默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.StealthFrequency_to.en: Share of the time a calm NPC or group moves sneaking. Higher near zombies. 0 never, 100 always. Default 30.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.StealthFrequency_to.ch: 平靜的NPC或團體以潛行移動的時間佔比. 殭屍附近會更高. 0為從不, 100為總是. 預設: 30.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.StealthFrequency_to.cn: 平静的NPC或团体以潜行移动的时间占比. 僵尸附近会更高. 0为从不, 100为总是. 默认: 30.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.StealthNotice.ch: [專家] 潛行: 殭屍察覺距離 (%%)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.StealthNotice.cn: [专家] 潜行: 僵尸察觉距离 (%%)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.StealthNotice_toolt.en: How far zombies notice a sneaking NPC, as a share of the normal distance. Poor zombie sight or hearing makes sneaking stronger, eagle sight and pinpoint hearing weaker. Default 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.StealthNotice_toolt.ch: 殭屍在多遠處會察覺潛行中的NPC, 以正常距離的比例表示. 殭屍視覺「眼拙」或聽覺「耳背」會讓潛行更有效, 「鷹眼」視覺與「靈敏」聽覺則會減弱效果. 預設: 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.StealthNotice_toolt.cn: 僵尸在多远处会察觉潜行中的NPC, 以正常距离的比例表示. 僵尸视觉“眼拙”或听觉“耳背”会让潜行更有效, “鹰眼”视觉与“灵敏”听觉则会减弱效果. 默认: 50.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.TalkAntiSpam_toolti.en:
NPCs remember repeated questions, lose patience and react to your tone. Off: no question memory or opinion changes from words; deeds still count.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.TalkAntiSpam_toolti.ch:
NPC會記得重複的問題, 失去耐心, 並對你的語氣做出反應. 關閉: 不記憶問題, 言語也不會改變好感度; 行為仍會計入.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.TalkAntiSpam_toolti.cn:
NPC会记住重复的问题, 失去耐心, 并对你的语气做出反应. 关闭: 不记忆问题, 言语也不会改变好感度; 行为仍会计入.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.TalkGreetOnOpen_too.en:
Opening a calm NPC's talk menu makes them stop, face you and greet you before choices appear. Fighting or frightened NPCs are not interrupted.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.TalkGreetOnOpen_too.ch:
開啟平靜NPC的對話選單時, 對方會停下, 面向你並打招呼, 之後才出現選項. 戰鬥中或受驚的NPC不會被打斷.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.TalkGreetOnOpen_too.cn:
打开平静NPC的对话菜单时, 对方会停下, 面向你并打招呼, 之后才出现选项. 战斗中或受惊的NPC不会被打断.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.TalkGroupMeetings_t.en:
Non-enemy groups within eight tiles may stop and talk, then part or walk together briefly. Off disables meetings; fights, fleeing and player orders always interrupt.
Default Normal (3).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.TalkGroupMeetings_t.ch:
相距八格內的非敵對團體可能會停下交談, 之後分開或短暫同行. 關閉則停用相遇交談; 戰鬥, 逃跑與玩家命令一律會打斷交談.
預設: 正常 (3).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.TalkGroupMeetings_t.cn:
相距八格内的非敌对团体可能会停下交谈, 之后分开或短暂同行. 关闭则禁用相遇交谈; 战斗, 逃跑和玩家命令总会打断交谈.
默认: 正常 (3).

Sandbox_ProjectALife.TalkMenuFocus.ch: 優先顯示相關對話選項
Sandbox_ProjectALife.TalkMenuFocus.cn: 优先显示相关对话选项

Sandbox_ProjectALife.TalkMenuFocus_toolt.en:
Prioritises useful replies, marks asked questions and hides unsuitable choices, such as personal questions for strangers. Requires conversation memory and patience.
Default on.
