Sandbox_BGWL_ExtendedMags_tooltip.cn: 0 = 关闭; 1 = 默认; 2 = 战利品权重翻倍. 这是相对概率, 而非物品数量. 各倍率会相乘叠加. 只有新生成的战利品会受影响; 修改现有世界的设置后请重新加载该世界.

Sandbox_BGWL_GuaranteedAmmoBoxes_tooltip.en: Off by default. Adds at least the ammo-box quantity selected directly below to each newly spawned compatible weapon. Works independently of magazines and special ammunition. Uses boxes with verified compatible contents. Random supplies may add more. Guaranteed additions ignore loot multipliers, including zero.
Sandbox_BGWL_GuaranteedAmmoBoxes_tooltip.ch: 預設關閉. 為每把新生成的相容武器, 至少附加正下方所選數量的彈藥盒. 與彈匣及特殊彈藥各自獨立運作. 只使用已確認內容物相容的彈藥盒. 隨機補給可能額外增加. 保證附加的物品不受戰利品倍率影響, 倍率為零時也一樣.
Sandbox_BGWL_GuaranteedAmmoBoxes_tooltip.cn: 默认关闭. 为每把新生成的兼容武器, 至少附加正下方所选数量的弹药盒. 与弹匣和特殊弹药各自独立运行. 只使用已确认内容物兼容的弹药盒. 随机补给可能额外增加. 保底附加的物品不受战利品倍率影响, 倍率为零时也一样.

Sandbox_BGWL_GuaranteedSpecialAmmo_toolt.en: Off by default. Works independently of magazines and ordinary ammo boxes. Uses only the special-ammunition quantity X directly below: rockets, flares and smoke rounds = X; 40 mm launchers and underbarrel launchers = 1.5 times X, rounded up; arrows, bolts and slingshot ammunition = 5 times X; paintballs = 25 times X; water = 10 times X. Random supplies may add more. Guaranteed additions ignore loot multipliers, including zero.
Sandbox_BGWL_GuaranteedSpecialAmmo_toolt.ch: 預設關閉. 與彈匣及一般彈藥盒各自獨立運作. 只使用正下方的特殊彈藥數量 X: 火箭彈、訊號彈與煙霧彈 = X; 40mm 發射器與槍掛式發射器 = X 的 1.5 倍, 無條件進位; 箭矢、弩箭與彈弓彈藥 = X 的 5 倍; 漆彈 = X 的 25 倍; 水 = X 的 10 倍. 隨機補給可能額外增加. 保證附加的物品不受戰利品倍率影響, 倍率為零時也一樣.
Sandbox_BGWL_GuaranteedSpecialAmmo_toolt.cn: 默认关闭. 与弹匣和普通弹药盒各自独立运行. 只使用正下方的特殊弹药数量 X: 火箭弹、信号弹和烟雾弹 = X; 40mm 发射器和下挂式发射器 = X 的 1.5 倍, 向上取整; 箭矢、弩箭和弹弓弹药 = X 的 5 倍; 彩弹 = X 的 25 倍; 水 = X 的 10 倍. 随机补给可能额外增加. 保底附加的物品不受战利品倍率影响, 倍率为零时也一样.

Sandbox_BGWL_GuaranteedWeaponSupplies_to.en: Off by default. Adds at least the magazine quantity selected directly below to each newly spawned compatible weapon. Includes compatible loaders when available. Ammo boxes and special ammunition have their own independent switches and quantities. Random supplies may add more. Guaranteed additions ignore loot multipliers, including zero.
Sandbox_BGWL_GuaranteedWeaponSupplies_to.ch: 預設關閉. 為每把新生成的相容武器, 至少附加正下方所選數量的彈匣或適用的相容裝彈器. 彈藥盒與特殊彈藥有各自獨立的開關與數量. 隨機補給可能額外增加. 保證附加的物品不受戰利品倍率影響, 倍率為零時也一樣.
Sandbox_BGWL_GuaranteedWeaponSupplies_to.cn: 默认关闭. 为每把新生成的兼容武器, 至少附加正下方所选数量的弹匣或适用的兼容装弹器. 弹药盒和特殊弹药有各自独立的开关和数量. 随机补给可能额外增加. 保底附加的物品不受战利品倍率影响, 倍率为零时也一样.

Only newly generated loot changes; reload an existing world after editing its settings. Scales loose magazine loot; 0 also disables companion magazines. Sandbox_BGWL_PageNote.en: 0–20 for each multiplier. Adjust how often this loot is chosen: 0 = off, 1 = default, 2 = double weight. Multipliers combine; item counts still depend on loot rarity, space and chance. Repeated overall sliders are linked and apply once.
Sandbox_BGWL_PageNote.ch: 每個倍率為 0–20. 調整此戰利品被抽中的頻率: 0 = 關閉, 1 = 預設, 2 = 權重加倍. 各倍率會相乘疊加; 物品數量仍取決於戰利品稀有度、空間與機率. 重複出現的整體滑桿彼此連動, 只會套用一次.
Sandbox_BGWL_PageNote.cn: 每个倍率为 0–20. 调整此战利品被选中的频率: 0 = 关闭, 1 = 默认, 2 = 权重翻倍. 各倍率会相乘叠加; 物品数量仍取决于战利品稀有度、空间和概率. 重复出现的总体滑块彼此联动, 只会应用一次.

Sandbox_BGWL_Parts_tooltip.en: 0 = off; 1 = default; 2 = double loot weight. This is a relative chance, not an item count. Multipliers combine. Only newly generated loot changes; reload an existing world after editing its settings. Scales ordinary and priority attachment loot weights. There is no fixed-count top-up.

Multipliers combine. Only newly generated loot changes; reload an existing world after editing its settings.
Sandbox_BGWL_TypeSHOTSEMI_tooltip.ch: A400、Auto-5、M1014 與 SPAS-12 等自動裝填霰彈槍. 0 = 關閉; 1 = 預設; 2 = 戰利品權重加倍. 這是相對機率, 不是物品數量. 各倍率會相乘疊加. 只有新產生的戰利品會受影響; 修改既有世界的設定後請重新載入該世界.
Sandbox_BGWL_TypeSHOTSEMI_tooltip.cn: A400、Auto-5、M1014 和 SPAS-12 等自动装填霰弹枪. 0 = 关闭; 1 = 默认; 2 = 战利品权重翻倍. 这是相对概率, 而非物品数量. 各倍率会相乘叠加. 只有新生成的战利品会受影响; 修改现有世界的设置后请重新加载该世界.

Sandbox_BGWL_TypeSMG_tooltip.en: Includes MP5, P90 and other weapons assigned to this group by the mod catalogue. 0 = off; 1 = default; 2 = double loot weight. This is a relative chance, not an item count. Multipliers combine. Only newly generated loot changes; reload an existing world after editing its settings.
Sandbox_BGWL_TypeSMG_tooltip.ch: 包含 MP5、P90, 以及 MOD 目錄歸入此群組的其他武器. 0 = 關閉; 1 = 預設; 2 = 戰利品權重加倍. 這是相對機率, 不是物品數量. 各倍率會相乘疊加. 只有新產生的戰利品會受影響; 修改既有世界的設定後請重新載入該世界.
Sandbox_BGWL_TypeSMG_tooltip.cn: 包括 MP5、P90, 以及模组目录归入此组的其他武器. 0 = 关闭; 1 = 默认; 2 = 战利品权重翻倍. 这是相对概率, 而非物品数量. 各倍率会相乘叠加. 只有新生成的战利品会受影响; 修改现有世界的设置后请重新加载该世界.

Sandbox_BGWL_WeaponSupplyAmmoBoxes_toolt.en: Whole number from 0 to 20; default 2. Used only by Guaranteed ammo boxes above. Guarantees this many compatible ordinary ammo boxes per new weapon. Does not set special-ammunition quantities. Random supplies may add more. Zero disables this guaranteed addition.
Sandbox_BGWL_WeaponSupplyAmmoBoxes_toolt.ch: 0 到 20 的整數; 預設 2. 只供上方的「保證彈藥盒」使用. 保證每把新武器附帶這麼多盒相容的一般彈藥盒. 不會設定特殊彈藥的數量. 隨機補給可能額外增加. 設為零會停用此保證附加.
Sandbox_BGWL_WeaponSupplyAmmoBoxes_toolt.cn: 0 到 20 的整数; 默认 2. 仅供上方的“保底弹药盒”使用. 保证每把新武器附带这么多盒兼容的普通弹药盒. 不会设置特殊弹药的数量. 随机补给可能额外增加. 设为零会禁用此保底附加.

Sandbox_BGWL_WeaponSupplyMagazines.ch: 每把武器的額外彈匣數
Sandbox_BGWL_WeaponSupplyMagazines.cn: 每把武器的额外弹匣数

Sandbox_BGWL_WeaponSupplyMagazines_toolt.en: Whole number from 0 to 20; default 2. Used only by Guaranteed magazines above. Guarantees this many extra compatible magazines or loaders per new weapon. The fitted magazine does not count. Random supplies may add more. Zero disables this guaranteed addition.
Sandbox_BGWL_WeaponSupplyMagazines_toolt.ch: 0 到 20 的整數; 預設 2. 只供上方的「保證彈匣」使用. 保證每把新武器額外附帶這麼多個相容的彈匣或裝彈器. 已裝在槍上的彈匣不計入. 隨機補給可能額外增加. 設為零會停用此保證附加.
Sandbox_BGWL_WeaponSupplyMagazines_toolt.cn: 0 到 20 的整数; 默认 2. 仅供上方的“保底弹匣”使用. 保证每把新武器额外附带这么多个兼容的弹匣或装弹器. 已装在枪上的弹匣不计入. 随机补给可能额外增加. 设为零会禁用此保底附加.

Sandbox_BGWL_WeaponSupplyNote.en: The three WIP switches work independently. Each quantity slider immediately below its switch controls only that category. Guaranteed additions ignore loot multipliers and may exceed container capacity. Random supplies remain and may add more.
Sandbox_BGWL_WeaponSupplyNote.ch: 三個開發中的開關各自獨立運作. 每個開關正下方的數量滑桿只控制該類別. 保證附加的物品不受戰利品倍率影響, 且可能超出容器容量. 隨機補給依然保留, 並可能額外增加.
Sandbox_BGWL_WeaponSupplyNote.cn: 三个开发中的开关各自独立运行. 每个开关正下方的数量滑块只控制该类别. 保底附加的物品不受战利品倍率影响, 且可能超出容器容量. 随机补给依然保留, 并可能额外增加.

Sandbox_BGWL_WeaponSupplySpecialAmmo_too.en: Whole number X from 0 to 20; default 2. Used only by Guaranteed special ammunition above. At X=2: 2 RPG rockets, 3 grenade-launcher or underbarrel rounds, 10 arrows or bolts. Magazines and ordinary boxes use their own sliders. Random supplies may add more. Zero disables this guaranteed addition.
Sandbox_BGWL_WeaponSupplySpecialAmmo_too.ch: 0 到 20 的整數 X; 預設 2. 只供上方的「保證特殊彈藥」使用. X=2 時: 2 枚 RPG 火箭彈, 3 發榴彈發射器或槍掛式發射器彈藥, 10 支箭矢或弩箭. 彈匣與一般彈藥盒使用各自的滑桿. 隨機補給可能額外增加. 設為零會停用此保證附加.
Sandbox_BGWL_WeaponSupplySpecialAmmo_too.cn: 0 到 20 的整数 X; 默认 2. 仅供上方的“保底特殊弹药”使用. X=2 时: 2 枚 RPG 火箭弹, 3 发榴弹发射器或下挂式发射器弹药, 10 支箭矢或弩箭. 弹匣和普通弹药盒使用各自的滑块. 随机补给可能额外增加. 设为零会禁用此保底附加.

Sandbox_HP_Adrenaline.en: Thrill Seeker: adrenaline per scare or streak (percent)
Sandbox_HP_Adrenaline.ch: 刺激追求者: 每次驚嚇或連殺的腎上腺素 (百分比)
Sandbox_HP_Adrenaline.cn: 刺激追求者: 每次惊吓或连杀的肾上腺素 (百分比)

Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineCrash.ch: 腎上腺素: 結束時的崩潰 (百分比)
Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineCrash.cn: 肾上腺素: 结束时的崩溃 (百分比)

Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineCrash_tooltip.en: When the rush ends, the sleepiness you had plus what built up comes back with this extra, and you lose this much endurance. 0 = no crash.
Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineCrash_tooltip.ch: 腎上腺素退去時, 你原有的睏意加上期間累積的睏意會連同這個額外量一起回來, 並且損失這麼多耐力. 0 = 不會崩潰.
Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineCrash_tooltip.cn: 肾上腺素退去时, 你原有的困意加上期间累积的困意会连同这个额外量一起回来, 并且损失这么多耐力. 0 = 不会崩溃.

Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineDecay.ch: 腎上腺素: 降到 0 所需分鐘數
Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineDecay.cn: 肾上腺素: 降到 0 所需分钟数

Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineDecay_tooltip.en: In-game minutes without scares or nearby kills before adrenaline (Thrill Seeker trait) drops to 0. Normal arousal is not affected.
Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineDecay_tooltip.ch: 沒有驚嚇或附近擊殺時, 腎上腺素 (刺激追求者特質) 降到 0 所需的遊戲內分鐘數. 不影響一般的慾火.
Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineDecay_tooltip.cn: 没有惊吓或附近击杀时, 肾上腺素 (刺激追求者特质) 降到 0 所需的游戏内分钟数. 不影响普通的欲火.

Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineKills.ch: 腎上腺素: 1 分鐘內的殭屍數
Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineKills.cn: 肾上腺素: 1 分钟内的僵尸数

Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineKills_tooltip.en: How many zombies you must kill in under 1 real minute for adrenaline to kick in.
Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineKills_tooltip.ch: 必須在現實時間 1 分鐘內殺死多少殭屍, 才會觸發腎上腺素.
Sandbox_HP_AdrenalineKills_tooltip.cn: 必须在现实时间 1 分钟内杀死多少僵尸, 才会触发肾上腺素.

Sandbox_HP_Adrenaline_tooltip.en: With the Thrill Seeker trait, how much adrenaline a strong scare (panic level 2) or a kill streak adds. While it lasts you feel no sleepiness and tire at half the rate.
Sandbox_HP_Adrenaline_tooltip.ch: 擁有刺激追求者特質時, 一次強烈驚嚇 (恐慌等級 2) 或一次連殺會增加多少腎上腺素. 持續期間你不會感到睏, 疲勞累積速度減半.
Sandbox_HP_Adrenaline_tooltip.cn: 拥有刺激追求者特质时, 一次强烈惊吓 (恐慌等级 2) 或一次连杀会增加多少肾上腺素. 持续期间你不会感到困, 疲劳累积速度减半.

Sandbox_HP_BodyHeat_tooltip.en: Relief gives you a heat rush: +2 degrees C over 5 in-game minutes (max 39.5), then back to normal over 5 real minutes. Helps against the cold (it never cools you below normal); in summer you overheat for a while.
Sandbox_HP_BodyHeat_tooltip.ch: 紓解後會一陣燥熱: 在 5 分鐘遊戲時間內體溫 +2°C (最高 39.5), 然後在 5 分鐘現實時間內恢復正常. 有助於抵禦寒冷 (絕不會讓你降到正常體溫以下); 夏天則會過熱一陣子.
Sandbox_HP_BodyHeat_tooltip.cn: 释放后会一阵燥热: 在 5 分钟游戏时间内体温 +2°C (最高 39.5), 然后在 5 分钟现实时间内恢复正常. 有助于抵御寒冷 (绝不会让你降到正常体温以下); 夏天则会过热一阵子.

Sandbox_HP_CounterGainMult_tooltip.en: Multiplies how much the counter rises per use.
Sandbox_HP_CounterGainMult_tooltip.ch: 每次使用時計數上升量的倍率.
Sandbox_HP_CounterGainMult_tooltip.cn: 每次使用时计数上升量的倍率.

Sandbox_HP_CritChance_tooltip.en: The 'event 42': rare chance that it goes VERY wrong. 0.1 = 1 in 1000.
Sandbox_HP_CritChance_tooltip.ch: 「事件 42」: 極少數情況下會出大事. 0.1 = 千分之一.
Sandbox_HP_CritChance_tooltip.cn: “事件 42”: 极少数情况下会出大事. 0.1 = 千分之一.

Sandbox_HP_CureRealHours_tooltip.en: REAL hours of play without doing it to get back to Clean. The addiction drops evenly from when you stop. Fapper takes twice as long and never goes below Habit; Still Hands, half.
Sandbox_HP_CureRealHours_tooltip.ch: 不做這件事的「現實」遊玩小時數, 達到後回到無成癮階段. 停止後成癮度會平均下降. 手槍俠需要兩倍時間, 而且永遠不會低於習慣; 管住雙手則只需一半.
Sandbox_HP_CureRealHours_tooltip.cn: 不做这件事的“现实”游玩小时数, 达到后回到无成瘾阶段. 停止后瘾会均匀下降. 撸管侠需要两倍时间, 而且永远不会低于习惯; 管住双手则只需一半.

Sandbox_HP_DeathByAbuse_tooltip.en: If enabled, the critical event can kill you (or leave you at 1 HP). If not, it only hurts your arm.
Sandbox_HP_DeathByAbuse_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, 嚴重事件可能害死你 (或讓你只剩 1 點生命). 停用時只會傷到手臂.
Sandbox_HP_DeathByAbuse_tooltip.cn: 启用后, 严重事件可能害死你 (或让你只剩 1 点生命). 禁用时只会伤到手臂.

Sandbox_HP_EnablePenalties_tooltip.en: If disabled, it's all relief with no consequences.
Sandbox_HP_EnablePenalties_tooltip.ch: 停用時, 只有紓解, 沒有任何後果.
Sandbox_HP_EnablePenalties_tooltip.cn: 禁用时, 只有释放, 没有任何后果.

Sandbox_HP_HandUsesPerDay_tooltip.en: How many times you can do it per day before calluses show up.
Sandbox_HP_HandUsesPerDay_tooltip.ch: 每天可以做幾次才會開始長繭.
Sandbox_HP_HandUsesPerDay_tooltip.cn: 每天可以做几次才会开始长茧.

Sandbox_HP_HandWear_tooltip.en: Overusing gives calluses (slower reloading) and, once very addicted, your hands shake (worse aim and melee).
Sandbox_HP_HandWear_tooltip.ch: 過度使用會長繭 (裝彈變慢), 而嚴重成癮後手會發抖 (瞄準和近戰變差).
Sandbox_HP_HandWear_tooltip.cn: 过度使用会长茧 (装弹变慢), 而严重成瘾后手会发抖 (瞄准和近战变差).

Sandbox_HP_HungerCost_tooltip.en: How much hunger it gives you each time (0 = none).
Sandbox_HP_HungerCost_tooltip.ch: 每次會增加多少飢餓 (0 = 不增加).
Sandbox_HP_HungerCost_tooltip.cn: 每次会增加多少饥饿 (0 = 不增加).

Sandbox_HP_ItemWear_tooltip.en: Used clothing gets soaked (the sock also gets dirty). Magazines, CalentorraZ, tissues, toilet paper and rags get used up.
Sandbox_HP_ItemWear_tooltip.ch: 用過的衣物會濕透 (襪子還會變髒). 雜誌、髒比辣妹、面紙、廁紙和碎布條會被用掉.
Sandbox_HP_ItemWear_tooltip.cn: 用过的衣物会湿透 (袜子还会变脏). 杂志、脏比辣妹、纸巾、厕纸和碎布条会被用掉.

Sandbox_HP_MagazineUses_tooltip.en: How many times a magazine (or CalentorraZ) can be used before it's ruined.
Sandbox_HP_MagazineUses_tooltip.ch: 一本雜誌 (或髒比辣妹) 在報廢前可以用幾次.
Sandbox_HP_MagazineUses_tooltip.cn: 一本杂志 (或脏比辣妹) 在报废前可以用几次.

Sandbox_HP_MoanChance_tooltip.en: Chance of letting out a loud noise when finishing, which draws zombies.
Sandbox_HP_MoanChance_tooltip.ch: 結束時發出大聲響並吸引殭屍的機率.
Sandbox_HP_MoanChance_tooltip.cn: 结束时发出大声响并吸引僵尸的概率.

Sandbox_HP_MoanRadius_tooltip.en: Radius in tiles of the noise that draws zombies.
Sandbox_HP_MoanRadius_tooltip.ch: 吸引殭屍的聲響半徑, 以格為單位.
Sandbox_HP_MoanRadius_tooltip.cn: 吸引僵尸的声响半径, 以格为单位.

Sandbox_HP_PC_AlcoholPill_tooltip.en: Mixing alcohol with pills (sleeping tablets, painkillers...) within 8h can kill you. Vitamins don't count.
Sandbox_HP_PC_AlcoholPill_tooltip.ch: 8 小時內把酒精和藥丸 (安眠藥、止痛藥…) 混用可能致死. 維生素不算.
Sandbox_HP_PC_AlcoholPill_tooltip.cn: 8 小时内把酒精和药片 (安眠药、止痛药…) 混用可能致死. 维生素不算.

Sandbox_HP_PC_BaseChance.ch: 心臟病發作: 基礎機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_HP_PC_BaseChance.cn: 心脏病发作: 基础概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_HP_PC_BaseChance_tooltip.en: Base risk per scare. Lifestyle factors multiply it.
Sandbox_HP_PC_BaseChance_tooltip.ch: 每次驚嚇的基礎風險. 生活習慣因素會以倍率調整此風險.
Sandbox_HP_PC_BaseChance_tooltip.cn: 每次惊吓的基础风险. 生活习惯因素会按倍率调整此风险.

Sandbox_HP_PC_Enabled.ch: 驚嚇引發心臟病 (生活習慣)
Sandbox_HP_PC_Enabled.cn: 惊吓引发心脏病 (生活习惯)

Sandbox_HP_PC_Enabled_tooltip.en: Zombie scares can cause a heart attack based on your fitness, alcohol, tobacco, junk food and fatigue.
Sandbox_HP_PC_Enabled_tooltip.ch: 殭屍驚嚇可能依你的體格、飲酒、吸菸、垃圾食物和疲勞程度引發心臟病.
Sandbox_HP_PC_Enabled_tooltip.cn: 僵尸惊吓可能根据你的体格、饮酒、吸烟、垃圾食品和疲劳程度引发心脏病.

Sandbox_HP_PC_Lethality.ch: 心臟病發作: 致死率 (百分比)
Sandbox_HP_PC_Lethality.cn: 心脏病发作: 致死率 (百分比)

Sandbox_HP_PC_Lethality_tooltip.en: Chance that the heart attack is fatal.
Sandbox_HP_PC_Lethality_tooltip.ch: 心臟病發作致命的機率.
Sandbox_HP_PC_Lethality_tooltip.cn: 心脏病发作致命的概率.

Sandbox_HP_SackFarmChance_tooltip.en: How often the Burlap Headsack spawns in barns, farm wardrobes and farm tools. For reference, the sledgehammer uses 0.1.
Sandbox_HP_SackFarmChance_tooltip.ch: 粗麻布頭套在穀倉、農場衣櫃和農具中出現的頻率. 作為參考, 大錘是 0.1.
Sandbox_HP_SackFarmChance_tooltip.cn: 粗麻布头套在谷仓、农场衣柜和农具中出现的频率. 作为参考, 大锤是 0.1.

Sandbox_HP_ScarecrowMode_tooltip.en: With a sack on your head: muffled moan (half the noise), Scarecrow lines and anonymity in multiplayer. With Beta Blockers, cold blood. Full costume: burlap sack, lumberjack shirt and jeans.
Sandbox_HP_ScarecrowMode_tooltip.ch: 頭上套著麻袋時: 呻吟變悶 (噪音減半)、說出稻草人台詞, 並在多人遊戲中匿名. 搭配 β-阻斷劑時則保持冷靜. 全套裝扮: 粗麻布頭套、伐木工襯衫和牛仔褲.
Sandbox_HP_ScarecrowMode_tooltip.cn: 头上套着麻袋时: 呻吟变闷 (噪音减半)、说出稻草人台词, 并在多人游戏中匿名. 搭配 β-阻断剂时则保持冷静. 全套装扮: 粗麻布头套、伐木工衬衫和牛仔裤.

Sandbox_HP_ScarecrowStash_tooltip.en: Chance, in each barn or shed container, to find the full costume along with a CalentorraZ.
Sandbox_HP_ScarecrowStash_tooltip.ch: 在每個穀倉或棚屋容器中, 找到全套裝扮外加一本髒比辣妹的機率.
Sandbox_HP_ScarecrowStash_tooltip.cn: 在每个谷仓或棚屋容器中, 找到全套装扮外加一本脏比辣妹的概率.

Sandbox_HP_ScarecrowZombies_tooltip.en: How often the zombie dressed as the Straw Man appears on farms (the farmer uses 80). Drops a CalentorraZ.
Sandbox_HP_ScarecrowZombies_tooltip.ch: 打扮成稻草人的殭屍在農場出現的頻率 (農民是 80). 會掉落一本髒比辣妹.
Sandbox_HP_ScarecrowZombies_tooltip.cn: 打扮成稻草人的僵尸在农场出现的频率 (农民是 80). 会掉落一本脏比辣妹.

Sandbox_HP_SeptemberNoFap_tooltip.en: When the in-game calendar reaches September, addiction and arousal rise x1.5, arousal rises even when Clean, and Still Hands only slows it to 3/4.
Sandbox_HP_SeptemberNoFap_tooltip.ch: 遊戲日曆到了九月時, 成癮度和慾火上升 x1.5, 即使在無成癮階段慾火也會上升, 而管住雙手只能減緩到 3/4.
Sandbox_HP_SeptemberNoFap_tooltip.cn: 游戏日历到了九月时, 瘾和欲火上升 x1.5, 即使在无成瘾阶段欲火也会上升, 而管住双手只能减缓到 3/4.

Sandbox_HP_SleepCost_tooltip.en: How much fatigue/drowsiness it gives you each time (0 = none).
Sandbox_HP_SleepCost_tooltip.ch: 每次會增加多少疲勞/睏意 (0 = 不增加).
Sandbox_HP_SleepCost_tooltip.cn: 每次会增加多少疲劳/困意 (0 = 不增加).

Sandbox_HP_TensionAnxiety_tooltip.en: With arousal at 80 or more you stay anxious (constant nerves) until you relieve yourself.
Sandbox_HP_TensionAnxiety_tooltip.ch: 慾火達到 80 以上時, 你會一直焦慮 (持續緊張), 直到你紓解為止.
Sandbox_HP_TensionAnxiety_tooltip.cn: 欲火达到 80 以上时, 你会一直焦虑 (持续紧张), 直到你释放为止.

Sandbox_HP_TensionBlur.ch: 慾火爆表: 視線模糊
Sandbox_HP_TensionBlur.cn: 欲火爆表: 视线模糊

Sandbox_HP_TensionBlur_tooltip.en: With arousal at 95 or more your vision blurs like the Short Sighted trait until you relieve yourself.
Sandbox_HP_TensionBlur_tooltip.ch: 慾火達到 95 以上時, 你的視線會像近視特質一樣模糊, 直到你紓解為止.
Sandbox_HP_TensionBlur_tooltip.cn: 欲火达到 95 以上时, 你的视线会像视力障碍特质一样模糊, 直到你释放为止.

Sandbox_HP_TensionEnabled_tooltip.en: A need that rises on its own over time and drops when you relieve yourself. High = you get distracted (stress, slower reading).
Sandbox_HP_TensionEnabled_tooltip.ch: 一種會隨時間自行上升、紓解後下降的需求. 偏高 = 你會分心 (壓力、閱讀變慢).
Sandbox_HP_TensionEnabled_tooltip.cn: 一种会随时间自行上升、释放后下降的需求. 偏高 = 你会分心 (压力、阅读变慢).

Sandbox_HP_TensionFromHabit_tooltip.en: If on, there is no arousal in the Clean phase; it starts at Habit.
Sandbox_HP_TensionFromHabit_tooltip.ch: 開啟時, 無成癮階段沒有慾火; 從習慣階段開始.
Sandbox_HP_TensionFromHabit_tooltip.cn: 开启时, 无成瘾阶段没有欲火; 从习惯阶段开始.

Sandbox_HP_TensionRate.ch: 緊繃上升速度 (每小時百分比)
Sandbox_HP_TensionRate.cn: 紧张上升速度 (每小时百分比)

Sandbox_HP_TensionRate_tooltip.en: How much tension rises per hour. 0 = it doesn't rise.
Sandbox_HP_TensionRate_tooltip.ch: 緊繃每小時上升多少. 0 = 不會上升.
Sandbox_HP_TensionRate_tooltip.cn: 紧张每小时上升多少. 0 = 不会上升.

Sandbox_HP_ThirstCost_tooltip.en: How much thirst it gives you each time (0 = none).
Sandbox_HP_ThirstCost_tooltip.ch: 每次會增加多少口渴 (0 = 不增加).
Sandbox_HP_ThirstCost_tooltip.cn: 每次会增加多少口渴 (0 = 不增加).

Sandbox_HP_ThresholdAnxiety_tooltip.en: From this value on, the Anxiety phase begins.
Sandbox_HP_ThresholdAnxiety_tooltip.ch: 從這個數值起, 進入焦慮階段.
Sandbox_HP_ThresholdAnxiety_tooltip.cn: 从这个数值起, 进入焦虑阶段.

Sandbox_HP_ThresholdDependency_tooltip.en: From this value on, the Dependency phase begins.
Sandbox_HP_ThresholdDependency_tooltip.ch: 從這個數值起, 進入依賴階段.
Sandbox_HP_ThresholdDependency_tooltip.cn: 从这个数值起, 进入依赖阶段.

Sandbox_HP_ThresholdHabit_tooltip.en: From this value on, the Habit phase begins.
Sandbox_HP_ThresholdHabit_tooltip.ch: 從這個數值起, 進入習慣階段.
Sandbox_HP_ThresholdHabit_tooltip.cn: 从这个数值起, 进入习惯阶段.

Sandbox_HP_ZombieHeartAttack.en: Heart attack if a zombie interrupts you (percent)
Sandbox_HP_ZombieHeartAttack.ch: 被殭屍打斷時心臟病發作 (百分比)
Sandbox_HP_ZombieHeartAttack.cn: 被僵尸打断时心脏病发作 (百分比)

Sandbox_HP_ZombieHeartAttack_tooltip.en: Chance of a heart attack from the scare if a zombie catches you mid-action.
Sandbox_HP_ZombieHeartAttack_tooltip.ch: 辦事到一半被殭屍撞見時, 因驚嚇引發心臟病的機率.
Sandbox_HP_ZombieHeartAttack_tooltip.cn: 办事到一半被僵尸撞见时, 因惊吓引发心脏病的概率.

Sandbox_CTBrewery_DebugModu_tooltip.en: Adds a '[CTB] Debug' entry to the stations' right-click menu. Only admins or a game started with -debug see it.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_DebugModu_tooltip.ch: 在工作臺的右鍵選單中加入「[CTB] 除錯」項目. 只有管理員或以 -debug 啟動的遊戲才看得到.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_DebugModu_tooltip.cn: 在工作站的右键菜单中添加“[CTB] 调试”选项. 只有管理员或以 -debug 启动的游戏才能看到.

Sandbox_CTBrewery_DergiSikligi_tooltip.en: How often all six notebooks spawn: the five themed volumes (wine, grain, distilling, cordials, parts) and the full notebook that teaches every branch. Bottling recipes are learned from them.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_DergiSikligi_tooltip.ch: 全部六本筆記的生成頻率: 五本主題分冊 (葡萄酒、穀物、蒸餾、甜露酒、零件) 以及教授所有分支的完整筆記. 裝瓶配方需從這些筆記中學習.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_DergiSikligi_tooltip.cn: 全部六本笔记的生成频率: 五本主题分册 (葡萄酒、谷物、蒸馏、甜露酒、部件) 以及传授所有分支的完整笔记. 装瓶配方需从这些笔记中学习.

Sandbox_CTBrewery_EkinSureCarpani_toolti.en: Multiplies the growth time of the mod's ten plants. 2 is twice as slow. Vanilla crops are unaffected.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_EkinSureCarpani_toolti.ch: 調整本 MOD 十種植物的生長時間倍率. 2 表示慢一倍. 原版作物不受影響.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_EkinSureCarpani_toolti.cn: 调整本 MOD 十种植物的生长时间倍率. 2 表示慢一倍. 原版作物不受影响.

Sandbox_CTBrewery_GelistirmeCarpani_tool.en: How strong the station upgrade parts are.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_GelistirmeCarpani_tool.ch: 工作臺升級零件的效果強度.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_GelistirmeCarpani_tool.cn: 工作站升级部件的效果强度.

Sandbox_CTBrewery_MahzenSicaklikAlt_tool.en: Below this the cellar stops aging; bottles do not spoil.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_MahzenSicaklikAlt_tool.ch: 低於此溫度時酒窖停止陳釀; 酒瓶不會變質.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_MahzenSicaklikAlt_tool.cn: 低于此温度时酒窖停止陈酿; 酒瓶不会变质.

Sandbox_CTBrewery_MahzenSicaklikUst_tool.en: Above this the cellar stops aging; bottles do not spoil.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_MahzenSicaklikUst_tool.ch: 高於此溫度時酒窖停止陳釀; 酒瓶不會變質.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_MahzenSicaklikUst_tool.cn: 高于此温度时酒窖停止陈酿; 酒瓶不会变质.

Sandbox_CTBrewery_SicaklikAlt_tooltip.en: Below this the barrel waits; the batch does not spoil.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_SicaklikAlt_tooltip.ch: 低於此溫度時發酵桶會暫停; 批次不會變質.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_SicaklikAlt_tooltip.cn: 低于此温度时发酵桶会暂停; 批次不会变质.

Sandbox_CTBrewery_SicaklikUst_tooltip.en: Above this the barrel waits; the batch does not spoil.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_SicaklikUst_tooltip.ch: 高於此溫度時發酵桶會暫停; 批次不會變質.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_SicaklikUst_tooltip.cn: 高于此温度时发酵桶会暂停; 批次不会变质.

Sandbox_CTBrewery_SureCarpani_tooltip.en: Multiplies barrel, still and cellar times. 0.5 is twice as fast, 2 twice as slow.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_SureCarpani_tooltip.ch: 調整發酵桶、蒸餾器與酒窖的時間倍率. 0.5 表示快一倍, 2 表示慢一倍.
Sandbox_CTBrewery_SureCarpani_tooltip.cn: 调整发酵桶、蒸馏器与酒窖的时间倍率. 0.5 表示快一倍, 2 表示慢一倍.

Sandbox_MultiplierConfig_CTB_Brewing_too.en: How fast the Brewing skill levels up.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_AimCalmEnabled.en: Your people don't mind your aim

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_AimCalmEnabled_toolti.en: Your own people and anyone following or waiting for you never complain or get scared when your gun points their way. Allies don't either while a fight is on around them. Anyone hostile to you or fighting you still reacts as usual.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_AimCalmEnabled_toolti.ch: 你的槍口對著自己人或正在跟隨、等候你的人時, 他們絕不會抱怨或受到驚嚇. 周圍正在戰鬥時, 同盟也一樣. 對你敵對或正在與你戰鬥的人仍照常反應.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_AimCalmEnabled_toolti.cn: 你的枪口对着自己人或正在跟随、等候你的人时, 他们绝不会抱怨或受到惊吓. 周围正在战斗时, 同盟也一样. 对你敌对或正在与你战斗的人仍照常反应.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_AlifeFixesEnabled_too.en: Fixes for bugs inside A-Life itself. NPCs are put away before the area around them unloads, so they don't come back as zombies (single player and servers). In multiplayer, NPCs left frozen are rebuilt. NPCs inside a building can unlock its key-locked doors, as a player there could, and knock broken glass out of a window before climbing through. On servers, zombies no longer drop masks and hats they aren't wearing (clothing left on reused zombie bodies). Also removes an error that filled the log. Off brings these bugs back.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_AlifeFixesEnabled_too.ch: 修正 A-Life 本身的錯誤. NPC會在周圍區域卸載前先被收起, 因此不會變成殭屍回來 (單人與伺服器皆適用). 多人模式中, 卡住不動的NPC會被重建. 建築內的NPC可以像在場玩家一樣打開需要鑰匙的上鎖門, 並在翻窗前先敲掉碎玻璃. 在伺服器上, 殭屍不再掉落自己沒戴的面罩與帽子 (重複利用的殭屍身體上殘留的衣物). 也移除了一個會塞滿日誌的錯誤. 關閉則這些錯誤會重新出現.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_AlifeFixesEnabled_too.cn: 修复 A-Life 本身的错误. NPC会在周围区域卸载前先被收起, 因此不会变成僵尸回来 (单人和服务器均适用). 多人模式中, 卡住不动的NPC会被重建. 建筑内的NPC可以像在场玩家一样打开需要钥匙的上锁门, 并在翻窗前先敲掉碎玻璃. 在服务器上, 僵尸不再掉落自己没戴的面罩和帽子 (重复利用的僵尸身体上残留的衣物). 也移除了一个会塞满日志的错误. 关闭则这些错误会重新出现.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_AlifeFixesNoZombiesIn.en: No zombies appear inside your base

A zombie the game creates inside a base's main building or quarters, or on an upper floor anywhere in a base, as the area loads or the zombie population fills it, is removed in the moment it is made, before anyone sees it. Zombies that walk in, and people or NPCs who turn inside, are never touched: only the game's own new zombies are. Zombies spawned there by an admin or another mod are removed too. Needs Fix A-Life bugs on. Off by default.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_AlifeFixesNoZombiesIn.ch: 區域載入或殭屍數量補充時, 遊戲在基地主建築或宿舍內、或基地任何地方的樓上生成的殭屍, 會在生成當下、任何人看到之前就被移除. 走進來的殭屍, 以及在室內屍變的人或NPC一律不受影響: 只處理遊戲自己新生成的殭屍. 管理員或其他 MOD 在那裡生成的殭屍也會被移除. 需要開啟「修正 A-Life 錯誤」. 預設關閉.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_AlifeFixesNoZombiesIn.cn: 区域加载或僵尸数量补充时, 游戏在基地主建筑或宿舍内、或基地任何地方的楼上生成的僵尸, 会在生成当下、任何人看到之前就被移除. 走进来的僵尸, 以及在室内尸变的人或NPC一律不受影响: 只处理游戏自己新生成的僵尸. 管理员或其他 MOD 在那里生成的僵尸也会被移除. 需要开启“修复 A-Life 错误”. 默认关闭.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ArmedGuardsEnabled.en: Guards carry the guns you donate
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ArmedGuardsEnabled.ch: 警衛會攜帶你捐贈的槍械
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ArmedGuardsEnabled.cn: 警卫会携带你捐赠的枪械

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ArmedGuardsEnabled_to.en: Each gun given to an outpost goes to one of its guards, with some of its ammo; they carry it the next time they spawn and drop it if killed.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ArmedGuardsEnabled_to.ch: 每把捐給前哨站的槍會連同部分彈藥交給其中一名警衛; 他們下次生成時會攜帶, 被殺時會掉落.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ArmedGuardsEnabled_to.cn: 每把捐给哨所的枪会连同部分弹药交给其中一名警卫; 他们下次生成时会携带, 被杀时会掉落.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseHostileCanBreach_.en: NPCs fighting a player, and raiders, may still break doors and barricades in base areas, and walk past door and window markers anywhere. Off: bases and markers hold them too.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseHostileCanBreach_.ch: 與玩家交戰的NPC以及掠奪者, 仍可破壞基地區域內的門與路障, 並無視任何地方的門窗標記. 關閉: 基地與標記也能擋住他們.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseHostileCanBreach_.cn: 与玩家交战的NPC以及掠夺者, 仍可破坏基地区域内的门和路障, 并无视任何地方的门窗标记. 关闭: 基地和标记也能挡住他们.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseKeepOut.en: Keep NPCs out of base grounds

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseKeepOut_tooltip.en: NPCs don't choose spots inside your grounds to wander to, and anyone who lingers there without belonging (6 seconds) walks back out. Not your residents, people following a player's orders, captives, raiders or anyone fighting a player, or someone you're standing next to (talking or trading).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseKeepOut_tooltip.ch: NPC閒晃時不會選擇你場地內的地點, 不屬於這裡卻在此逗留的人 (6 秒) 會自行走出去. 不適用於: 你的居民、聽從玩家命令的人、俘虜、掠奪者或與玩家交戰者, 以及站在你身旁的人 (交談或交易中).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseKeepOut_tooltip.cn: NPC闲逛时不会选择你场地内的地点, 不属于这里却在此逗留的人 (6 秒) 会自行走出去. 不适用于: 你的居民、听从玩家命令的人、俘虏、掠夺者或与玩家交战者, 以及站在你身旁的人 (交谈或交易中).

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxAreas_tooltip.en: Rectangles (main, quarters, yard) one base may have. Admins aren't limited.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxAreas_tooltip.ch: 單一基地可擁有的矩形區域數 (主建築、宿舍、院子). 管理員不受限制.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxAreas_tooltip.cn: 单个基地可拥有的矩形区域数 (主建筑、宿舍、院子). 管理员不受限制.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxBases.ch: 每位玩家或陣營的基地數
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxBases.cn: 每位玩家或阵营的基地数

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxBases_tooltip.en: How many bases each player (or vanilla faction) may mark. Admins aren't limited.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxBases_tooltip.ch: 每位玩家 (或原版陣營) 可標記的基地數量. 管理員不受限制.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxBases_tooltip.cn: 每位玩家 (或原版阵营) 可标记的基地数量. 管理员不受限制.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxPosts_tooltip.en: Tiles a resident crew stands guard on. Admins aren't limited.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxPosts_tooltip.ch: 居民隊伍站哨的格子數. 管理員不受限制.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxPosts_tooltip.cn: 居民队伍站岗的格子数. 管理员不受限制.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxResidents_tool.en: How many NPCs may live at one base (default 12, up to 30), whatever the beds say; beds in the quarters are the other limit. A crew only moves in if all of them fit.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxResidents_tool.ch: 單一基地可居住的NPC數量 (預設: 12, 最多 30), 不論床位多少; 宿舍床位是另一項限制. 隊伍只有全員都住得下才會入住.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxResidents_tool.cn: 单个基地可居住的NPC数量 (默认: 12, 最多 30), 不论床位多少; 宿舍床位是另一项限制. 队伍只有全员都住得下才会入住.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxSide_tooltip.en: Longest side of one base area, for players. Admins may mark up to 400.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxSide_tooltip.ch: 玩家單一基地區域的最長邊. 管理員最多可標記 400 格.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseMaxSide_tooltip.cn: 玩家单个基地区域的最长边. 管理员最多可标记 400 格.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseProtect_tooltip.en: No NPC spawns in player bases (right-click > [A-Life Jimmy] Bases), and non-hostile NPCs won't break, pick or scavenge anything inside.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseProtect_tooltip.ch: 玩家基地 (右鍵 > [A-Life Jimmy] 基地) 內不會生成NPC, 非敵對NPC也不會破壞、撬鎖或搜刮其中任何東西.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseProtect_tooltip.cn: 玩家基地 (右键 > [A-Life Jimmy] 基地) 内不会生成NPC, 非敌对NPC也不会破坏、撬锁或搜刮其中任何东西.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseShutDoors_tooltip.en: Your residents shut a door or window of their base behind them once they've gone through and nobody is in the way, and one they opened in passing (one you opened or left open stays as it is). An outside door that was locked locks again. Off: doors and windows they open stay open.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseShutDoors_tooltip.ch: 你的居民穿過基地的門或窗、且無人擋路後, 會隨手關上自己路過時打開的門窗 (你打開或保持敞開的則維持原狀). 原本上鎖的外門會再次上鎖. 關閉: 他們打開的門窗會保持敞開.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BaseShutDoors_tooltip.cn: 你的居民穿过基地的门或窗、且无人挡路后, 会随手关上自己路过时打开的门窗 (你打开或保持敞开的则维持原状). 原本上锁的外门会再次上锁. 关闭: 他们打开的门窗会保持敞开.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BasesRaidChance.ch: 基地遭突襲機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BasesRaidChance.cn: 基地遭突袭概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BasesRaidChance_toolt.en: Per hostile group within 80 tiles, checked every game hour while you're away.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BasesRaidChance_toolt.ch: 你不在時, 每個遊戲內小時對 80 格內的每個敵對團體各判定一次.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BasesRaidChance_toolt.cn: 你不在时, 每个游戏内小时对 80 格内的每个敌对团体各判定一次.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BasesRaids.en: Raids on player bases while you're away
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BasesRaids.ch: 你不在時玩家基地遭突襲
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BasesRaids.cn: 你不在时玩家基地遭突袭

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BasesRaids_tooltip.en: Hostile groups may attack a base with residents while no player is within 110 tiles (from day 7, at most every 3 days a base). Guard posts help; a crew out of food fights worse. Nobody takes the base over.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BasesRaids_tooltip.ch: 110 格內沒有玩家時, 敵對團體可能攻擊有居民的基地 (第 7 天起, 每個基地最多每 3 天一次). 崗哨有幫助; 斷糧的隊伍戰力較差. 不會有人奪走基地.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BasesRaids_tooltip.cn: 110 格内没有玩家时, 敌对团体可能攻击有居民的基地 (第 7 天起, 每个基地最多每 3 天一次). 岗哨有帮助; 断粮的队伍战力较差. 不会有人夺走基地.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BlameFair_tooltip.en: Outpost theft only angers the garrison at the players who were inside; avengers only hunt someone who actually killed that outpost's people; manhunters never switch to a bystander.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BlameFair_tooltip.ch: 前哨站失竊只會讓駐軍對當時在裡面的玩家發怒; 復仇者只追獵真正殺了該前哨站成員的人; 獵殺者絕不會轉而攻擊旁觀者.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BlameFair_tooltip.cn: 哨所失窃只会让驻军对当时在里面的玩家发怒; 复仇者只追猎真正杀了该哨所成员的人; 猎杀者绝不会转而攻击旁观者.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BoardingStaged_toolti.en: A new house outpost gets 1-2 planks on its ground-floor windows and sheets on a couple; more boards go up every few days and as it grows. Upper floors only get sheets. Off: A-Life boards every window at once.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BoardingStaged_toolti.ch: 新建的房屋前哨站會在一樓窗戶釘上 1-2 塊木板, 並在幾扇窗掛上床單; 每隔幾天以及隨著成長, 會釘上更多木板. 樓上只掛床單. 關閉: A-Life 會一次封住所有窗戶.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BoardingStaged_toolti.cn: 新建的房屋哨所会在一楼窗户钉上 1-2 块木板, 并在几扇窗挂上床单; 每隔几天以及随着发展, 会钉上更多木板. 楼上只挂床单. 关闭: A-Life 会一次封住所有窗户.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BreachPolicy.en: NPCs only break in when looting or raiding
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BreachPolicy.ch: NPC只在洗劫或突襲時強行闖入
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BreachPolicy.cn: NPC只在洗劫或突袭时强行闯入

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BreachPolicy_tooltip.en: NPCs open doors they can open, but only smash windows, break doors, pull down barricades or pick locks when they're looting or raiding, and only when there's no door they could open instead. When forcing their way in they go for a window before a door (much quicker), and looters may use windows when a building's doors are all locked. Everyone else goes another way or somewhere else.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BreachPolicy_tooltip.ch: NPC會打開能開的門, 但只有在洗劫或突襲時才會砸窗、破門、拆路障或撬鎖, 而且只在沒有可開的門時才這麼做. 強行闖入時會先選窗戶再選門 (快得多), 建築的門全都上鎖時, 洗劫者可能從窗戶進出. 其他人則會改走別條路或去別處.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_BreachPolicy_tooltip.cn: NPC会打开能开的门, 但只有在洗劫或突袭时才会砸窗、破门、拆路障或撬锁, 而且只在没有可开的门时才这么做. 强行闯入时会先选窗户再选门 (快得多), 建筑的门全都上锁时, 洗劫者可能从窗户进出. 其他人则会改走别的路或去别处.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CalmDownEnabled_toolt.en: Wary factions that turn on you for ignoring their warnings stay hostile only for a while (A-Life: the faction for a day, the group for good), then go back to how they felt. Naturally hostile factions and real grudges (robbery, a killed crewmate) are unaffected.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CalmDownEnabled_toolt.ch: 因你無視警告而翻臉的謹慎陣營只會敵對一段時間 (A-Life 原設定: 陣營一天, 團體永久), 之後恢復原本的態度. 天生敵對的陣營與真正的仇怨 (搶劫、殺害隊友) 不受影響.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CalmDownEnabled_toolt.cn: 因你无视警告而翻脸的谨慎阵营只会敌对一段时间 (A-Life 原设定: 阵营一天, 团体永久), 之后恢复原本的态度. 天生敌对的阵营和真正的仇怨 (抢劫、杀害队友) 不受影响.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CalmDownHours.en: Provoked NPCs calm down after (game hours)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CalmDownHours.ch: 被激怒的NPC冷靜所需時間 (遊戲內小時)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CalmDownHours.cn: 被激怒的NPC冷静所需时间 (游戏内小时)

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CalmDownHours_tooltip.en: How long a provoked faction and group stay hostile. A-Life's own is 24 hours for the faction and forever for the group.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CalmDownHours_tooltip.ch: 被激怒的陣營與團體保持敵對的時間. A-Life 原設定為陣營 24 小時, 團體永久.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CalmDownHours_tooltip.cn: 被激怒的阵营和团体保持敌对的时间. A-Life 原设定为阵营 24 小时, 团体永久.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ContextMenuShow.ch: 顯示 [A-Life Jimmy] 右鍵選單
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ContextMenuShow.cn: 显示 [A-Life Jimmy] 右键菜单

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ContextMenuShow_toolt.en: Off hides the [A-Life Jimmy] entry of the right-click menu for everyone, admins and -debug games included, and its Debug (admin) tools go with it until it is back on. Each player can also hide it just for themselves in Options > Mods. Trade, Medical Check and the other entries outside it stay. With it hidden: the faction window opens from the people button in the sidebar (its Bases section has the tools for land, buildings, guard posts, stores and the body dump, and the Show bases on the ground tick box), NPC safety from its sidebar button or the faction window, and you invite someone to your nearest base by talking to them (Come live at our base). Only in this menu: the Status panel, door and window marks, letting someone who surrendered go (Q still makes them drop their weapon and empty their pockets), sending a whole base crew away at once (People > Actions sends one at a time) and inviting someone to a base other than your nearest.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ContextMenuShow_toolt.ch: 關閉時, 對所有人隱藏右鍵選單中的 [A-Life Jimmy] 項目, 包括管理員與 -debug 遊戲, 其中的「除錯 (管理員)」工具也會一併隱藏, 直到重新開啟. 每位玩家也可以在 選項 > 模組 中只對自己隱藏. 「交易」、「醫療檢查」及此項目以外的其他項目都會保留. 隱藏時: 陣營視窗改由側邊欄的人員按鈕開啟 (其「基地」區段有土地、建築、崗哨、倉庫與棄屍處的工具, 以及「顯示地面上的基地範圍」勾選框), NPC 安全改由其側邊欄按鈕或陣營視窗開啟, 邀請某人入住你最近的基地則改為與對方交談 (「來我們基地住吧」). 只能在此選單操作的有: 狀態面板、門窗標記、放走投降的人 (按 Q 仍會讓他們丟下武器並清空口袋)、一次遣走整個基地隊伍 (人員 > 動作 一次只遣走一人), 以及邀請某人到非最近的基地.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ContextMenuShow_toolt.cn: 关闭时, 对所有人隐藏右键菜单中的 [A-Life Jimmy] 项目, 包括管理员和 -debug 游戏, 其中的“调试 (管理员)”工具也会一并隐藏, 直到重新开启. 每位玩家也可以在 选项 > 模组 中只对自己隐藏. “交易”、“医疗检查”及此项目以外的其他项目都会保留. 隐藏时: 阵营窗口改由侧边栏的人员按钮打开 (其“基地”区域有土地、建筑、岗哨、仓库和弃尸处的工具, 以及“显示地面上的基地范围”复选框), NPC 安全改由其侧边栏按钮或阵营窗口打开, 邀请某人入住你最近的基地则改为与对方交谈 (“来我们基地住吧”). 只能在此菜单操作的有: 状态面板、门窗标记、放走投降的人 (按 Q 仍会让他们丢下武器并清空口袋)、一次遣走整个基地队伍 (人员 > 动作 一次只遣走一人), 以及邀请某人到非最近的基地.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CrewStandingEnabled.en: Crews act on their own standing

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CrewStandingEnabled_t.en: A crew you've helped (or wronged) enough treats you by its own standing, not just its faction's: a crew that owes you stays friendly even if its faction turns hostile, and the other way round. A grudge or a raid still wins.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CrewStandingEnabled_t.ch: 你幫助 (或得罪) 夠多的隊伍會依自身的信譽對待你, 而不只看其陣營的信譽: 欠你人情的隊伍即使陣營轉為敵對仍保持友善, 反之亦然. 仇怨或突襲仍然優先.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CrewStandingEnabled_t.cn: 你帮助 (或得罪) 够多的队伍会依自身的信誉对待你, 而不只看其阵营的信誉: 欠你人情的队伍即使阵营转为敌对仍保持友善, 反之亦然. 仇怨或突袭仍然优先.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CrowdingLimit_tooltip.en: After day 3, a squad won't appear if this many groups are within 120 tiles. A-Life default 2.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CrowdingLimit_tooltip.ch: 第 3 天之後, 若 120 格內已有這麼多團體, 就不會出現小隊. A-Life 預設: 2.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CrowdingLimit_tooltip.cn: 第 3 天之后, 若 120 格内已有这么多团体, 就不会出现小队. A-Life 默认: 2.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CrowdingSquadsOnly_to.en: When deciding whether a roaming squad may appear, ignore encounter crews and camps.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CrowdingSquadsOnly_to.ch: 判斷遊蕩小隊能否出現時, 忽略遭遇隊伍與營地.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_CrowdingSquadsOnly_to.cn: 判断游荡小队能否出现时, 忽略遭遇队伍和营地.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DebugMenu_tooltip.en: Shows Debug (admin) in the [A-Life Jimmy] right-click menu in single player: admin tools for testing (self-test, spawning, sieges, traders). Off, it shows only in a -debug game, on a test world (the scenario test option, or a save with the word test in its name), and to admins in multiplayer.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DebugMenu_tooltip.ch: 單人模式中在 [A-Life Jimmy] 右鍵選單顯示「除錯 (管理員)」: 測試用的管理員工具 (自我測試、生成、圍攻、商人). 關閉時, 只在 -debug 遊戲、測試世界 (情境測試選項, 或名稱含 test 一字的存檔) 以及多人模式的管理員才會顯示.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DebugMenu_tooltip.cn: 单人模式中在 [A-Life Jimmy] 右键菜单显示“调试 (管理员)”: 测试用的管理员工具 (自检、生成、围攻、商人). 关闭时, 只在 -debug 游戏、测试世界 (场景测试选项, 或名称含 test 一词的存档) 以及多人模式的管理员才会显示.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DefendersEnabled.en: Your people step in when someone attacks you
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DefendersEnabled.ch: 有人攻擊你時自己人會出手
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DefendersEnabled.cn: 有人攻击你时自己人会出手

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DefendersEnabled_tool.en: NPCs normally only fight other NPCs their faction is at war with. With this on, anyone hostile to you is hostile to your residents too (anywhere, and while you are away: a grudge against the base owner, a raid, a faction hostile to all players). Allied NPCs step in within 25 tiles of you, friendly ones only when it is right on you (6 tiles). It fights back.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DefendersEnabled_tool.ch: NPC通常只與陣營交戰中的其他NPC戰鬥. 開啟後, 對你敵對的人也會敵視你的居民 (不論在哪裡, 包括你不在時: 對基地主人的仇怨、突襲、敵視所有玩家的陣營). 同盟NPC會在你 25 格內出手, 友善NPC只在攻擊近在你身邊時 (6 格) 才出手. 對方會還手.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DefendersEnabled_tool.cn: NPC通常只与阵营交战中的其他NPC战斗. 开启后, 对你敌对的人也会敌视你的居民 (不论在哪里, 包括你不在时: 对基地主人的仇怨、突袭、敌视所有玩家的阵营). 同盟NPC会在你 25 格内出手, 友善NPC只在攻击近在你身边时 (6 格) 才出手. 对方会还手.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DiagnosticsEnabled_to.en: Write A-Life counters (ownership handoffs, movement stalls, squads, saves) to the server log as [ALIFE-JIMMY] diag lines.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DiagnosticsEnabled_to.ch: 將 A-Life 計數 (所有權交接、移動卡頓、小隊、存檔) 以 [ALIFE-JIMMY] diag 行寫入伺服器日誌.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DiagnosticsEnabled_to.cn: 将 A-Life 计数 (所有权交接、移动卡顿、小队、存档) 以 [ALIFE-JIMMY] diag 行写入服务器日志.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DiscretionEnabled.en: NPCs read the situation before fighting

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DiscretionEnabled_too.en: Unless attacked or holding a grudge, NPCs won't start fights when outgunned, low on ammo against an armed target, or surrounded by zombies (gunfire would draw them). Against zombies they switch to melee when the dead are thick around or ammo is low.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DiscretionEnabled_too.ch: 除非遭到攻擊或懷有仇怨, NPC在火力不如對方、面對武裝目標而彈藥不足, 或被殭屍包圍 (槍聲會引來殭屍) 時不會主動開戰. 對付殭屍時, 若周圍殭屍密集或彈藥不足, 會改用近戰.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DiscretionEnabled_too.cn: 除非遭到攻击或怀有仇怨, NPC在火力不如对方、面对武装目标而弹药不足, 或被僵尸包围 (枪声会引来僵尸) 时不会主动开战. 对付僵尸时, 若周围僵尸密集或弹药不足, 会改用近战.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DonationsEnabled.en: Outposts take in what you leave in their crates
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DonationsEnabled.ch: 前哨站會收下你放進箱子的物品
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DonationsEnabled.cn: 哨所会收下你放进箱子的物品

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DonationsEnabled_tool.en: Food and medicine become supplies (growth; medicine heals defenders), guns, ammo and melee weapons go to the outpost's armory (defenders use them in sieges). Players who were inside recently gain standing with that faction (capped per day). Taken in once you're 40+ tiles away.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DonationsEnabled_tool.ch: 食物與藥品會成為物資 (用於成長; 藥品可治療守軍), 槍械、彈藥與近戰武器會進入前哨站的軍械庫 (守軍在圍攻時使用). 最近曾在裡面的玩家會獲得該陣營的信譽 (每日有上限). 你離開 40 格以上後才會收下.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DonationsEnabled_tool.cn: 食物和药品会成为物资 (用于发展; 药品可治疗守军), 枪械、弹药和近战武器会进入哨所的军械库 (守军在围攻时使用). 最近曾在里面的玩家会获得该阵营的信誉 (每日有上限). 你离开 40 格以上后才会收下.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DoorMarks_tooltip.en: Right-click a door or window > [A-Life Jimmy] to mark it No trespassing (NPCs who don't belong keep out; your residents, people on your orders and captives may pass) or Private (everyone keeps out, your residents too). Raiders and anyone fighting a player pass both while Attackers can breach bases is on. NPCs can always get out, and shut a marked door they opened behind them (never one you opened or left open).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DoorMarks_tooltip.ch: 對門或窗按右鍵 > [A-Life Jimmy], 可標記為「禁止擅入」 (不屬於這裡的NPC不得進入; 你的居民、聽你命令的人與俘虜可進出) 或「私人」 (所有人都不得進入, 你的居民也一樣). 開啟「進攻方可攻破基地」時, 掠奪者與任何與玩家交戰者兩種標記都能進出. NPC永遠可以出去, 並會隨手關上自己打開的已標記門 (絕不會關你打開或保持敞開的門).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_DoorMarks_tooltip.cn: 右键点击门或窗 > [A-Life Jimmy], 可标记为“禁止擅入” (不属于这里的NPC不得进入; 你的居民、听你命令的人和俘虏可通过) 或“私人” (所有人都不得进入, 你的居民也一样). 开启“进攻方可攻破基地”时, 掠夺者和任何与玩家交战者两种标记都能通过. NPC始终可以出去, 并会随手关上自己打开的已标记门 (绝不会关你打开或保持敞开的门).

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EmotesEnabled_tooltip.en: Emotes count as saying the matching thing to the nearest person you face: wave = hello, follow me / come here = follow, stop / freeze = wait, move out = go away, thank you, thumbs up, insult, yes / no answer their questions.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EmotesEnabled_tooltip.ch: 表情動作等同對你面前最近的人說出對應的話: 揮手 = 打招呼, 跟著我 / 來這裡 = 跟隨, 停下 / 別動 = 等待, 出發 = 走開, 還有謝謝你、比讚、侮辱, 而 是 / 否 可回答他們的問題.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EmotesEnabled_tooltip.cn: 表情动作等同对你面前最近的人说出对应的话: 挥手 = 打招呼, 跟着我 / 来这里 = 跟随, 停下 / 别动 = 等待, 走开 = 让对方走开, 还有谢谢你、点赞、侮辱, 而 是 / 否 可回答他们的问题.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EquipAutoReturn.en: Lent kit comes back when the escort ends
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EquipAutoReturn.ch: 護送結束時收回借出的裝備
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EquipAutoReturn.cn: 护送结束时收回借出的装备

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EquipAutoReturn_toolt.en: When someone you equipped stops following or waiting for you (for a quarter of an hour), what you lent them goes back into your inventory if you're within 30 tiles, or else a resident's goes into their base's stores and anyone else's waits until you're near. Off: they keep it until you take it back.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EquipAutoReturn_toolt.ch: 你配裝過的人停止跟隨或等候你 (持續一刻鐘) 時, 若你在 30 格內, 借出的東西會回到你的物品欄; 否則居民的會放進其基地的倉庫, 其他人的則等你靠近時再歸還. 關閉: 他們會一直保留, 直到你收回.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EquipAutoReturn_toolt.cn: 你配装过的人停止跟随或等候你 (持续一刻钟) 时, 若你在 30 格内, 借出的东西会回到你的物品栏; 否则居民的会放进其基地的仓库, 其他人的则等你靠近时再归还. 关闭: 他们会一直保留, 直到你收回.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EquipEnabled.en: Equip your people and followers for a trip
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EquipEnabled.ch: 為自己人與跟隨者配裝外出
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EquipEnabled.cn: 为自己人和跟随者配装外出

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EquipEnabled_tooltip.en: Right-click one of your residents or someone following you > Equip (or 'Gear up for this.' in conversation): hand them weapons, clothes (residents) and gear from your inventory for a trip, and take any of it back whenever you like. No prices, no standing. Ammo that fits their gun goes into their spare rounds and isn't given back.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EquipEnabled_tooltip.ch: 對你的居民或跟隨你的人按右鍵 > 裝備 (或在對話中選「準備好裝備.」): 從你的物品欄把武器、衣物 (限居民) 與裝備交給他們外出使用, 並可隨時收回任何一件. 不計價, 不影響信譽. 適用其槍械的彈藥會成為他們的備用子彈, 不會歸還.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_EquipEnabled_tooltip.cn: 右键点击你的居民或跟随你的人 > 装备 (或在对话中选“准备好装备.”): 从你的物品栏把武器、衣物 (限居民) 和装备交给他们外出使用, 并可随时收回任何一件. 不计价, 不影响信誉. 适用其枪械的弹药会成为他们的备用子弹, 不会归还.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ExpeditionsEnabled_to.en: Real garrison members leave to scavenge or patrol and come back (or don't). Replaces A-Life's outpost squads, which appear from nowhere and never return. Members only leave while no player is within 120 tiles, and the garrison never drops below its minimum.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ExpeditionsEnabled_to.ch: 真正的駐軍成員會離開去搜刮或巡邏, 然後回來 (或回不來). 取代 A-Life 憑空出現且永不返回的前哨站小隊. 成員只在 120 格內沒有玩家時離開, 駐軍人數絕不會低於下限.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ExpeditionsEnabled_to.cn: 真正的驻军成员会离开去搜刮或巡逻, 然后回来 (或回不来). 取代 A-Life 凭空出现且永不返回的哨所小队. 成员只在 120 格内没有玩家时离开, 驻军人数绝不会低于下限.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_FriendliesEnabled.en: Friendly NPCs follow and wait when asked
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_FriendliesEnabled.ch: 友善NPC會應要求跟隨與等候
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_FriendliesEnabled.cn: 友善NPC会应要求跟随和等候

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_FriendliesEnabled_too.en: With friendly standing, say 'follow me', 'wait here' or 'go away' to someone (or answer yes to 'Maybe we can work together?'): their crew follows you for 3 game hours or holds its spot for 6. At most 4 followers.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_FriendliesEnabled_too.ch: 信譽達友善時, 對某人說「跟我來」、「在這裡等」或「走開」 (或對「也許我們可以合作?」回答是): 他們的隊伍會跟隨你 3 個遊戲內小時, 或原地等候 6 小時. 最多 4 名跟隨者.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_FriendliesEnabled_too.cn: 信誉达到友善时, 对某人说“跟我来”、“在这里等”或“走开” (或对“也许我们可以合作?”回答是): 他们的队伍会跟随你 3 个游戏内小时, 或原地等候 6 小时. 最多 4 名跟随者.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_FriendlyFireForgiven_.en: How many times one of your own people or an ally lets it go when you hit them (within 10 minutes): no anger, no grudge, no lost standing, they don't fight back. The next hit turns that one person against you, never their faction or crew. Killing still counts as killing. 0: off (A-Life's own rule only).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_FriendlyFireForgiven_.ch: 你打到自己人或同盟時, 對方 (10 分鐘內) 可以不計較的次數: 不生氣、不記仇、不扣信譽, 也不還手. 再打一次就只會讓那個人與你為敵, 絕不牽連其陣營或隊伍. 殺人仍算殺人. 0: 關閉 (只用 A-Life 原本的規則).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_FriendlyFireForgiven_.cn: 你打到自己人或同盟时, 对方 (10 分钟内) 可以不计较的次数: 不生气、不记仇、不扣信誉, 也不还手. 再打一次就只会让那个人与你为敌, 绝不牵连其阵营或队伍. 杀人仍算杀人. 0: 关闭 (只用 A-Life 原本的规则).

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_GrowthEnabled.ch: 前哨站隨時間成長 (實驗性)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_GrowthEnabled.cn: 哨所随时间发展 (实验性)

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_GrowthEnabled_tooltip.en: Outposts spend supplies from expeditions (and a little foraging) to add a supply crate and campfire, then a fence with a gate at the main door, then take over a neighbouring building. Only placed while no player is within 40 tiles. The main entrance is never blocked.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_GrowthEnabled_tooltip.ch: 前哨站會花用遠征 (以及少量採集) 得來的物資, 先增設物資箱與營火, 再於大門加蓋附柵門的圍籬, 之後佔領鄰近的建築. 只在 40 格內沒有玩家時放置. 主要入口絕不會被擋住.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_GrowthEnabled_tooltip.cn: 哨所会花用远征 (以及少量采集) 得来的物资, 先增设物资箱和营火, 再在大门加盖带栅门的围栏, 之后占领邻近的建筑. 只在 40 格内没有玩家时放置. 主要入口绝不会被挡住.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HandGiftsEnabled.en: Give NPCs what you're holding (say: take this)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HandGiftsEnabled.ch: 把手上的東西交給NPC (說: 拿著)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HandGiftsEnabled.cn: 把手上的东西交给NPC (说: 拿着)

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HandGiftsEnabled_tool.en: Say 'take this' (or 'here you go', 'this is for you') to someone who isn't hostile while holding an item: they take it and your standing with their faction rises. Outpost members pass supplies and weapons on to their outpost.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HandGiftsEnabled_tool.ch: 手持物品時對非敵對的人說「拿著」 (或「給你」、「這是給你的」): 對方會收下, 你在其陣營的信譽也會提升. 前哨站成員會把物資與武器轉交給前哨站.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HandGiftsEnabled_tool.cn: 手持物品时对非敌对的人说“拿着” (或“给你”、“这是给你的”): 对方会收下, 你在其阵营的信誉也会提升. 哨所成员会把物资和武器转交给哨所.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HandoffEnabled_toolti.en: In multiplayer, when a different player's game takes over an NPC, it resumes chasing or searching where the last owner left off instead of forgetting.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HandoffEnabled_toolti.ch: 多人模式中, 當NPC改由另一位玩家的遊戲接管時, 會從上一位擁有者中斷處繼續追擊或搜尋, 而不是全部忘記.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HandoffEnabled_toolti.cn: 多人模式中, 当NPC改由另一位玩家的游戏接管时, 会从上一位拥有者中断处继续追击或搜索, 而不是全部忘记.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesEnabled.ch: 小隊加入所屬陣營的前哨站
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesEnabled.cn: 小队加入所属阵营的哨所

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesEnabled_tooltip.en: Off-screen squads head to an outpost of their own faction and join its garrison; they appear there the next time you're nearby. Calls for help are answered by the outpost's own faction. Fewer groups roam as a result.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesEnabled_tooltip.ch: 畫面外的小隊會前往自己陣營的前哨站並加入駐軍; 下次你靠近時他們就會出現在那裡. 求救由前哨站所屬陣營回應. 因此四處遊蕩的團體會變少.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesEnabled_tooltip.cn: 画面外的小队会前往自己阵营的哨所并加入驻军; 下次你靠近时他们就会出现在那里. 求救由哨所所属阵营回应. 因此四处游荡的团体会变少.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesFoundChance.en: Chance per game hour a small squad settles down (percent)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesFoundChance.ch: 小型小隊每遊戲內小時定居的機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesFoundChance.cn: 小型小队每游戏内小时定居的概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesFoundChance_tool.en: For squads of 1-3 whose faction has no outpost nearby. The home (a holdout, forest camp or held house, whatever the faction uses) is placed when a player is 60-150 tiles from their town, never within 40 tiles of a player, never in a base area or a building a player has been in.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesFoundChance_tool.ch: 適用於附近沒有自己陣營前哨站的 1-3 人小隊. 住所 (堅守據點、森林營地或據守的房屋, 依陣營慣用而定) 會在玩家距其城鎮 60-150 格時放置, 絕不在玩家 40 格內, 也絕不在基地區域或玩家去過的建築內.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesFoundChance_tool.cn: 适用于附近没有自己阵营哨所的 1-3 人小队. 住所 (坚守据点、森林营地或据守的房屋, 视阵营惯用而定) 会在玩家距其城镇 60-150 格时放置, 绝不在玩家 40 格内, 也绝不在基地区域或玩家去过的建筑内.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesJoinChance.en: Chance per game hour a squad heads home (percent)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesJoinChance.ch: 小隊每遊戲內小時返回據點的機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesJoinChance.cn: 小队每游戏内小时返回据点的概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesJoinChance_toolt.en: Per squad, per game hour, when an outpost of its faction has room nearby. Doubled when the garrison is under half strength.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesJoinChance_toolt.ch: 附近有自己陣營的前哨站且有空位時, 每支小隊每遊戲內小時判定一次. 駐軍不到一半兵力時機率加倍.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesJoinChance_toolt.cn: 附近有自己阵营的哨所且有空位时, 每支小队每游戏内小时判定一次. 驻军不到一半兵力时概率加倍.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesJoinRadius.en: How far squads travel to join (tiles)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesJoinRadius.ch: 小隊前往加入的最遠距離 (格)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesJoinRadius.cn: 小队前往加入的最远距离 (格)

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesJoinRadius_toolt.en: Squads only consider outposts within this distance. Calls for help reach any distance.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesJoinRadius_toolt.ch: 小隊只考慮這個距離內的前哨站. 求救則不受距離限制.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesJoinRadius_toolt.cn: 小队只考虑这个距离内的哨所. 求救则不受距离限制.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesMixed_tooltip.en: A small squad (3 or fewer) with no outpost of its own nearby may move in with a friendly peaceable faction, like a lone nurse joining a family. They keep their own faction.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesMixed_tooltip.ch: 附近沒有自己前哨站的小型小隊 (3 人以下) 可能搬去和友善的和平陣營同住, 就像落單的護士加入一個家庭. 他們仍保留自己的陣營.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesMixed_tooltip.cn: 附近没有自己哨所的小型小队 (3 人以下) 可能搬去和友善的和平阵营同住, 就像落单的护士加入一个家庭. 他们仍保留自己的阵营.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesNomadShare_toolt.en: This share of squads never settle down or join an outpost.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesNomadShare_toolt.ch: 這個比例的小隊永遠不會定居或加入前哨站.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HomesNomadShare_toolt.cn: 这个比例的小队永远不会定居或加入哨所.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HostileFactionsAllow.en: Allow player factions to be hostile to other players
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HostileFactionsAllow.ch: 允許玩家陣營敵視其他玩家
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HostileFactionsAllow.cn: 允许玩家阵营敌视其他玩家

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HostileFactionsAllow_.en: Multiplayer. On: a faction's leader can set their people (residents and parties) to treat every player outside the faction as hostile (My people > Reputation). The server's PvP setting, safehouses and non-PvP zones still apply, and faction members are never targets. Off: the switch is greyed out.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HostileFactionsAllow_.ch: 多人模式. 開啟: 陣營領袖可設定讓自己的人 (居民與外出隊伍) 把陣營外的所有玩家視為敵對 (我的人員 > 聲望). 伺服器的 PvP 設定、安全屋與非 PvP 區域仍然適用, 陣營成員絕不會成為目標. 關閉: 該開關呈灰色無法使用.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_HostileFactionsAllow_.cn: 多人模式. 开启: 阵营领袖可设置让自己的人 (居民和外出队伍) 把阵营外的所有玩家视为敌对 (我的人员 > 声望). 服务器的 PvP 设置、安全屋和非 PvP 区域仍然适用, 阵营成员绝不会成为目标. 关闭: 该开关呈灰色无法使用.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesBandages.ch: 每個NPC至少攜帶的繃帶數
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesBandages.cn: 每个NPC至少携带的绷带数

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesBandages_tool.en: Tops up each NPC's first aid when they appear. A-Life gives most 1-2 (medics 4). 0 leaves A-Life's own.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesBandages_tool.ch: NPC出現時補足其急救用品. A-Life 大多給 1-2 條 (醫護兵 4 條). 0 則維持 A-Life 原本的數量.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesBandages_tool.cn: NPC出现时补足其急救用品. A-Life 大多给 1-2 条 (医护兵 4 条). 0 则维持 A-Life 原本的数量.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesBleedRate_too.en: How fast open wounds drain health. 0: wounds never bleed. At 100 an untreated bullet wound kills in about six minutes.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesBleedRate_too.ch: 開放性傷口扣除健康值的速度. 0: 傷口永不流血. 設為 100 時, 未處理的槍傷約六分鐘致死.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesBleedRate_too.cn: 开放性伤口扣除健康值的速度. 0: 伤口永不流血. 设为 100 时, 未处理的枪伤约六分钟致死.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesBurns_tooltip.en: NPCs on fire build up burns: painful, slow to heal and prone to infection. Treat them by disinfecting and bandaging.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesBurns_tooltip.ch: 著火的NPC會累積燒傷: 很痛、癒合慢且容易感染. 以消毒與包紮治療.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesBurns_tooltip.cn: 着火的NPC会累积烧伤: 很痛、愈合慢且容易感染. 以消毒和包扎治疗.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesEffects_toolt.en: A broken or badly hurt leg makes them limp, and hurt arms make them aim worse, until healed or treated.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesEffects_toolt.ch: 腿部骨折或重傷會讓他們跛行, 手臂受傷會讓他們瞄準變差, 直到痊癒或接受治療.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesEffects_toolt.cn: 腿部骨折或重伤会让他们跛行, 手臂受伤会让他们瞄准变差, 直到痊愈或接受治疗.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesEnabled_toolt.en: Hits leave wounds on body parts: scratches, lacerations, deep wounds, bites, bullet wounds, bruises and fractures, depending on what hit them. Wounds bleed until bandaged or clotted, heal over days, and show on the hover tag.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesEnabled_toolt.ch: 受到攻擊會依攻擊來源在身體部位留下傷口: 刮傷、撕裂傷、深傷口、咬傷、槍傷、瘀傷與骨折. 傷口會流血直到包紮或凝血, 需數天癒合, 並顯示在懸停標籤上.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesEnabled_toolt.cn: 受到攻击会依攻击来源在身体部位留下伤口: 刮伤、撕裂伤、深伤口、咬伤、枪伤、瘀伤和骨折. 伤口会流血直到包扎或凝血, 需数天愈合, 并显示在悬停标签上.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesFalls_tooltip.en: A-Life spares NPCs from fall damage. With this on, a fall of a floor bruises or breaks a leg, two floors most likely break one, and three or more mean bad breaks and real harm.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesFalls_tooltip.ch: A-Life 讓NPC免受墜落傷害. 開啟後, 從一層樓摔下會造成瘀傷或腿骨折, 兩層樓多半會摔斷一條腿, 三層以上則會嚴重骨折並受重傷.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesFalls_tooltip.cn: A-Life 让NPC免受坠落伤害. 开启后, 从一层楼摔下会造成瘀伤或腿骨折, 两层楼多半会摔断一条腿, 三层以上则会严重骨折并受重伤.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesHealSpeed_too.en: At 100 a scratch heals in about two days, a bullet wound in about ten, a fracture (with a splint) in about forty.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesHealSpeed_too.ch: 設為 100 時, 刮傷約兩天癒合, 槍傷約十天, 骨折 (上夾板) 約四十天.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesHealSpeed_too.cn: 设为 100 时, 刮伤约两天愈合, 枪伤约十天, 骨折 (上夹板) 约四十天.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesMedicRounds_t.en: A resident with the Medic specialty walks over to wounded residents of their base, downed ones first, then the worst bleeding, and treats them with supplies from the base's Medical store (bandage, disinfect, stitch, splint, take a bullet out). Players of the base can call them too: right-click Call the medic, or Medic! in a conversation. During the base alarm they only treat people under a roof.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesMedicRounds_t.ch: 具備醫護兵專長的居民會走到基地中受傷的居民身邊, 先處理倒地者, 再處理流血最嚴重者, 並使用基地醫療倉庫的物資治療 (包紮、消毒、縫合、上夾板、取出子彈). 基地的玩家也可以呼叫他們: 右鍵選單的「呼叫醫護兵」, 或對話中的「醫護兵!」. 基地警報期間, 他們只治療室內的人.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesMedicRounds_t.cn: 具备医护兵专长的居民会走到基地中受伤的居民身边, 先处理倒地者, 再处理流血最严重者, 并使用基地医疗仓库的物资治疗 (包扎、消毒、缝合、上夹板、取出子弹). 基地的玩家也可以呼叫他们: 右键菜单的“呼叫医护兵”, 或对话中的“医护兵!”. 基地警报期间, 他们只治疗室内的人.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesRegen_tooltip.en: With nothing bleeding, an NPC's health slowly comes back (about a day to full), held back by wounds that haven't healed yet. A-Life has no recovery of its own.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesRegen_tooltip.ch: 沒有任何部位流血時, NPC的健康會慢慢恢復 (約一天回滿), 但恢復會受到尚未癒合傷口的限制. A-Life 本身沒有恢復機制.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesRegen_tooltip.cn: 没有任何部位流血时, NPC的健康会慢慢恢复 (约一天回满), 但恢复会受到尚未愈合伤口的限制. A-Life 本身没有恢复机制.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesSelfCare.en: NPCs bandage wounds and call for help

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesSelfCare_tool.en: A bleeding NPC who isn't fighting bandages the wound with their own kit, even on guard or under orders; a resident fighting zombies stops to do it once none is close. With nothing left they call out when someone can come or hear them, and the nearest crewmate or fellow resident with a bandage (a medic first) comes over and does it. One dressing per wound.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesSelfCare_tool.ch: 流血且未在戰鬥的NPC會用自己的用品包紮傷口, 即使在警戒中或執行命令時也一樣; 正在對付殭屍的居民會等附近沒有殭屍時停下來包紮. 用品用完時, 他們會在有人能趕來或聽見時呼救, 最近帶有繃帶的隊友或同基地居民 (優先醫護兵) 會過來幫忙包紮. 每個傷口包紮一次.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesSelfCare_tool.cn: 流血且未在战斗的NPC会用自己的用品包扎伤口, 即使在警戒中或执行命令时也一样; 正在对付僵尸的居民会等附近没有僵尸时停下来包扎. 用品用完时, 他们会在有人能赶来或听见时呼救, 最近带有绷带的队友或同基地居民 (优先医护兵) 会过来帮忙包扎. 每个伤口包扎一次.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesTreatment_too.en: Right-click a hurt NPC who isn't hostile to you (or has surrendered to you) to bandage, stitch or splint their wounds with your own supplies. Gives First Aid experience, and a little standing with their faction and crew.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesTreatment_too.ch: 對未與你敵對 (或已向你投降) 的受傷NPC按右鍵, 即可用你自己的用品替其包紮、縫合或上夾板. 可獲得急救經驗, 以及少量其陣營與隊伍的信譽.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesTreatment_too.cn: 右键点击未与你敌对 (或已向你投降) 的受伤NPC, 即可用你自己的用品为其包扎、缝合或上夹板. 可获得急救经验, 以及少量其阵营和队伍的信誉.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesWoundInfectio.en: Open wounds that aren't disinfected can get infected (not the zombie infection): they heal at a quarter of the speed and hurt more until disinfected. Alcohol bandages disinfect as they go on.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesWoundInfectio.ch: 未消毒的開放性傷口可能感染 (不是殭屍感染): 消毒前癒合速度只剩四分之一, 也會更痛. 消毒繃帶在包上時就會消毒.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_InjuriesWoundInfectio.cn: 未消毒的开放性伤口可能感染 (不是僵尸感染): 消毒前愈合速度只剩四分之一, 也会更痛. 消毒绷带在包上时就会消毒.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntentLines_tooltip.en: An NPC near you says something when they change course: backing off from a fight that isn't worth it (and why: the odds, the noise, their ammo), deciding it's on after all when you come too close, or stepping in to protect you or their base. At most once every 45 seconds each.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntentLines_tooltip.ch: 你附近的NPC改變行動時會說句話: 放棄不值得打的仗 (以及原因: 勝算、噪音、彈藥), 在你靠太近時決定還是要打, 或出手保護你或他們的基地. 每人最多每 45 秒一次.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntentLines_tooltip.cn: 你附近的NPC改变行动时会说句话: 放弃不值得打的仗 (以及原因: 胜算、噪音、弹药), 在你靠太近时决定还是要打, 或出手保护你或他们的基地. 每人最多每 45 秒一次.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationCoverSeco.en: Captives try to escape after (seconds uncovered)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationCoverSeco.ch: 俘虜未被槍指著多久後試圖逃跑 (秒)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationCoverSeco.cn: 俘虏未被枪指着多久后试图逃跑 (秒)

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationCoverSeco.en: How long someone who surrendered stays put with nobody aiming at them before they may make a break for it (checked every 3 seconds after that). Walk more than 30 tiles away and they slip off anyway. Only with 'Captives may refuse orders' on.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationCoverSeco.ch: 投降者在沒有人用槍指著他們的情況下會原地待多久, 之後才可能趁機逃跑 (此後每 3 秒檢查一次). 若你走開超過 30 格, 他們無論如何都會溜走. 僅在開啟「俘虜可能拒絕命令」時有效.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationCoverSeco.cn: 投降者在没有人用枪指着他们的情况下会原地待多久, 之后才可能趁机逃跑 (此后每 3 秒检查一次). 若你走开超过 30 格, 他们无论如何都会溜走. 仅在开启“俘虏可能拒绝命令”时有效.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationDefiance_.en: Told to drop their weapon or empty their pockets, someone who surrendered may refuse: run for it, or (still armed) fight. More likely when they're angry with you, hostile, or have the numbers; less when they're wounded or peaceable.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationDefiance_.ch: 被命令丟下武器或掏空口袋時, 投降者可能拒絕: 逃跑, 或 (仍持有武器時) 反抗. 他們對你生氣, 與你敵對或人數佔優時更可能拒絕; 負傷或屬於和平陣營時則較不會.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationDefiance_.cn: 被命令丢下武器或掏空口袋时, 投降者可能拒绝: 逃跑, 或 (仍持有武器时) 反抗. 他们对你生气, 与你敌对或人数占优时更可能拒绝; 负伤或属于和平阵营时则较不会.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationEnabled_t.en: Aim a gun at an NPC and tap the shout key (Q). They may surrender: hands up, and you can make them drop their weapon or empty their pockets, or let them go. If they refuse, they hold a grudge.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationEnabled_t.ch: 用槍瞄準NPC並按一下喊叫鍵 (Q). 對方可能投降: 舉起雙手, 你可以命令他們丟下武器或掏空口袋, 或放他們走. 若他們拒絕, 就會記仇.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationEnabled_t.cn: 用枪瞄准NPC并按一下喊叫键 (Q). 对方可能投降: 举起双手, 你可以命令他们丢下武器或掏空口袋, 或放他们走. 若他们拒绝, 就会记仇.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationMode14_op.ch: A-Life 的版本, Q 下達其命令
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationMode14_op.cn: A-Life 的版本, Q 下达其命令

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationMode14_to.en: A-Life 1.4 has hold-ups of its own (orders in the talk window). A-Life's: Q while aiming gives its orders (hands up, then hand over weapons, then empty pockets), with ours on top: the disarmed stay disarmed, standing, grudges, Mercy. Ours: our own hold-ups (Q) beside A-Life's, one owner per NPC. Talk window only: Q is the game's own shout. A-Life 1.3.15 always uses ours.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationMode14_to.ch: A-Life 1.4 有自己的脅迫機制 (在對話視窗中下令). A-Life 的版本: 瞄準時按 Q 會下達它的命令 (舉手, 接著交出武器, 再掏空口袋), 並疊加我們的功能: 被繳械者保持繳械, 信譽, 仇怨, 饒恕. 我們的版本: 我們自己的脅迫 (Q) 與 A-Life 的並存, 每個NPC只歸其中一方處理. 僅限對話視窗: Q 是遊戲原本的喊叫. A-Life 1.3.15 一律使用我們的版本.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationMode14_to.cn: A-Life 1.4 有自己的胁迫机制 (在对话窗口中下令). A-Life 的版本: 瞄准时按 Q 会下达它的命令 (举手, 接着交出武器, 再掏空口袋), 并叠加我们的功能: 被缴械者保持缴械, 信誉, 仇怨, 饶恕. 我们的版本: 我们自己的胁迫 (Q) 与 A-Life 的并存, 每个NPC只归其中一方处理. 仅限对话窗口: Q 是游戏原本的喊叫. A-Life 1.3.15 总是使用我们的版本.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationOdds14.ch: 以我們的機率調整 A-Life 1.4 的脅迫
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationOdds14.cn: 以我们的概率调整 A-Life 1.4 的胁迫

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationOdds14_to.en: A-Life weighs a hold-up its own way. On: someone hurt, frightened or in pain gives in more easily, and crew-mates you killed lately make them more or less likely to (by who they are), up to 30 points either way. Only with Hold people up at gunpoint on.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationOdds14_to.ch: A-Life 以自己的方式衡量脅迫. 開啟: 受傷, 受驚或疼痛的人更容易屈服, 而你近期殺死的隊友會讓他們更可能或更不可能屈服 (視他們的身分而定), 雙向最多 30 點. 僅在開啟「持槍脅迫他人」時有效.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_IntimidationOdds14_to.cn: A-Life 以自己的方式衡量胁迫. 开启: 受伤, 受惊或疼痛的人更容易屈服, 而你近期杀死的队友会让他们更可能或更不可能屈服 (视他们的身份而定), 双向最多 30 点. 仅在开启“持枪胁迫他人”时有效.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_MemoriesEnabled_toolt.en: When you start talking, NPCs may bring up real things you did to their faction or crew (gifts, help, attacks, killings) with where and when it happened. Only deeds their faction has heard about.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_MemoriesEnabled_toolt.ch: 開始交談時, NPC可能會提起你對他們陣營或隊伍真正做過的事 (送禮, 幫忙, 攻擊, 殺人), 以及發生的地點與時間. 僅限他們陣營聽說過的事蹟.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_MemoriesEnabled_toolt.cn: 开始交谈时, NPC可能会提起你对他们阵营或队伍真正做过的事 (送礼, 帮忙, 攻击, 杀人), 以及发生的地点和时间. 仅限他们阵营听说过的事迹.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_MercyEnabled_tooltip.en: Someone you let go after a hold-up remembers how you treated them. Treated well, they may put in a good word or their crew may offer to join you; robbed or hurt, they may warn everyone or their squad may come after you. Killing someone who surrendered costs extra standing and brings revenge.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_MercyEnabled_tooltip.ch: 脅迫後被你放走的人會記得你如何對待他們. 待他們好, 他們可能替你說好話, 或他們的隊伍可能提議加入你; 被搶或受傷, 他們可能警告所有人, 或他們的小隊可能來找你算帳. 殺死投降者會額外損失信譽並招來復仇.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_MercyEnabled_tooltip.cn: 胁迫后被你放走的人会记得你如何对待他们. 待他们好, 他们可能替你说好话, 或他们的队伍可能提议加入你; 被抢或受伤, 他们可能警告所有人, 或他们的小队可能来找你算账. 杀死投降者会额外损失信誉并招来复仇.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NamesCreatorDisplayNa.en: A-Life 1.4 draws a random name for every NPC unless their NPC Creation preset's NPC name is Set name. On, a preset you made yourself that has no name setting (every preset made before 1.4, and Random name, which A-Life saves the same way) names its people with its Display name, as before 1.4, in our tags and windows and, for your residents, in A-Life's too. Off, or a preset set to Random male name or Random female name: A-Life's random names.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NamesCreatorDisplayNa.ch: A-Life 1.4 會替每個NPC隨機抽取名字, 除非其NPC生成預設的NPC名字 (NPC name) 設為指定名字 (Set name). 開啟時, 你自己製作且沒有名字設定的預設 (1.4 之前製作的所有預設, 以及隨機名字, A-Life 以相同方式儲存) 會像 1.4 之前一樣, 以其顯示名稱 (Display name) 為成員命名, 套用於我們的標籤與視窗, 對你的居民也套用於 A-Life 的介面. 關閉, 或預設設為隨機男性名字或隨機女性名字時: 使用 A-Life 的隨機名字.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NamesCreatorDisplayNa.cn: A-Life 1.4 会为每个NPC随机抽取名字, 除非其NPC生成预设的NPC名字 (NPC name) 设为指定名字 (Set name). 开启时, 你自己制作且没有名字设置的预设 (1.4 之前制作的所有预设, 以及随机名字, A-Life 以相同方式保存) 会像 1.4 之前一样, 以其显示名称 (Display name) 为成员命名, 应用于我们的标签和窗口, 对你的居民也应用于 A-Life 的界面. 关闭, 或预设设为随机男性名字或随机女性名字时: 使用 A-Life 的随机名字.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsCaffeine_tooltip.en: Coffee, tea, Vitamins, coffee beans or a cola handed to an NPC makes them less tired, and residents on watch take one from a base Food or Medical store when tired. Each dose works less while the last is still in them, part of the tiredness comes back as it wears off, and too much makes them jittery. Needs tiredness on.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsCaffeine_tooltip.ch: 把咖啡, 茶, 維生素, 咖啡豆或可樂交給NPC能減輕其疲勞, 站哨的居民疲勞時也會從基地的食物倉庫或醫療倉庫取用一份. 前一劑仍在體內時, 下一劑效果會減弱, 藥效退去時部分疲勞會回來, 攝取過量則會讓他們緊張不安. 需要開啟疲勞.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsCaffeine_tooltip.cn: 把咖啡, 茶, 维生素, 咖啡豆或可乐交给NPC能减轻其疲劳, 站岗的居民疲劳时也会从基地的食物仓库或医疗仓库取用一份. 前一剂仍在体内时, 下一剂效果会减弱, 药效消退时部分疲劳会回来, 摄取过量则会让他们紧张不安. 需要开启疲劳.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsCorpseSickness.en: NPC moodle: corpse sickness and smell
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsCorpseSickness.ch: NPC狀態圖示: 屍體病與臭味
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsCorpseSickness.cn: NPC状态图标: 尸体病与臭味

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsCorpseSickness_t.en: Off: living near bodies doesn't sicken NPCs (no smell or sickness moodles, no effects).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsCorpseSickness_t.ch: 關閉: 住在屍體附近不會讓NPC生病 (沒有臭味或生病的狀態圖示, 也沒有影響).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsCorpseSickness_t.cn: 关闭: 住在尸体附近不会让NPC生病 (没有臭味或生病的状态图标, 也没有影响).

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsDrunk_tooltip.en: Off: alcohol you hand over still calms them but never gets them drunk.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsDrunk_tooltip.ch: 關閉: 你給的酒仍能讓他們平靜, 但永遠不會讓他們喝醉.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsDrunk_tooltip.cn: 关闭: 你给的酒仍能让他们平静, 但永远不会让他们喝醉.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsEffects_tooltip.en: Tired NPCs can't sprint; very hungry, thirsty, exhausted or panicked ones aim worse; starving or dehydrated residents slowly lose health (anyone else gets by on their own supplies), and wounds heal at half speed. Stressed or panicked NPCs give up more easily when held up.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsEffects_tooltip.ch: 疲勞的NPC無法衝刺; 非常飢餓, 口渴, 筋疲力竭或驚慌的NPC瞄準較差; 挨餓或脫水的居民會慢慢失去生命值 (其他人則靠自己的物資過活), 傷口癒合速度減半. 有壓力或驚慌的NPC遭到脅迫時更容易屈服.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsEffects_tooltip.cn: 疲劳的NPC无法冲刺; 非常饥饿, 口渴, 筋疲力尽或惊慌的NPC瞄准较差; 挨饿或脱水的居民会慢慢失去生命值 (其他人则靠自己的物资过活), 伤口愈合速度减半. 有压力或惊慌的NPC遭到胁迫时更容易屈服.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsEnabled.en: NPCs get hungry, thirsty, tired and stressed
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsEnabled.ch: NPC會飢餓, 口渴, 疲勞並感到壓力
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsEnabled.cn: NPC会饥饿, 口渴, 疲劳并感到压力

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsEnabled_tooltip.en: NPCs near you and your residents have needs, shown in Medical Check and on the hover tag when pressing. Residents eat and drink at a base with food and sleep at night (in their Sleep shift where shifts go by the schedule); NPCs away from you look after themselves. Food and drink you hand them help; so does a drink for their nerves. Wounds, losing crewmates and being held up stress them.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsEnabled_tooltip.ch: 你附近的NPC與你的居民會有需求, 顯示在醫療檢查中, 需求迫切時也會顯示在懸停標籤上. 居民在有食物的基地吃喝, 並在夜間睡覺 (若排班依據為排班表, 則在其睡眠班次); 離你較遠的NPC會自行照顧自己. 你交給他們的食物和飲料有幫助; 給他們喝一杯壓壓驚也有用. 受傷, 失去隊友與遭到脅迫都會讓他們有壓力.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsEnabled_tooltip.cn: 你附近的NPC和你的居民会有需求, 显示在医疗检查中, 需求迫切时也会显示在悬停标签上. 居民在有食物的基地吃喝, 并在夜间睡觉 (若排班依据为排班表, 则在其睡眠班次); 离你较远的NPC会自行照顾自己. 你交给他们的食物和饮料有帮助; 给他们喝一杯压压惊也有用. 受伤, 失去队友和遭到胁迫都会让他们有压力.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsFatigue_tooltip.en: Off: NPCs never get tired (no moodle, no sprinting limits).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsFatigue_tooltip.ch: 關閉: NPC永遠不會疲勞 (沒有狀態圖示, 也沒有衝刺限制).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsFatigue_tooltip.cn: 关闭: NPC永远不会疲劳 (没有状态图标, 也没有冲刺限制).

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsFear.ch: NPC狀態圖示: 害怕與驚慌
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsFear.cn: NPC状态图标: 害怕与惊慌

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsFear_tooltip.en: Shows A-Life's own fear and panic as moodles. Display only: A-Life acts on them either way.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsFear_tooltip.ch: 把 A-Life 自身的恐懼與驚慌顯示為狀態圖示. 僅供顯示: 無論如何 A-Life 都會依此行動.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsFear_tooltip.cn: 把 A-Life 自身的恐惧与惊慌显示为状态图标. 仅供显示: 无论如何 A-Life 都会据此行动.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsGrief.ch: NPC狀態圖示: 悲傷 (哀悼中的居民)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsGrief.cn: NPC状态图标: 悲伤 (哀悼中的居民)

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsGrief_tooltip.en: Residents mourning a crewmate are Depressed, then Unhappy, then Sad over three days, and stay a little stressed. Off: no moodle or stress (they still mourn).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsGrief_tooltip.ch: 哀悼隊友的居民在三天內會依序變為沮喪, 不開心, 有點不開心, 並持續帶有些許壓力. 關閉: 沒有狀態圖示或壓力 (他們仍會哀悼).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsGrief_tooltip.cn: 哀悼队友的居民在三天内会依次变为沮丧, 不开心, 有点不开心, 并持续带有些许压力. 关闭: 没有状态图标或压力 (他们仍会哀悼).

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsHunger_tooltip.en: Off: NPCs never get hungry (no moodle, no effects).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsHunger_tooltip.ch: 關閉: NPC永遠不會飢餓 (沒有狀態圖示, 也沒有影響).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsHunger_tooltip.cn: 关闭: NPC永远不会饥饿 (没有状态图标, 也没有影响).

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsLines_tooltip.en: Now and then an NPC near you says something about their most pressing moodle: hunger, thirst, tiredness, stress, pain, drink, sickness, grief or the infection taking hold. Never in a fight.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsLines_tooltip.ch: 你附近的NPC偶爾會針對自己最迫切的狀態說些話: 飢餓, 口渴, 疲勞, 壓力, 疼痛, 酒醉, 生病, 悲傷, 或感染逐漸發作. 戰鬥中絕不會說.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsLines_tooltip.cn: 你附近的NPC偶尔会针对自己最迫切的状态说些话: 饥饿, 口渴, 疲劳, 压力, 疼痛, 醉酒, 生病, 悲伤, 或感染逐渐发作. 战斗中绝不会说.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsRate_tooltip.en: At 100 an NPC with no food gets hungry in about a day; a resident at a base with no food starves in under two. Thirst is a little faster.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsRate_tooltip.ch: 設為 100 時, 沒有食物的NPC大約一天就會飢餓; 位於沒有食物的基地的居民不到兩天就會陷入嚴重飢餓. 口渴稍微快一些.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsRate_tooltip.cn: 设为 100 时, 没有食物的NPC大约一天就会饥饿; 位于没有食物的基地的居民不到两天就会陷入严重饥饿. 口渴稍微快一些.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsStress_tooltip.en: Off: no stress from wounds, losses or hold-ups (no moodle, no effect on aim or surrendering).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsStress_tooltip.ch: 關閉: 受傷, 損失或脅迫都不會產生壓力 (沒有狀態圖示, 也不影響瞄準或投降).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsStress_tooltip.cn: 关闭: 受伤, 损失或胁迫都不会产生压力 (没有状态图标, 也不影响瞄准或投降).

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsThirst_tooltip.en: Off: NPCs never get thirsty (no moodle, no effects).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsThirst_tooltip.ch: 關閉: NPC永遠不會口渴 (沒有狀態圖示, 也沒有影響).
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NeedsThirst_tooltip.cn: 关闭: NPC永远不会口渴 (没有状态图标, 也没有影响).

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcSafetyEnabled_tool.en: With your safety on, hitting, shooting or shoving one of your own people (see Who safety protects) does nothing (no damage, no anger). Multiplayer uses the game's own safety button (server option SafetySystem); single player gets a safety button in the left sidebar.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcSafetyEnabled_tool.ch: 開啟安全模式時, 毆打, 射擊或推擠你自己的人 (見「安全模式保護哪些人」) 都沒有作用 (不造成傷害, 也不會惹對方生氣). 多人遊戲使用遊戲本身的安全模式按鈕 (伺服器選項 SafetySystem); 單人遊戲則會在左側欄加入一個安全模式按鈕.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcSafetyEnabled_tool.cn: 开启安全模式时, 殴打, 射击或推搡你自己的人 (见“安全模式保护哪些人”) 都没有作用 (不造成伤害, 也不会惹对方生气). 多人游戏使用游戏本身的安全模式按钮 (服务器选项 SafetySystem); 单人游戏则会在左侧栏加入一个安全模式按钮.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcSafetyWho_tooltip.en: With your safety on, which NPCs your hits can't hurt. People hostile to you can always be hurt.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcSafetyWho_tooltip.ch: 開啟安全模式時, 哪些NPC不會被你打傷. 與你敵對的人永遠可以被打傷.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcSafetyWho_tooltip.cn: 开启安全模式时, 哪些NPC不会被你打伤. 与你敌对的人永远可以被打伤.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsFactions.ch: 滑鼠懸停時顯示陣營標籤
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsFactions.cn: 鼠标悬停时显示阵营标签

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsFactions_toolt.en: Adds a [TAG] (the faction's initials) before the name, so you can tell who belongs to which faction.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsFactions_toolt.ch: 在名字前加上 [TAG] (陣營的縮寫), 讓你分辨誰屬於哪個陣營.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsFactions_toolt.cn: 在名字前加上 [TAG] (阵营的缩写), 让你分辨谁属于哪个阵营.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsHostile_toolti.en: A skull in front of the label of anyone hostile to you, even if they seem friendly.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsHostile_toolti.ch: 任何與你敵對的人, 其標籤前都會有一個骷髏, 即使他們看似友善.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsHostile_toolti.cn: 任何与你敌对的人, 其标签前都会有一个骷髅, 即使他们看似友善.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsIntent.en: Show what NPCs are up to on mouse-over
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsIntent.ch: 滑鼠懸停時顯示NPC在做什麼
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsIntent.cn: 鼠标悬停时显示NPC在做什么

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsIntent_tooltip.en: Under an NPC's name: keeping their distance from you, attacking you, protecting you, fighting zombies, checking out a noise, searching, scavenging, running away... So someone marked hostile who isn't attacking shows why.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsIntent_tooltip.ch: 在NPC名字下方顯示: 與你保持距離, 攻擊你, 保護你, 對付殭屍, 察看聲響, 搜尋, 搜刮, 逃跑… 這樣一來, 被標為敵對卻沒有攻擊的人也會顯示原因.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsIntent_tooltip.cn: 在NPC名字下方显示: 与你保持距离, 攻击你, 保护你, 对付僵尸, 查看声响, 搜索, 搜刮, 逃跑… 这样一来, 被标为敌对却没有攻击的人也会显示原因.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsNames_tooltip.en: Hover the mouse over an NPC to see their name above their head, coloured by how they feel about you.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsNames_tooltip.ch: 把滑鼠移到NPC身上, 即可看到其頭上的名字, 顏色代表他們對你的觀感.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsNames_tooltip.cn: 把鼠标移到NPC身上, 即可看到其头上的名字, 颜色代表他们对你的看法.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsTasks.en: Show your residents' tasks on mouse-over
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsTasks.ch: 滑鼠懸停時顯示居民的目前活動
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsTasks.cn: 鼠标悬停时显示居民的当前活动

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsTasks_tooltip.en: Under the name of someone living at your base: what they're meant to be doing (on guard, working, carrying a body, patrolling...), how far they are from where they should be, and whether they're stuck. Their spot is highlighted. Only for your own bases.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsTasks_tooltip.ch: 在住在你基地的人名字下方顯示: 他們應該在做什麼 (警戒中, 工作中, 搬運屍體, 巡邏中…), 離應在的位置多遠, 以及是否卡住. 他們的定點會反白標示. 僅限你自己的基地.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_NpcTagsTasks_tooltip.cn: 在住在你基地的人名字下方显示: 他们应该在做什么 (警戒中, 工作中, 搬运尸体, 巡逻中…), 离应在的位置多远, 以及是否卡住. 他们的定点会高亮显示. 仅限你自己的基地.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_OutpostsPermanent_too.en: Once an outpost has been manned it no longer expires of old age; it falls only when its garrison is wiped out. One that is never built or manned still expires as in A-Life. Scripted events are unaffected.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_OutpostsPermanent_too.ch: 前哨站一旦有人駐守, 就不會再因存在過久而消失; 只有駐軍全滅時才會陷落. 從未建成或從未有人駐守的前哨站仍會像 A-Life 原本那樣到期消失. 腳本事件不受影響.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_OutpostsPermanent_too.cn: 哨所一旦有人驻守, 就不会再因存在过久而消失; 只有驻军全灭时才会陷落. 从未建成或从未有人驻守的哨所仍会像 A-Life 原本那样到期消失. 脚本事件不受影响.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PersistMode_tooltip.en: A-Life only saves squads and a few outposts. Promoted keeps crews you've interacted with; All keeps every living NPC.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PersistMode_tooltip.ch: A-Life 只會保存小隊與少數前哨站. 「已升格的隊伍」會保留你互動過的隊伍; 「所有存活的NPC」會保留每個存活的NPC.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PersistMode_tooltip.cn: A-Life 只会保存小队和少数哨所. “已升格的队伍”会保留你互动过的队伍; “所有存活的NPC”会保留每个存活的NPC.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverBaseline_to.en: Chance for any unvisited building to be picked over even where A-Life groups haven't been, as if unseen survivors passed through. 0 = only where groups have actually worked the area.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverBaseline_to.ch: 任何未造訪過的建築被搜刮過的機率, 即使 A-Life 團體未曾到過該處, 就像有看不見的倖存者經過一樣. 0 = 只限團體實際活動過的區域.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverBaseline_to.cn: 任何未造访过的建筑被搜刮过的概率, 即使 A-Life 团体未曾到过该处, 就像有看不见的幸存者经过一样. 0 = 只限团体实际活动过的区域.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverEnabled_too.en: Unvisited buildings in areas A-Life's groups have been working (scavenging, sheltering, resting) look looted: valuables gone from unopened containers, doors open, windows broken, blood and bodies. Builds up over time. Never touches visited buildings, bases, safehouses or outposts.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverEnabled_too.ch: A-Life 團體活動過 (搜刮, 避難, 休息) 的區域中, 未造訪過的建築會呈現被洗劫的樣子: 未開啟的容器中貴重物品不見了, 門被打開, 窗戶破碎, 還有血跡與屍體. 會隨時間累積. 絕不會影響已造訪的建築, 基地, 安全屋或前哨站.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverEnabled_too.cn: A-Life 团体活动过 (搜刮, 避难, 休息) 的区域中, 未造访过的建筑会呈现被洗劫的样子: 未打开的容器中贵重物品不见了, 门被打开, 窗户破碎, 还有血迹和尸体. 会随时间累积. 绝不会影响已造访的建筑, 基地, 安全屋或哨所.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverFactionCorp.ch: 被搜刮建築中的拾荒者屍體 (實驗性)
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverFactionCorp.cn: 被搜刮建筑中的拾荒者尸体 (实验性)

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverFactionCorp.en: Rarely, a dead member of the faction that scavenged the building, in their faction's gear. Placed already dead where no player can see.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverFactionCorp.ch: 偶爾會有搜刮該建築的陣營成員死在裡面, 穿著該陣營的裝備. 只在沒有玩家看得到的地方以屍體形式放置.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverFactionCorp.cn: 偶尔会有搜刮该建筑的阵营成员死在里面, 穿着该阵营的装备. 只在没有玩家看得到的地方以尸体形式放置.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverStrength_to.en: Scales how many buildings are affected. 100 is the intended rate.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverStrength_to.ch: 調整受影響建築的數量. 100 為預期比率.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverStrength_to.cn: 调整受影响建筑的数量. 100 为预期比率.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverVisuals_too.en: Open doors, smashed windows and blood in scavenged buildings.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverVisuals_too.ch: 被搜刮過的建築中會有敞開的門, 破碎的窗戶與血跡.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverVisuals_too.cn: 被搜刮过的建筑中会有敞开的门, 破碎的窗户和血迹.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverZombieCorps.ch: 被搜刮建築中的殭屍屍體
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PickedOverZombieCorps.cn: 被搜刮建筑中的僵尸尸体

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteEnabled_toolti.en: When a player talks to (or fights) an encounter crew, it becomes a real squad: it lives on off-screen, travels and scavenges, and is saved with the world. Uses a roaming-squad slot.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteEnabled_toolti.ch: 玩家與遭遇隊伍交談 (或交戰) 時, 該隊伍會成為真正的小隊: 在畫面外繼續存在, 移動並搜刮, 並隨世界一同保存. 會佔用一個漫遊小隊名額.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteEnabled_toolti.cn: 玩家与遭遇队伍交谈 (或交战) 时, 该队伍会成为真正的小队: 在画面外继续存在, 移动并搜刮, 并随世界一同保存. 会占用一个漫游小队名额.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteMaxExtra.en: Promoted crews beyond A-Life's squad cap
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteMaxExtra.ch: 超出 A-Life 小隊上限的升格隊伍
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteMaxExtra.cn: 超出 A-Life 小队上限的升格队伍

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteMaxExtra_toolt.en: A-Life fills its roaming-squad cap quickly in a new world. Crews you interact with can still be promoted past it, up to this many at once.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteMaxExtra_toolt.ch: 在新世界中, A-Life 很快就會填滿漫遊小隊上限. 你互動過的隊伍仍可超過上限升格, 同時最多這麼多支.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteMaxExtra_toolt.cn: 在新世界中, A-Life 很快就会填满漫游小队上限. 你互动过的队伍仍可超过上限升格, 同时最多这么多支.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteOnFight.ch: 與隊伍交戰會讓其升格
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteOnFight.cn: 与队伍交战会让其升格

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteOnFight_toolti.en: A crew you fight carries on as a real squad - whether you hit them first or they opened fire on you. Survivors remember it through faction reputation.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteOnFight_toolti.ch: 與你交戰過的隊伍會作為真正的小隊繼續存在, 無論是你先動手還是他們先對你開火. 倖存者會透過陣營聲望記住這件事.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteOnFight_toolti.cn: 与你交战过的队伍会作为真正的小队继续存在, 无论是你先动手还是他们先对你开火. 幸存者会通过阵营声望记住这件事.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteOnRobbery_tool.en: A crew that robs you and walks away carries on as a real squad you may meet again.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteOnRobbery_tool.ch: 搶劫你後離開的隊伍會作為真正的小隊繼續存在, 你之後可能再遇到他們.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_PromoteOnRobbery_tool.cn: 抢劫你后离开的队伍会作为真正的小队继续存在, 你之后可能再遇到他们.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_RadioBaseRange_toolti.en: How far each base's own radio reaches, in tiles. A call goes through when the base is within both this and your radio's own range (750 tiles for a toy walkie-talkie, 2000 for an ordinary one, up to 20000 for military and high-end radios). A radioman living at the base doubles it.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_RadioBaseRange_toolti.ch: 每個基地自身無線電的通訊距離, 以格計. 只有基地同時位於此範圍與你無線電本身的範圍內時, 呼叫才會接通 (玩具對講機 750 格, 一般對講機 2000 格, 軍用與高階無線電最多 20000 格). 住在基地的無線電兵會讓此範圍加倍.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_RadioBaseRange_toolti.cn: 每个基地自身无线电的通讯距离, 以格计. 只有基地同时位于此范围和你无线电本身的范围内时, 呼叫才会接通 (玩具对讲机 750 格, 普通对讲机 2000 格, 军用和高端无线电最多 20000 格). 住在基地的无线电兵会让此范围加倍.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_RadioEnabled_tooltip.en: With a working two-way radio (a walkie-talkie in your inventory, or a ham radio you stand next to: on, with power), right-click it > Call your people: a status check of your bases (who's at home, on a post, asleep, out, hurt or bitten, and the alarm), Come to me (1, 2 or 4 of the people off the guard posts, or one by name, follow you as an escort for a day), Hold the base (everyone at home up and alert for an hour), Sound the alarm, Stand down and Head home. The base must be within the reach of both your radio and the base's own radio. People you call travel unseen and come into view about 40 tiles from you, after about one game hour per 400 tiles. Off: no radio menu.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_RadioEnabled_tooltip.ch: 帶著可用的雙向無線電 (物品欄中的對講機, 或你站在旁邊, 已開啟且有電的業餘無線電臺), 右鍵點選它 > 呼叫你的人: 狀態回報 (回報各基地狀況: 誰在基地, 在崗位上, 睡覺, 外出, 受傷或被咬, 以及警報狀態); 到我這裡來 (不在崗哨上的 1, 2 或 4 人, 或指名一人, 擔任護送跟隨你一天); 固守基地 (所有在基地的人起身戒備一小時); 拉響警報; 解除戒備; 回基地. 基地必須同時位於你的無線電與基地自身無線電的範圍內. 你呼叫的人會在畫面外移動, 大約每 400 格花費一個遊戲內小時, 並在離你約 40 格處出現在視野中. 關閉: 沒有無線電選單.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_RadioEnabled_tooltip.cn: 带着可用的双向无线电 (物品栏中的对讲机, 或你站在旁边, 已打开且有电的无线电台), 右键点击它 > 呼叫你的人: 状态汇报 (汇报各基地状况: 谁在基地, 在岗位上, 睡觉, 外出, 受伤或被咬, 以及警报状态); 到我这里来 (不在岗哨上的 1, 2 或 4 人, 或指名一人, 担任护送跟随你一天); 坚守基地 (所有在基地的人起身戒备一小时); 拉响警报; 解除戒备; 回基地. 基地必须同时位于你的无线电和基地自身无线电的范围内. 你呼叫的人会在画面外移动, 大约每 400 格花费一个游戏内小时, 并在离你约 40 格处出现在视野中. 关闭: 没有无线电菜单.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ResidentsAnnounce.en: Residents say what they're off to do
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ResidentsAnnounce.ch: 居民會說出要去做什麼
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ResidentsAnnounce.cn: 居民会说出要去做什么

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ResidentsAnnounce_too.en: When one of your residents gets a new kind of task (a guard post, a body to move, a weapon to fetch, a job) they say a short line, like "Heading to the Gate." At most one line each every 45 seconds, only with a player nearby.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ResidentsAnnounce_too.ch: 你的居民接到新類型的目前活動時 (前往崗哨, 搬運屍體, 拿取武器, 做工作), 會說一句簡短台詞, 例如「我去大門那邊.」. 每人每 45 秒最多一句, 且附近有玩家時才會說.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ResidentsAnnounce_too.cn: 你的居民接到新类型的当前活动时 (前往岗哨, 搬运尸体, 拿取武器, 做工作), 会说一句简短台词, 例如“我去大门那边.”. 每人每 45 秒最多一句, 且附近有玩家时才会说.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ResidentsBaseAlarm_to.en: When a real threat comes to a base, everyone living there gets up and the crew off the guard posts go to it. It goes off when one of the crew is fighting people, shot or killed at the base, a raider is within 40 tiles, two other hostile people are within 25, hostile people drive up, a loud noise near the grounds comes with hostile people about (A-Life 1.4), or zombies gather in numbers by a building or a sleeper. Sleepers stand up, training and work pause (the task says Alarm), and those off a post head for the fight, with a longer reach while it lasts; the guards hold their posts, and with more than three going one stays in each quarters. It lasts 15 minutes after the last sign of the threat, with a note in the base's News. A loud noise alone sends whoever is awake to look, without waking anyone. Off: they react only to what each of them sees.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ResidentsBaseAlarm_to.ch: 當真正的威脅來到基地時, 所有住在那裡的人都會起身, 不在崗哨上的隊員會前去應對. 觸發條件: 有隊員在基地與人交戰, 中彈或被殺, 掠奪者在 40 格內, 另外兩名敵對者在 25 格內, 敵對者開車前來, 場地附近出現巨大聲響且周圍有敵對者 (A-Life 1.4), 或殭屍大量聚集在建築或睡眠者旁. 睡眠者會起身, 訓練與工作暫停 (目前活動顯示「警報」), 不在崗位上的人前往戰鬥, 警報期間應對範圍更大; 警衛堅守崗位, 若出動人數超過三人, 每間宿舍會留一人. 警報在威脅最後一次出現後持續 15 分鐘, 並在基地的消息中留下紀錄. 只有巨大聲響時, 醒著的人會前去察看, 但不會叫醒任何人. 關閉: 他們只對各自看到的事物做出反應.
