Tooltip_HDF_CinnamonBark.en: Dry it on a drying rack to turn it into cinnamon.
Tooltip_HDF_CinnamonBark.ch: 放在晾曬架上風乾, 即可製成肉桂.
Tooltip_HDF_CinnamonBark.cn: 放在晾晒架上风干, 即可制成肉桂.

Tooltip_Item_SyndicateBill.en: Exclusive Syndicate bill. Worth 100 regular bills.
Tooltip_Item_SyndicateBill.ch: 幫派專屬鈔票. 價值等同 100 張普通鈔票.
Tooltip_Item_SyndicateBill.cn: 帮派专属钞票. 价值相当于 100 张普通钞票.

Tooltip_Item_UrietaDebitCard.en: Right-click to link to your Urieta Shop account.
Tooltip_Item_UrietaDebitCard.ch: 右鍵點選以繫結你的 Urieta 商店帳戶.
Tooltip_Item_UrietaDebitCard.cn: 右键点击以绑定你的 Urieta 商店账户.

Tooltip_JD_AirdropRadio.en: A military-grade radio tuned to an emergency supply frequency. Use it to call in an airdrop at your location. Single use — the radio is destroyed after transmitting.
Tooltip_JD_AirdropRadio.ch: 一台調到緊急補給頻率的軍規無線電. 使用它可在你的位置呼叫空投. 一次性使用 — 無線電發送訊號後即損毀.
Tooltip_JD_AirdropRadio.cn: 一台调到紧急补给频率的军用级无线电. 使用它可在你的位置呼叫空投. 一次性使用 — 无线电发送信号后即损毁.

Tooltip_AHS_Item_FlexibleSplint.en: Advanced flexible splint for fractures. It provides the strongest recovery bonus of the AHS splints.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_FlexibleSplint.ch: 用於骨折的高級柔性夾板. 提供 AHS 夾板中最強的恢復加成.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_FlexibleSplint.cn: 用于骨折的高级柔性夹板. 提供 AHS 夹板中最强的恢复加成.

Tooltip_AHS_Item_Nebulizer.en: Five-treatment device that reduces cardiac, panic, and stress load during an active tachycardia episode.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_Nebulizer.ch: 可使用五次的裝置, 在心搏過速發作期間降低心臟, 恐慌與壓力負荷.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_Nebulizer.cn: 可使用五次的装置, 在心动过速发作期间降低心脏, 恐慌与应激负荷.

Tooltip_AHS_Item_NebulizerBlocked.en: Can only be used during an active tachycardia episode.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_NebulizerBlocked.ch: 只能在心搏過速發作期間使用.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_NebulizerBlocked.cn: 只能在心动过速发作期间使用.

Tooltip_AHS_Item_SkinStapler.en: Five-charge wound-closure tool. Requires First Aid level 1 and closes deep wounds that contain no glass.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_SkinStapler.ch: 可使用五次的傷口閉合工具. 需要急救等級 1, 可閉合不含玻璃碎片的深層傷口.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_SkinStapler.cn: 可使用五次的伤口闭合工具. 需要急救等级 1, 可闭合不含玻璃碎片的深层伤口.

Tooltip_AHS_Item_Splint.en: Medical splint for fractures. Its splint factor is always higher than the vanilla splint, shortening recovery time.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_Splint.ch: 用於骨折的醫用夾板. 其夾板係數一定高於原版夾板, 可縮短恢復時間.
Tooltip_AHS_Item_Splint.cn: 用于骨折的医用夹板. 其夹板系数一定高于原版夹板, 可缩短恢复时间.

Tooltip_GeigerCounter.en: Measures radiation levels and emitts signals when equipped / attached.
Tooltip_GeigerCounter.ch: 測量輻射值, 裝備 / 掛載時會發出訊號.
Tooltip_GeigerCounter.cn: 测量辐射值, 装备 / 挂载时会发出信号.

Tooltip_LabSyringeCure.ch: 裝有實驗性解藥的注射器.
Tooltip_LabSyringeCure.cn: 装有实验性解药的注射器.

Tooltip_PillsPentoxifylline.ch: 對抗高濃度二氧化碳中毒.
Tooltip_PillsPentoxifylline.cn: 对抗高浓度二氧化碳中毒.

Tooltip_PillsPotassiumIodine.en: Lowers the negative effects of radiation.

Tooltip_EBFChainsaw_RecipeCutHeavyChainH.en: Teaches how to cut a chain with hook into a heavy chain and large hook.
Tooltip_EBFChainsaw_RecipeCutHeavyChainH.ch: 教你如何將帶鉤鏈條切割成重型鏈條和大鉤子.
Tooltip_EBFChainsaw_RecipeCutHeavyChainH.cn: 教你如何将带钩链条切割成重型链条和大钩子.

Tooltip_Recipe_CSOpenBottleWithImprovise.en: Slower than the proper opener and may damage the implement. A wine cork is lost.
Tooltip_Recipe_CSOpenBottleWithImprovise.ch: 比使用正規開瓶器慢, 且可能損壞工具. 葡萄酒軟木塞會遺失.
Tooltip_Recipe_CSOpenBottleWithImprovise.cn: 比使用正规开瓶器慢, 且可能损坏工具. 葡萄酒软木塞会丢失.

Tooltip_IDBFS_NeedStoredBiofuel.en: Requires biofuel stored in this dispenser.
Tooltip_IDBFS_NeedStoredBiofuel.ch: 需要此加油機中儲存的生物燃料.
Tooltip_IDBFS_NeedStoredBiofuel.cn: 需要此加油机中储存的生物燃料.

Tooltip_IDBFS_NoCompatibleVehicle.en: No compatible vehicle with free fuel capacity is close enough.
Tooltip_IDBFS_NoCompatibleVehicle.ch: 附近沒有可加油且油箱尚有空間的相容載具.
Tooltip_IDBFS_NoCompatibleVehicle.cn: 附近没有可加油且油箱尚有空间的兼容载具.

Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_BiofuelDispenser.en: Builds a four-level, 22,000-liter dispenser that stores and supplies biofuel.
Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_BiofuelDispenser.ch: 建造一座四層, 容量 22,000 公升的加油機, 用於儲存並供應生物燃料.
Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_BiofuelDispenser.cn: 建造一座四层, 容量 22,000 升的加油机, 用于储存并供应生物燃料.

Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_GreenBarrel.en: Builds a 600-liter green barrel for storing any liquid.
Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_GreenBarrel.ch: 建造一個 600 公升的綠色桶, 可儲存任何液體.
Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_GreenBarrel.cn: 建造一个 600 升的绿色桶, 可储存任何液体.

Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_GreenOliveBarrel.en: Builds a 600-liter olive green barrel for storing any liquid.
Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_GreenOliveBarrel.ch: 建造一個 600 公升的橄欖綠桶, 可儲存任何液體.
Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_GreenOliveBarrel.cn: 建造一个 600 升的橄榄绿桶, 可储存任何液体.

Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_MetalBarrel.en: Builds a 600-liter metal barrel for storing any liquid.
Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_MetalBarrel.ch: 建造一個 600 公升的金屬桶, 可儲存任何液體.
Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_MetalBarrel.cn: 建造一个 600 升的金属桶, 可储存任何液体.

Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_OrangeBarrel.en: Builds a 600-liter orange barrel for storing any liquid.
Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_OrangeBarrel.ch: 建造一個 600 公升的橙色桶, 可儲存任何液體.
Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_OrangeBarrel.cn: 建造一个 600 升的橙色桶, 可储存任何液体.

Tooltip_WBHM_AntiDiarrhealTablets.en: Reduces fluid-loss/cramping states in the diagnostic medical stomach-illness model.
Tooltip_WBHM_AntiDiarrhealTablets.ch: 有助於在腸胃疾病期間減輕體液流失與絞痛.
Tooltip_WBHM_AntiDiarrhealTablets.cn: 有助于在肠胃疾病期间减轻体液流失和绞痛.
Tooltip_WBHM_AntiDiarrhealTablets._note: 2026-10-03 裁決: 同一 workshop 項目 (3723942896) 的 TDDUPMarriageCompanion 與 TDDUPMedicalFramework 共用 WBHM 醫療系統, 是同一種藥品; Companion 是白話版, Framework 多了「診斷醫療模型」的系統說明. 現值照 Framework 翻, 改成照 Companion 的白話說法, 內容是 Framework 說明的子集, 對兩方都成立.

Tooltip_WBHM_AntiNauseaTablets.en: Reduces nausea and vomiting-risk states in the diagnostic medical stomach-illness model.
Tooltip_WBHM_AntiNauseaTablets.ch: 有助於在腸胃疾病期間減輕噁心與嘔吐.
Tooltip_WBHM_AntiNauseaTablets.cn: 有助于在肠胃疾病期间减轻恶心和呕吐.
Tooltip_WBHM_AntiNauseaTablets._note: 2026-10-03 裁決: TDDUPMarriageCompanion 與 TDDUPMedicalFramework 是同一 WBHM 醫療系統的同一種藥品, Companion 是白話版, Framework 多了「診斷醫療模型」的說明. 改成照 Companion 的白話說法, 對兩方都成立.

Tooltip_WBHM_AntihistamineTablets.en: Reduces simulated allergy flare symptoms in the medical model.
Tooltip_WBHM_AntihistamineTablets._note: 2026-10-03 裁決: TDDUPMarriageCompanion 與 TDDUPMedicalFramework 是同一 WBHM 醫療系統的同一種藥品, Companion 寫 Helps reduce allergy symptoms, Framework 寫在醫療模型中減輕模擬的過敏發作症狀. 改成照 Companion 的白話說法, 對兩方都成立.

Tooltip_WBHM_BlisterPads.en: Comfort supply for simulated blisters and foot pain.
Tooltip_WBHM_BlisterPads.ch: 用於模擬水泡與足部疼痛的舒緩用品.
Tooltip_WBHM_BlisterPads.cn: 用于模拟水泡和足部疼痛的舒缓用品.

Tooltip_WBHM_BrothPacket.en: Simple broth comfort supply for nausea, dehydration, and recovery roleplay.
Tooltip_WBHM_BrothPacket.ch: 簡易高湯舒緩用品, 用於噁心、脫水與康復角色扮演.
Tooltip_WBHM_BrothPacket.cn: 简易高汤舒缓用品, 用于恶心、脱水和康复角色扮演.

Tooltip_WBHM_BurnGel.en: Comfort treatment for simulated minor burns and sunburn.
Tooltip_WBHM_BurnGel.ch: 用於模擬輕微燒傷與曬傷的舒緩治療.
Tooltip_WBHM_BurnGel.cn: 用于模拟轻微烧伤和晒伤的舒缓治疗.

Tooltip_WBHM_CleanProcedureKit.en: Clean field-care supplies for safer wound treatment.
Tooltip_WBHM_CleanProcedureKit.ch: 乾淨的野外照護用品, 讓傷口處理更安全.
Tooltip_WBHM_CleanProcedureKit.cn: 干净的野外护理用品, 让伤口处理更安全.

Tooltip_WBHM_CoughSyrup.en: Reduces simulated cough and respiratory discomfort. Does not cure infections.
Tooltip_WBHM_CoughSyrup.ch: 減輕模擬的咳嗽與呼吸道不適. 無法治癒感染.
Tooltip_WBHM_CoughSyrup.cn: 减轻模拟的咳嗽和呼吸道不适. 无法治愈感染.

Tooltip_WBHM_DecongestantTablets.en: Reduces simulated congestion from cold, allergy, smoke, or dust exposure.
Tooltip_WBHM_DecongestantTablets.ch: 減輕因感冒、過敏、煙霧或粉塵曝露造成的模擬鼻塞.
Tooltip_WBHM_DecongestantTablets.cn: 减轻因感冒、过敏、烟雾或粉尘暴露造成的模拟鼻塞.

Tooltip_WBHM_ElasticWrap.en: Supports simulated sprains, swelling, and mobility pain.
Tooltip_WBHM_ElasticWrap.ch: 支撐模擬的扭傷、腫脹與行動疼痛.
Tooltip_WBHM_ElasticWrap.cn: 支撑模拟的扭伤、肿胀和行动疼痛.

Tooltip_WBHM_ElectrolytePowder.en: Diagnostic medical supply for dehydration recovery. Restores fluids/electrolyte balance in the health model.
Tooltip_WBHM_ElectrolytePowder.ch: 用於脫水恢復與補充體液的電解質粉.
Tooltip_WBHM_ElectrolytePowder.cn: 用于脱水恢复和补充体液的电解质粉.
Tooltip_WBHM_ElectrolytePowder._note: 2026-10-03 裁決: TDDUPMarriageCompanion 與 TDDUPMedicalFramework 是同一 WBHM 醫療系統的同一種用品, 兩方都說用於脫水恢復與補充體液/電解質, Framework 多了「診斷醫療用品, 健康模型」的系統說明. 改成照 Companion 的白話說法, 對兩方都成立.

Tooltip_WBHM_EyeDrops.en: Reduces simulated watery-eye and smoke/dust eye irritation.
Tooltip_WBHM_EyeDrops.ch: 減輕模擬的流淚以及煙霧/粉塵造成的眼睛刺激.
Tooltip_WBHM_EyeDrops.cn: 减轻模拟的流泪以及烟雾/粉尘造成的眼睛刺激.

Tooltip_WBHM_FootPowder.en: Helps simulated wet-feet irritation and blister recovery.
Tooltip_WBHM_FootPowder.ch: 幫助緩解模擬的足部潮濕刺激並促進水泡恢復.
Tooltip_WBHM_FootPowder.cn: 帮助缓解模拟的足部潮湿刺激并促进水泡恢复.

Tooltip_WBHM_GauzeBandAid.en: Two gauze packs plus tape. Better than nothing for small wounds, but weaker than a proper bandage.
Tooltip_WBHM_GauzeBandAid.ch: 兩包紗布加膠帶. 用於小傷口聊勝於無, 但效果不如正規繃帶.
Tooltip_WBHM_GauzeBandAid.cn: 两包纱布加胶带. 用于小伤口聊胜于无, 但效果不如正规绷带.

Tooltip_WBHM_GauzeBandage.en: Four gauze packs plus tape. A basic field bandage; useful, but not as reliable as a pressure dressing.
Tooltip_WBHM_GauzeBandage.ch: 四包紗布加膠帶. 基本的野外繃帶; 堪用, 但不如加壓敷料可靠.
Tooltip_WBHM_GauzeBandage.cn: 四包纱布加胶带. 基本的野外绷带; 堪用, 但不如加压敷料可靠.

Tooltip_WBHM_GauzePack.en: Clean gauze pack used with medical tape to craft field dressings.
Tooltip_WBHM_GauzePack.ch: 乾淨的紗布包, 搭配醫療膠帶可製作野外敷料.
Tooltip_WBHM_GauzePack.cn: 干净的纱布包, 搭配医用胶带可制作野外敷料.

Tooltip_WBHM_HeatPack.en: Short-term comfort treatment for simulated chills, cramps, and soreness.
Tooltip_WBHM_HeatPack.ch: 針對模擬的發冷、絞痛與痠痛的短期舒緩治療.
Tooltip_WBHM_HeatPack.cn: 针对模拟的发冷、绞痛和酸痛的短期舒缓治疗.

Tooltip_WBHM_HeavyGauzeDressing.en: Six gauze packs plus tape. Emergency heavy bleeding dressing; good enough to buy time, still inferior to trauma supplies.
Tooltip_WBHM_HeavyGauzeDressing.ch: 六包紗布加膠帶. 緊急大出血敷料; 足以爭取時間, 但仍不如創傷用品.
Tooltip_WBHM_HeavyGauzeDressing.cn: 六包纱布加胶带. 紧急大出血敷料; 足以争取时间, 但仍不如创伤用品.

Tooltip_WBHM_HemostaticGauze.en: Emergency bleed-control gauze for serious bleeding. Does not count as a bandage; follow with a pressure dressing or clean wound care.
Tooltip_WBHM_HemostaticGauze.ch: 用於嚴重出血的緊急止血紗布. 不算作繃帶; 之後應使用加壓敷料或進行乾淨的傷口護理.
Tooltip_WBHM_HemostaticGauze.cn: 用于严重出血的紧急止血纱布. 不算作绷带; 之后应使用加压敷料或进行干净的伤口护理.

Tooltip_WBHM_InstantColdPack.en: Short-term comfort treatment for simulated sprains, swelling, heat strain, or minor burns.
Tooltip_WBHM_InstantColdPack.ch: 針對模擬的扭傷、腫脹、熱傷害或輕微燒傷的短期舒緩治療.
Tooltip_WBHM_InstantColdPack.cn: 针对模拟的扭伤、肿胀、热损伤或轻微烧伤的短期舒缓治疗.

Tooltip_WBHM_MedicalGlovesBox.en: A box of clean medical gloves. Surgical gloves reduce dirty-hand treatment risk when worn.
Tooltip_WBHM_MedicalGlovesBox.ch: 一盒乾淨的醫療手套. 戴上手術手套可降低髒手治療的風險.
Tooltip_WBHM_MedicalGlovesBox.cn: 一盒干净的医用手套. 戴上手术手套可降低脏手治疗的风险.

Tooltip_WBHM_MedicalMaskBox.en: A box of disposable medical masks. Surgical masks reduce close-proximity cold spread.
Tooltip_WBHM_MedicalMaskBox.ch: 一盒拋棄式醫療口罩. 手術口罩可降低近距離的感冒傳播.
Tooltip_WBHM_MedicalMaskBox.cn: 一盒一次性医用口罩. 手术口罩可降低近距离的感冒传播.

Tooltip_WBHM_MedicalTape.en: Secures dressings and improves field treatment quality.
Tooltip_WBHM_MedicalTape.ch: 固定敷料並提升野外治療品質.
Tooltip_WBHM_MedicalTape.cn: 固定敷料并提升野外治疗质量.

Tooltip_WBHM_N95Respirator.en: Better protection from pollen, dust, and respiratory exposure than a basic mask.
Tooltip_WBHM_N95Respirator.ch: 對花粉、粉塵與呼吸道曝露的防護優於基本口罩.
Tooltip_WBHM_N95Respirator.cn: 对花粉、粉尘和呼吸道暴露的防护优于基本口罩.

Tooltip_WBHM_NormalSaline.en: Sterile saline rinse for dirty wounds. Cleans less aggressively than alcohol or disinfectant but is gentler and safer for field care.
Tooltip_WBHM_NormalSaline.ch: 用於髒汙傷口的無菌生理食鹽水沖洗液. 清潔力不如酒精或消毒劑, 但更溫和, 野外照護時更安全.
Tooltip_WBHM_NormalSaline.cn: 用于脏污伤口的无菌生理盐水冲洗液. 清洁力不如酒精或消毒剂, 但更温和, 野外护理时更安全.

Tooltip_WBHM_OralRehydrationDrink.en: Prepared rehydration drink for dehydration or stomach illness recovery.
Tooltip_WBHM_OralRehydrationDrink.ch: 調配好的補水飲料, 用於脫水或腸胃疾病恢復.
Tooltip_WBHM_OralRehydrationDrink.cn: 调配好的补水饮料, 用于脱水或肠胃疾病恢复.

Tooltip_WBHM_PressureDressing.en: Emergency dressing that applies strong pressure to traumatic bleeding. Buys time but still needs follow-up care.
Tooltip_WBHM_PressureDressing.ch: 對創傷性出血施加強力壓迫的緊急敷料. 能爭取時間, 但仍需後續照護.
Tooltip_WBHM_PressureDressing.cn: 对创伤性出血施加强力压迫的紧急敷料. 能争取时间, 但仍需后续护理.

Tooltip_WBHM_RecoveryCareKit.en: Broad field-care kit for simulated short-term recovery states.
Tooltip_WBHM_RecoveryCareKit.ch: 用於短期恢復的綜合野外照護包.
Tooltip_WBHM_RecoveryCareKit.cn: 用于短期恢复的综合野外护理包.
Tooltip_WBHM_RecoveryCareKit._note: 2026-10-03 裁決: TDDUPMarriageCompanion 與 TDDUPMedicalFramework 是同一 WBHM 醫療系統的同一種用品, 只差 Framework 多寫 simulated ... states. 改成去掉「模擬狀態」的白話說法, 對兩方都成立.

Tooltip_WBHM_Sling.en: Supports an injured arm during short-term recovery. The medical model can mark the arm as temporarily limited.
Tooltip_WBHM_Sling.ch: 在短期恢復期間支撐受傷的手臂.
Tooltip_WBHM_Sling.cn: 在短期恢复期间支撑受伤的手臂.
Tooltip_WBHM_Sling._note: 2026-10-03 裁決: TDDUPMarriageCompanion 與 TDDUPMedicalFramework 是同一 WBHM 醫療系統的同一種用品, Companion 的英文是 Framework 第一句, Framework 多一句「醫療模型可將手臂標記為暫時受限」. 只保留兩方共有的第一句, 對兩方都成立.

Tooltip_WBHM_StomachCareKit.en: Compact field kit for dehydration and stomach-illness care.
Tooltip_WBHM_StomachCareKit.ch: 用於脫水與腸胃疾病照護的小型野外照護包.
Tooltip_WBHM_StomachCareKit.cn: 用于脱水和肠胃疾病护理的小型野外护理包.

Tooltip_WBHM_Tourniquet.en: Limb-only emergency bleeding control. Powerful, painful, and time-limited.
Tooltip_WBHM_Tourniquet.ch: 僅限四肢的緊急止血工具. 效果強、很痛, 且有使用時限.
Tooltip_WBHM_Tourniquet.cn: 仅限四肢的紧急止血工具. 效果强、很痛, 且有使用时限.

Tooltip_WBHM_TraumaDressingKit.en: Rare emergency kit for stabilizing serious bleeding.
Tooltip_WBHM_TraumaDressingKit.ch: 用於穩定嚴重出血的稀有急救包.
Tooltip_WBHM_TraumaDressingKit.cn: 用于稳定严重出血的稀有急救包.

Tooltip_WBHM_TraumaShears.en: Cuts clothing away quickly for field treatment. Improves treatment preparedness.
Tooltip_WBHM_TraumaShears.ch: 可快速剪開衣物以進行野外治療. 提升治療準備程度.
Tooltip_WBHM_TraumaShears.cn: 可快速剪开衣物以进行野外治疗. 提升治疗准备程度.

Tooltip_Recipe_TSA_MonolithCrystalForgeA.ch: 將鍛造斧頭轉化為方尖碑斧.
Tooltip_Recipe_TSA_MonolithCrystalForgeA.cn: 将锻造斧头转化为方尖碑斧.

Tooltip_Recipe_TSA_MonolithCrystalForgeS.ch: 將金屬矛轉化為方尖碑矛.
Tooltip_Recipe_TSA_MonolithCrystalForgeS.cn: 将金属矛转化为方尖碑矛.

Tooltip_Recipe_TSA_MonolithCrystalForgeS.ch: 將鍛造長劍轉化為方尖碑長劍.
Tooltip_Recipe_TSA_MonolithCrystalForgeS.cn: 将锻造长剑转化为方尖碑长剑.

Tooltip_Recipe_TSA_MonolithCrystalToDeni.en: Duplicates dark blue denim fabric roll.

Tooltip_AutoLightTimers_NightOutdoorMoti.en: A weatherproof outdoor motion sensor with a built-in day/night cutoff. Active only between dusk and dawn — saves bulbs and electricity by ignoring motion during daylight.
Tooltip_AutoLightTimers_NightOutdoorMoti.ch: 一款防風雨的室外運動感測器, 內建晝夜切換開關. 僅在黃昏至黎明之間運作——白天會忽略動作, 以節省燈泡與電力.
Tooltip_AutoLightTimers_NightOutdoorMoti.cn: 一款防风雨的室外运动传感器, 内置昼夜切换开关. 仅在黄昏至黎明之间工作——白天会忽略运动, 以节省灯泡和电力.

Tooltip_PFR_NotAColdUnit.en: This is the game's own air conditioner. The Cold Unit you craft uses the same casing, so once placed they look identical - yours is the one you built and mounted yourself.
Tooltip_PFR_NotAColdUnit.ch: 這是遊戲本身的冷氣機. 你製作的冷風機使用相同的外殼, 所以安裝後兩者看起來一模一樣 - 你的是你親手製作並安裝的那台.
Tooltip_PFR_NotAColdUnit.cn: 这是游戏自带的空调. 你制作的冷风机使用相同的外壳, 所以安装后两者看起来一模一样 - 你的是你亲手制作并安装的那台.

Tooltip_item_CDPlayer.en: A compact portable CD player for listening with headphones.
Tooltip_item_CDPlayer.ch: 一款小巧的攜帶式 CD 播放器, 可搭配耳機聆聽.
Tooltip_item_CDPlayer.cn: 一款小巧的便携式CD播放器, 可搭配耳机聆听.

Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeDripDesc.en: Drip emitter. A pipe that waters the crop on its own tile and passes water on. No pressure needed, only water. Too much pressure bursts it, so keep pumps off its line or cap it with a router. Needs a Pipe Wrench.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeDripDesc.ch: 滴灌頭. 為所在格子的作物澆水並將水繼續往下傳的管道. 不需要壓力, 只需要水. 壓力過大會使其爆裂, 因此別讓水泵接在同一條管線上, 或用流體分配器限制壓力. 需要管鉗.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeDripDesc.cn: 滴灌头. 为所在格子的作物浇水并将水继续往下传的管道. 不需要压力, 只需要水. 压力过大会使其爆裂, 因此别让水泵接在同一条管线上, 或用流体分配器限制压力. 需要管钳.

Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeRouterDesc.en: A one-way valve: water flows in through the green band (IN) and out through the red band (OUT), never back, capped at the pressure ceiling you set. Put a vessel on its tile and the two sides exchange only through it: a purifier cleans water in transit, a tank buffers it. Rotate with R to aim the OUT side.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeRouterDesc.ch: 單向閥: 水從綠色環 (IN) 流入, 從紅色環 (OUT) 流出, 絕不回流, 壓力上限由你設定. 在它所在的地格放上容器後, 兩側只能經由該容器交換: 淨水器會在途中淨化水, 水箱則作為緩衝. 按 R 旋轉以調整 OUT 端的方向.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeRouterDesc.cn: 单向阀: 水从绿色环 (IN) 流入, 从红色环 (OUT) 流出, 绝不回流, 压力上限由你设置. 在它所在的地块放上容器后, 两侧只能通过该容器交换: 净水器会在途中净化水, 水箱则起缓冲作用. 按 R 旋转以调整 OUT 端的朝向.

Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeSprinklerDesc.en: Sprinkler. A pipe that waters the whole 3x3 around it, but needs real pressure, which means a pump. It sprays every tile whether or not it is growing, wastes water, and is loud enough to draw zombies. Needs a Pipe Wrench.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeSprinklerDesc.ch: 灑水器. 能為周圍 3x3 範圍澆水的水管, 但需要足夠的水壓, 也就是需要水泵. 不論地格上是否有作物都會噴灑, 浪費水, 而且聲音大到會引來殭屍. 需要管鉗.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeSprinklerDesc.cn: 洒水器. 能给周围 3x3 范围浇水的水管, 但需要足够的水压, 也就是需要水泵. 不管地块上有没有作物都会喷洒, 浪费水, 而且声音大到会引来僵尸. 需要管钳.

Tooltip_craft_WaterPressureGaugeDesc.en: Pressure dial. Sits on a pipe; right-click to read the pressure at that point and whether a sprinkler would run there. Needs a Pipe Wrench.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPressureGaugeDesc.ch: 壓力錶. 裝在水管上; 按右鍵可讀取該處的水壓, 以及灑水器在那裡能否運作. 需要管鉗.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPressureGaugeDesc.cn: 压力表. 装在水管上; 右键可读取该处的水压, 以及洒水器在那里能否运作. 需要管钳.

Tooltip_craft_WaterPumpDesc.en: Electric pump. On a pipe run it raises pressure while powered, and chained pumps add up. Beside a well or open water it also draws water into the network. It sucks up from about two floors below but pushes far higher, so place it low. Needs a Pipe Wrench and welding gear.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPumpDesc.ch: 電動水泵. 裝在管線上時, 通電期間會提高水壓, 串聯多台水泵效果可疊加. 放在水井或開放水域旁時, 也會把水抽進管網. 它最多只能從約兩層樓以下吸水, 但能往上推送得高得多, 所以要裝在低處. 需要管鉗與焊接工具.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPumpDesc.cn: 电动水泵. 装在管线上时, 通电期间会提高水压, 串联多台水泵效果可叠加. 放在水井或开放水域旁时, 也会把水抽进管网. 它最多只能从约两层楼以下吸水, 但能往上推送得高得多, 所以要装在低处. 需要管钳和焊接工具.

Tooltip_craft_WaterPurifierElectricDesc.en: Electric purifier tank. Put it on a Fluid Router: tainted water enters from the green (IN) side and leaves purified through the red (OUT) side while it has power. The filter wears with use; right-click to repair it with charcoal and ripped sheets. Needs welding gear and clear space above.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPurifierElectricDesc.ch: 電動淨水槽. 放在流體分配器上: 通電期間, 受汙染的水從綠色 (IN) 端進入, 淨化後從紅色 (OUT) 端流出. 濾芯會隨使用而耗損; 按右鍵可用木炭和碎布修理. 需要焊接工具, 且上方要有淨空.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPurifierElectricDesc.cn: 电动净水罐. 放在流体分配器上: 通电期间, 受污染的水从绿色 (IN) 端进入, 净化后从红色 (OUT) 端流出. 滤芯会随使用而磨损; 右键可用木炭和碎布条修理. 需要焊接工具, 且上方要留出空间.

Tooltip_TrampleSteam.en: Puts a spring in your step. Parachute not included.
Tooltip_TrampleSteam.ch: 讓你走起路來充滿彈性. 不附降落傘.
Tooltip_TrampleSteam.cn: 让你走起路来充满弹性. 不附带降落伞.

Tooltip_SZ_SoapBox.en: Contains 12 full bars of the same soap. Right-click to unpack.
Tooltip_SZ_SoapBox.ch: 內含12塊同款的完整肥皂. 按右鍵即可拆開.
Tooltip_SZ_SoapBox.cn: 内含12块同款的完整肥皂. 右键点击即可拆开.

Tooltip_craft_TCAppearanceStationDesc.en: A mirror and a pair of scissors. Bring a companion here to rename them and change their hair, beard and hair colour.
Tooltip_craft_TCAppearanceStationDesc.ch: 一面鏡子和一把剪刀. 帶同伴來這裡可為其改名, 並更換髮型, 鬍鬚與髮色.
Tooltip_craft_TCAppearanceStationDesc.cn: 一面镜子和一把剪刀. 带同伴来这里可为其改名, 并更换发型, 胡须与发色.

Tooltip_craft_TCSurvivorBeaconDesc.en: A radio post that tells other survivors your base is open. Must be built against a wall. Place one, set your base area, and people will start finding their way to you.
Tooltip_craft_TCSurvivorBeaconDesc.ch: 一座無線電信標, 告訴其他倖存者你的基地對外開放. 必須靠牆建造. 放置一座, 設定你的基地區域, 人們就會開始找到路前來投靠你.
Tooltip_craft_TCSurvivorBeaconDesc.cn: 一座无线电信标, 告诉其他幸存者你的基地对外开放. 必须靠墙建造. 放置一座, 设置你的基地区域, 人们就会开始找到路前来投靠你.

Tooltip_craft_SkyblockLogStorage.en: Stores logs, sticks and other tree loot
Tooltip_craft_SkyblockLogStorage.ch: 存放原木、樹枝和其他樹木掉落物
Tooltip_craft_SkyblockLogStorage.cn: 存放原木、树枝和其他树木掉落物

Tooltip_item_BrollowsDigest.en: A well-thumbed engineering digest. Reading it teaches you how to upgrade a Cobblestone Generator to Tier 2 - better ore yields, and the only way to get Copper Ore.
Tooltip_item_BrollowsDigest.ch: 一本被翻得破舊的工程文摘. 閱讀後可學會將圓石產生器升級為第 2 級 - 礦石產量更高, 也是取得銅礦石的唯一途徑.
Tooltip_item_BrollowsDigest.cn: 一本被翻得破旧的工程文摘. 阅读后可学会将圆石生成器升级为第 2 级 - 矿石产量更高, 也是获取铜矿石的唯一途径.

Tooltip_PZC_BoltQuiver.ch: 縮短十字弩的裝填時間.
Tooltip_PZC_BoltQuiver.cn: 缩短十字弩的装填时间.

Tooltip_Anchor.en: Gain immunity from being knocked down by gravity anomalies, but lose some carry weight. Gives off faint radiation.
Tooltip_Anchor.ch: 免疫重力異常造成的擊倒, 但負重能力會降低. 會散發微弱輻射.
Tooltip_Anchor.cn: 免疫重力异常造成的击倒, 但负重能力会降低. 会散发微弱辐射.

Tooltip_Bubble.en: Purges radiation and illness from your body, but it makes you quite thirsty and gives off faint radiation.
Tooltip_Bubble.ch: 清除體內的輻射和疾病, 但會讓你相當口渴, 並散發微弱輻射.
Tooltip_Bubble.cn: 清除体内的辐射和疾病, 但会让你相当口渴, 并散发微弱辐射.

Tooltip_DeadStar.en: Gravity anomalies ignore you, completely. Theres no con to this, but you better use it quick, the radiation melts your skin.
Tooltip_DeadStar.ch: 重力異常會完全無視你. 這沒有任何缺點, 但你最好快點使用, 輻射會融化你的皮膚.
Tooltip_DeadStar.cn: 重力异常会完全无视你. 这没有任何缺点, 但你最好快点使用, 辐射会融化你的皮肤.

Tooltip_Ember.en: Frost Zone damage is halved, and it warms you up. Makes you thirsty and a bit tired. Gives off moderate radiation.
Tooltip_Ember.ch: 極寒區域的傷害減半, 並能讓你暖和起來. 會讓你口渴且有點疲倦. 會散發中等輻射.
Tooltip_Ember.cn: 极寒区域的伤害减半, 并能让你暖和起来. 会让你口渴且有点疲倦. 会散发中等辐射.

Tooltip_Featherweight.en: Get 6 more carry weight, but you gain fatigue over time. Gives off moderate radiation.
Tooltip_Featherweight.ch: 負重上限增加 6, 但會隨時間累積疲勞. 會散發中等輻射.
Tooltip_Featherweight.cn: 负重上限增加 6, 但会随时间累积疲劳. 会散发中等辐射.

Tooltip_Hoarfrost.en: Damage taken in Thermal Zones is halved, and it cools you down, but sometimes a bit too much. Gives off faint radiation.
Tooltip_Hoarfrost.ch: 在極熱區域受到的傷害減半, 並能讓你降溫, 但有時會降得太多. 會散發微弱輻射.
Tooltip_Hoarfrost.cn: 在极热区域受到的伤害减半, 并能让你降温, 但有时会降得太多. 会散发微弱辐射.

Tooltip_LeadCase.en: The Lead Case provides protection from most artifacts radiation and allows you to still use it.
Tooltip_LeadCase.ch: 鉛防護箱能阻擋大多數神器的輻射, 同時仍可使用神器.
Tooltip_LeadCase.cn: 铅防护箱能阻挡大多数神器的辐射, 同时仍可使用神器.

Tooltip_Salamander.en: Gain passive health regen, but gain stress over time. Gives off alot of radiation.
Tooltip_Salamander.ch: 獲得被動生命恢復, 但會隨時間累積壓力. 會散發大量輻射.
Tooltip_Salamander.cn: 获得被动生命恢复, 但会随时间累积压力. 会散发大量辐射.

Tooltip_SlimeHeart.en: Gas mask filters drain slower, but you feel permenantly queasy and it gives off moderate radiation.
Tooltip_SlimeHeart.ch: 防毒面具濾罐消耗變慢, 但你會一直感到噁心, 而且會散發中等輻射.
Tooltip_SlimeHeart.cn: 防毒面具过滤器消耗变慢, 但你会一直感到恶心, 而且会散发中等辐射.

Tooltip_SnowFlakeCore.en: Your bleeding wounds freeze over, but you start to feel a big sluggish. Gives off moderate radiation.
Tooltip_SnowFlakeCore.ch: 你的出血傷口會凍結止血, 但你會開始感到有點遲緩. 會散發中等輻射.
Tooltip_SnowFlakeCore.cn: 你的出血伤口会冻结止血, 但你会开始感到有点迟缓. 会散发中等辐射.

Tooltip_Stormglass.en: Emission damage is halved, but you also panic during emissions. Gives off alot of radiation.
Tooltip_Stormglass.ch: 輻射風暴傷害減半, 但你在輻射風暴期間也會陷入恐慌. 會散發大量輻射.
Tooltip_Stormglass.cn: 辐射风暴伤害减半, 但你在辐射风暴期间也会陷入恐慌. 会散发大量辐射.

Tooltip_Play_Guitar_NoVehicle.en: Step out of the vehicle before playing.
Tooltip_Play_Guitar_NoVehicle.ch: 彈吉他之前先離開載具
Tooltip_Play_Guitar_NoVehicle.cn: 弹吉他之前先离开载具

Tooltip_BayonetKnife.en: Please don't spawn me, thats not how the bayonet system work bruh
Tooltip_BayonetKnife.ch: 請不要生成我, 刺刀系統不是這樣運作的啦老兄
Tooltip_BayonetKnife.cn: 请不要生成我, 刺刀系统不是这样运作的啦老兄

Tooltip_Muzzle.en: Needs a wrench in order to install or remove
Tooltip_Muzzle.ch: 需要扳手才能安裝或拆卸
Tooltip_Muzzle.cn: 需要扳手才能安装或拆卸

Tooltip_Recipe_RR_Operate_GP7.en: You can start and drive a GP7 light engine.
Tooltip_Recipe_RR_Operate_GP7.ch: 你能夠發動並駕駛單機運行的 GP7 火車頭.
Tooltip_Recipe_RR_Operate_GP7.cn: 你能够启动并驾驶单机运行的 GP7 机车.

Tooltip_Recipe_RR_TrainHandling.en: You can couple cars and handle a train on the automatic brake.
Tooltip_Recipe_RR_TrainHandling.ch: 你能夠連掛車廂, 並以自動制動操作列車.
Tooltip_Recipe_RR_TrainHandling.cn: 你能够连挂车厢, 并以自动制动操作列车.

Tooltip_item_RR_ModelManual_GP7.en:
The builder's operating manual for one class of locomotive:
controls, starting, running, what to do when she will not.
Read it and you can run a GP7 light engine.
Tooltip_item_RR_ModelManual_GP7.ch:
製造商為某一型火車頭編寫的操作手冊:
操控, 發動, 運行, 以及發動不了時該怎麼辦.
讀完就能駕駛單機運行的 GP7 火車頭.
Tooltip_item_RR_ModelManual_GP7.cn:
制造商为某一型机车编写的操作手册:
操控, 启动, 运行, 以及启动不了时该怎么办.
读完就能驾驶单机运行的 GP7 机车.

Tooltip_item_RR_RailFrog.en: A steel ramp clamped over the railhead that a derailed wheel is driven back up into gauge.
Tooltip_item_RR_RailFrog.ch: 夾在軌頭上的鋼製斜坡, 用來把脫軌的車輪開回軌距內.
Tooltip_item_RR_RailFrog.cn: 夹在轨头上的钢制斜坡, 用来把脱轨的车轮开回轨距内.

Tooltip_item_RR_RailSkate.en: A steel wedge over the railhead that holds the locomotive where she stands.
Tooltip_item_RR_RailSkate.ch: 卡在軌頭上的鋼製楔塊, 能把火車頭固定在原地.
Tooltip_item_RR_RailSkate.cn: 卡在轨头上的钢制楔块, 能把机车固定在原地.

Tooltip_item_RR_SpikeMaul.en: A long-handled hammer with a narrow double face, for driving track spikes. A sledgehammer will do the job, but this is what it is for.
Tooltip_item_RR_SpikeMaul.ch: 一把長柄窄雙面錘, 用來敲入道釘. 大鎚也能湊合, 但這才是專門的工具.
Tooltip_item_RR_SpikeMaul.cn: 一把长柄窄双面锤, 用来敲入道钉. 破墙大锤也能凑合, 但这才是专门的工具.

Tooltip_item_RR_TrackJack.en: A thirty-ton ratchet jack for lifting a derailed truck and walking it back over the rails.
Tooltip_item_RR_TrackJack.ch: 一台三十噸的棘輪千斤頂, 用來頂起脫軌的轉向架並把它挪回軌道上.
Tooltip_item_RR_TrackJack.cn: 一台三十吨的棘轮千斤顶, 用来顶起脱轨的转向架并把它挪回轨道上.

Tooltip_item_RR_TrainHandlingBook.en:
The company book: the automatic brake, slack, grades, signals.
The brake handle you already know stops the locomotive and
nothing else. A train is stopped down the brake pipe, and
getting that wrong is what runs a grade away from you.
Long enough to take several sittings.
Teaches working a train: couplers, and the brake that
reaches the cars.
Tooltip_item_RR_TrainHandlingBook.ch:
公司規程手冊: 自動制動, 車鉤間隙, 坡道, 號誌.
你已經熟悉的制動手柄只能讓火車頭停下,
其他什麼都停不了. 列車要靠制動管停下,
搞錯了就會在坡道上失控溜走.
內容很長, 需要分好幾次讀完.
教你操作列車: 車鉤, 以及作用到
車廂的制動.
Tooltip_item_RR_TrainHandlingBook.cn:
公司规程手册: 自动制动, 车钩间隙, 坡道, 信号.
你已经熟悉的制动手柄只能让机车停下,
其他什么都停不了. 列车要靠制动管停下,
搞错了就会在坡道上失控溜走.
内容很长, 需要分好几次读完.
教你操作列车: 车钩, 以及作用到
车厢的制动.

Tooltip_UM_BoltQuiver.ch: 縮短十字弩的裝填時間.
Tooltip_UM_BoltQuiver.cn: 缩短十字弩的装填时间.

Tooltip_UM_BowQuiver.en: Increases Ultimate Marksman bow reload speed by 100%.
Tooltip_UM_BowQuiver.ch: 使 Ultimate Marksman 弓的裝填速度提高 100%%.
Tooltip_UM_BowQuiver.cn: 使 Ultimate Marksman 弓的装填速度提高 100%%.

Tooltip_ArrowShaft.en: A straight wooden shaft cut and squared to length, bare and unfletched. Used to fletch arrows.
Tooltip_ArrowShaft.ch: 一根筆直的木製箭桿, 已裁切並修整至適當長度, 光禿且尚未裝上箭羽. 用於製作箭矢.
Tooltip_ArrowShaft.cn: 一根笔直的木制箭杆, 已裁切并修整至适当长度, 光秃且尚未装上箭羽. 用于制作箭矢.

Tooltip_BodkinArrow.en: A fletched shaft tipped with a narrow forged bodkin point. Punches through cleanly and usually comes back intact. Fired from any bow.
Tooltip_BodkinArrow.ch: 一根裝上箭羽、配有鍛造窄錐形箭頭的箭桿. 能乾淨俐落地貫穿目標, 通常能完好回收. 可用任何弓發射.
Tooltip_BodkinArrow.cn: 一根装上箭羽、配有锻造窄锥形箭头的箭杆. 能干净利落地贯穿目标, 通常能完好回收. 可用任何弓发射.

Tooltip_BodkinArrowMFD.en: A manufactured bullet point arrow on a carbon shaft. Slightly stronger than a Pinpoint carbon arrow. Fired from any bow.
Tooltip_BodkinArrowMFD.ch: 一支以碳製箭桿製成的量產子彈頭箭矢. 比碳素箭矢略強. 可用任何弓發射.
Tooltip_BodkinArrowMFD.cn: 一支以碳制箭杆制成的量产子弹头箭矢. 比碳素箭矢略强. 可用任何弓发射.

Tooltip_BodkinArrowhead.en: A narrow, four-sided point forged to punch through rather than cut. Used to tip arrows.
Tooltip_BodkinArrowhead.ch: 一枚狹長的四稜箭頭, 鍛造用於貫穿而非切割. 用於裝在箭矢上.
Tooltip_BodkinArrowhead.cn: 一枚狭长的四棱箭头, 锻造用于贯穿而非切割. 用于装在箭矢上.

Tooltip_BodkinArrowheadMFD.en: A mass-produced bullet point, factory-sharp. Fits a Carbon Arrow Shaft.
Tooltip_BodkinArrowheadMFD.ch: 一枚量產的子彈頭, 出廠即十分鋒利. 可裝在碳製箭桿上.
Tooltip_BodkinArrowheadMFD.cn: 一枚量产的子弹头, 出厂即十分锋利. 可装在碳制箭杆上.

Tooltip_BodkinArrowheadMFDPack10.en: A sealed case of 10 manufactured bullet points. Open it to get the heads out.
Tooltip_BodkinArrowheadMFDPack10.ch: 一個密封盒, 內含 10 枚量產子彈頭. 開啟後即可取出箭頭.
Tooltip_BodkinArrowheadMFDPack10.cn: 一个密封盒, 内含 10 枚量产子弹头. 打开后即可取出箭头.

Tooltip_BodkinArrowheadMFDPack5.en: A sealed case of 5 manufactured bullet points. Open it to get the heads out.
Tooltip_BodkinArrowheadMFDPack5.ch: 一個密封盒, 內含 5 枚量產子彈頭. 開啟後即可取出箭頭.
Tooltip_BodkinArrowheadMFDPack5.cn: 一个密封盒, 内含 5 枚量产子弹头. 打开后即可取出箭头.

Tooltip_BoneArrowhead.en: A splinter of carcass bone worked to a sharp point. Used to tip arrows.
Tooltip_BoneArrowhead.ch: 一片從動物屍骸取下的碎骨, 磨製成尖頭. 用於裝在箭矢上.
Tooltip_BoneArrowhead.cn: 一片从动物尸骸取下的碎骨, 磨制成尖头. 用于装在箭矢上.

Tooltip_BroadheadArrow.en: A fletched shaft tipped with a wide forged broadhead. The hardest-hitting arrow you can craft, though it breaks more often. Fired from any bow.
Tooltip_BroadheadArrow.ch: 一根裝上箭羽、配有鍛造寬刃箭頭的箭桿. 你能製作的箭矢中殺傷力最強的一種, 不過也更容易斷裂. 可用任何弓發射.
Tooltip_BroadheadArrow.cn: 一根装上箭羽、配有锻造宽刃箭头的箭杆. 你能制作的箭矢中杀伤力最强的一种, 不过也更容易断裂. 可用任何弓发射.

Tooltip_BroadheadArrowMFD.en: A manufactured broadhead arrow on a carbon shaft. The hardest-hitting arrow in the mod. Fired from any bow.
Tooltip_BroadheadArrowMFD.ch: 一支以碳製箭桿製成的量產寬刃箭矢. 本模組中殺傷力最強的箭矢. 可用任何弓發射.
Tooltip_BroadheadArrowMFD.cn: 一支以碳制箭杆制成的量产宽刃箭矢. 本模组中杀伤力最强的箭矢. 可用任何弓发射.

Tooltip_BroadheadArrowhead.en: A wide-bladed point forged and ground for a heavy wound. Used to tip arrows.
Tooltip_BroadheadArrowhead.ch: 一枚寬刃箭頭, 經鍛造與研磨, 能造成重創. 用於裝在箭矢上.
Tooltip_BroadheadArrowhead.cn: 一枚宽刃箭头, 经锻造与研磨, 能造成重创. 用于装在箭矢上.

Tooltip_BroadheadArrowheadMFD.en: A mass-produced broadhead point, factory-ground. Fits a Carbon Arrow Shaft.
Tooltip_BroadheadArrowheadMFD.ch: 一枚量產的寬刃箭頭, 出廠即已研磨. 可裝在碳製箭桿上.
Tooltip_BroadheadArrowheadMFD.cn: 一枚量产的宽刃箭头, 出厂即已研磨. 可装在碳制箭杆上.

Tooltip_BroadheadArrowheadMFDPack10.en: A sealed case of 10 manufactured broadhead points. Open it to get the heads out.
Tooltip_BroadheadArrowheadMFDPack10.ch: 一個密封盒, 內含 10 枚量產寬刃箭頭. 開啟後即可取出箭頭.
Tooltip_BroadheadArrowheadMFDPack10.cn: 一个密封盒, 内含 10 枚量产宽刃箭头. 打开后即可取出箭头.

Tooltip_BroadheadArrowheadMFDPack5.en: A sealed case of 5 manufactured broadhead points. Open it to get the heads out.
Tooltip_BroadheadArrowheadMFDPack5.ch: 一個密封盒, 內含 5 枚量產寬刃箭頭. 開啟後即可取出箭頭.
Tooltip_BroadheadArrowheadMFDPack5.cn: 一个密封盒, 内含 5 枚量产宽刃箭头. 打开后即可取出箭头.

Tooltip_BrokenArrow.en: A snapped arrow, its shaft cracked and its fletching torn loose. Useless as ammunition. Can be re-fletched back into a working arrow.
Tooltip_BrokenArrow.ch: 一支折斷的箭矢, 箭桿已裂開, 箭羽也已脫落. 無法當作彈藥使用. 可重新裝上箭羽, 修復成能用的箭矢.
Tooltip_BrokenArrow.cn: 一支折断的箭矢, 箭杆已裂开, 箭羽也已脱落. 无法当作弹药使用. 可重新装上箭羽, 修复成能用的箭矢.

Tooltip_CarbonArrowCrate.en: A shipping crate of packed carbon hunting arrows. Open it to get the packs out.
Tooltip_CarbonArrowCrate.ch: 一個裝有整包碳素箭矢的貨運箱. 開啟後即可取出整包箭矢.
Tooltip_CarbonArrowCrate.cn: 一个装有整包碳素箭矢的货运箱. 打开后即可取出整包箭矢.

Tooltip_CarbonArrowPack.en: A sealed retail pack of carbon hunting arrows. Open it to get the arrows out.
Tooltip_CarbonArrowPack.ch: 一包密封的零售碳素箭矢. 開啟後即可取出箭矢.
Tooltip_CarbonArrowPack.cn: 一包密封的零售碳素箭矢. 打开后即可取出箭矢.

Tooltip_CarbonArrowShaft.en: A manufactured carbon shaft, already fletched. Needs a point before it can be fired.
Tooltip_CarbonArrowShaft.ch: 一根量產的碳製箭桿, 已裝好箭羽. 需要裝上箭頭才能發射.
Tooltip_CarbonArrowShaft.cn: 一根量产的碳制箭杆, 已装好箭羽. 需要装上箭头才能发射.

Tooltip_CarbonArrowShaftPack.en: A sealed retail pack of carbon arrow shafts. Open it to get the shafts out.
Tooltip_CarbonArrowShaftPack.ch: 一包密封的零售碳製箭桿. 開啟後即可取出箭桿.
Tooltip_CarbonArrowShaftPack.cn: 一包密封的零售碳制箭杆. 打开后即可取出箭杆.

Tooltip_CarbonHuntingArrow.en: A factory-made Pinpoint Carbon Arrow with a machined hunting point. Deadly and tough enough to shoot again and again, but it cannot be crafted -- only found. Fired from any bow.
Tooltip_CarbonHuntingArrow.ch: 一支工廠製造的碳素箭矢, 配有機械加工的狩獵箭頭. 致命且堅固, 可以一再重複射擊, 但無法製作 -- 只能找到. 可用任何弓發射.
Tooltip_CarbonHuntingArrow.cn: 一支工厂制造的碳素箭矢, 配有机械加工的狩猎箭头. 致命且坚固, 可以一再重复射击, 但无法制作 -- 只能找到. 可用任何弓发射.

Tooltip_CarvedHornLimb.en: A limb of horn, carefully carved off an animal skull. Ready to be backed and bound into a bow.
Tooltip_CarvedHornLimb.ch: 一片從動物頭骨上仔細雕下的角質弓臂. 可以加上背襯並綁製成弓.
Tooltip_CarvedHornLimb.cn: 一片从动物头骨上仔细雕下的角质弓臂. 可以加上背衬并绑制成弓.

Tooltip_FiberglassBowStave.en: A wooden bow stave faced with fiberglass tape and bonded with epoxy. Needs stringing to become a bow.
Tooltip_FiberglassBowStave.ch: 一根貼上玻璃纖維膠帶並以環氧樹脂黏合的木製弓胚. 需要上弦才能成為弓.
Tooltip_FiberglassBowStave.cn: 一根贴上玻璃纤维胶带并以环氧树脂粘合的木制弓胚. 需要上弦才能成为弓.

Tooltip_FletchedArrowShaft.en: An arrow shaft bound with three fletchings and a length of cord, still without a point. Sharpen it or fit an arrowhead to finish the arrow.
Tooltip_FletchedArrowShaft.ch: 一根以三片箭羽和一段繩子綁好的箭桿, 仍未裝上箭頭. 將其削尖或裝上箭頭即可完成箭矢.
Tooltip_FletchedArrowShaft.cn: 一根以三片箭羽和一段绳子绑好的箭杆, 仍未装上箭头. 将其削尖或装上箭头即可完成箭矢.

Tooltip_Fletching.en: A handful of vanes cut from feathers, stiff card or bottle plastic. Used to fletch arrows.
Tooltip_Fletching.ch: 一把從羽毛、硬卡片或塑膠瓶裁下的箭羽. 用於製作箭矢.
Tooltip_Fletching.cn: 一把从羽毛、硬卡片或塑料瓶裁下的箭羽. 用于制作箭矢.

Tooltip_HornBow.en: A wood-cored bow backed with sinew and horn carved from a skull, wrapped in leather. The strongest bow a survivor can build without a factory.
Tooltip_HornBow.ch: 一把以木為芯、背襯獸筋與從頭骨雕下的角, 並以皮革包覆的弓. 倖存者在沒有工廠的情況下所能打造的最強弓.
Tooltip_HornBow.cn: 一把以木为芯、背衬兽筋与从头骨雕下的角, 并以皮革包覆的弓. 幸存者在没有工厂的情况下所能打造的最强弓.

Tooltip_MetalArrowhead.en: A scrap of thin metal cut and shaped into a point. Used to tip arrows.
Tooltip_MetalArrowhead.ch: 一片裁切並塑形成尖頭的薄金屬廢料. 用於裝在箭矢上.
Tooltip_MetalArrowhead.cn: 一片裁切并塑形成尖头的薄金属废料. 用于装在箭矢上.

Tooltip_RecurveBow.en: A modern recurve bow, its wood core faced with fiberglass tape and bonded with epoxy. Hits harder than anything carved by hand.
Tooltip_RecurveBow.ch: 一把現代反曲弓, 木芯貼上玻璃纖維膠帶並以環氧樹脂黏合. 威力勝過任何手工雕製的弓.
Tooltip_RecurveBow.cn: 一把现代反曲弓, 木芯贴上玻璃纤维胶带并以环氧树脂粘合. 威力胜过任何手工雕制的弓.

Tooltip_StoneArrowhead.en: A piece of flint knapped down to a sharp point and edge. Used to tip arrows.
Tooltip_StoneArrowhead.ch: 一塊打製出銳利尖端與刃口的燧石. 用於裝在箭矢上.
Tooltip_StoneArrowhead.cn: 一块打制出锐利尖端与刃口的燧石. 用于装在箭矢上.

Tooltip_craft_RadArcheryTargetDesc.en: A straw-stuffed practice target on a wooden frame. Shoot it to train Archery, then pull your arrows back out of it.
Tooltip_craft_RadArcheryTargetDesc.ch: 一個裝在木架上、填滿稻草的練習箭靶. 射擊它可訓練射箭, 之後再把箭矢拔回來.
Tooltip_craft_RadArcheryTargetDesc.cn: 一个装在木架上、填满稻草的练习箭靶. 射击它可训练射箭, 之后再把箭矢拔回来.

Tooltip_SOS_BreachCharge.en: A focused demolition charge. Right-click an adjacent door or window to breach it without a wide-area explosion.
Tooltip_SOS_BreachCharge.ch: 聚能爆破炸藥. 對相鄰的門或窗點選右鍵即可破門, 不會造成大範圍爆炸.
Tooltip_SOS_BreachCharge.cn: 聚能爆破炸药. 右键点击相邻的门或窗户即可破门, 不会造成大范围爆炸.

Tooltip_SOS_FieldRepair.en: Repairs a damaged weapon or tool in your inventory. Requires scrap or electronics scrap, duct tape, and a screwdriver. Can fail and may damage the item.
Tooltip_SOS_FieldRepair.ch: 修理物品欄中受損的武器或工具. 需要廢料或電子零件、布膠帶與螺絲起子. 可能失敗並損壞物品.
Tooltip_SOS_FieldRepair.cn: 修理物品栏中受损的武器或工具. 需要废料或电子废料、管道胶带和螺丝刀. 可能失败并损坏物品.

Tooltip_SOS_FieldRepairAdvanced.en: Stronger field repair for damaged weapons and tools. Needs Maintenance 3, more scrap, tape or epoxy, screwdriver, and pliers. Restores more condition than basic Field Repair.
Tooltip_SOS_FieldRepairAdvanced.ch: 針對受損武器與工具的強化戰地維修. 需要維護 3 級、更多廢料、膠帶或環氧樹脂、螺絲起子與鉗子. 比基本戰地維修恢復更多耐久度.
Tooltip_SOS_FieldRepairAdvanced.cn: 针对受损武器和工具的强化战地维修. 需要维护 3 级、更多废料、胶带或环氧树脂、螺丝刀和钳子. 比基础战地维修恢复更多耐久度.

Tooltip_SOS_Laser.en: Tactical laser module. Improves hit chance and aiming speed. Needs a screwdriver to attach/detach. Occupies the cannon slot (swap with suppressor if preferred).
Tooltip_SOS_Laser.ch: 戰術雷射模組. 提升命中率與瞄準速度. 安裝或拆卸需要螺絲起子. 佔用槍管槽位 (可視需要與消音器互換).
Tooltip_SOS_Laser.cn: 战术激光模块. 提升命中率和瞄准速度. 安装或拆卸需要螺丝刀. 占用枪管槽位 (可视需要与消音器互换).

Tooltip_SOS_Suppressor.en: Operator suppressor for pistols and rifles that have a quiet sound bank. Cuts report volume and zombie-hear range. Needs a screwdriver. Occupies the cannon slot (swap with laser if preferred). Not for shotguns — their report stays loud.
Tooltip_SOS_Suppressor.ch: 幹員用消音器, 適用於具備消音音效的手槍與步槍. 降低槍聲音量與殭屍聽覺範圍. 需要螺絲起子. 佔用槍管槽位 (可視需要與雷射互換). 不適用於霰彈槍 — 其槍聲依然很大.
Tooltip_SOS_Suppressor.cn: 干员用消音器, 适用于具备消音音效的手枪和步枪. 降低枪声音量和僵尸听觉范围. 需要螺丝刀. 占用枪管槽位 (可视需要与激光互换). 不适用于霰弹枪 — 其枪声依然很大.

Tooltip_DC_StationPart.en:
Requires parts 1/2 and 2/2 of the same station tier.
Carry one part; the other may be on the ground within 2 tiles.
Place using the furniture menu. Rotate with R.
Tooltip_DC_StationPart.ch:
需要同一等級風乾架的第 1/2 與第 2/2 部件.
攜帶其中一個部件, 另一個可放在 2 格範圍內的地面上.
透過家具選單放置. 按 R 旋轉.
Tooltip_DC_StationPart.cn:
需要同一等级风干架的第 1/2 和第 2/2 部件.
携带其中一个部件, 另一个可以放在 2 格范围内的地面上.
通过家具菜单放置. 按 R 旋转.

Tooltip_BoteBR_Bote.en: An aluminum rowboat. Place it on water near the shore, board it and row out to fish where the big ones live.
Tooltip_BoteBR_Bote.ch: 一艘鋁製划艇. 放到靠近岸邊的水面上, 登船後划出去, 到大魚出沒的地方釣魚.
Tooltip_BoteBR_Bote.cn: 一艘铝制划艇. 放到靠近岸边的水面上, 登船后划出去, 到大鱼出没的地方钓鱼.

Tooltip_BoteBR_Trawler.en: A proper fishing trawler with a wheelhouse. Place it on deep water, board it and take the helm inside the cabin. Big deck for the serious fisherman.
Tooltip_BoteBR_Trawler.ch: 一艘配有駕駛艙的正規拖網漁船. 放到深水上, 登船後進入船艙掌舵. 寬敞的甲板, 專為認真的漁夫打造.
Tooltip_BoteBR_Trawler.cn: 一艘配有驾驶室的正规拖网渔船. 放到深水上, 登船后进入船舱掌舵. 宽敞的甲板, 专为认真的渔夫打造.

Tooltip_CovoBR_Boia.en: Marks the position of a submerged pot.
Tooltip_CovoBR_Boia.ch: 標示沉在水中的蟹籠位置.
Tooltip_CovoBR_Boia.cn: 标示沉在水中的蟹笼位置.

Tooltip_CovoBR_Covo.en: Wood-and-rope trap for crabs and lobsters. Bait it and drop it in the water.
Tooltip_CovoBR_Covo.ch: 用木頭和繩子製成的螃蟹與龍蝦陷阱. 放上誘餌後投入水中.
Tooltip_CovoBR_Covo.cn: 用木头和绳子制成的螃蟹与龙虾陷阱. 放上诱饵后投入水中.

Tooltip_CovoBR_CovoIscado.en: Baited and ready. Drop it in the water and come back in 5 hours.
Tooltip_CovoBR_CovoIscado.ch: 已放好誘餌, 準備就緒. 投入水中, 5 小時後再回來.
Tooltip_CovoBR_CovoIscado.cn: 已放好诱饵, 准备就绪. 投入水中, 5 小时后再回来.

Tooltip_CovoBR_Isca.en: Cured fish fillets. Enough for up to 5 pots.
Tooltip_CovoBR_Isca.ch: 醃製魚片. 最多可供 5 個蟹籠使用.
Tooltip_CovoBR_Isca.cn: 腌制鱼片. 最多可供 5 个蟹笼使用.

Tooltip_cat_AutoReload.en: Worn on the left middle finger or carried in your main inventory: each magazine-loading cycle inserts 5 rounds instead of 1.
Tooltip_cat_AutoReload.ch: 戴在左手中指或放在主物品欄中: 每次裝填彈匣時裝入 5 發而非 1 發.
Tooltip_cat_AutoReload.cn: 戴在左手中指或放在主物品栏中: 每次装填弹匣时装入 5 发而非 1 发.

Tooltip_QoLC_ButcherCorpseNoKnife.en: Needs a sharp knife or a meat cleaver.
Tooltip_QoLC_ButcherCorpseNoKnife.ch: 需要一把鋒利的刀或切肉刀.
Tooltip_QoLC_ButcherCorpseNoKnife.cn: 需要一把锋利的刀或剁肉刀.

Tooltip_QoLC_CorpseFlesh.en: Is there anything you would not do to survive? Eating this will make you very ill. It composts.
Tooltip_QoLC_CorpseFlesh.ch: 為了活下去, 還有什麼是你做不出來的? 吃下這個會讓你病得很重. 可以堆肥.
Tooltip_QoLC_CorpseFlesh.cn: 为了活下去, 还有什么是你做不出来的? 吃下这个会让你病得很重. 可以堆肥.

Tooltip_QoLC_CuredCorpseFlesh.en: Cured through. Raw, so cook it, and then it is meat like any other.
Tooltip_QoLC_CuredCorpseFlesh.ch: 已經醃透了. 還是生的, 所以要煮熟, 之後就跟其他肉沒兩樣.
Tooltip_QoLC_CuredCorpseFlesh.cn: 已经腌透了. 还是生的, 所以要煮熟, 之后就跟其他肉没两样.

Tooltip_QoLC_CuringCorpseFlesh.en: Packed in salt. Leave it somewhere that is not cold for three days.
Tooltip_QoLC_CuringCorpseFlesh.ch: 用鹽醃著. 放在不冷的地方三天.
Tooltip_QoLC_CuringCorpseFlesh.cn: 用盐腌着. 放在不冷的地方三天.

Tooltip_QoLC_Lockpick.en: Thin enough to work a pin tumbler, with a screwdriver for tension.
Tooltip_QoLC_Lockpick.ch: 薄得足以撥動彈子鎖的鎖栓, 再用螺絲起子施加扭力.
Tooltip_QoLC_Lockpick.cn: 薄到足以拨动弹子锁的锁销, 再用螺丝刀施加扭力.

Tooltip_QoLC_LockpickBook1.en: Teaches how to make a pick, and how to use one.
Tooltip_QoLC_LockpickBook1.ch: 教你如何製作開鎖工具, 以及如何使用.
Tooltip_QoLC_LockpickBook1.cn: 教你如何制作开锁工具, 以及如何使用.

Tooltip_QoLC_LockpickBook2.en: Teaches how to lever a lock open with a crowbar.
Tooltip_QoLC_LockpickBook2.ch: 教你如何用鐵撬把鎖撬開.
Tooltip_QoLC_LockpickBook2.cn: 教你如何用撬棍把锁撬开.

Tooltip_QoLC_PreparedCorpseFlesh.en: Trimmed and boned properly. Still a mistake to eat, and still a long way from food.
Tooltip_QoLC_PreparedCorpseFlesh.ch: 已妥善修整並去骨. 吃它仍是個錯誤, 而且離能當食物還差得遠.
Tooltip_QoLC_PreparedCorpseFlesh.cn: 已妥善修整并去骨. 吃它仍是个错误, 而且离能当食物还差得远.

Tooltip_QoLC_ReadOnePage.en: Still too advanced to learn from, but reading a page is enough to recognize another copy later.
Tooltip_QoLC_ReadOnePage.ch: 內容仍太艱深, 無法從中學習, 但讀過一頁就足以在之後認出另一本相同的書.
Tooltip_QoLC_ReadOnePage.cn: 内容仍太深奥, 无法从中学习, 但读过一页就足以在之后认出另一本相同的书.

Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookCarpentry.en: Exercises to work through with a saw and a hammer. Costs planks, teaches carpentry.
Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookCarpentry.ch: 用鋸子和鎚子完成的練習題. 消耗木板, 可學習木工.
Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookCarpentry.cn: 用手锯和羊角锤完成的练习题. 消耗木板, 可学习木工.

Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookElectrical.en: Exercises to work through with a screwdriver. Costs scrap electronics and wire, teaches electrical.
Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookElectrical.ch: 用螺絲起子完成的練習題. 消耗電子零件和鐵絲, 可學習電工.
Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookElectrical.cn: 用螺丝刀完成的练习题. 消耗电子废料和铁丝, 可学习电工.

Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookTailoring.en: Exercises to work through with scissors and a needle. Costs rags and thread, teaches tailoring.
Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookTailoring.ch: 用剪刀和針完成的練習題. 消耗碎布和縫線, 可學習縫紉.
Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookTailoring.cn: 用剪刀和针完成的练习题. 消耗碎布条和线, 可学习缝纫.

Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookWelding.en: Exercises to work through with a torch and a mask. Costs scrap metal, teaches welding.
Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookWelding.ch: 用瓦斯噴槍和焊接面罩完成的練習題. 消耗廢金屬, 可學習金工.
Tooltip_QoLC_WorkbookWelding.cn: 用丙烷喷灯和焊工面罩完成的练习题. 消耗金属废料, 可学习金工.

Tooltip_MGsMRE_ProteinWaferPackage.cn: 粉质骨白色的威化饼, 用厚重的不反光铝箔包裹

Tooltip_MGsMRE_PulpWafers.en:
Thin brittle squares pressed from Dehydrated wild berry skins -Crushed acorns and Reclaimed
Corn syrup -They shatter like Bark in your mouth -Delivering a brief tart burst of Sweetness
Tooltip_MGsMRE_PulpWafers.ch:
以脫水野莓果皮, 碎橡實與回收的
玉米糖漿壓製成的薄脆方片, 在嘴裡像樹皮般碎裂, 帶來短暫的酸甜滋味
Tooltip_MGsMRE_PulpWafers.cn:
用脱水野莓果皮, 碎橡子与回收的
玉米糖浆压制成的薄脆方片, 在嘴里像树皮般碎裂, 带来短暂的酸甜滋味

Tooltip_MGsMRE_PumpkinSpiceTeaMug.en: Mug of Pumpkin Spice Tea to sooth the wandering Spirits
Tooltip_MGsMRE_PumpkinSpiceTeaMug.ch: 一杯南瓜香料茶, 撫慰遊蕩的靈魂
Tooltip_MGsMRE_PumpkinSpiceTeaMug.cn: 一杯南瓜香料茶, 抚慰游荡的灵魂

Tooltip_MGsMRE_PurAqua.en:
Mass-produced molecularly stripped Water packaged in high-gloss Wax-coated paper carton
Distributed to lower-tier Office sectors to maintain Baseline worker hydration -Sterile and Safe
Tooltip_MGsMRE_PurAqua.ch:
大量生產的分子級純化水, 裝在高光澤的塗蠟紙盒中
配發給基層辦公部門, 維持員工的基本水分補給, 無菌又安全
Tooltip_MGsMRE_PurAqua.cn:
大量生产的分子级纯化水, 装在高光泽的涂蜡纸盒中
配发给基层办公部门, 维持员工的基本水分补给, 无菌又安全

Tooltip_MGsMRE_PureSpringWater.en:
Pure crystal-clear Spring water -Helps
To counter Stamina drain from Lipids and Alcohol
Tooltip_MGsMRE_PureSpringWater.ch:
純淨清澈的泉水, 有助於
抵銷油脂與酒精造成的耐力消耗
Tooltip_MGsMRE_PureSpringWater.cn:
纯净清澈的泉水, 有助于
抵消油脂与酒精造成的耐力消耗

Tooltip_MGsMRE_QuailPear.en: Salted dried bird meat coated in a cactus-fruit reduction
Tooltip_MGsMRE_QuailPear.ch: 鹽漬鳥肉乾, 裹上濃縮仙人掌果醬汁
Tooltip_MGsMRE_QuailPear.cn: 盐渍鸟肉干, 裹上浓缩仙人掌果酱汁

Tooltip_MGsMRE_QuailPearOpen.en: Shredded heavily salted Dried bird meat coated in a sweet Sticky cactus-fruit reduction
Tooltip_MGsMRE_QuailPearOpen.ch: 重鹽醃製的手撕鳥肉乾, 裹上香甜黏稠的濃縮仙人掌果醬汁
Tooltip_MGsMRE_QuailPearOpen.cn: 重盐腌制的手撕鸟肉干, 裹上香甜黏稠的浓缩仙人掌果酱汁

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadCorn.en:
Thick blackened cornbread Biscuits baked with
Wood ash and charcoal Dust to bind to ingested Rad-particles
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadCorn.ch:
厚實焦黑的玉米麵包餅乾, 烘烤時加入
木灰與炭粉, 用來吸附吃下肚的輻射微粒
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadCorn.cn:
厚实焦黑的玉米面包饼干, 烘烤时加入
木灰与炭粉, 用来吸附吃下肚的辐射微粒

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadMeatStrip.en:
Blackened leathery mystery meat Strip that is rough and Fibrous weeping a dark oily Residue
Durable Wasteland survival protein -It cuts down severe Hunger but induces thirst due to its Preparation
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadMeatStrip.ch:
焦黑如皮革的不明肉條, 粗糙多筋, 滲出深色的油狀殘渣
耐放的廢土求生蛋白質, 能大幅緩解飢餓, 但因製作方式會讓人口渴
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadMeatStrip.cn:
焦黑如皮革的不明肉条, 粗糙多筋, 渗出深色的油状残渣
耐放的废土求生蛋白质, 能大幅缓解饥饿, 但因制作方式会让人口渴

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadMeatStrips.en: Tightly wound roll of blackened Leathery mystery meat strips tied together with Rusted wire
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadMeatStrips.ch: 一捲緊緊纏繞的焦黑皮革狀不明肉條, 用生鏽的鐵絲綁在一起
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadMeatStrips.cn: 一卷紧紧缠绕的焦黑皮革状不明肉条, 用生锈的铁丝绑在一起

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadRoast.en:
Chalky gray-green survival Biscuit baked from mutant Spud flour
And rendered lard -Stamped with a crude Biohazard symbol
To warn scavengers of its Questionable origin
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadRoast.ch:
以突變馬鈴薯粉與煉製豬油烘烤的
粉質灰綠色求生餅乾, 印著簡陋的生物危害標誌
警告拾荒者它來路可疑
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadRoast.cn:
用变异土豆粉与熬制猪油烘烤的
粉质灰绿色求生饼干, 印着简陋的生物危害标志
警告拾荒者它来路可疑

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadShieldDrops.en:
Rusted unsealed tin containing Smooth amber-colored translucent Spheres -They provide a
Sugary spike to conquer fatigue while the sugar Matrix coat the throat and settle internal Toxicity
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadShieldDrops.ch:
生鏽且未密封的鐵罐, 裝著光滑的琥珀色半透明圓球, 能提供
糖分衝擊以驅除疲勞, 同時糖衣能包覆喉嚨並緩和體內毒性
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadShieldDrops.cn:
生锈且未密封的铁罐, 装着光滑的琥珀色半透明圆球, 能提供
糖分冲击以驱除疲劳, 同时糖衣能包覆喉咙并缓和体内毒性

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadSoda.en:
Flat pre-collapse cola served in a Degraded plastic bottle that has turned an Unsettling
Cloudy amber color after years of Improper storage -Intense chemically sweet High-fructose corn syrup
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadSoda.ch:
沒氣的崩潰前可樂, 裝在老化的塑膠瓶裡, 因多年保存不當而變成令人不安的
混濁琥珀色, 帶有濃烈化學甜味的高果糖玉米糖漿
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadSoda.cn:
没气的崩溃前可乐, 装在老化的塑料瓶里, 因多年储存不当而变成令人不安的
浑浊琥珀色, 带有浓烈化学甜味的高果糖玉米糖浆

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadStag.en: Mutated venison strips Packed with beans

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadStagHot.en:
Hot Tough thick-cut mutated Venison strips
Packed with smoked Pinto beans in a heavy Lard glaze
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadStagHot.ch:
熱騰騰的堅韌厚切突變鹿肉條
搭配煙燻斑豆, 裹著厚厚一層豬油
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadStagHot.cn:
热腾腾的坚韧厚切变异鹿肉条
搭配烟熏斑豆, 裹着厚厚一层猪油

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadStagOpen.en:
Tough thick-cut mutated Venison strips
Packed with smoked Pinto beans in a heavy Lard glaze
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadStagOpen.ch:
堅韌的厚切突變鹿肉條
搭配煙燻斑豆, 裹著厚厚一層豬油
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadStagOpen.cn:
坚韧的厚切变异鹿肉条
搭配烟熏斑豆, 裹着厚厚一层猪油

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadiatorMustard.en:
Thick pungent yellow Condiment made from crushed wild Mustard seeds
Scavenged vinegar scraps And a dash of Turmeric -It has a sharp sinus-clearing
Heat with a faint metallic Aftertaste -Perfect for masking the flavour of Stale meat
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadiatorMustard.ch:
濃稠嗆辣的黃色調味醬, 以壓碎的野生芥末籽
搜刮來的剩醋與少許薑黃製成, 帶有直衝鼻腔的強烈
辣勁與淡淡的金屬餘味, 最適合掩蓋不新鮮肉類的味道
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadiatorMustard.cn:
浓稠呛辣的黄色调味酱, 用压碎的野生芥末籽
搜刮来的剩醋和少许姜黄制成, 带有直冲鼻腔的强烈
辣劲与淡淡的金属余味, 最适合掩盖不新鲜肉类的味道

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RaiderRation.en: Patchwork pouch made from scrap Materials -Crudely stitched and tied with thin leather strings
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RaiderRation.ch: 以廢料拼縫而成的拼布袋, 縫工粗糙, 用細皮繩綁緊
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RaiderRation.cn: 用废料拼缝而成的拼布袋, 缝工粗糙, 用细皮绳绑紧

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RainCheck.en: Yellow waterproof vinyl Wrap sealed with a heavy industrial Plastic zip

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RainCheck.cn: 黄色防水乙烯基包装, 用厚重的工业用塑料拉链封口

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RainCheckEmpty.ch: 當時防水, 現在依然防水
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RainCheckEmpty.cn: 当时防水, 现在依然防水

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationBars.en:
Dense matte-grey rectangular bars Embossed with deep parallel Ridges
Across its upper surface -Heavily salted Lard and Toasted Yeast flavour
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationBars.ch:
緻密的霧灰色長方形條塊, 表面壓印著深深的平行
凸紋, 帶有重鹹豬油與烤酵母風味
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationBars.cn:
致密的哑光灰色长方形条块, 表面压印着深深的平行
凸纹, 带有重咸猪油与烤酵母风味

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationBroth.en:
Dark muddy-brown liquid Served in a heavy-duty vacuum-sealed Plastic pouch with an
Integrated thermal nozzle -Heavy gelatinous and thick Protein paste that coats the Throat
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationBroth.ch:
深泥褐色的液體, 裝在附有一體式保溫吸嘴的
重型真空密封塑膠袋中, 是厚重黏稠的膠質蛋白糊, 會裹住喉嚨
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationBroth.cn:
深泥褐色的液体, 装在带有一体式保温吸嘴的
重型真空密封塑料袋中, 是厚重黏稠的胶质蛋白糊, 会裹住喉咙

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationEnhancer.en: Quick-Apply patch to reduce Pain and Fatigue and boost Endurance
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationEnhancer.ch: 快速貼用的貼片, 可減輕疼痛與疲勞並提升耐力
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationEnhancer.cn: 快速贴用的贴片, 可减轻疼痛与疲劳并提升耐力

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationGradeDrench.en:
Fine pale pink mineral Drink mixed from electrolyte powder -Used to combat
Severe heat exhaustion and Muscle tremors -Very salty with a sharp Synthetic citrus finish
That smells intensely of Artificial lime and chemical Purification tablets
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationGradeDrench.ch:
以電解質粉沖泡的細緻淡粉紅色礦物飲料, 用來對抗
嚴重的熱衰竭與肌肉顫抖, 非常鹹, 帶有刺激的人工柑橘尾韻
聞起來有濃烈的人工萊姆與化學淨水錠氣味
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationGradeDrench.cn:
用电解质粉冲泡的细腻淡粉色矿物饮料, 用来对抗
严重的热衰竭与肌肉震颤, 非常咸, 带有刺激的人工柑橘余味
闻起来有浓烈的人工青柠与化学净水片气味

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RavenChews.en:
Pitch-black rubbery fruit Nuggets that taste intensely sour
Almost like Copper and Wild honey
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RavenChews.ch:
漆黑有嚼勁的水果軟糖塊, 味道極酸
幾乎像是銅與野生蜂蜜
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RavenChews.cn:
漆黑有嚼劲的水果软糖块, 味道极酸
几乎像是铜与野生蜂蜜

Tooltip_MGsMRE_ReadyCocoa.en:
Chocolate drink with a gritty High-calorie suspension that needs vigorous shaking
Forms an impenetrable Crust on the top if left sitting for more than 40 seconds
Tooltip_MGsMRE_ReadyCocoa.ch:
含有顆粒感高熱量懸浮物的巧克力飲料, 需要用力搖勻
若放置超過 40 秒, 頂部會結成一層打不穿的硬殼
Tooltip_MGsMRE_ReadyCocoa.cn:
含有颗粒感高热量悬浮物的巧克力饮料, 需要用力摇匀
如果放置超过 40 秒, 顶部会结成一层打不穿的硬壳

Tooltip_MGsMRE_ReclaimedBrew.en:
Heavy-duty crinkly Silver foil laminate pouch with an Intensely bitter roasted
Chicory root -Deeply scorched Smoky malt scraps -An unrefined earthy wood-ash undertone
And a completely sugarless Blunt finish
Tooltip_MGsMRE_ReclaimedBrew.ch:
厚實起皺的銀色鋁箔複合袋, 內含極苦的烘焙
菊苣根, 深度焦烤的煙燻麥芽碎屑, 帶有粗獷的泥土與木灰底韻
以及完全無糖的直白尾韻
Tooltip_MGsMRE_ReclaimedBrew.cn:
厚实起皱的银色铝箔复合袋, 内含极苦的烘焙
菊苣根, 深度焦烤的烟熏麦芽碎屑, 带有粗犷的泥土与木灰底韵
以及完全无糖的直白余味

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RehydratedMashFlakes.en:
Thick synthetic potato-like paste -Tastes strongly of Salt and heavy
Preservation chemicals providing a dense Carbohydrate anchor in the stomach
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RehydratedMashFlakes.ch:
濃稠的合成仿馬鈴薯泥, 嚐起來有濃重的鹽味與大量
防腐化學藥劑味, 能在胃裡提供紮實的碳水化合物飽足感
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RehydratedMashFlakes.cn:
浓稠的合成仿土豆泥, 尝起来有浓重的盐味和大量
防腐化学药剂味, 能在胃里提供扎实的碳水化合物饱腹感

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RehydratedRicePilaf.en:
Hyper-compressed grain matrix packed with high-yield Jasmine rice starches
Saturated with pure lab-grown Chicken proteins -Engineered to flash-rehydrate into a
Steaming fluffy pilaf meal within Minutes when mixed with hot or cold fluid
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RehydratedRicePilaf.ch:
超高壓縮的穀物基質, 富含高產量茉莉香米澱粉
並浸透純實驗室培育的雞肉蛋白, 專為快速復水設計, 與冷熱液體混合後
數分鐘內就能變成熱騰騰, 蓬鬆的抓飯
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RehydratedRicePilaf.cn:
超高压缩的谷物基质, 富含高产量茉莉香米淀粉
并浸透纯实验室培育的鸡肉蛋白, 专为快速复水设计, 与冷热液体混合后
数分钟内就能变成热气腾腾, 蓬松的抓饭

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RepliKit.en: Military-grade REPLI-KIT containing Micro-dispensed Synth-nutrient pellets
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RepliKit.ch: 軍規 REPLI-KIT, 內含微量分配的合成營養顆粒
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RepliKit.cn: 军用级 REPLI-KIT, 内含微量分配的合成营养颗粒

Military-grade REPLI-KIT containing micro-dispensed Synth-nutrient pellets
Built with integrated Dispensing arms and precision dosage Compartments -Including-
T-FATSYNTH lipid spheres and B-VITABLOOM micro-nutrients -Guaranteed to maintain
Vital functions in Orbital drops -Fallout shelters or deep Quarantine zones
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RepliKitOpen.ch:
軍規 REPLI-KIT, 內含微量分配的合成營養顆粒
配有一體式分配臂與精準劑量隔層, 內容包括

軌道空投, 輻射避難所或深層隔離區中維持生命機能
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RepliKitOpen.cn:
军用级 REPLI-KIT, 内含微量分配的合成营养颗粒
配有一体式分配臂与精准剂量隔层, 内容包括
T-FATSYNTH 脂质球与 B-VITABLOOM 微量营养素, 保证在
轨道空投, 辐射避难所或深层隔离区中维持生命机能

Tooltip_MGsMRE_ResinJerky.en:
Premium dense survival Ration engineered to last Forever in the harshest Environments
Cannot be ruined by Water -Mud or crushing damage -Immune to natural Spoilage and rot
Tooltip_MGsMRE_ResinJerky.ch:
高級緻密求生口糧, 專為在最嚴苛的環境中永久保存而設計
不怕水, 泥巴或擠壓損壞, 不會自然腐敗或腐爛
Tooltip_MGsMRE_ResinJerky.cn:
高级致密求生口粮, 专为在最严苛的环境中永久保存而设计
不怕水, 泥巴或挤压损坏, 不会自然变质或腐烂

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RevivalStim.en:
Spring-loaded auto-injector Filled with a fluorescent green Chemical
Stimulant meant to kickstart a Frozen heart and clear out Post-stasis muscle atrophy
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RevivalStim.ch:
彈簧式自動注射器, 裝有螢光綠色的化學
興奮劑, 用來重新啟動凍結的心臟, 並消除休眠後的肌肉萎縮
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RevivalStim.cn:
弹簧式自动注射器, 装有荧光绿色的化学
兴奋剂, 用来重新启动冻结的心脏, 并消除休眠后的肌肉萎缩

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RiceBlock.en:
Dense dry grain block -Oil-treated and Ready to Eat
Dissolve in water to make a Nutritious rice meal
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RiceBlock.ch:
緻密的乾燥穀物塊, 經油處理, 開封即食
溶於水即可做成營養的米飯餐
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RiceBlock.cn:
致密的干燥谷物块, 经油处理, 开袋即食
溶于水即可做成营养的米饭餐

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RiceBlockWrapper.en:
Clear plastic vacuum Sleeve that seals the grains
The center features a tan Printed cardboard band
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RiceBlockWrapper.ch:
透明塑膠真空套, 將穀物密封其中
中央有一圈印刷的棕褐色紙板封條
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RiceBlockWrapper.cn:
透明塑料真空套, 将谷物密封其中
中间有一圈印刷的棕褐色纸板封条

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RicePilaf.en:
Industrial vacuum sleeve that tightly Shrinks around the contours

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RicePilaf.ch:
工業用真空套, 緊緊收縮貼合
壓縮穀物的輪廓, 能無限期防潮防塵保存
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RicePilaf.cn:
工业用真空套, 紧紧收缩贴合
压缩谷物的轮廓, 能无限期防潮防尘保存

Tooltip_OffGridTransformer.en: Carries the controller's power across town. Run a cable to the controller or to another transformer. While the system has power it lights everything around it, as far as the controller reaches, and it can wire up a building.
Tooltip_OffGridTransformer.ch: 將控制器的電力輸送到鎮上各處. 從它拉一條電纜到控制器或另一台變壓器. 系統有電時, 它會為周圍所有照明與電器供電 (範圍與控制器相同), 並可為一棟建築接線.
Tooltip_OffGridTransformer.cn: 将控制器的电力输送到镇上各处. 从它拉一条电缆到控制器或另一台变压器. 系统有电时, 它会为周围所有照明和电器供电 (范围与控制器相同), 并可为一栋建筑接线.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkBarrelMixed.en: It holds something besides gasoline. Empty it first.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkBarrelMixed.ch: 裡面裝有汽油以外的東西. 請先清空.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkBarrelMixed.cn: 里面装有汽油以外的东西. 请先清空.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkBarrelTaken.en: This barrel already feeds a generator.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkBarrelTaken.ch: 此油桶已在為一台發電機供油.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkBarrelTaken.cn: 此油桶已在为一台发电机供油.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkConvert.en: Convert this generator into an Off-Grid backup generator. Once converted, you can run a cable from this generator to a controller and start managing it on the controller UI.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkConvert.ch: 將這台發電機轉換為離網備用發電機. 轉換後, 你可以從這台發電機拉一條電纜到控制器, 並開始在控制器介面上管理它.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkConvert.cn: 将这台发电机转换为离网备用发电机. 转换后, 你可以从这台发电机拉一根电缆到控制器, 并开始在控制器界面上管理它.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkFull.en: This controller already has four generators.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkFull.ch: 此控制器已連接四台發電機.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkFull.cn: 此控制器已连接四台发电机.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkHere.en: There is already a backup generator here.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkHere.ch: 這裡已經有一台備用發電機.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkHere.cn: 这里已经有一台备用发电机.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkMaster.en: Starts a generator when the batteries run low, and stops it when they are nearly full or the sun has taken over.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkMaster.ch: 電池電量低時啟動發電機, 電池快充滿或太陽能接手供電時則停止它.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkMaster.cn: 电池电量低时启动发电机, 电池快充满或太阳能接手供电时则停止它.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkModded.en: This generator model can't be converted.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkModded.ch: 此型號的發電機無法改裝.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkModded.cn: 此型号的发电机无法改装.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNeedPetrol.ch: 需要一個裝有汽油的容器.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNeedPetrol.cn: 需要一个装有汽油的容器.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNoBarrel.en: No barrel of gasoline within 5 tiles. Put one nearby and fill it with gasoline.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNoBarrel.ch: 5 格內沒有裝汽油的油桶. 在附近放一個油桶並裝滿汽油.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNoBarrel.cn: 5 格内没有装汽油的油桶. 在附近放一个油桶并装满汽油.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNoLink.en: Not connected to a controller. Run a cable from it to one.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNoLink.ch: 未連接至控制器. 從它拉一條電纜到控制器.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNoLink.cn: 未连接至控制器. 从它拉一条电缆到控制器.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkOutside.ch: 請先將發電機移到室外.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkOutside.cn: 请先将发电机移到室外.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkServerOff.en: Backup generators are switched off on this server.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkServerOff.ch: 此伺服器已停用備用發電機.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkServerOff.cn: 此服务器已停用备用发电机.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkSkill.en: Needs Electrical 3, or to have read Magazine: How to Use Generators.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkSkill.ch: 需要電工 3, 或已讀過「如何使用發電機」.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkSkill.cn: 需要电工 3, 或已读过“电子杂志4: 发电机使用指南”.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkUnplug.ch: 請先中斷發電機的連接.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkUnplug.cn: 请先断开发电机的连接.

Tooltip_OffGrid_ChooseBuildings.en: Click a building or a player-built structure to add it or take it away. Anything this part reaches can be chosen.
Tooltip_OffGrid_ChooseBuildings.ch: 點選建築或玩家建造的結構以新增或移除. 此元件範圍內的任何建築都可選擇.
Tooltip_OffGrid_ChooseBuildings.cn: 点击建筑或玩家建造的结构以添加或移除. 此部件范围内的任何建筑都可选择.

Tooltip_OffGrid_Coverage.en: Coverage on your current floor. Green: supplying power. Amber: no power. Lights and appliances in reach glow green when switched on, white when switched off. Press Esc to hide.
Tooltip_OffGrid_Coverage.ch: 目前樓層的供電範圍. 綠色: 供電中. 琥珀色: 無電力. 範圍內的照明和電器開啟時呈綠色, 關閉時呈白色. 按 Esc 隱藏.
Tooltip_OffGrid_Coverage.cn: 当前楼层的供电范围. 绿色: 供电中. 琥珀色: 无电力. 范围内的照明和电器打开时呈绿色, 关闭时呈白色. 按 Esc 隐藏.

Tooltip_OffGrid_Painted.en: Painted with the Brush Tool: not a working controller.
Tooltip_OffGrid_Painted.ch: 以筆刷工具繪製: 不是可運作的控制器.
Tooltip_OffGrid_Painted.cn: 以笔刷工具绘制: 不是可运作的控制器.

Tooltip_OffGrid_TooHeavy.en: Too heavy for what you are carrying.
Tooltip_OffGrid_TooHeavy.ch: 以你目前攜帶的東西來說太重了.
Tooltip_OffGrid_TooHeavy.cn: 以你当前携带的东西来说太重了.

Tooltip_OffGrid_UnwireBuildings.en: Stops powering the buildings this part wired. Its own reach stays.
Tooltip_OffGrid_UnwireBuildings.ch: 停止為此元件接線的建築供電. 它本身的供電範圍不變.
Tooltip_OffGrid_UnwireBuildings.cn: 停止为此部件接线的建筑供电. 它本身的供电范围不变.

Tooltip_OffGrid_WireBuilding.en: Powers every floor of the building this stands in or next to, whenever the system has power. Power can reach a few tiles past its walls. Whatever runs in there draws on the batteries.
Tooltip_OffGrid_WireBuilding.ch: 系統有電時, 為此元件所在或相鄰建築的每一層樓供電. 電力可延伸到牆外幾格. 建築內運轉的任何設備都會消耗電池電量.
Tooltip_OffGrid_WireBuilding.cn: 系统有电时, 为此部件所在或相邻建筑的每一层楼供电. 电力可延伸到墙外几格. 建筑内运行的任何设备都会消耗电池电量.

Tooltip_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.en:
"When only flesh remained,
they offered that too.
Still, the hunger endured."

Moves all blessings to unblessed
equipment in the same category.
Consumed on success.
Right-click this finger to begin.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.ch:
「當只剩血肉,
他們連血肉也獻上.
然而飢渴依舊.」

將所有祝福轉移到
同類別的無祝福裝備上.
成功時消耗.
右鍵點選此手指開始.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.cn:
“当只剩血肉,
他们连血肉也献上.
然而饥渴依旧.”

将所有祝福转移到
同类别的无祝福装备上.
成功时消耗.
右键点击此手指开始.

Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferIdentify.en: Examine this item's blessings before transferring them.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferIdentify.ch: 轉移前先檢視此物品的祝福.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferIdentify.cn: 转移前先检查此物品的祝福.

Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferMaterial.en: Requires one Saint's Withered Finger in your inventory.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferMaterial.ch: 物品欄中需要一根聖徒的枯萎手指.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferMaterial.cn: 物品栏中需要一根圣徒的枯萎手指.

Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferNoTargets.en: Carry an unblessed, unequipped item of the same category that supports every blessing on this item.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferNoTargets.ch: 攜帶一件同類別、未裝備且無祝福, 並能承載此物品所有祝福的物品.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferNoTargets.cn: 携带一件同类别、未装备且无祝福, 并能承载此物品所有祝福的物品.

Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferUnequip.en: Unequip and detach this item before transferring its blessings.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferUnequip.ch: 轉移祝福前, 請先卸下並拆下此物品.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferUnequip.cn: 转移祝福前, 请先卸下并拆下此物品.

Tooltip_CU_Anticoagulant.en: Thins the blood until a clot stops growing, and keeps it thin for about three days. Everything that was going to bleed now bleeds for longer.
Tooltip_CU_Anticoagulant.ch: 使血液變稀直到血栓停止增大, 並維持約三天. 原本就會流血的部位, 現在會流得更久.
Tooltip_CU_Anticoagulant.cn: 使血液变稀直到血栓停止增大, 并维持约三天. 原本就会流血的部位, 现在会流得更久.

Tooltip_CU_ChestNeedle.en: Fourteen gauge, long enough to reach. For a chest that is filling with air and crushing the lung inside it. Four in the pack.
Tooltip_CU_ChestNeedle.ch: 14 號針, 長度足以刺到位. 用於胸腔正在充氣、壓迫內部肺臟的情況. 一包四支.
Tooltip_CU_ChestNeedle.cn: 14 号针, 长度足以刺到位. 用于胸腔正在充气、压迫内部肺脏的情况. 一包四支.

Tooltip_CU_Crutch.en: Hold it to walk properly on one leg.
Tooltip_CU_Crutch.ch: 拿著它就能用單腿正常行走.
Tooltip_CU_Crutch.cn: 拿着它就能用单腿正常行走.

Tooltip_CU_Defibrillator.en: Pads, a capacitor and eight charges of battery. It can put a heart back into rhythm, and it can take one out of rhythm just as easily. Whoever takes the shock goes out cold either way.
Tooltip_CU_Defibrillator.ch: 電極貼片、電容器以及可電擊八次的電池. 它能讓心臟恢復正常節律, 也同樣容易讓心臟失去節律. 無論如何, 受電擊者都會昏過去.
Tooltip_CU_Defibrillator.cn: 电极片、电容器以及可电击八次的电池. 它能让心脏恢复正常节律, 也同样容易让心脏失去节律. 无论如何, 受电击者都会昏过去.

Tooltip_CU_Diuretic.en: Takes the water off a chest that is drowning from the inside. It will also take it off the rest of you, so drink.
Tooltip_CU_Diuretic.ch: 排出胸腔裡讓人從內部溺斃的積水. 它也會排掉你身體其他部位的水分, 所以要多喝水.
Tooltip_CU_Diuretic.cn: 排出胸腔里让人从内部溺毙的积水. 它也会排掉你身体其他部位的水分, 所以要多喝水.

Tooltip_CU_Fentanyl.en: Measured in specks. Nothing hurts at all for a little while. The dose band is barely there, and past it your chest locks up.
Tooltip_CU_Fentanyl.ch: 以微粒計量. 短時間內完全感覺不到任何疼痛. 安全劑量範圍極窄, 一旦超過, 你的胸口就會僵住.
Tooltip_CU_Fentanyl.cn: 以微粒计量. 短时间内完全感觉不到任何疼痛. 安全剂量范围极窄, 一旦超过, 你的胸口就会僵住.

Tooltip_CU_Heroin.en: Street cut, strength unknown. Takes the pain and the misery with it, and takes them back when it wears off. Too much and you stop breathing.
Tooltip_CU_Heroin.ch: 街頭摻雜貨, 純度不明. 能帶走疼痛與痛苦, 藥效退去時又會把它們還回來. 過量就會停止呼吸.
Tooltip_CU_Heroin.cn: 街头掺杂货, 纯度不明. 能带走疼痛与痛苦, 药效退去时又会把它们还回来. 过量就会停止呼吸.

Tooltip_CU_JournalBlood.en: Blood: losing it, running out of it, and clotting where it should not. Read it to learn the terms.
Tooltip_CU_JournalBlood.ch: 血液: 失血、血量耗竭, 以及在不該凝血的地方凝血. 閱讀以學會相關術語.
Tooltip_CU_JournalBlood.cn: 血液: 失血、血量耗竭, 以及在不该凝血的地方凝血. 阅读以学会相关术语.

Tooltip_CU_JournalChest.en: Everything that goes wrong in a chest: broken ribs, a collapsed lung, fluid, infection, what was breathed in. Read it to learn the terms.
Tooltip_CU_JournalChest.ch: 胸腔裡可能出的一切問題: 肋骨骨折、肺塌陷、積液、感染、吸入的東西. 閱讀以學會相關術語.
Tooltip_CU_JournalChest.cn: 胸腔里可能出的一切问题: 肋骨骨折、肺塌陷、积液、感染、吸入的东西. 阅读以学会相关术语.

Tooltip_CU_JournalEmergency.en: Sugar, water, kidneys and body heat: the things that kill quietly. Read it to learn the terms.
Tooltip_CU_JournalEmergency.ch: 血糖、水分、腎臟與體溫: 那些悄無聲息就能致命的東西. 閱讀以學會相關術語.
Tooltip_CU_JournalEmergency.cn: 血糖、水分、肾脏与体温: 那些悄无声息就能致命的东西. 阅读以学会相关术语.

Tooltip_CU_JournalInfection.en: Wounds that go bad, and what they go on to become. Read it to learn the terms.
Tooltip_CU_JournalInfection.ch: 惡化的傷口, 以及它們接下來會演變成什麼. 閱讀以學會相關術語.
Tooltip_CU_JournalInfection.cn: 恶化的伤口, 以及它们接下来会演变成什么. 阅读以学会相关术语.

Tooltip_CU_JournalTrauma.en: Crushed limbs, head injuries, and what the worst days leave behind in a mind. Read it to learn the terms.
Tooltip_CU_JournalTrauma.ch: 壓碎的肢體、頭部創傷, 以及最難熬的日子在心中留下的東西. 閱讀以學會相關術語.
Tooltip_CU_JournalTrauma.cn: 压碎的肢体、头部创伤, 以及最难熬的日子在心中留下的东西. 阅读以学会相关术语.

Tooltip_CU_Morphine.en: A hospital ampoule. Kills pain for a long time and has the most forgiving dose of the three. Too much is a long sleep you cannot be woken from.
Tooltip_CU_Morphine.ch: 醫院用安瓿. 止痛時間長, 是三者中劑量最寬容的. 過量就是一場叫不醒的長眠.
Tooltip_CU_Morphine.cn: 医院用安瓿. 止痛时间长, 是三者中剂量最宽容的. 过量就是一场叫不醒的长眠.

Tooltip_CU_Needed_antibiotics.en: For the infection you already have. Take it.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_antibiotics.ch: 用於你已經有的感染. 吃吧.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_antibiotics.cn: 用于你已经有的感染. 吃吧.

Tooltip_CU_Needed_anticoagulant.en: Thins the blood until the clot stops growing. Your problem list wants this.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_anticoagulant.ch: 使血液變稀直到血栓停止增大. 你的問題清單需要這個.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_anticoagulant.cn: 使血液变稀直到血栓停止增大. 你的问题列表需要这个.

Tooltip_CU_Needed_decompress.en: Lets the air out of a chest that is crushing the lung inside it. Your problem list wants this NOW.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_decompress.ch: 排出胸腔裡壓迫內部肺臟的空氣. 你的問題清單「立刻」需要這個.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_decompress.cn: 排出胸腔里压迫内部肺脏的空气. 你的问题列表“立刻”需要这个.

Tooltip_CU_Needed_diuretic.en: Takes the water off a chest that is drowning from the inside. Your problem list wants this.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_diuretic.ch: 排出胸腔裡讓人從內部溺斃的積水. 你的問題清單需要這個.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_diuretic.cn: 排出胸腔里让人从内部溺毙的积水. 你的问题列表需要这个.

Tooltip_CU_Needed_fluids.en: Runs a litre into a circulation that has nothing left in it. Your problem list wants this now.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_fluids.ch: 為已經空無一物的循環系統輸入一公升液體. 你的問題清單現在就需要這個.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_fluids.cn: 为已经空无一物的循环系统输入一升液体. 你的问题列表现在就需要这个.

Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_antibiotics.en: For a wound infection, sepsis, pneumonia or tetanus. Nothing on your problem list needs it yet.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_antibiotics.ch: 用於傷口感染、敗血症、肺炎或破傷風. 你的問題清單上目前還沒有需要它的項目.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_antibiotics.cn: 用于伤口感染、败血症、肺炎或破伤风. 你的问题列表上目前还没有需要它的项目.

Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_anticoagulant.en: For a clot in a leg, or one that has reached the lungs. Nothing needs it yet.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_anticoagulant.ch: 用於腿部血栓, 或已進入肺部的血栓. 目前還沒有需要它的情況.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_anticoagulant.cn: 用于腿部血栓, 或已进入肺部的血栓. 目前还没有需要它的情况.

Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_decompress.en: For a tension pneumothorax: a chest filling with air. Nothing on your problem list needs it yet.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_decompress.ch: 用於張力性氣胸: 胸腔正在充氣. 你的問題清單上目前還沒有需要它的項目.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_decompress.cn: 用于张力性气胸: 胸腔正在充气. 你的问题列表上目前还没有需要它的项目.

Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_diuretic.en: For pulmonary oedema: lungs filling because the heart cannot clear them. Nothing needs it yet.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_diuretic.ch: 用於肺水腫: 心臟排不掉肺裡的液體, 導致肺部積水. 目前還沒有需要用到它的情況.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_diuretic.cn: 用于肺水肿: 心脏排不掉肺里的液体, 导致肺部积水. 目前还没有需要用到它的情况.

Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_fluids.en: For haemorrhagic shock or failing kidneys - an empty circulation. Nothing on your problem list needs it yet.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_fluids.ch: 用於出血性休克或腎衰竭 - 循環血量不足. 你的病況清單上目前還沒有需要用到它的項目.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_fluids.cn: 用于出血性休克或肾衰竭 - 循环血量不足. 你的病况清单上目前还没有需要用到它的项目.

Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_airway.ch: 不需要. 你的雙手就夠了.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_airway.cn: 不需要. 你的双手就够了.

Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_debride.en: Any blade - kitchen knives, hunting knives, scalpels.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_debride.ch: 任何刀刃都行 - 菜刀、獵刀、手術刀.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_debride.cn: 任何刀刃都行 - 菜刀、猎刀、手术刀.

Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_decompress.en: A Decompression Needle. Medical clinics, hospital lockers and shelves, ambulances and army bunker medical rooms. Four uses to a pack.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_decompress.ch: 一支減壓針. 可在診所、醫院的置物櫃與架子、救護車和軍事地堡的醫務室找到. 一包可用四次.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_decompress.cn: 一支减压针. 可在诊所、医院的储物柜与架子、救护车和军事地堡的医务室找到. 一包可用四次.

Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_fasciotomy.en: Any blade - kitchen knives, hunting knives, scalpels.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_fasciotomy.ch: 任何刀刃都行 - 菜刀、獵刀、手術刀.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_fasciotomy.cn: 任何刀刃都行 - 菜刀、猎刀、手术刀.

Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_fluids.en: A Bag of Saline. Medical clinics, hospital lockers and shelves, ambulances and army bunker medical rooms.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_fluids.ch: 一袋生理食鹽水. 可在診所、醫院的置物櫃與架子、救護車和軍事地堡的醫務室找到.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_fluids.cn: 一袋生理盐水. 可在诊所、医院的储物柜与架子、救护车和军事地堡的医务室找到.

Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_strap.en: A bandage, ripped sheet or rag - medicine cabinets and first aid kits, or tear up any sheet or clothing.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_strap.ch: 繃帶、碎布或破布 - 可在藥櫃和急救箱找到, 或撕開任何床單或衣物.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_strap.cn: 绷带、碎布条或破布 - 可在药柜和急救箱找到, 或撕开任何床单或衣物.

Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_trepan.en: A saw - hardware stores, garages, toolboxes. The same one amputation uses.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_trepan.ch: 一把鋸子 - 五金行、車庫、工具箱. 跟截肢用的是同一種.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_trepan.cn: 一把锯子 - 五金店、车库、工具箱. 跟截肢用的是同一种.

Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_airway.en: Clear what somebody brought up out of their airway so they can breathe again.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_airway.ch: 清除某人吐進呼吸道的東西, 讓對方能重新呼吸.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_airway.cn: 清除某人吐进呼吸道的东西, 让对方能重新呼吸.

Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_debride.en: Cut the dead and dirty tissue out of a wound so the infection in it has nothing left to live on.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_debride.ch: 把傷口裡壞死與骯髒的組織切掉, 讓其中的感染無處可存.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_debride.cn: 把伤口里坏死与肮脏的组织切掉, 让其中的感染无处可存.

Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_decompress.en: Put a needle between the ribs to let out the air that is trapped in the chest and crushing the lung. This is the most urgent thing in the mod.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_decompress.ch: 把針插進肋骨之間, 放出困在胸腔裡、壓迫肺部的空氣. 這是本模組中最緊急的處置.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_decompress.cn: 把针插进肋骨之间, 放出困在胸腔里、压迫肺部的空气. 这是本模组中最紧急的处置.

Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_fasciotomy.en: Cut the sheath around a swollen limb open before the pressure inside it strangles the limb.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_fasciotomy.ch: 在腫脹肢體內部的壓力把它勒死之前, 切開包覆肢體的筋膜.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_fasciotomy.cn: 在肿胀肢体内部的压力把它勒死之前, 切开包裹肢体的筋膜.

Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_fluids.en: Run a litre of saline into a vein. It is not blood, but it is volume, and volume is most of a blood pressure.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_fluids.ch: 把一公升生理食鹽水輸入靜脈. 它不是血, 但它是容量, 而血壓大半就靠容量.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_fluids.cn: 把一升生理盐水输入静脉. 它不是血, 但它是容量, 而血压大半就靠容量.

Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_strap.en: Bind the chest so the broken ribs stop grinding with every breath, and the lung underneath stops taking damage.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_strap.ch: 把胸部綁緊, 讓斷掉的肋骨不再隨每次呼吸互相摩擦, 底下的肺也不再受損.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_strap.cn: 把胸部绑紧, 让断掉的肋骨不再随每次呼吸互相摩擦, 底下的肺也不再受损.

Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_trepan.en: Drill through the skull to let out a bleed that has nowhere else to go. It is the hardest thing here and there is nothing else to try.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_trepan.ch: 在頭骨上鑽孔, 放出無處可去的顱內出血. 這是這裡最困難的處置, 而且也沒有別的辦法可試了.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_trepan.cn: 在头骨上钻孔, 放出无处可去的颅内出血. 这是这里最困难的处置, 而且也没有别的办法可试了.

Tooltip_CU_ProstheticArm.en: Fits any arm amputation once the stump is cauterized.
Tooltip_CU_ProstheticArm.ch: 殘肢燒灼止血後, 可裝在任何手臂截肢處.
Tooltip_CU_ProstheticArm.cn: 残肢烧灼止血后, 可装在任何手臂截肢处.

Tooltip_CU_ProstheticLeg.en: Fits any leg amputation once the stump is cauterized.
Tooltip_CU_ProstheticLeg.ch: 殘肢燒灼止血後, 可裝在任何腿部截肢處.
Tooltip_CU_ProstheticLeg.cn: 残肢烧灼止血后, 可装在任何腿部截肢处.

Tooltip_CU_SalineBag.en: A litre of salt water and a line to put it in with. It is not blood, but it is volume, and volume is most of a blood pressure.
Tooltip_CU_SalineBag.ch: 一公升鹽水和一條輸液管. 它不是血, 但它是容量, 而血壓大半就靠容量.
Tooltip_CU_SalineBag.cn: 一升盐水和一根输液管. 它不是血, 但它是容量, 而血压大半就靠容量.

Tooltip_CU_SeveredArm.en: A whole arm. You would have to be very hungry.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredArm.ch: 一整條手臂. 你得餓到極點才會想吃.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredArm.cn: 一整条手臂. 你得饿到极点才会想吃.

Tooltip_CU_SeveredFoot.en: Somebody's foot. It would feed you.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredFoot.ch: 某人的腳. 可以拿來果腹.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredFoot.cn: 某人的脚. 可以拿来果腹.

Tooltip_CU_SeveredForearm.en: An arm from the elbow down. It would feed you for a day.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredForearm.ch: 從手肘以下的手臂. 夠你吃一天.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredForearm.cn: 从手肘以下的手臂. 够你吃一天.

Tooltip_CU_SeveredHand.en: Somebody's hand. It would feed you.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredHand.ch: 某人的手. 可以拿來果腹.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredHand.cn: 某人的手. 可以拿来果腹.

Tooltip_CU_SeveredLeg.en: A whole leg. Enough for a week, and you will think about it for longer.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredLeg.ch: 一整條腿. 夠吃一個星期, 而你會惦記它更久.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredLeg.cn: 一整条腿. 够吃一个星期, 而你会惦记它更久.

Tooltip_CU_SeveredLowerLeg.en: A leg from the knee down. There is a lot of meat on it.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredLowerLeg.ch: 從膝蓋以下的腿. 上面有很多肉.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredLowerLeg.cn: 从膝盖以下的腿. 上面有很多肉.

Tooltip_CU_Wheelchair.en: Sit in it to get about without legs, much faster than crawling, and fight from it. It cannot take stairs or climb; get out of it first.
Tooltip_CU_Wheelchair.ch: 坐上去就能在沒有腿的情況下移動, 比爬行快得多, 還能坐著戰鬥. 它無法上下樓梯或攀爬; 請先下輪椅.
Tooltip_CU_Wheelchair.cn: 坐上去就能在没有腿的情况下移动, 比爬行快得多, 还能坐着战斗. 它无法上下楼梯或攀爬; 请先下轮椅.

Tooltip_CU_WoodenProstheticArm.en: Scrap wood and duct tape. Fits any arm amputation once the stump is cauterized, but it is slow, it cannot climb, and it wears out and breaks.
Tooltip_CU_WoodenProstheticArm.ch: 廢木材加布膠帶. 殘肢燒灼止血後, 可裝在任何手臂截肢處, 但速度慢、無法攀爬, 還會磨損壞掉.
Tooltip_CU_WoodenProstheticArm.cn: 废木材加管道胶带. 残肢烧灼止血后, 可装在任何手臂截肢处, 但速度慢、无法攀爬, 还会磨损坏掉.

Tooltip_CU_WoodenProstheticLeg.en: Scrap wood and duct tape. Fits any leg amputation once the stump is cauterized, but you will limp on it and never run, it cannot climb, and it wears out and breaks.
Tooltip_CU_WoodenProstheticLeg.ch: 廢木材加布膠帶. 殘肢燒灼止血後, 可裝在任何腿部截肢處, 但使用它時只能跛行、無法奔跑, 也無法攀爬, 還會磨損壞掉.
Tooltip_CU_WoodenProstheticLeg.cn: 废木材加管道胶带. 残肢烧灼止血后, 可装在任何腿部截肢处, 但使用它时只能跛行、无法奔跑, 也无法攀爬, 还会磨损坏掉.

Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_jumper_po.en: Thermal polo-neck sweater used by Favalli. Provides insulation against the cold.
Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_jumper_po.ch: Favalli 穿的保暖高領毛衣. 能隔絕寒冷.
Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_jumper_po.cn: Favalli 穿的保暖高领毛衣. 能抵御寒冷.

Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_mascara2.en: Diving mask modified by Favalli. Protects the eyes and face.
Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_mascara2.ch: 經 Favalli 改裝的潛水面罩. 可保護眼睛與臉部.
Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_mascara2.cn: 经 Favalli 改装的潜水面罩. 可保护眼睛和面部.

Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_mascara2_.en: Favalli diving mask without an installed filter.
Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_mascara2_.ch: 未安裝濾芯的 Favalli 潛水面罩.
Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_mascara2_.cn: 未安装滤芯的 Favalli 潜水面罩.

Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_trajeeter.en: Full-body thermal pajamas used by Favalli.
Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_trajeeter.ch: Favalli 穿的全身式保暖睡衣.
Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_trajeeter.cn: Favalli 穿的全身式保暖睡衣.

Tooltip_WolfBond_Mouthwash.en: Freshens breath and supports daily oral hygiene.
Tooltip_WolfBond_Mouthwash.ch: 讓口氣清新, 有助於日常口腔衛生.
Tooltip_WolfBond_Mouthwash.cn: 让口气清新, 有助于日常口腔卫生.

Tooltip_WBNails_FingernailsAlreadyTrimme.ch: 你的手指甲已經修剪過了.
Tooltip_WBNails_FingernailsAlreadyTrimme.cn: 你的手指甲已经修剪过了.

Tooltip_WBNails_ToenailsAlreadyTrimmed.ch: 你的腳趾甲已經修剪過了.
Tooltip_WBNails_ToenailsAlreadyTrimmed.cn: 你的脚趾甲已经修剪过了.

Tooltip_WBHM_ButterflyClosures.en: Adhesive wound-closure strips for clean, moderate lacerations. They close wound edges after bleeding control and irrigation, but are not suitable for severe deep wounds or bite wounds.
Tooltip_WBHM_ButterflyClosures.ch: 用於乾淨、中度撕裂傷的黏性傷口閉合貼條. 可在止血並沖洗傷口後將傷口邊緣閉合, 但不適用於嚴重的深傷口或咬傷.
Tooltip_WBHM_ButterflyClosures.cn: 用于干净、中度撕裂伤的粘性伤口闭合贴条. 可在止血并冲洗伤口后将伤口边缘闭合, 但不适用于严重的深伤口或咬伤.

Tooltip_KBW_BuildPlacement.ch: 建造所選的已規劃構件.
Tooltip_KBW_BuildPlacement.cn: 建造所选的已规划构件.

Tooltip_KBW_ClearFilters.en: Return to all categories and clear the search, material, skill, type, version, and ready-only filters.
Tooltip_KBW_ClearFilters.ch: 返回所有分類, 並清除搜尋, 材質, 技能, 類型, 版本與僅顯示可建造的篩選條件.
Tooltip_KBW_ClearFilters.cn: 返回所有分类, 并清除搜索, 材质, 技能, 类型, 版本和仅显示可建造的筛选条件.

Tooltip_KBW_DecorativeWallFixture.en: Decorative wall fixture. Does not store items.
Tooltip_KBW_DecorativeWallFixture.ch: 裝飾性牆面擺設. 無法存放物品.
Tooltip_KBW_DecorativeWallFixture.cn: 装饰性墙面摆设. 无法存放物品.

Tooltip_KBW_ReadyFilter.en: Finds a version you can build with your carried supplies and nearby ground items. Results appear as recipes are checked. Placement is checked when you choose a location. Click again to show all recipes.
Tooltip_KBW_ReadyFilter.ch: 尋找你能用隨身物資和附近地面物品建造的版本. 結果會隨著配方檢查逐步顯示. 放置位置會在你選擇地點時檢查. 再點一次即可顯示所有配方.
Tooltip_KBW_ReadyFilter.cn: 查找你能用随身物资和附近地面物品建造的版本. 结果会随着配方检查逐步显示. 放置位置会在你选择地点时检查. 再次点击可显示所有配方.

Tooltip_KBW_WoodenPanelWindowFrame.en: A wooden panel wall with a window opening. Build a wooden or metal wall frame first.
Tooltip_KBW_WoodenPanelWindowFrame.ch: 帶有窗戶開口的木質鑲板牆. 請先建造木質或金屬牆框架.
Tooltip_KBW_WoodenPanelWindowFrame.cn: 带有窗洞的木质镶板墙. 请先建造木质或金属墙框架.

Tooltip_Recipe_TBT_NeedsCold.en: The broth must be cooked, then left to cool before it will set.
Tooltip_Recipe_TBT_NeedsCold.ch: 骨頭湯必須先煮熟, 再放涼後才會凝固.
Tooltip_Recipe_TBT_NeedsCold.cn: 骨头汤必须先煮熟, 然后放凉才会凝固.

Tooltip_item_TBT_BoilFirst.en: Needs long, slow cooking before it can be sliced.
Tooltip_item_TBT_BoilFirst.ch: 需要長時間慢火燉煮後才能切片.
Tooltip_item_TBT_BoilFirst.cn: 需要长时间文火慢炖后才能切片.

Tooltip_item_TBT_CleanFirst.en: Must be cleaned with salt and water before use.
Tooltip_item_TBT_CleanFirst.ch: 使用前必須用鹽和水清洗.
Tooltip_item_TBT_CleanFirst.cn: 使用前必须用盐和水清洗.

Tooltip_item_TBT_RenderFirst.en: Render it down into lard and cracklings.

Tooltip_item_TBT_SoakFirst.en: Soak in water before cooking, or it will taste foul.
Tooltip_item_TBT_SoakFirst.ch: 烹煮前要先泡水, 否則會有腥臊味.
Tooltip_item_TBT_SoakFirst.cn: 烹饪前需先用水浸泡, 否则会有腥臊味.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AddGasoline.en: Drain pure gasoline from carried containers, including containers inside bags.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AddGasoline.ch: 從隨身攜帶的容器中倒出純汽油, 包含包內的容器.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AddGasoline.cn: 从随身携带的容器中倒出纯汽油, 包括包内的容器.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AdministerCure.en: Completely clears the Knox infection. Ordinary wound infections are unaffected.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AdministerCure.ch: 徹底清除諾克斯感染. 一般的傷口感染不受影響.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AdministerCure.cn: 彻底清除诺克斯感染. 普通的伤口感染不受影响.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AssignDeliveryCon.en: Select any furniture container on the hideout's ground floor. If it is moved or removed, assign a delivery container again.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AssignDeliveryCon.ch: 選擇藏身點一樓的任一傢俱容器. 若該容器被移動或移除, 請重新指定交付容器.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AssignDeliveryCon.cn: 选择藏身点一楼的任一家具容器. 若该容器被移动或移除, 请重新指定交付容器.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AutoCompleteQuest.en: DEBUG: Complete this quest without consuming items or completing objectives.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AutoCompleteQuest.ch: 除錯: 不消耗物品、不完成目標, 直接完成此任務.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AutoCompleteQuest.cn: 调试: 不消耗物品、不完成目标, 直接完成此任务.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AutoCompleteUpgra.en: DEBUG: Install this upgrade without prerequisites, skills, or materials.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AutoCompleteUpgra.ch: 除錯: 無需前置條件、技能或材料, 直接安裝此升級.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_AutoCompleteUpgra.cn: 调试: 无需前置条件、技能或材料, 直接安装此升级.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_BarterHideoutOnly.en: Trades can only be completed while idle inside the hideout.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_BarterHideoutOnly.ch: 只能在藏身點內空閒時完成交易.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_BarterHideoutOnly.cn: 只能在藏身点内空闲时完成交易.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_BarterItemsMissin.en: Carry every offered item in your inventory or nested bags.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_BarterItemsMissin.ch: 請將所有要交出的物品帶在物品欄或其中的包內.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_BarterItemsMissin.cn: 请将所有要交出的物品携带在物品栏或其中的包内.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_BoardVehicle.en: Exit the vehicle before boarding the extraction helicopter.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_BoardVehicle.ch: 請先離開車輛, 再登上撤離直升機.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_BoardVehicle.cn: 请先离开车辆, 再登上撤离直升机.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_CancelVehicleExtr.en: Cancel the countdown. No fuel is spent.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_CancelVehicleExtr.ch: 取消倒數. 不會消耗燃料.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_CancelVehicleExtr.cn: 取消倒计时. 不会消耗燃料.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_CompleteBarter.en: Exchange the offered items. Trust unlocks this trade and is not consumed.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_CompleteBarter.ch: 交出所提供的物品進行交換. 信任用於解鎖此交易, 不會被消耗.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_CompleteBarter.cn: 交出所提供的物品进行交换. 信任用于解锁此交易, 不会被消耗.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_CompleteQuest.en: Consume the required items and complete this quest for your current quest group.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_CompleteQuest.ch: 消耗所需物品, 為你目前所屬的任務群組完成此任務.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_CompleteQuest.cn: 消耗所需物品, 为你当前所属的任务组完成此任务.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_Contacts.en: Review contact quests and repeatable barter trades
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_Contacts.ch: 檢視聯絡人任務與可重複的以物易物交易
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_Contacts.cn: 查看联络人任务和可重复的以物易物交易

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_DebugFillTank.en: DEBUG: Fill the generator tank without consuming carried gasoline.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_DebugFillTank.ch: 除錯: 加滿發電機油箱, 不消耗隨身汽油.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_DebugFillTank.cn: 调试: 加满发电机油箱, 不消耗随身汽油.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_DebugRemoveUpgrad.en: DEBUG: Remove this upgrade from the shared hideout. Materials are not refunded; existing deliveries, furniture, and dependent upgrades remain.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_DebugRemoveUpgrad.ch: 除錯: 從共享藏身點移除此升級. 材料不會退還; 已有的交付物、傢俱與相依的升級都會保留.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_DebugRemoveUpgrad.cn: 调试: 从共享藏身点移除此升级. 材料不会退还; 已有的交付物、家具和依赖它的升级都会保留.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_DebugTools.en: Open server-authoritative Extraction Mode test actions
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_DebugTools.ch: 開啟由伺服器主導的撤離模式測試動作
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_DebugTools.cn: 打开由服务器主导的撤离模式测试操作

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_Deploy.en: Choose the rotating raid or a special deployment. Manage readiness and opt out.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_Deploy.ch: 選擇輪換突襲或特殊部署. 管理就緒狀態與不參加.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_Deploy.cn: 选择轮换突袭或特殊部署. 管理就绪状态和不参加.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_FlareOutdoors.en: Move outdoors so the helicopter can see the flare.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_FlareOutdoors.ch: 移到室外, 讓直升機能看見訊號彈.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_FlareOutdoors.cn: 移到室外, 让直升机能看到信号弹.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_FlareRequired.en: An extraction flare gun is required.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_GarageAlreadyRetu.en: The active vehicle is already being returned.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_GarageAlreadyRetu.ch: 使用中的車輛已在收回中.
Tooltip_ExtractionMode_GarageAlreadyRetu.cn: 使用中的车辆已在收回中.

Tooltip_ExtractionMode_GarageControlsWal.en: Walk to the outlined tile and use the garage controls.
