UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page1.en: I finally got a job as a rail maintenance worker! $10.25 per hour! All I need to do is clean up some debris from the railroads and ensure they're in good condition!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page1.ch: 我終於找到工作了, 當鐵路維修工! 時薪 $10.25! 我只要清掉鐵軌上的雜物, 確保鐵軌狀況良好就行了!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page1.cn: 我终于找到工作了, 当铁路维修工! 时薪 $10.25! 我只要清掉铁轨上的杂物, 确保铁轨状况良好就行了!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page2.en: I thought I would have more time to write in this, but being a rail maintenance worker takes a lot out of you. Anyway, it's been a few months since I wrote in this, but I was cleaning the railroads as per usual, clearing any stones or branches, when I saw a dead body all torn up! The dead body was too far from the railroad, so I don't think they were hit by a train. I immediately went back to find a phone so I could call the cops and ambulance! When I got back to where I saw the body, it was gone. If it weren't for the blood trails, they probably would've thought I was on drugs or something. What a messed up day.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page2.ch: 我以為會有更多時間寫這本日記, 但當鐵路維修工真的很累人. 總之, 距離上次寫已經過了幾個月, 那天我照常在清理鐵軌, 清掉石頭和樹枝, 結果看到一具被撕得稀爛的屍體! 屍體離鐵軌太遠了, 所以我不認為是被火車撞的. 我馬上回去找電話, 好打給警察和救護車! 等我回到看見屍體的地方, 屍體卻不見了. 要不是還有血跡, 他們大概會以為我嗑藥還是怎樣. 真是糟糕透頂的一天.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page2.cn: 我以为会有更多时间写这本日记, 但当铁路维修工真的很累人. 总之, 距离上次写已经过了几个月, 那天我照常在清理铁轨, 清掉石头和树枝, 结果看到一具被撕得稀烂的尸体! 尸体离铁轨太远了, 所以我不认为是被火车撞的. 我马上回去找电话, 好打给警察和救护车! 等我回到看见尸体的地方, 尸体却不见了. 要不是还有血迹, 他们大概会以为我嗑药还是怎样. 真是糟糕透顶的一天.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page3.en: I couldn't get some sleep. It's midnight and I have to be up a 5AM. I can't stop thinking about that dead body I found. If there was a serial killer, why was I spared? Did I leave just in time before the killer got back? Was it a message just for me? There are so many questions I have that are unanswered.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page3.ch: 我睡不著. 現在是午夜, 我早上 5 點就得起床. 我沒辦法不去想那具屍體. 如果真有連續殺人犯, 為什麼我沒事? 是我剛好在兇手回來前離開了嗎? 還是那是專門留給我的訊息? 我有太多問題得不到解答.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page3.cn: 我睡不着. 现在是午夜, 我早上 5 点就得起床. 我没办法不去想那具尸体. 如果真有连环杀手, 为什么我没事? 是我刚好在凶手回来前离开了吗? 还是那是专门留给我的信息? 我有太多问题得不到解答.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page4.en: Today, I saw something even worse than I did yesterday. I was clearing debris as usual and I saw two people just crouched down from what it looked like, picking at something. I yelled at them to leave and when they got up and turned around, they're faces and neck were covered in blood! I saw another dead body torn up like the last one! They kept getting closer to me, so I just ran. I ran until I made it back. I called the cops again and just had them go down the railroad. I didn't even go with them. I just took the rest of the week off of work.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page4.ch: 今天我看到比昨天更可怕的東西. 我照常在清理雜物, 看到兩個人蹲在那裡, 看起來像是在撕扯什麼東西. 我大喊要他們離開, 結果他們站起來轉過身, 臉和脖子上全是血! 我又看到一具跟上次一樣被撕爛的屍體! 他們一直朝我靠近, 我只好拔腿就跑. 我一路跑回去. 我又打給警察, 讓他們自己沿著鐵軌過去. 我甚至沒有跟他們一起去. 這週剩下的日子我直接請假了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page4.cn: 今天我看到比昨天更可怕的东西. 我照常在清理杂物, 看到两个人蹲在那里, 看起来像是在撕扯什么东西. 我大喊让他们离开, 结果他们站起来转过身, 脸和脖子上全是血! 我又看到一具跟上次一样被撕烂的尸体! 他们一直朝我靠近, 我只好拔腿就跑. 我一路跑回去. 我又打给警察, 让他们自己沿着铁轨过去. 我甚至没有跟他们一起去. 这周剩下的日子我直接请假了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page5.en: Chaos is erupting in West Point. The military has came into town and they are taking me somewhere to get me tested. I have no idea what for.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page5.ch: 西點鎮陷入一片混亂. 軍隊進城了, 他們要把我帶去某個地方做檢測. 我完全不知道是為了什麼.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story18_Page5.cn: 西点镇陷入一片混乱. 军队进城了, 他们要把我带去某个地方做检测. 我完全不知道是为了什么.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page1.en: Hello, I bought this journal today because I've been going through depression for a while now and a therapist I went to recommended me to write down my thoughts in a journal. I work at a Spiffo's Burgers as a dishwasher. I have no friends or family to talk to. The only social interaction I get is just from my co-workers who usually just ask for something. They don't seem to care about my existence. I try talking to them about things and they don't really seem to care. I can't seem to figure out what is wrong with me.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page1.ch: 你好, 我今天買了這本日記, 因為我已經憂鬱一陣子了, 我去看的心理治療師建議我把想法寫在日記裡. 我在斯皮福餐廳當洗碗工. 我沒有朋友, 也沒有家人可以說話. 我唯一跟人互動的機會就是同事, 而他們通常只是來叫我做事. 他們似乎根本不在乎我的存在. 我試著跟他們聊些事情, 他們也不怎麼在意. 我實在想不通自己到底哪裡有問題.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page1.cn: 你好, 我今天买了这本日记, 因为我已经抑郁一段时间了, 我去看的心理医生建议我把想法写在日记里. 我在斯皮福餐厅当洗碗工. 我没有朋友, 也没有家人可以说话. 我唯一的社交互动就是同事, 而他们通常只是来叫我干活. 他们似乎根本不在乎我的存在. 我试着跟他们聊些事情, 他们也不怎么在意. 我实在想不通自己到底哪里有问题.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page10.en: [A realistic sketch of two hands holding together. One of them appears to be masculine and the other hand appears to be feminine. There is a signature on the bottom right saying ''Cassy'']
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page10.ch: [一幅寫實的素描, 畫著兩隻緊握在一起的手. 其中一隻看起來是男性的手, 另一隻看起來是女性的手. 右下角有個簽名, 寫著「Cassy」]
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page10.cn: [一幅写实的素描, 画着两只紧握在一起的手. 其中一只看起来是男性的手, 另一只看起来是女性的手. 右下角有个签名, 写着“Cassy”]

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page11.en:
[5/20/1993]
I guess Cassy found my journal and decided to draw in it. Although I do prefer a little bit of privacy, I love her enough, so it's no big deal. Anyway, I finally turned the corner of my life and I am living happily.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page11.ch:
[5/20/1993]
我猜 Cassy 發現了我的日記, 還決定在上面畫畫. 雖然我比較希望保有一點隱私, 但我夠愛她, 所以沒什麼大不了的. 總之, 我的人生終於出現了轉機, 我現在過得很快樂.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page11.cn:
[5/20/1993]
我猜 Cassy 发现了我的日记, 还决定在上面画画. 虽然我更希望保留一点隐私, 但我足够爱她, 所以没什么大不了的. 总之, 我的人生终于迎来了转机, 我现在过得很幸福.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page12.en:
[5/31/1993]
I graduated from my college and ended up getting a raise because of it! I have my own car now, I am moving in with Cassy. So much has happened and I am still processing everything. All because of jalapeños. Though, I still think I should write my thoughts down. That way if I go back, I can see the accomplishments and struggles I've faced. I know thinking about the past has made things worse for me, but I think you need to have a healthy balance between thinking of the past, thinking of your future, and living in the moment.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page12.ch:
[5/31/1993]
我大學畢業了, 還因此加薪了! 我現在有自己的車了, 也要搬去跟 Cassy 一起住. 發生了好多事, 我到現在都還在消化. 這一切都是因為墨西哥辣椒. 不過我還是覺得應該繼續把想法寫下來. 這樣以後回頭看, 就能看到我曾經的成就和掙扎. 我知道回想過去曾讓我的狀況變得更糟, 但我認為人需要在回顧過去, 展望未來, 和活在當下之間取得健康的平衡.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page12.cn:
[5/31/1993]
我大学毕业了, 还因此加薪了! 我现在有自己的车了, 也要搬去跟 Cassy 一起住. 发生了好多事, 我到现在都还在消化. 这一切都是因为墨西哥辣椒. 不过我还是觉得应该继续把想法写下来. 这样以后回头看, 就能看到我曾经的成就和挣扎. 我知道回想过去曾让我的状况变得更糟, 但我认为人需要在回顾过去, 展望未来, 和活在当下之间取得健康的平衡.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page13.en:
[6/27/1993]
Cassy and I had an argument over bills and money. She keeps spending money on expensive makeup often. I wouldn't mind it if she didn't blow $80 of makeup every two weeks. She decided to stay with her parents for now. I hope I did not fuck this up for the both of us... 

Now that I think about it, I'm no better with my spending habits on eating out. I think we both just need to cool off.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page13.ch:
[6/27/1993]
Cassy 和我為了帳單和錢吵了一架. 她老是花錢買昂貴的化妝品. 如果她不是每兩週就砸 $80 在化妝品上, 我也不會介意. 她決定暫時先回她爸媽家住. 希望我沒有把我們倆的關係搞砸了… 

現在回想起來, 我在外食上的花錢習慣也沒好到哪裡去. 我想我們倆都需要冷靜一下.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page13.cn:
[6/27/1993]
Cassy 和我为了账单和钱吵了一架. 她老是花钱买昂贵的化妆品. 如果她不是每两周就砸 $80 在化妆品上, 我也不会介意. 她决定暂时先回她爸妈家住. 希望我没有把我们俩的关系搞砸了… 

现在回想起来, 我在下馆子上的花钱习惯也没好到哪里去. 我想我们俩都需要冷静一下.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page14.en:
[7/1/1993]
Felix told me about the firework show that's happening at Louisville on 4th of July and that I should ask Cassy if she wants to come with. I don't know. She might still be mad at me...

She said yes! I honestly thought we were done!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page14.ch:
[7/1/1993]
Felix 跟我說 7 月 4 日獨立日路易斯維爾有煙火秀, 叫我問問 Cassy 要不要一起去. 我不知道耶. 她可能還在生我的氣…

她答應了! 我本來真的以為我們完了!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page14.cn:
[7/1/1993]
Felix 跟我说 7 月 4 日独立日路易斯维尔有烟花表演, 叫我问问 Cassy 要不要一起去. 我不知道. 她可能还在生我的气…

她答应了! 我本来真的以为我们完了!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page15.en:
[7/6/1993]
After the firework show, a virus broke out. Cassy and I are fine, but Felix seem to have caught the virus. According to the news, it's contained and there's nothing to worry about. There have been a lot of military patrols on the street.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page15.ch:
[7/6/1993]
煙火秀結束後, 爆發了一種病毒. Cassy 和我都沒事, 但 Felix 好像感染了. 根據新聞報導, 疫情已經受到控制, 沒什麼好擔心的. 街上出現了大量的軍隊巡邏.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page15.cn:
[7/6/1993]
烟花表演结束后, 爆发了一种病毒. Cassy 和我都没事, 但 Felix 好像感染了. 根据新闻报道, 疫情已经得到控制, 没什么好担心的. 街上出现了大量的军队巡逻.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page16.en:
[7/9/1993]
For the past few days, there were riots, protests, killings, bombings, airstrikes, and military shooting people. I've seen people being eaten alive by the infected people. I might as well call them zombies. Cassy and I have Felix tied up until a cure can be found. Or at least Cassy is hoping a cure will come out soon. From what I've seen in person and on the news, there is apparently no cure and the government is on lockdown. From the way the General was speaking, it seems like there isn't going to be a cure. I'm thinking about just killing Felix and putting him out of his misery. If he's still in there.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page16.ch:
[7/9/1993]
過去幾天, 到處都是暴動, 抗議, 殺戮, 爆炸, 空襲, 還有軍隊對人開槍. 我親眼看到有人被感染者活活吃掉. 乾脆直接叫他們殭屍算了. Cassy 和我把 Felix 綁起來, 等到有解藥為止. 或者說至少 Cassy 希望解藥很快就會出來. 從我親眼所見和新聞報導來看, 顯然根本沒有解藥, 政府也已經封鎖了. 從那位將軍說話的樣子看來, 似乎不會有解藥了. 我在考慮乾脆殺了 Felix, 讓他解脫. 如果他還有意識的話.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page16.cn:
[7/9/1993]
过去几天, 到处都是暴乱, 抗议, 杀戮, 爆炸, 空袭, 还有军队向人开枪. 我亲眼看到有人被感染者活活吃掉. 干脆直接叫他们僵尸算了. Cassy 和我把 Felix 绑了起来, 等到有解药为止. 或者说至少 Cassy 希望解药很快就会出来. 从我亲眼所见和新闻报道来看, 显然根本没有解药, 政府也已经封锁了. 从那位将军说话的样子来看, 似乎不会有解药了. 我在考虑干脆杀了 Felix, 让他解脱. 如果他还有意识的话.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page17.en:
[7/10/1993]
I killed Felix... I did not feel good about it at all... Cassy was not happy I did that. She argued that a cure would be made to save Felix. I tried to tell her that there probably wasn't going to be a cure for this. I told her we both need each other. She did not say a word and just left me. I don't know where she is now. I should've thought a little bit further before making that decision... What the hell am I even doing?!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page17.ch:
[7/10/1993]
我殺了 Felix… 我一點都不好受… Cassy 對我這麼做很不高興. 她堅持說會有解藥研發出來救 Felix. 我試著跟她說, 這種病大概不會有解藥. 我跟她說我們需要彼此. 她一句話也沒說, 就這樣離開了我. 我不知道她現在在哪裡. 做出那個決定之前, 我應該多想一下的… 我到底在幹什麼?!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page17.cn:
[7/10/1993]
我杀了 Felix… 我一点都不好受… Cassy 对我这么做很不高兴. 她坚持说会有解药研发出来救 Felix. 我试着跟她说, 这种病大概不会有解药. 我跟她说我们需要彼此. 她一句话也没说, 就这样离开了我. 我不知道她现在在哪里. 做出那个决定之前, 我应该多想一下的… 我到底在干什么?!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page18.en:
[7/11/1993]
[Shaky Handwriting] I found Cassy.... walking as one of the infect. I wish I did not see her like that. Cassy, I'm sorry. I'm the one who needs you!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page18.ch:
[7/11/1993]
[字跡顫抖] 我找到 Cassy 了… 她成了感染者的一員, 在外面遊蕩. 真希望我沒看到她變成那樣. Cassy, 對不起. 是我需要妳啊!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page18.cn:
[7/11/1993]
[字迹颤抖] 我找到 Cassy 了… 她成了感染者的一员, 在外面游荡. 真希望我没看到她变成那样. Cassy, 对不起. 是我需要你啊!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page2.en:
[2/20/1993]
I hate my job so much. I want to quit. Before closing, some customer threw a fit over something I had no control over. My manager, Tim, was not in the office. He apparently left without notifying anyone, or at least he didn't notify me. I have no idea why that customer decided to just yell at me instead of anyone else. The customer left and I thought that was the end of that. After we locked the doors, that same customer came back to me threw a cup of water on me in this freezing weather! I do not own a car and nobody asked if I wanted a ride home. I'm going to apply for another job tomorrow.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page2.ch:
[2/20/1993]
我超討厭我的工作. 我想辭職. 打烊前, 有個客人為了一件我根本無法控制的事大發脾氣. 我的經理 Tim 不在辦公室. 他顯然沒通知任何人就走了, 至少他沒通知我. 我完全不知道那個客人為什麼偏偏只對我大吼, 而不是對別人. 客人走了之後, 我以為事情就這樣結束了. 結果我們鎖門之後, 那個客人又回來找我, 在這種冷死人的天氣裡往我身上潑了一杯水! 我沒有車, 也沒人問我要不要載我回家. 我明天就要去應徵別的工作.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page2.cn:
[2/20/1993]
我超讨厌我的工作. 我想辞职. 打烊前, 有个顾客为了一件我根本控制不了的事大发脾气. 我的经理 Tim 不在办公室. 他显然没通知任何人就走了, 至少他没通知我. 我完全不知道那个顾客为什么偏偏只冲我大吼, 而不是冲别人. 顾客走了之后, 我以为事情就这样结束了. 结果我们锁门之后, 那个顾客又回来找我, 在这种冻死人的天气里往我身上泼了一杯水! 我没有车, 也没人问我要不要送我回家. 我明天就要去应聘别的工作.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page3.en:
[2/25/1993]
It's been a few days of putting up with bullshit. No place hiring near me. Repeating the same thing at my job to the point my brain is going numb. And trying to find a vehicle. At least tomorrow is Friday.

My dad gave me a call after work. We talked about a few things before the conversation devolved into him judging my choice to go to college. ''I'm surprised that you're the one who went to college instead of Chas.'' I'm sorry that I can't be like my older brother, Chas. ''You honestly should've go straight for construction work instead of computer stuff.'' Is what he told me.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page3.ch:
[2/25/1993]
這幾天一直在忍受鳥事. 我附近沒有地方在徵人. 工作上一直重複同樣的事, 重複到我的腦袋都麻木了. 還要想辦法找一台車. 至少明天就是星期五了.

下班後我爸打電話給我. 我們聊了幾件事, 接著話題就變成他在批評我選擇去念大學. 「真沒想到念大學的是你, 而不是 Chas.」很抱歉我沒辦法像我哥 Chas 那樣. 「你真的應該直接去做建築工, 而不是搞什麼電腦的東西.」這是他跟我說的話.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page3.cn:
[2/25/1993]
这几天一直在忍受破事. 我附近没有地方在招人. 工作上一直重复同样的事, 重复到我的脑子都麻木了. 还要想办法找一辆车. 至少明天就是星期五了.

下班后我爸给我打了电话. 我们聊了几件事, 接着话题就变成他在批评我选择去上大学. “真没想到上大学的是你, 而不是 Chas.”很抱歉我没法像我哥 Chas 那样. “你真应该直接去干建筑工, 而不是搞什么电脑的东西.”这是他跟我说的话.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page4.en: Everytime I talk to him, it's like he wants to remind me that Chas was the favorite child and I am just a complete failure! I shouldn't have to deal with this, but unfortunately, I do deal with it.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page4.ch: 每次跟他說話, 他都好像要提醒我 Chas 才是他最疼的孩子, 而我就是個徹頭徹尾的失敗者! 我不該承受這些的, 但很不幸, 我還是得承受.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page4.cn: 每次跟他说话, 他都好像要提醒我 Chas 才是他最疼的孩子, 而我就是个彻头彻尾的失败者! 我不该承受这些的, 但很不幸, 我还是得承受.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page5.en:
[3/12/1993]
It's snowing heavily right now. They're saying it's going to snow within the next few days. Spiffo's Burger is closed due to the snow and I'm all caught up on homework and bills for now. My paycheck is going to be complete shit, but at least I can focus on myself.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page5.ch:
[3/12/1993]
現在雪下得很大. 他們說接下來幾天都會下雪. 斯皮福餐廳因為下雪關門了, 而我的作業和帳單目前也都處理完了. 我的薪水會少得可憐, 但至少我可以專心照顧自己.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page5.cn:
[3/12/1993]
现在雪下得很大. 他们说接下来几天都会下雪. 斯皮福餐厅因为下雪关门了, 而我的作业和账单目前也都处理完了. 我的工资会少得可怜, 但至少我可以专心照顾自己.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page6.en:
[3/13/1993]
It's still snowing from yesterday! One of my neighbors knocked on my door to ask if I had some jalapeños. I had plenty, so I decided to give him a bag. He thanked me and then asked if I'd be welcomed to his little party he's throwing during the snow storm. He introduced himself as Felix. He seemed like an alright guy and I could use some social interaction, so I accepted and gave him my phone number. I'm a little anxious about it. I keep thinking
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page6.ch:
[3/13/1993]
從昨天到現在還在下雪! 我的一個鄰居來敲門, 問我有沒有墨西哥辣椒. 我有很多, 所以就給了他一袋. 他向我道謝, 接著問我願不願意參加他在暴風雪期間辦的小派對. 他自我介紹說他叫 Felix. 他看起來人還不錯, 而我也需要跟人互動一下, 所以我答應了, 還給了他我的電話號碼. 我有點焦慮. 我一直在想「我對任何人來說都不夠好.」或是「他一定會在最後一刻取消.」
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page6.cn:
[3/13/1993]
从昨天到现在还在下雪! 我的一个邻居来敲门, 问我有没有墨西哥辣椒. 我有很多, 所以就给了他一袋. 他向我道谢, 接着问我愿不愿意参加他在暴风雪期间办的小派对. 他自我介绍说他叫 Felix. 他看起来人还不错, 而我也需要一些社交互动, 所以我答应了, 还给了他我的电话号码. 我有点焦虑. 我一直在想“我对任何人来说都不够好.”或是“他肯定会在最后一刻取消.”

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page7.en: I came back from the party. I got a called around 7pm and he told me where it was. I met some of his friends and a girl, Cassy, there. I feel like I made an actual connection with a few people tonight and somehow got myself a date with Cassy. I don't know if I should be happy or if this is nothing but temporary, but I'll take whatever happiness I can get.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page7.ch: 我從派對回來了. 晚上 7 點左右我接到電話, 他告訴我派對在哪裡. 我在那裡認識了他的一些朋友, 還有一個叫 Cassy 的女孩. 我覺得今晚我真的跟幾個人建立了連結, 而且不知怎麼的還跟 Cassy 約到了會. 我不知道該不該高興, 或者這一切只是暫時的, 但我能得到多少快樂就收下多少.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page7.cn: 我从派对回来了. 晚上 7 点左右我接到电话, 他告诉我派对在哪里. 我在那里认识了他的一些朋友, 还有一个叫 Cassy 的女孩. 我觉得今晚我真的跟几个人建立了联系, 而且不知怎么的还跟 Cassy 约到了会. 我不知道该不该高兴, 或者这一切只是暂时的, 但我能得到多少快乐就收下多少.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page8.en:
[3/22/1993]
Felix, Cassy and I are still hanging out. For the first time in a long time, I feel like I made actual connections with people. Felix told me he knows someone who is working for a tech company and next thing I know, I'm working an IT job now. It honestly feels great!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page8.ch:
[3/22/1993]
Felix, Cassy 和我還是常常一起出去. 這是我很久以來第一次覺得自己真的跟人建立了連結. Felix 說他認識一個在科技公司上班的人, 結果一轉眼, 我現在就在做 IT 的工作了. 說真的, 感覺超棒的!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page8.cn:
[3/22/1993]
Felix, Cassy 和我还是经常一起出去玩. 这是我很久以来第一次觉得自己真的跟人建立了联系. Felix 说他认识一个在科技公司上班的人, 结果一转眼, 我现在就在做 IT 的工作了. 说真的, 感觉超棒的!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page9.en:
[4/19/1993]
It's been a while since I wrote in this. So, Cassy and I are together now. This job is nice enough to let me go to college while working there! I honestly couldn't be happier where I am right now!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page9.ch:
[4/19/1993]
好一陣子沒寫這本日記了. 所以, Cassy 和我現在在一起了. 這份工作很不錯, 讓我可以一邊上班一邊念大學! 說真的, 我現在的生活好到不能再好了!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story19_Page9.cn:
[4/19/1993]
好一阵子没写这本日记了. 所以, Cassy 和我现在在一起了. 这份工作很不错, 让我可以一边上班一边上大学! 说真的, 我现在的生活好到不能再好了!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page1.en: Day 1: I'm going to sound really stupid for putting this down, but at this point everybody is doing what they can to survive. If there's anyway that humanity will prevail, I want this on record. If you are reading this, I am most likely already dead. It's been a week since this happened, but I don't see this stopping any time soon. It all started when I was robbing some houses when I heard sirens. I got nervous. At first I assumed it was for me, but it wasn't. Someone in the neighborhood started attacking and eating someone. I've seen some crazy shit in my day, but that was fucked up! I just went home that night.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page1.ch: 第 1 天: 把這些寫下來聽起來會很蠢, 但現在每個人都在盡其所能地求生. 如果人類還有任何機會能撐過去, 我希望這些能留下紀錄. 如果你正在讀這個, 我很可能已經死了. 事情發生已經一個星期了, 但我看不出這會在短期內停止. 一切始於我在洗劫幾間房子時聽到了警笛聲. 我很緊張. 一開始我以為是衝著我來的, 但並不是. 社區裡有人開始攻擊並吃掉另一個人. 我這輩子看過不少瘋狂的鳥事, 但那真的太他媽噁心了! 那天晚上我就直接回家了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page1.cn: 第 1 天: 把这些写下来听起来会很蠢, 但现在每个人都在尽其所能地求生. 如果人类还有任何机会能挺过去, 我希望这些能留下记录. 如果你正在读这个, 我很可能已经死了. 事情发生已经一个星期了, 但我看不出这会在短期内停止. 一切始于我在洗劫几栋房子时听到了警笛声. 我很紧张. 一开始我以为是冲着我来的, 但并不是. 社区里有人开始攻击并吃掉另一个人. 我这辈子见过不少疯狂的破事, 但那真是他妈的太恶心了! 那天晚上我就直接回家了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page10.en: [The page has some pencil marking on it, but it's covered in blood!]
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page10.ch: [這一頁有些鉛筆字跡, 但上面沾滿了血!]
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page10.cn: [这一页有些铅笔字迹, 但上面沾满了血!]

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page2.en: Day 2: I remember seeing on the news that Louisville had a quarantine zone. I lived in West Point, and wanted to go there, but too many people were heading there. I would've never gotten there on time.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page2.ch: 第 2 天: 我記得在新聞上看到路易斯維爾設了隔離區. 我住在西點鎮, 本來想去那裡, 但太多人都在往那邊去了. 我絕對不可能及時趕到.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page2.cn: 第 2 天: 我记得在新闻上看到路易斯维尔设了隔离区. 我住在西点镇, 本来想去那里, 但太多人都在往那边去了. 我绝对不可能及时赶到.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page3.en: Day 5: I am currently at a gym right now. Running low on food. Those things are everywhere! I think it's time for me to make my move! I was able to hotwire a truck and make my way outside of West Point. I found a farmhouse and decided to stay here. It's pretty cozy here.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page3.ch: 第 5 天: 我現在在一間健身房裡. 食物快吃完了. 那些東西到處都是! 我想是時候行動了! 我成功短接發動了一輛卡車, 離開了西點鎮. 我找到一間農舍, 決定待在這裡. 這裡還挺舒適的.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page3.cn: 第 5 天: 我现在在一家健身房里. 食物快吃完了. 那些东西到处都是! 我想是时候行动了! 我成功短接启动了一辆卡车, 离开了西点镇. 我找到一座农舍, 决定待在这里. 这里还挺舒适的.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page4.en: Day 6: I realized I am going to need to head back to West Point for supplies. God, I wish I packed some things up before heading out of here. On my supply run, I saw this woman who was being attacked by those zombies. I managed to save her and brought her back the farmhouse. Her name is Lisa. She was living alone and had tons of supplies on her. I was not going to let her get eaten by those things. She later told me that if you get bitten, you turn into one of them. God help us.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page4.ch: 第 6 天: 我發現我得回西點鎮補給物資. 天啊, 真希望我離開前有先打包一些東西. 在搜刮物資的途中, 我看到一個女人正被那些殭屍攻擊. 我成功救了她, 把她帶回農舍. 她叫 Lisa. 她之前一個人住, 身上帶著大量物資. 我不會讓她被那些東西吃掉的. 她後來告訴我, 如果被咬了, 就會變成牠們的一員. 願上帝幫助我們.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page4.cn: 第 6 天: 我发现我得回西点镇补充物资. 天啊, 真希望我离开前有先打包一些东西. 在搜刮物资的途中, 我看到一个女人正被那些僵尸攻击. 我成功救了她, 把她带回农舍. 她叫 Lisa. 她之前一个人住, 身上带着大量物资. 我不会让她被那些东西吃掉的. 她后来告诉我, 如果被咬了, 就会变成它们的一员. 愿上帝帮助我们.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page5.en: Day 9: This small farmhouse isn't going to cut it for Lisa and I. It's too small and does not have a lot to offer. I went foraging north of the farmhouse and found a house that was even bigger than my current one. I'll have to bring Lisa with me.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page5.ch: 第 9 天: 這間小農舍對我和 Lisa 來說不夠用. 它太小了, 也沒什麼資源. 我到農舍北邊去搜尋, 發現一間比我現在住的還要大的房子. 我得帶 Lisa 一起過去.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page5.cn: 第 9 天: 这座小农舍对我和 Lisa 来说不够用. 它太小了, 也没什么资源. 我到农舍北边去搜寻, 发现一栋比我现在住的还要大的房子. 我得带 Lisa 一起过去.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page6.en: Day 11: Moved all my stuff to this new house. It's actually even nicer than the farmhouse. There's a lot of space for Lisa and I to move around in. Plus, Lisa was a garderner before all of this, so she can grow some food safely out here! Saw a helicopter flying around. Must be nice to not have to deal with the zombies while having a method to escape this damn place. Lucky bastard!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page6.ch: 第 11 天: 把我所有的東西都搬到這間新房子了. 這裡其實比農舍還要好. 有很多空間讓我和 Lisa 活動. 而且 Lisa 在這一切發生之前是個園丁, 所以她可以在這裡安全地種些食物! 看到一架直升機在附近飛. 不用應付殭屍, 還有辦法逃離這個鬼地方, 一定很爽吧. 幸運的混蛋!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page6.cn: 第 11 天: 把我所有的东西都搬到这栋新房子了. 这里其实比农舍还要好. 有很多空间让我和 Lisa 活动. 而且 Lisa 在这一切发生之前是个园丁, 所以她可以在这里安全地种些食物! 看到一架直升机在附近飞. 不用对付僵尸, 还有办法逃离这个鬼地方, 一定很爽吧. 走运的混蛋!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page7.en: Day 13: The truck is going bad. I have no idea what's wrong with it. I heard there's book about vehicle maintenance, I wonder if someone has it. I found a book about vehicle maintenance, plus some other really helpful books too! Jackpot!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page7.ch: 第 13 天: 卡車狀況越來越差. 我完全不知道它哪裡出了問題. 我聽說有本關於車輛保養的書, 不知道有沒有人有. 我找到一本車輛保養的書了, 還有其他一些非常有用的書! 中大獎了!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page7.cn: 第 13 天: 卡车状况越来越差. 我完全不知道它哪里出了问题. 我听说有本关于车辆保养的书, 不知道有没有人有. 我找到一本车辆保养的书了, 还有其他一些非常有用的书! 中大奖了!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page8.en: On my way back, I was feeling a bit exhausted from all the running, so I sat down and read the vehicle maintenance book. A zombie snuck up behind me and gave me a really bad cut. I wasn't bitten luckily. Day 14:I feel so awful today. Feeling like I'm about to throw up. Fever. Maybe I'll feel fine later.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page8.ch: 在回來的路上, 我跑了一整路覺得有點累, 就坐下來讀那本車輛保養的書. 一隻殭屍從我背後偷偷靠近, 給了我一道很嚴重的割傷. 幸好我沒被咬到. 第 14 天: 我今天感覺糟透了. 覺得快要吐了. 發燒. 也許等一下就會好了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page8.cn: 在回来的路上, 我跑了一路觉得有点累, 就坐下来读那本车辆保养的书. 一只僵尸从我背后偷偷靠近, 给了我一道很严重的割伤. 幸好我没被咬到. 第 14 天: 我今天感觉糟透了. 觉得快要吐了. 发烧. 也许过一会儿就会好了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page9.en: Day 15: I'm feeling worse today. Way worse. Lisa told me I'm showing symptoms of being infected by a zombie. What the fuck. I wasn't bitten. [Handwriting is very shaky] Well, I'm dying. I wonder if there's something after death. Maybe Lisa will go on and survive this thing.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page9.ch: 第 15 天: 我今天感覺更糟了. 糟多了. Lisa 說我出現了被殭屍感染的症狀. 搞什麼鬼. 我又沒被咬. [字跡非常顫抖] 好吧, 我快死了. 不知道死後會不會有什麼. 也許 Lisa 會繼續活下去, 撐過這一切.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story1_Page9.cn: 第 15 天: 我今天感觉更糟了. 糟多了. Lisa 说我出现了被僵尸感染的症状. 搞什么鬼. 我又没被咬. [字迹非常颤抖] 好吧, 我快死了. 不知道死后会不会有什么. 也许 Lisa 会继续活下去, 挺过这一切.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story20_Page1.en: This outbreak has happened and my jeans have torn up! I'm a hard working individual! You know how it goes when you work at a place where you constantly lift up heavy objects!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story20_Page1.ch: 疫情爆發了, 我的牛仔褲也破了! 我可是個認真工作的人! 你知道在一個要不停搬重物的地方工作是什麼感覺吧!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story20_Page1.cn: 疫情爆发了, 我的牛仔裤也破了! 我可是个勤劳肯干的人! 你知道在一个要不停搬重物的地方工作是什么感觉吧!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story20_Page2.en: I wore my favorite jeans today and they ripped because some dickhead left one of those zombies as a crawler! That crawler tore right through my jeans!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story20_Page2.ch: 我今天穿了我最愛的牛仔褲, 結果褲子破了, 因為有個混帳把一隻殭屍打成了爬行者就丟著不管! 那隻爬行者直接把我的牛仔褲撕破了!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story20_Page2.cn: 我今天穿了我最爱的牛仔裤, 结果裤子破了, 因为有个混蛋把一只僵尸打成了爬行者就扔着不管! 那只爬行者直接把我的牛仔裤撕破了!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story20_Page3.en: I did what I had to do.... I went to a clothing store and took as many pants I could fit in this bag! NO MORE HOLES IN MY PANTS!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story20_Page3.ch: 我做了我該做的事… 我去了一間服飾店, 把這個包包塞得下的褲子全拿了! 我的褲子再也不會有破洞了!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story20_Page3.cn: 我做了我该做的事… 我去了一家服装店, 把这个包能塞下的裤子全拿了! 我的裤子再也不会有破洞了!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story21_Page1.en:
Day 1:
I lost my home, my belongings, and my very way of life. All I have now is my shotgun and some food and water. I can survive for a long time. But there is one thing I desire the most in this apocalypse. A Plonkie. I never had a chance to stock up on Plonkies. I ate my last one two days ago before the chaos broke out. Now there is peace, but no Plonkie.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story21_Page1.ch:
第 1 天:
我失去了我的家, 我的財物, 還有我原本的生活方式. 我現在只剩下我的霰彈槍和一些食物和水. 我能撐很久. 但在這場末日中, 我最渴望的只有一樣東西. 一個 Plonkies 奶油海綿蛋糕. 我一直沒機會囤 Plonkies. 我在混亂爆發前兩天吃掉了最後一個. 現在終於平靜了, 卻沒有 Plonkies.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story21_Page1.cn:
第 1 天:
我失去了我的家, 我的财物, 还有我原本的生活方式. 我现在只剩下我的霰弹枪和一些食物和水. 我能撑很久. 但在这场末日中, 我最渴望的只有一样东西. 一个蛋黄夹心卷. 我一直没机会囤蛋黄夹心卷. 我在混乱爆发前两天吃掉了最后一个. 现在终于平静了, 却没有蛋黄夹心卷.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story21_Page2.en:
Day 2:
I checked all the gas stations in and near Rosewood. Not a single Plonkie in sight! Boy, am I pissed off.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story21_Page2.ch:
第 2 天:
我找遍了羅斯伍德裡面和附近的所有加油站. 連一個 Plonkies 都沒看到! 天啊, 我快氣炸了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story21_Page2.cn:
第 2 天:
我找遍了罗斯伍德里面和附近的所有加油站. 连一个蛋黄夹心卷都没看到! 天啊, 我快气炸了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story21_Page3.en:
Day 5:
I saved a kid from being eaten alive by a zombie. Used up a few of my shotgun shells. I asked him if he had a Plonkie. He told me no. He offered me some food, but I don't want that. I just want a Plonkie.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story21_Page3.ch:
第 5 天:
我救了一個差點被殭屍活活吃掉的小孩. 用掉了幾發霰彈. 我問他有沒有 Plonkies. 他說沒有. 他給了我一些食物, 但我不想要那些. 我只想要 Plonkies.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story21_Page3.cn:
第 5 天:
我救了一个差点被僵尸活活吃掉的小孩. 用掉了几发霰弹. 我问他有没有蛋黄夹心卷. 他说没有. 他给了我一些食物, 但我不想要那些. 我只想要蛋黄夹心卷.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story21_Page4.en:
Day 7:
I found a truck near a fairground. You will not believe what I found! A truck full of Plonkies! I can now die happy and satisfied!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story21_Page4.ch:
第 7 天: 
我在遊樂場附近找到一輛卡車. 你絕對不敢相信我發現了什麼! 一整車的 Plonkies 奶油海綿蛋糕! 我現在可以死而無憾了!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story21_Page4.cn:
第 7 天: 
我在游乐场附近找到一辆卡车. 你绝对不敢相信我发现了什么! 一整车的蛋黄夹心卷! 我现在可以死而无憾了!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story2_Page1.en: Entry 1: I found shelter at an abandoned church. My church. The stained glass is shattered, but the infected shouldn't be able to reach me. No one but just me, my radio, and the NNR. God bless this church, for it is my shelter and safety. Psalm 91:1-2: ''Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the Lord, ‘He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.’''
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story2_Page1.ch: 第 1 篇: 我在一座廢棄的教堂找到了庇護所. 我的教堂. 彩繪玻璃都碎了, 但感染者應該進不來. 這裡沒有別人, 只有我, 我的收音機, 還有 NNR 廣播電台. 願神祝福這座教堂, 因為它是我的庇護所, 是我的平安. 詩篇 91:1-2: 「住在至高者隱密處的, 必住在全能者的蔭下. 我要論到耶和華說: 『祂是我的避難所, 是我的山寨, 是我的神, 是我所倚靠的. 』」
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story2_Page1.cn: 第 1 篇: 我在一座废弃的教堂找到了庇护所. 我的教堂. 彩绘玻璃都碎了, 但感染者应该进不来. 这里没有别人, 只有我, 我的收音机, 还有 NNR 广播电台. 愿神祝福这座教堂, 因为它是我的庇护所, 是我的平安. 诗篇 91:1-2: “住在至高者隐密处的, 必住在全能者的荫下. 我要论到耶和华说: ‘他是我的避难所, 是我的山寨, 是我的神, 是我所倚靠的. ’”

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story2_Page2.en: Entry 2: I tried to sleep last night. But the rats kept me awake last night. They were getting into what little food I had left. Nothing but crumbs left in this bag of chips. I found the rat that stole my food. I killed it, went over to the nearest house to cook it. Matthew 10:29-31:''Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground outside your Father’s care. So don’t be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.''
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story2_Page2.ch: 第 2 篇: 昨晚我試著睡覺. 可是老鼠吵得我整晚睡不著. 牠們在偷吃我僅剩的一點食物. 這袋洋芋片裡只剩碎屑了. 我找到偷吃我食物的那隻老鼠. 我把牠宰了, 拿到最近的房子去煮. 馬太福音 10:29-31: 「兩隻麻雀不是賣一分銀子嗎? 然而沒有一隻會在你們父的看顧之外掉在地上. 所以, 不要懼怕, 你們比許多麻雀還貴重. 」
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story2_Page2.cn: 第 2 篇: 昨晚我试着睡觉. 可是老鼠吵得我整晚睡不着. 它们在偷吃我仅剩的一点食物. 这袋薯片里只剩碎屑了. 我找到偷吃我食物的那只老鼠. 我把它宰了, 拿到最近的房子去煮. 马太福音 10:29-31: “两只麻雀不是卖一分银子吗? 然而没有一只会在你们父的看顾之外掉在地上. 所以, 不要惧怕, 你们比许多麻雀还贵重. ”

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story2_Page3.en: Entry 3: That rat wasn't enough to keep me fed for a while. I saw two survivors walking around, scavenging. I wanted to call out, but felt it was best to remain hidden. People lose their minds when they think their life is over. One of them mentioned something about air activity being detected. They moved faster after the announcement. I was curious and tuned into the NNR. The cases of the Knox infection are seen around the world, not just in Kentucky. God, please help us all. I decided to go to the NNR radio station. If anyone's getting updated information right now, it's them.  Proverbs 3:5-6:''Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.''
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story2_Page3.ch: 第 3 篇: 那隻老鼠撐不了多久. 我看到兩個倖存者在附近走動, 四處搜刮物資. 我想喊他們, 但覺得還是躲著比較好. 人一旦覺得自己活不下去, 就會失去理智. 其中一人提到偵測到空中活動. 宣布之後他們走得更快了. 我很好奇, 就把收音機轉到 NNR 廣播電台. 諾克斯感染的病例遍布全世界, 不只在肯塔基. 神啊, 求祢幫助我們所有人. 我決定去 NNR 廣播電台. 如果現在有誰掌握最新消息, 那一定是他們. 箴言 3:5-6: 「你要專心仰賴耶和華, 不可倚靠自己的聰明. 在你一切所行的事上都要認定祂, 祂必指引你的路. 」
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story2_Page3.cn: 第 3 篇: 那只老鼠撑不了多久. 我看到两个幸存者在附近走动, 四处搜刮物资. 我想喊他们, 但觉得还是躲着比较好. 人一旦觉得自己活不下去, 就会失去理智. 其中一人提到侦测到空中活动. 宣布之后他们走得更快了. 我很好奇, 就把收音机调到 NNR 广播电台. 诺克斯感染的病例遍布全世界, 不只在肯塔基. 神啊, 求你帮助我们所有人. 我决定去 NNR 广播电台. 如果现在有谁掌握最新消息, 那一定是他们. 箴言 3:5-6: “你要专心仰赖耶和华, 不可倚靠自己的聪明. 在你一切所行的事上都要认定他, 他必指引你的路. ”

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page1.en: Day 1: I decided to write in this journal. Those things are all over Rosewood. How did this happen?
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page1.ch: 第 1 天: 我決定在這本日誌裡寫點東西. 那些東西在羅斯伍德到處都是. 怎麼會變成這樣?
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page1.cn: 第 1 天: 我决定在这本日志里写点东西. 那些东西在罗斯伍德到处都是. 怎么会变成这样?

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page10.en: GOD DAMN IT! I went back outside to put this can inside the microwave and saw one of those sons of bitches slamming against my microwave! They destroyed it before I could do anything!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page10.ch: 該死的! 我回到外面要把這個罐頭放進微波爐, 結果看到一個王八蛋在猛撞我的微波爐! 我還來不及做什麼, 它們就把微波爐砸爛了!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page10.cn: 该死的! 我回到外面要把这个罐头放进微波炉, 结果看到一个王八蛋在猛撞我的微波炉! 我还来不及做什么, 它们就把微波炉砸烂了!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page11.en: Day 20: I found another microwave. This time I'll be quick!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page11.ch: 第 20 天: 我又找到一台微波爐. 這次我會動作快一點!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page11.cn: 第 20 天: 我又找到一台微波炉. 这次我会动作快一点!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page12.en: Well shit. They destroyed that microwave and I got bit. I just realized that I could've just-
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page12.ch: 好喔, 完蛋了. 它們把那台微波爐也砸了, 我還被咬了. 我才剛想到, 其實我大可以直接-
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page12.cn: 好吧, 完蛋了. 它们把那台微波炉也砸了, 我还被咬了. 我才刚想到, 其实我大可以直接-

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page2.en: Day 2: I went out scavenging and I think there are more of those zomboids out on the street. Yep, there's definitely more than yesterday.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page2.ch: 第 2 天: 我出去搜刮物資, 我覺得街上的殭屍變多了. 沒錯, 絕對比昨天還多.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page2.cn: 第 2 天: 我出去搜刮物资, 我觉得街上的僵尸变多了. 没错, 绝对比昨天还多.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page3.en: Day 3: I found out they're attracted to noise. No matter what it is. They're just attracted to it. So I came up with a plan. I'm going to learn how to hotwire a vehicle and steal an emergency vehicle with sirens.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page3.ch: 第 3 天: 我發現它們會被噪音吸引. 不管是什麼聲音. 它們就是會被吸引過去. 所以我想到一個計畫. 我要學會怎麼短接發動車子, 然後偷一輛有警笛的緊急車輛.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page3.cn: 第 3 天: 我发现它们会被噪音吸引. 不管是什么声音. 它们就是会被吸引过去. 所以我想到一个计划. 我要学会怎么短接启动车子, 然后偷一辆有警笛的紧急车辆.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page4.en: Day 5: Hotwiring is much easier than I thought it would be. I found a pickup truck at the firestation that had sirens. I flipped them on and attracted SO MANY of them! I'm safe now. As a matter of fact, I'm hiding right now as I write this. It's night time and I think they all came out. They're all attracted to the truck! I'm a hero!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page4.ch: 第 5 天: 短接發動比我想像的簡單多了. 我在消防局找到一輛裝有警笛的皮卡車. 我把警笛打開, 引來了超多殭屍! 我現在安全了. 老實說, 我寫這段的時候正躲著. 現在是晚上, 我想它們全都出來了. 它們全被那輛卡車吸引過去! 我是英雄!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page4.cn: 第 5 天: 短接启动比我想象的简单多了. 我在消防局找到一辆装有警笛的皮卡车. 我把警笛打开, 引来了超多僵尸! 我现在安全了. 老实说, 我写这段的时候正躲着. 现在是晚上, 我想它们全都出来了. 它们全被那辆卡车吸引过去! 我是英雄!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page5.en: Day 9: The sirens have been keep me and other survivors up at night. I would turn the sirens off, but I can't get to the truck without being eaten. HOLY SHIT! I checked out the truck and there are SO MANY OF THOSE ZOMBOIDS! WAY MORE THAN 4 DAYS AGO! This is bad!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page5.ch: 第 9 天: 警笛聲吵得我和其他倖存者晚上都睡不著. 我很想把警笛關掉, 但我沒辦法在不被吃掉的情況下接近那輛卡車. 我的天啊! 我去看了一下那輛卡車, 那裡有超級多殭屍! 比 4 天前多太多了! 這下糟了!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page5.cn: 第 9 天: 警笛声吵得我和其他幸存者晚上都睡不着. 我很想把警笛关掉, 但我没办法在不被吃掉的情况下接近那辆卡车. 我的天啊! 我去看了一下那辆卡车, 那里有超级多僵尸! 比 4 天前多太多了! 这下糟了!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page6.en: Day 10: I came up with a plan! I remember seeing somewhere that if you put metal in a microwave, it'll explode and start a fire! I got plenty of cans. All I need is a microwave. Plenty of people have those, right?
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page6.ch: 第 10 天: 我想到一個計畫! 我記得在哪裡看過, 把金屬放進微波爐會爆炸起火! 我有一大堆罐頭. 我只需要一台微波爐. 很多人家裡都有, 對吧?
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page6.cn: 第 10 天: 我想到一个计划! 我记得在哪里看过, 把金属放进微波炉会爆炸起火! 我有一大堆罐头. 我只需要一台微波炉. 很多人家里都有, 对吧?

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page7.en: Day 14: I can not find a microwave! I even checked Spiffo's Burgers! Even THEY do NOT have a microwave! It's a burger joint! Why do they not have a microwave?!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page7.ch: 第 14 天: 我找不到微波爐! 我連斯皮福餐廳都找過了! 連他們都沒有微波爐! 那可是漢堡店耶! 為什麼他們沒有微波爐?!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page7.cn: 第 14 天: 我找不到微波炉! 我连斯皮福餐厅都找过了! 连他们都没有微波炉! 那可是汉堡店啊! 为什么他们没有微波炉?!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page8.en: Day 17: I finally found a microwave! Had to drive to Muldraugh and even there I had a hard time finding a microwave! I'm sleepy. I'm going to put this plan into action tomorrow.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page8.ch: 第 17 天: 我終於找到微波爐了! 我得開車到馬爾德勞, 就算在那裡也很難找到微波爐! 我好睏. 我明天就要執行這個計畫.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page8.cn: 第 17 天: 我终于找到微波炉了! 我得开车到马尔德劳, 就算在那里也很难找到微波炉! 我好困. 我明天就要执行这个计划.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page9.en: Day 18: I'm looking at the hotel where I left that pickup truck. It's still going off and attracting those zomboids! And there's a LOT more of them! Time to put this plan into action! God damn it! After I had everything set up, a few of those zomboids spotted me! I had to run and hide! I think they're still looking for me! It's night time right now. I think they gave up on me.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page9.ch: 第 18 天: 我正看著我停那輛皮卡車的那間飯店. 警笛還在響, 還在吸引那些殭屍! 而且它們變得更多了! 是時候執行計畫了! 該死的! 我把一切都準備好之後, 有幾隻殭屍發現了我! 我只好逃跑躲起來! 我想它們還在找我! 現在是晚上. 我想它們已經放棄找我了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story3_Page9.cn: 第 18 天: 我正看着我停那辆皮卡车的那间酒店. 警笛还在响, 还在吸引那些僵尸! 而且它们变得更多了! 是时候执行计划了! 该死的! 我把一切都准备好之后, 有几只僵尸发现了我! 我只好逃跑躲起来! 我想它们还在找我! 现在是晚上. 我想它们已经放弃找我了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story4_Page1.en: Day 1: Finally! There's an apocalypse! I can use my ammo I kept for years now! My name will go down in history as ''The [The word ''man'' has been crossed out] Hero Who Lived''! Nothing will stop me now!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story4_Page1.ch: 第 1 天: 終於! 末日來了! 我終於可以用上我存了好幾年的彈藥了! 我的名字將以「活下來的 [「男人」這個詞被劃掉了] 英雄」名留青史! 現在什麼都擋不住我!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story4_Page1.cn: 第 1 天: 终于! 末日来了! 我终于可以用上我存了好几年的弹药了! 我的名字将以“活下来的 [“男人”这个词被划掉了] 英雄”名留青史! 现在什么都挡不住我!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story4_Page2.en: Day 2: I did not have as much ammo as I thought I would to take on the whole state of Kentucky. Shit.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story4_Page2.ch: 第 2 天: 要對付整個肯塔基州, 我的彈藥沒有我想的那麼多. 可惡.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story4_Page2.cn: 第 2 天: 要对付整个肯塔基州, 我的弹药没有我想的那么多. 可恶.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story5_Crazy.en: I WILL NOT BE ONE OF THEM! I WILL NOT BE ONE OF THEM! I WILL NOT BE ONE OF THEM! I WILL NOT BE ONE OF THEM! I WILL NOT BE ONE OF THEM!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story5_Crazy.ch: 我絕不會變成它們的一份子! 我絕不會變成它們的一份子! 我絕不會變成它們的一份子! 我絕不會變成它們的一份子! 我絕不會變成它們的一份子!
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story5_Crazy.cn: 我绝不会变成它们的一员! 我绝不会变成它们的一员! 我绝不会变成它们的一员! 我绝不会变成它们的一员! 我绝不会变成它们的一员!

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page1.en: I know what caused all of this. I know how to fix it. But to make you understand, I have to start with where it began for me. Back at Joe’s Diner, where the coffee was brewed from rainwater collected in rusted barrels. That’s where I first noticed something was… off.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page1.ch: 我知道這一切是怎麼造成的. 我知道該怎麼解決. 但為了讓你明白, 我得從這一切在我身上開始的地方說起. 那時在喬的餐館, 咖啡是用生鏽桶子收集的雨水煮的. 就是在那裡, 我第一次注意到有什麼…不對勁.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page1.cn: 我知道这一切是怎么造成的. 我知道该怎么解决. 但为了让你明白, 我得从这一切在我身上开始的地方说起. 那时在乔的餐馆, 咖啡是用生锈桶子收集的雨水煮的. 就是在那里, 我第一次注意到有什么…不对劲.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page10.en: I buried a box years ago, behind the shed. I can’t remember what’s inside, but I’m afraid to dig it up now.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page10.ch: 好幾年前, 我在棚屋後面埋了一個箱子. 我想不起來裡面裝了什麼, 但現在我不敢把它挖出來.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page10.cn: 好几年前, 我在棚屋后面埋了一个箱子. 我想不起来里面装了什么, 但现在我不敢把它挖出来.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page11.en: Found a map in an old coat pocket. It had circles drawn around places I’ve never been. One of them was already crossed out.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page11.ch: 在一件舊外套的口袋裡找到一張地圖. 上面圈出了一些我從沒去過的地方. 其中一個已經被劃掉了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page11.cn: 在一件旧外套的口袋里找到一张地图. 上面圈出了一些我从没去过的地方. 其中一个已经被划掉了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page12.en: There was a night I woke up to the sound of humming. The melody was familiar. When I looked outside, there was no one there.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page12.ch: 有一晚我被哼歌聲吵醒. 那旋律很耳熟. 我往外看時, 外面一個人也沒有.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page12.cn: 有一晚我被哼歌声吵醒. 那旋律很耳熟. 我往外看时, 外面一个人也没有.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page13.en: I knew a man who claimed he could hear the dead. He said they never stopped talking, just got quieter.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page13.ch: 我認識一個人, 他說他能聽到死者的聲音. 他說他們從來沒停止說話, 只是越來越小聲.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page13.cn: 我认识一个人, 他说他能听到死者的声音. 他说他们从来没停止说话, 只是越来越小声.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page14.en: Saw a cat sitting in the middle of the road. It didn’t move when I approached, just stared with those bright green eyes. When I looked away for a second, it was gone.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page14.ch: 看到一隻貓坐在馬路中央. 我走近時牠一動也不動, 只是用那雙亮綠色的眼睛盯著我. 我才移開視線一秒, 牠就不見了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page14.cn: 看到一只猫坐在马路中央. 我走近时它一动也不动, 只是用那双亮绿色的眼睛盯着我. 我才移开视线一秒, 它就不见了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page15.en: Once, I dreamt of standing in the middle of a field of black flowers. When I woke up, my boots were covered in mud.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page15.ch: 有一次, 我夢見自己站在一片黑色花海中央. 醒來時, 我的靴子沾滿了泥巴.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page15.cn: 有一次, 我梦见自己站在一片黑色花海中央. 醒来时, 我的靴子沾满了泥巴.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page16.en: I met a woman who had no reflection in mirrors. She laughed when I noticed.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page16.ch: 我遇過一個在鏡子裡沒有倒影的女人. 我發現時, 她笑了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page16.cn: 我遇过一个在镜子里没有倒影的女人. 我发现时, 她笑了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page17.en: The radio played static for hours, then suddenly said, 'It’s almost over.' Then silence again.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page17.ch: 收音機播了好幾個小時的雜訊, 然後突然說: 「快結束了. 」接著又是一片寂靜.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page17.cn: 收音机播了好几个小时的杂音, 然后突然说: “快结束了. ”接着又是一片寂静.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page18.en: I used to think the rain was just water. Now I know better. It smells different now—sweet, almost.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page18.ch: 我以前以為雨就只是水. 現在我知道不是了. 現在雨聞起來不一樣了——幾乎是甜的.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page18.cn: 我以前以为雨就只是水. 现在我知道不是了. 现在雨闻起来不一样了——几乎是甜的.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page19.en: Found a notebook in an alley. Every page was blank except the last, which said, 'Don’t look at the sky.'
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page19.ch: 在一條巷子裡找到一本筆記本. 每一頁都是空白的, 只有最後一頁寫著: 「不要看天空. 」
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page19.cn: 在一条巷子里找到一本笔记本. 每一页都是空白的, 只有最后一页写着: “不要看天空. ”

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page2.en: I was fixing my fence when the neighbor’s kid told me about the birds. How they didn’t fly away anymore, even when you got close. I thought it was just strange animal behavior. Now I know it was more than that.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page2.ch: 我在修籬笆的時候, 鄰居的小孩跟我說了那些鳥的事. 說牠們再也不會飛走了, 就算你靠得很近也一樣. 我以為那只是動物的怪異行為. 現在我知道沒那麼簡單.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page2.cn: 我在修篱笆的时候, 邻居的小孩跟我说了那些鸟的事. 说它们再也不会飞走了, 就算你靠得很近也一样. 我以为那只是动物的怪异行为. 现在我知道没那么简单.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page20.en: The river ran red once, just for a few minutes. No one else saw it.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page20.ch: 河水曾經變紅過一次, 只維持了幾分鐘. 沒有其他人看到.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page20.cn: 河水曾经变红过一次, 只持续了几分钟. 没有其他人看到.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page21.en: The moon looked wrong last night. Too close. Too big.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page21.ch: 昨晚的月亮看起來不對勁. 太近了. 太大了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page21.cn: 昨晚的月亮看起来不对劲. 太近了. 太大了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page22.en: I saw a deer standing on two legs in the tree line. It watched me until I left.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page22.ch: 我看到一頭鹿用兩條腿站在樹林邊. 牠一直盯著我, 直到我離開.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page22.cn: 我看到一头鹿用两条腿站在树林边. 它一直盯着我, 直到我离开.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page23.en: I heard my own voice calling me from the woods. I didn’t answer.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page23.ch: 我聽到自己的聲音從樹林裡呼喚我. 我沒有回應.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page23.cn: 我听到自己的声音从树林里呼唤我. 我没有回应.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page24.en: An old man told me everything was connected. Then he laughed until he cried.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page24.ch: 一個老人告訴我, 一切都是有關聯的. 然後他笑到哭了出來.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page24.cn: 一个老人告诉我, 一切都是有关联的. 然后他笑到哭了出来.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page25.en: I found an old photograph of my family, but I wasn’t in it. I remember being there when it was taken.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page25.ch: 我找到一張家人的舊照片, 但我不在裡面. 我記得拍照時我明明在場.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page25.cn: 我找到一张家人的旧照片, 但我不在里面. 我记得拍照时我明明在场.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page26.en: There’s a hum in the air sometimes, so low you can’t tell if it’s real or in your head.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page26.ch: 空氣中有時會有一種嗡嗡聲, 低到你分不清它是真的, 還是只在你腦子裡.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page26.cn: 空气中有时会有一种嗡嗡声, 低到你分不清它是真的, 还是只在你脑子里.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page27.en: A shadow passed over me today, but there was nothing in the sky.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page27.ch: 今天有道影子從我頭上掠過, 但天上什麼也沒有.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page27.cn: 今天有道影子从我头上掠过, 但天上什么也没有.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page28.en: The ground feels softer lately. Like it’s breathing.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page28.ch: 最近地面感覺變軟了. 好像在呼吸一樣.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page28.cn: 最近地面感觉变软了. 好像在呼吸一样.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page29.en: I think I’ve delayed enough. You deserve to know the truth. The cause of all this… the cure… it’s in the next page in full detail.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page29.ch: 我想我拖得夠久了. 你有權知道真相. 這一切的原因…解藥…都詳細寫在下一頁.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page29.cn: 我想我拖得够久了. 你有权知道真相. 这一切的原因…解药…都详细写在下一页.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page3.en: Spent three nights in the woods once when my truck broke down. Rained all night, every night. Woke up to a fox staring at me in silence. Didn’t blink. Didn’t move. Just watched.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page3.ch: 有一次我的卡車拋錨, 我在樹林裡待了三個晚上. 每晚都下了一整夜的雨. 醒來時有隻狐狸默默盯著我. 牠不眨眼. 不動. 就只是看著.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page3.cn: 有一次我的卡车抛锚, 我在树林里待了三个晚上. 每晚都下了一整夜的雨. 醒来时有只狐狸默默盯着我. 它不眨眼. 不动. 就只是看着.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page30.en: [The page is torn, and the rest is unreadable. There are dark stains along the edge of the paper.]
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page30.ch: [這一頁被撕破了, 剩下的部分無法辨讀. 紙張邊緣有深色的汙漬. ]
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page30.cn: [这一页被撕破了, 剩下的部分无法辨读. 纸张边缘有深色的污渍. ]

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page4.en: Old Mrs. Callahan swore the tomatoes in her garden were growing faster than usual. She joked it was because she sang to them every morning. The vines were black at the roots.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page4.ch: 老卡拉漢太太發誓她菜園裡的番茄長得比平常快. 她開玩笑說是因為她每天早上都對它們唱歌. 那些藤蔓的根部是黑色的.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page4.cn: 老卡拉汉太太发誓她菜园里的番茄长得比平常快. 她开玩笑说是因为她每天早上都对它们唱歌. 那些藤蔓的根部是黑色的.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page5.en: There’s an abandoned gas station on Route 9. Pumps still work. No one knows why. The air there tastes like metal.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page5.ch: 9 號公路上有一間廢棄的加油站. 油泵還能用. 沒人知道為什麼. 那裡的空氣嚐起來有金屬味.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page5.cn: 9 号公路上有一间废弃的加油站. 油泵还能用. 没人知道为什么. 那里的空气尝起来有金属味.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page6.en: Saw a man fishing in the river, but the hook was bare. He stared into the water for hours. Never caught a thing. I passed him on my way back, and he was still there.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page6.ch: 看到一個男人在河邊釣魚, 但魚鉤上什麼也沒掛. 他盯著水面好幾個小時. 什麼也沒釣到. 我回程經過他身邊時, 他還在那裡.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page6.cn: 看到一个男人在河边钓鱼, 但鱼钩上什么也没挂. 他盯着水面好几个小时. 什么也没钓到. 我回程经过他身边时, 他还在那里.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page7.en: I used to walk across the old bridge outside town. Kids carved their names into the railing. Found mine there last week. I’ve never carved anything in my life.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page7.ch: 我以前常走過鎮外那座舊橋. 小孩們會把名字刻在欄杆上. 上週我在那裡發現了我的名字. 我這輩子從來沒刻過任何東西.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page7.cn: 我以前常走过镇外那座旧桥. 小孩们会把名字刻在栏杆上. 上周我在那里发现了我的名字. 我这辈子从来没刻过任何东西.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page8.en: The wind in this place sometimes sounds like whispers. I tried to listen once. I think it said my name.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page8.ch: 這地方的風聲有時聽起來像低語. 有一次我試著仔細聽. 我想它說了我的名字.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page8.cn: 这地方的风声有时听起来像低语. 有一次我试着仔细听. 我想它说了我的名字.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page9.en: Back when the power first went out, I lit candles around the house. One of them burned cold,no heat at all. Still melted the wax, though.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page9.ch: 剛停電的時候, 我在屋子裡點了蠟燭. 其中一根燒起來是冷的, 一點熱度都沒有. 但蠟還是融化了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story6_Page9.cn: 刚停电的时候, 我在屋子里点了蜡烛. 其中一根烧起来是冷的, 一点热度都没有. 但蜡还是融化了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page1.en: Day 1: I'm finally somewhere safe. I haven't slept or eaten anything since the military started shooting people in Louisville. I'm lucky that I found some food and water. Found this journal and wanted to write down my thoughts. What the hell did the military go from accepting refugees to just shooting anyone. Including reporters. How the fuck am I still alive?
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page1.ch: 第 1 天: 我終於到了安全的地方. 自從軍隊在路易斯維爾開始對人開槍以來, 我就沒睡過覺也沒吃過東西. 我很幸運找到了一些食物和水. 找到這本日誌, 想把我的想法寫下來. 軍隊到底怎麼會從收容難民變成見人就開槍. 連記者都不放過. 我他媽怎麼還活著?
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page1.cn: 第 1 天: 我终于到了安全的地方. 自从军队在路易斯维尔开始对人开枪以来, 我就没睡过觉也没吃过东西. 我很幸运找到了一些食物和水. 找到这本日志, 想把我的想法写下来. 军队到底怎么会从收容难民变成见人就开枪. 连记者都不放过. 我他妈怎么还活着?

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page2.en: Day 2: Finally got some sleep in. I'm surprised something hasn't killed me in my sleep. It's oddly quiet out here. At least I can go hunting and fishing in peace. Despite the circumstance, it's quite lovely.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page2.ch: 第 2 天: 終於睡了一覺. 我很意外睡著的時候沒被什麼東西殺掉. 這裡安靜得出奇. 至少我可以安心打獵和釣魚. 撇開現在的處境不談, 這裡其實挺美的.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page2.cn: 第 2 天: 终于睡了一觉. 我很意外睡着的时候没被什么东西杀掉. 这里安静得出奇. 至少我可以安心打猎和钓鱼. 撇开现在的处境不谈, 这里其实挺美的.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page3.en: Day 3: I decided I needed to head back towards Louisville. On my way back, there was this guy shouting, attracting the infected. He walked around the dead for about 20 minutes before calmly walking into the woods. You can literally walk faster than the infected. How the hell did this outbreak even occur if all you have to do is simply walk?
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page3.ch: 第 3 天: 我決定得往路易斯維爾回去. 回程路上有個傢伙在大吼大叫, 把感染者都引了過來. 他在死人堆周圍繞了大概 20 分鐘, 然後從容地走進樹林. 你用走的根本就比感染者快. 如果只要用走的就能逃掉, 這場疫情到底是怎麼爆發的?
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page3.cn: 第 3 天: 我决定得往路易斯维尔回去. 回程路上有个家伙在大吼大叫, 把感染者都引了过来. 他在死人堆周围绕了大概 20 分钟, 然后从容地走进树林. 你用走的根本就比感染者快. 如果只要用走的就能逃掉, 这场疫情到底是怎么爆发的?

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page4.en: Day 4: I managed to steal a military radio. I couldn't find the proper channels to keep tabs on the military to see what they're up to.   I spent the rest of the day watching the news at a random house. A man who went by General McGrew made a statement. Apparently, I'm one of the lucky few who are immune to the airborne variant of the virus outbreak. Didn't even think about it being airborne. Makes a lot more sense on this spread so quickly.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page4.ch: 第 4 天: 我成功偷到一台軍用無線電. 我找不到正確的頻道來監聽軍方的動向. 當天剩下的時間, 我都在一間隨便找的房子裡看新聞. 一位叫麥格魯將軍的人發表了聲明. 看來我是少數對這次病毒爆發的空氣傳播變種免疫的幸運兒之一. 我壓根沒想過它會經由空氣傳播. 這樣它擴散得這麼快就說得通了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page4.cn: 第 4 天: 我成功偷到一台军用无线电. 我找不到正确的频道来监听军方的动向. 当天剩下的时间, 我都在一间随便找的房子里看新闻. 一位叫麦格鲁将军的人发表了声明. 看来我是少数对这次病毒爆发的空气传播变种免疫的幸运儿之一. 我压根没想过它会经由空气传播. 这样它扩散得这么快就说得通了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page5.en: If there are billions of people dead from this virus right now, then that's a lot of infected I'll have to deal with.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page5.ch: 如果現在已經有幾十億人死於這種病毒, 那我要對付的感染者可多了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page5.cn: 如果现在已经有几十亿人死于这种病毒, 那我要对付的感染者可多了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page6.en: Day 5: I spotted 2 survivors walking past a Spiffo's Burgers. They argued about going in there for a while. One of them mentioned that the Spiffo's Burgers was the source of the outbreak? I was gathering some newspapers and coincidentally, there's a news article mentioning about Spiffo's new ''secret sauce''. I wonder if that's what those people were talking about.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page6.ch: 第 5 天: 我看到 2 個倖存者經過一家斯皮福漢堡. 他們為了要不要進去爭論了好一陣子. 其中一人提到斯皮福漢堡是疫情的源頭? 我正在收集一些報紙, 巧的是, 有一篇新聞報導提到斯皮福的新「秘密醬料」. 不知道那些人說的是不是這個.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page6.cn: 第 5 天: 我看到 2 个幸存者经过一家斯皮福汉堡. 他们为了要不要进去争论了好一阵子. 其中一人提到斯皮福汉堡是疫情的源头? 我正在收集一些报纸, 巧的是, 有一篇新闻报道提到斯皮福的新“秘密酱料”. 不知道那些人说的是不是这个.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page7.en: Day 6: Fuck. I was looting a house and in one of the rooms there was a dead woman who took her own life. Next to her was a crib and I saw a small body in there. I didn't dare to look further in it. The look and smell of the whole room was enough for me to just leave the house. I'm trying to forget what I saw, but I just can't.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page7.ch: 第 6 天: 幹. 我在一間房子裡搜刮, 其中一個房間裡有個自殺身亡的女人. 她旁邊有張嬰兒床, 我看到裡面有一具小小的屍體. 我不敢再往裡面看. 整個房間的景象和氣味就足以讓我直接離開那間房子. 我試著忘掉我看到的東西, 但我就是忘不了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page7.cn: 第 6 天: 操. 我在一间房子里搜刮, 其中一个房间里有个自杀身亡的女人. 她旁边有张婴儿床, 我看到里面有一具小小的尸体. 我不敢再往里面看. 整个房间的景象和气味就足以让我直接离开那间房子. 我试着忘掉我看到的东西, 但我就是忘不了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page8.en: Some assholes robbed me. They got a hold of this journal and ripped a lot of pages out and took them. I guess I'm done writing in this. There's pretty much no point. I've lost everything else I had. I'm leaving this behind. If someone else happens to be reading this. I hope the world will go back to the way it was. I doubt it will though.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page8.ch: 有幾個混蛋搶了我. 他們拿到這本日誌, 撕走了好多頁. 我想我不會再寫了. 幾乎沒什麼意義了. 我其他所有東西都沒了. 我要把這本留在這裡. 如果剛好有人在讀這本日誌. 我希望這個世界能恢復原樣. 雖然我很懷疑.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Page8.cn: 有几个混蛋抢了我. 他们拿到这本日志, 撕走了好多页. 我想我不会再写了. 几乎没什么意义了. 我其他所有东西都没了. 我要把这本留在这里. 如果刚好有人在读这本日志. 我希望这个世界能恢复原样. 虽然我很怀疑.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Torn1.en: Day [You see this page torn out.]
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Torn1.ch: 第 [你看到這一頁被撕掉了. ] 天
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story7_Torn1.cn: 第 [你看到这一页被撕掉了. ] 天

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story8.en: To whoever is reading this. I got bit and decided to just be one of the zombies. Please leave me like this and don't kill me. It is my last request.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story8.ch: 致正在讀這段文字的人. 我被咬了, 決定就這樣變成殭屍. 請讓我保持這樣, 不要殺我. 這是我最後的請求.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story8.cn: 致正在读这段文字的人. 我被咬了, 决定就这样变成僵尸. 请让我保持这样, 不要杀我. 这是我最后的请求.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page1.en: 4-25-93: Dear Diary, today was kinda boring. School was normal, Jenny wouldn’t stop talking about the spring dance, and I’m just not in the mood. Mom made pancakes though,they were perfect. I almost forgave her for making me do chores yesterday.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page1.ch: 4-25-93: 親愛的日記, 今天有點無聊. 學校一如往常, 珍妮一直講春季舞會講個不停, 我實在沒那個心情. 不過媽媽做了鬆餅, 做得超完美. 我差點就原諒她昨天逼我做家事了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page1.cn: 4-25-93: 亲爱的日记, 今天有点无聊. 学校一如往常, 珍妮一直讲春季舞会讲个不停, 我实在没那个心情. 不过妈妈做了松饼, 做得超完美. 我差点就原谅她昨天逼我做家务了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page10.en: 6-30-93: Dad says we might have to leave town. I don’t want to. My room, my clothes, my stupid stuffed cat… I don’t want to leave. Mom keeps making lists of things to pack. I’m scared.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page10.ch: 6-30-93: 爸說我們可能得離開鎮上. 我不想走. 我的房間, 我的衣服, 我那隻蠢蠢的貓咪玩偶… 我不想離開. 媽一直在列要打包的東西清單. 我好害怕.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page10.cn: 6-30-93: 爸说我们可能得离开镇上. 我不想走. 我的房间, 我的衣服, 我那只傻乎乎的猫咪玩偶… 我不想离开. 妈一直在列要打包的东西清单. 我好害怕.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page11.en: 7-01-93: Something feels off today. The air is heavy. I saw people on the street arguing over… I don’t even know. The news keeps flashing numbers and red alerts. Dad says not to worry, but his hands are shaking.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page11.ch: 7-01-93: 今天感覺怪怪的. 空氣很沉重. 我看到街上有人在吵架, 吵的是… 我也不知道. 新聞一直閃著數字和紅色警報. 爸說不用擔心, 可是他的手在發抖.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page11.cn: 7-01-93: 今天感觉怪怪的. 空气很沉重. 我看到街上有人在吵架, 吵的是… 我也不知道. 新闻一直闪着数字和红色警报. 爸说不用担心, 可是他的手在发抖.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page12.en: 7-02-93: Jenny called today! She sounded… weird. Quiet, like she was scared. She told me to stay home and lock the doors. I laughed, but my stomach hurt after. Maybe she’s right.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page12.ch: 7-02-93: 珍妮今天打電話來了! 她聽起來… 怪怪的. 很安靜, 好像在害怕. 她叫我待在家裡, 把門鎖好. 我笑了出來, 可是之後肚子好痛. 也許她是對的.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page12.cn: 7-02-93: 珍妮今天打电话来了! 她听起来… 怪怪的. 很安静, 好像在害怕. 她叫我待在家里, 把门锁好. 我笑了出来, 可是之后肚子好痛. 也许她是对的.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page13.en: 7-03-93: Mom wouldn’t go to the grocery store today. She said the shelves were empty and people were shouting at each other. Dad looked pale when he got back from work. Everyone is tense. Even the neighbors are whispering behind curtains.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page13.ch: 7-03-93: 媽今天不肯去雜貨店. 她說貨架都空了, 大家還互相大吼大叫. 爸下班回來時臉色好蒼白. 每個人都很緊繃. 連鄰居都躲在窗簾後面竊竊私語.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page13.cn: 7-03-93: 妈今天不肯去杂货店. 她说货架都空了, 大家还互相大吼大叫. 爸下班回来时脸色好苍白. 每个人都很紧绷. 连邻居都躲在窗帘后面窃窃私语.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page14.en: 7-04-93: Fireworks were canceled. Knox is bad. Sirens all night. I heard screams from somewhere in town. Mom hugged me tight, but Dad looked out the window for hours, silent. I’m trying not to think about it.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page14.ch: 7-04-93: 煙火取消了. 諾克斯那邊情況很糟. 警笛響了一整晚. 我聽到鎮上某處傳來尖叫聲. 媽緊緊抱著我, 但爸好幾個小時都望著窗外, 一句話也不說. 我試著不去想它.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page14.cn: 7-04-93: 烟花取消了. 诺克斯那边情况很糟. 警笛响了一整晚. 我听到镇上某处传来尖叫声. 妈紧紧抱着我, 但爸好几个小时都望着窗外, 一句话也不说. 我试着不去想它.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page15.en: 7-05-93: I saw someone running down the street today. No car chasing them, just… running. They looked wild. Eyes wide. I got chills just watching from our porch. Dad shut all the blinds immediately.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page15.ch: 7-05-93: 今天我看到有人沿著街道狂奔. 後面沒有車在追, 就只是… 在跑. 他看起來很瘋狂. 眼睛瞪得好大. 我光是從門廊看著就全身發寒. 爸立刻把所有百葉窗都拉上了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page15.cn: 7-05-93: 今天我看到有人沿着街道狂奔. 后面没有车在追, 就只是… 在跑. 他看起来很疯狂. 眼睛瞪得好大. 我光是从门廊看着就浑身发冷. 爸立刻把所有百叶窗都拉上了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page16.en: 7-06-93: The news keeps saying people are sick, but no one knows why. We heard someone banging on a door down the street. Mom won’t let me look outside. Dad is pacing and mumbling about evacuation plans.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page16.ch: 7-06-93: 新聞一直說有人生病了, 但沒人知道原因. 我們聽到街上有人在猛敲某戶人家的門. 媽不准我看外面. 爸一直來回踱步, 嘴裡唸著撤離計畫.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page16.cn: 7-06-93: 新闻一直说有人生病了, 但没人知道原因. 我们听到街上有人在猛敲某户人家的门. 妈不准我看外面. 爸一直来回踱步, 嘴里念叨着撤离计划.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page17.en: 7-07-93: More sirens. People screaming. Jenny’s voice came over the phone again, frantic, warning me not to leave the house. Her line cut out. I can’t reach her anymore. Something is really wrong.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page17.ch: 7-07-93: 更多警笛聲. 人們在尖叫. 珍妮又打電話來了, 聲音很慌亂, 警告我不要離開家. 然後電話就斷了. 我再也聯絡不上她. 真的出大事了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page17.cn: 7-07-93: 更多警笛声. 人们在尖叫. 珍妮又打电话来了, 声音很慌乱, 警告我不要离开家. 然后电话就断了. 我再也联系不上她. 真的出大事了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page18.en:
7-08-93: Oh my god! I saw the military shoot some completely injured person! He was limping towards a soldier and he just shot him dead! 
There are monsters outside! They look like people, but they're not human! Friends, family, crushes... they look like them but they're not them.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page18.ch:
7-08-93: 我的天啊! 我看到軍隊開槍打死一個傷得很重的人! 他一跛一跛地走向一名士兵, 那士兵就直接把他射死了! 
外面有怪物! 牠們看起來像人, 但牠們不是人! 朋友, 家人, 暗戀的人… 牠們看起來像他們, 但已經不是他們了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page18.cn:
7-08-93: 我的天啊! 我看到军队开枪打死一个伤得很重的人! 他一瘸一拐地走向一名士兵, 那士兵就直接把他打死了! 
外面有怪物! 它们看起来像人, 但它们不是人! 朋友, 家人, 暗恋的人… 它们看起来像他们, 但已经不是他们了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page19.en: 7-09-93: Knox is gone… or maybe it’s everywhere. The streets are full of them. Dad tried to get us out, but it’s impossible. Mom is shaking, clutching me. Nothing is real anymore. I don’t know if I’ll survive.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page19.ch: 7-09-93: 諾克斯完了… 或者到處都一樣. 街上滿滿都是牠們. 爸試著帶我們離開, 但根本不可能. 媽在發抖, 緊緊抓著我. 一切都不再真實了. 我不知道自己能不能活下來.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page19.cn: 7-09-93: 诺克斯完了… 或者到处都一样. 街上满满都是它们. 爸试着带我们离开, 但根本不可能. 妈在发抖, 紧紧抓着我. 一切都不再真实了. 我不知道自己能不能活下来.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page2.en: 5-02-93: Ugh, math test today. Totally bombed it. Ms. Harper gave me that look again, you know, the one that says 'you’re hopeless.' Lunch was okay, though. Paul smiled at me in the hallway, so that made it a tiny bit better.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page2.ch: 5-02-93: 唉, 今天考數學. 完全考砸了. 哈潑老師又給我那種眼神, 你知道的, 就是那種寫著「你沒救了」的眼神. 不過午餐還可以. 保羅在走廊對我笑了, 所以心情稍微好了一點點.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page2.cn: 5-02-93: 唉, 今天考数学. 完全考砸了. 哈珀老师又给我那种眼神, 你知道的, 就是那种写着“你没救了”的眼神. 不过午饭还可以. 保罗在走廊对我笑了, 所以心情稍微好了一点点.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page20.en: 7-10-93: We haven’t slept. We can’t leave the house. Every window shows them outside. Shadows moving. Groans. I think Dad is keeping a weapon under the bed. Mom keeps crying. I can’t breathe properly.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page20.ch: 7-10-93: 我們都沒睡. 我們不能離開房子. 每扇窗外都看得到牠們. 晃動的影子. 呻吟聲. 我想爸在床底下藏了武器. 媽一直在哭. 我快喘不過氣了.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page20.cn: 7-10-93: 我们都没睡. 我们不能离开房子. 每扇窗外都看得到它们. 晃动的影子. 呻吟声. 我想爸在床底下藏了武器. 妈一直在哭. 我快喘不过气了.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page21.en: 7-11-93: Two days since chaos broke out. Screams, growls, and the smell… I can’t describe it. They’re everywhere. I don’t know how long we’ll last. I just hope Jenny is alive… I hope anyone is.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page21.ch: 7-11-93: 混亂爆發已經兩天了. 尖叫聲, 低吼聲, 還有那股味道… 我形容不出來. 牠們到處都是. 我不知道我們還能撐多久. 我只希望珍妮還活著… 只希望還有人活著.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page21.cn: 7-11-93: 混乱爆发已经两天了. 尖叫声, 低吼声, 还有那股味道… 我形容不出来. 它们到处都是. 我不知道我们还能撑多久. 我只希望珍妮还活着… 只希望还有人活着.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page3.en: 5-10-93: Mom got a new car today. It’s shiny and red! I finally get why she was obsessed. Jenny is still annoying, but I kinda like driving around the block for a minute like I’m grown-up.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page3.ch: 5-10-93: 媽今天買了新車. 亮晶晶的紅色! 我終於懂她為什麼那麼著迷了. 珍妮還是很煩, 不過我有點喜歡開車在街區繞一下下, 好像自己是大人一樣.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page3.cn: 5-10-93: 妈今天买了新车. 亮闪闪的红色! 我终于懂她为什么那么着迷了. 珍妮还是很烦, 不过我有点喜欢开车在街区绕一小会儿, 好像自己是大人一样.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page4.en: 5-17-93: Baseball season started! I’m not on the team, but going to the games is fun. Paul waved at me again, can you believe it? I hope he comes to the spring dance. Ugh, I hope he comes to the dance.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page4.ch: 5-17-93: 棒球季開始了! 我不是球隊的人, 但去看比賽很好玩. 保羅又對我揮手了, 你敢相信嗎? 希望他會來春季舞會. 唉, 真希望他會來舞會.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page4.cn: 5-17-93: 棒球赛季开始了! 我不是球队的人, 但去看比赛很好玩. 保罗又对我挥手了, 你敢相信吗? 希望他会来春季舞会. 唉, 真希望他会来舞会.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page5.en: 5-24-93: School is stressful. Homework is stacking up like a mountain. Jenny keeps texting about the dance, but I just can’t focus. Wish I could just disappear for a while.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page5.ch: 5-24-93: 學校壓力好大. 作業堆得像山一樣高. 珍妮一直傳訊息來講舞會的事, 但我就是沒辦法專心. 真希望能消失一陣子.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page5.cn: 5-24-93: 学校压力好大. 作业堆得像山一样高. 珍妮一直发消息来讲舞会的事, 但我就是没办法专心. 真希望能消失一阵子.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page6.en: 6-01-93: Summer’s almost here. Can’t wait. Mom says we’re going to the lake this weekend. Dad’s been grumbling about news stuff, but I mostly ignore him. He looked worried though… it’s annoying.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page6.ch: 6-01-93: 夏天快到了. 等不及了. 媽說這個週末我們要去湖邊. 爸一直在抱怨新聞上的事, 但我大多不理他. 不過他看起來很擔心… 真煩.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page6.cn: 6-01-93: 夏天快到了. 等不及了. 妈说这个周末我们要去湖边. 爸一直在抱怨新闻上的事, 但我大多不理他. 不过他看起来很担心… 真烦.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page7.en: 6-10-93: Spent the afternoon at the mall with Jenny. Got a cute top. Ate too much ice cream. Dad keeps talking about Knox in whispers. I don’t even know what that is, but it sounded serious.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page7.ch: 6-10-93: 下午跟珍妮去逛購物中心. 買了一件可愛的上衣. 冰淇淋吃太多了. 爸一直小聲地講諾克斯的事. 我根本不知道那是什麼, 但聽起來很嚴重.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page7.cn: 6-10-93: 下午跟珍妮去逛商场. 买了一件可爱的上衣. 冰淇淋吃太多了. 爸一直小声地讲诺克斯的事. 我根本不知道那是什么, 但听起来很严重.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page8.en: 6-18-93: News says there’s something happening in Knox. People getting sick or disappearing. Dad is freaking out a little, mumbling about viruses and government stuff. Mom says it’s nothing, but she won’t stop checking the TV.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page8.ch: 6-18-93: 新聞說諾克斯那邊出事了. 有人生病或失蹤. 爸有點抓狂, 嘴裡唸著病毒和政府什麼的. 媽說沒什麼, 但她一直忍不住看電視.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page8.cn: 6-18-93: 新闻说诺克斯那边出事了. 有人生病或失踪. 爸有点抓狂, 嘴里念叨着病毒和政府什么的. 妈说没什么, 但她一直忍不住看电视.

UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page9.en: 6-25-93: School canceled for the week. Knox is still on the news, and it’s getting worse. Dad is putting boards on the windows. Jenny hasn’t called, which is weird. Mom keeps trying to stay calm but I can hear her crying at night.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page9.ch: 6-25-93: 學校停課一週. 諾克斯還在新聞上, 而且越來越糟. 爸在窗戶上釘木板. 珍妮都沒打電話來, 好奇怪. 媽一直努力保持冷靜, 但我晚上聽得到她在哭.
UI_SurvivorJournal_Story9_Page9.cn: 6-25-93: 学校停课一周. 诺克斯还在新闻上, 而且越来越糟. 爸在窗户上钉木板. 珍妮都没打电话来, 好奇怪. 妈一直努力保持冷静, 但我晚上听得到她在哭.

UI_TTF_BF_Status_BonusTime_TT.en:
Bonus Time
Green: You are currently inside the configured fishing bonus time window.
White: You are outside the bonus time window.
UI_TTF_BF_Status_BonusTime_TT.ch:
獎勵時段
綠色: 你目前處於設定的釣魚獎勵時段內.
白色: 你目前不在獎勵時段內.
UI_TTF_BF_Status_BonusTime_TT.cn:
奖励时段
绿色: 你当前处于设置的钓鱼奖励时段内.
白色: 你当前不在奖励时段内.

UI_TTF_BF_Status_Shore_TT.en:
Shore Detection
Red: Your current aim position is detected as near shore.
White: Your current aim position is not near shore.
UI_TTF_BF_Status_Shore_TT.ch:
岸邊偵測
紅色: 你目前的瞄準位置被判定為靠近岸邊.
白色: 你目前的瞄準位置不在岸邊附近.
UI_TTF_BF_Status_Shore_TT.cn:
岸边检测
红色: 你当前的瞄准位置被判定为靠近岸边.
白色: 你当前的瞄准位置不在岸边附近.

UI_TTF_BF_Status_Weather_TT.en:
Weather Detection
Green: Current weather improves fishing.
White: Current weather has no effect.
Red: Current weather makes fishing worse.
UI_TTF_BF_Status_Weather_TT.ch:
天氣偵測
綠色: 目前的天氣有利於釣魚.
白色: 目前的天氣沒有影響.
紅色: 目前的天氣不利於釣魚.
UI_TTF_BF_Status_Weather_TT.cn:
天气检测
绿色: 当前天气有利于钓鱼.
白色: 当前天气没有影响.
红色: 当前天气不利于钓鱼.

UI_options_TTF_BetterFishing_disableStat.en: Disables the icon-only fishing status UI when a fishing rod is equipped.
UI_options_TTF_BetterFishing_disableStat.ch: 裝備釣竿時, 停用僅顯示圖示的釣魚狀態介面.
UI_options_TTF_BetterFishing_disableStat.cn: 装备鱼竿时, 禁用仅显示图标的钓鱼状态界面.

UI_options_TTF_BetterFishing_statusUISca.en: Changes the size of the fishing status UI.
UI_options_TTF_BetterFishing_statusUISca.ch: 變更釣魚狀態介面的大小.
UI_options_TTF_BetterFishing_statusUISca.cn: 更改钓鱼状态界面的大小.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_autoLockDela.en: How long a browsed inventory remains selected during active gameplay before snapping back to the Proximity/Corpse inventory. Paused time is not counted.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_autoLockDela.ch: 遊戲進行中, 瀏覽的物品欄保持選取多久後才彈回鄰近/屍體物品欄. 暫停時間不計入.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_autoLockDela.cn: 游戏进行中, 浏览的物品栏保持选中多长时间后才弹回邻近/尸体物品栏. 暂停时间不计入.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableAutoLo.en: When enabled, locking is automatic. Players can browse other inventories until moving away or the configured delay expires.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableAutoLo.ch: 啟用後, 鎖定會自動進行. 玩家可瀏覽其他物品欄, 直到走遠或設定的延遲時間到期.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableAutoLo.cn: 启用后, 锁定将自动进行. 玩家可以浏览其他物品栏, 直到走远或设定的延迟时间到期.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableDualMo.en: Shows both Proximity and Corpses Only. Auto-Lock prefers Corpses Only while corpses are nearby. Corpse Only mode takes priority if both modes are enabled.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableDualMo.ch: 同時顯示鄰近與僅屍體. 附近有屍體時, 自動鎖定會優先選擇僅屍體. 若兩種模式皆啟用, 以僅屍體模式為優先.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableDualMo.cn: 同时显示邻近和仅尸体. 附近有尸体时, 自动锁定会优先选择仅尸体. 如果两种模式都启用, 以仅尸体模式为优先.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableNested.en: When enabled, containers inside loot inventories are shown as additional container buttons.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableNested.ch: 啟用後, 戰利品物品欄中的容器會顯示為額外的容器按鈕.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableNested.cn: 启用后, 战利品物品栏中的容器会显示为额外的容器按钮.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableNested.en: When enabled, containers inside the player inventory are shown as additional container buttons.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableNested.ch: 啟用後, 玩家物品欄中的容器會顯示為額外的容器按鈕.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableNested.cn: 启用后, 玩家物品栏中的容器会显示为额外的容器按钮.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_hideIndividu.en: When Corpses Only or Dual Mode is active, hides individual corpse buttons and uses the Corpses Only inventory instead.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_hideIndividu.ch: 當僅屍體或雙重模式啟用時, 隱藏個別屍體按鈕, 改用僅屍體物品欄.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_hideIndividu.cn: 当仅尸体或双重模式启用时, 隐藏单个尸体按钮, 改用仅尸体物品栏.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_preserveInve.ch: 暫停後保留物品欄視窗
UI_BetterContainers_Options_preserveInve.cn: 暂停后保留物品栏窗口

UI_BetterContainers_Options_preserveInve.en: When enabled, inventory windows that were open before entering the pause menu are restored after returning to the game.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_preserveInve.ch: 啟用後, 進入暫停選單前已開啟的物品欄視窗會在回到遊戲後還原.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_preserveInve.cn: 启用后, 进入暂停菜单前已打开的物品栏窗口会在返回游戏后恢复.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_proximityInc.en: Active when Loot Nested Containers is enabled
UI_BetterContainers_Options_proximityInc.ch: 啟用戰利品巢狀容器時生效
UI_BetterContainers_Options_proximityInc.cn: 启用战利品嵌套容器时生效

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showCorpsesO.ch: 僅在附近有屍體時顯示僅屍體
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showCorpsesO.cn: 仅在附近有尸体时显示仅尸体

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showCorpsesO.en: In Dual Mode, hides the Corpses Only button when no corpses are nearby. The Proximity button remains available.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showCorpsesO.ch: 雙重模式下, 附近沒有屍體時隱藏僅屍體按鈕. 鄰近按鈕仍可使用.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showCorpsesO.cn: 双重模式下, 附近没有尸体时隐藏仅尸体按钮. 邻近按钮仍可使用.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showEquipped.ch: 顯示已裝備/已掛載區塊
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showEquipped.cn: 显示已装备/已挂载区域

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showEquipped.en: When enabled, worn, held, attached hotbar items, and keyrings are grouped into one collapsible section in the player inventory.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showEquipped.ch: 啟用後, 穿戴, 手持, 掛在快捷列上的物品以及鑰匙圈會歸入玩家物品欄中一個可摺疊的區塊.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showEquipped.cn: 启用后, 穿戴, 手持, 挂在快捷栏上的物品以及钥匙圈会归入玩家物品栏中一个可折叠的区域.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFavourit.en: Show Pinned Item Types on Player Inventory
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFavourit.ch: 在玩家物品欄顯示已固定的物品類型
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFavourit.cn: 在玩家物品栏显示已固定的物品类型

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFavourit.en: When enabled, pinned item types are also shown on the player inventory.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFavourit.ch: 啟用後, 已固定的物品類型也會顯示在玩家物品欄.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFavourit.cn: 启用后, 已固定的物品类型也会显示在玩家物品栏.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.en: Show Freshness Bar for Spoilable Food
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.ch: 顯示易腐食物的新鮮度條
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.cn: 显示易腐食物的新鲜度条

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.en: Shows remaining freshness from 100%% fresh to 0%% rotten, with a marker at the stale threshold.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.ch: 顯示剩餘新鮮度, 從 100%% 新鮮到 0%% 腐爛, 並在不新鮮的門檻處標示記號.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.cn: 显示剩余新鲜度, 从 100%% 新鲜到 0%% 腐烂, 并在不新鲜的阈值处显示标记.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.en: Show Freshness Percentage for Spoilable Food
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.ch: 顯示易腐食物的新鮮度百分比
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.cn: 显示易腐食物的新鲜度百分比

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.en: Shows the remaining freshness percentage on hover and permanently for individual items in expanded stacks.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.ch: 滑鼠懸停時顯示剩餘新鮮度百分比, 展開堆疊中的個別物品則會持續顯示.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.cn: 鼠标悬停时显示剩余新鲜度百分比, 展开堆叠中的单个物品则会持续显示.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showNestedCo.en: When enabled, nested container buttons show the icon of the container they are inside.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showNestedCo.ch: 啟用後, 巢狀容器按鈕會顯示其所在容器的圖示.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showNestedCo.cn: 启用后, 嵌套容器按钮会显示其所在容器的图标.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showWeightCo.en: Show stack and individual weights in inventory lists. Click the weight header to change sort direction.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showWeightCo.ch: 在物品欄清單中顯示堆疊與單個物品的重量. 點選重量標題可變更排序方向.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showWeightCo.cn: 在物品栏列表中显示堆叠和单个物品的重量. 点击重量标题可更改排序方向.

UI_LGN3_ItemOrderingDescription.en: Drag to reorder, uncheck to ignore.
UI_LGN3_ItemOrderingDescription.ch: 拖曳以重新排序, 取消勾選則忽略.
UI_LGN3_ItemOrderingDescription.cn: 拖动以重新排序, 取消勾选则忽略.

UI_LGN3_StatusCreatedFromCurrent.ch: 已依目前衣著建立套裝
UI_LGN3_StatusCreatedFromCurrent.cn: 已根据当前衣着创建套装

UI_Blacklist_Active.ch: 生效中的禁令 / 搜尋
UI_Blacklist_Active.cn: 生效中的禁令 / 搜索

UI_Blacklist_Err_Category.en: The server administrator has banned this item category from trading.
UI_Blacklist_Err_Category.ch: 伺服器管理員已禁止交易此物品類別.
UI_Blacklist_Err_Category.cn: 服务器管理员已禁止交易此物品类别.

UI_Blacklist_Err_Fluid.en: The server administrator has banned this liquid, including mixtures and other containers.
UI_Blacklist_Err_Fluid.ch: 伺服器管理員已禁止此液體, 包括其混合物與其他容器.
UI_Blacklist_Err_Fluid.cn: 服务器管理员已禁止此液体, 包括其混合物和其他容器.

UI_Blacklist_Err_Item.en: The server administrator has banned this item from trading.
UI_Blacklist_Err_Item.ch: 伺服器管理員已禁止交易此物品.
UI_Blacklist_Err_Item.cn: 服务器管理员已禁止交易此物品.

UI_Blacklist_Help.en: Rules apply immediately to sales and supply contracts. Listings are returned; open orders are refunded. Accepted contracts and paid deliveries continue. Category rules cover every item in that inventory category.
UI_Blacklist_Help.ch: 規則會立即套用於銷售與供貨合約. 已上架的商品會退回; 未成交的訂單會退款. 已接受的合約與已付款的交付會繼續進行. 類別規則涵蓋該物品欄類別中的所有物品.
UI_Blacklist_Help.cn: 规则会立即应用于销售和供货合同. 已上架的商品会退回; 未成交的订单会退款. 已接受的合同和已付款的交付会继续进行. 类别规则涵盖该物品栏类别中的所有物品.

UI_Blacklist_Inherited.en: Already blocked by category; an individual ban can also be added
UI_Blacklist_Inherited.ch: 已被類別規則封鎖; 仍可另外新增個別禁令
UI_Blacklist_Inherited.cn: 已被类别规则屏蔽; 仍可另外添加单独禁令

UI_Blacklist_Saved.en: Blacklist saved. Listings returned: {1}; open contracts refunded: {2}.
UI_Blacklist_Saved.ch: 黑名單已儲存. 退回的上架商品: {1}; 退款的未成交合約: {2}.
UI_Blacklist_Saved.cn: 黑名单已保存. 退回的上架商品: {1}; 退款的未成交合同: {2}.

UI_Contract_AdminPayout.en: Pay executor; refund remainder to customer
UI_Contract_AdminPayout.ch: 支付執行者; 剩餘款項退還委託人
UI_Contract_AdminPayout.cn: 支付执行者; 剩余款项退还委托人

UI_Contract_AgreedHours.en: Agreed real hours — work: {1}; service review: {2}.
UI_Contract_AgreedHours.ch: 約定的現實時數 — 工作: {1}; 服務審核: {2}.
UI_Contract_AgreedHours.cn: 约定的现实时数 — 工作: {1}; 服务审核: {2}.

UI_Contract_Amount.ch: 數量 / 公升 (最多 3 位小數)
UI_Contract_Amount.cn: 数量 / 升 (最多 3 位小数)

UI_Contract_CatalogueEmpty.en: No matches. Change the search or category.
UI_Contract_CatalogueEmpty.ch: 沒有符合的結果. 請變更搜尋內容或類別.
UI_Contract_CatalogueEmpty.cn: 没有匹配的结果. 请更改搜索内容或类别.

UI_Contract_CatalogueResults.en: Found: {1} — up to 50 items per page
UI_Contract_CatalogueResults.ch: 找到: {1} — 每頁最多 50 個物品
UI_Contract_CatalogueResults.cn: 找到: {1} — 每页最多 50 个物品

UI_Contract_CatalogueSearchHelp.en: Search by name or item ID. Multiple words can be entered in any order.
UI_Contract_CatalogueSearchHelp.ch: 依名稱或物品 ID 搜尋. 可輸入多個關鍵字, 順序不拘.
UI_Contract_CatalogueSearchHelp.cn: 按名称或物品 ID 搜索. 可输入多个关键词, 顺序不限.

UI_Contract_Err_AcceptLimit.en: Your active assignment limit has been reached.
UI_Contract_Err_AcceptLimit.ch: 你進行中的任務已達上限.
UI_Contract_Err_AcceptLimit.cn: 你进行中的任务已达上限.

UI_Contract_Err_Payout.en: Enter a valid payout, no greater than the reserved reward, with at most two decimal places.
UI_Contract_Err_Payout.ch: 請輸入有效的支付金額, 不得超過預留的報酬, 且最多兩位小數.
UI_Contract_Err_Payout.cn: 请输入有效的支付金额, 不得超过预留的报酬, 且最多两位小数.

UI_Contract_Err_Requirements.en: Invalid requirements. Check the type, quantity and percentages. Use liquid orders for liquid containers; restricted items cannot be ordered.
UI_Contract_Err_Requirements.ch: 需求無效. 請檢查類型、數量與百分比. 液體容器請使用液體訂單; 受限物品無法訂購.
UI_Contract_Err_Requirements.cn: 需求无效. 请检查类型、数量和百分比. 液体容器请使用液体订单; 受限物品无法订购.

UI_Contract_Err_State.en: The contract changed or this action is unavailable. Reopen its details.
UI_Contract_Err_State.ch: 合約已變更或此操作無法使用. 請重新開啟其詳細資訊.
UI_Contract_Err_State.cn: 合同已变更或此操作不可用. 请重新打开其详情.

UI_Contract_Err_SupplyAmount.en: Select up to 50 matching items without exceeding the remaining amount. If partial deliveries are disabled, supply the full remainder.
UI_Contract_Err_SupplyAmount.ch: 請選取最多 50 個符合的物品, 且不超過剩餘數量. 若已停用部分交付, 請交付全部剩餘數量.
UI_Contract_Err_SupplyAmount.cn: 请选择最多 50 个匹配的物品, 且不超过剩余数量. 若已禁用部分交付, 请交付全部剩余数量.

UI_Contract_Err_SupplyItem.en: A selected item is missing, protected or does not meet the requirements.
UI_Contract_Err_SupplyItem.ch: 某個選取的物品遺失、受保護或不符合需求.
UI_Contract_Err_SupplyItem.cn: 某个选中的物品丢失、受保护或不符合需求.

UI_Contract_Err_SupplyRollback.en: The delivery failed. Removed items were returned or queued for your recovery. No reward was paid.
UI_Contract_Err_SupplyRollback.ch: 交付失敗. 已移除的物品已退回或排入佇列等你取回. 未支付任何報酬.
UI_Contract_Err_SupplyRollback.cn: 交付失败. 已移除的物品已退回或排队等你取回. 未支付任何报酬.

UI_Contract_EventAbandoned.ch: 執行者已離開; 剩餘部分重新開放
UI_Contract_EventAbandoned.cn: 执行者已离开; 剩余部分重新开放

UI_Contract_EventCancelled.ch: 已取消; 剩餘報酬已退款
UI_Contract_EventCancelled.cn: 已取消; 剩余报酬已退款

UI_Contract_EventCreated.ch: 已建立; 報酬已預留
UI_Contract_EventCreated.cn: 已创建; 报酬已预留

UI_Contract_EventExpired.ch: 無人接取的訂單已過期; 報酬已退款
UI_Contract_EventExpired.cn: 无人接取的订单已过期; 报酬已退款

UI_Contract_EventOverdue.ch: 期限已過; 已提出爭議
UI_Contract_EventOverdue.cn: 期限已过; 已发起争议

UI_Contract_Reason.en: Reason / note (required for rejection, dispute or cancellation request)
UI_Contract_Reason.ch: 原因 / 備註 (拒絕、爭議或取消請求時必填)
UI_Contract_Reason.cn: 原因 / 备注 (拒绝、争议或取消请求时必填)

UI_Contract_ServiceHelp.en: The customer approves services. Overdue work or review opens a dispute; it never pays automatically. Deadlines use real time, including time offline. Accepted terms cannot be edited.
UI_Contract_ServiceHelp.ch: 由客戶核准服務. 逾期的工作或審核會開啟爭議; 絕不會自動付款. 期限採用現實時間, 包含離線期間. 已接受的條款無法修改.
UI_Contract_ServiceHelp.cn: 由客户批准服务. 逾期的工作或审核会开启争议; 绝不会自动付款. 期限使用现实时间, 包括离线期间. 已接受的条款无法修改.

UI_Contract_Set_contractCreateLimit.ch: 每位玩家的進行中訂單上限 (1–100)
UI_Contract_Set_contractCreateLimit.cn: 每位玩家的进行中订单上限 (1–100)

UI_Contract_Set_contractOpenHours.ch: 無人承接訂單的有效期, 現實小時 (1–720)
UI_Contract_Set_contractOpenHours.cn: 无人承接订单的有效期, 现实小时 (1–720)

UI_Contract_Set_contractReviewHours.ch: 服務審核時間, 現實小時 (1–720)
UI_Contract_Set_contractReviewHours.cn: 服务审核时间, 现实小时 (1–720)

UI_Contract_Set_contractWorkHours.ch: 預設完成時間, 現實小時 (1–720)
UI_Contract_Set_contractWorkHours.cn: 默认完成时间, 现实小时 (1–720)

UI_Contract_SupplyHelp.en: Whole selected items and containers are transferred with their contents. Liquid orders count the requested component in millilitres. Excess is not accepted: adjust the last container first. Partial deliveries are paid proportionally and are final. Up to 50 items per delivery.
UI_Contract_SupplyHelp.ch: 所選的完整物品與容器會連同內容物一併轉移. 液體訂單以毫升計算所需成分. 不接受超出數量: 請先調整最後一個容器. 部分交付會按比例付款, 且不可撤回. 每次交付最多 50 個物品.
UI_Contract_SupplyHelp.cn: 所选的完整物品和容器会连同内容物一起转移. 液体订单按毫升计算所需成分. 不接受超出数量: 请先调整最后一个容器. 部分交付按比例付款, 且不可撤销. 每次交付最多 50 个物品.

UI_Contract_TermsHours.en: Unclaimed order: {1} real hours; service review: {2} real hours.
UI_Contract_TermsHours.ch: 無人承接的訂單: {1} 現實小時; 服務審核: {2} 現實小時.
UI_Contract_TermsHours.cn: 无人承接的订单: {1} 现实小时; 服务审核: {2} 现实小时.

UI_NMS_Help.en: <H1> Nutrition <LINE> <TEXT> Food does three things: it fills your <RGB:0.86,0.76,0.52> stomach <RGB:1,1,1> , it tops up your <RGB:0.95,0.72,0.35> energy <RGB:1,1,1> , and it supplies <RGB:0.62,0.78,0.58> protein <RGB:1,1,1> . Food tooltips show all three as pips. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Stomach <LINE> <TEXT> One pip is about one hour of fullness. Bulky, fatty and protein-rich food keeps you full longer than sugary snacks with the same calories. While your stomach has food in it you are Well Fed and wounds heal a little faster. A stomach holds about five hours; eating past that is wasted. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Hunger <LINE> <TEXT> Hunger returns gradually as the stomach empties, and faster when your energy reserve is low. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Energy <LINE> <TEXT> One pip is about 250 kcal. Hard work burns more. A small surplus is stored as fat and a deficit is drawn from fat, so your weight follows what you eat over weeks. Below zero your body is running on empty and malnourishment builds. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Protein <LINE> <TEXT> One pip is about 10 g. Protein slowly runs down every day. Meat, fish, eggs, beans, nuts and dairy restore it. Staying deficient causes malnourishment even if you eat enough calories. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Malnourishment <LINE> <TEXT> Builds over days when you are short on calories or protein, and fades over a day or two once you eat properly. It slows stamina recovery and healing. The faint bar shows where it is heading. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Weight <LINE> <TEXT> Changes slowly. The coloured bands are where weight traits change: underweight below 75 kg, overweight above 85 kg.
UI_NMS_Help.ch: <H1> 營養 <LINE> <TEXT> 食物有三種作用: 填飽你的 <RGB:0.86,0.76,0.52> 胃 <RGB:1,1,1> , 補充你的 <RGB:0.95,0.72,0.35> 能量 <RGB:1,1,1> , 並提供 <RGB:0.62,0.78,0.58> 蛋白質 <RGB:1,1,1> . 食物提示會以刻度格顯示這三項. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 胃 <LINE> <TEXT> 一格約等於一小時的飽足感. 體積大, 油脂多與富含蛋白質的食物, 比熱量相同的含糖零食更耐餓. 胃裡有食物時, 你會處於「吃飽了」狀態, 傷口癒合也會稍微加快. 胃大約能容納五小時的份量, 超過的部分會被浪費. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 飢餓 <LINE> <TEXT> 隨著胃逐漸排空, 飢餓感會慢慢回來, 能量儲備偏低時回來得更快. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 能量 <LINE> <TEXT> 一格約為 250 kcal. 勞動越繁重, 消耗越多. 少量盈餘會轉為脂肪囤積, 不足時則從脂肪中提取, 因此你的體重會在數週內隨飲食而變化. 低於零時, 你的身體已能量耗盡, 營養不良會逐漸累積. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 蛋白質 <LINE> <TEXT> 一格約為 10 g. 蛋白質每天都會慢慢減少. 肉, 魚, 蛋, 豆類, 堅果與乳製品可以補充. 長期缺乏蛋白質, 即使熱量攝取足夠也會導致營養不良. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 營養不良 <LINE> <TEXT> 熱量或蛋白質不足時, 會在數天內逐漸累積, 恢復正常飲食後約一兩天內消退. 它會減緩耐力恢復與傷口癒合. 淡色條顯示它的變化趨勢. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 體重 <LINE> <TEXT> 變化緩慢. 彩色區段是體重特質改變的分界: 低於 75 kg 為體重過輕, 高於 85 kg 為體重過重.
UI_NMS_Help.cn: <H1> 营养 <LINE> <TEXT> 食物有三种作用: 填饱你的 <RGB:0.86,0.76,0.52> 胃 <RGB:1,1,1> , 补充你的 <RGB:0.95,0.72,0.35> 能量 <RGB:1,1,1> , 并提供 <RGB:0.62,0.78,0.58> 蛋白质 <RGB:1,1,1> . 食物提示会以格子显示这三项. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 胃 <LINE> <TEXT> 一格约等于一小时的饱腹感. 体积大, 油脂多和富含蛋白质的食物, 比热量相同的含糖零食更耐饿. 胃里有食物时, 你会处于“吃饱了”状态, 伤口愈合也会稍微加快. 胃大约能容纳五小时的量, 超出的部分会被浪费. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 饥饿 <LINE> <TEXT> 随着胃逐渐排空, 饥饿感会慢慢回来, 能量储备偏低时回来得更快. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 能量 <LINE> <TEXT> 一格约为 250 kcal. 劳动越繁重, 消耗越多. 少量盈余会转化为脂肪囤积, 不足时则从脂肪中提取, 因此你的体重会在数周内随饮食而变化. 低于零时, 你的身体已经能量耗尽, 营养不良会逐渐累积. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 蛋白质 <LINE> <TEXT> 一格约为 10 g. 蛋白质每天都会慢慢减少. 肉, 鱼, 蛋, 豆类, 坚果和乳制品可以补充. 长期缺乏蛋白质, 即使热量摄入足够也会导致营养不良. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 营养不良 <LINE> <TEXT> 热量或蛋白质不足时, 会在数天内逐渐累积, 恢复正常饮食后约一两天内消退. 它会减缓耐力恢复和伤口愈合. 淡色条显示它的变化趋势. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 体重 <LINE> <TEXT> 变化缓慢. 彩色区段是体重特质改变的分界: 低于 75 kg 为体重过轻, 高于 85 kg 为体重过重.
