UI_CHB_FootprintNotFound.cn: 无法识别这座锅炉的完整占地范围.

UI_CHB_InfoUnservedStructureMany.ch: {VALUE}座玩家建造的建築未獲供暖
UI_CHB_InfoUnservedStructureMany.cn: {VALUE}座玩家建造的建筑未获供暖

UI_CHB_InfoUnservedStructureOne.ch: {VALUE}座玩家建造的建築未獲供暖
UI_CHB_InfoUnservedStructureOne.cn: {VALUE}座玩家建造的建筑未获供暖

UI_CHB_Mode_Comfort_Tooltip.en: Low, nearly constant power use around refrigerator level. Outdoor temperature has only a minor effect on consumption.
UI_CHB_Mode_Comfort_Tooltip.ch: 低且近乎恆定的耗電, 約與冰箱相當. 室外溫度對耗電量影響很小.
UI_CHB_Mode_Comfort_Tooltip.cn: 低且近乎恒定的耗电, 约与冰箱相当. 室外温度对耗电量影响很小.

UI_CHB_Mode_Hardcore_Tooltip.en: Power use is close to real electric heating. In severe cold the boiler puts a very heavy load on a generator and requires frequent refuelling.
UI_CHB_Mode_Hardcore_Tooltip.ch: 耗電量接近真實電暖設備. 嚴寒時鍋爐會對發電機造成極大負載, 需要頻繁補充燃料.
UI_CHB_Mode_Hardcore_Tooltip.cn: 耗电量接近真实电暖设备. 严寒时锅炉会对发电机造成极大负载, 需要频繁补充燃料.

UI_CHB_Mode_Normal_Tooltip.en: Balanced heating with a noticeable fuel cost. Open exterior doors increase energy use, especially in severe cold.
UI_CHB_Mode_Normal_Tooltip.ch: 均衡的暖氣效果, 燃料消耗明顯. 敞開的外門會增加耗能, 嚴寒時尤其明顯.
UI_CHB_Mode_Normal_Tooltip.cn: 均衡的供暖效果, 燃料消耗明显. 敞开的外门会增加能耗, 严寒时尤其明显.

UI_CHB_NoTemplate.en: A complete industrial boiler could not be found. Move near one and press Ctrl+F8 again.
UI_CHB_NoTemplate.ch: 找不到完整的工業鍋爐. 請靠近一座後再按一次Ctrl+F8.
UI_CHB_NoTemplate.cn: 找不到完整的工业锅炉. 请靠近一座后再按一次Ctrl+F8.

UI_CHB_NoWater.en: No suitable water is available in carried containers, or the boiler is already full.
UI_CHB_NoWater.ch: 攜帶的容器中沒有合適的水, 或鍋爐已經滿了.
UI_CHB_NoWater.cn: 携带的容器中没有合适的水, 或锅炉已经满了.

UI_CHB_OptionsCompatibility_Tooltip.en: Experimental fallback for other mods that extend or replace the standard power grid. Use the separate LG Extended Electricity option for LG support. If CHB cannot directly detect normal grid power or a vanilla generator, this option allows a boiler to use electricity reported on its square by another mod. In multiplayer, the server Sandbox setting is authoritative. Fuel and load accounting for external power sources may differ from normal CHB operation.
UI_CHB_OptionsCompatibility_Tooltip.ch: 針對其他擴充或取代標準電網之模組的實驗性備援方案. 支援LG時請使用另外的LG Extended Electricity選項. 若CHB無法直接偵測到一般電網電力或原版發電機, 此選項允許鍋爐使用其他模組回報在其所在格子上的電力. 多人遊戲中以伺服器的沙盒設定為準. 外部電源的燃料與負載計算可能與CHB一般運作不同.
UI_CHB_OptionsCompatibility_Tooltip.cn: 针对其他扩展或替代标准电网之模组的实验性后备方案. 支持LG时请使用单独的LG Extended Electricity选项. 若CHB无法直接检测到普通电网电力或原版发电机, 此选项允许锅炉使用其他模组报告在其所在格子上的电力. 多人游戏中以服务器的沙盒设置为准. 外部电源的燃料与负载计算可能与CHB正常运行不同.

UI_CHB_OptionsLGExtendedElectricity_Tool.en: Enable compatibility with LG Extended Electricity. When enabled and LG Extended Electricity is active, CHB can use electricity delivered to the boiler square through LG's extended network. In multiplayer, the server Sandbox setting is authoritative. CHB does not add this external boiler load to LG generator fuel or breaker accounting.
UI_CHB_OptionsLGExtendedElectricity_Tool.ch: 啟用與LG Extended Electricity的相容性. 啟用且LG Extended Electricity正在運作時, CHB可使用透過LG擴充電網送達鍋爐所在格子的電力. 多人遊戲中以伺服器的沙盒設定為準. CHB不會將這項外部鍋爐負載計入LG發電機的燃料或斷路器計算.
UI_CHB_OptionsLGExtendedElectricity_Tool.cn: 启用与LG Extended Electricity的兼容性. 启用且LG Extended Electricity正在运行时, CHB可使用通过LG扩展电网送达锅炉所在格子的电力. 多人游戏中以服务器的沙盒设置为准. CHB不会将这项外部锅炉负载计入LG发电机的燃料或断路器计算.

UI_CU_Fibrillation.cn: 你的心脏正失序地颤动.

UI_CU_FirearmOff.en: Firearm episodes are turned off in this server's sandbox settings.
UI_CU_FirearmOff.ch: 此伺服器的沙盒設定已關閉槍枝事件.
UI_CU_FirearmOff.cn: 此服务器的沙盒设置已关闭枪械事件.

UI_CU_Flashback_3.en: Their face. You keep seeing their face.
UI_CU_Flashback_3.ch: 那張臉. 你一直看到那張臉.
UI_CU_Flashback_3.cn: 那张脸. 你一直看到那张脸.

UI_CU_Flashback_5.en: You're back there. You're right back there.
UI_CU_Flashback_5.ch: 你又回到那裡了. 你就在那裡.
UI_CU_Flashback_5.cn: 你又回到那里了. 你就在那里.

UI_CU_Flashback_6.ch: 呼吸. 已經結束了. 已經結束了.
UI_CU_Flashback_6.cn: 呼吸. 已经结束了. 已经结束了.

UI_CU_HandMissing.en: You have no hand to hold that with.

UI_CU_LimbKept.en: You are holding what used to be part of someone.
UI_CU_LimbKept.ch: 你手上拿著的, 曾經是某人身體的一部分.
UI_CU_LimbKept.cn: 你手上拿着的, 曾经是某人身体的一部分.

UI_CU_NeedCrutch.en: Hold a crutch to walk properly on one leg. Hospitals and medical clinics have them.
UI_CU_NeedCrutch.ch: 拿著拐杖才能用單腳正常行走. 醫院和診所有拐杖.
UI_CU_NeedCrutch.cn: 拿着拐杖才能用单腿正常行走. 医院和诊所有拐杖.

UI_CU_NeedHelpProsthetic.en: With no arms, somebody else has to put it on for you.
UI_CU_NeedHelpProsthetic.ch: 沒有手臂的話, 得由別人幫你裝上.
UI_CU_NeedHelpProsthetic.cn: 没有手臂的话, 得由别人帮你装上.

UI_CU_NeedLegs.en: You can't do that without legs to stand on.
UI_CU_NeedLegs.ch: 沒有腿可以站, 你做不到.
UI_CU_NeedLegs.cn: 没有腿可以站, 你做不到.

UI_CU_NoArms.en: That takes a hand you no longer have. A prosthetic arm would do it.
UI_CU_NoArms.ch: 那需要一隻你已經沒有的手. 義肢手臂可以做到.
UI_CU_NoArms.cn: 那需要一只你已经没有的手. 假肢手臂可以做到.

UI_CU_NotCured.en: It was already in your blood.
UI_CU_NotCured.ch: 它早就進到你的血液裡了.
UI_CU_NotCured.cn: 它早就进到你的血液里了.

UI_CU_Overdose_NothingHasEverBeenWrongNo.en: Nothing has ever been wrong. Nothing at all.
UI_CU_Overdose_NothingHasEverBeenWrongNo.ch: 從來沒有任何不對勁. 什麼都沒有.
UI_CU_Overdose_NothingHasEverBeenWrongNo.cn: 从来没有任何不对劲. 什么都没有.

UI_CU_Overdose_NothingYouFeelNothingAtAl.en: Nothing. You feel nothing at all.
UI_CU_Overdose_NothingYouFeelNothingAtAl.ch: 什麼都沒有. 你什麼都感覺不到.
UI_CU_Overdose_NothingYouFeelNothingAtAl.cn: 什么都没有. 你什么都感觉不到.

UI_CU_Overdose_TooMuchInOneArm.en: That is a lot of %1 in one arm.
UI_CU_Overdose_TooMuchInOneArm.ch: 一條手臂打了這麼多%1, 太多了.
UI_CU_Overdose_TooMuchInOneArm.cn: 一条手臂打了这么多%1, 太多了.

UI_CU_Overdose_WarmAllOfItWarm.ch: 溫暖. 一切都, 好溫暖.
UI_CU_Overdose_WarmAllOfItWarm.cn: 温暖. 一切都, 好温暖.

UI_CU_Overdose_YouAreBreathingButBarely.ch: 你還在呼吸, 但很微弱.
UI_CU_Overdose_YouAreBreathingButBarely.cn: 你还在呼吸, 但很微弱.

UI_CU_Overdose_YouCanTGetABreathIn.en: You can't get a breath in.

UI_CU_Overdose_YouCanTMakeYourselfBreath.en: You can't make yourself breathe in.

UI_CU_Overdose_YouComeBackUpYouWishYou.en: You come back up. You wish you hadn't.
UI_CU_Overdose_YouComeBackUpYouWishYou.ch: 你醒過來了. 你希望自己沒有醒.
UI_CU_Overdose_YouComeBackUpYouWishYou.cn: 你醒过来了. 你希望自己没有醒.

UI_CU_Overdose_YouHaveNoIdeaHowLongYou.en: You have no idea how long you were out.
UI_CU_Overdose_YouHaveNoIdeaHowLongYou.ch: 你不知道自己昏迷了多久.
UI_CU_Overdose_YouHaveNoIdeaHowLongYou.cn: 你不知道自己昏迷了多久.

UI_CU_Overdose_YourChestHasLockedItWonT.en: Your chest has locked. It won't move.
UI_CU_Overdose_YourChestHasLockedItWonT.ch: 你的胸口僵住了. 它動不了.
UI_CU_Overdose_YourChestHasLockedItWonT.cn: 你的胸口僵住了. 它动不了.

UI_CU_Overdose_YourHeadIsNotRightSomethi.en: Your head is not right. Something is missing.
UI_CU_Overdose_YourHeadIsNotRightSomethi.ch: 你的腦袋不對勁. 少了什麼東西.
UI_CU_Overdose_YourHeadIsNotRightSomethi.cn: 你的脑袋不对劲. 少了什么东西.

UI_CU_Overdose_YourKneesGiveYouDonTMind.en: Your knees give. You don't mind.
UI_CU_Overdose_YourKneesGiveYouDonTMind.ch: 你的膝蓋一軟. 你不在乎.
UI_CU_Overdose_YourKneesGiveYouDonTMind.cn: 你的膝盖一软. 你不在乎.

UI_CU_Overdose_YourSkinCrawlsEverythingI.ch: 你渾身起雞皮疙瘩. 全身都在癢.
UI_CU_Overdose_YourSkinCrawlsEverythingI.cn: 你浑身起鸡皮疙瘩. 全身都在痒.

UI_CU_PTSD_Onset.en: It keeps coming back. It isn't going to stop.
UI_CU_PTSD_Onset.ch: 它一直回來. 它不會停止的.
UI_CU_PTSD_Onset.cn: 它一直回来. 它不会停止的.

UI_CU_Proc_NoChange.en: That did not clear it. Badly done work only sets it back - try again, more carefully.
UI_CU_Proc_NoChange.ch: 這樣沒有解決. 做得不好只會讓情況倒退 - 再試一次, 更小心一點.
UI_CU_Proc_NoChange.cn: 这样没有解决. 做得不好只会让情况倒退 - 再试一次, 更小心一点.

UI_CU_Rhythm_vtach.en: Your heart is racing out of control.

UI_CU_RollAgain.en: You have the strength to roll again.

UI_CU_Rolling.en: With no arms or legs, all you can do is roll.
UI_CU_Rolling.ch: 沒有手腳, 你唯一能做的就是滾動.
UI_CU_Rolling.cn: 没有手脚, 你唯一能做的就是滚动.

UI_CU_Squeamish.en: You can't look at it. Your hands won't hold still.
UI_CU_Squeamish.ch: 你不敢看. 你的手停不住地抖.
UI_CU_Squeamish.cn: 你不敢看. 你的手停不住地抖.

UI_CU_TooHeavy.en: You can't carry that like this.
UI_CU_TooHeavy.ch: 你這個樣子搬不動那個.
UI_CU_TooHeavy.cn: 你这个样子搬不动那个.

UI_CU_TooMiserable.en: What's the point... (too low to treat yourself - somebody else can, and anything urgent you still will)
UI_CU_TooMiserable.ch: 有什麼意義… (太消沉了, 無法自行治療 - 別人可以幫你, 而緊急狀況你仍會處理)
UI_CU_TooMiserable.cn: 有什么意义… (太消沉了, 无法自行治疗 - 别人可以帮你, 而紧急状况你仍会处理)

UI_CU_TwoHanded.en: You need two hands for that.

UI_CU_WheelchairOut.en: Get out of the wheelchair first.

UI_CU_Witness_suicide.ch: 不. 不, 不, 不 -
UI_CU_Witness_suicide.cn: 不. 不, 不, 不 -

UI_trait_CU_ArmLegDesc.en: Surviving the Knox Event cost you an arm and a leg, funny huh? You start with only your right arm and right leg.
UI_trait_CU_ArmLegDesc.ch: 在諾克斯事件中倖存讓你付出了一條手臂和一條腿的代價, 很好笑吧? 你開局只剩右手臂和右腿.
UI_trait_CU_ArmLegDesc.cn: 在诺克斯事件中幸存让你付出了一条手臂和一条腿的代价, 很好笑吧? 你开局只剩右臂和右腿.

UI_trait_CU_CreeperDesc.en: Both of your arms were amputated. You need someone else to put a prosthesis on.
UI_trait_CU_CreeperDesc.ch: 你的雙臂都被截肢了. 需要別人幫你裝上義肢.
UI_trait_CU_CreeperDesc.cn: 你的双臂都被截肢了. 需要别人帮你装上假肢.

UI_trait_CU_ProsArmDesc.en: One of your arms has been replaced with a prosthetic. It's functional, but far from natural.
UI_trait_CU_ProsArmDesc.ch: 你的一條手臂已換成義肢. 它能用, 但遠不如原本自然.
UI_trait_CU_ProsArmDesc.cn: 你的一条手臂已换成假肢. 它能用, 但远不如原本自然.

UI_trait_CU_ProsLegDesc.en: One of your legs has been replaced with a prosthetic. Walking isn't quite the same anymore.
UI_trait_CU_ProsLegDesc.ch: 你的一條腿已換成義肢. 走路的感覺已經不太一樣了.
UI_trait_CU_ProsLegDesc.cn: 你的一条腿已换成假肢. 走路的感觉已经不太一样了.

UI_trait_CU_ProsUserDesc.en: You've spent enough time around prosthetics to know how to use and maintain them. (+2 Prosthetics, 25%% more Prosthetics XP)
UI_trait_CU_ProsUserDesc.ch: 你和義肢相處夠久了, 知道怎麼使用和保養它們. (+2 義肢, 義肢經驗 +25%%)
UI_trait_CU_ProsUserDesc.cn: 你和假肢相处够久了, 知道怎么使用和保养它们. (+2 假肢, 假肢经验 +25%%)

UI_trait_CU_QuadriplegicDesc.en: You have no arms and no legs. You can only roll a few metres before you are too exhausted to move, and you cannot hold or climb anything. You can lift light things in your teeth, gnaw scrap wood off wooden objects (it hurts), and lash the wood together with duct tape into a crude prosthetic.
UI_trait_CU_QuadriplegicDesc.ch: 你沒有手臂也沒有腿. 你只能滾動幾公尺就會累到動不了, 而且無法手持或攀爬任何東西. 你可以用牙齒叼起輕的東西, 從木製物件上啃下廢木材 (會痛), 再用布膠帶把木頭綁成簡易義肢.
UI_trait_CU_QuadriplegicDesc.cn: 你没有手臂也没有腿. 你只能滚动几米就会累到动不了, 而且无法手持或攀爬任何东西. 你可以用牙齿叼起轻的东西, 从木制物件上啃下废木材 (会痛), 再用管道胶带把木头绑成简易假肢.

UI_trait_CU_SlugDesc.en: Both of your legs were amputated.

UI_trait_CU_TheseusDesc.en: But are you still the same man? All of your limbs have been replaced by prosthetics.
UI_trait_CU_TheseusDesc.ch: 但你還是同一個人嗎? 你的四肢全都換成了義肢.
UI_trait_CU_TheseusDesc.cn: 但你还是同一个人吗? 你的四肢全都换成了假肢.

UI_trait_CU_UnfinishedDesc.en: You are not done yet. The first time your heart stops and the clock runs out on you, it starts again - guaranteed, once, however long the odds. After that you take your chances with everybody else.
UI_trait_CU_UnfinishedDesc.ch: 你還沒完. 你的心臟第一次停止、時間耗盡時, 它會重新跳動 - 保證一次, 不管機會多渺茫. 之後你就和其他人一樣聽天由命了.
UI_trait_CU_UnfinishedDesc.cn: 你还没完. 你的心脏第一次停止、时间耗尽时, 它会重新跳动 - 保证一次, 不管机会多渺茫. 之后你就和其他人一样听天由命了.

UI_optionscreen_binding_UseLaser_Toggle.ch: 切換槍械雷射瞄準器開關
UI_optionscreen_binding_UseLaser_Toggle.cn: 切换枪械激光瞄准器开关

UI_trait_LegendaryWelderApprenticeDesc.en: Apprentice in the art of welding.

UI_trait_LegendaryWelderExpertDesc.en: Expert in the art of welding.

UI_trait_LegendaryWelderMasterDesc.en: Legendary master in the art of welding.

UI_AA_farm_done.en: Farming done: %1 harvested, %2 watered, %3 treated, %4 sown.
UI_AA_farm_done.ch: 農耕完成: 收穫%1, 澆水%2, 治療%3, 播種%4.
UI_AA_farm_done.cn: 农耕完成: 收获%1, 浇水%2, 治疗%3, 播种%4.

UI_AA_farm_heavy.en: Stopped: the harvest is getting too heavy.
UI_AA_farm_heavy.ch: 已停止: 收成太重了.
UI_AA_farm_heavy.cn: 已停止: 收成太重了.

UI_AA_farm_nothing.en: Nothing to do on these crops right now.
UI_AA_farm_nothing.ch: 這些作物目前沒有需要處理的事.
UI_AA_farm_nothing.cn: 这些作物目前没有需要处理的事.

UI_AA_farm_nowater.en: Stopped: out of water and no source in reach.
UI_AA_farm_nowater.ch: 已停止: 水用完了, 附近也沒有水源.
UI_AA_farm_nowater.cn: 已停止: 水用完了, 附近也没有水源.

UI_AA_farm_tend_tt.en: Harvests, treats and waters every crop within %1 tiles, nearest first. What it does is set in Mod Options.
UI_AA_farm_tend_tt.ch: 由近到遠, 收穫、治療並澆灌%1格內的所有作物. 具體執行哪些工作可在模組選項中設定.
UI_AA_farm_tend_tt.cn: 由近及远, 收获、治疗并浇灌%1格内的所有作物. 具体执行哪些工作可在模组选项中设置.

UI_AA_fish_nets_done.ch: 已檢查漁網: %1. 已補餌漁網: %2.
UI_AA_fish_nets_done.cn: 已检查渔网: %1. 已补饵渔网: %2.

UI_AA_fish_nets_nothing.ch: 目前還沒有需要檢查的漁網.
UI_AA_fish_nets_nothing.cn: 目前还没有需要检查的渔网.

UI_AA_fish_nets_tt.en: Checks every net that has waited at least an hour and re-baits empty ones with Chum.
UI_AA_fish_nets_tt.ch: 檢查每張已放置至少一小時的漁網, 並用散餌為空漁網補餌.
UI_AA_fish_nets_tt.cn: 检查每张已放置至少一小时的渔网, 并用散饵为空渔网补饵.

UI_AA_fish_nohook.en: The rod has no hook - fish will not bite without one.
UI_AA_fish_nohook.ch: 釣竿沒有魚鉤 - 沒有魚鉤, 魚不會上鉤.
UI_AA_fish_nohook.cn: 鱼竿没有鱼钩 - 没有鱼钩, 鱼不会上钩.

UI_AA_fish_nolure.ch: 魚餌用完了. 釣到%1條.
UI_AA_fish_nolure.cn: 鱼饵用完了. 钓到%1条.

UI_AA_fish_nowater.en: No water to cast at between 4 and 14 tiles away.
UI_AA_fish_nowater.ch: 4到14格範圍內沒有可以拋竿的水域.
UI_AA_fish_nowater.cn: 4到14格范围内没有可以抛竿的水域.

UI_AA_fish_rod_lost.en: Fishing stopped: the rod is gone (did the line snap?). %1 caught.
UI_AA_fish_rod_lost.ch: 釣魚停止: 釣竿不見了 (可能是斷線了). 釣到%1條.
UI_AA_fish_rod_lost.cn: 钓鱼停止: 鱼竿不见了 (可能是断线了). 钓到%1条.

UI_AA_fish_rod_tt.en: Casts, waits for a bite, reels in carefully and re-baits the hook between casts. Moving or pressing ESC stops it.
UI_AA_fish_rod_tt.ch: 拋竿、等待魚上鉤、小心收線, 並在每次拋竿之間重新掛餌. 移動或按 ESC 鍵即可停止.
UI_AA_fish_rod_tt.cn: 抛竿、等待鱼上钩、小心收线, 并在每次抛竿之间重新挂饵. 移动或按 ESC 键即可停止.

UI_AA_fish_unsupported.en: The game's fishing code was not found - rod fishing is unavailable.
UI_AA_fish_unsupported.ch: 找不到遊戲的釣魚程式碼 - 無法使用釣竿釣魚.
UI_AA_fish_unsupported.cn: 找不到游戏的钓鱼代码 - 无法使用鱼竿钓鱼.

UI_AA_gen_done.ch: 已修理發電機: %1. 已使用電子零件: %2.
UI_AA_gen_done.cn: 已修理发电机: %1. 已使用电子废料: %2.

UI_AA_gen_noscrap.en: Out of Electronics Scrap. Generators repaired: %1.
UI_AA_gen_noscrap.ch: 電子零件用完了. 已修理發電機: %1.
UI_AA_gen_noscrap.cn: 电子废料用完了. 已修理发电机: %1.

UI_AA_gen_nothing.ch: 附近沒有受損的發電機.
UI_AA_gen_nothing.cn: 附近没有受损的发电机.

UI_AA_gen_running.en: A running generator cannot be repaired - switch it off first.
UI_AA_gen_running.ch: 運轉中的發電機無法修理 - 請先關閉它.
UI_AA_gen_running.cn: 运行中的发电机无法修理 - 请先关闭它.

UI_AA_gen_tt_toggle.en: It is running: it will be switched off for the repair and back on afterwards.
UI_AA_gen_tt_toggle.ch: 發電機正在運轉: 修理時會先關閉, 修好後再重新開啟.
UI_AA_gen_tt_toggle.cn: 发电机正在运行: 修理时会先关闭, 修好后再重新开启.

UI_AA_logs_full.en: The container is full. Logs hauled: %1.
UI_AA_logs_full.ch: 容器已滿. 已搬運原木: %1.
UI_AA_logs_full.cn: 容器已满. 已搬运原木: %1.

UI_AA_logs_notallowed.en: This container does not take logs.

UI_AA_logs_tt.en: Carries the logs lying within %1 tiles into this container, as many per trip as you can carry.
UI_AA_logs_tt.ch: 把%1格內散落的原木搬進這個容器, 每趟都搬你拿得動的最大量.
UI_AA_logs_tt.cn: 把%1格内散落的原木搬进这个容器, 每趟都搬你拿得动的最大量.

UI_AA_logs_unreachable.en: Could not reach the container. Logs hauled: %1.
UI_AA_logs_unreachable.ch: 無法抵達容器. 已搬運原木: %1.
UI_AA_logs_unreachable.cn: 无法到达容器. 已搬运原木: %1.

UI_AA_opt_farmCure_tt.en: Sprays mildew, flies, aphids and slugs with the matching treatment, when you carry one.
UI_AA_opt_farmCure_tt.ch: 身上帶有對應的防治藥劑時, 會對白粉病、蒼蠅、蚜蟲和蛞蝓噴灑.
UI_AA_opt_farmCure_tt.cn: 身上带有对应的防治药剂时, 会对白粉病、苍蝇、蚜虫和蛞蝓喷洒.

UI_AA_opt_farmHarvest_tt.en: Harvests every crop that is ready. The job stops when the produce gets too heavy, so you decide where it goes.
UI_AA_opt_farmHarvest_tt.ch: 收穫所有可收成的作物. 收成太重時作業會停止, 讓你自己決定要放到哪裡.
UI_AA_opt_farmHarvest_tt.cn: 收获所有可收获的作物. 收成太重时作业会停止, 让你自己决定要放到哪里.

UI_AA_opt_farmReach_tt.en: How far from the clicked crop the job works. Every plot inside it is tended, nearest first.
UI_AA_opt_farmReach_tt.ch: 以點選的作物為中心的作業範圍. 範圍內的每塊田地都會由近到遠照料.
UI_AA_opt_farmReach_tt.cn: 以点击的作物为中心的作业范围. 范围内的每块田地都会由近及远照料.

UI_AA_opt_farmRefill.en: Refill water at a nearby source

UI_AA_opt_farmRefill_tt.en: When the watering can runs dry it is refilled at the nearest rain barrel, sink or well inside the farm radius.
UI_AA_opt_farmRefill_tt.ch: 澆水壺中的水用完時, 會到農耕半徑內最近的集雨桶、洗手台或水井補水.
UI_AA_opt_farmRefill_tt.cn: 洒水壶里的水用完时, 会到农耕半径内最近的雨水收集桶、水池或水井补水.

UI_AA_opt_farmSowSeason.en: Only sow seeds that are in season

UI_AA_opt_farmSowSeason_tt.en: When the server plays with growing seasons, seeds out of season are greyed out in the menu.
UI_AA_opt_farmSowSeason_tt.ch: 伺服器啟用生長季節時, 非當季的種子在選單中會顯示為灰色.
UI_AA_opt_farmSowSeason_tt.cn: 服务器启用生长季节时, 非当季的种子在菜单中会显示为灰色.

UI_AA_opt_farmSow_tt.en: Adds 'Sow empty furrows with...' entries for the seeds you carry. The plain 'Tend crops' entry never sows.
UI_AA_opt_farmSow_tt.ch: 為你攜帶的種子加入「在空的種植地播種…」選項. 一般的「照料附近的作物」選項永遠不會播種.
UI_AA_opt_farmSow_tt.cn: 为你携带的种子添加“在空犁沟中播种…”选项. 普通的“照料附近的作物”选项永远不会播种.

UI_AA_opt_farmWater_tt.en: Waters a plant when it is below its own water need, and never above its own maximum - overwatering hurts plants in the base game too.
UI_AA_opt_farmWater_tt.ch: 植物水分低於自身需求時才澆水, 而且絕不超過其上限 - 在原版遊戲中澆太多水同樣會傷害植物.
UI_AA_opt_farmWater_tt.cn: 植物水分低于自身需求时才浇水, 而且绝不超过其上限 - 在原版游戏中浇水过多同样会伤害植物.

UI_AA_opt_fishMax_tt.en: 0 keeps fishing until the bait runs out or you stop it.
UI_AA_opt_fishMax_tt.ch: 設為0則會一直釣, 直到魚餌用完或你手動停止.
UI_AA_opt_fishMax_tt.cn: 设为0则会一直钓, 直到鱼饵用完或你手动停止.

UI_AA_opt_fishNetBait_tt.en: A net whose bait has run out gets Chum from your inventory - the only bait a net takes.
UI_AA_opt_fishNetBait_tt.ch: 魚餌用完的漁網會從你的物品欄補上散餌 - 這是漁網唯一能用的魚餌.
UI_AA_opt_fishNetBait_tt.cn: 鱼饵用完的渔网会从你的物品栏补上散饵 - 这是渔网唯一能用的鱼饵.

UI_AA_opt_fishReach_tt.en: How far from where you click placed fishing nets are looked for.
UI_AA_opt_fishReach_tt.ch: 以點選位置為中心, 搜尋已放置漁網的範圍.
UI_AA_opt_fishReach_tt.cn: 以点击位置为中心, 搜索已放置渔网的范围.

UI_AA_opt_fishRod_tt.en: Fishes with your rod: casts, waits for a bite, reels in and re-baits the hook between casts. It plays the game's own fishing minigame, carefully - a fish can still get away.
UI_AA_opt_fishRod_tt.ch: 用你的釣竿釣魚: 拋竿、等待魚上鉤、收線, 並在每次拋竿之間重新掛餌. 它會謹慎地玩遊戲本身的釣魚小遊戲 - 魚還是有可能跑掉.
UI_AA_opt_fishRod_tt.cn: 用你的鱼竿钓鱼: 抛竿、等待鱼上钩、收线, 并在每次抛竿之间重新挂饵. 它会谨慎地玩游戏自带的钓鱼小游戏 - 鱼还是有可能跑掉.

UI_AA_opt_genFixAll.ch: 修理附近所有受損的發電機
UI_AA_opt_genFixAll.cn: 修理附近所有受损的发电机

UI_AA_opt_genFixAll_tt.en: One click repairs every generator below 100%% within reach, nearest first. Off: only the generator you clicked.
UI_AA_opt_genFixAll_tt.ch: 點一下就由近到遠修理附近所有低於100%%的發電機. 關閉: 只修理你點選的發電機.
UI_AA_opt_genFixAll_tt.cn: 点一下就由近及远修理附近所有低于100%%的发电机. 关闭: 只修理你点击的发电机.

UI_AA_opt_genReach_tt.en: How far from the clicked generator other damaged generators are looked for.
UI_AA_opt_genReach_tt.ch: 以點選的發電機為中心, 搜尋其他受損發電機的範圍.
UI_AA_opt_genReach_tt.cn: 以点击的发电机为中心, 搜索其他受损发电机的范围.

UI_AA_opt_genReturnItems.ch: 把未用完的電子零件放回去
UI_AA_opt_genReturnItems.cn: 把未用完的电子废料放回去

UI_AA_opt_genReturnItems_tt.en: Electronics Scrap fetched from crates or the floor and not used goes back where it came from.
UI_AA_opt_genReturnItems_tt.ch: 從箱子或地上拿來但沒用到的電子零件會放回原處.
UI_AA_opt_genReturnItems_tt.cn: 从箱子或地上拿来但没用到的电子废料会放回原处.

UI_AA_opt_genToggle.en: Switch a running generator off for the repair
UI_AA_opt_genToggle.ch: 修理時關閉運轉中的發電機
UI_AA_opt_genToggle.cn: 修理时关闭运行中的发电机

UI_AA_opt_genToggle_tt.en: The game will not repair a running generator. With this on it is switched off, repaired and switched back on - even if the job is stopped early. Off: running generators are skipped.
UI_AA_opt_genToggle_tt.ch: 遊戲不允許修理運轉中的發電機. 開啟後會先關閉發電機, 進行修理, 再重新開啟 - 即使作業提前停止, 仍會重新開啟. 關閉: 跳過運轉中的發電機.
UI_AA_opt_genToggle_tt.cn: 游戏不允许修理运行中的发电机. 开启后会先关闭发电机, 进行修理, 再重新开启 - 即使作业提前停止, 仍会重新开启. 关闭: 跳过运行中的发电机.

UI_AA_opt_logsFromContainers.en: Also take logs out of other containers
UI_AA_opt_logsFromContainers.ch: 也從其他容器中取出原木
UI_AA_opt_logsFromContainers.cn: 也从其他容器中取出原木

UI_AA_opt_logsFromContainers_tt.en: Off by default: logs already stored somewhere else are your storage, not a mess to tidy.
UI_AA_opt_logsFromContainers_tt.ch: 預設關閉: 已經存放在其他地方的原木是你的庫存, 不是要收拾的雜物.
UI_AA_opt_logsFromContainers_tt.cn: 默认关闭: 已经存放在其他地方的原木是你的库存, 不是要收拾的杂物.

UI_AA_opt_logsKind_tt.en: Logs only, logs and planks, or logs, planks and firewood.
UI_AA_opt_logsKind_tt.ch: 只搬原木, 原木和木板, 或原木、木板和木柴.
UI_AA_opt_logsKind_tt.cn: 只搬原木, 原木和木板, 或原木、木板和木柴.

UI_AA_opt_logsReach_tt.en: Logs lying within this distance of the container you clicked are carried to it.
UI_AA_opt_logsReach_tt.ch: 距離你點選的容器在此範圍內散落的原木, 都會被搬進該容器.
UI_AA_opt_logsReach_tt.cn: 距离你点击的容器在此范围内散落的原木, 都会被搬进该容器.

UI_MM_stop_conflict.en: Auto training stopped: another mod refused to start this exercise. The details are in console.txt.
UI_MM_stop_conflict.ch: 自動練習已停止: 其他模組拒絕開始這項鍛鍊. 詳情請檢視 console.txt.
UI_MM_stop_conflict.cn: 自动练习已停止: 其他模组拒绝开始这项锻炼. 详情请查看console.txt.

UI_MM_stop_needpanel.en: Auto training stopped: this exercise comes from another mod - keep the Fitness panel open while it trains.
UI_MM_stop_needpanel.ch: 自動練習已停止: 這項鍛鍊來自其他模組 - 訓練期間請保持鍛鍊面板開啟.
UI_MM_stop_needpanel.cn: 自动练习已停止: 这项锻炼来自其他模组 - 训练期间请保持锻炼面板开启.

UI_RPT_DepotAlreadyFull.en: This propane storage tank is already full.
UI_RPT_DepotAlreadyFull.ch: 這座丙烷儲罐已經滿了.
UI_RPT_DepotAlreadyFull.cn: 这座丙烷储罐已经满了.

UI_RPT_NoItemSources.en: Carry a supported propane container or tool that contains propane.
UI_RPT_NoItemSources.ch: 請攜帶一個裝有丙烷的受支援丙烷容器. 瓦斯噴槍無法提供丙烷.
UI_RPT_NoItemSources.cn: 请携带一个装有丙烷的受支持丙烷容器. 丙烷喷灯无法提供丙烷.
UI_RPT_NoItemSources._note: 2026-10-03：譯文刻意依同分支較新的 UI_EN.txt，不照執行期 UI.json。上游 UI.json 仍是舊文（只寫 Filibuster 卡車、說工具也能供丙烷），UI_EN.txt 已改成通用丙烷車並新增 F700 卡車字串；Lua（ArcadiaRefillablePropane_Shared.lua getPropaneVehicleProfile）同時支援 Filibuster 與 F700，mod.info 寫明噴槍只能被補充。en 錨點填執行期 UI.json 值，供 own_anchor_drift 比對。

UI_RPT_NoNearbyVehicleSources.en: Park a supported Filibuster propane truck containing propane beside this depot.
UI_RPT_NoNearbyVehicleSources.ch: 請把裝有丙烷的受支援丙烷車停在這座儲罐旁邊.
UI_RPT_NoNearbyVehicleSources.cn: 请把装有丙烷的受支持丙烷车停在这座储罐旁边.
UI_RPT_NoNearbyVehicleSources._note: 2026-10-03：譯文刻意依同分支較新的 UI_EN.txt，不照執行期 UI.json。上游 UI.json 仍是舊文（只寫 Filibuster 卡車、說工具也能供丙烷），UI_EN.txt 已改成通用丙烷車並新增 F700 卡車字串；Lua（ArcadiaRefillablePropane_Shared.lua getPropaneVehicleProfile）同時支援 Filibuster 與 F700，mod.info 寫明噴槍只能被補充。en 錨點填執行期 UI.json 值，供 own_anchor_drift 比對。

UI_RPT_StoreAction.ch: 正將丙烷存入工業儲罐
UI_RPT_StoreAction.cn: 正在将丙烷存入工业储罐

UI_RPT_StoreItemInDepot.ch: 將攜帶的丙烷存入儲罐
UI_RPT_StoreItemInDepot.cn: 将携带的丙烷存入储罐

UI_RPT_StoreVehicleInDepot.en: Store nearby truck propane in tank
UI_RPT_StoreVehicleInDepot.ch: 將附近丙烷車的丙烷存入儲罐
UI_RPT_StoreVehicleInDepot.cn: 将附近丙烷车的丙烷存入储罐

UI_CU_CrudeBroke.ch: 你的木製義肢碎裂解體了
UI_CU_CrudeBroke.cn: 你的木制假肢碎裂散架了

UI_CU_CrudeWarn.ch: 你的木製義肢正在碎裂
UI_CU_CrudeWarn.cn: 你的木制假肢正在开裂

UI_CU_TooHeavyForTeeth.en: Too heavy to lift in your teeth.
UI_CU_TooHeavyForTeeth.ch: 太重了, 無法用牙齒叼起來.
UI_CU_TooHeavyForTeeth.cn: 太重了, 没法用牙齿叼起来.

UI_FNVG_Brightness_tooltip.en: How strong the night vision overlay is. Higher values make the view brighter
UI_FNVG_Brightness_tooltip.ch: 夜視疊加效果的強度. 數值越高, 畫面越亮
UI_FNVG_Brightness_tooltip.cn: 夜视叠加效果的强度. 数值越高, 画面越亮

UI_HCTS_OptAlwaysQuick_TT.en: Every get-up from the ground or furniture uses the quick animation, however it is started (moving, the right-click menu, keybinds). The Crouch double-tap works either way.
UI_HCTS_OptAlwaysQuick_TT.ch: 從地上或家具起身時一律使用快速動畫, 不論是以何種方式觸發 (移動、右鍵選單、按鍵綁定). 雙擊蹲下鍵在兩種設定下都有效.
UI_HCTS_OptAlwaysQuick_TT.cn: 从地上或家具起身时一律使用快速动画, 无论以何种方式触发 (移动、右键菜单、按键绑定). 双击下蹲键在两种设置下都有效.

UI_BestLock_HotwireWireCut.en: Not working. Need to check the wire.
UI_BestLock_HotwireWireCut.ch: 沒有反應. 得檢查一下電線.
UI_BestLock_HotwireWireCut.cn: 没有反应. 得检查一下电线.

UI_VorpallySauced_NotifyMagazineReset.en: The mark is gone. It is just a magazine.
UI_VorpallySauced_NotifyMagazineReset.ch: 銘印消失了. 它只是個普通的彈匣.
UI_VorpallySauced_NotifyMagazineReset.cn: 铭印消失了. 它只是个普通的弹匣.

UI_VorpallySauced_UnmakeDesc.en: Strips the mark. The magazine goes back to holding %1. Nothing comes back.
UI_VorpallySauced_UnmakeDesc.ch: 剝除銘印. 彈匣容量恢復為 %1. 失去的不會再回來.
UI_VorpallySauced_UnmakeDesc.cn: 剥除铭印. 弹匣容量恢复为 %1. 失去的不会再回来.

UI_VorpallySauced_UnmakeNeedEmpty.en: Empty it first. There are still %1 rounds in there.
UI_VorpallySauced_UnmakeNeedEmpty.ch: 先把它清空. 裡面還有 %1 發子彈.
UI_VorpallySauced_UnmakeNeedEmpty.cn: 先把它清空. 里面还有 %1 发子弹.

UI_ST_DescKeyOrigin.en: Keys: which building the key opens and the street it is on
UI_ST_DescKeyOrigin.ch: 鑰匙: 可開啟哪棟建築及其所在街道
UI_ST_DescKeyOrigin.cn: 钥匙: 能打开哪栋建筑及其所在街道

UI_ST_KeyAlsoOpensMany.en: This key also fits %1 other buildings
UI_ST_KeyAlsoOpensMany.ch: 這把鑰匙也能開啟另外 %1 棟建築
UI_ST_KeyAlsoOpensMany.cn: 这把钥匙也能打开另外 %1 栋建筑

UI_ST_KeyAlsoOpensOne.en: This key also fits one other building
UI_ST_KeyAlsoOpensOne.ch: 這把鑰匙也能開啟另外一棟建築
UI_ST_KeyAlsoOpensOne.cn: 这把钥匙也能打开另外一栋建筑

UI_BestLock_HotwireLockBroken.en: The ignition lock is broken. The key won't go in.
UI_BestLock_HotwireLockBroken.ch: 點火鎖壞了. 鑰匙插不進去.
UI_BestLock_HotwireLockBroken.cn: 点火锁坏了. 钥匙插不进去.

UI_FNVG_Color_tooltip.en: The color of the night vision overlay

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_EquipReveal_Label.en: Show the hotbar when switching items
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_EquipReveal_Label.ch: 切換物品時顯示快捷欄
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_EquipReveal_Label.cn: 切换物品时显示快捷栏

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_EquipReveal_Desc.en: When the item in either hand changes, the bottom hotbar comes into view and hides again after the panel delay. Requires Animate bottom bar.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_EquipReveal_Desc.ch: 任一手上的物品變更時, 底部快捷欄會顯示出來, 並在面板收起延遲過後再次隱藏. 需要啟用底部欄動畫.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_EquipReveal_Desc.cn: 任意一只手上的物品变化时, 底部快捷栏会显示出来, 并在面板收回延迟过后再次隐藏. 需要启用底部栏动画.

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_InventoryLink_Label.ch: 物品欄與容器同時顯示
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_InventoryLink_Label.cn: 物品栏与容器同时显示

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_InventoryLink_Desc.en: When the inventory or the container comes into view, the other one comes with it, so you can move items without either one hiding. Requires Animate inventories and containers.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_InventoryLink_Desc.ch: 物品欄或容器其中一個顯示時, 另一個也會一起顯示, 讓你搬移物品時兩者都不會隱藏. 需要啟用物品欄與容器動畫.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_InventoryLink_Desc.cn: 物品栏或容器其中一个显示时, 另一个也会随之显示, 这样移动物品时两者都不会隐藏. 需要启用物品栏与容器动画.

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_KeepHands_Desc.en: While the left sidebar is hidden, both hand slots stay in place and show what you are holding. Also applies while aiming with Hide all HUD while aiming. The rest of the sidebar stays hidden.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_KeepHands_Desc.ch: 左側欄隱藏時, 雙手欄位仍會留在原位, 顯示你手上拿的東西. 啟用瞄準時隱藏所有 HUD 時, 瞄準期間同樣適用. 側欄的其餘部分維持隱藏.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_KeepHands_Desc.cn: 左侧栏隐藏时, 双手栏位仍保留在原位, 显示你手中持有的物品. 启用瞄准时隐藏所有HUD时, 瞄准期间同样适用. 侧栏其余部分保持隐藏.

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_MinimapVehicle_Label.ch: 在車內保持顯示小地圖
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_MinimapVehicle_Label.cn: 在车内保持显示小地图

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_MinimapVehicle_Desc.en: With Animate minimap with fade enabled, the open minimap stays visible while you are in a vehicle and fades again after you leave it. Aiming with Hide all HUD while aiming still hides it.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_MinimapVehicle_Desc.ch: 啟用小地圖淡入淡出動畫時, 已開啟的小地圖在你乘車期間會保持可見, 下車後才再次淡出. 啟用瞄準時隱藏所有 HUD 時, 瞄準仍會將它隱藏.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_MinimapVehicle_Desc.cn: 启用小地图淡入淡出动画时, 打开的小地图在你乘车期间会保持可见, 下车后再次淡出. 启用瞄准时隐藏所有HUD时, 瞄准仍会将其隐藏.

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_OtherPanels_Desc.en: Extends the in-place fade to any other window open on screen, including windows from other mods. It appears when the cursor enters its area and fades after the panel delay. Confirmations, right-click menus, tooltips, text boxes in use and anything being dragged are left alone.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_OtherPanels_Desc.ch: 將原地淡出效果延伸到畫面上開啟的任何其他視窗, 包括其他模組的視窗. 游標進入其區域時顯示, 並在面板收起延遲過後淡出. 確認對話方塊, 右鍵選單, 工具提示, 正在使用的文字方塊以及拖曳中的任何東西都不受影響.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_OtherPanels_Desc.cn: 将原地淡出效果扩展到屏幕上打开的任何其他窗口, 包括其他模组的窗口. 光标进入其区域时显示, 并在面板收回延迟过后淡出. 确认框, 右键菜单, 工具提示, 正在使用的文本框以及正在拖动的任何东西都不受影响.

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_PauseShowAll_Desc.en: While the game is paused or the Esc menu is open, every hidden panel comes back into view. When the game resumes, each one hides again on its normal timing.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_PauseShowAll_Desc.ch: 遊戲暫停或開啟 Esc 選單時, 所有隱藏的面板都會重新顯示. 遊戲繼續後, 各面板會依平常的時機再次隱藏.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_PauseShowAll_Desc.cn: 游戏暂停或打开Esc菜单时, 所有隐藏的面板都会重新显示. 游戏恢复后, 各面板会按正常时机再次隐藏.

UI_LPP_Notice_CrowRemoved.en:
Livestock Panel Plus update

The rooster crow is no longer part of Livestock Panel Plus.
It is now only in the standalone mod Rooster Crow.
To keep roosters crowing, subscribe to Rooster Crow on the Steam Workshop and enable it.
If you already use Rooster Crow, nothing changes.
UI_LPP_Notice_CrowRemoved.ch:
牲畜面板增強版更新

公雞啼叫功能已不再屬於牲畜面板增強版.
現在只收錄在獨立模組 Rooster Crow 中.
若想讓公雞繼續啼叫, 請在 Steam 工作坊訂閱 Rooster Crow 並啟用它.
如果你已經在使用 Rooster Crow, 則不受任何影響.
UI_LPP_Notice_CrowRemoved.cn:
牲畜面板增强版更新

公鸡打鸣功能已不再属于牲畜面板增强版.
现在只包含在独立模组 Rooster Crow 中.
若想让公鸡继续打鸣, 请在 Steam 创意工坊订阅 Rooster Crow 并启用它.
如果你已经在使用 Rooster Crow, 则不受任何影响.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessBusy.en: One of the players already has a Chess invitation.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessBusy.ch: 其中一名玩家已經有西洋棋邀請了.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessBusy.cn: 其中一名玩家已经有国际象棋邀请了.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessDeclined.cn: 国际象棋邀请已被拒绝.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnected.en: A player left the Chess game. Start a new multiplayer game to play again.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnected.ch: 有玩家離開了西洋棋對局. 開始新的多人對局即可再次遊玩.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnected.cn: 有玩家离开了国际象棋对局. 开始新的多人对局即可再次游玩.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnectedDevice.en: A PalmPilot was put away, lost power, or had Beam disabled. Start a new multiplayer game to play again.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnectedDevice.ch: 有台 PalmPilot 被收起、沒電, 或停用了紅外線傳輸. 開始新的多人對局即可再次遊玩.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnectedDevice.cn: 有台 PalmPilot 被收起、没电, 或禁用了红外传输. 开始新的多人对局即可再次游玩.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnectedRange.en: Players moved too far apart. Stay within 3 tiles on the same floor. Start a new multiplayer game to play again.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnectedRange.ch: 玩家之間距離太遠. 請待在同一樓層的 3 格範圍內. 開始新的多人對局即可再次遊玩.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnectedRange.cn: 玩家之间距离太远. 请待在同一楼层的 3 格范围内. 开始新的多人对局即可再次游玩.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessMPOnly.en: Multiplayer Chess requires a hosted or multiplayer game.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessMPOnly.ch: 多人西洋棋只能在自架主機或多人遊戲中進行.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessMPOnly.cn: 多人国际象棋只能在自建主机或多人游戏中进行.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessMenuHint.en: Solo games are saved. Multiplayer starts fresh.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessMenuHint.ch: 單人對局會儲存進度. 多人對局每次都會重新開始.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessMenuHint.cn: 单人对局会保存进度. 多人对局每次都会重新开始.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessNoPlayers.en: No nearby player has a powered PalmPilot in hand.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessNoPlayers.ch: 附近沒有玩家手上拿著已開機的 PalmPilot.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessNoPlayers.cn: 附近没有玩家手持已开机的 PalmPilot.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessOffer.en: %1 invites you to play Chess on your PalmPilot.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessOffer.ch: %1 邀請你在 PalmPilot 上下西洋棋.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessOffer.cn: %1 邀请你在 PalmPilot 上下国际象棋.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessUnavailable.en: Chess player or PalmPilot is unavailable or out of range.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessUnavailable.ch: 西洋棋玩家或 PalmPilot 無法使用, 或已超出範圍.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessUnavailable.cn: 国际象棋玩家或 PalmPilot 不可用, 或已超出范围.

UI_options_AWCWF_desc_effects.en: Configure muzzle and shell-ejection effects independently from weapon sounds.
UI_options_AWCWF_desc_effects.ch: 可獨立於武器音效, 單獨設定槍口與拋殼特效.
UI_options_AWCWF_desc_effects.cn: 可独立于武器音效, 单独配置枪口与抛壳特效.

UI_options_AWCWF_enable_muzzle_smoke_too.en: Show muzzle flash and smoke when firing. Disable to hide this visual effect.
UI_options_AWCWF_enable_muzzle_smoke_too.ch: 開火時顯示槍口火光與煙霧. 關閉則隱藏此視覺效果.
UI_options_AWCWF_enable_muzzle_smoke_too.cn: 开火时显示枪口火光与烟雾. 关闭则隐藏此视觉效果.

UI_options_AWCWF_enable_shell_ejection_t.en: Eject spent shell casings that fall to the ground. Disable to stop spawning casings.
UI_options_AWCWF_enable_shell_ejection_t.ch: 射擊時拋出彈殼並掉落在地上. 關閉則不再生成彈殼.
UI_options_AWCWF_enable_shell_ejection_t.cn: 射击时抛出弹壳并掉落在地上. 关闭则不再生成弹壳.

UI_options_AWCWF_shell_casing_volume_too.en: Adjust the volume of shell casings hitting the ground. 0 mutes it, 0.5 is the default, and 2 is double volume.
UI_options_AWCWF_shell_casing_volume_too.ch: 調整彈殼落地的音量. 0為靜音, 0.5為預設, 2為兩倍音量.
UI_options_AWCWF_shell_casing_volume_too.cn: 调整弹壳落地的音量. 0为静音, 0.5为默认, 2为两倍音量.

UI_NEQ_options_disable_tooltip.en: For you only: no figure button, no panel, no shortcut, and the inventory list is drawn by the game again. Saved outfits are kept. Useful on a server where the mod is required.
UI_NEQ_options_disable_tooltip.ch: 只對你自己生效: 不顯示人物按鈕與面板, 快捷鍵也會失效, 物品欄清單改回由遊戲原本的方式繪製. 已儲存的套裝會保留. 適合在必須安裝此模組的伺服器上使用.
UI_NEQ_options_disable_tooltip.cn: 仅对你自己生效: 不显示人物按钮和面板, 快捷键也会失效, 物品栏列表改回由游戏原本的方式绘制. 已保存的套装会保留. 适合在必须安装此模组的服务器上使用.

UI_NEQ_options_reset_geometry_tooltip.en: Puts the panel back on the inventory at its starting size. Use it if the panel has grown past the edge of the screen.
UI_NEQ_options_reset_geometry_tooltip.ch: 把面板以初始大小放回物品欄上. 若面板已經大到超出螢幕邊緣, 可使用此項.
UI_NEQ_options_reset_geometry_tooltip.cn: 将面板以初始大小放回物品栏上. 如果面板已经大到超出屏幕边缘, 可使用此项.

UI_options_AWCWF_desc_thermal.ch: 熱成像瞄準鏡掃描最佳化 (由 Gogumi 製作). 選擇你本機的標記樣式; 其他玩家保留各自的設定.
UI_options_AWCWF_desc_thermal.cn: 热成像瞄准镜扫描优化 (由 Gogumi 制作). 选择你本地的标记样式; 其他玩家保留各自的设置.

UI_options_AWCWF_thermal_marker_mode_too.en:
Both styles use the optimized scanner.
 Classic keeps detected markers.
 Visibility Fade holds markers for 150 ms, then 
fades them over 350 ms after losing sight.
 Apply a style change to clear current markers.
 Your choice is saved on this computer.
UI_options_AWCWF_thermal_marker_mode_too.ch: 兩種樣式都使用最佳化的掃描器. 「經典」會保留已偵測到的標記. 「可見度淡出」會在失去視線後讓標記停留 150 毫秒, 再於 350 毫秒內淡出. 套用樣式變更會清除目前的標記. 你的選擇會儲存在這台電腦上.
UI_options_AWCWF_thermal_marker_mode_too.cn: 两种样式都使用优化后的扫描器. “经典”会保留已检测到的标记. “可见度淡出”会在失去视线后让标记停留 150 毫秒, 再在 350 毫秒内淡出. 应用样式更改会清除当前的标记. 你的选择会保存在这台电脑上.

UI_options_AWCWF_thermal_mode_classic.ch: 最佳化 - 經典標記 (預設)
UI_options_AWCWF_thermal_mode_classic.cn: 优化 - 经典标记 (默认)

UI_options_AWCWF_thermal_mode_fade.ch: 最佳化 - 可見度淡出

UI_FamilyZMedicine_NoteConflict.en: This note changed since you opened it. Refresh it before editing again.
UI_FamilyZMedicine_NoteConflict.ch: 此紀錄在你開啟後已被更改. 請先重新整理再編輯.
UI_FamilyZMedicine_NoteConflict.cn: 此记录在你打开后已被更改. 请先刷新再编辑.

UI_NEQ_options_match_cleanui_tooltip.en: The panel and the wardrobe use CleanUI's own frame and the background opacity set in CleanUI's options, so they match the inventory. The opacity slider is not used while this is on. Needs CleanUI.
UI_NEQ_options_match_cleanui_tooltip.ch: 面板與衣櫥會使用 CleanUI 本身的外框, 以及 CleanUI 選項中設定的背景不透明度, 讓外觀與物品欄一致. 開啟此項時不會使用不透明度滑桿. 需要 CleanUI.
UI_NEQ_options_match_cleanui_tooltip.cn: 面板和衣橱会使用 CleanUI 自身的边框, 以及 CleanUI 选项中设置的背景不透明度, 使外观与物品栏一致. 开启此项时不会使用不透明度滑块. 需要 CleanUI.

UI_NEQ_options_panel_opacity_tooltip.en: How solid the background of the panel and the wardrobe is. 100 is fully opaque; lower lets the game show through.
UI_NEQ_options_panel_opacity_tooltip.ch: 面板與衣櫥背景的不透明程度. 100 為完全不透明; 數值越低, 越能透出後方的遊戲畫面.
UI_NEQ_options_panel_opacity_tooltip.cn: 面板和衣橱背景的不透明程度. 100 为完全不透明; 数值越低, 越能透出后方的游戏画面.

UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_BackBagBalloo.en:
Adds a balloon attachment slot to bags that can be equipped on the back.
Changing this option requires reloading your save data.
If an equipped bag does not match the current setting, unequip and re-equip it.
UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_BackBagBalloo.ch:
為可背在背上的背包新增氣球掛載欄位.
更改此設定後需要重新載入存檔資料.
如果已裝備的背包與目前設定不符, 請卸下後重新裝備.
UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_BackBagBalloo.cn:
为可背在背上的背包添加气球挂载栏位.
更改此设置后需要重新加载存档数据.
如果已装备的背包与当前设置不符, 请卸下后重新装备.

UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_BackBagCarabi.en:
Adds left- and right-side carabiner attachment slots to supported bags.
Changing this option requires reloading your save data.
If an equipped bag does not match the current setting, unequip and re-equip it.
UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_BackBagCarabi.ch:
為支援的背包新增左右兩側的登山扣掛載欄位.
更改此設定後需要重新載入存檔資料.
如果已裝備的背包與目前設定不符, 請卸下後重新裝備.
UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_BackBagCarabi.cn:
为支持的背包添加左右两侧的登山扣挂载栏位.
更改此设置后需要重新加载存档数据.
如果已装备的背包与当前设置不符, 请卸下后重新装备.

UI_KnoxGPS_OptCarsTip.en: Steering wheel where you left each vehicle. The mark clears itself when you get back in.
UI_KnoxGPS_OptCarsTip.ch: 在你停放每輛車的位置顯示方向盤圖示. 你回到車上時標記會自動清除.
UI_KnoxGPS_OptCarsTip.cn: 在你停放每辆车的位置显示方向盘图标. 你回到车上时标记会自动清除.

UI_KnoxGPS_OptVisitedTip.en: Small check mark on every building this character has walked into. Zoom in to see them.
UI_KnoxGPS_OptVisitedTip.ch: 在此角色走進過的每棟建築上顯示小勾號. 放大地圖即可看到.
UI_KnoxGPS_OptVisitedTip.cn: 在此角色走进过的每栋建筑上显示小勾号. 放大地图即可看到.

UI_EPR_BlackoutVolume_tooltip.en: Volume of the sounds a power outage makes, on top of Sound Volume: the breaker, the crackle of flickering lights, power coming back, alarms and lightning strikes. 0 mutes them.
UI_EPR_BlackoutVolume_tooltip.ch: 停電時各種音效的音量, 會再疊加在「音量」之上: 斷路器跳脫、燈光閃爍的劈啪聲、恢復供電、警報與雷擊. 設為0則靜音.
UI_EPR_BlackoutVolume_tooltip.cn: 停电时各种音效的音量, 会再叠加在“音量”之上: 断路器跳闸、灯光闪烁的噼啪声、恢复供电、警报与雷击. 设为0则静音.

UI_EPR_Menu_PumpNoPower.en: No power here. Start a generator nearby first.
UI_EPR_Menu_PumpNoPower.ch: 此處沒有電力. 請先啟動附近的發電機.
UI_EPR_Menu_PumpNoPower.cn: 此处没有电力. 请先启动附近的发电机.

UI_EPR_Menu_StartPumpTT.en: Pumps this tank's water through the building's pipes. Sinks, toilets and showers here keep running while a generator powers the tank.
UI_EPR_Menu_StartPumpTT.ch: 將此水箱的水抽送進建築的管線. 只要有發電機為水箱供電, 這裡的水槽、馬桶與淋浴間就能持續供水.
UI_EPR_Menu_StartPumpTT.cn: 将此水箱的水抽送进建筑的管道. 只要有发电机为水箱供电, 这里的水槽、马桶和淋浴间就能持续供水.

UI_EPR_Menu_StopPumpTT.en: Stops pumping this tank's water through the building's pipes.
UI_EPR_Menu_StopPumpTT.ch: 停止將此水箱的水抽送進建築的管線.
UI_EPR_Menu_StopPumpTT.cn: 停止将此水箱的水抽送进建筑的管道.

UI_Aegis_ClearCatSub_floor.en: player built only, replaced with the ground next door
UI_Aegis_ClearCatSub_floor.ch: 僅限玩家建造的, 會換成相鄰的地面
UI_Aegis_ClearCatSub_floor.cn: 仅限玩家建造的, 替换为相邻的地面

UI_Aegis_ClearCatSub_loot.ch: 真正的物品, 移除後永久消失
UI_Aegis_ClearCatSub_loot.cn: 真实物品, 移除后永久消失

UI_Aegis_ClearCatsHint.en: Only what actually stands in the area is listed.
UI_Aegis_ClearCatsHint.ch: 只會列出此區域內實際存在的東西.
UI_Aegis_ClearCatsHint.cn: 仅列出该区域内实际存在的内容.

UI_Aegis_ClearChunkFull.en: At most %1 chunks at a time.

UI_Aegis_ClearChunkHint.en: Click chunks to pick or drop them, Enter clears, Escape cancels
UI_Aegis_ClearChunkHint.ch: 點選區塊以選取或取消選取, Enter 清除, Escape 取消
UI_Aegis_ClearChunkHint.cn: 点击区块以选择或取消选择, Enter清理, Escape取消

UI_Aegis_ClearChunkTooltip.en: Pick whole chunks (8x8 tiles each) by clicking them. Clicking a picked chunk again drops it. Enter clears them, Escape cancels.
UI_Aegis_ClearChunkTooltip.ch: 點選以選取整個區塊 (每塊 8x8 格). 再次點選已選取的區塊即可取消選取. Enter 清除所選區塊, Escape 取消.
UI_Aegis_ClearChunkTooltip.cn: 点击选择整个区块 (每块8x8格). 再次点击已选择的区块可取消选择. Enter清理这些区块, Escape取消.

UI_Aegis_KitGroupTip.en: Kits with the same group name share one timer: claim one and the whole group waits. Empty means this kit keeps its own.
UI_Aegis_KitGroupTip.ch: 群組名稱相同的補給包共用一個計時器: 領取其中一個, 整個群組都要等待. 留空表示此補給包使用自己的計時器.
UI_Aegis_KitGroupTip.cn: 组名相同的套装共享一个计时器: 领取其中一个, 整组都需等待. 留空表示此套装使用自己的计时器.

UI_Aegis_KitStateHint.en: Empty fields hand the item out as the script defines it. Condition and fill are percentages.
UI_Aegis_KitStateHint.ch: 欄位留空時, 物品會依腳本定義的狀態發放. 耐久與填充量皆為百分比.
UI_Aegis_KitStateHint.cn: 字段留空时, 物品将按脚本定义的状态发放. 耐久和填充量均为百分比.

UI_Aegis_SearchZone.ch: 搜尋區域、擁有者或成員…
UI_Aegis_SearchZone.cn: 搜索区域、所有者或成员…

UI_FurniturePushPull_StackedContainerUns.en: Unstack container furniture before moving it to protect its contents.
UI_FurniturePushPull_StackedContainerUns.ch: 移動前請先將堆疊的容器家具拆開, 以保護其中的物品.
UI_FurniturePushPull_StackedContainerUns.cn: 移动前请先将堆叠的容器家具拆开, 以保护其中的物品.

UI_PSI_FirstPersonBars_option1.ch: 準星下方顯示最後目標
UI_PSI_FirstPersonBars_option1.cn: 准星下方显示最后目标

UI_PSI_FirstPersonBars_tooltip.en: For Project Viewpoint. In first and third person, bars cannot sit over their targets. Last Target Under Crosshair shows one bar below the middle of the screen for the zombie or animal you hit last, for a few seconds after each hit. Your own bar stays when it is pinned to the screen. The isometric view is unchanged.
UI_PSI_FirstPersonBars_tooltip.ch: 適用於 Project Viewpoint. 在第一與第三人稱視角下, 血條無法顯示在目標上方. 「準星下方顯示最後目標」會在畫面中央下方顯示一條血條, 對應你最後擊中的殭屍或動物, 每次命中後持續數秒. 你自己的血條若固定在畫面上則會保留. 等距視角不受影響.
UI_PSI_FirstPersonBars_tooltip.cn: 适用于 Project Viewpoint. 在第一与第三人称视角下, 血条无法显示在目标上方. “准星下方显示最后目标”会在屏幕中央下方显示一条血条, 对应你最后击中的僵尸或动物, 每次命中后持续数秒. 你自己的血条若固定在屏幕上则会保留. 等距视角不受影响.

UI_PSI_FirstPersonNumbers_tooltip.en: For Project Viewpoint. In first and third person, numbers cannot sit over their target, so they appear around the middle of the screen: your hits, misses, damage you take, wounds and level ups. Numbers for burning zombies, vehicle parts and explosions stay hidden. The isometric view is unchanged.
UI_PSI_FirstPersonNumbers_tooltip.ch: 適用於 Project Viewpoint. 在第一與第三人稱視角下, 數字無法顯示在目標上方, 因此改為出現在畫面中央附近: 你的命中、揮空、你受到的傷害、傷口與升級. 燃燒殭屍、車輛零件與爆炸的數字仍保持隱藏. 等距視角不受影響.
UI_PSI_FirstPersonNumbers_tooltip.cn: 适用于 Project Viewpoint. 在第一与第三人称视角下, 数字无法显示在目标上方, 因此改为出现在屏幕中央附近: 你的命中、挥空、你受到的伤害、伤口与升级. 燃烧僵尸、车辆部件与爆炸的数字仍保持隐藏. 等距视角不受影响.

UI_optionscreen_binding_ALife_WorldStatu.ch: 開啟 A-Life 世界狀態
UI_optionscreen_binding_ALife_WorldStatu.cn: 打开 A-Life 世界状态

UI_RMMP_DrawHint.en: Drag a rectangle on the map. Right-click to cancel.
UI_RMMP_DrawHint.ch: 在地圖上拖曳出矩形. 按右鍵取消.
UI_RMMP_DrawHint.cn: 在地图上拖出矩形. 右键点击取消.

UI_RMMP_EditTitle.ch: 編輯區域 - 地圖建構器
UI_RMMP_EditTitle.cn: 编辑区域 - 地图构建器

UI_RMMP_EntryMessageHint.en: Shown when a player enters this region. Leave blank for no message.
UI_RMMP_EntryMessageHint.ch: 玩家進入此區域時顯示. 留空則不顯示訊息.
UI_RMMP_EntryMessageHint.cn: 玩家进入此区域时显示. 留空则不显示消息.

UI_RMMP_InvalidChance.en: Enter a percentage between 0 and 100, or leave the field blank.
UI_RMMP_InvalidChance.ch: 請輸入 0 到 100 之間的百分比, 或將欄位留空.
UI_RMMP_InvalidChance.cn: 请输入 0 到 100 之间的百分比, 或将该字段留空.

UI_RMMP_MapHint.en: Drag to pan. Scroll to zoom. Right-click to set corners.
UI_RMMP_MapHint.ch: 拖曳以平移. 捲動滾輪以縮放. 按右鍵設定角點.
UI_RMMP_MapHint.cn: 拖动以平移. 滚动滚轮以缩放. 右键点击设置角点.

UI_RMMP_SelectionReady.en: Region selected. Complete the form and save.
UI_RMMP_SelectionReady.ch: 已選擇區域. 填寫表單後儲存.
UI_RMMP_SelectionReady.cn: 已选择区域. 填写表单后保存.

UI_RMMP_TraitFieldHint.en: 0-100%. Blank keeps the default. 0 explicitly disables this chance.
UI_RMMP_TraitFieldHint.ch: 0-100%%. 留空則沿用預設值. 填 0 會明確停用此機率.
UI_RMMP_TraitFieldHint.cn: 0-100%%. 留空则沿用默认值. 填 0 会明确禁用此概率.

UI_RMMP_TraitHelp.ch: 特性規則 (滑鼠停留可檢視詳情)
UI_RMMP_TraitHelp.cn: 特性规则 (鼠标悬停查看详情)

UI_RMMP_TraitRules.en: Cognition controls door opening. Sight and hearing each use a separate deterministic roll per zombie. Chances are thresholds, not weights: best, normal, poor, then random. Unmatched rolls use sandbox defaults. Good/Pinpoint Hearing and Bad/Poor senses are aliases; the higher chance wins. Overlapping regions use the highest chance per property. Blank fields inherit category properties, then sandbox defaults.
UI_RMMP_TraitRules.ch: 感知控制開門. 視覺與聽覺各自對每隻殭屍使用獨立的確定性擲點. 機率是門檻而非權重: 依序為最佳, 正常, 差, 最後是隨機. 未落入任何門檻的擲點使用沙盒預設值. 聽覺好與精確聽覺, 以及感官的差與弱互為別名, 取較高的機率. 重疊的區域在每個屬性上取最高機率. 空白欄位先繼承類別屬性, 再沿用沙盒預設值.
UI_RMMP_TraitRules.cn: 感知控制开门. 视觉和听觉各自对每只僵尸使用独立的确定性掷点. 概率是阈值而非权重: 依次为最佳, 正常, 差, 最后是随机. 未落入任何阈值的掷点使用沙盒默认值. 好听觉与精确听觉, 以及感官的差与弱互为别名, 取较高的概率. 重叠区域在每个属性上取最高概率. 空白字段先继承类别属性, 再使用沙盒默认值.

UI_ArcadiaShore_NoReadyBatteryBay.ch: 此房車內沒有就緒的電池艙. 若尚未安裝, 請放置一座電池艙; 否則請進入房車並等待其內容物載入, 然後重新整理並再次連接.
UI_ArcadiaShore_NoReadyBatteryBay.cn: 此房车内没有就绪的电池舱. 若尚未安装, 请放置一座电池舱; 否则请进入房车并等待其内容加载完成, 然后刷新并重新连接.

UI_IconsInventory_options_enableDpadCont.en: Up on first row to go to previous, down on last to go next
UI_IconsInventory_options_enableDpadCont.ch: 在第一列按上切換到上一個, 在最後一列按下切換到下一個
UI_IconsInventory_options_enableDpadCont.cn: 在第一行按上切换到上一个, 在最后一行按下切换到下一个

UI_optionscreen_KBW_ShowUnlearnedRecipes.en: Show recipes you have not learned yet
List magazine recipes before you read the magazine, locked, with the magazine or skill level that unlocks them. Turn this off to hide them until learned.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_ShowUnlearnedRecipes.ch: 在閱讀雜誌之前就列出雜誌配方, 以鎖定狀態顯示, 並標示可解鎖它們的雜誌或技能等級. 關閉此選項則會將它們隱藏, 直到學會為止.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_ShowUnlearnedRecipes.cn: 在阅读杂志之前就列出杂志配方, 以锁定状态显示, 并标明可解锁它们的杂志或技能等级. 关闭此选项则会将它们隐藏, 直到学会为止.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Amate.en: Handy with wood and basic tools.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Amate.ch: 擅長處理木材與使用基本工具.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Amate.cn: 擅长处理木材和使用基本工具.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Amate.en: Knows the basics of wiring and electronics.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Amate.ch: 懂得配線與電子學的基礎知識.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Amate.cn: 懂得布线和电子学的基础知识.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Amate.en: Knows the basics of welding and metalwork.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Amate.ch: 懂得焊接與金屬加工的基礎知識.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Amate.cn: 懂得焊接和金属加工的基础知识.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Anxio.en: You're always on edge. Stress builds up faster.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Anxio.ch: 你總是緊繃不安. 壓力累積得更快.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Anxio.cn: 你总是紧绷不安. 压力累积得更快.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Apoth.en: Trained in preparing remedies. Can identify poisonous plants, find medicinal herbs, and craft poultices, but without a forager's eye for the wild.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Apoth.ch: 受過調製藥物的訓練. 能辨識有毒植物、找到藥草並製作藥膏, 但缺乏採集者對野外的眼光.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Apoth.cn: 受过调制药物的训练. 能识别有毒植物、找到草药并制作药膏, 但缺乏采集者对野外的眼光.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Bruis.en: Hits hard with short blunt weapons.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Bruis.ch: 使用短鈍器時出手沉重.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Bruis.cn: 使用短钝器时出手沉重.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Chemi.en: Knows how to mix volatile compounds, pesticides and improvise water filters.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Chemi.ch: 懂得調配揮發性化合物、農藥, 以及製作簡易濾水器.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Chemi.cn: 懂得调配挥发性化合物、农药, 以及制作简易滤水器.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Compo.en: You keep a level head under pressure. Stress builds up more slowly.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Compo.ch: 你在壓力下也能保持冷靜. 壓力累積得更慢.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Compo.cn: 你在压力下也能保持冷静. 压力累积得更慢.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Craft.en: Increased XP gains for Crafting skills.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Craft.ch: 提供製作技能的經驗值增益.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Craft.cn: 提供制作技能的经验值增益.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Creat.en: A rich inner life keeps you occupied and grounded. Boredom and unhappiness build up more slowly.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Creat.ch: 豐富的內心世界讓你保持充實與踏實. 無聊與不快樂累積得更慢.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Creat.cn: 丰富的内心世界让你保持充实和踏实. 无聊和不开心累积得更慢.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Depre.en: The weight of it all sits heavy on you. Unhappiness builds up faster.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Depre.ch: 一切的重擔都沉沉壓在你身上. 不快樂累積得更快.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Depre.cn: 一切的重担都沉沉压在你身上. 不开心累积得更快.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Eagle.en: Has a faster visibility fade and a higher visibility arc.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Eagle.ch: 能見度消失得更快, 視野範圍更廣.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Eagle.cn: 能见度消失得更快, 视野范围更广.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Eloqu.en: A natural people-person who stays composed under pressure. Reduces panic by 70%%.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Eloqu.ch: 天生善於與人相處, 在壓力下也能保持冷靜. 恐慌降低 70%%.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Eloqu.cn: 天生善于与人相处, 在压力下也能保持冷静. 恐慌降低 70%%.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:FastR.en: Takes less time to read books.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Gambl.en: Your experience gains are unpredictable: sometimes lost, sometimes doubled.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Gambl.ch: 你的經驗值獲得難以預測: 有時損失, 有時加倍.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Gambl.cn: 你的经验值获得难以预测: 有时损失, 有时加倍.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Impat.en: You can't stand sitting still. Boredom builds up faster.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Impat.ch: 你受不了靜坐不動. 無聊累積得更快.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Impat.cn: 你受不了静坐不动. 无聊累积得更快.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Inven.en: Has lower skill level requirements to research recipes from items or auto learn recipes.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Inven.ch: 透過物品研究配方或自動學習配方時所需技能等級更低.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Inven.cn: 通过物品研究配方或自动学习配方时所需技能等级更低.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Juggl.ch: 手腳靈巧, 反應敏捷.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Juggl.cn: 手脚灵巧, 反应敏捷.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Lance.en: Skilled at keeping enemies at spear's length.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Lance.ch: 擅長以長矛的距離將敵人擋在外面.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Lance.cn: 擅长以长矛的距离将敌人挡在外面.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Organ.ch: 增加背包及容器的容量.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Organ.cn: 增加背包及容器的容量.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Patie.en: Long waits and dull tasks don't get to you. Boredom builds up more slowly.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Patie.ch: 漫長的等待與無聊的工作影響不了你. 無聊累積得更慢.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Patie.cn: 漫长的等待和无聊的工作影响不了你. 无聊累积得更慢.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Resil.en: Less prone to disease. Slower rate of zombification.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Resil.ch: 不容易生病. 殭屍化的速度較慢.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Resil.cn: 不容易生病. 僵尸化的速度较慢.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Sharp.en: Steady hands and a sharp eye with firearms.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Sharp.ch: 手穩眼利, 善用槍械.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Sharp.cn: 手稳眼利, 善用枪械.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Slice.en: Quick and precise with short blades.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Slice.ch: 使用短刃武器時迅速而精準.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Slice.cn: 使用短刃武器时迅速而精准.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Snare.ch: 你懂得基本的陷阱配方.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Snare.cn: 你懂得基本的陷阱配方.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Sneak.en: Moves quietly and stays out of sight.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Sneak.ch: 行動安靜, 不易被發現.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Sneak.cn: 行动安静, 不易被发现.

UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Targe.en: You gain less experience in Aiming and Reloading.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Targe.ch: 你在瞄準與裝填技能上獲得的經驗較少.
UI_trait_SeinarExtendedProfessions:Targe.cn: 你在瞄准和装填技能上获得的经验较少.

UI_UO_StatusActiveTip.en: Shared text measurements are being reused. Click to refresh the status.
UI_UO_StatusActiveTip.ch: 正在重複使用共用的文字測量結果. 點選以重新整理狀態.
UI_UO_StatusActiveTip.cn: 正在复用共享的文本测量结果. 点击以刷新状态.

UI_UO_StatusApi.ch: 選單 API 無法使用

UI_UO_StatusApiTip.en: The required menu functions are missing. Save a report with the game build.
UI_UO_StatusApiTip.ch: 缺少必要的選單函式. 請儲存報告並附上遊戲版本.
UI_UO_StatusApiTip.cn: 缺少必要的菜单函数. 请保存报告并附上游戏版本.

UI_UO_StatusBlockedTip.en: Click to refresh and save a session report for details.
UI_UO_StatusBlockedTip.ch: 點選以重新整理, 並儲存工作階段報告以檢視詳細資訊.
UI_UO_StatusBlockedTip.cn: 点击以刷新, 并保存会话报告以查看详细信息.

UI_UO_StatusBuildTip.en: The default mode requires the reviewed 42.21.0 revision. Experimental mode adds checks on other B42 builds.
UI_UO_StatusBuildTip.ch: 預設模式需要已審查的 42.21.0 版本. 實驗模式會在其他 B42 版本上加入檢查.
UI_UO_StatusBuildTip.cn: 默认模式需要已审查的 42.21.0 版本. 实验模式会在其他 B42 版本上添加检查.

UI_UO_StatusDisabledTip.ch: 啟用 UO 並按下「套用」.
UI_UO_StatusDisabledTip.cn: 启用 UO 并按下“应用”.

UI_UO_StatusExperimentalTip.en: Every nonempty calculation is compared with the original on this unverified build.
UI_UO_StatusExperimentalTip.ch: 在此未驗證的版本上, 每次非空的計算都會與原始計算比對.
UI_UO_StatusExperimentalTip.cn: 在此未验证的版本上, 每次非空的计算都会与原始计算比对.

UI_UO_StatusFaultTip.en: The original calculation is restored. Save a report and restart the world session before retrying.
UI_UO_StatusFaultTip.ch: 已還原原始計算. 請儲存報告, 並在重試前重新開始世界工作階段.
UI_UO_StatusFaultTip.cn: 已还原原始计算. 请保存报告, 并在重试前重新开始世界会话.

UI_UO_StatusHookTip.en: UO preserves methods replaced by other code. Save a report to inspect the interaction.
UI_UO_StatusHookTip.ch: UO 會保留被其他程式碼取代的方法. 請儲存報告以檢查兩者的互動.
UI_UO_StatusHookTip.cn: UO 会保留被其他代码替换的方法. 请保存报告以检查两者的交互.

UI_UO_StatusMPOptimizerTip.en: This overlapping integration has not been validated. UO keeps its menu cache suspended.
UI_UO_StatusMPOptimizerTip.ch: 此重疊的整合尚未經過驗證. UO 會讓其選單快取保持暫停.
UI_UO_StatusMPOptimizerTip.cn: 此重叠的集成尚未经过验证. UO 会让其菜单缓存保持暂停.

UI_UO_StatusMPTip.en: The Disable in multiplayer setting is active for this client.
UI_UO_StatusMPTip.ch: 此客戶端已啟用「在多人遊戲中停用」設定.
UI_UO_StatusMPTip.cn: 此客户端已启用“在多人游戏中禁用”设置.

UI_UO_StatusMismatch.cn: 已暂停: 宽度不一致

UI_UO_StatusMismatchTip.en: The original result is preserved. A fresh calculation after clearing cached measurements still differed. Save a report with your game build and mod list.
UI_UO_StatusMismatchTip.ch: 已保留原始結果. 清除快取的測量資料後重新計算, 結果仍然不同. 請儲存報告並附上遊戲版本與 MOD 清單.
UI_UO_StatusMismatchTip.cn: 已保留原始结果. 清除缓存的测量数据后重新计算, 结果仍然不同. 请保存报告并附上游戏版本和模组列表.

UI_UO_StatusNoSessionTip.en: The cache activates after a world session starts.
UI_UO_StatusNoSessionTip.ch: 快取會在世界工作階段開始後啟動.
UI_UO_StatusNoSessionTip.cn: 缓存会在世界会话开始后激活.

UI_UO_StatusOffTip.en: Enable menu caching and press Apply. Timing can still record the original path if enabled.
UI_UO_StatusOffTip.ch: 啟用選單快取並按下「套用」. 若已啟用計時, 仍可記錄原始路徑的時間.
UI_UO_StatusOffTip.cn: 启用菜单缓存并按下“应用”. 若已启用计时, 仍可记录原始路径的时间.

UI_UO_StatusResponsiveUITip.en: This overlapping integration has not been validated. UO keeps its menu cache suspended.
UI_UO_StatusResponsiveUITip.ch: 此重疊的整合尚未經過驗證. UO 會讓其選單快取保持暫停.
UI_UO_StatusResponsiveUITip.cn: 此重叠的集成尚未经过验证. UO 会让其菜单缓存保持暂停.

UI_UO_StatusScan.ch: 無法取得 MOD 清單

UI_UO_StatusScanTip.en: UO could not read the active mod list. Save a report and inspect console.txt.
UI_UO_StatusScanTip.ch: UO 無法讀取已啟用的 MOD 清單. 請儲存報告並檢查 console.txt.
UI_UO_StatusScanTip.cn: UO 无法读取已启用的模组列表. 请保存报告并检查 console.txt.

UI_UO_StatusTempoTip.en: UO leaves menu optimization to Tempo. Session reports remain available.
UI_UO_StatusTempoTip.ch: UO 將選單最佳化交給 Tempo. 工作階段報告仍可使用.
UI_UO_StatusTempoTip.cn: UO 将菜单优化交给 Tempo. 会话报告仍可使用.

UI_UO_StatusUnavailableTip.en: Start a world session. If this persists, replace the complete mod folder and restart.
UI_UO_StatusUnavailableTip.ch: 請開始世界工作階段. 若問題持續, 請替換整個 MOD 資料夾並重新啟動.
UI_UO_StatusUnavailableTip.cn: 请开始世界会话. 若问题持续, 请替换整个模组文件夹并重新启动.

UI_UO_allowUnverifiedBuilds.ch: 實驗性: 允許未驗證的 B42 版本
UI_UO_allowUnverifiedBuilds.cn: 实验性: 允许未验证的 B42 版本

UI_UO_allowUnverifiedBuildsTip.en: Off by default. On unverified B42 builds, compare every nonempty calculation with the original. Extra checks add work and do not establish full compatibility. Known mod guards remain active.
UI_UO_allowUnverifiedBuildsTip.ch: 預設關閉. 在未驗證的 B42 版本上, 將每次非空的計算與原始計算比對. 額外檢查會增加負擔, 且無法確保完全相容. 已知 MOD 的防護仍會生效.
UI_UO_allowUnverifiedBuildsTip.cn: 默认关闭. 在未验证的 B42 版本上, 将每次非空的计算与原始计算比对. 额外检查会增加开销, 且无法确保完全兼容. 已知模组的防护仍会生效.

UI_UO_menuTimingTip.en: Optional millisecond timing for cached and original calculations. For an OFF run, disable caching while leaving timing enabled. Zero samples can represent sub-millisecond calls. Suspended for known overlapping optimizers.
UI_UO_menuTimingTip.ch: 選用的毫秒計時, 用於快取與原始計算. 若要進行 OFF 測試, 請停用快取但保持計時啟用. 測得 0 毫秒的樣本可能代表不到 1 毫秒的呼叫. 遇到已知的重疊最佳化 MOD 時會暫停.
UI_UO_menuTimingTip.cn: 可选的毫秒计时, 用于缓存和原始计算. 若要进行 OFF 测试, 请禁用缓存但保持计时启用. 测得 0 毫秒的样本可能代表不到 1 毫秒的调用. 遇到已知的重叠优化模组时会暂停.

UI_UO_periodicReportsTip.en: Also write during play at the selected interval. Requires automatic start/end reports. Off by default to reduce disk activity.
UI_UO_periodicReportsTip.ch: 遊玩期間也依所選間隔寫入報告. 需要啟用自動開始/結束報告. 預設關閉以減少磁碟活動.
UI_UO_periodicReportsTip.cn: 游玩期间也按所选间隔写入报告. 需要启用“自动会话报告”. 默认关闭以减少磁盘活动.

UI_UO_reportIntervalSecondsTip.en: 60 to 900 real seconds. Used only when periodic reports are enabled.
UI_UO_reportIntervalSecondsTip.ch: 現實時間 60 到 900 秒. 僅在啟用定期報告時使用.
UI_UO_reportIntervalSecondsTip.cn: 现实时间 60 到 900 秒. 仅在启用定期报告时使用.

UI_BTI_Dose_Warning.en: WARNING: Taking a third medicine before the current effect ends will cause sudden death by systemic failure.
UI_BTI_Dose_Warning.ch: 警告: 在目前藥效結束前第三次服藥, 會因全身性衰竭而猝死.
UI_BTI_Dose_Warning.cn: 警告: 在当前药效结束前第三次服药, 会因全身性衰竭而猝死.

UI_BTI_InfectionPanel.en: Tracks the zombie virus progression and the modifiers applied to your character.
UI_BTI_InfectionPanel.ch: 追蹤殭屍病毒的感染進度, 以及套用在你角色身上的修正效果.
UI_BTI_InfectionPanel.cn: 追踪僵尸病毒的感染进度, 以及作用于你角色的修正效果.

UI_BTI_Info_Healthy.en: You are not infected with the zombie virus.

UI_BTI_Info_Zero.en: The virus is incurable. Medication has reduced it to a minimum, but it will return when its effect wears off.
UI_BTI_Info_Zero.ch: 這種病毒無法治癒. 藥物已將它壓制到最低, 但藥效消退後它就會復發.
UI_BTI_Info_Zero.cn: 这种病毒无法治愈. 药物已将其压制到最低, 但药效消退后它会卷土重来.

UI_BTI_Med_Until.ch: 剩餘阻斷時間: %s 小時
UI_BTI_Med_Until.cn: 剩余阻断时长: %s 小时

UI_BTI_Notif_CravingSatisfied.en: The raw meat craving is satisfied
UI_BTI_Notif_CravingSatisfied.ch: 對生肉的渴望已獲得滿足
UI_BTI_Notif_CravingSatisfied.cn: 对生肉的渴望已得到满足

UI_BTI_Notif_FeedRelief.en: Part of your demons fade away, for now
UI_BTI_Notif_FeedRelief.ch: 你心中的部分惡魔暫時消散了
UI_BTI_Notif_FeedRelief.cn: 你心中的部分恶魔暂时消散了

UI_BTI_Notif_Hydrophobia.en: Water makes you sick (intensity %s%%) — you fear drinking
UI_BTI_Notif_Hydrophobia.ch: 喝水會讓你不適 (強度 %s%%) — 你害怕喝水

UI_options_claimableoutposts_gameplay_no.en: Outpost generation, discovery, and multiplayer gameplay settings are controlled by the server sandbox. Outpost horde attacks use the built-in Dynamic Horde Events-style spawning and attraction system.

UI_options_claimableoutposts_infestation.en: Randomizes each infected-location spread timer above or below its configured day value. 20%% means a 10-day timer is rolled between about 8 and 12 days.
UI_options_claimableoutposts_infestation.ch: 讓每個感染地點的擴散計時器在設定的天數上下隨機浮動. 20%% 表示 10 天的計時器會在約 8 到 12 天之間隨機決定.
UI_options_claimableoutposts_infestation.cn: 让每个感染地点的扩散计时器在设置的天数上下随机浮动. 20%% 表示 10 天的计时器会在约 8 到 12 天之间随机决定.

UI_options_claimableoutposts_mapVisibili.en: Which enabled outposts are revealed is controlled by the world/server sandbox setting. You can still hide all outpost icons locally with the option above.

UI_options_claimableoutposts_rallyAttrac.en: Range of each attraction signal. Actual response depends on nearby simulated zombies, hearing and normal AI. The central outpost square must be loaded.
UI_options_claimableoutposts_rallyAttrac.ch: 每次吸引訊號的範圍. 實際反應取決於附近的模擬殭屍、聽覺與一般 AI. 前哨站中心格必須已載入.
UI_options_claimableoutposts_rallyAttrac.cn: 每次吸引信号的范围. 实际反应取决于附近的模拟僵尸、听觉和常规 AI. 前哨站中心格必须已加载.

UI_options_claimableoutposts_rallyInterv.ch: 集結間隔 (以 10 分鐘為單位)
UI_options_claimableoutposts_rallyInterv.cn: 集结间隔 (以 10 分钟为单位)

UI_options_claimableoutposts_rallyInterv.en: In-game time between attraction attempts, in 10-minute units: 1 = 10 minutes; 3 = 30 minutes; 6 = 1 hour; 12 = 2 hours. Default: 6. Population is rechecked when due. Unloaded attempts are skipped without a backlog.
UI_options_claimableoutposts_rallyInterv.ch: 兩次吸引嘗試之間的遊戲時間, 以 10 分鐘為單位: 1 = 10 分鐘; 3 = 30 分鐘; 6 = 1 小時; 12 = 2 小時. 預設: 6. 時間到時會重新檢查殭屍數量. 未載入時的嘗試會直接略過, 不會累積補做.
UI_options_claimableoutposts_rallyInterv.cn: 两次吸引尝试之间的游戏时间, 以 10 分钟为单位: 1 = 10 分钟; 3 = 30 分钟; 6 = 1 小时; 12 = 2 小时. 默认: 6. 到时会重新检查僵尸数量. 未加载时的尝试会直接跳过, 不会累积补做.

UI_options_claimableoutposts_rallyPoints.en: Unclaimed, infested outposts at threat 4 periodically attract existing nearby zombies. Attraction stops below threat 4 or when claimed. This mechanic adds no zombies.
UI_options_claimableoutposts_rallyPoints.ch: 威脅等級 4 且未佔領的被感染前哨站會定期吸引附近現有的殭屍. 威脅低於 4 或被佔領時即停止吸引. 此機制不會新增殭屍.
UI_options_claimableoutposts_rallyPoints.cn: 威胁等级 4 且未占领的被感染前哨站会定期吸引附近现有的僵尸. 威胁低于 4 或被占领时即停止吸引. 此机制不会新增僵尸.

UI_options_claimableoutposts_rallyPopula.en: Count loaded living zombies within this distance of the center, across all floors. Bandit NPCs are excluded. Attraction stops at 50 plus one zombie for every two world days survived. The added amount is capped at 150: maximum 200 from day 300 onward. Arrivals may exceed the threshold.
UI_options_claimableoutposts_rallyPopula.ch: 計算距中心此距離內所有樓層已載入的存活殭屍, 不包含強盜NPC. 殭屍數量達到 50 加上每存活 2 個世界天數再加 1 隻時即停止吸引. 增加量上限為 150: 從第 300 天起最多 200. 陸續抵達的殭屍可能超過此門檻.
UI_options_claimableoutposts_rallyPopula.cn: 统计距中心此距离内所有楼层已加载的存活僵尸, 不包含强盗NPC. 僵尸数量达到 50 加上每存活 2 个世界天数再加 1 只时即停止吸引. 增加量上限为 150: 从第 300 天起最多 200. 陆续抵达的僵尸可能超过此阈值.

UI_HP_PhaseDown_habit.cn: 好转了: 现在只是习惯而已

UI_HP_PhaseUp_anxiety.cn: 跌到谷底… 现在是焦虑了

UI_HP_TensionAnxious.en: so hot and bothered... I'm getting anxious
UI_HP_TensionAnxious.ch: 慾火焚身… 我開始焦慮了
UI_HP_TensionAnxious.cn: 欲火焚身… 我开始焦虑了

UI_HP_TensionHigh.ch: 我沒辦法專心… 太興奮了!
UI_HP_TensionHigh.cn: 我没法集中精神… 太上头了!

UI_HP_ZombieHands.en: AAAH! NOT while my hands are busy!
