UI_HP_ZombieHands.cn: 啊啊! 我手正忙着呢, 别来!

UI_trait_AdrenalinicoDesc.en: Strong scares and zombie kill streaks give you a RUSH: your arousal goes up and for a while you feel no sleepiness or fatigue... then comes the crash.
UI_trait_AdrenalinicoDesc.ch: 強烈驚嚇和連續擊殺殭屍會讓你「爽」一下: 慾火上升, 一段時間內你不會睏也不會累… 接著就是崩潰.
UI_trait_AdrenalinicoDesc.cn: 强烈惊吓和连续击杀僵尸会让你“爽”一下: 欲火上升, 一段时间内你不会困也不会累… 接着就是崩溃.

UI_trait_ManosQuietasDesc.en: Iron self-control. The counter climbs half as fast and you recover quicker.
UI_trait_ManosQuietasDesc.ch: 鋼鐵般的自制力. 計數上升速度只有一半, 恢復得也更快.
UI_trait_ManosQuietasDesc.cn: 钢铁般的自制力. 计数上升速度只有一半, 恢复得也更快.

UI_trait_PajeroDesc.en: You've already got the itch. You start at Habit, the counter climbs twice as fast and you never fully quit.
UI_trait_PajeroDesc.ch: 你早就有這個癮了. 一開始就處於習慣階段, 計數上升速度兩倍, 而且永遠無法完全戒掉.
UI_trait_PajeroDesc.cn: 你早就有这个瘾了. 一开局就处于习惯阶段, 计数上升速度翻倍, 而且永远无法完全戒掉.

UI_profdesc_CTB_Meyhaneci.en:
Years spent behind a tavern counter: you can smell when a barrel has stalled
and hear when a still is running.
Bottling wine and beer is already second nature,
and a cellar is a calendar rather than a dark room.
UI_profdesc_CTB_Meyhaneci.ch:
在酒館吧檯後待了多年: 你聞得出發酵桶何時停滯
也聽得出蒸餾器何時在運轉.
葡萄酒與啤酒裝瓶早已成了第二天性,
酒窖對你來說是一本日曆, 而不是一間暗房.
UI_profdesc_CTB_Meyhaneci.cn:
在酒馆吧台后待了多年: 你闻得出发酵桶何时停滞
也听得出蒸馏器何时在运转.
给葡萄酒和啤酒装瓶早已成为本能,
酒窖对你来说是一本日历, 而不是一间暗室.

UI_trait_CTB_CirakDesc.en:
A summer spent behind the counter: washing barrels, carrying buckets,
watching the master gauge the must.
Only just starting a pot of your own.
UI_trait_CTB_CirakDesc.ch:
在吧檯後度過了一個夏天: 洗木桶、提水桶,
看著師傅估量果漿.
才剛開始釀自己的第一鍋.
UI_trait_CTB_CirakDesc.cn:
在吧台后度过了一个夏天: 洗木桶、提水桶,
看着师傅估量果浆.
才刚开始酿自己的第一锅.

UI_trait_CTB_MeyhaneciDesc.en:
The badge of the Tavern Keeper profession.
The language of barrel, still and cellar was learnt on the job.
UI_trait_CTB_MeyhaneciDesc.ch:
酒館老闆職業的標誌.
發酵桶、蒸餾器與酒窖的門道, 都是在工作中學會的.
UI_trait_CTB_MeyhaneciDesc.cn:
酒馆老板职业的标志.
发酵桶、蒸馏器和酒窖的门道, 都是在工作中学会的.

UI_OverTheShoulder_DoubleTapHold_tooltip.en: A double tap of the look key keeps the head following the mouse until the key is pressed again. A tap still glances and holding the key still follows the mouse.
UI_OverTheShoulder_DoubleTapHold_tooltip.ch: 連按兩下回望鍵後, 頭部會持續跟隨滑鼠, 直到再按一次該鍵. 輕按仍為一瞥, 按住仍會跟隨滑鼠.
UI_OverTheShoulder_DoubleTapHold_tooltip.cn: 双击回望键后, 头部会持续跟随鼠标, 直到再次按下该键. 点击仍为瞥视, 按住仍会跟随鼠标.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_Look_tooltip.en: How the briefing looks. Every look shows the lines you switch on above, at the position and text size set below (Emergency Broadcast becomes a full-width bar in the centre positions; Cinematic always uses the whole screen). To try them all on your own character, right-click in the world and pick "Survivor Briefing: test looks".
UI_SurvivorBriefing_Look_tooltip.ch: 簡報的外觀. 每種外觀都會顯示你在上方開啟的資訊行, 並使用下方設定的位置與文字大小 (緊急廣播在置中位置會變成全寬橫條; 電影外觀一律使用整個螢幕). 若要在自己的角色上逐一試用, 請在世界中按右鍵並選擇「倖存者簡報: 測試外觀」.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_Look_tooltip.cn: 简报的外观. 每种外观都会显示你在上方开启的信息行, 并使用下方设置的位置和文本大小 (紧急广播在居中位置会变成全宽横条; 电影外观始终使用整个屏幕). 若要在自己的角色上逐一试用, 请在世界中右键点击并选择“幸存者简报: 测试外观”.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_dailySunrise_tooltip.en: Shows the daily briefing at sunrise instead of at the hour above. Sunrise follows the game's seasons: earlier in summer, later in winter. If the world has no sunrise (Endless Day or Endless Night), the hour above is used.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_dailySunrise_tooltip.ch: 在日出時顯示每日簡報, 而不是在上方設定的時刻. 日出時間依遊戲季節而變: 夏天較早, 冬天較晚. 若世界沒有日出 (永晝模式或永夜模式), 則使用上方的時刻.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_dailySunrise_tooltip.cn: 在日出时显示每日简报, 而不是在上方设置的时刻. 日出时间随游戏季节变化: 夏天较早, 冬天较晚. 如果世界没有日出 (永昼模式或永夜模式), 则使用上方的时刻.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_looksMenu.en: Looks window in the right-click menu
UI_SurvivorBriefing_looksMenu.ch: 右鍵選單中的外觀視窗
UI_SurvivorBriefing_looksMenu.cn: 右键菜单中的外观窗口

UI_SurvivorBriefing_looksMenu_tooltip.en: Adds "Survivor Briefing: test looks" to the menu you get by right-clicking in the world, to try every look on your own character and keep the one you like. Off: the entry is gone.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_looksMenu_tooltip.ch: 在世界中按右鍵開啟的選單裡加入「倖存者簡報: 測試外觀」, 讓你在自己的角色上試用每種外觀, 並保留喜歡的那一種. 關閉: 該選項會消失.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_looksMenu_tooltip.cn: 在世界中右键点击打开的菜单里添加“幸存者简报: 测试外观”, 让你在自己的角色上试用每种外观, 并保留喜欢的那一种. 关闭: 该选项会消失.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_onTown_tooltip.en: Shows the briefing when you walk or drive into a town or a named area such as the airport. Not again for the same place within 6 in-game hours, and not when you only skirt its edge.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_onTown_tooltip.ch: 當你步行或開車進入城鎮或具名區域 (例如機場) 時顯示簡報. 同一地點在遊戲內 6 小時內不會再次顯示, 只是擦過邊緣時也不會顯示.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_onTown_tooltip.cn: 当你步行或驾车进入城镇或有名称的区域 (例如机场) 时显示简报. 同一地点在游戏内6小时内不会再次显示, 只是擦过边缘时也不会显示.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_showOutbreakDay_tool.en: Which day of the Knox Event it is. The outbreak began on July 4, 1993 (the in-game radio says so), so July 4 is day 1 and the usual start, July 9, is day 6. Not shown before July 4. With "Only what your character can know" on, it needs the date, like the Date line.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_showOutbreakDay_tool.ch: 現在是諾克斯事件的第幾天. 疫情於 1993 年 7 月 4 日爆發 (遊戲內的廣播是這麼說的), 所以 7 月 4 日是第 1 天, 一般的開局日 7 月 9 日是第 6 天. 7 月 4 日之前不會顯示. 開啟「只顯示角色能得知的資訊」時, 和「日期」行一樣需要知道日期.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_showOutbreakDay_tool.cn: 现在是诺克斯事件的第几天. 疫情于1993年7月4日爆发 (游戏内的广播是这么说的), 所以7月4日是第1天, 通常的开局日7月9日是第6天. 7月4日之前不显示. 开启“仅显示角色可知信息”时, 和“日期”行一样需要知道日期.

UI_SNS_Options_KeyTip.en: Key for the list of your sensor networks (admins: all networks).
UI_SNS_Options_KeyTip.ch: 開啟你的感應網路清單的按鍵 (管理員: 所有網路).
UI_SNS_Options_KeyTip.cn: 打开你的感应网络列表的按键 (管理员: 所有网络).

UI_SNS_Options_Title.ch: 廢料場哨兵 - 感應柱
UI_SNS_Options_Title.cn: 废料场哨兵 - 感应柱

UI_SNT_Options_Title.ch: 廢料場哨兵: 砲塔與防禦系統
UI_SNT_Options_Title.cn: 废料场哨兵: 炮塔与防御系统

UI_HydeCoUG_MineOreNeedsTool.en: Needs a pickaxe, hammer or stone maul.
UI_HydeCoUG_MineOreNeedsTool.ch: 需要丁字鎬, 錘子或石質重錘.
UI_HydeCoUG_MineOreNeedsTool.cn: 需要丁字镐, 锤子或石质重锤.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_AirFoul.en: The air is foul. You can taste it.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_AirFoul.ch: 空氣汙濁. 你嘗得到那股味道.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_AirFoul.cn: 空气污浊. 你尝得到那股味道.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_AirStale.en: The air down here is stale and heavy.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_AirStale.ch: 這下面的空氣不流通, 又悶又重.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_AirStale.cn: 这下面的空气不流通, 又闷又重.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_BeamHere.ch: 這裡已經立了一根支柱.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_BeamHere.cn: 这里已经立了一根支柱.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_BlastOpened.en: The blast broke %1 squares of rock.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_BlastOpened.ch: 爆破炸開了 %1 格岩石.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_BlastOpened.cn: 爆破炸开了 %1 格岩石.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_BlastRoom.en: The charge went off inside a room. Only the walls to break, and dynamite will not take those down.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_BlastRoom.ch: 炸藥在房間內爆炸. 只有牆壁可炸, 而炸藥炸不倒那些牆.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_BlastRoom.cn: 炸药在房间内爆炸. 只有墙壁可炸, 而炸药炸不倒那些墙.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_BreathingNone.en: Nothing on your face and nothing on your back.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_BreathingNone.ch: 臉上沒戴東西, 背上也沒背東西.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_BreathingNone.cn: 脸上没戴东西, 背上也没背东西.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_ClimbNoOpening.en: There is rock straight above you.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_CutBarsTo.ch: 切斷柵欄 (通往 %1 的管道)
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_CutBarsTo.cn: 切断栅栏 (通往 %1 的管道)

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_DigUpOn.en: Digging up. Swing at the floor in front to open the rock above it.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_DigUpOn.ch: 往上挖掘. 朝前方地面揮擊, 可打通其上方的岩石.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_DigUpOn.cn: 往上挖掘. 朝前方地面挥击, 可打通其上方的岩石.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_FlameLow.en: Your flame burns low and blue.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_FlameLow.ch: 你的火焰變得微弱, 呈現藍色.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_FlameLow.cn: 你的火焰变得微弱, 呈现蓝色.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_FlameOut.ch: 你的火焰閃了幾下就熄滅了
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_FlameOut.cn: 你的火焰闪了几下就熄灭了

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_GrateDry.en: There is nothing under this one worth opening.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_GrateDry.ch: 這個底下沒有值得打開的東西.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_GrateDry.cn: 这个底下没有值得打开的东西.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_GrateNoRoom.en: There is nowhere beside it to slide the grate.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_GrateNoRoom.ch: 旁邊沒有地方可以把格柵推開.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_GrateNoRoom.cn: 旁边没有地方可以把格栅推开.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_GrateNoTool.en: You need a crowbar to get under the edge of it.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_GrateNoTool.ch: 你需要撬棍才能撬進它的邊緣底下.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_GrateNoTool.cn: 你需要撬棍才能撬进它的边缘底下.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsCut.en: Something sharp in the rock cuts your hand.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsCut.ch: 岩石裡的尖銳物割傷了你的手.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsCut.cn: 岩石里的尖锐物割伤了你的手.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsHint.en: Bare hands: hold Shift and swing at rock to the north or west to claw stairs up.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsHint.ch: 徒手: 按住 Shift 朝北方或西方的岩石揮擊, 可以扒出往上的樓梯.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsHint.cn: 徒手: 按住 Shift 朝北方或西方的岩石挥击, 可以扒出往上的楼梯.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsNorthWest.en: By hand you can only claw stairs up into rock to the north or west.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsNorthWest.ch: 徒手只能朝北方或西方的岩石扒出往上的樓梯.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsNorthWest.cn: 徒手只能朝北方或西方的岩石扒出往上的楼梯.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsOnlyUp.en: Bare-handed, you can only claw your way up.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsOnlyUp.ch: 赤手空拳時, 你只能往上扒出一條路.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsOnlyUp.cn: 赤手空拳时, 你只能往上扒出一条路.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HoleNeedsGear.en: Needs a wooden ladder or a grappling hook.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_LadderLowerTip.en: A wooden ladder reaches one level down.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_LadderTooDeep.en: Too deep for a wooden ladder.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_LidGone.en: The cover has been taken away.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_LidShutPush.en: The cover is back on. You will push it off on your way out.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_LidShutPush.ch: 蓋子已蓋回去. 你出去時會把它推開.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_LidShutPush.cn: 盖子已盖回去. 你出去时会把它推开.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_LidUnderVehicle.en: There is a vehicle parked over this manhole.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_LidUnderVehicle.ch: 有一輛車停在這個人孔上方.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_LidUnderVehicle.cn: 有一辆车停在这个检查井上方.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_MineOpenTip.en: The boards come off for good and you keep the planks.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_MineOpenTip.ch: 木板會永久拆除, 你可以保留木板.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_MineOpenTip.cn: 木板会永久拆除, 你可以保留木板.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_MineOpenTool.en: Needs a crowbar or a hammer.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_MiningHintShaft.en: Ctrl + swing at the floor: a shaft
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_MiningHintShaft.ch: Ctrl + 朝地面揮擊: 豎井
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_MiningHintShaft.cn: Ctrl + 朝地面挥击: 竖井

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_MiningHintStairs.en: Ctrl + Shift + swing: stairs, up to the north or west, down to the south or east
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_MiningHintStairs.ch: Ctrl + Shift + 揮擊: 樓梯, 往北方或西方向上, 往南方或東方向下
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_MiningHintStairs.cn: Ctrl + Shift + 挥击: 楼梯, 往北方或西方向上, 往南方或东方向下

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_MiningOn.en: Mining on. Your swings dig now.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_MiningOn.ch: 採礦模式開啟. 你的揮擊現在會挖掘.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_MiningOn.cn: 采矿模式开启. 你的挥击现在会挖掘.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedBarsKit.en: Needs a propane torch with 3 uses and a welder mask or welding goggles.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedBarsKit.ch: 需要剩餘 3 次使用的丙烷噴燈, 以及焊工面罩或焊接護目鏡.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedBarsKit.cn: 需要剩余 3 次使用的丙烷喷灯, 以及焊工面罩或焊接护目镜.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedBeamMaterials.en: You need two planks and two nails.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedBeamMaterials.ch: 你需要兩塊木板和兩根釘子.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedBeamMaterials.cn: 你需要两块木板和两根钉子.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedCutKit.en: Needs a propane torch with 2 uses and a welder mask or welding goggles.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedCutKit.ch: 需要剩餘 2 次使用的丙烷噴燈, 以及焊工面罩或焊接護目鏡.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedCutKit.cn: 需要剩余 2 次使用的丙烷喷灯, 以及焊工面罩或焊接护目镜.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedPickaxe.en: You need a pickaxe to cut into that.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedPickaxe.ch: 你需要丁字鎬才能鑿開那個.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedPickaxe.cn: 你需要丁字镐才能凿开那个.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedPry.en: You need a crowbar to lift this.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedPry.ch: 你需要撬棍才能抬起這個.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedPry.cn: 你需要撬棍才能抬起这个.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedRope.en: You need a rope or a sheet rope.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedSackDirt.en: You need an empty sack to carry the dirt.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedSackDirt.ch: 你需要一個空麻袋來裝泥土.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedSackDirt.cn: 你需要一个空麻袋来装泥土.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedSackGravel.en: You need an empty sack to carry the gravel.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedSackGravel.ch: 你需要一個空麻袋來裝碎石.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedSackGravel.cn: 你需要一个空麻袋来装碎石.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedSackSand.en: You need an empty sack to carry the sand.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedSackSand.ch: 你需要一個空麻袋來裝沙子.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedSackSand.cn: 你需要一个空麻袋来装沙子.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedShovel.en: You need a shovel or a pickaxe to dig down through earth.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedShovel.ch: 你需要鏟子或丁字鎬才能往下挖穿泥土.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedShovel.cn: 你需要铲子或丁字镐才能往下挖穿泥土.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedSledgehammer.en: You need a sledgehammer for masonry.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedSledgehammer.ch: 你需要大錘才能敲開砌體.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedSledgehammer.cn: 你需要大锤才能敲开砌体.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedStakeRope.en: You need a stake, a rope, and a hammer, pickaxe or sledgehammer.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedStakeRope.ch: 你需要一根木樁, 一條繩索, 以及錘子, 丁字鎬或大錘.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedStakeRope.cn: 你需要一根木桩, 一条绳索, 以及锤子, 丁字镐或大锤.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedTorch.en: Needs a propane torch and a welder mask.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedTorch.ch: 需要丙烷噴燈和焊工面罩.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedTorch.cn: 需要丙烷喷灯和焊工面罩.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedWeldKit.en: Needs a propane torch with 2 uses, welding rods with 2 uses and a welder mask or welding goggles.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedWeldKit.ch: 需要剩餘 2 次使用的丙烷噴燈, 剩餘 2 次使用的焊條, 以及焊工面罩或焊接護目鏡.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NeedWeldKit.cn: 需要剩余 2 次使用的丙烷喷灯, 剩余 2 次使用的焊条, 以及焊工面罩或焊接护目镜.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NetPoolEmpty.en: The net comes up with nothing this time.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NetPoolEmpty.ch: 這次網子什麼也沒撈到.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NetPoolEmpty.cn: 这次网子什么也没捞到.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NoFloorForPit.en: You need three clear squares of your own tunnel ahead of you.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NoFloorForPit.ch: 你前方需要有三格屬於你自己隧道的淨空地面.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NoFloorForPit.cn: 你前方需要有三格属于你自己隧道的净空地面.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NoLadder.en: There is no ladder to climb here.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NoLadder.ch: 這裡沒有可以爬的梯子.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NoLadder.cn: 这里没有可以爬的梯子.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NoRoomForStairs.en: Not enough solid ground here for a flight of stairs.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NoRoomForStairs.ch: 這裡沒有足夠的堅實地面可以挖一段樓梯.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_NoRoomForStairs.cn: 这里没有足够的坚实地面可以挖一段楼梯.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptCanaryKey_toolti.en: Turns it on or off. There is no key until you pick one.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptCanaryKey_toolti.ch: 切換開啟或關閉. 在你選定按鍵之前不會有按鍵.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptCanaryKey_toolti.cn: 切换开启或关闭. 在你选定按键之前不会有按键.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptCanary_tooltip.en: Shows the carried canary beside the clock. Its warnings still show over your head with it hidden.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptCanary_tooltip.ch: 在時鐘旁顯示攜帶的金絲雀. 隱藏時, 牠的警告仍會顯示在你頭上.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptCanary_tooltip.cn: 在时钟旁显示携带的金丝雀. 隐藏时, 它的警告仍会显示在你头上.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptDepthKey.en: Show or hide the depth meter

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptDepthKey_tooltip.en: Turns it on or off. There is no key until you pick one.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptDepthKey_tooltip.ch: 切換開啟或關閉. 在你選定按鍵之前不會有按鍵.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptDepthKey_tooltip.cn: 切换开启或关闭. 在你选定按键之前不会有按键.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptDepth_tooltip.en: Shows the depth reading from a worn depth meter.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptDepth_tooltip.ch: 顯示所配戴深度計的深度讀數.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptDepth_tooltip.cn: 显示所佩戴深度计的深度读数.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptEnvLineKey.en: Show or hide the environment line

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptEnvLineKey_toolt.en: Turns the environment line on or off. There is no key until you pick one.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptEnvLineKey_toolt.ch: 切換環境列開啟或關閉. 在你選定按鍵之前不會有按鍵.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptEnvLineKey_toolt.cn: 切换环境栏开启或关闭. 在你选定按键之前不会有按键.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptEnvLine_tooltip.en: Shows the red or green line under the clock row that says whether the air where you stand is safe.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptEnvLine_tooltip.ch: 在時鐘列下方顯示紅色或綠色的一行, 指出你所在位置的空氣是否安全.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptEnvLine_tooltip.cn: 在时钟栏下方显示红色或绿色的一行, 指出你所在位置的空气是否安全.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptFilterKey_toolti.en: Turns it on or off. There is no key until you pick one.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptFilterKey_toolti.ch: 切換開啟或關閉. 在你選定按鍵之前不會有按鍵.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptFilterKey_toolti.cn: 切换开启或关闭. 在你选定按键之前不会有按键.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptFilter_tooltip.en: Shows the filter gauge from a worn gas mask or respirator.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptFilter_tooltip.ch: 顯示所配戴防毒面具或呼吸器的濾芯量表.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptFilter_tooltip.cn: 显示所佩戴防毒面具或呼吸器的滤芯量表.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptO2LevelsKey_tool.en: Turns it on or off. There is no key until you pick one.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptO2LevelsKey_tool.ch: 切換開啟或關閉. 在你選定按鍵之前不會有按鍵.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptO2LevelsKey_tool.cn: 切换开启或关闭. 在你选定按键之前不会有按键.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptO2Levels_tooltip.en: Shows the O2 levels gauge from a carried oxygen sensor.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptO2Levels_tooltip.ch: 顯示所攜帶氧氣偵測器的氧氣含量量表.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptO2Levels_tooltip.cn: 显示所携带氧气检测仪的氧气含量量表.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptOxygenKey.en: Show or hide the oxygen supply

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptOxygenKey_toolti.en: Turns it on or off. There is no key until you pick one.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptOxygenKey_toolti.ch: 切換開啟或關閉. 在你選定按鍵之前不會有按鍵.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptOxygenKey_toolti.cn: 切换开启或关闭. 在你选定按键之前不会有按键.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptOxygen_tooltip.en: Shows the oxygen supply gauge from a worn air tank.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptOxygen_tooltip.ch: 顯示所背氣瓶的供氧量表.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptOxygen_tooltip.cn: 显示所背气瓶的供氧量表.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptPerfReport_toolt.en: From your next launch, times how long this mod's code takes and writes it once a minute to HydeCoUnderGround_HandlerTimes.txt in the Lua folder inside your Zomboid folder. Leave it off unless you are checking performance.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptPerfReport_toolt.ch: 從下次啟動遊戲起, 記錄本模組程式碼執行所花的時間, 每分鐘寫入一次到 Zomboid 資料夾內 Lua 資料夾中的 HydeCoUnderGround_HandlerTimes.txt. 除非你在檢查效能, 否則請保持關閉.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptPerfReport_toolt.cn: 从下次启动游戏起, 记录本模组代码运行所花的时间, 每分钟写入一次到 Zomboid 文件夹内 Lua 文件夹中的 HydeCoUnderGround_HandlerTimes.txt. 除非你在检查性能, 否则请保持关闭.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptPickaxeKey.en: Show or hide the mining pickaxe
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptPickaxeKey.ch: 顯示或隱藏採礦丁字鎬
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptPickaxeKey.cn: 显示或隐藏采矿丁字镐

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptPickaxeKey_toolt.en: Turns it on or off. There is no key until you pick one.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptPickaxeKey_toolt.ch: 切換開啟或關閉. 在你選定按鍵之前不會有按鍵.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptPickaxeKey_toolt.cn: 切换开启或关闭. 在你选定按键之前不会有按键.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptPickaxe_tooltip.en: Shows the pickaxe beside the clock that lights up while mining mode is on. Mining mode still works with it hidden.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptPickaxe_tooltip.ch: 在時鐘旁顯示丁字鎬圖示, 採礦模式開啟時會亮起. 隱藏時採礦模式仍可運作.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_OptPickaxe_tooltip.cn: 在时钟旁显示丁字镐图标, 采矿模式开启时会亮起. 隐藏时采矿模式仍可运行.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_PlaceNotDrop.en: Too big to just put down. Place it instead.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_PlaceNotDrop.ch: 太大了, 不能直接丟下. 請改用放置.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_PlaceNotDrop.cn: 太大了, 不能直接丢下. 请改用放置.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_PreparedToRemove.ch: 已移除諾克斯地下世界特質
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_PreparedToRemove.cn: 已移除诺克斯地下世界特质

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_RopeLetDownTip.en: Hooks the grappling hook on the edge and lets the rope down. Take the rope down to get the hook back.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_RopeLetDownTip.ch: 將抓鉤勾在邊緣並放下繩索. 收回繩索即可拿回抓鉤.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_RopeLetDownTip.cn: 将抓钩勾在边缘并放下绳索. 收回绳索即可拿回抓钩.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SafeHouse.en: You cannot dig on someone else's safehouse.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SafeHouse.ch: 你不能在別人的安全屋挖掘.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SafeHouse.cn: 你不能在别人的安全屋挖掘.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SetBeam.en: Set a mine prop (2 planks, 2 nails)
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SetBeam.ch: 架設礦坑支柱 (2 塊木板, 2 根釘子)
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SetBeam.cn: 架设矿坑支柱 (2 块木板, 2 根钉子)

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_Shaft.en: Digging here would cut into the well shaft.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_Shaft.ch: 在這裡挖掘會挖穿井的豎井.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_Shaft.cn: 在这里挖掘会挖穿井的竖井.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_ShaftBlocked.en: There is nothing below this square to dig into.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_ShaftBlocked.ch: 這一格下方沒有可以挖的東西.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_ShaftBlocked.cn: 这一格下方没有可以挖的东西.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SporeHalo2.en: The spores are getting to you

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SporeHalo3.ch: 你被孢子嗆得喘不過氣
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SporeHalo3.cn: 你被孢子呛得喘不过气

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SporeMoodle_1.en: You can taste the spores in the air.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SporeMoodle_1.ch: 你嘗得到空氣中的孢子.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SporeMoodle_1.cn: 你尝得到空气中的孢子.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SporeMoodle_2.en: Your throat is raw and you keep coughing.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SporeMoodle_2.ch: 你的喉嚨疼痛, 咳個不停.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SporeMoodle_2.cn: 你的喉咙疼痛, 咳个不停.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SporeMoodle_3.en: You are breathing more spore than air.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SporeMoodle_3.ch: 你吸進的孢子比空氣還多.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SporeMoodle_3.cn: 你吸进的孢子比空气还多.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsArrival.en: There is nowhere to step off at the top.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsArrival.ch: 頂端沒有可以踏出去的地方.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsArrival.cn: 顶端没有可以踏出去的地方.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsDirection.en: Stairs can only be dug to the north or the west.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsDirection.ch: 樓梯只能往北方或西方挖.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsDirection.cn: 楼梯只能往北方或西方挖.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsHeadroom.en: There is open space over the steps that is not yours to take out.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsHeadroom.ch: 台階上方有不屬於你、不能挖除的空間.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsHeadroom.cn: 台阶上方有不属于你、不能挖除的空间.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsOpen.en: There is already open space where the steps would go.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsOpen.ch: 台階要挖的位置已經有空間了.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsOpen.cn: 台阶要挖的位置已经有空间了.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsOthers.en: That would cut into somebody else's floor.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsOthers.ch: 那樣會挖穿別人的地板.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsOthers.cn: 那样会挖穿别人的地板.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsSewer.en: You cannot cut steps into the sewer itself.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsSewer.ch: 你不能在下水道本身挖台階.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StairsSewer.cn: 你不能在下水道本身挖台阶.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StaleLayout.en: Knox Underground: your saved basement layout for this server is from before the mod was added, so the sewers and caves won't work for you. Quit, delete map_basements.bin from Zomboid/saves/Multiplayer/%1, and join again.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StaleLayout.ch: 諾克斯地下世界: 你在這個伺服器儲存的地下室配置是在加入本模組之前建立的, 因此下水道與洞穴對你無法運作. 請退出, 從 Zomboid/saves/Multiplayer/%1 刪除 map_basements.bin, 然後重新加入.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StaleLayout.cn: 诺克斯地下世界: 你在这个服务器保存的地下室布局是在加入本模组之前创建的, 因此下水道和洞穴对你无法运行. 请退出, 从 Zomboid/saves/Multiplayer/%1 删除 map_basements.bin, 然后重新加入.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StaleLayoutSP.en: Knox Underground: this save's basement layout was made without the mod's sewers, caves and mines, so it has no underground. To add it: quit, delete map_basements.bin from Zomboid/Saves/%1, and load the save again. House basements stay as they are; places you have already been stay without the underground.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StaleLayoutSP.ch: 諾克斯地下世界: 這個存檔的地下室配置在建立時沒有本模組的下水道, 洞穴與礦坑, 因此沒有地下世界. 若要加入: 請退出, 從 Zomboid/Saves/%1 刪除 map_basements.bin, 然後重新載入存檔. 房屋地下室會維持原樣; 你已經去過的地方仍不會有地下世界.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StaleLayoutSP.cn: 诺克斯地下世界: 这个存档的地下室布局在创建时没有本模组的下水道, 洞穴和矿坑, 因此没有地下世界. 如果要加入: 请退出, 从 Zomboid/Saves/%1 删除 map_basements.bin, 然后重新加载存档. 房屋地下室会保持原样; 你已经去过的地方仍不会有地下世界.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StreetMinesAdmins.en: Only admins can start a mine from the street here.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StreetMinesAdmins.ch: 這裡只有管理員能從街道開挖礦坑.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StreetMinesAdmins.cn: 这里只有管理员能从街道开挖矿坑.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StreetMinesOff.en: Mines cannot be started from the street here.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StreetMinesOff.ch: 這裡不能從街道開挖礦坑.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StreetMinesOff.cn: 这里不能从街道开挖矿坑.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateBelow.en: White threads are running through it. Down here in the dark it will fruit in a few days.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateBelow.ch: 白色菌絲正在裡面蔓延. 在這下面的黑暗中, 幾天後就會出菇.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateBelow.cn: 白色菌丝正在里面蔓延. 在这下面的黑暗中, 几天后就会出菇.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateNeedFork.en: Spent straw has to be broken up. You need a shovel, a garden fork or a rake.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateNeedFork.ch: 用過的稻草需要打散. 你需要鏟子, 園藝叉或釘耙.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateNeedFork.cn: 用过的稻草需要打散. 你需要铲子, 园艺叉或钉耙.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateNeedSack.en: Spent straw is compost. You need an empty sack to put it in.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateNeedSack.ch: 用過的稻草是堆肥. 你需要一個空麻袋來裝.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateNeedSack.cn: 用过的稻草是堆肥. 你需要一个空麻袋来装.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateNeedShovel.en: A stump has to be dug out. You need a shovel.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateNeedShovel.ch: 樹樁需要挖出來. 你需要鏟子.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateNeedShovel.cn: 树桩需要挖出来. 你需要铲子.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateNeedSpores.en: You need %1 spore prints of %2. You have %3.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateNeedSpores.ch: 你需要 %1 張 %2 孢子印. 你有 %3 張.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateNeedSpores.cn: 你需要 %1 张 %2 孢子印. 你有 %3 张.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateSurface.en: Nothing will take up out here. Carry it down below ground and sow it there.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateSurface.ch: 在外面什麼都長不起來. 把它帶到地下再播種.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SubstrateSurface.cn: 在外面什么都长不起来. 把它带到地下再播种.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SurfaceBlocked.en: You need open ground overhead to sink a shaft here.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SurfaceBlocked.ch: 你需要上方是開闊的地面, 才能在這裡開鑿豎井.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_SurfaceBlocked.cn: 你需要上方是开阔的地面, 才能在这里开凿竖井.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_TieRope.en: Tie a rope to the well

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_TieRopeFailed.en: The rope would not tie here.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_TipSection.ch: 下水道區段 %1 - %2 個入口
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_TipSection.cn: 下水道区段 %1 - %2 个入口

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_UpBlocked.en: There is no plain rock above this square to dig into.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_UpBlocked.ch: 這一格上方沒有可以挖的一般岩石.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_UpBlocked.cn: 这一格上方没有可以挖的普通岩石.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_UpStreet.en: The street is right above. Dig stairs up instead.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_UpStreet.ch: 正上方就是街道. 改挖往上的樓梯吧.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_UpStreet.cn: 正上方就是街道. 改挖往上的楼梯吧.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeClimbTip.en: Throws the grappling hook up to the first edge in reach and climbs the rope. Take the rope down to get the hook back. On the rope, press forward to climb up or back to climb down.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeClimbTip.ch: 把抓鉤擲向可及範圍內的第一個邊緣, 並沿繩索攀爬. 收回繩索即可拿回抓鉤. 在繩索上, 按前進往上爬, 按後退往下爬.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeClimbTip.cn: 把抓钩抛向可及范围内的第一个边缘, 并沿绳索攀爬. 收回绳索即可拿回抓钩. 在绳索上, 按前进往上爬, 按后退往下爬.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeNeedClip.en: You need a carabiner to climb.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeNeedClip.ch: 你需要登山扣才能攀爬.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeNeedClip.cn: 你需要登山扣才能攀爬.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeNoCatch.en: Nothing in reach for the hook to catch on.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeNoCatch.ch: 可及範圍內沒有能讓抓鉤勾住的地方.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeNoCatch.cn: 可及范围内没有能让抓钩勾住的地方.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeNoWall.en: There is no wall here to climb.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeNoWall.ch: 這裡沒有可以攀爬的牆.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeNoWall.cn: 这里没有可以攀爬的墙.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeOverhead.en: There is no room above you to throw it.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeOverhead.ch: 你上方沒有空間可以擲出它.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeOverhead.cn: 你上方没有空间可以抛出它.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeRealisticTi.en: Realistic climbing: you can fall if you are tired, heavily loaded or hurt.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeRealisticTi.ch: 擬真攀爬: 疲累, 負重過重或受傷時可能摔落.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeRealisticTi.cn: 拟真攀爬: 疲惫, 负重过重或受伤时可能摔落.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeWeak.en: You are not strong enough to climb a wall on a rope.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeWeak.ch: 你的力量不足以靠繩索攀牆.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WallRopeWeak.cn: 你的力量不足以靠绳索攀墙.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_WellDry.en: This one just ends in dirt.

UI_profdesc_HCUG_Miner.en: You worked the seams before the world ended. You start with three levels of Mining, know the powder work and the furnace work, and swing a pick like you mean it.
UI_profdesc_HCUG_Miner.ch: 世界末日前你在礦層裡工作. 你開局擁有三級採礦技能, 懂得火藥作業與熔爐作業, 揮起丁字鎬來毫不含糊.
UI_profdesc_HCUG_Miner.cn: 世界末日前你在矿层里工作. 你开局拥有三级采矿技能, 懂得火药作业和熔炉作业, 挥起丁字镐来毫不含糊.

UI_trait_HCUG_BadBackDesc.en:
Less knockback from melee weapons.
Decreased carrying weight.
Every swing of a pick or shovel below ground costs you more breath.
UI_trait_HCUG_BadBackDesc.ch:
近戰武器的擊退效果降低.
負重能力減少.
在地下每次揮動丁字鎬或鏟子都會消耗你更多體力.
UI_trait_HCUG_BadBackDesc.cn:
近战武器的击退效果降低.
负重能力减少.
在地下每次挥动丁字镐或铲子都会消耗你更多体力.

UI_trait_HCUG_DeepLungsDesc.en: Stale air and foul air below ground wear on you at half the rate.
UI_trait_HCUG_DeepLungsDesc.ch: 地下不流通與汙濁的空氣對你的消耗速度減半.
UI_trait_HCUG_DeepLungsDesc.cn: 地下不流通和污浊的空气对你的消耗速度减半.

UI_trait_HCUG_MinerDesc.en:
At home in tight spaces below ground.
Cannot be Claustrophobic.
UI_trait_HCUG_MinerDesc.ch:
在地下狹窄空間中也能自在活動.
不能同時擁有「幽閉恐懼症」特質.
UI_trait_HCUG_MinerDesc.cn:
在地下狭窄空间中也能自在活动.
不能同时拥有“幽闭恐惧”特质.

UI_SMA_AdminAsleep.en: The player is asleep: the game adds no XP to a sleeper.

UI_SMA_Guide_Common.en: <H2> Learn and practise <LINE> <TEXT> Close this guide and choose Read on the magazine to learn the style. Opening these pages alone does not teach it. Finish reading; interrupted reading does not grant the style. <LINE> <LINE> Martial Arts is one skill, from level 0 to 10, shared by every style. Each level raises your attack speed and damage and lowers the endurance each strike costs. Every style also has its own hidden mastery, from 0 to 5. Landing hits with a style trains the skill and that style's mastery. You begin with two combinations. Each mastery level unlocks four more, longer ones, and mastery 2, 3, 4 and 5 each unlock a special, which is a heavy attack. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Controls <LINE> <TEXT> Keep both hands free of ordinary equipment. Aim and attack to begin. Hold attack to continue the combination; release it to finish the current strike. Release aim to cancel. Aim toward a fallen zombie and use the floor-attack control when necessary. <LINE> <LINE> Right-click the ground and choose Martial Arts, or press K, to open the Martial Arts window. Choose the style you fight with there and see each style's mastery and everything it unlocks; click an unlocked heavy attack of your active style to equip it. Default keys: Backslash cycles learned styles; R uses the equipped special; K opens the window. All of them can be rebound in Options. <LINE> <LINE> Every strike costs endurance, including misses. Moving strikes cost 12% more, and each skill level improves efficiency and stance footwork. Watch your endurance. Higher skill improves speed but does not remove fatigue or attack recovery. Specials have no timed cooldown.
UI_SMA_Guide_Common.ch: <H2> 學習與練習 <LINE> <TEXT> 關閉本指南, 然後對雜誌選擇「閱讀」以學會該流派. 只翻開這些頁面並不會學會. 必須讀完; 中斷閱讀不會習得該流派. <LINE> <LINE> 武術是單一技能, 從 0 級到 10 級, 所有流派共用. 每提升一級都會提高攻擊速度與傷害, 並降低每次出招消耗的耐力. 每個流派另有各自的隱藏精通度, 從 0 到 5. 使用某個流派命中目標會同時訓練此技能與該流派的精通度. 一開始你會有兩個連段. 每提升一級精通度會再解鎖四個更長的連段, 而精通度 2、3、4、5 各會解鎖一個特殊技, 也就是重擊. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 操作 <LINE> <TEXT> 雙手不要拿一般裝備. 瞄準並攻擊即可開始. 按住攻擊可延續連段; 放開則完成目前這一擊. 放開瞄準即可取消. 必要時瞄準倒地的殭屍並使用地面攻擊操作. <LINE> <LINE> 在地面按右鍵並選擇「武術」, 或按 K, 即可開啟武術視窗. 你可以在那裡選擇作戰流派, 檢視各流派的精通度與所有解鎖內容; 點選目前流派已解鎖的重擊即可裝備. 預設按鍵: 反斜線鍵切換已學會的流派; R 使用已裝備的特殊技; K 開啟視窗. 全部都可以在「選項」中重新設定. <LINE> <LINE> 每次出招都會消耗耐力, 揮空也一樣. 移動中出招多消耗 12%%, 而每一級技能都會提升效率與架式步法. 注意你的耐力. 技能越高速度越快, 但不會消除疲勞或攻擊後的硬直. 特殊技沒有冷卻時間.
UI_SMA_Guide_Common.cn: <H2> 学习与练习 <LINE> <TEXT> 关闭本指南, 然后对杂志选择“阅读”来学会该流派. 仅仅翻开这些页面并不能学会. 必须读完; 中断阅读不会习得该流派. <LINE> <LINE> 武术是一项技能, 从0级到10级, 所有流派共享. 每提升一级都会提高攻击速度和伤害, 并降低每次出招消耗的耐力. 每个流派还有各自的隐藏精通度, 从0到5. 用某个流派命中目标会同时训练该技能和该流派的精通度. 开始时你拥有两个连招. 每提升一级精通度会再解锁四个更长的连招, 而精通度2、3、4、5各解锁一个特殊技, 即重击. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 操作 <LINE> <TEXT> 双手不要持有普通装备. 瞄准并攻击即可开始. 按住攻击可继续连招; 松开则完成当前这一击. 松开瞄准即可取消. 必要时瞄准倒地的僵尸并使用地面攻击操作. <LINE> <LINE> 右键点击地面并选择“武术”, 或按 K, 即可打开武术窗口. 你可以在那里选择战斗所用的流派, 并查看各流派的精通度及其全部解锁内容; 点击当前流派已解锁的重击即可装备. 默认按键: 反斜杠键切换已学会的流派; R 使用已装备的特殊技; K 打开窗口. 所有按键均可在“选项”中重新绑定. <LINE> <LINE> 每次出招都会消耗耐力, 打空也一样. 移动中出招多消耗12%%, 每级技能都会提升效率和架势步法. 注意你的耐力. 技能越高速度越快, 但不会消除疲劳或攻击后摇. 特殊技没有冷却时间.

UI_SMA_Guide_basic.en: Slow, ordinary strikes available to everyone. Mastery levels 1-4 add body straight, one-two, short knee and straight-hook. At mastery 5, Grab and Knee unlocks as your only heavy attack. Equip it in the Martial Arts window and use the heavy-attack control (R by default). Eight normal attack choices and one heavy at full mastery, with modest speed and damage gains. At close range, the knee and jab-knee can grab a standing zombie by the head. Use the normal shove control for emergency separation.
UI_SMA_Guide_basic.ch: 動作緩慢的一般打擊, 人人都能使用. 精通度 1-4 級會加入腹部直拳、一二連擊、短膝擊與直拳接勾拳. 精通度 5 時解鎖「抓握膝擊」, 這是你唯一的重擊. 在武術視窗中裝備它, 並使用重擊操作 (預設為 R). 完全精通時共有八種一般攻擊可選與一種重擊, 速度與傷害提升幅度不大. 近距離時, 膝擊與刺拳膝擊可以抓住站立殭屍的頭. 緊急拉開距離時請使用一般推擠操作.
UI_SMA_Guide_basic.cn: 动作缓慢的普通打击, 所有人都能使用. 精通度1-4级会加入腹部直拳、一二连击、短膝击和直拳接勾拳. 精通度5时解锁“抓握膝击”, 这是你唯一的重击. 在武术窗口中装备它, 并使用重击操作 (默认为 R). 满精通时共有八种普通攻击可选和一种重击, 速度和伤害提升幅度有限. 近距离时, 膝击和刺拳膝击可以抓住站立僵尸的头部. 紧急脱身时请使用普通推开操作.

UI_SMA_Guide_boxing.en: <H1> Boxing <LINE> <TEXT> Work behind the jab. Slip and roll under punches, then counter with hooks, uppercuts, body shots and the overhand right. The rear cross and uppercuts deliver your strongest punches. Short combinations conserve endurance; a long flurry leaves less room to disengage. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> A grounded opponent <LINE> <TEXT> Aim at the floor to drop into a crouching hammer punch, then recover before moving on.
UI_SMA_Guide_boxing.ch: <H1> 拳擊 <LINE> <TEXT> 以刺拳為核心進攻. 側閃、下潛避開來拳, 再以勾拳、上勾拳、腹部拳與右手過頂拳反擊. 後手直拳與上勾拳是你威力最強的拳. 短連段可節省耐力; 長串連打會讓你更難脫離. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的對手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄準地面即可蹲身使出鎚拳, 收招後再繼續行動.
UI_SMA_Guide_boxing.cn: <H1> 拳击 <LINE> <TEXT> 以刺拳为核心展开进攻. 侧闪、下潜躲开来拳, 再用勾拳、上勾拳、腹部拳和右手过顶拳反击. 后手直拳和上勾拳是你最强力的拳. 短连招能节省耐力; 长串连打会让你更难脱身. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的对手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄准地面即可蹲下打出锤拳, 收招后再继续行动.

UI_SMA_Guide_karate.en: <H1> Karate <LINE> <TEXT> Alternate lead and reverse punches with snapping kicks. Front, side and roundhouse kicks lead into spinning hook, spinning back and jumping kicks. Keep enough space to recover from the heavier techniques. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> A grounded opponent <LINE> <TEXT> Aim at the floor for a leaping heel stomp. At Karate mastery 4, hold Shift and press your special key for the running flying kick. You do not need to aim first.
UI_SMA_Guide_karate.ch: <H1> 空手道 <LINE> <TEXT> 交替使用前手拳、逆突與彈踢. 前踢、側踢與迴旋踢可銜接轉身勾踢、轉身後踢與跳踢. 保留足夠空間, 以便從較重的招式中收招. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的對手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄準地面即可躍起以腳跟踩踏. 空手道精通度 4 時, 按住 Shift 並按下特殊技按鍵即可施展助跑飛踢. 不需要先瞄準.
UI_SMA_Guide_karate.cn: <H1> 空手道 <LINE> <TEXT> 交替使用前手拳、逆突和弹踢. 前踢、侧踢和回旋踢可衔接转身勾踢、转身后踢和跳踢. 保持足够的距离, 以便从较重的招式中恢复. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的对手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄准地面即可跃起用脚跟踩踏. 空手道精通度4时, 按住 Shift 并按下特殊技按键即可发动助跑飞踢. 无需先瞄准.

UI_SMA_Guide_mma.en: <H1> Mixed martial arts <LINE> <TEXT> Mix punches, elbows, knees and kicks. Enter with straights or a superman punch, work the body, then finish with hooks, a spinning backfist or a flying knee. Leg kicks create a different entry into punching range. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> A grounded opponent <LINE> <TEXT> Aim at the floor for a diving punch. The double-leg takedown is a separate special, unlocked at MMA mastery 5, with a paired ground-and-pound sequence. That finisher supports solo and experimental hosted/dedicated multiplayer testing. A server reservation prevents two players from mounting the same zombie. <LINE> <LINE> To use the finisher, reach MMA mastery 5, right-click the ground > Martial Arts > Equipped special and choose Double-leg takedown and ground-and-pound. Keep both hands free, face a standing zombie within five tiles, aim and press R. Your character walks into position, grabs and completes the sequence. You can release right-click; incidental movement inputs do not cancel it. Press Space to cancel. Start with at least 35% endurance. It begins with a standing takedown; a zombie already on the floor is not an entry target.
UI_SMA_Guide_mma.ch: <H1> 綜合格鬥 <LINE> <TEXT> 混合運用拳、肘、膝與踢. 以直拳或超人拳切入, 攻擊身體, 再以勾拳、轉身背拳或飛膝收尾. 腿踢提供另一種切入出拳距離的方式. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的對手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄準地面即可使出俯衝拳. 抱雙腿摔是另一個獨立的特殊技, 於綜合格鬥精通度 5 解鎖, 並搭配一段地面捶打動作. 這個終結技支援單人遊戲, 以及實驗性的自架/專用伺服器多人測試. 伺服器端的預約機制可防止兩名玩家騎上同一隻殭屍. <LINE> <LINE> 要使用這個終結技, 請達到綜合格鬥精通度 5, 在地面按右鍵 > 武術 > 已裝備的特殊技, 並選擇「抱雙腿摔接地面捶打」. 保持雙手空著, 面向五格內一隻站立的殭屍, 瞄準並按 R. 你的角色會走到定位、抓住對方並完成整套動作. 你可以放開右鍵; 不小心的移動輸入不會取消動作. 按空白鍵取消. 開始時至少需有 35%% 的耐力. 動作從站立摔開始; 已倒在地上的殭屍不能作為切入目標.
UI_SMA_Guide_mma.cn: <H1> 综合格斗 <LINE> <TEXT> 混合使用拳、肘、膝和腿. 用直拳或超人拳切入, 攻击身体, 再以勾拳、转身背拳或飞膝收尾. 腿踢提供了另一种切入出拳距离的方式. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的对手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄准地面即可打出俯冲拳. 抱双腿摔是一个单独的特殊技, 在综合格斗精通度5时解锁, 并配有一套地面砸拳动作. 该终结技支持单人游戏, 以及实验性的主机/专用服务器多人测试. 服务器端的预占机制可防止两名玩家骑上同一只僵尸. <LINE> <LINE> 要使用该终结技, 需达到综合格斗精通度5, 右键点击地面 > 武术 > 已装备的特殊技, 并选择“抱双腿摔接地面砸拳”. 保持双手空闲, 面向五格内一只站立的僵尸, 瞄准并按 R. 你的角色会自动走到位置、抓住对方并完成整套动作. 你可以松开右键; 无意中的移动输入不会取消动作. 按空格键取消. 开始时至少需要35%%的耐力. 动作从站立抱摔开始; 已倒地的僵尸不能作为切入目标.

UI_SMA_Guide_muaythai.en: <H1> Muay Thai <LINE> <TEXT> Use the push kick to manage distance. Round kicks follow the hands; elbows, spinning and jumping elbows and knees punish opponents at close range. Heavy kicks cost more endurance than setup punches. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> A grounded opponent <LINE> <TEXT> Aim at the floor to leap and drop onto a fallen opponent, then return to your high guard.
UI_SMA_Guide_muaythai.ch: <H1> 泰拳 <LINE> <TEXT> 用推踢控制距離. 掃踢緊接在拳之後; 肘擊、轉身肘、跳肘與膝擊可在近距離重創對手. 重踢比起手的拳消耗更多耐力. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的對手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄準地面即可躍起壓向倒地的對手, 之後回到高位防守.
UI_SMA_Guide_muaythai.cn: <H1> 泰拳 <LINE> <TEXT> 用推踢控制距离. 扫踢紧跟在拳之后; 肘击、转身肘、跳肘和膝击能在近距离重创对手. 重踢比铺垫的拳消耗更多耐力. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的对手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄准地面即可跃起压向倒地的对手, 然后恢复高位防守.

UI_SMA_Guide_taekwondo.en: Control distance with kicks and light footwork. Mastery unlocks twenty-two combinations, including jumping and tornado-kick chains. Back, hook, turning and axe kicks are heavy attacks. Longer combinations need more room and stamina.
UI_SMA_Guide_taekwondo.ch: 以踢擊與輕快的步法控制距離. 精通度可解鎖二十二種連段, 包括跳踢與旋風踢連段. 後踢、勾踢、轉身踢與下劈踢屬於重擊. 較長的連段需要更多空間與耐力.
UI_SMA_Guide_taekwondo.cn: 用踢击和轻快的步法控制距离. 精通度可解锁二十二种连招, 包括跳踢和旋风踢连招. 后踢、勾踢、转身踢和下劈腿属于重击. 较长的连招需要更多空间和耐力.

UI_SMA_MountTarget.en: Face a zombie lying on its back within five tiles, aim and press R. You will approach automatically. Press Space to cancel.
UI_SMA_MountTarget.ch: 面向五格內一隻仰躺的殭屍, 瞄準並按 R. 你會自動靠近. 按空白鍵取消.
UI_SMA_MountTarget.cn: 面向五格内一只仰面躺倒的僵尸, 瞄准并按 R. 你会自动靠近. 按空格键取消.

UI_SMA_NotReady.en: Special unavailable: check your selection, mastery, free hands and current attack.
UI_SMA_NotReady.ch: 無法使用特殊技: 請檢查你的選擇、精通度、是否空手以及目前的攻擊.
UI_SMA_NotReady.cn: 特殊技不可用: 请检查你的选择、精通度、双手是否空闲以及当前攻击.

UI_SMA_RunningKickInput.en: Hold Shift and press your special key to launch the flying kick.
UI_SMA_RunningKickInput.ch: 按住 Shift 並按下特殊技按鍵即可施展飛踢.
UI_SMA_RunningKickInput.cn: 按住 Shift 并按下特殊技按键即可发动飞踢.

UI_SMA_SpecialStamina.en: Not enough stamina for this special. Rest and try again.
UI_SMA_SpecialStamina.ch: 耐力不足, 無法施展此特殊技. 休息後再試一次.
UI_SMA_SpecialStamina.cn: 耐力不足, 无法发动此特殊技. 休息后再试一次.

UI_SMA_TakedownTarget.en: Select the MMA double-leg takedown (mastery 5), face a standing zombie within five tiles, then aim and press R. You will approach and grab automatically. Press Space to cancel. Supports solo and experimental multiplayer testing.
UI_SMA_TakedownTarget.ch: 選擇綜合格鬥的抱雙腿摔 (精通度 5), 面向五格內一隻站立的殭屍, 然後瞄準並按 R. 你會自動靠近並抓住對方. 按空白鍵取消. 支援單人遊戲與實驗性的多人測試.
UI_SMA_TakedownTarget.cn: 选择综合格斗的抱双腿摔 (精通度5), 面向五格内一只站立的僵尸, 然后瞄准并按 R. 你会自动靠近并抓住对方. 按空格键取消. 支持单人游戏和实验性的多人测试.

UI_SMA_TrainTooltip.en: Shadow-practise your active style on the spot, cycling through the combinations you have unlocked. Trains Martial Arts slowly, much slower than fighting.
UI_SMA_TrainTooltip.ch: 原地對空練習目前的流派, 輪流使出你已解鎖的連段. 可緩慢訓練武術, 比實戰慢得多.
UI_SMA_TrainTooltip.cn: 原地空练当前流派, 轮流打出你已解锁的连招. 可缓慢提升武术, 比实战慢得多.

UI_optionscreen_binding_SMA_Dodge.en: Martial arts dodge (in your stance: strafe left or right to pick a side, otherwise back)
UI_optionscreen_binding_SMA_Dodge.ch: 武術閃避 (處於架式時: 向左或向右平移可選擇閃避方向, 否則向後閃)
UI_optionscreen_binding_SMA_Dodge.cn: 武术闪避 (处于架势时: 向左或向右平移可选择闪避方向, 否则向后闪避)

UI_optionscreen_binding_SMA_Special.en: Use equipped martial arts special (hold for combinations)
UI_optionscreen_binding_SMA_Special.ch: 使用已裝備的武術特殊技 (按住可施展連段)
UI_optionscreen_binding_SMA_Special.cn: 使用已装备的武术特殊技 (按住可施展连招)

UI_trait_SMAAwkwardFighterDesc.en: Martial Arts experience and style mastery come 30 percent slower.
UI_trait_SMAAwkwardFighterDesc.ch: 武術經驗與流派精通度的成長速度慢百分之三十.
UI_trait_SMAAwkwardFighterDesc.cn: 武术经验和流派精通度的增长速度降低百分之三十.

UI_trait_SMABoxerDesc.en: Start with Boxing learned and its mastery at 1. Fight with empty hands; gloves are optional. Landing punches trains Martial Arts and Boxing mastery, which unlocks longer combinations and heavy attacks.
UI_trait_SMABoxerDesc.ch: 開局即學會拳擊, 且精通度為 1. 以空手作戰; 拳套可戴可不戴. 出拳命中會訓練武術與拳擊精通度, 精通度可解鎖更長的連段與重擊.
UI_trait_SMABoxerDesc.cn: 开局即学会拳击, 精通度为1. 空手作战; 拳套可戴可不戴. 出拳命中会训练武术和拳击精通度, 精通度可解锁更长的连招和重击.

UI_trait_SMAKarateDesc.en: Start with Karate learned and its mastery at 1. Fight with empty hands. Landing hits trains Martial Arts and Karate mastery, which unlocks longer combinations and heavy attacks.
UI_trait_SMAKarateDesc.ch: 開局即學會空手道, 且精通度為 1. 以空手作戰. 命中目標會訓練武術與空手道精通度, 精通度可解鎖更長的連段與重擊.
UI_trait_SMAKarateDesc.cn: 开局即学会空手道, 精通度为1. 空手作战. 命中目标会训练武术和空手道精通度, 精通度可解锁更长的连招和重击.

UI_trait_SMAMMADesc.en: Start with MMA learned and its mastery at 1. Fight with empty hands. Landing hits trains Martial Arts and MMA mastery, which unlocks longer combinations and heavy attacks.
UI_trait_SMAMMADesc.ch: 開局即學會綜合格鬥, 且精通度為 1. 以空手作戰. 命中目標會訓練武術與綜合格鬥精通度, 精通度可解鎖更長的連段與重擊.
UI_trait_SMAMMADesc.cn: 开局即学会综合格斗, 精通度为1. 空手作战. 命中目标会训练武术和综合格斗精通度, 精通度可解锁更长的连招和重击.

UI_trait_SMAMuayThaiDesc.en: Start with Muay Thai learned and its mastery at 1. Fight with empty hands. Landing hits trains Martial Arts and Muay Thai mastery, which unlocks longer combinations and heavy attacks.
UI_trait_SMAMuayThaiDesc.ch: 開局即學會泰拳, 且精通度為 1. 以空手作戰. 命中目標會訓練武術與泰拳精通度, 精通度可解鎖更長的連段與重擊.
UI_trait_SMAMuayThaiDesc.cn: 开局即学会泰拳, 精通度为1. 空手作战. 命中目标会训练武术和泰拳精通度, 精通度可解锁更长的连招和重击.

UI_trait_SMATrainedFighterDesc.en: Start with Martial Arts at level 1 and gain Martial Arts experience faster. The skill raises attack speed and damage and lowers strike stamina cost for every martial arts style you learn.
UI_trait_SMATrainedFighterDesc.ch: 開局武術技能為 1 級, 且武術經驗成長較快. 此技能會提高你學會的每種武術流派的攻擊速度與傷害, 並降低出招的耐力消耗.
UI_trait_SMATrainedFighterDesc.cn: 开局武术技能为1级, 武术经验增长更快. 该技能会提高你所学每种武术流派的攻击速度和伤害, 并降低出招的耐力消耗.

UI_trait_HCJF_ArcWelderDesc.ch: 金工經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_ArcWelderDesc.cn: 金工经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_BarFighterDesc.ch: 短棍經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_BarFighterDesc.cn: 短棍经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_BarflyDesc.en: Unhappiness and stress creep up once a day has gone by without a drink, as a smoker's do.
UI_trait_HCJF_BarflyDesc.ch: 一整天沒喝酒後, 憂鬱與壓力就會逐漸上升, 就像吸菸者沒菸抽一樣.
UI_trait_HCJF_BarflyDesc.cn: 一整天没喝酒后, 忧郁和压力就会逐渐上升, 就像吸烟者没烟抽一样.

UI_trait_HCJF_ChatterboxDesc.en: Every so often you talk to yourself out loud, and zombies hear it.
UI_trait_HCJF_ChatterboxDesc.ch: 你不時會大聲自言自語, 殭屍會聽見.
UI_trait_HCJF_ChatterboxDesc.cn: 你时不时会大声自言自语, 僵尸会听见.

UI_trait_HCJF_ClockWatcherDesc.en: Boredom builds half again as fast.
UI_trait_HCJF_ClockWatcherDesc.ch: 無聊累積速度變為 1.5 倍.
UI_trait_HCJF_ClockWatcherDesc.cn: 无聊积累速度变为 1.5 倍.

UI_trait_HCJF_CoolUnderFireDesc.en: Panic drains away twice as fast.

UI_trait_HCJF_CrowdPleaserDesc.en: Holding a musical instrument or a microphone while standing still slowly lifts boredom and unhappiness.
UI_trait_HCJF_CrowdPleaserDesc.ch: 靜止站立並手持樂器或麥克風時, 會慢慢減輕無聊與憂鬱.
UI_trait_HCJF_CrowdPleaserDesc.cn: 静止站立并手持乐器或麦克风时, 会慢慢缓解无聊和忧郁.

UI_trait_HCJF_DeskJockeyDesc.en: Fitness, Strength and Running level 25%% slower.
UI_trait_HCJF_DeskJockeyDesc.ch: 體格、力量與衝刺經驗獲取速度減慢 25%%
UI_trait_HCJF_DeskJockeyDesc.cn: 体格、力量和冲刺经验获取速度降低 25%%

UI_trait_HCJF_EarlyRiserDesc.en: Tires half as fast between five and eleven in the morning.
UI_trait_HCJF_EarlyRiserDesc.ch: 早上五點到十一點之間, 疲勞累積速度減半.
UI_trait_HCJF_EarlyRiserDesc.cn: 早上五点到十一点之间, 疲劳积累速度减半.

UI_trait_HCJF_ForgeHardenedDesc.en: Heat bothers you less: overheating builds more slowly.
UI_trait_HCJF_ForgeHardenedDesc.ch: 較不怕熱: 過熱累積得更慢.
UI_trait_HCJF_ForgeHardenedDesc.cn: 不太怕热: 过热积累得更慢.

UI_trait_HCJF_GreaseMonkeyDesc.ch: 技工經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_GreaseMonkeyDesc.cn: 技工经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_GreenThumbDesc.ch: 耕作經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_GreenThumbDesc.cn: 耕作经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_HeavyHitterDesc.ch: 長棍經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_HeavyHitterDesc.cn: 长棍经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_HorseSenseDesc.ch: 畜牧經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_HorseSenseDesc.cn: 畜牧经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_IronLiverDesc.en: Gets drunk slower and sobers up twice as fast.
UI_trait_HCJF_IronLiverDesc.ch: 較不容易喝醉, 酒醒速度加倍.
UI_trait_HCJF_IronLiverDesc.cn: 更不容易喝醉, 醒酒速度加倍.

UI_trait_HCJF_LongHaulerDesc.en: Tires a third more slowly while in a vehicle.
UI_trait_HCJF_LongHaulerDesc.ch: 待在車內時, 疲勞累積速度減慢三分之一.
UI_trait_HCJF_LongHaulerDesc.cn: 待在车内时, 疲劳积累速度减慢三分之一.

UI_trait_HCJF_NeedleworkDesc.ch: 縫紉經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_NeedleworkDesc.cn: 缝纫经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_OldSoulDesc.en: The old crafts (Carving, Knapping, Pottery, Blacksmithing, Masonry, Tailoring, Glassmaking) level 40%% faster.
UI_trait_HCJF_OldSoulDesc.ch: 傳統工藝 (雕刻、石器、陶藝、鍛造、石工、縫紉、玻璃) 經驗獲取速度加快 40%%
UI_trait_HCJF_OldSoulDesc.cn: 传统手艺 (雕刻、石器、陶艺、锻造、石工、缝纫、玻璃) 经验获取速度提高 40%%

UI_trait_HCJF_ProspectorSEyeDesc.en: Spots stones, old coins and buried finds more easily in search mode.
UI_trait_HCJF_ProspectorSEyeDesc.ch: 在搜尋模式中更容易發現石頭、古錢幣與埋藏物.
UI_trait_HCJF_ProspectorSEyeDesc.cn: 在搜索模式中更容易发现石头、古钱币和埋藏物.

UI_trait_HCJF_ShortOrderDesc.ch: 烹飪經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_ShortOrderDesc.cn: 烹饪经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_SparkyDesc.ch: 電工經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_SparkyDesc.cn: 电工经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_SteadyHandDesc.en: First Aid, Short Blade and Butchering level 50%% faster.
UI_trait_HCJF_SteadyHandDesc.ch: 急救、短刀與屠宰經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_SteadyHandDesc.cn: 急救、短刀和屠宰经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_StrongStomachDesc.en: Rotting corpses make you sick half as fast, and handling the dead doesn't upset you.
UI_trait_HCJF_StrongStomachDesc.ch: 腐爛屍體讓你生病的速度減半, 處理死者也不會讓你心煩.
UI_trait_HCJF_StrongStomachDesc.cn: 腐烂尸体让你生病的速度减半, 处理死者也不会让你心烦.

UI_trait_HCJF_SuperstitiousDesc.en: Being outside after dark wears on your nerves.
UI_trait_HCJF_SuperstitiousDesc.ch: 天黑後待在戶外會讓你心神不寧.
UI_trait_HCJF_SuperstitiousDesc.cn: 天黑后待在户外会让你心神不宁.

UI_trait_HCJF_TeetotalerDesc.en: Drinking makes you unhappy instead of relaxed.
UI_trait_HCJF_TeetotalerDesc.ch: 喝酒不會讓你放鬆, 反而讓你憂鬱.
UI_trait_HCJF_TeetotalerDesc.cn: 喝酒不会让你放松, 反而让你忧郁.

UI_trait_HCJF_TradesmanDesc.ch: 木工與石工經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_TradesmanDesc.cn: 木工和石工经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_TrailLegsDesc.en: Endurance comes back half again as fast while walking.
UI_trait_HCJF_TrailLegsDesc.ch: 步行時耐力恢復速度變為 1.5 倍.
UI_trait_HCJF_TrailLegsDesc.cn: 步行时耐力恢复速度变为 1.5 倍.

UI_TheyKnew_OptMessages_tooltip.en: The text above your character when you take a med, test yourself or protection wears off.
UI_TheyKnew_OptMessages_tooltip.ch: 你服藥、自我檢測或保護效果消退時, 角色頭上顯示的文字.
UI_TheyKnew_OptMessages_tooltip.cn: 在你服药、自我检测或保护效果消退时, 角色头顶显示的文字.

UI_TheyKnew_OptMoodles_tooltip.en: Moodles for protection, recovery and a positive test (needs MoodleFramework).
UI_TheyKnew_OptMoodles_tooltip.ch: 保護、康復與檢測陽性的狀態圖示 (需要 MoodleFramework).
UI_TheyKnew_OptMoodles_tooltip.cn: 保护中、康复中与检测阳性的状态图标 (需要 MoodleFramework).

UI_trait_gs_carelessreloaderdesc.en: Sloppy at the press. About 1 round in 20 is spoiled: its primer and powder are lost.
UI_trait_gs_carelessreloaderdesc.ch: 在壓床前做事馬虎. 每 20 發約有 1 發報廢: 其底火與火藥會損失.
UI_trait_gs_carelessreloaderdesc.cn: 在压床前做事马虎. 每 20 发约有 1 发报废: 其底火和火药会损失.

UI_trait_gs_handloaderdesc.en: Years at the reloading bench. Loads rounds a quarter faster at the press, and improvised powder costs no quality.
UI_trait_gs_handloaderdesc.ch: 在複裝工作臺前待了多年. 在壓床上複裝子彈的速度快四分之一, 使用簡易火藥也不會降低品質.
UI_trait_gs_handloaderdesc.cn: 在复装工作台前待了多年. 在压床上复装子弹的速度快四分之一, 使用简易火药也不会降低质量.

UI_ZomVisFix_Options_Jumpscare_Desc.en: let zombies revealed by this mod influence the jumpscare effect handling (default: true)
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_Jumpscare_Desc.ch: 讓本模組顯示的殭屍影響驚嚇效果的處理 (預設: 開啟)
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_Jumpscare_Desc.cn: 让此模组显示的僵尸影响惊吓效果的处理 (默认: 开启)

UI_ZomVisFix_Options_SubTile_Desc.en: use exact player and zombie positions for raycasting (default: true)
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_SubTile_Desc.ch: 使用玩家與殭屍的精確位置進行射線偵測 (預設: 開啟)
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_SubTile_Desc.cn: 使用玩家和僵尸的精确位置进行光线追踪 (默认: 开启)

UI_ZomVisFix_Options_ZombieProcessingRat.en: limit how many times per second should this mod process a zombie
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_ZombieProcessingRat.ch: 限制本模組每秒處理單一殭屍的次數
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_ZombieProcessingRat.cn: 限制此模组每秒处理单个僵尸的次数

UI_HydeCoOrchard_NeedMulch.en: Mulching takes %1, made from raked leaves.
UI_HydeCoOrchard_NeedMulch.ch: 鋪覆蓋物需要 %1, 用耙集的落葉製成.
UI_HydeCoOrchard_NeedMulch.cn: 铺护根物需要 %1, 用耙集的落叶制成.

RM_30af2059-1537-4beb-a7e0-b28b6f15c626.en: Hey hey, How are you all today?
RM_30af2059-1537-4beb-a7e0-b28b6f15c626.ch: 嘿嘿, 大家今天過得如何?
RM_30af2059-1537-4beb-a7e0-b28b6f15c626.cn: 嘿嘿, 大家今天过得如何?

RM_5ab46bf2-05b3-49d7-95db-9d90db7144dc.en: What do we need? First - Let's Heat some water
RM_5ab46bf2-05b3-49d7-95db-9d90db7144dc.ch: 我們需要什麼? 首先 - 把水加熱
RM_5ab46bf2-05b3-49d7-95db-9d90db7144dc.cn: 我们需要什么? 首先 - 把水加热

RM_777a5d02-d3cc-46b7-9697-996034d6ca9e.en: There! Most of our work's done, all we need now is patience!
RM_777a5d02-d3cc-46b7-9697-996034d6ca9e.ch: 好了! 大部分的工作都完成了, 現在只需要一點耐心!
RM_777a5d02-d3cc-46b7-9697-996034d6ca9e.cn: 好了! 大部分的工作都完成了, 现在只需要一点耐心!

RM_7882f5ee-271a-4051-bac9-8eac5e425618.en: The best start of our mornings!

RM_79940cc2-04c8-497a-beaf-b7ebc5885599.en: And it's as easy as that! Some Hot Brewed Coffee!
RM_79940cc2-04c8-497a-beaf-b7ebc5885599.ch: 就是這麼簡單! 一杯熱騰騰的沖泡咖啡!
RM_79940cc2-04c8-497a-beaf-b7ebc5885599.cn: 就是这么简单! 一杯热腾腾的冲泡咖啡!

RM_7b901f5b-71cb-4762-a338-2d0ac4d54f25.en: Let that Hot Water slowly Brew our Coffee!
RM_7b901f5b-71cb-4762-a338-2d0ac4d54f25.ch: 讓熱水慢慢沖泡出我們的咖啡!
RM_7b901f5b-71cb-4762-a338-2d0ac4d54f25.cn: 让热水慢慢冲泡出我们的咖啡!

RM_909bad9d-b7ff-42d5-b60c-1857be5598b9.ch: VHS: Sapph 的烹飪秀 EP1 (咖啡)
RM_909bad9d-b7ff-42d5-b60c-1857be5598b9.cn: VHS: Sapph 的烹饪秀 EP1 (咖啡)

RM_94f3b733-566e-4c5e-ae09-e23f9ac8f171.en: Hope you all enjoyed it - see you all, next time~[img=music]
RM_94f3b733-566e-4c5e-ae09-e23f9ac8f171.ch: 希望大家喜歡 - 我們下次見~[img=music]
RM_94f3b733-566e-4c5e-ae09-e23f9ac8f171.cn: 希望大家喜欢 - 我们下次见~[img=music]

RM_96e0f364-6b24-46fb-bc60-fd955249c5cc.en: Second - Get some Coffee Beans, Grind it on a Grinder like this!
RM_96e0f364-6b24-46fb-bc60-fd955249c5cc.ch: 接著 - 拿一些咖啡豆, 像這樣用研磨機磨碎!
RM_96e0f364-6b24-46fb-bc60-fd955249c5cc.cn: 接着 - 拿一些咖啡豆, 像这样用研磨机磨碎!

RM_d5c8295d-d935-4729-b8a8-a6e5d8f2bc6e.en: and... There! Now, we just need some paper or cloth filters.
RM_d5c8295d-d935-4729-b8a8-a6e5d8f2bc6e.ch: …好了! 現在, 我們只需要一些濾紙或濾布.
RM_d5c8295d-d935-4729-b8a8-a6e5d8f2bc6e.cn: …好了! 现在, 我们只需要一些滤纸或滤布.

RM_ee8c853f-75c4-4771-9e07-c945b8a9f349.en: <Noises> Or if you're bold, you can even use a Mortar and Pestle...<Noises>
RM_ee8c853f-75c4-4771-9e07-c945b8a9f349.ch: <Noises> 或者你夠大膽的話, 甚至可以用研缽和杵…<Noises>
RM_ee8c853f-75c4-4771-9e07-c945b8a9f349.cn: <Noises> 或者你够大胆的话, 甚至可以用研钵和杵…<Noises>

RM_ef323d59-b334-4635-9969-d0a404c1d578.ch: 今天我們要沖泡的是… 咖啡
RM_ef323d59-b334-4635-9969-d0a404c1d578.cn: 今天我们要冲泡的是… 咖啡

RM_VPS_Extra.en: Ebenezer Missionary Baptist Church - Rosewood, Kentucky - 1982
RM_VPS_Extra.ch: 以便以謝宣道浸信會 - 肯塔基州羅斯伍德 - 1982
RM_VPS_Extra.cn: 以便以谢宣道浸信会 - 肯塔基州罗斯伍德 - 1982

RM_VPS_T1_01.ch: 以便以謝宣道浸信會, 肯塔基州羅斯伍德.
RM_VPS_T1_01.cn: 以便以谢宣道浸信会, 肯塔基州罗斯伍德.

RM_VPS_T1_02.en: This is the Lord's day, and we are recording.
RM_VPS_T1_02.ch: 今天是主日, 我們正在錄音.
RM_VPS_T1_02.cn: 今天是主日, 我们正在录音.

RM_VPS_T1_03.en: Thirty of us bought that camera together.
RM_VPS_T1_03.ch: 我們三十個人合錢買了那台攝影機.
RM_VPS_T1_03.cn: 我们三十个人凑钱买了那台摄像机.

RM_VPS_T1_04.en: I hope you know what that cost.
RM_VPS_T1_04.ch: 我希望你們知道那花了多少錢.
RM_VPS_T1_04.cn: 我希望你们知道那花了多少钱.

RM_VPS_T1_05.en: Tommy Culver, I can see you.
RM_VPS_T1_05.ch: 湯米·卡爾弗, 我看得見你.
RM_VPS_T1_05.cn: 汤米·卡尔弗, 我看得见你.

RM_VPS_T1_06.en: Turn with me to Genesis, chapter four.
RM_VPS_T1_06.ch: 跟我一起翻到創世記第四章.
RM_VPS_T1_06.cn: 跟我一起翻到创世记第四章.

RM_VPS_T1_07.en: Verse two first. It is a small verse.
RM_VPS_T1_07.ch: 先看第二節. 那是很短的一節.
RM_VPS_T1_07.cn: 先看第二节. 那是很短的一节.

RM_VPS_T1_08.en: "And Abel was a keeper of sheep,

RM_VPS_T1_09.en: but Cain was a tiller of the ground."

RM_VPS_T1_10.en: Hold onto the farmer. We will want him.
RM_VPS_T1_10.ch: 記住那個種地的. 我們以後會用到他.
RM_VPS_T1_10.cn: 记住那个种地的. 我们以后会用到他.

RM_VPS_T1_11.ch: 不是今天. 但還是把他記著.
RM_VPS_T1_11.cn: 不是今天. 但还是把他记着.

RM_VPS_T1_13.en: "And it came to pass, when they were in the field,

RM_VPS_T1_14.en: that Cain rose up against Abel his brother,
RM_VPS_T1_14.ch: 該隱起來打他兄弟亞伯,
RM_VPS_T1_14.cn: 该隐起来打他兄弟亚伯,

RM_VPS_T1_17.en: Not in a temple. Not before a judge.
RM_VPS_T1_17.ch: 不在殿裡. 不在審判官面前.
RM_VPS_T1_17.cn: 不在殿里. 不在审判官面前.

RM_VPS_T1_18.en: Where there was nobody to see it.
RM_VPS_T1_18.ch: 在沒有一個人看得見的地方.
RM_VPS_T1_18.cn: 在没有一个人看得见的地方.

RM_VPS_T1_19.en: No court out there. No witness. No sentence.
RM_VPS_T1_19.ch: 那外頭沒有法庭. 沒有見證人. 沒有判決.
RM_VPS_T1_19.cn: 那外头没有法庭. 没有见证人. 没有判决.

RM_VPS_T1_20.en: Somebody had to do all of it.
RM_VPS_T1_20.ch: 這一切, 都得有人自己動手.
RM_VPS_T1_20.cn: 这一切, 都得有人自己动手.

RM_VPS_T1_21.ch: 該隱把自己立成了[col=191,102,255]行刑的人[/].
RM_VPS_T1_21.cn: 该隐把自己立成了[col=191,102,255]行刑的人[/].

RM_VPS_T1_22.en: He took an office he was never given.
RM_VPS_T1_22.ch: 他擔起了一個從來沒有交給他的職分.
RM_VPS_T1_22.cn: 他担起了一个从来没有交给他的职分.

RM_VPS_T1_23.en: That is what murder is, church -
RM_VPS_T1_23.ch: 教會啊, 殺人就是這麼一回事 -
RM_VPS_T1_23.cn: 教会啊, 杀人就是这么一回事 -

RM_VPS_T1_24.en: a man doing God's work for Him, badly,
RM_VPS_T1_24.ch: 一個人替神做祂的工, 做得一塌糊塗,
RM_VPS_T1_24.cn: 一个人替神做他的工, 做得一塌糊涂,

RM_VPS_T1_26.en: The Lord asks where his brother is.
RM_VPS_T1_26.ch: 主問他, 你兄弟在哪裡.
RM_VPS_T1_26.cn: 主问他, 你兄弟在哪里.

RM_VPS_T1_28.ch: 我豈是看守我兄弟的嗎? 」
RM_VPS_T1_28.cn: 我岂是看守我兄弟的吗? ”

RM_VPS_T1_30.en: And the Lord does not argue with him.

RM_VPS_T1_33.en: the voice of thy brother's[col=217,31,31] blood[/]

RM_VPS_T1_34.en: crieth unto me from the ground."

RM_VPS_T1_37.en: and I have never once gotten past that line.
RM_VPS_T1_37.ch: 卻從來沒有一次能越過這一句.
RM_VPS_T1_37.cn: 却从来没有一次能越过这一句.

RM_VPS_T1_40.en: But[col=102,191,255] savagery[/] is not the sin the Lord names.
RM_VPS_T1_40.ch: 但[col=102,191,255]兇殘[/]不是主指出來的那個罪.
RM_VPS_T1_40.cn: 但[col=102,191,255]凶残[/]不是主指出来的那个罪.

RM_VPS_T1_41.en: He does not say thou hast killed.

RM_VPS_T1_42.en: He says what hast thou done.
RM_VPS_T1_42.ch: 祂說的是, 你做了甚麼事呢.
RM_VPS_T1_42.cn: 他说的是, 你做了什么事呢.

RM_VPS_T1_43.en: The killing was the smaller part.
RM_VPS_T1_43.ch: 殺人是其中比較小的那一半.
RM_VPS_T1_43.cn: 杀人是其中比较小的那一半.

RM_VPS_T1_44.en: Cain thought that field was empty.
RM_VPS_T1_44.ch: 該隱以為那片田是空的.
RM_VPS_T1_44.cn: 该隐以为那片田是空的.

RM_VPS_T1_45.en: He thought a thing done where nobody looks
RM_VPS_T1_45.ch: 他以為在沒有人看的地方做的事,
RM_VPS_T1_45.cn: 他以为在没有人看的地方做的事,

RM_VPS_T1_46.en: is a thing that did not happen.

RM_VPS_T1_48.en: Verse eleven: the earth opened her mouth.
RM_VPS_T1_48.ch: 第十一節: 地開了口.
RM_VPS_T1_48.cn: 第十一节: 地开了口.

RM_VPS_T1_49.en: It took what he gave it, and it kept it.
RM_VPS_T1_49.ch: 地接了他所給的, 而且留住了.
RM_VPS_T1_49.cn: 地接了他所给的, 而且留住了.

RM_VPS_T1_51.en: Cain ate his supper and slept. It did not.
RM_VPS_T1_51.ch: 該隱吃了晚飯, 睡了覺. 它沒有.
RM_VPS_T1_51.cn: 该隐吃了晚饭, 睡了觉. 它没有.

RM_VPS_T1_52.en: My grandmother had a word for a thing
RM_VPS_T1_52.ch: 我祖母對一樣東西有個說法,
RM_VPS_T1_52.cn: 我奶奶对一样东西有个说法,

RM_VPS_T1_53.en: that will not be reasoned with.
RM_VPS_T1_53.ch: 就是那種怎麼講道理都講不通的東西.
RM_VPS_T1_53.cn: 就是那种怎么讲道理都讲不通的东西.

RM_VPS_T1_54.en: She called a deed like that[col=191,102,255] fell[/].
RM_VPS_T1_54.ch: 她管那樣的行為叫[col=191,102,255]狠絕[/].
RM_VPS_T1_54.cn: 她管那样的行为叫[col=191,102,255]狠绝[/].

RM_VPS_T1_55.en: It does not only mean wicked.

RM_VPS_T1_56.en: It means it has already made up its mind.
RM_VPS_T1_56.ch: 那意思是, 它早已下定了決心.
RM_VPS_T1_56.cn: 那意思是, 它早已下定了决心.

RM_VPS_T1_57.en: Now hear the part I came to say.
RM_VPS_T1_57.ch: 現在聽我今天真正要說的那一段.
RM_VPS_T1_57.cn: 现在听我今天真正要说的那一段.

RM_VPS_T1_59.en: Cain never heard a thing. Not one thing.
RM_VPS_T1_59.ch: 該隱甚麼也沒聽見. 一點也沒有.
RM_VPS_T1_59.cn: 该隐什么也没听见. 一点也没有.

RM_VPS_T1_60.en: He walked out of that field in the quiet.
RM_VPS_T1_60.ch: 他在一片安靜裡走出了那片田.
RM_VPS_T1_60.cn: 他在一片安静里走出了那片田.

RM_VPS_T1_62.en: and the only ear in all creation
RM_VPS_T1_62.ch: 而在一切受造之物中, 唯一
RM_VPS_T1_62.cn: 而在一切受造之物中, 唯一

RM_VPS_T1_63.en: tuned to hear it was the ear of God.
RM_VPS_T1_63.ch: 聽得見那聲音的耳朵, 是神的耳朵.
RM_VPS_T1_63.cn: 听得见那声音的耳朵, 是神的耳朵.

RM_VPS_T1_65.en: Some of you have done things in a field.
RM_VPS_T1_65.ch: 你們有些人在田裡做過事.
RM_VPS_T1_65.cn: 你们有些人在田里做过事.

RM_VPS_T1_67.en: You are just not the one who can hear it.
RM_VPS_T1_67.ch: 只是你不是那個聽得見的人.
RM_VPS_T1_67.cn: 只是你不是那个听得见的人.

RM_VPS_T1_68.en: Verse fifteen, and then the sister sings.
RM_VPS_T1_68.ch: 第十五節, 然後請姊妹起唱.
RM_VPS_T1_68.cn: 第十五节, 然后请姊妹起唱.

RM_VPS_T1_69.en: "And the LORD set a mark upon Cain,
RM_VPS_T1_69.ch: 「耶和華就給該隱立一個記號,
RM_VPS_T1_69.cn: “耶和华就给该隐立一个记号,

RM_VPS_T1_70.en: lest any finding him should kill him."

RM_VPS_T1_71.en: God marked the murderer to keep him alive.
RM_VPS_T1_71.ch: 神給那殺人的立記號, 是為了留他的命.
RM_VPS_T1_71.cn: 神给那杀人的立记号, 是为了留他的命.

RM_VPS_T1_72.en: Next time there is a mark on a door in Egypt.
RM_VPS_T1_72.ch: 下一次, 記號是在埃及的一扇門上.
RM_VPS_T1_72.cn: 下一次, 记号是在埃及的一扇门上.

RM_VPS_T1_73.en: The Lord is merciful to the sinner,

RM_VPS_T1_74.en: and He is[col=191,102,255] merciless[/] to the sin,

RM_VPS_T1_75.en: and He is both at once,
RM_VPS_T1_75.ch: 而祂在同一刻是這兩樣,
RM_VPS_T1_75.cn: 而他在同一刻是这两样,

RM_VPS_T1_76.en: and that is the hardest thing I know.
RM_VPS_T1_76.ch: 這是我所知道最難的一件事.
RM_VPS_T1_76.cn: 这是我所知道最难的一件事.

RM_VPS_T1_77.ch: 姊妹 - 你來給我們起頭領唱.
RM_VPS_T1_77.cn: 姊妹 - 你来给我们起头领唱.

RM_VPS_T1_78.en: If this word has blessed you, write to us.
RM_VPS_T1_78.ch: 若這道使你得了福, 就寫信給我們.
RM_VPS_T1_78.cn: 若这道使你得了福, 就写信给我们.

RM_VPS_T1_80.ch: 郵政信箱 41 號, 肯塔基州羅斯伍德.
RM_VPS_T1_80.cn: 邮政信箱 41 号, 肯塔基州罗斯伍德.

RM_VPS_T1_81.en: Tape one of three. The Lord willing, a two.
RM_VPS_T1_81.ch: 三卷中的第一卷. 主若許可, 還有第二卷.
RM_VPS_T1_81.cn: 三卷中的第一卷. 主若许可, 还有第二卷.

RM_VPS_T1_HYMN1.en: [img=music] There is a fountain filled with[col=217,31,31] blood[/] [img=music]

RM_VPS_T1_HYMN2.ch: [img=music] 從以馬內利的血脈湧出 [img=music]
RM_VPS_T1_HYMN2.cn: [img=music] 从以马内利的血脉涌出 [img=music]

RM_VPS_T1_HYMN3.en: [img=music] And sinners plunged beneath that flood [img=music]
RM_VPS_T1_HYMN3.ch: [img=music] 罪人投身在那洪流之下 [img=music]
RM_VPS_T1_HYMN3.cn: [img=music] 罪人投身在那洪流之下 [img=music]

RM_VPS_T2_01.ch: 以便以謝宣道浸信會, 羅斯伍德.
RM_VPS_T2_01.cn: 以便以谢宣道浸信会, 罗斯伍德.

RM_VPS_T2_03.en: Three weeks ago I left you in a field.
RM_VPS_T2_03.ch: 三週前, 我把你們留在一片田地裡.
RM_VPS_T2_03.cn: 三周前, 我把你们留在一片田地里.

RM_VPS_T2_04.en: Some of you have not slept right since.
RM_VPS_T2_04.ch: 從那之後, 你們有些人就沒睡好.
RM_VPS_T2_04.cn: 从那之后, 你们有些人就没睡好.

RM_VPS_T2_06.en: I left you with a mark, as well.
RM_VPS_T2_06.ch: 我也留給了你們一個銘印.
RM_VPS_T2_06.cn: 我也留给了你们一个铭印.

RM_VPS_T2_07.en: God set one on Cain to keep him breathing.
RM_VPS_T2_07.ch: 神在該隱身上立了一個, 為要讓他繼續呼吸.
RM_VPS_T2_07.cn: 神在该隐身上立了一个, 为要让他继续呼吸.

RM_VPS_T2_08.en: This morning we put one on a door.
RM_VPS_T2_08.ch: 今天早上, 我們把一個抹在門上.
RM_VPS_T2_08.cn: 今天早上, 我们把一个抹在门上.

RM_VPS_T2_10.en: Now Pharaoh has been asked nine times.
RM_VPS_T2_10.ch: 如今, 法老已經被求過九次.
RM_VPS_T2_10.cn: 如今, 法老已经被求过九次.

RM_VPS_T2_13.en: Scripture says he hardened his own heart.
RM_VPS_T2_13.ch: 聖經說, 是他自己硬著心.
RM_VPS_T2_13.cn: 圣经说, 是他自己硬着心.

RM_VPS_T2_14.en: Scripture says the Lord hardened it.
RM_VPS_T2_14.ch: 聖經也說, 是主使他的心剛硬.
RM_VPS_T2_14.cn: 圣经也说, 是主使他的心刚硬.

RM_VPS_T2_15.en: Don't you go smoothing that over.
RM_VPS_T2_15.ch: 你們可別把這事給抹平了.
RM_VPS_T2_15.cn: 你们可别把这事给抹平了.

RM_VPS_T2_16.en: A man can want a thing long enough
RM_VPS_T2_16.ch: 一個人可以想要一樣東西, 想得夠久,
RM_VPS_T2_16.cn: 一个人可以想要一样东西, 想得够久,

RM_VPS_T2_17.en: that God stops taking it away from him.
RM_VPS_T2_17.ch: 久到神不再從他手裡拿走.
RM_VPS_T2_17.cn: 久到神不再从他手里拿走.

RM_VPS_T2_18.en: That is the Lord honoring it, not breaking it.
RM_VPS_T2_18.ch: 那是主看重那意願, 不是折斷它.
RM_VPS_T2_18.cn: 那是主看重那意愿, 不是折断它.

RM_VPS_T2_22.en: Not one firstborn has died yet,

RM_VPS_T2_23.en: and God has already changed what year it is.
RM_VPS_T2_23.ch: 神就已經改了這是哪一年.
RM_VPS_T2_23.cn: 神就已经改了这是哪一年.

RM_VPS_T2_24.en: He dates it from the[col=217,31,31] blood[/], not the leaving.
RM_VPS_T2_24.ch: 祂從那[col=217,31,31]血[/]算起, 不從離開埃及算起.
RM_VPS_T2_24.cn: 他从那[col=217,31,31]血[/]算起, 不从离开埃及算起.

RM_VPS_T2_25.en: Verse seven. Take a lamb. Take the[col=217,31,31] blood[/].
RM_VPS_T2_25.ch: 第七節. 取一隻羊羔. 取那[col=217,31,31]血[/].
RM_VPS_T2_25.cn: 第七节. 取一只羊羔. 取那[col=217,31,31]血[/].

RM_VPS_T2_26.en: "And strike it on the two side posts

RM_VPS_T2_27.en: and on the upper door post of the houses."

RM_VPS_T2_29.en: The Lord Himself passes through Egypt tonight.
RM_VPS_T2_29.ch: 今夜, 主親自要走過埃及.
RM_VPS_T2_29.cn: 今夜, 主亲自要走过埃及.

RM_VPS_T2_33.en: A token. A mark on the door.
RM_VPS_T2_33.ch: 一個記號. 門上的一道銘印.
RM_VPS_T2_33.cn: 一个记号. 门上的一道铭印.

RM_VPS_T2_34.en: That[col=217,31,31] blood[/] did not stop the destroyer
RM_VPS_T2_34.ch: 那[col=217,31,31]血[/]攔住滅命的, 並不是因為
RM_VPS_T2_34.cn: 那[col=217,31,31]血[/]拦住灭命的, 并不是因为

RM_VPS_T2_36.en: There is no strength in[col=217,31,31] blood[/] on a doorframe.
RM_VPS_T2_36.ch: 門框上那[col=217,31,31]血[/]裡沒有一點力量.
RM_VPS_T2_36.cn: 门框上那[col=217,31,31]血[/]里没有一点力量.

RM_VPS_T2_37.en: A child could wash it off.
RM_VPS_T2_37.ch: 一個孩子就能把它洗掉.
RM_VPS_T2_37.cn: 一个孩子就能把它洗掉.

RM_VPS_T2_38.en: It stopped him because it said
RM_VPS_T2_38.ch: 它攔住了他, 是因為它說明了
RM_VPS_T2_38.cn: 它拦住了他, 是因为它说明了

RM_VPS_T2_40.en: It said: this one is spoken for.
RM_VPS_T2_40.ch: 它說: 這一家已經有主了.
RM_VPS_T2_40.cn: 它说: 这一家已经有主了.

RM_VPS_T2_41.en: Verse twenty-three calls him the destroyer.
RM_VPS_T2_41.ch: 第二十三節稱他為滅命的.
RM_VPS_T2_41.cn: 第二十三节称他为灭命的.

RM_VPS_T2_42.en: Not an accident. Something sent, with work to do.
RM_VPS_T2_42.ch: 不是意外. 是被差來的, 帶著要辦的事.
RM_VPS_T2_42.cn: 不是意外. 是被差来的, 带着要办的事.

RM_VPS_T2_43.en: That was[col=191,102,255] destruction[/] with an order on it.

RM_VPS_T2_44.en: Every house in Egypt got what was coming.
RM_VPS_T2_44.ch: 埃及每一戶都得了該得的.
RM_VPS_T2_44.cn: 埃及每一户都得了该得的.

RM_VPS_T2_45.en: The marked houses got what was coming
RM_VPS_T2_45.ch: 帶著銘印的那些房子, 該來的
RM_VPS_T2_45.cn: 带着铭印的那些房子, 该来的

RM_VPS_T2_47.en: Now the knife that took that lamb was sharp.
RM_VPS_T2_47.ch: 取了那羊羔性命的刀, 是鋒利的.
RM_VPS_T2_47.cn: 取了那羊羔性命的刀, 是锋利的.

RM_VPS_T2_48.en: Somebody knew how to do it quick,

RM_VPS_T2_49.en: because a dull blade makes a thing suffer,
RM_VPS_T2_49.ch: 因為鈍刃會讓一條性命受苦,
RM_VPS_T2_49.cn: 因为钝刃会让一条性命受苦,

RM_VPS_T2_50.en: and they were not permitted to make it suffer.
RM_VPS_T2_50.ch: 而他們不被允許讓牠受苦.
RM_VPS_T2_50.cn: 而他们不被允许让它受苦.

RM_VPS_T2_51.en: And that lamb had done nothing.
RM_VPS_T2_51.ch: 而那羊羔什麼也沒做過.
RM_VPS_T2_51.cn: 而那羊羔什么也没做过.

RM_VPS_T2_52.en: What was done to it was an[col=191,102,255] execution[/].
RM_VPS_T2_52.ch: 對牠所做的, 是一場[col=191,102,255]處決[/].
RM_VPS_T2_52.cn: 对它所做的, 是一场[col=191,102,255]处决[/].

RM_VPS_T2_53.en: It is not a sacrifice if nothing dies.
RM_VPS_T2_53.ch: 若沒有東西死去, 那就不是獻祭.
RM_VPS_T2_53.cn: 若没有东西死去, 那就不是献祭.

RM_VPS_T2_54.en: There was a cost. There is always a cost.
RM_VPS_T2_54.ch: 這是有代價的. 從來都有代價.
RM_VPS_T2_54.cn: 这是有代价的. 从来都有代价.

RM_VPS_T2_55.en: Somebody's hands were not clean that night.
RM_VPS_T2_55.ch: 那一夜, 有人的手是不乾淨的.
RM_VPS_T2_55.cn: 那一夜, 有人的手是不干净的.

RM_VPS_T2_56.ch: 希伯來書第九章第二十二節.
RM_VPS_T2_56.cn: 希伯来书第九章第二十二节.

RM_VPS_T2_60.en: There is no other door. There never was.
RM_VPS_T2_60.ch: 沒有別的門. 從來沒有.
RM_VPS_T2_60.cn: 没有别的门. 从来没有.

RM_VPS_T2_61.en: You do not get bound to a thing for free.
RM_VPS_T2_61.ch: 你不可能白白就與一樣東西結下羈絆.
RM_VPS_T2_61.cn: 你不可能白白就与一样东西结下羁绊.

RM_VPS_T2_62.en: And while we are stood in Hebrews nine -
RM_VPS_T2_62.ch: 既然我們還站在希伯來書第九章 -
RM_VPS_T2_62.cn: 既然我们还站在希伯来书第九章 -

RM_VPS_T2_63.en: verse fourteen. Put a finger in it.
RM_VPS_T2_63.ch: 第十四節. 用手指夾住這一頁.
RM_VPS_T2_63.cn: 第十四节. 用手指夹住这一页.

RM_VPS_T2_65.en: offered himself without spot to God..."
RM_VPS_T2_65.ch: 將自己無瑕無疵獻給神…"
RM_VPS_T2_65.cn: 将自己无瑕无疵献给神…"

RM_VPS_T2_68.en: I am not ready and neither are you.
RM_VPS_T2_68.ch: 我還沒預備好, 你們也沒有.
RM_VPS_T2_68.cn: 我还没预备好, 你们也没有.

RM_VPS_T2_69.en: Leave the finger in. We come back.
RM_VPS_T2_69.ch: 手指別拿開. 我們會回來.
RM_VPS_T2_69.cn: 手指别拿开. 我们会回来.

RM_VPS_T2_70.en: Now some of you are in a[col=217,31,31] covenant[/],
RM_VPS_T2_70.ch: 你們有些人正在一個[col=217,31,31]盟約[/]裡,
RM_VPS_T2_70.cn: 你们有些人正在一个[col=217,31,31]盟约[/]里,

RM_VPS_T2_71.en: and the feeling has gone out of it.
RM_VPS_T2_71.ch: 而那份感覺已經從裡面走了.
RM_VPS_T2_71.cn: 而那份感觉已经从里面走了.

RM_VPS_T2_72.en: You promised when you were full of something,
RM_VPS_T2_72.ch: 你許諾的時候, 心裡是滿的,
RM_VPS_T2_72.cn: 你许诺的时候, 心里是满的,

RM_VPS_T2_74.en: and you are still keeping it.

RM_VPS_T2_75.ch: 親愛的, 那不是失敗.
RM_VPS_T2_75.cn: 亲爱的, 那不是失败.

RM_VPS_T2_77.en: and it is the greater half of the thing.
RM_VPS_T2_77.ch: 而那才是這件事更重的一半.
RM_VPS_T2_77.cn: 而那才是这件事更重的一半.

RM_VPS_T2_78.en: A[col=217,31,31] covenant[/] is not the feeling.
RM_VPS_T2_78.ch: 一個[col=217,31,31]盟約[/]不是那份感覺.
RM_VPS_T2_78.cn: 一个[col=217,31,31]盟约[/]不是那份感觉.

RM_VPS_T2_79.en: It is the mark on the door

RM_VPS_T2_80.en: after the feeling has left the house.
RM_VPS_T2_80.ch: 在感覺離開了這屋子之後.
RM_VPS_T2_80.cn: 在感觉离开了这屋子之后.

RM_VPS_T2_81.en: The[col=217,31,31] blood[/] on that door asked no questions.
RM_VPS_T2_81.ch: 門上那[col=217,31,31]血[/]沒有問過任何問題.
RM_VPS_T2_81.cn: 门上那[col=217,31,31]血[/]没有问过任何问题.

RM_VPS_T2_82.en: It marked them, and what was marked belonged,
RM_VPS_T2_82.ch: 它給他們立了銘印, 凡帶了銘印的就有了歸屬,
RM_VPS_T2_82.cn: 它给他们立了铭印, 凡带了铭印的就有了归属,

RM_VPS_T2_84.en: Whatever you have put your[col=217,31,31] blood[/] into -
RM_VPS_T2_84.ch: 凡是你把[col=217,31,31]血[/]投進去的東西 -
RM_VPS_T2_84.cn: 凡是你把[col=217,31,31]血[/]投进去的东西 -

RM_VPS_T2_88.en: you are marked to it now.
RM_VPS_T2_88.ch: 你如今已經被銘印在它上面了.
RM_VPS_T2_88.cn: 你如今已经被铭印在它上面了.

RM_VPS_T2_90.ch: 不是那句許諾. 是那道銘印.
RM_VPS_T2_90.cn: 不是那句许诺. 是那道铭印.

RM_VPS_T2_91.en: Now go back with me to verse two.
RM_VPS_T2_91.ch: 現在, 跟我回到第二節.
RM_VPS_T2_91.cn: 现在, 跟我回到第二节.

RM_VPS_T2_92.en: A new year, counted from a doorframe in the dark.
RM_VPS_T2_92.ch: 新的一年, 從黑暗裡的一道門框算起.
RM_VPS_T2_92.cn: 新的一年, 从黑暗里的一道门框算起.

RM_VPS_T2_93.en: That is a[col=217,31,31] rebirth[/], and it is not gentle.
RM_VPS_T2_93.ch: 那是一次[col=217,31,31]重生[/], 而它並不溫柔.
RM_VPS_T2_93.cn: 那是一次[col=217,31,31]重生[/], 而它并不温柔.

RM_VPS_T2_95.ch: 你的年曆才會從頭算起.
RM_VPS_T2_95.cn: 你的年历才会从头算起.

RM_VPS_T2_97.ch: 郵政信箱 41 號, 肯塔基州羅斯伍德.
RM_VPS_T2_97.cn: 邮政信箱 41 号, 肯塔基州罗斯伍德.

RM_VPS_T2_98.en: Tape two of three. There is one more.
RM_VPS_T2_98.ch: 三卷之中的第二卷. 還有一卷.
RM_VPS_T2_98.cn: 三卷之中的第二卷. 还有一卷.

RM_VPS_T2_HYMN1.en: [img=music] What can wash away my sin [img=music]

RM_VPS_T2_HYMN2.en: [img=music] Nothing but the[col=217,31,31] blood[/] of Jesus [img=music]

RM_VPS_T2_HYMN3.en: [img=music] What can make me whole again [img=music]

RM_VPS_T2_HYMN4.en: [img=music] Nothing but the[col=217,31,31] blood[/] of Jesus [img=music]

RM_VPS_T3_02.en: Last of the three. We are recording.
RM_VPS_T3_02.ch: 三卷中的最後一卷. 我們正在錄音.
RM_VPS_T3_02.cn: 三卷中的最后一卷. 我们正在录音.

RM_VPS_T3_03.ch: 希伯來書第十二章第二十四節.
RM_VPS_T3_03.cn: 希伯来书第十二章第二十四节.

RM_VPS_T3_08.en: Six weeks, and the Book walked us
RM_VPS_T3_08.ch: 六週了, 聖經把我們
RM_VPS_T3_08.cn: 六周了, 圣经把我们

RM_VPS_T3_10.en: and I did not plan it.

RM_VPS_T3_100.en: He is not going to lose His nerve

RM_VPS_T3_101.en: at the side of your grave.

RM_VPS_T3_102.en: You will go in the ground. Every one of you.
RM_VPS_T3_102.ch: 你們都要進土裡. 每一個都是.
RM_VPS_T3_102.cn: 你们都要进土里. 每一个都是.

RM_VPS_T3_103.en: Tommy, you too, and I'm sorry, son.
RM_VPS_T3_103.ch: 湯米, 你也是, 對不起, 孩子.
RM_VPS_T3_103.cn: 汤米, 你也是, 对不起, 孩子.

RM_VPS_T3_104.en: And you will be[col=217,31,31] undying[/] anyway,

RM_VPS_T3_105.en: because what is in you does not die.
RM_VPS_T3_105.ch: 因為在你裡面的那個, 不會死.
RM_VPS_T3_105.cn: 因为在你里面的那个, 不会死.

RM_VPS_T3_106.ch: 湯米睡著了. 讓他睡.
RM_VPS_T3_106.cn: 汤米睡着了. 让他睡.

RM_VPS_T3_108.ch: 郵政信箱 41 號, 肯塔基州羅斯伍德.
RM_VPS_T3_108.cn: 邮政信箱 41 号, 肯塔基州罗斯伍德.

RM_VPS_T3_109.en: That's the three. I don't have a four in me.
RM_VPS_T3_109.ch: 這就是三卷. 我裡頭沒有第四卷.
RM_VPS_T3_109.cn: 这就是三卷. 我里头没有第四卷.

RM_VPS_T3_11.en: Abel's[col=217,31,31] blood[/] said one word from that ground.
RM_VPS_T3_11.ch: 亞伯的[col=217,31,31]血[/]從那地裡只說了一個字.
RM_VPS_T3_11.cn: 亚伯的[col=217,31,31]血[/]从那地里只说了一个字.

RM_VPS_T3_110.en: God bless you and keep you.
RM_VPS_T3_110.ch: 願神賜福給你, 也保護你.
RM_VPS_T3_110.cn: 愿神赐福给你, 也保护你.

RM_VPS_T3_12.en: It said vengeance. And it was owed it.
RM_VPS_T3_12.ch: 它說的是復仇. 而那本就是欠它的.
RM_VPS_T3_12.cn: 它说的是复仇. 而那本就是欠它的.

RM_VPS_T3_14.en: Both of them are still speaking.

RM_VPS_T3_16.en: Abel was a long time in the ground.
RM_VPS_T3_16.ch: 亞伯在地裡已經很久了.
RM_VPS_T3_16.cn: 亚伯在地里已经很久了.

RM_VPS_T3_17.en: His body was gone. His voice was not.
RM_VPS_T3_17.ch: 他的身體沒了. 他的聲音沒有.
RM_VPS_T3_17.cn: 他的身体没了. 他的声音没有.

RM_VPS_T3_18.en: Now. Tape one. I told you to hold a farmer.
RM_VPS_T3_18.ch: 現在. 第一卷. 我叫你們記住一個種地的.
RM_VPS_T3_18.cn: 现在. 第一卷. 我叫你们记住一个种地的.

RM_VPS_T3_20.en: Cain was a tiller of the ground.

RM_VPS_T3_21.en: And what he put into that field was his brother.
RM_VPS_T3_21.ch: 而他種進那片田裡的, 是他的兄弟.

RM_Tikitown_ProximaVHS_Name.en: VHS - Proxima Medical: First Aid Certification
RM_Tikitown_ProximaVHS_Name.ch: VHS: Proxima醫療 - 急救認證
RM_Tikitown_ProximaVHS_Name.cn: VHS: Proxima医疗 - 急救认证

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L01.en: Welcome to Proxima Medical, and congratulations on joining the team.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L01.ch: 歡迎加入Proxima醫療, 也恭喜你成為團隊的一員.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L01.cn: 欢迎来到Proxima医疗, 恭喜你加入这个团队.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L02.en: This tape covers your First Aid certification. Every associate completes it before working the floor.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L02.ch: 這卷帶子是你的急救認證課程. 每位員工正式上工前都必須完成這門課程.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L02.cn: 这盒录像带是你的急救认证课程. 每位员工上岗前都必须完成这门课程.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L03.en: Keep your handbook open to section four and follow along at your own pace.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L03.ch: 把手冊翻到第四節放在旁邊, 照自己的步調跟著做.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L03.cn: 把手册翻到第四节放在旁边, 按自己的节奏跟着做.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L04.en: Safety comes first here. The techniques on this tape have saved lives, including some of our own.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L04.ch: 在這裡安全第一. 這卷帶子裡的技術救過人命, 其中也包括我們自己的同事.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L04.cn: 在这里安全第一. 这盒录像带里的技术救过人命, 其中也包括我们自己的同事.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L05.en: Retrieve the training dummy at your station. Module one: wound dressing. Wrap firm and even, and follow along.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L05.ch: 去拿你工作站上的練習假人. 第一單元: 傷口包紮. 纏得紮實均勻, 跟著做.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L05.cn: 去取你工位上的练习假人. 第一单元: 伤口包扎. 缠得紧实均匀, 跟着做.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L06.en: Take your time with each drill. Slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L06.ch: 每個演練都慢慢來. 慢就是穩, 穩就是快.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L06.cn: 每个练习都慢慢来. 慢就是稳, 稳就是快.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L07.en: When you finish, your supervisor will have a sign-off sheet to confirm your certification.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L07.ch: 做完之後, 你的主管手上有一張簽核表, 用來確認你的認證.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L07.cn: 完成之后, 你的主管手上有一张签字确认表, 用来确认你的认证.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L08.en: Module two: the sterile field. Always disinfect before you dress a wound. A clean wound heals faster.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L08.ch: 第二單元: 無菌區. 包紮傷口前一定要先消毒. 乾淨的傷口好得更快.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L08.cn: 第二单元: 无菌区. 包扎伤口前一定要先消毒. 干净的伤口愈合更快.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L09.en: Excellent, all clean. Proxima was founded on a simple idea: good medicine should reach the people who need it.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L09.ch: 很好, 都乾淨了. Proxima創立的理念很簡單: 好的醫療應該送到需要的人手上.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L09.cn: 很好, 都干净了. Proxima创立的理念很简单: 好的医疗应该送到需要的人手里.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L10.en: Module three: foreign body removal. Use tweezers, keep your hands steady, and clear the site before closing.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L10.ch: 第三單元: 取出異物. 用鑷子, 手要穩, 縫合前先把傷口清乾淨.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L10.cn: 第三单元: 取出异物. 用镊子, 手要稳, 缝合前先把伤口清理干净.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L11.en: If a step doesn't click the first time, rewind and run it again. Repetition is how this becomes second nature.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L11.ch: 某個步驟第一次沒抓到訣竅, 就倒帶重看一次. 反覆練習才能變成本能.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L11.cn: 某个步骤第一次没掌握, 就倒带重看一遍. 反复练习才能变成本能.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L12.en: You're doing well. Most associates find the second half easier once the basics settle in.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L12.ch: 你表現得很好. 多數員工把基礎練熟之後, 都覺得後半段輕鬆多了.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L12.cn: 你表现得很好. 多数员工把基础掌握牢之后, 都觉得后半段轻松多了.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L13.en: Module four: immobilization. A proper splint keeps an injured limb stable until you can get help.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L13.ch: 第四單元: 固定. 正確的夾板能讓受傷的肢體保持穩定, 撐到你找到援助.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L13.cn: 第四单元: 固定. 正确的夹板能让受伤的肢体保持稳定, 撑到你找到救援.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L14.en: Our associates take real pride in looking out for one another. That starts with knowing this material.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L14.ch: 我們的員工很自豪能彼此照應. 而這要從熟悉這些內容開始.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L14.cn: 我们的员工很自豪能互相照应. 而这要从熟悉这些内容开始.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L15.en: Module five: suturing. Even spacing, steady tension, and a clean close. Practice until it feels routine.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L15.ch: 第五單元: 縫合. 針距均勻, 張力穩定, 收口乾淨. 練到變成習慣動作為止.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L15.cn: 第五单元: 缝合. 针距均匀, 张力稳定, 收口干净. 练到成为习惯动作为止.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L16.en: Almost there. One more module, and it's the one that ties everything together.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L16.ch: 快到了. 還剩一個單元, 而它會把前面全部串起來.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L16.cn: 快到了. 还剩一个单元, 而它会把前面所有内容串起来.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L17.en: Keep your skills sharp, this will be an annual re-training requirement for continued employment at Proxima.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L17.ch: 保持技術純熟, 這門課是在Proxima繼續任職的年度複訓要求.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L17.cn: 保持技术熟练, 这门课是在Proxima继续任职的年度复训要求.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L18.en: Module six: full trauma response. Every technique in sequence, performed perfectly now and under pressure. This is what it all builds toward.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L18.ch: 第六單元: 完整創傷處置. 所有技術依序操作, 現在要做到完美, 壓力下也要做到. 前面所有課程都是為了這一關.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L18.cn: 第六单元: 完整创伤处理. 所有技术按顺序操作, 现在要做到完美, 有压力时也一样. 前面所有课程都是为了这一关.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L19.en: That completes the practical portion. Please turn your supervisor signed certification with Human Resources on the second floor.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L19.cn: 实操部分到此结束. 请把主管签好的认证交到二楼的人力资源部.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L20.en: Welcome to Proxima Medical. We're glad to have you. See your supervisor for your floor assignment.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L20.cn: 欢迎来到Proxima医疗. 很高兴你能加入. 去找你的主管确认你的楼层岗位分配.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000003.cn: 方舟由两台 GX-9 发电机供电.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000004.en: One unit serves as the primary generator.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000004.ch: 其中一台作為主發電機.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000004.cn: 其中一台作为主发电机.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000005.en: The second unit acts as backup power.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000006.cn: 发电机系统由 NOAH 中央计算机监控.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000007.cn: 燃料存量和运行状况可通过 NOAH 终端检查.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000008.en: Fuel is supplied through the external surface inlet system.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000008.ch: 燃料經由地面外部注油口系統供應.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000008.cn: 燃料通过地面外部加注口系统供应.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000009.en: Refueling operations should be performed carefully.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000012.cn: 润滑剂能减少机械磨损.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000014.ch: 冷卻液能提升散熱效率.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000014.cn: 冷却液能提高散热效率.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000015.en: Proper coolant levels reduce fuel consumption.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000015.ch: 適當的冷卻液量能降低燃料消耗.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000015.cn: 适当的冷却液量能降低燃料消耗.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000016.ch: 留意發電機是否有異常噪音或冒煙.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000016.cn: 留意发电机是否有异常噪音或冒烟.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000017.ch: 受損的發電機會消耗更多燃料.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000017.cn: 受损的发电机会消耗更多燃料.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000018.en: Qualified personnel may repair generators using spare parts.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000018.ch: 合格人員可使用備用零件修理發電機.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000018.cn: 合格人员可使用备用零件修理发电机.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000019.en: Technical skill is required for advanced repairs.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000019.ch: 進階維修需要技術能力.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000019.cn: 高级维修需要技术能力.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000020.en: Do not operate heavily damaged systems.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000020.ch: 請勿操作嚴重受損的系統.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000020.cn: 请勿操作严重受损的系统.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000021.en: Loss of generator power may compromise Ark survival.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000021.ch: 失去發電機電力可能危及方舟的存續.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000021.cn: 失去发电机电力可能危及方舟的存续.
